verses.textZh: 有福的人： 不从恶人的计谋， 不站罪人的道路， 不坐好讥笑的人的座位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有福的人： 不从恶人的计谋， 不站罪人的道路， 不坐好讥笑的人的座位。
verses.textZhCuv: 不从恶人的计谋， 不站罪人的道路， 不坐亵慢人的座位，
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one who does not walk in step with the wicked or stand in the way that sinners take or sit in the company of mockers,
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the man who walks not in the counsel of the wicked, nor stands in the way of sinners, nor sits in the seat of scoffers;
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is the man Who walks not in the counsel of the ungodly, Nor stands in the path of sinners, Nor sits in the seat of the scornful;
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, the joys of those who do not follow the advice of the wicked, or stand around with sinners, or join in with mockers.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the person who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, Nor stand in the path of sinners, Nor sit in the seat of scoffers!
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one who does not walk in step with the wicked or stand in the way that sinners take or sit in the company of mockers,

verses.textZh: 他喜爱的是耶和华的律法， 他昼夜默诵的也是耶和华的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他喜爱的是耶和华的律法， 他昼夜默诵的也是耶和华的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟喜爱耶和华的律法， 昼夜思想， 这人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: but whose delight is in the law of the Lord , and who meditates on his law day and night.
verses.textEnEsv: but his delight is in the law of the Lord , and on his law he meditates day and night.
verses.textEnNkjv: But his delight is in the law of the Lord, And in His law he meditates day and night.
verses.textEnNlt: But they delight in the law of the Lord , meditating on it day and night.
verses.textEnNasb: But his delight is in the Law of the Lord, And on His Law he meditates day and night.
verses.textEn: but whose delight is in the law of the Lord , and who meditates on his law day and night.

verses.textZh: 他像一棵树，栽在溪水旁， 按时结果子， 叶子总不枯干； 他所作的一切，尽都顺利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他像一棵树，栽在溪水旁， 按时结果子， 叶子总不枯干； 他所作的一切，尽都顺利。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要像一棵树栽在溪水旁， 按时候结果子， 叶子也不枯干。 凡他所做的尽都顺利。
verses.textEnNiv: That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither— whatever they do prospers.
verses.textEnEsv: He is like a tree planted by streams of water that yields its fruit in its season, and its leaf does not wither. In all that he does, he prospers.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall be like a tree Planted by the rivers of water, That brings forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also shall not wither; And whatever he does shall prosper.
verses.textEnNlt: They are like trees planted along the riverbank, bearing fruit each season. Their leaves never wither, and they prosper in all they do.
verses.textEnNasb: He will be like a tree planted by streams of water, Which yields its fruit in its season, And its leaf does not wither; And in whatever he does, he prospers.
verses.textEn: That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither— whatever they do prospers.

verses.textZh: 恶人却不是这样， 他们好象糠秕， 被风吹散。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人却不是这样， 他们好象糠秕， 被风吹散。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人并不是这样， 乃像糠秕被风吹散。
verses.textEnNiv: Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked are not so, but are like chaff that the wind drives away.
verses.textEnNkjv: The ungodly are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
verses.textEnNlt: But not the wicked! They are like worthless chaff, scattered by the wind.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked are not so, But they are like chaff which the wind blows away.
verses.textEn: Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.

verses.textZh: 因此，在审判的时候，恶人必站立不住； 在义人的团体中，罪人也必这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，在审判的时候，恶人必站立不住； 在义人的团体中，罪人也必这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，当审判的时候、恶人必站立不住； 罪人在义人的会中也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous;
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: They will be condemned at the time of judgment. Sinners will have no place among the godly.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
verses.textEn: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华看顾义人的道路， 恶人的道路却必灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华看顾义人的道路， 恶人的道路却必灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华知道义人的道路； 恶人的道路却必灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked leads to destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: for the Lord knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord knows the way of the righteous, But the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord watches over the path of the godly, but the path of the wicked leads to destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord knows the way of the righteous, But the way of the wicked will perish.
verses.textEn: For the Lord watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked leads to destruction.

verses.textZh: 列国为甚么骚动？ 万民为甚么空谋妄想？
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国为甚么骚动？ 万民为甚么空谋妄想？
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦为什么争闹？ 万民为什么谋算虚妄的事？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do the nations rage, And the people plot a vain thing?
verses.textEnNlt: Why are the nations so angry? Why do they waste their time with futile plans?
verses.textEnNasb: Why are the nations restless And the peoples plotting in vain?
verses.textEn: Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?

verses.textZh: 世上的君王起来， 首领聚在一起， 敌对耶和华和他所膏立的，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上的君王起来， 首领聚在一起， 敌对耶和华和他所膏立的，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 世上的君王一齐起来， 臣宰一同商议， 要敌挡耶和华并他的受膏者，
verses.textEnNiv: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord and against his Anointed, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against the Lord and against His Anointed, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The kings of the earth prepare for battle; the rulers plot together against the Lord and against his anointed one.
verses.textEnNasb: The kings of the earth take their stand And the rulers conspire together Against the Lord and against His Anointed, saying,
verses.textEn: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed, saying,

verses.textZh: "我们来挣断他们给我们的束缚， 摆脱他们的绳索！"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们来挣断他们给我们的束缚， 摆脱他们的绳索！"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：我们要挣开他们的捆绑， 脱去他们的绳索。
verses.textEnNiv: "Let us break their chains and throw off their shackles."
verses.textEnEsv: "Let us burst their bonds apart and cast away their cords from us."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Let us break Their bonds in pieces And cast away Their cords from us."
verses.textEnNlt: "Let us break their chains," they cry, "and free ourselves from slavery to God."
verses.textEnNasb: "Let’s tear their shackles apart And throw their ropes away from us!"
verses.textEn: "Let us break their chains and throw off their shackles."

verses.textZh: 那坐在天上的必发笑， 主必讥笑他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那坐在天上的必发笑， 主必讥笑他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那坐在天上的必发笑； 主必嗤笑他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.
verses.textEnEsv: He who sits in the heavens laughs; the Lord holds them in derision.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who sits in the heavens shall laugh; The Lord shall hold them in derision.
verses.textEnNlt: But the one who rules in heaven laughs. The Lord scoffs at them.
verses.textEnNasb: He who sits in the heavens laughs, The Lord scoffs at them.
verses.textEn: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.

verses.textZh: 那时，他必在烈怒中对他们讲话， 在震怒中使他们惊慌，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，他必在烈怒中对他们讲话， 在震怒中使他们惊慌，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，他要在怒中责备他们， 在烈怒中惊吓他们，
verses.textEnNiv: He rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he will speak to them in his wrath, and terrify them in his fury, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He shall speak to them in His wrath, And distress them in His deep displeasure:
verses.textEnNlt: Then in anger he rebukes them, terrifying them with his fierce fury.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He will speak to them in His anger And terrify them in His fury, saying,
verses.textEn: He rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,

verses.textZh: "我已经在锡安我的圣山上， 立了我的君王。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我已经在锡安我的圣山上， 立了我的君王。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：我已经立我的君 在锡安－我的圣山上了。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have installed my king on Zion, my holy mountain."
verses.textEnEsv: "As for me, I have set my King on Zion, my holy hill."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet I have set My King On My holy hill of Zion."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord declares, "I have placed my chosen king on the throne in Jerusalem, on my holy mountain."
verses.textEnNasb: "But as for Me, I have installed My King Upon Zion, My holy mountain."
verses.textEn: "I have installed my king on Zion, my holy mountain."

verses.textZh: 受膏者说："我要宣告耶和华的谕旨： 耶和华对我说：‘你是我的儿子， 我今日生了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 受膏者说："我要宣告耶和华的谕旨： 耶和华对我说：‘你是我的儿子， 我今日生了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 受膏者说：我要传圣旨。 耶和华曾对我说：你是我的儿子， 我今日生你。
verses.textEnNiv: I will proclaim the Lord ’s decree: He said to me, "You are my son; today I have become your father.
verses.textEnEsv: I will tell of the decree: The Lord said to me, "You are my Son; today I have begotten you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will declare the decree: The Lord has said to Me, ‘You are My Son, Today I have begotten You.
verses.textEnNlt: The king proclaims the Lord ’s decree: "The Lord said to me, ‘You are my son. Today I have become your Father.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will announce the decree of the Lord: He said to Me, ‘You are My Son, Today I have fathered You.
verses.textEn: I will proclaim the Lord ’s decree: He said to me, "You are my son; today I have become your father.

verses.textZh: 你求我，我就把列国赐给你作产业， 把全地都归属于你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你求我，我就把列国赐给你作产业， 把全地都归属于你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你求我，我就将列国赐你为基业， 将地极赐你为田产。
verses.textEnNiv: Ask me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.
verses.textEnEsv: Ask of me, and I will make the nations your heritage, and the ends of the earth your possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ask of Me, and I will give You The nations for Your inheritance, And the ends of the earth for Your possession.
verses.textEnNlt: Only ask, and I will give you the nations as your inheritance, the whole earth as your possession.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Ask it of Me, and I will certainly give the nations as Your inheritance, And the ends of the earth as Your possession.
verses.textEn: Ask me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.

verses.textZh: 你必用铁杖击打他们， 好象打碎陶器一样粉碎他们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必用铁杖击打他们， 好象打碎陶器一样粉碎他们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必用铁杖打破他们； 你必将他们如同窑匠的瓦器摔碎。
verses.textEnNiv: You will break them with a rod of iron ; you will dash them to pieces like pottery."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall break them with a rod of iron and dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall break them with a rod of iron; You shall dash them to pieces like a potter’s vessel.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You will break them with an iron rod and smash them like clay pots.’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You shall break them with a rod of iron, You shall shatter them like earthenware.’ "
verses.textEn: You will break them with a rod of iron ; you will dash them to pieces like pottery."

verses.textZh: 现在，君王啊！你们要谨慎。 地上的审判官啊！你们应当听劝告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，君王啊！你们要谨慎。 地上的审判官啊！你们应当听劝告。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在，你们君王应当省悟！ 你们世上的审判官该受管教！
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, you kings, be wise; be warned, you rulers of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, O kings, be wise; be warned, O rulers of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, be wise, O kings; Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Now then, you kings, act wisely! Be warned, you rulers of the earth!
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, you kings, use insight; Let yourselves be instructed, you judges of the earth.
verses.textEn: Therefore, you kings, be wise; be warned, you rulers of the earth.

verses.textZh: 你们要以敬畏的态度事奉耶和华， 又应当存战兢的心而欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要以敬畏的态度事奉耶和华， 又应当存战兢的心而欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 当存畏惧事奉耶和华， 又当存战兢而快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Serve the Lord with fear and celebrate his rule with trembling.
verses.textEnEsv: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.textEnNkjv: Serve the Lord with fear, And rejoice with trembling.
verses.textEnNlt: Serve the Lord with reverent fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.textEnNasb: Serve the Lord with reverence And rejoice with trembling.
verses.textEn: Serve the Lord with fear and celebrate his rule with trembling.

verses.textZh: 你们要用嘴亲吻子， 否则他一发怒，你们就在路上灭亡， 因为他的怒气快要发作。 凡是投靠他的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要用嘴亲吻子， 否则他一发怒，你们就在路上灭亡， 因为他的怒气快要发作。 凡是投靠他的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 当以嘴亲子，恐怕他发怒， 你们便在道中灭亡， 因为他的怒气快要发作。 凡投靠他的，都是有福的。
verses.textEnNiv: Kiss his son, or he will be angry and your way will lead to your destruction, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
verses.textEnEsv: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish in the way, for his wrath is quickly kindled. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry, And you perish in the way, When His wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all those who put their trust in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Submit to God’s royal son, or he will become angry, and you will be destroyed in the midst of all your activities— for his anger flares up in an instant. But what joy for all who take refuge in him!
verses.textEnNasb: Kiss the Son, that He not be angry and you perish on the way, For His wrath may be kindled quickly. How blessed are all who take refuge in Him!
verses.textEn: Kiss his son, or he will be angry and your way will lead to your destruction, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，是在逃避他儿子押沙龙时作的。 耶和华啊！我的仇敌竟然这么多。 起来攻击我的竟然那么多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，是在逃避他儿子押沙龙时作的。 耶和华啊！我的仇敌竟然这么多。 起来攻击我的竟然那么多。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我的敌人何其加增； 有许多人起来攻击我。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , how many are my foes! How many rise up against me!
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , how many are my foes! Many are rising against me;
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, how they have increased who trouble me! Many are they who rise up against me.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , I have so many enemies; so many are against me.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, how my enemies have increased! Many are rising up against me.
verses.textEn: Lord , how many are my foes! How many rise up against me!

verses.textZh: 有很多人议论我说： "他从神那里得不到救助。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有很多人议论我说： "他从神那里得不到救助。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多人议论我说： 他得不着神的帮助。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Many are saying of me, "God will not deliver him."
verses.textEnEsv: many are saying of my soul, "There is no salvation for him in God." Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Many are they who say of me, "Thereis no help for him in God." Selah
verses.textEnNlt: So many are saying, "God will never rescue him!" Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Many are saying of my soul, "There is no salvation for him in God." Selah
verses.textEn: Many are saying of me, "God will not deliver him."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你却是我周围的盾牌， 是我的荣耀，是使我抬起头来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你却是我周围的盾牌， 是我的荣耀，是使我抬起头来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你－耶和华是我四围的盾牌， 是我的荣耀，又是叫我抬起头来的。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, Lord , are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O Lord , are a shield about me, my glory, and the lifter of my head.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, O Lord, are a shield for me, My glory and the One who lifts up my head.
verses.textEnNlt: But you, O Lord , are a shield around me; you are my glory, the one who holds my head high.
verses.textEnNasb: But You, Lord, are a shield around me, My glory, and the One who lifts my head.
verses.textEn: But you, Lord , are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

verses.textZh: 我发声向耶和华呼求的时候， 他就从他的圣山上回答我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我发声向耶和华呼求的时候， 他就从他的圣山上回答我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我用我的声音求告耶和华， 他就从他的圣山上应允我。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: I call out to the Lord , and he answers me from his holy mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: I cried aloud to the Lord , and he answered me from his holy hill. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: I cried to the Lord with my voice, And He heard me from His holy hill. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: I cried out to the Lord , and he answered me from his holy mountain. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: I was crying out to the Lord with my voice, And He answered me from His holy mountain. Selah
verses.textEn: I call out to the Lord , and he answers me from his holy mountain.

verses.textZh: 我躺下，我睡觉， 我醒来，都因耶和华在扶持着我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我躺下，我睡觉， 我醒来，都因耶和华在扶持着我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我躺下睡觉，我醒着， 耶和华都保佑我。
verses.textEnNiv: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, because the Lord sustains me.
verses.textEnEsv: I lay down and slept; I woke again, for the Lord sustained me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I lay down and slept; I awoke, for the Lord sustained me.
verses.textEnNlt: I lay down and slept, yet I woke up in safety, for the Lord was watching over me.
verses.textEnNasb: I lay down and slept; I awoke, for the Lord sustains me.
verses.textEn: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, because the Lord sustains me.

verses.textZh: 虽有千万人包围攻击我， 我也不怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽有千万人包围攻击我， 我也不怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有成万的百姓来周围攻击我， 我也不怕。
verses.textEnNiv: I will not fear though tens of thousands assail me on every side.
verses.textEnEsv: I will not be afraid of many thousands of people who have set themselves against me all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people Who have set themselves against me all around.
verses.textEnNlt: I am not afraid of ten thousand enemies who surround me on every side.
verses.textEnNasb: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people Who have set themselves against me all around.
verses.textEn: I will not fear though tens of thousands assail me on every side.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你起来； 我的神啊！求你拯救我， 你击打了我所有仇敌的脸颊， 打碎了恶人的牙齿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你起来； 我的神啊！求你拯救我， 你击打了我所有仇敌的脸颊， 打碎了恶人的牙齿。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你起来！ 我的神啊，求你救我！ 因为你打了我一切仇敌的腮骨， 敲碎了恶人的牙齿。
verses.textEnNiv: Arise, Lord ! Deliver me, my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, O Lord ! Save me, O my God! For you strike all my enemies on the cheek; you break the teeth of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, O Lord; Save me, O my God! For You have struck all my enemies on the cheekbone; You have broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.textEnNlt: Arise, O Lord ! Rescue me, my God! Slap all my enemies in the face! Shatter the teeth of the wicked!
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, Lord; save me, my God! For You have struck all my enemies on the cheek; You have shattered the teeth of the wicked.
verses.textEn: Arise, Lord ! Deliver me, my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 救恩属于耶和华， 愿你赐福给你的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 救恩属于耶和华， 愿你赐福给你的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 救恩属乎耶和华； 愿你赐福给你的百姓。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: From the Lord comes deliverance. May your blessing be on your people.
verses.textEnEsv: Salvation belongs to the Lord ; your blessing be on your people! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Salvation belongs to the Lord. Your blessing is upon Your people. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Victory comes from you, O Lord . May you bless your people. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Salvation belongs to the Lord; May Your blessing be upon Your people! Selah
verses.textEn: From the Lord comes deliverance. May your blessing be on your people.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。 我公义的神啊 ！ 我呼求的时候，求你答应我。 我在困苦中，你曾使我舒畅。 求你恩待我，听我的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。 我公义的神啊 ！ 我呼求的时候，求你答应我。 我在困苦中，你曾使我舒畅。 求你恩待我，听我的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 显我为义的神啊， 我呼吁的时候，求你应允我！ 我在困苦中，你曾使我宽广； 现在求你怜恤我，听我的祷告！
verses.textEnNiv: Answer me when I call to you, my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have given me relief when I was in distress. Be gracious to me and hear my prayer!
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved me in my distress; Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
verses.textEnNlt: Answer me when I call to you, O God who declares me innocent. Free me from my troubles. Have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness! You have relieved me in my distress; Be gracious to me and hear my prayer.
verses.textEn: Answer me when I call to you, my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.

verses.textZh: 尊贵的人啊！你们把我的荣耀变为羞辱，要到几时呢？ 你们喜爱虚妄，追求虚谎，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 尊贵的人啊！你们把我的荣耀变为羞辱，要到几时呢？ 你们喜爱虚妄，追求虚谎，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这上流人哪，你们将我的尊荣变为羞辱要到几时呢？ 你们喜爱虚妄，寻找虚假，要到几时呢？ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: How long will you people turn my glory into shame? How long will you love delusions and seek false gods ?
verses.textEnEsv: O men, how long shall my honor be turned into shame? How long will you love vain words and seek after lies? Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: How long, O you sons of men, Willyouturn my glory to shame? Howlong will you love worthlessness And seek falsehood? Selah
verses.textEnNlt: How long will you people ruin my reputation? How long will you make groundless accusations? How long will you continue your lies? Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: You sons of man, how long will my honor be treated as an insult? How long will you love what is worthless and strive for a lie? Selah
verses.textEn: How long will you people turn my glory into shame? How long will you love delusions and seek false gods ?

verses.textZh: 你们要知道耶和华已经把虔诚人分别出来，归他自己； 我向耶和华呼求的时候，他就垂听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要知道耶和华已经把虔诚人分别出来，归他自己； 我向耶和华呼求的时候，他就垂听。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要知道，耶和华已经分别虔诚人归他自己； 我求告耶和华，他必听我。
verses.textEnNiv: Know that the Lord has set apart his faithful servant for himself; the Lord hears when I call to him.
verses.textEnEsv: But know that the Lord has set apart the godly for himself; the Lord hears when I call to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But know that the Lord has set apart for Himself him who is godly; The Lord will hear when I call to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: You can be sure of this: The Lord set apart the godly for himself. The Lord will answer when I call to him.
verses.textEnNasb: But know that the Lord has set apart the godly person for Himself; The Lord hears when I call to Him.
verses.textEn: Know that the Lord has set apart his faithful servant for himself; the Lord hears when I call to him.

verses.textZh: 你们生气，却不可犯罪； 在床上的时候，你们要在心里思想，并且要安静。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们生气，却不可犯罪； 在床上的时候，你们要在心里思想，并且要安静。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们应当畏惧，不可犯罪； 在床上的时候，要心里思想，并要肃静。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Tremble and do not sin; when you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent.
verses.textEnEsv: Be angry, and do not sin; ponder in your own hearts on your beds, and be silent. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Be angry, and do not sin. Meditate within your heart on your bed, and be still. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t sin by letting anger control you. Think about it overnight and remain silent. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Tremble, and do not sin; Meditate in your heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah
verses.textEn: Tremble and do not sin; when you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent.

verses.textZh: 你们应当献公义的祭， 也要投靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们应当献公义的祭， 也要投靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 当献上公义的祭， 又当倚靠耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Offer right sacrifices, and put your trust in the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Offer sacrifices in the right spirit, and trust the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And trust in the Lord.
verses.textEn: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the Lord .

verses.textZh: 有许多人说："谁能指示我们得甚么好处呢？" 耶和华啊！求你仰起你的脸，光照我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多人说："谁能指示我们得甚么好处呢？" 耶和华啊！求你仰起你的脸，光照我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多人说：谁能指示我们什么好处？ 耶和华啊，求你仰起脸来，光照我们。
verses.textEnNiv: Many, Lord , are asking, "Who will bring us prosperity?" Let the light of your face shine on us.
verses.textEnEsv: There are many who say, "Who will show us some good? Lift up the light of your face upon us, O Lord !"
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereare many who say, "Who will show us any good?" Lord, lift up the light of Your countenance upon us.
verses.textEnNlt: Many people say, "Who will show us better times?" Let your face smile on us, Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Many are saying, "Who will show us anything good?" Lift up the light of Your face upon us, Lord!
verses.textEn: Many, Lord , are asking, "Who will bring us prosperity?" Let the light of your face shine on us.

verses.textZh: 你使我心里喜乐， 胜过人在丰收五谷新酒时的喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我心里喜乐， 胜过人在丰收五谷新酒时的喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我心里快乐， 胜过那丰收五谷新酒的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Fill my heart with joy when their grain and new wine abound.
verses.textEnEsv: You have put more joy in my heart than they have when their grain and wine abound.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have put gladness in my heart, More than in the season that their grain and wine increased.
verses.textEnNlt: You have given me greater joy than those who have abundant harvests of grain and new wine.
verses.textEnNasb: You have put joy in my heart, More than when their grain and new wine are abundant.
verses.textEn: Fill my heart with joy when their grain and new wine abound.

verses.textZh: 我必平平安安躺下睡觉， 因为只有你耶和华能使我安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必平平安安躺下睡觉， 因为只有你耶和华能使我安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必安然躺下睡觉， 因为独有你－耶和华使我安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord , make me dwell in safety.
verses.textEnEsv: In peace I will both lie down and sleep; for you alone, O Lord , make me dwell in safety.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will both lie down in peace, and sleep; For You alone, O Lord, make me dwell in safety.
verses.textEnNlt: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, O Lord , will keep me safe.
verses.textEnNasb: In peace I will both lie down and sleep, For You alone, Lord, have me dwell in safety.
verses.textEn: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord , make me dwell in safety.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用管乐伴奏。 耶和华啊！求你留心听我的话， 顾念我的叹息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用管乐伴奏。 耶和华啊！求你留心听我的话， 顾念我的叹息。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的言语， 顾念我的心思！
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to my words, Lord , consider my lament.
verses.textEnEsv: Give ear to my words, O Lord ; consider my groaning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give ear to my words, O Lord, Consider my meditation.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , hear me as I pray; pay attention to my groaning.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen to my words, Lord, Consider my sighing.
verses.textEn: Listen to my words, Lord , consider my lament.

verses.textZh: 我的王，我的神啊！ 求你倾听我呼求的声音， 因为我向你祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的王，我的神啊！ 求你倾听我呼求的声音， 因为我向你祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的王我的神啊，求你垂听我呼求的声音！ 因为我向你祈祷。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.
verses.textEnEsv: Give attention to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to you do I pray.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give heed to the voice of my cry, My King and my God, For to You I will pray.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to my cry for help, my King and my God, for I pray to no one but you.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen to the sound of my cry for help, my King and my God, For to You I pray.
verses.textEn: Hear my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你在清晨听我的声音； 我要一早向你陈明， 并且迫切等候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你在清晨听我的声音； 我要一早向你陈明， 并且迫切等候。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，早晨你必听我的声音； 早晨我必向你陈明我的心意，并要警醒！
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning, Lord , you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait expectantly.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I prepare a sacrifice for you and watch.
verses.textEnNkjv: My voice You shall hear in the morning, O Lord; In the morning I will direct it to You, And I will look up.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to my voice in the morning, Lord . Each morning I bring my requests to you and wait expectantly.
verses.textEnNasb: In the morning, Lord, You will hear my voice; In the morning I will present my prayer to You and be on the watch.
verses.textEn: In the morning, Lord , you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait expectantly.

verses.textZh: 因为你是不喜爱邪恶的神， 恶人不能与你同住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你是不喜爱邪恶的神， 恶人不能与你同住。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你不是喜悦恶事的神， 恶人不能与你同居。
verses.textEnNiv: For you are not a God who is pleased with wickedness; with you, evil people are not welcome.
verses.textEnEsv: For you are not a God who delights in wickedness; evil may not dwell with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness, Nor shall evil dwell with You.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, you take no pleasure in wickedness; you cannot tolerate the sins of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: For You are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness; No evil can dwell with You.
verses.textEn: For you are not a God who is pleased with wickedness; with you, evil people are not welcome.

verses.textZh: 狂傲的人不能在你眼前站立， 你恨恶所有作恶的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 狂傲的人不能在你眼前站立， 你恨恶所有作恶的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前； 凡作孽的，都是你所恨恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: The arrogant cannot stand in your presence. You hate all who do wrong;
verses.textEnEsv: The boastful shall not stand before your eyes; you hate all evildoers.
verses.textEnNkjv: The boastful shall not stand in Your sight; You hate all workers of iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, the proud may not stand in your presence, for you hate all who do evil.
verses.textEnNasb: The boastful will not stand before Your eyes; You hate all who do injustice.
verses.textEn: The arrogant cannot stand in your presence. You hate all who do wrong;

verses.textZh: 你必灭绝说谎话的； 好流人血和弄诡诈的， 都是耶和华所憎恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必灭绝说谎话的； 好流人血和弄诡诈的， 都是耶和华所憎恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 说谎言的，你必灭绝； 好流人血弄诡诈的，都为耶和华所憎恶。
verses.textEnNiv: you destroy those who tell lies. The bloodthirsty and deceitful you, Lord , detest.
verses.textEnEsv: You destroy those who speak lies; the Lord abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall destroy those who speak falsehood; The Lord abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
verses.textEnNlt: You will destroy those who tell lies. The Lord detests murderers and deceivers.
verses.textEnNasb: You destroy those who speak lies; The Lord loathes the person of bloodshed and deceit.
verses.textEn: you destroy those who tell lies. The bloodthirsty and deceitful you, Lord , detest.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我必凭着你丰盛的慈爱， 进入你的殿； 我要存着敬畏你的心， 向你的圣所敬拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我必凭着你丰盛的慈爱， 进入你的殿； 我要存着敬畏你的心， 向你的圣所敬拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我必凭你丰盛的慈爱进入你的居所； 我必存敬畏你的心向你的圣殿下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: But I, by your great love, can come into your house; in reverence I bow down toward your holy temple.
verses.textEnEsv: But I, through the abundance of your steadfast love, will enter your house. I will bow down toward your holy temple in the fear of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for me, I will come into Your house in the multitude of Your mercy; In fear of You I will worship toward Your holy temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of your unfailing love, I can enter your house; I will worship at your Temple with deepest awe.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, by Your abundant graciousness I will enter Your house, At Your holy temple I will bow in reverence for You.
verses.textEn: But I, by your great love, can come into your house; in reverence I bow down toward your holy temple.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你因我仇敌的缘故， 按着你的公义引导我， 在我面前铺平你的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你因我仇敌的缘故， 按着你的公义引导我， 在我面前铺平你的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你因我的仇敌，凭你的公义引领我， 使你的道路在我面前正直。
verses.textEnNiv: Lead me, Lord , in your righteousness because of my enemies— make your way straight before me.
verses.textEnEsv: Lead me, O Lord , in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your way straight before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lead me, O Lord, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; Make Your way straight before my face.
verses.textEnNlt: Lead me in the right path, O Lord , or my enemies will conquer me. Make your way plain for me to follow.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, lead me in Your righteousness because of my enemies; Make Your way straight before me.
verses.textEn: Lead me, Lord , in your righteousness because of my enemies— make your way straight before me.

verses.textZh: 因为他们的口里没有真话， 他们的内心充满毁灭人的意图， 他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓， 他们用舌头弄诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们的口里没有真话， 他们的内心充满毁灭人的意图， 他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓， 他们用舌头弄诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，他们的口中没有诚实； 他们的心里满有邪恶； 他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓； 他们用舌头谄媚人。
verses.textEnNiv: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with malice. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongues they tell lies.
verses.textEnEsv: For there is no truth in their mouth; their inmost self is destruction; their throat is an open grave; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thereis no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is destruction; Their throat is an open tomb; They flatter with their tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies cannot speak a truthful word. Their deepest desire is to destroy others. Their talk is foul, like the stench from an open grave. Their tongues are filled with flattery.
verses.textEnNasb: For there is nothing trustworthy in their mouth; Their inward part is destruction itself. Their throat is an open grave; They flatter with their tongue.
verses.textEn: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with malice. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongues they tell lies.

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你定他们的罪； 愿他们因自己的诡计跌倒， 愿你因他们许多的过犯，把他们赶出去， 因为他们背叛了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你定他们的罪； 愿他们因自己的诡计跌倒， 愿你因他们许多的过犯，把他们赶出去， 因为他们背叛了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你定他们的罪！ 愿他们因自己的计谋跌倒； 愿你在他们许多的过犯中把他们逐出， 因为他们背叛了你。
verses.textEnNiv: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.
verses.textEnEsv: Make them bear their guilt, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; because of the abundance of their transgressions cast them out, for they have rebelled against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pronounce them guilty, O God! Let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions, For they have rebelled against You.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, declare them guilty. Let them be caught in their own traps. Drive them away because of their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.
verses.textEnNasb: Make them pay, God; Have them fall by their own schemes! Scatter them in the multitude of their wrongdoings, For they are rebellious against You.
verses.textEn: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.

verses.textZh: 愿所有投靠你的人都喜乐， 常常欢呼； 愿你保护他们， 又愿爱你名的人，因你欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿所有投靠你的人都喜乐， 常常欢呼； 愿你保护他们， 又愿爱你名的人，因你欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡投靠你的，愿他们喜乐，时常欢呼， 因为你护庇他们； 又愿那爱你名的人都靠你欢欣。
verses.textEnNiv: But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.
verses.textEnEsv: But let all who take refuge in you rejoice; let them ever sing for joy, and spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may exult in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let all those rejoice who put their trust in You; Let them ever shout for joy, because You defend them; Let those also who love Your name Be joyful in You.
verses.textEnNlt: But let all who take refuge in you rejoice; let them sing joyful praises forever. Spread your protection over them, that all who love your name may be filled with joy.
verses.textEnNasb: But rejoice, all who take refuge in You, Sing for joy forever! And may You shelter them, That those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
verses.textEn: But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！因为你必赐福给义人， 你要以恩惠像盾牌四面护卫他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！因为你必赐福给义人， 你要以恩惠像盾牌四面护卫他。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你必赐福与义人； 耶和华啊，你必用恩惠如同盾牌四面护卫他。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely, Lord , you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.
verses.textEnEsv: For you bless the righteous, O Lord ; you cover him with favor as with a shield.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You, O Lord, will bless the righteous; With favor You will surround him as with a shield.
verses.textEnNlt: For you bless the godly, O Lord ; you surround them with your shield of love.
verses.textEnNasb: For You bless the righteous person, Lord, You surround him with favor as with a shield.
verses.textEn: Surely, Lord , you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏，调用"舍明尼"。 耶和华啊！求你不要在烈怒中责备我， 也不要在气忿中管教我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏，调用"舍明尼"。 耶和华啊！求你不要在烈怒中责备我， 也不要在气忿中管教我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你不要在怒中责备我， 也不要在烈怒中惩罚我！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , rebuke me not in your anger, nor discipline me in your wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, do not rebuke me in Your anger, Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , don’t rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your rage.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, do not rebuke me in Your anger, Nor discipline me in Your wrath.
verses.textEn: Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你恩待我，因为我软弱； 耶和华啊！求你医治我，因为我的骨头发抖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你恩待我，因为我软弱； 耶和华啊！求你医治我，因为我的骨头发抖。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你可怜我，因为我软弱。 耶和华啊，求你医治我，因为我的骨头发战。
verses.textEnNiv: Have mercy on me, Lord , for I am faint; heal me, Lord , for my bones are in agony.
verses.textEnEsv: Be gracious to me, O Lord , for I am languishing; heal me, O Lord , for my bones are troubled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak; O Lord, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
verses.textEnNlt: Have compassion on me, Lord , for I am weak. Heal me, Lord , for my bones are in agony.
verses.textEnNasb: Be gracious to me, Lord, for I am frail; Heal me, Lord, for my bones are horrified.
verses.textEn: Have mercy on me, Lord , for I am faint; heal me, Lord , for my bones are in agony.

verses.textZh: 我的心也大大战栗， 耶和华啊！要等到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心也大大战栗， 耶和华啊！要等到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我心也大大地惊惶。 耶和华啊，你要到几时才救我呢？
verses.textEnNiv: My soul is in deep anguish. How long, Lord , how long?
verses.textEnEsv: My soul also is greatly troubled. But you, O Lord — how long?
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul also is greatly troubled; But You, O Lord—how long?
verses.textEnNlt: I am sick at heart. How long, O Lord , until you restore me?
verses.textEnNasb: And my soul is greatly horrified; But You, Lord—how long?
verses.textEn: My soul is in deep anguish. How long, Lord , how long?

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你回转搭救我， 因你慈爱的缘故拯救我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你回转搭救我， 因你慈爱的缘故拯救我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你转回搭救我！ 因你的慈爱拯救我。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn, Lord , and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn, O Lord , deliver my life; save me for the sake of your steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Return, O Lord, deliver me! Oh, save me for Your mercies’ sake!
verses.textEnNlt: Return, O Lord , and rescue me. Save me because of your unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: Return, Lord, rescue my soul; Save me because of Your mercy.
verses.textEn: Turn, Lord , and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.

verses.textZh: 因为在死亡之地无人记念你， 在阴间有谁称谢你呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在死亡之地无人记念你， 在阴间有谁称谢你呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，在死地无人记念你， 在阴间有谁称谢你？
verses.textEnNiv: Among the dead no one proclaims your name. Who praises you from the grave?
verses.textEnEsv: For in death there is no remembrance of you; in Sheol who will give you praise?
verses.textEnNkjv: For in death thereis no remembrance of You; In the grave who will give You thanks?
verses.textEnNlt: For the dead do not remember you. Who can praise you from the grave?
verses.textEnNasb: For there is no mention of You in death; In Sheol, who will praise You?
verses.textEn: Among the dead no one proclaims your name. Who praises you from the grave?

verses.textZh: 我因悲叹而疲惫， 我夜夜流泪，把床漂起， 把床榻浸透。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因悲叹而疲惫， 我夜夜流泪，把床漂起， 把床榻浸透。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因唉哼而困乏； 我每夜流泪，把床榻漂起， 把褥子湿透。
verses.textEnNiv: I am worn out from my groaning. All night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
verses.textEnEsv: I am weary with my moaning; every night I flood my bed with tears; I drench my couch with my weeping.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am weary with my groaning; All night I make my bed swim; I drench my couch with my tears.
verses.textEnNlt: I am worn out from sobbing. All night I flood my bed with weeping, drenching it with my tears.
verses.textEnNasb: I am weary with my sighing; Every night I make my bed swim, I flood my couch with my tears.
verses.textEn: I am worn out from my groaning. All night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

verses.textZh: 我因愁烦眼目昏花， 因众多的仇敌视力衰退。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因愁烦眼目昏花， 因众多的仇敌视力衰退。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因忧愁眼睛干瘪， 又因我一切的敌人眼睛昏花。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.
verses.textEnEsv: My eye wastes away because of grief; it grows weak because of all my foes.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eye wastes away because of grief; It grows old because of all my enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: My vision is blurred by grief; my eyes are worn out because of all my enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: My eye has wasted away with grief; It has grown old because of all my enemies.
verses.textEn: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.

verses.textZh: 你们所有作恶的人，离开我去吧， 因为耶和华听了我哀哭的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所有作恶的人，离开我去吧， 因为耶和华听了我哀哭的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们一切作孽的人，离开我吧！ 因为耶和华听了我哀哭的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: Away from me, all you who do evil, for the Lord has heard my weeping.
verses.textEnEsv: Depart from me, all you workers of evil, for the Lord has heard the sound of my weeping.
verses.textEnNkjv: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; For the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.textEnNlt: Go away, all you who do evil, for the Lord has heard my weeping.
verses.textEnNasb: Leave me, all you who practice injustice, For the Lord has heard the sound of my weeping.
verses.textEn: Away from me, all you who do evil, for the Lord has heard my weeping.

verses.textZh: 耶和华听了我的恳求， 耶和华必接纳我的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华听了我的恳求， 耶和华必接纳我的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华听了我的恳求； 耶和华必收纳我的祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has heard my cry for mercy; the Lord accepts my prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has heard my plea; the Lord accepts my prayer.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has heard my supplication; The Lord will receive my prayer.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has heard my plea; the Lord will answer my prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has heard my pleading, The Lord receives my prayer.
verses.textEn: The Lord has heard my cry for mercy; the Lord accepts my prayer.

verses.textZh: 我所有的仇敌都必蒙羞，大大惊惶； 眨眼之间，他们必蒙羞后退。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所有的仇敌都必蒙羞，大大惊惶； 眨眼之间，他们必蒙羞后退。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的一切仇敌都必羞愧，大大惊惶； 他们必要退后，忽然羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: All my enemies will be overwhelmed with shame and anguish; they will turn back and suddenly be put to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: All my enemies shall be ashamed and greatly troubled; they shall turn back and be put to shame in a moment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; Let them turn back and be ashamed suddenly.
verses.textEnNlt: May all my enemies be disgraced and terrified. May they suddenly turn back in shame.
verses.textEnNasb: All my enemies will be put to shame and greatly horrified; They shall turn back, they will suddenly be put to shame.
verses.textEn: All my enemies will be overwhelmed with shame and anguish; they will turn back and suddenly be put to shame.

verses.textZh: 大卫因便雅悯人古实的话，向耶和华所唱的"士迦庸"。 耶和华我的神啊！我已经投靠了你， 求你拯救我脱离所有追赶我的人。 求你搭救我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫因便雅悯人古实的话，向耶和华所唱的"士迦庸"。 耶和华我的神啊！我已经投靠了你， 求你拯救我脱离所有追赶我的人。 求你搭救我，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神啊，我投靠你！ 求你救我脱离一切追赶我的人，将我救拔出来！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord my God, I take refuge in you; save and deliver me from all who pursue me,
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord my God, in you do I take refuge; save me from all my pursuers and deliver me,
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord my God, in You I put my trust; Save me from all those who persecute me; And deliver me,
verses.textEnNlt: I come to you for protection, O Lord my God. Save me from my persecutors—rescue me!
verses.textEnNasb: O Lord my God, in You I have taken refuge; Save me from all those who pursue me, and rescue me,
verses.textEn: Lord my God, I take refuge in you; save and deliver me from all who pursue me,

verses.textZh: 免得他们像狮子一般把我撕裂， 把我撕碎的时候，也没有人搭救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得他们像狮子一般把我撕裂， 把我撕碎的时候，也没有人搭救。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕他们像狮子撕裂我， 甚至撕碎，无人搭救。
verses.textEnNiv: or they will tear me apart like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
verses.textEnEsv: lest like a lion they tear my soul apart, rending it in pieces, with none to deliver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest they tear me like a lion, Rending me in pieces, while thereis none to deliver.
verses.textEnNlt: If you don’t, they will maul me like a lion, tearing me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
verses.textEnNasb: Or he will tear my soul like a lion, Dragging me away, while there is no one to rescue me.
verses.textEn: or they will tear me apart like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神啊！如果我作了这事， 如果我手中有罪孽，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神啊！如果我作了这事， 如果我手中有罪孽，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神啊，我若行了这事， 若有罪孽在我手里，
verses.textEnNiv: Lord my God, if I have done this and there is guilt on my hands—
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord my God, if I have done this, if there is wrong in my hands,
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord my God, if I have done this: If there is iniquity in my hands,
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord my God, if I have done wrong or am guilty of injustice,
verses.textEnNasb: O Lord my God, if I have done this, If there is injustice in my hands,
verses.textEn: Lord my God, if I have done this and there is guilt on my hands—

verses.textZh: 如果我以恶回报那与我为友的人， 或是无故掠夺与我为敌的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我以恶回报那与我为友的人， 或是无故掠夺与我为敌的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 我若以恶报那与我交好的人－ 连那无故与我为敌的，我也救了他，
verses.textEnNiv: if I have repaid my ally with evil or without cause have robbed my foe—
verses.textEnEsv: if I have repaid my friend with evil or plundered my enemy without cause,
verses.textEnNkjv: If I have repaid evil to him who was at peace with me, Or have plundered my enemy without cause,
verses.textEnNlt: if I have betrayed a friend or plundered my enemy without cause,
verses.textEnNasb: If I have done evil to my friend, Or have plundered my enemy for no reason,
verses.textEn: if I have repaid my ally with evil or without cause have robbed my foe—

verses.textZh: 就任凭仇敌追赶我，直到追上， 把我的性命践踏在地上， 使我的光荣归于尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就任凭仇敌追赶我，直到追上， 把我的性命践踏在地上， 使我的光荣归于尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 就任凭仇敌追赶我，直到追上， 将我的性命踏在地下， 使我的荣耀归于灰尘。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let him trample my life to the ground and make me sleep in the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: let the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it, and let him trample my life to the ground and lay my glory in the dust. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the enemy pursue me and overtake me; Yes, let him trample my life to the earth, And lay my honor in the dust. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: then let my enemies capture me. Let them trample me into the ground and drag my honor in the dust. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Let the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it; And let him trample my life to the ground And lay my glory in the dust. Selah
verses.textEn: then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let him trample my life to the ground and make me sleep in the dust.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你在怒中起来， 求你挺身而起，抵挡我敌人的暴怒， 求你为我兴起；你已经出令施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你在怒中起来， 求你挺身而起，抵挡我敌人的暴怒， 求你为我兴起；你已经出令施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你在怒中起来， 挺身而立，抵挡我敌人的暴怒！ 求你为我兴起！你已经命定施行审判！
verses.textEnNiv: Arise, Lord , in your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake, my God; decree justice.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, O Lord , in your anger; lift yourself up against the fury of my enemies; awake for me; you have appointed a judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, O Lord, in Your anger; Lift Yourself up because of the rage of my enemies; Rise up for me to the judgment You have commanded!
verses.textEnNlt: Arise, O Lord , in anger! Stand up against the fury of my enemies! Wake up, my God, and bring justice!
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, Lord, in Your anger; Raise Yourself against the rage of my enemies, And stir Yourself for me; You have ordered judgment.
verses.textEn: Arise, Lord , in your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake, my God; decree justice.

verses.textZh: 愿万民聚集环绕你， 愿你归回高处，统管他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿万民聚集环绕你， 愿你归回高处，统管他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿众民的会环绕你！ 愿你从其上归于高位！
verses.textEnNiv: Let the assembled peoples gather around you, while you sit enthroned over them on high.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the assembly of the peoples be gathered about you; over it return on high.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the congregation of the peoples shall surround You; For their sakes, therefore, return on high.
verses.textEnNlt: Gather the nations before you. Rule over them from on high.
verses.textEnNasb: Let the assembly of the peoples encompass You, And return on high over it.
verses.textEn: Let the assembled peoples gather around you, while you sit enthroned over them on high.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华审判万民。 耶和华啊！求你按着我的公义， 照着我心中的正直判断我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华审判万民。 耶和华啊！求你按着我的公义， 照着我心中的正直判断我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向众民施行审判； 耶和华啊，求你按我的公义和我心中的纯正判断我。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the Lord judge the peoples. Vindicate me, Lord , according to my righteousness, according to my integrity, O Most High.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord judges the peoples; judge me, O Lord , according to my righteousness and according to the integrity that is in me.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord shall judge the peoples; Judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, And according to my integrity within me.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord judges the nations. Declare me righteous, O Lord , for I am innocent, O Most High!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord judges the peoples; Vindicate me, Lord, according to my righteousness and my integrity that is in me.
verses.textEn: Let the Lord judge the peoples. Vindicate me, Lord , according to my righteousness, according to my integrity, O Most High.

verses.textZh: 愿恶人的恶行止息， 愿你使义人坚立。 公义的神啊！ 你是察验人心肠肺腑的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恶人的恶行止息， 愿你使义人坚立。 公义的神啊！ 你是察验人心肠肺腑的。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恶人的恶断绝！ 愿你坚立义人！ 因为公义的神察验人的心肠肺腑。
verses.textEnNiv: Bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure— you, the righteous God who probes minds and hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, let the evil of the wicked come to an end, and may you establish the righteous— you who test the minds and hearts, O righteous God!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, But establish the just; For the righteous God tests the hearts and minds.
verses.textEnNlt: End the evil of those who are wicked, and defend the righteous. For you look deep within the mind and heart, O righteous God.
verses.textEnNasb: Please let the evil of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; For the righteous God puts hearts and minds to the test.
verses.textEn: Bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure— you, the righteous God who probes minds and hearts.

verses.textZh: 神是我的盾牌， 他拯救心里正直的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神是我的盾牌， 他拯救心里正直的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 神是我的盾牌； 他拯救心里正直的人。
verses.textEnNiv: My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.
verses.textEnEsv: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: My defense is of God, Who saves the upright in heart.
verses.textEnNlt: God is my shield, saving those whose hearts are true and right.
verses.textEnNasb: My shield is with God, Who saves the upright in heart.
verses.textEn: My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.

verses.textZh: 神是公义的审判者， 他是天天向恶人发怒的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神是公义的审判者， 他是天天向恶人发怒的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 神是公义的审判者， 又是天天向恶人发怒的神。
verses.textEnNiv: God is a righteous judge, a God who displays his wrath every day.
verses.textEnEsv: God is a righteous judge, and a God who feels indignation every day.
verses.textEnNkjv: God is a just judge, And God is angry withthewicked every day.
verses.textEnNlt: God is an honest judge. He is angry with the wicked every day.
verses.textEnNasb: God is a righteous judge, And a God who shows indignation every day.
verses.textEn: God is a righteous judge, a God who displays his wrath every day.

verses.textZh: 如果人不悔改，神必把他的刀磨快。神已经把弓拉开，准备妥当。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果人不悔改，神必把他的刀磨快。神已经把弓拉开，准备妥当。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人不回头，他的刀必磨快， 弓必上弦，预备妥当了。
verses.textEnNiv: If he does not relent, he will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.
verses.textEnEsv: If a man does not repent, God will whet his sword; he has bent and readied his bow;
verses.textEnNkjv: If he does not turn back, He will sharpen His sword; He bends His bow and makes it ready.
verses.textEnNlt: If a person does not repent, God will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.
verses.textEnNasb: If one does not repent, He will sharpen His sword; He has bent His bow and taken aim.
verses.textEn: If he does not relent, he will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.

verses.textZh: 他亲自预备了致命的武器， 他使所射的箭成为燃烧的箭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他亲自预备了致命的武器， 他使所射的箭成为燃烧的箭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也预备了杀人的器械； 他所射的是火箭。
verses.textEnNiv: He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes ready his flaming arrows.
verses.textEnEsv: he has prepared for him his deadly weapons, making his arrows fiery shafts.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also prepares for Himself instruments of death; He makes His arrows into fiery shafts.
verses.textEnNlt: He will prepare his deadly weapons and shoot his flaming arrows.
verses.textEnNasb: He has also prepared deadly weapons for Himself; He makes His arrows fiery shafts.
verses.textEn: He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes ready his flaming arrows.

verses.textZh: 看哪！恶人为了罪孽经历产痛， 他怀的是恶毒，生下的是虚谎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！恶人为了罪孽经历产痛， 他怀的是恶毒，生下的是虚谎。
verses.textZhCuv: 试看恶人因奸恶而劬劳， 所怀的是毒害，所生的是虚假。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever is pregnant with evil conceives trouble and gives birth to disillusionment.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the wicked man conceives evil and is pregnant with mischief and gives birth to lies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, thewicked brings forth iniquity; Yes, he conceives trouble and brings forth falsehood.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked conceive evil; they are pregnant with trouble and give birth to lies.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, an evil person is pregnant with injustice, And he conceives harm and gives birth to lies.
verses.textEn: Whoever is pregnant with evil conceives trouble and gives birth to disillusionment.

verses.textZh: 他挖掘坑穴，挖得深深的， 自己却掉进所挖的陷阱里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他挖掘坑穴，挖得深深的， 自己却掉进所挖的陷阱里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他掘了坑，又挖深了， 竟掉在自己所挖的阱里。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever digs a hole and scoops it out falls into the pit they have made.
verses.textEnEsv: He makes a pit, digging it out, and falls into the hole that he has made.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made a pit and dug it out, And has fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.textEnNlt: They dig a deep pit to trap others, then fall into it themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: He has dug a pit and hollowed it out, And has fallen into the hole which he made.
verses.textEn: Whoever digs a hole and scoops it out falls into the pit they have made.

verses.textZh: 他的恶毒必回到自己的头上， 他的强暴必落在自己的头顶上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的恶毒必回到自己的头上， 他的强暴必落在自己的头顶上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的毒害必临到他自己的头上； 他的强暴必落到他自己的脑袋上。
verses.textEnNiv: The trouble they cause recoils on them; their violence comes down on their own heads.
verses.textEnEsv: His mischief returns upon his own head, and on his own skull his violence descends.
verses.textEnNkjv: His trouble shall return upon his own head, And his violent dealing shall come down on his own crown.
verses.textEnNlt: The trouble they make for others backfires on them. The violence they plan falls on their own heads.
verses.textEnNasb: His harm will return on his own head, And his violence will descend on the top of his own head.
verses.textEn: The trouble they cause recoils on them; their violence comes down on their own heads.

verses.textZh: 我要照着耶和华的公义称谢他， 歌颂至高者耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要照着耶和华的公义称谢他， 歌颂至高者耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要照着耶和华的公义称谢他， 歌颂耶和华至高者的名。
verses.textEnNiv: I will give thanks to the Lord because of his righteousness; I will sing the praises of the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.textEnEsv: I will give to the Lord the thanks due to his righteousness, and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord , the Most High.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will praise the Lord according to His righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.textEnNlt: I will thank the Lord because he is just; I will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.textEnNasb: I will give thanks to the Lord according to His righteousness And will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
verses.textEn: I will give thanks to the Lord because of his righteousness; I will sing the praises of the name of the Lord Most High.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用"迦特"的乐器。 耶和华我们的主啊！ 你的名在全地是多么威严， 你把你的荣美彰显在天上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用"迦特"的乐器。 耶和华我们的主啊！ 你的名在全地是多么威严， 你把你的荣美彰显在天上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！ 你将你的荣耀彰显于天。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory in the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, our Lord, How excellent is Your name in all the earth, Who have set Your glory above the heavens!
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , our Lord, your majestic name fills the earth! Your glory is higher than the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, our Lord, How majestic is Your name in all the earth, You who have displayed Your splendor above the heavens!
verses.textEn: Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory in the heavens.

verses.textZh: 因你仇敌的缘故， 你从小孩和婴儿的口中， 得着了赞美 ， 使仇敌和报仇的无话可说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你仇敌的缘故， 你从小孩和婴儿的口中， 得着了赞美 ， 使仇敌和报仇的无话可说。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因敌人的缘故， 从婴孩和吃奶的口中， 建立了能力， 使仇敌和报仇的闭口无言。
verses.textEnNiv: Through the praise of children and infants you have established a stronghold against your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of the mouth of babies and infants, you have established strength because of your foes, to still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.textEnNkjv: Out of the mouth of babes and nursing infants You have ordained strength, Because of Your enemies, That You may silence the enemy and the avenger.
verses.textEnNlt: You have taught children and infants to tell of your strength, silencing your enemies and all who oppose you.
verses.textEnNasb: From the mouths of infants and nursing babies You have established strength Because of Your enemies, To do away with the enemy and the revengeful.
verses.textEn: Through the praise of children and infants you have established a stronghold against your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.

verses.textZh: 我观看你手所造的天， 和你所安放的月亮和星星。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看你手所造的天， 和你所安放的月亮和星星。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看你指头所造的天， 并你所陈设的月亮星宿，
verses.textEnNiv: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,
verses.textEnEsv: When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,
verses.textEnNkjv: When I consider Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, The moon and the stars, which You have ordained,
verses.textEnNlt: When I look at the night sky and see the work of your fingers— the moon and the stars you set in place—
verses.textEnNasb: When I consider Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, The moon and the stars, which You have set in place;
verses.textEn: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,

verses.textZh: 啊！人算甚么，你竟记念他？ 世人算甚么，你竟眷顾他？
verses.textZhCnvs: 啊！人算甚么，你竟记念他？ 世人算甚么，你竟眷顾他？
verses.textZhCuv: 便说：人算什么，你竟顾念他！ 世人算什么，你竟眷顾他！
verses.textEnNiv: what is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verses.textEnEsv: what is man that you are mindful of him, and the son of man that you care for him?
verses.textEnNkjv: What is man that You are mindful of him, And the son of man that You visit him?
verses.textEnNlt: what are mere mortals that you should think about them, human beings that you should care for them?
verses.textEnNasb: What is man that You think of him, And a son of man that You are concerned about him?
verses.textEn: what is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?

verses.textZh: 你使他比天使 低微一点， 却赐给他荣耀尊贵作冠冕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使他比天使 低微一点， 却赐给他荣耀尊贵作冠冕。
verses.textZhCuv: 你叫他比天使 微小一点， 并赐他荣耀尊贵为冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: You have made them a little lower than the angels and crowned them with glory and honor.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you have made him a little lower than the heavenly beings and crowned him with glory and honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have made him a little lower than the angels, And You have crowned him with glory and honor.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet you made them only a little lower than God and crowned them with glory and honor.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet You have made him a little lower than God, And You crown him with glory and majesty!
verses.textEn: You have made them a little lower than the angels and crowned them with glory and honor.

verses.textZh: 你叫他管理你手所造的， 把万物都放在他的脚下，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你叫他管理你手所造的， 把万物都放在他的脚下，
verses.textZhCuv: 使万物，就是一切的牛羊、 田野的兽、空中的鸟、海里的鱼， 凡经行海道的，都服在他的脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: You made them rulers over the works of your hands; you put everything under their feet:
verses.textEnEsv: You have given him dominion over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet,
verses.textEnNkjv: You have made him to have dominion over the works of Your hands; You have put all things under his feet,
verses.textEnNlt: You gave them charge of everything you made, putting all things under their authority—
verses.textEnNasb: You have him rule over the works of Your hands; You have put everything under his feet,
verses.textEn: You made them rulers over the works of your hands; you put everything under their feet:

verses.textZh: 就是所有的牛羊、 田间的走兽、
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是所有的牛羊、 田间的走兽、
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！
verses.textEnNiv: all flocks and herds, and the animals of the wild,
verses.textEnEsv: all sheep and oxen, and also the beasts of the field,
verses.textEnNkjv: All sheep and oxen— Even the beasts of the field,
verses.textEnNlt: the flocks and the herds and all the wild animals,
verses.textEnNasb: All sheep and oxen, And also the animals of the field,
verses.textEn: all flocks and herds, and the animals of the wild,

verses.textZh: 空中的飞鸟、海里的鱼， 和海里游行的水族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 空中的飞鸟、海里的鱼， 和海里游行的水族。
verses.textZhCuv: 空中的飞鸟、海里的鱼， 和海里游行的水族。
verses.textEnNiv: the birds in the sky, and the fish in the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
verses.textEnEsv: the birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, whatever passes along the paths of the seas.
verses.textEnNkjv: The birds of the air, And the fish of the sea That pass through the paths of the seas.
verses.textEnNlt: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and everything that swims the ocean currents.
verses.textEnNasb: The birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea, Whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
verses.textEn: the birds in the sky, and the fish in the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我们的主啊！ 你的名在全地是多么威严。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我们的主啊！ 你的名在全地是多么威严。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华我们的主啊！ 你的名在全地是多么威严。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, our Lord, How excellent is Your name in all the earth!
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , our Lord, your majestic name fills the earth!
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, our Lord, How majestic is Your name in all the earth!
verses.textEn: Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，调用"慕拉宾"。 耶和华啊！我要全心称谢你， 我要述说你一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，调用"慕拉宾"。 耶和华啊！我要全心称谢你， 我要述说你一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要一心称谢耶和华； 我要传扬你一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: I will give thanks to you, Lord , with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart; I will recount all of your wonderful deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will praise You, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will tell of all Your marvelous works.
verses.textEnNlt: I will praise you, Lord , with all my heart; I will tell of all the marvelous things you have done.
verses.textEnNasb: I will give thanks to the Lord with all my heart; I will tell of all Your wonders.
verses.textEn: I will give thanks to you, Lord , with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.

verses.textZh: 我要因你快乐欢欣； 至高者啊！我要歌颂你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要因你快乐欢欣； 至高者啊！我要歌颂你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要因你欢喜快乐； 至高者啊，我要歌颂你的名！
verses.textEnNiv: I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing the praises of your name, O Most High.
verses.textEnEsv: I will be glad and exult in you; I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be filled with joy because of you. I will sing praises to your name, O Most High.
verses.textEnNasb: I will rejoice and be jubilant in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
verses.textEn: I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing the praises of your name, O Most High.

verses.textZh: 我的仇敌转身退后的时候， 就在你的面前绊倒、灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的仇敌转身退后的时候， 就在你的面前绊倒、灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仇敌转身退去的时候， 他们一见你的面就跌倒灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before you.
verses.textEnEsv: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish before your presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: When my enemies turn back, They shall fall and perish at Your presence.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies retreated; they staggered and died when you appeared.
verses.textEnNasb: When my enemies turn back, They stumble and perish before You.
verses.textEn: My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before you.

verses.textZh: 因为你为我伸了冤，辨了屈； 你坐在宝座上，施行公义的审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你为我伸了冤，辨了屈； 你坐在宝座上，施行公义的审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你已经为我伸冤，为我辨屈； 你坐在宝座上，按公义审判。
verses.textEnNiv: For you have upheld my right and my cause, sitting enthroned as the righteous judge.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have maintained my just cause; you have sat on the throne, giving righteous judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have maintained my right and my cause; You sat on the throne judging in righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: For you have judged in my favor; from your throne you have judged with fairness.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have maintained my just cause; You have sat on the throne judging righteously.
verses.textEn: For you have upheld my right and my cause, sitting enthroned as the righteous judge.

verses.textZh: 你斥责了列国，灭绝了恶人； 你涂抹了他们的名，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你斥责了列国，灭绝了恶人； 你涂抹了他们的名，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾斥责外邦，你曾灭绝恶人； 你曾涂抹他们的名，直到永永远远。
verses.textEnNiv: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: You have rebuked the nations; you have made the wicked perish; you have blotted out their name forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have rebuked the nations, You have destroyed the wicked; You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have erased their names forever.
verses.textEnNasb: You have rebuked the nations, You have eliminated the wicked; You have wiped out their name forever and ever.
verses.textEn: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 仇敌的结局到了，他们遭毁灭， 直到永远； 你拆毁他们的城镇，使它们湮没无闻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 仇敌的结局到了，他们遭毁灭， 直到永远； 你拆毁他们的城镇，使它们湮没无闻。
verses.textZhCuv: 仇敌到了尽头； 他们被毁坏，直到永远。 你拆毁他们的城邑， 连他们的名号都归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: Endless ruin has overtaken my enemies, you have uprooted their cities; even the memory of them has perished.
verses.textEnEsv: The enemy came to an end in everlasting ruins; their cities you rooted out; the very memory of them has perished.
verses.textEnNkjv: O enemy, destructions are finished forever! And you have destroyed cities; Even their memory has perished.
verses.textEnNlt: The enemy is finished, in endless ruins; the cities you uprooted are now forgotten.
verses.textEnNasb: The enemy has come to an end in everlasting ruins, And You have uprooted the cities; The very memory of them has perished.
verses.textEn: Endless ruin has overtaken my enemies, you have uprooted their cities; even the memory of them has perished.

verses.textZh: 耶和华却永远坐着为王， 为了施行审判，他已经设立宝座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华却永远坐着为王， 为了施行审判，他已经设立宝座。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟耶和华坐着为王，直到永远； 他已经为审判设摆他的宝座。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord reigns forever; he has established his throne for judgment.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord sits enthroned forever; he has established his throne for justice,
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord shall endure forever; He has prepared His throne for judgment.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord reigns forever, executing judgment from his throne.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord sits as King forever; He has established His throne for judgment,
verses.textEn: The Lord reigns forever; he has established his throne for judgment.

verses.textZh: 他必以公义审判世界， 按正直判断万民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必以公义审判世界， 按正直判断万民。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要按公义审判世界， 按正直判断万民。
verses.textEnNiv: He rules the world in righteousness and judges the peoples with equity.
verses.textEnEsv: and he judges the world with righteousness; he judges the peoples with uprightness.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall judge the world in righteousness, And He shall administer judgment for the peoples in uprightness.
verses.textEnNlt: He will judge the world with justice and rule the nations with fairness.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will judge the world in righteousness; He will execute judgment for the peoples fairly.
verses.textEn: He rules the world in righteousness and judges the peoples with equity.

verses.textZh: 耶和华要给受欺压的人作保障， 作患难时的避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华要给受欺压的人作保障， 作患难时的避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又要给受欺压的人作高台， 在患难的时候作高台。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is a stronghold for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, A refuge in times of trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is a shelter for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will also be a stronghold for the oppressed, A stronghold in times of trouble;
verses.textEn: The Lord is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

verses.textZh: 认识你名的人必倚靠你； 耶和华啊！你从未撇弃寻求你的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 认识你名的人必倚靠你； 耶和华啊！你从未撇弃寻求你的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，认识你名的人要倚靠你， 因你没有离弃寻求你的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who know your name trust in you, for you, Lord , have never forsaken those who seek you.
verses.textEnEsv: And those who know your name put their trust in you, for you, O Lord , have not forsaken those who seek you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who know Your name will put their trust in You; For You, Lord, have not forsaken those who seek You.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who know your name trust in you, for you, O Lord , do not abandon those who search for you.
verses.textEnNasb: And those who know Your name will put their trust in You, For You, Lord, have not abandoned those who seek You.
verses.textEn: Those who know your name trust in you, for you, Lord , have never forsaken those who seek you.

verses.textZh: 你们要歌颂住在锡安的耶和华， 要在万民中传扬他的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要歌颂住在锡安的耶和华， 要在万民中传扬他的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 应当歌颂居锡安的耶和华， 将他所行的传扬在众民中。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing the praises of the Lord , enthroned in Zion; proclaim among the nations what he has done.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing praises to the Lord , who sits enthroned in Zion! Tell among the peoples his deeds!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Zion! Declare His deeds among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing praises to the Lord who reigns in Jerusalem. Tell the world about his unforgettable deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Zion; Declare His deeds among the peoples.
verses.textEn: Sing the praises of the Lord , enthroned in Zion; proclaim among the nations what he has done.

verses.textZh: 因为那追讨流人血的罪的，他记念受苦的人， 他没有忘记他们的哀求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那追讨流人血的罪的，他记念受苦的人， 他没有忘记他们的哀求。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为那追讨流人血之罪的－他记念受屈的人， 不忘记困苦人的哀求。
verses.textEnNiv: For he who avenges blood remembers; he does not ignore the cries of the afflicted.
verses.textEnEsv: For he who avenges blood is mindful of them; he does not forget the cry of the afflicted.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He avenges blood, He remembers them; He does not forget the cry of the humble.
verses.textEnNlt: For he who avenges murder cares for the helpless. He does not ignore the cries of those who suffer.
verses.textEnNasb: For He who requires blood remembers them; He does not forget the cry of the needy.
verses.textEn: For he who avenges blood remembers; he does not ignore the cries of the afflicted.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你恩待我， 看看那些恨我的人加给我的苦难； 求你把我从死门拉上来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你恩待我， 看看那些恨我的人加给我的苦难； 求你把我从死门拉上来，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你是从死门把我提拔起来的； 求你怜恤我，看那恨我的人所加给我的苦难，
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , see how my enemies persecute me! Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,
verses.textEnEsv: Be gracious to me, O Lord ! See my affliction from those who hate me, O you who lift me up from the gates of death,
verses.textEnNkjv: Have mercy on me, O Lord! Consider my trouble from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , have mercy on me. See how my enemies torment me. Snatch me back from the jaws of death.
verses.textEnNasb: Be gracious to me, Lord; See my oppression from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,
verses.textEn: Lord , see how my enemies persecute me! Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,

verses.textZh: 好叫我述说你一切可称颂的事， 并在锡安的城门 因你的救恩欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好叫我述说你一切可称颂的事， 并在锡安的城门 因你的救恩欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫我述说你一切的美德； 我必在锡安城 的门因你的救恩欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: that I may declare your praises in the gates of Daughter Zion, and there rejoice in your salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: that I may recount all your praises, that in the gates of the daughter of Zion I may rejoice in your salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: That I may tell of all Your praise In the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: Save me so I can praise you publicly at Jerusalem’s gates, so I can rejoice that you have rescued me.
verses.textEnNasb: So that I may tell of all Your praises, That in the gates of the daughter of Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.textEn: that I may declare your praises in the gates of Daughter Zion, and there rejoice in your salvation.

verses.textZh: 列国陷入自己挖掘的坑中， 他们的脚在自己暗设的网里缠住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国陷入自己挖掘的坑中， 他们的脚在自己暗设的网里缠住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中； 他们的脚在自己暗设的网罗里缠住了。
verses.textEnNiv: The nations have fallen into the pit they have dug; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
verses.textEnEsv: The nations have sunk in the pit that they made; in the net that they hid, their own foot has been caught.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nations have sunk down in the pit which they made; In the net which they hid, their own foot is caught.
verses.textEnNlt: The nations have fallen into the pit they dug for others. Their own feet have been caught in the trap they set.
verses.textEnNasb: The nations have sunk down into the pit which they have made; In the net which they hid, their own foot has been caught.
verses.textEn: The nations have fallen into the pit they have dug; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.

verses.textZh: 耶和华已经把自己显明，又施行了审判； 恶人被自己手所作的缠住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华已经把自己显明，又施行了审判； 恶人被自己手所作的缠住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华已将自己显明了，他已施行审判； 恶人被自己手所做的缠住了 。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is known by his acts of justice; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has made himself known; he has executed judgment; the wicked are snared in the work of their own hands. Higgaion. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord is known by the judgment He executes; The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is known for his justice. The wicked are trapped by their own deeds. Quiet Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has made Himself known; He has executed judgment. A wicked one is ensnared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion Selah
verses.textEn: The Lord is known by his acts of justice; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands.

verses.textZh: 恶人都必归到阴间， 忘记神的列国都必灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人都必归到阴间， 忘记神的列国都必灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人，就是忘记神的外邦人， 都必归到阴间。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked go down to the realm of the dead, all the nations that forget God.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked shall return to Sheol, all the nations that forget God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked shall be turned into hell, And all the nations that forget God.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked will go down to the grave. This is the fate of all the nations who ignore God.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked will return to Sheol, All the nations who forget God.
verses.textEn: The wicked go down to the realm of the dead, all the nations that forget God.

verses.textZh: 但贫穷的人必不会被永远遗忘， 困苦人的希望也必不会永久落空。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但贫穷的人必不会被永远遗忘， 困苦人的希望也必不会永久落空。
verses.textZhCuv: 穷乏人必不永久被忘； 困苦人的指望必不永远落空。
verses.textEnNiv: But God will never forget the needy; the hope of the afflicted will never perish.
verses.textEnEsv: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, and the hope of the poor shall not perish forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the needy shall not always be forgotten; The expectation of the poor shall not perish forever.
verses.textEnNlt: But the needy will not be ignored forever; the hopes of the poor will not always be crushed.
verses.textEnNasb: For the needy will not always be forgotten, Nor the hope of the afflicted perish forever.
verses.textEn: But God will never forget the needy; the hope of the afflicted will never perish.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你起来，不要让世人得胜； 愿列国都在你面前受审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你起来，不要让世人得胜； 愿列国都在你面前受审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你起来，不容人得胜！ 愿外邦人在你面前受审判！
verses.textEnNiv: Arise, Lord , do not let mortals triumph; let the nations be judged in your presence.
