verses.textEnEsv: Arise, O Lord ! Let not man prevail; let the nations be judged before you!
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, O Lord, Do not let man prevail; Let the nations be judged in Your sight.
verses.textEnNlt: Arise, O Lord ! Do not let mere mortals defy you! Judge the nations!
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, Lord, do not let mankind prevail; Let the nations be judged before You.
verses.textEn: Arise, Lord , do not let mortals triumph; let the nations be judged in your presence.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你使他们惊惧， 愿列国都知道自己不过是人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你使他们惊惧， 愿列国都知道自己不过是人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你使外邦人恐惧； 愿他们知道自己不过是人。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Strike them with terror, Lord ; let the nations know they are only mortal.
verses.textEnEsv: Put them in fear, O Lord ! Let the nations know that they are but men! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Put them in fear, O Lord, That the nations may know themselves tobebut men. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Make them tremble in fear, O Lord . Let the nations know they are merely human. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Put them in fear, Lord; Let the nations know that they are merely human. Selah
verses.textEn: Strike them with terror, Lord ; let the nations know they are only mortal.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你为甚么远远地站着？在患难的时候，你为甚么隐藏起来呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你为甚么远远地站着？在患难的时候，你为甚么隐藏起来呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你为什么站在远处？ 在患难的时候为什么隐藏？
verses.textEnNiv: Why, Lord , do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
verses.textEnEsv: Why, O Lord , do you stand far away? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do You stand afar off, O Lord? Why do You hide in times of trouble?
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , why do you stand so far away? Why do you hide when I am in trouble?
verses.textEnNasb: Why do You stand far away, Lord? Why do You hide Yourself in times of trouble?
verses.textEn: Why, Lord , do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

verses.textZh: 恶人骄横地追逼困苦人， 愿恶人陷入自己所设的阴谋中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人骄横地追逼困苦人， 愿恶人陷入自己所设的阴谋中。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人在骄横中把困苦人追得火急； 愿他们陷在自己所设的计谋里。
verses.textEnNiv: In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak, who are caught in the schemes he devises.
verses.textEnEsv: In arrogance the wicked hotly pursue the poor; let them be caught in the schemes that they have devised.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked in his pride persecutes the poor; Let them be caught in the plots which they have devised.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked arrogantly hunt down the poor. Let them be caught in the evil they plan for others.
verses.textEnNasb: In arrogance the wicked hotly pursue the needy; Let them be caught in the plots which they have devised.
verses.textEn: In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak, who are caught in the schemes he devises.

verses.textZh: 恶人夸耀心中的欲望， 他称赞贪财的人，却藐视耶和华 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人夸耀心中的欲望， 他称赞贪财的人，却藐视耶和华 。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为恶人以心愿自夸； 贪财的背弃耶和华，并且轻慢他 。
verses.textEnNiv: He boasts about the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For the wicked boasts of the desires of his soul, and the one greedy for gain curses and renounces the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s desire; He blesses the greedy and renounces the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: For they brag about their evil desires; they praise the greedy and curse the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: For the wicked boasts of his soul’s desire, And the greedy person curses and shows disrespect to the Lord.
verses.textEn: He boasts about the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the Lord .

verses.textZh: 恶人面带骄傲，说："耶和华必不追究！" 在他的一切思想中，都没有神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人面带骄傲，说："耶和华必不追究！" 在他的一切思想中，都没有神。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人面带骄傲，说：耶和华必不追究； 他一切所想的都以为没有神。
verses.textEnNiv: In his pride the wicked man does not seek him; in all his thoughts there is no room for God.
verses.textEnEsv: In the pride of his face the wicked does not seek him; all his thoughts are, "There is no God."
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked in his proud countenance does not seek God; God is in none of his thoughts.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked are too proud to seek God. They seem to think that God is dead.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked, in his haughtiness, does not seek Him. There is no God in all his schemes.
verses.textEn: In his pride the wicked man does not seek him; in all his thoughts there is no room for God.

verses.textZh: 他的道路时常稳妥， 你的判断高超，他却不放在眼内； 他对所有的仇敌都嗤之以鼻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的道路时常稳妥， 你的判断高超，他却不放在眼内； 他对所有的仇敌都嗤之以鼻。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡他所做的，时常稳固； 你的审判超过他的眼界。 至于他一切的敌人， 他都向他们喷气。
verses.textEnNiv: His ways are always prosperous; your laws are rejected by him; he sneers at all his enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: His ways prosper at all times; your judgments are on high, out of his sight; as for all his foes, he puffs at them.
verses.textEnNkjv: His ways are always prospering; Your judgments are far above, out of his sight; Asfor all his enemies, he sneers at them.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet they succeed in everything they do. They do not see your punishment awaiting them. They sneer at all their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: His ways succeed at all times; Yet Your judgments are on high, out of his sight; As for all his enemies, he snorts at them.
verses.textEn: His ways are always prosperous; your laws are rejected by him; he sneers at all his enemies.

verses.textZh: 他心里说："我必永不摇动， 我决不会遭遇灾难。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他心里说："我必永不摇动， 我决不会遭遇灾难。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他心里说：我必不动摇， 世世代代不遭灾难。
verses.textEnNiv: He says to himself, "Nothing will ever shake me." He swears, "No one will ever do me harm."
verses.textEnEsv: He says in his heart, "I shall not be moved; throughout all generations I shall not meet adversity."
verses.textEnNkjv: He has said in his heart, "I shall not be moved; I shall never be in adversity."
verses.textEnNlt: They think, "Nothing bad will ever happen to us! We will be free of trouble forever!"
verses.textEnNasb: He says to himself, "I will not be moved; Throughout the generations I will not be in adversity."
verses.textEn: He says to himself, "Nothing will ever shake me." He swears, "No one will ever do me harm."

verses.textZh: 他口里充满咒诅、诡诈和欺压的话， 舌头底下尽是毒害与奸恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他口里充满咒诅、诡诈和欺压的话， 舌头底下尽是毒害与奸恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 他满口是咒骂、诡诈、欺压， 舌底是毒害、奸恶。
verses.textEnNiv: His mouth is full of lies and threats; trouble and evil are under his tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: His mouth is filled with cursing and deceit and oppression; under his tongue are mischief and iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression; Under his tongue is trouble and iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: Their mouths are full of cursing, lies, and threats. Trouble and evil are on the tips of their tongues.
verses.textEnNasb: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression; Under his tongue is harm and injustice.
verses.textEn: His mouth is full of lies and threats; trouble and evil are under his tongue.

verses.textZh: 他在村庄里埋伏等候， 在隐密处杀害无辜的人， 他的眼睛暗地里窥探不幸的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在村庄里埋伏等候， 在隐密处杀害无辜的人， 他的眼睛暗地里窥探不幸的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在村庄埋伏等候； 他在隐密处杀害无辜的人。 他的眼睛窥探无倚无靠的人；
verses.textEnNiv: He lies in wait near the villages; from ambush he murders the innocent. His eyes watch in secret for his victims;
verses.textEnEsv: He sits in ambush in the villages; in hiding places he murders the innocent. His eyes stealthily watch for the helpless;
verses.textEnNkjv: He sits in the lurking places of the villages; In the secret places he murders the innocent; His eyes are secretly fixed on the helpless.
verses.textEnNlt: They lurk in ambush in the villages, waiting to murder innocent people. They are always searching for helpless victims.
verses.textEnNasb: He sits in the lurking places of the villages; He kills the innocent in the secret places; His eyes surreptitiously watch for the unfortunate.
verses.textEn: He lies in wait near the villages; from ambush he murders the innocent. His eyes watch in secret for his victims;

verses.textZh: 他在隐密处埋伏，像狮子埋伏在丛林中； 他埋伏要掳走困苦人， 他把困苦人拉入自己的网中，掳走了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在隐密处埋伏，像狮子埋伏在丛林中； 他埋伏要掳走困苦人， 他把困苦人拉入自己的网中，掳走了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他埋伏在暗地，如狮子蹲在洞中。 他埋伏，要掳去困苦人； 他拉网，就把困苦人掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: like a lion in cover he lies in wait. He lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.
verses.textEnEsv: he lurks in ambush like a lion in his thicket; he lurks that he may seize the poor; he seizes the poor when he draws him into his net.
verses.textEnNkjv: He lies in wait secretly, as a lion in his den; He lies in wait to catch the poor; He catches the poor when he draws him into his net.
verses.textEnNlt: Like lions crouched in hiding, they wait to pounce on the helpless. Like hunters they capture the helpless and drag them away in nets.
verses.textEnNasb: He lurks in secret like a lion in his lair; He lurks to catch the needy; He catches the needy when he pulls him into his net.
verses.textEn: like a lion in cover he lies in wait. He lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.

verses.textZh: 他击打，他屈身蹲伏， 不幸的人就倒在他的爪下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他击打，他屈身蹲伏， 不幸的人就倒在他的爪下。
verses.textZhCuv: 他屈身蹲伏， 无倚无靠的人就倒在他爪牙 之下。
verses.textEnNiv: His victims are crushed, they collapse; they fall under his strength.
verses.textEnEsv: The helpless are crushed, sink down, and fall by his might.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he crouches, he lies low, That the helpless may fall by his strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Their helpless victims are crushed; they fall beneath the strength of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he crushes the needy one, who cowers; And unfortunate people fall by his mighty power.
verses.textEn: His victims are crushed, they collapse; they fall under his strength.

verses.textZh: 他心里说："神已经忘记了， 他已经掩面，永远不看。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他心里说："神已经忘记了， 他已经掩面，永远不看。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他心里说：神竟忘记了； 他掩面永不观看。
verses.textEnNiv: He says to himself, "God will never notice; he covers his face and never sees."
verses.textEnEsv: He says in his heart, "God has forgotten, he has hidden his face, he will never see it."
verses.textEnNkjv: He has said in his heart, "God has forgotten; He hides His face; He will never see."
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked think, "God isn’t watching us! He has closed his eyes and won’t even see what we do!"
verses.textEnNasb: He says to himself, "God has forgotten; He has hidden His face; He will never see it."
verses.textEn: He says to himself, "God will never notice; he covers his face and never sees."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你起来；神啊！求你举起手来， 不要忘记困苦的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你起来；神啊！求你举起手来， 不要忘记困苦的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你起来！神啊，求你举手，不要忘记困苦人！
verses.textEnNiv: Arise, Lord ! Lift up your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, O Lord ; O God, lift up your hand; forget not the afflicted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, O Lord! O God, lift up Your hand! Do not forget the humble.
verses.textEnNlt: Arise, O Lord ! Punish the wicked, O God! Do not ignore the helpless!
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, Lord; God, lift up Your hand. Do not forget the humble.
verses.textEn: Arise, Lord ! Lift up your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless.

verses.textZh: 恶人为甚么藐视神， 心里说："你必不追究"呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人为甚么藐视神， 心里说："你必不追究"呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人为何轻慢神， 心里说：你必不追究？
verses.textEnNiv: Why does the wicked man revile God? Why does he say to himself, "He won’t call me to account"?
verses.textEnEsv: Why does the wicked renounce God and say in his heart, "You will not call to account"?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do the wicked renounce God? He has said in his heart, "You will not require anaccount."
verses.textEnNlt: Why do the wicked get away with despising God? They think, "God will never call us to account."
verses.textEnNasb: Why has the wicked treated God disrespectfully? He has said to himself, " You will not require an account."
verses.textEn: Why does the wicked man revile God? Why does he say to himself, "He won’t call me to account"?

verses.textZh: 其实你已经看见了， 忧患与愁苦你都已经看到，并且放在自己的手中； 不幸的人把自己交托你； 你是帮助孤儿的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实你已经看见了， 忧患与愁苦你都已经看到，并且放在自己的手中； 不幸的人把自己交托你； 你是帮助孤儿的。
verses.textZhCuv: 其实你已经观看； 因为奸恶毒害，你都看见了， 为要以手施行报应。 无倚无靠的人把自己交托你； 你向来是帮助孤儿的。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, God, see the trouble of the afflicted; you consider their grief and take it in hand. The victims commit themselves to you; you are the helper of the fatherless.
verses.textEnEsv: But you do see, for you note mischief and vexation, that you may take it into your hands; to you the helpless commits himself; you have been the helper of the fatherless.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You have seen, for You observe trouble and grief, To repay it by Your hand. The helpless commits himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
verses.textEnNlt: But you see the trouble and grief they cause. You take note of it and punish them. The helpless put their trust in you. You defend the orphans.
verses.textEnNasb: You have seen it, for You have looked at harm and provocation to take it into Your hand. The unfortunate commits himself to You; You have been the helper of the orphan.
verses.textEn: But you, God, see the trouble of the afflicted; you consider their grief and take it in hand. The victims commit themselves to you; you are the helper of the fatherless.

verses.textZh: 愿你打断恶人和坏人的膀臂， 愿你追究他们的恶行，直到清清楚楚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你打断恶人和坏人的膀臂， 愿你追究他们的恶行，直到清清楚楚。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你打断恶人的膀臂； 至于坏人，愿你追究他的恶，直到净尽。
verses.textEnNiv: Break the arm of the wicked man; call the evildoer to account for his wickedness that would not otherwise be found out.
verses.textEnEsv: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call his wickedness to account till you find none.
verses.textEnNkjv: Break the arm of the wicked and the evil man; Seek out his wickedness until You find none.
verses.textEnNlt: Break the arms of these wicked, evil people! Go after them until the last one is destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: Break the arm of the wicked and the evildoer, Seek out his wickedness until You find none.
verses.textEn: Break the arm of the wicked man; call the evildoer to account for his wickedness that would not otherwise be found out.

verses.textZh: 耶和华作王直到永永远远， 列国都从他的地上灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华作王直到永永远远， 列国都从他的地上灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华永永远远为王； 外邦人从他的地已经灭绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is king forever and ever; the nations perish from his land.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis King forever and ever; The nations have perished out of His land.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is king forever and ever! The godless nations will vanish from the land.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is King forever and ever; Nations have perished from His land.
verses.textEn: The Lord is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！困苦人的心愿你已经听见， 你必坚固他们的心，也必留心听他们的呼求；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！困苦人的心愿你已经听见， 你必坚固他们的心，也必留心听他们的呼求；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，谦卑人的心愿， 你早已知道 。 你必预备他们的心， 也必侧耳听他们的祈求，
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord , hear the desire of the afflicted; you encourage them, and you listen to their cry,
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , you hear the desire of the afflicted; you will strengthen their heart; you will incline your ear
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, You have heard the desire of the humble; You will prepare their heart; You will cause Your ear to hear,
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you know the hopes of the helpless. Surely you will hear their cries and comfort them.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, You have heard the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their heart, You will make Your ear attentive
verses.textEn: You, Lord , hear the desire of the afflicted; you encourage them, and you listen to their cry,

verses.textZh: 好为孤儿和受欺压的人伸冤， 使地上的人不再施行恐吓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好为孤儿和受欺压的人伸冤， 使地上的人不再施行恐吓。
verses.textZhCuv: 为要给孤儿和受欺压的人伸冤， 使强横的人不再威吓他们。
verses.textEnNiv: defending the fatherless and the oppressed, so that mere earthly mortals will never again strike terror.
verses.textEnEsv: to do justice to the fatherless and the oppressed, so that man who is of the earth may strike terror no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: To do justice to the fatherless and the oppressed, That the man of the earth may oppress no more.
verses.textEnNlt: You will bring justice to the orphans and the oppressed, so mere people can no longer terrify them.
verses.textEnNasb: To vindicate the orphan and the oppressed, So that mankind, which is of the earth, will no longer cause terror.
verses.textEn: defending the fatherless and the oppressed, so that mere earthly mortals will never again strike terror.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 我投靠耶和华，你们怎么对我说： "你要像飞鸟逃到你的山上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 我投靠耶和华，你们怎么对我说： "你要像飞鸟逃到你的山上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是投靠耶和华； 你们怎么对我说：你当像鸟飞往你的山去。
verses.textEnNiv: In the Lord I take refuge. How then can you say to me: "Flee like a bird to your mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: In the Lord I take refuge; how can you say to my soul, Flee like a bird to your mountain,
verses.textEnNkjv: In the Lord I put my trust; How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain"?
verses.textEnNlt: I trust in the Lord for protection. So why do you say to me, "Fly like a bird to the mountains for safety!
verses.textEnNasb: In the Lord I take refuge; How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.textEn: In the Lord I take refuge. How then can you say to me: "Flee like a bird to your mountain.

verses.textZh: 看哪！恶人的弓已经拉开， 箭已经上弦， 要从暗处射那心里正直的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！恶人的弓已经拉开， 箭已经上弦， 要从暗处射那心里正直的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，恶人弯弓，把箭搭在弦上， 要在暗中射那心里正直的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For look, the wicked bend their bows; they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
verses.textEnEsv: for behold, the wicked bend the bow; they have fitted their arrow to the string to shoot in the dark at the upright in heart;
verses.textEnNkjv: For look! The wicked bend their bow, They make ready their arrow on the string, That they may shoot secretly at the upright in heart.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked are stringing their bows and fitting their arrows on the bowstrings. They shoot from the shadows at those whose hearts are right.
verses.textEnNasb: "For, behold, the wicked bend the bow, They have set their arrow on the string To shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
verses.textEn: For look, the wicked bend their bows; they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.

verses.textZh: 根基既然毁坏， 义人还能作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 根基既然毁坏， 义人还能作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 根基若毁坏， 义人还能做什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: When the foundations are being destroyed, what can the righteous do?"
verses.textEnEsv: if the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.textEnNkjv: If the foundations are destroyed, What can the righteous do?
verses.textEnNlt: The foundations of law and order have collapsed. What can the righteous do?"
verses.textEnNasb: "If the foundations are destroyed, What can the righteous do?"
verses.textEn: When the foundations are being destroyed, what can the righteous do?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华在他的圣殿里， 耶和华的宝座在天上， 他的眼睛观看，他的目光察验世人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在他的圣殿里， 耶和华的宝座在天上， 他的眼睛观看，他的目光察验世人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在他的圣殿里； 耶和华的宝座在天上； 他的慧眼察看世人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord is on his heavenly throne. He observes everyone on earth; his eyes examine them.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord ’s throne is in heaven; his eyes see, his eyelids test the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis in His holy temple, The Lord’s throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, His eyelids test the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord is in his holy Temple; the Lord still rules from heaven. He watches everyone closely, examining every person on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is in His holy temple; the Lord’s throne is in heaven; His eyes see, His eyelids test the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord is on his heavenly throne. He observes everyone on earth; his eyes examine them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华试验义人和恶人， 他的心恨恶喜爱强暴的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华试验义人和恶人， 他的心恨恶喜爱强暴的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华试验义人； 惟有恶人和喜爱强暴的人，他心里恨恶。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord examines the righteous, but the wicked, those who love violence, he hates with a passion.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord tests the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and the one who loves violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord tests the righteous, But the wicked and the one who loves violence His soul hates.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord examines both the righteous and the wicked. He hates those who love violence.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord tests the righteous and the wicked, And His soul hates one who loves violence.
verses.textEn: The Lord examines the righteous, but the wicked, those who love violence, he hates with a passion.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使火炭落在恶人身上， 烈火、硫磺和旱风是他们杯中的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使火炭落在恶人身上， 烈火、硫磺和旱风是他们杯中的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要向恶人密布网罗； 有烈火、硫磺、热风，作他们杯中的分。
verses.textEnNiv: On the wicked he will rain fiery coals and burning sulfur; a scorching wind will be their lot.
verses.textEnEsv: Let him rain coals on the wicked; fire and sulfur and a scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.textEnNkjv: Upon the wicked He will rain coals; Fire and brimstone and a burning wind Shallbe the portion of their cup.
verses.textEnNlt: He will rain down blazing coals and burning sulfur on the wicked, punishing them with scorching winds.
verses.textEnNasb: He will rain coals of fire upon the wicked, And brimstone and burning wind will be the portion of their cup.
verses.textEn: On the wicked he will rain fiery coals and burning sulfur; a scorching wind will be their lot.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华是公义的，他喜爱公义的行为， 正直的人必得见他的面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华是公义的，他喜爱公义的行为， 正直的人必得见他的面。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华是公义的，他喜爱公义； 正直人必得见他的面。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord is righteous, he loves justice; the upright will see his face.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord is righteous; he loves righteous deeds; the upright shall behold his face.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lordis righteous, He loves righteousness; His countenance beholds the upright.
verses.textEnNlt: For the righteous Lord loves justice. The virtuous will see his face.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord is righteous, He loves righteousness; The upright will see His face.
verses.textEn: For the Lord is righteous, he loves justice; the upright will see his face.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，调用"舍明尼"。 耶和华啊！求你施行拯救，因为虔诚人没有了， 在世人中的信实人也不见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，调用"舍明尼"。 耶和华啊！求你施行拯救，因为虔诚人没有了， 在世人中的信实人也不见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你帮助，因虔诚人断绝了； 世人中间的忠信人没有了。
verses.textEnNiv: Help, Lord , for no one is faithful anymore; those who are loyal have vanished from the human race.
verses.textEnEsv: Save, O Lord , for the godly one is gone; for the faithful have vanished from among the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Help, Lord, for the godly man ceases! For the faithful disappear from among the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: Help, O Lord , for the godly are fast disappearing! The faithful have vanished from the earth!
verses.textEnNasb: Help, Lord, for the godly person has come to an end, For the faithful have disappeared from the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: Help, Lord , for no one is faithful anymore; those who are loyal have vanished from the human race.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此说谎， 用谄媚的嘴唇说话，口是心非。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此说谎， 用谄媚的嘴唇说话，口是心非。
verses.textZhCuv: 人人向邻舍说谎； 他们说话，是嘴唇油滑，心口不一。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone lies to their neighbor; they flatter with their lips but harbor deception in their hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: Everyone utters lies to his neighbor; with flattering lips and a double heart they speak.
verses.textEnNkjv: They speak idly everyone with his neighbor; With flattering lips and a double heart they speak.
verses.textEnNlt: Neighbors lie to each other, speaking with flattering lips and deceitful hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: They speak lies to one another; They speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
verses.textEn: Everyone lies to their neighbor; they flatter with their lips but harbor deception in their hearts.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华剪除一切说谄媚话的嘴唇， 和说夸大话的舌头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华剪除一切说谄媚话的嘴唇， 和说夸大话的舌头。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡油滑的嘴唇和夸大的舌头， 耶和华必要剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord silence all flattering lips and every boastful tongue—
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that makes great boasts,
verses.textEnNkjv: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, And the tongue that speaks proud things,
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord cut off their flattering lips and silence their boastful tongues.
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaks great things;
verses.textEn: May the Lord silence all flattering lips and every boastful tongue—

verses.textZh: 他们曾说："我们必能以舌头取胜； 我们的嘴唇是自己的，谁能作我们的主呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们曾说："我们必能以舌头取胜； 我们的嘴唇是自己的，谁能作我们的主呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们曾说：我们必能以舌头得胜； 我们的嘴唇是我们自己的， 谁能作我们的主呢？
verses.textEnNiv: those who say, "By our tongues we will prevail; our own lips will defend us—who is lord over us?"
verses.textEnEsv: those who say, "With our tongue we will prevail, our lips are with us; who is master over us?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail; Our lips are our own; Who is lord over us?"
verses.textEnNlt: They say, "We will lie to our hearts’ content. Our lips are our own—who can stop us?"
verses.textEnNasb: Who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail; Our lips are our own; who is lord over us?"
verses.textEn: those who say, "By our tongues we will prevail; our own lips will defend us—who is lord over us?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："因为困苦人的冤屈和贫穷人的叹息， 我现在要起来，把他们安置在他们渴望的稳妥之中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："因为困苦人的冤屈和贫穷人的叹息， 我现在要起来，把他们安置在他们渴望的稳妥之中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：因为困苦人的冤屈 和贫穷人的叹息， 我现在要起来， 把他安置在他所切慕的稳妥之地。
verses.textEnNiv: "Because the poor are plundered and the needy groan, I will now arise," says the Lord . "I will protect them from those who malign them."
verses.textEnEsv: "Because the poor are plundered, because the needy groan, I will now arise," says the Lord ; "I will place him in the safety for which he longs."
verses.textEnNkjv: "For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, Now I will arise," says the Lord; "I will set him in the safety for which he yearns."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replies, "I have seen violence done to the helpless, and I have heard the groans of the poor. Now I will rise up to rescue them, as they have longed for me to do."
verses.textEnNasb: "Because of the devastation of the poor, because of the groaning of the needy, Now I will arise," says the Lord; "I will put him in the safety for which he longs."
verses.textEn: "Because the poor are plundered and the needy groan, I will now arise," says the Lord . "I will protect them from those who malign them."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的言语是纯净的言语， 好象银子在泥炉中炼过，精炼过七次一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的言语是纯净的言语， 好象银子在泥炉中炼过，精炼过七次一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的言语是纯净的言语， 如同银子在泥炉中炼过七次。
verses.textEnNiv: And the words of the Lord are flawless, like silver purified in a crucible, like gold refined seven times.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of the Lord are pure words, like silver refined in a furnace on the ground, purified seven times.
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of the Lordare pure words, Like silver tried in a furnace of earth, Purified seven times.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord ’s promises are pure, like silver refined in a furnace, purified seven times over.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of the Lord are pure words; Like silver refined in a furnace on the ground, filtered seven times.
verses.textEn: And the words of the Lord are flawless, like silver purified in a crucible, like gold refined seven times.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你保守我们， 保护我们 永远脱离这世代的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你保守我们， 保护我们 永远脱离这世代的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你必保护他们； 你必保佑他们永远脱离这世代的人。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord , will keep the needy safe and will protect us forever from the wicked,
verses.textEnEsv: You, O Lord , will keep them; you will guard us from this generation forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall keep them, O Lord, You shall preserve them from this generation forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, Lord , we know you will protect the oppressed, preserving them forever from this lying generation,
verses.textEnNasb: You, Lord, will keep them; You will protect him from this generation forever.
verses.textEn: You, Lord , will keep the needy safe and will protect us forever from the wicked,

verses.textZh: 恶人到处横行， 邪恶在世人中被高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人到处横行， 邪恶在世人中被高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 下流人在世人中升高， 就有恶人到处游行。
verses.textEnNiv: who freely strut about when what is vile is honored by the human race.
verses.textEnEsv: On every side the wicked prowl, as vileness is exalted among the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked prowl on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: even though the wicked strut about, and evil is praised throughout the land.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked strut about on every side When vileness is exalted among the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: who freely strut about when what is vile is honored by the human race.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 耶和华啊！你忘记我要到几时呢？ 要到永远吗？ 你掩面不顾我，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 耶和华啊！你忘记我要到几时呢？ 要到永远吗？ 你掩面不顾我，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你忘记我要到几时呢？要到永远吗？ 你掩面不顾我要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long, Lord ? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
verses.textEnEsv: How long, O Lord ? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
verses.textEnNkjv: How long, O Lord? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , how long will you forget me? Forever? How long will you look the other way?
verses.textEnNasb: How long, Lord? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
verses.textEn: How long, Lord ? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

verses.textZh: 我心里筹算不安，内心终日愁苦，要到几时呢？ 我的仇敌胜过我，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心里筹算不安，内心终日愁苦，要到几时呢？ 我的仇敌胜过我，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我心里筹算，终日愁苦，要到几时呢？ 我的仇敌升高压制我，要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and day after day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?
verses.textEnEsv: How long must I take counsel in my soul and have sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall my enemy be exalted over me?
verses.textEnNkjv: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart daily? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?
verses.textEnNlt: How long must I struggle with anguish in my soul, with sorrow in my heart every day? How long will my enemy have the upper hand?
verses.textEnNasb: How long am I to feel anxious in my soul, With grief in my heart all the day? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?
verses.textEn: How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and day after day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神啊！求你看顾我，应允我； 求你使我的眼睛明亮，免得我沉睡至死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神啊！求你看顾我，应允我； 求你使我的眼睛明亮，免得我沉睡至死；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神啊，求你看顾我，应允我！ 使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死；
verses.textEnNiv: Look on me and answer, Lord my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death,
verses.textEnEsv: Consider and answer me, O Lord my God; light up my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death,
verses.textEnNkjv: Consider and hear me, O Lord my God; Enlighten my eyes, Lest I sleep the sleepof death;
verses.textEnNlt: Turn and answer me, O Lord my God! Restore the sparkle to my eyes, or I will die.
verses.textEnNasb: Consider and answer me, O Lord my God; Enlighten my eyes, or I will sleep the sleep of death,
verses.textEn: Look on me and answer, Lord my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death,

verses.textZh: 免得我的仇敌说："我胜过了他"； 免得我跌倒的时候我的敌人就欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得我的仇敌说："我胜过了他"； 免得我跌倒的时候我的敌人就欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得我的仇敌说：我胜了他； 免得我的敌人在我摇动的时候喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: and my enemy will say, "I have overcome him," and my foes will rejoice when I fall.
verses.textEnEsv: lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed over him," lest my foes rejoice because I am shaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed against him"; Lest those who trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let my enemies gloat, saying, "We have defeated him!" Don’t let them rejoice at my downfall.
verses.textEnNasb: And my enemy will say, "I have overcome him," And my adversaries will rejoice when I am shaken.
verses.textEn: and my enemy will say, "I have overcome him," and my foes will rejoice when I fall.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我倚靠你的慈爱， 我的心必因你的救恩欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我倚靠你的慈爱， 我的心必因你的救恩欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我倚靠你的慈爱； 我的心因你的救恩快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: But I trust in your unfailing love; my heart rejoices in your salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: But I have trusted in your steadfast love; my heart shall rejoice in your salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I have trusted in Your mercy; My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: But I trust in your unfailing love. I will rejoice because you have rescued me.
verses.textEnNasb: But I have trusted in Your faithfulness; My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.
verses.textEn: But I trust in your unfailing love; my heart rejoices in your salvation.

verses.textZh: 我要歌颂耶和华，因他以厚恩待我。 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要歌颂耶和华，因他以厚恩待我。 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要向耶和华歌唱， 因他用厚恩待我。
verses.textEnNiv: I will sing the Lord ’s praise, for he has been good to me.
verses.textEnEsv: I will sing to the Lord , because he has dealt bountifully with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will sing to the Lord, Because He has dealt bountifully with me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will sing to the Lord because he is good to me.
verses.textEnNasb: I will sing to the Lord, Because He has looked after me.
verses.textEn: I will sing the Lord ’s praise, for he has been good to me.

verses.textZh: 愚顽人心里说："没有神。" 他们都是败坏，行了可憎的事， 没有一个行善的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚顽人心里说："没有神。" 他们都是败坏，行了可憎的事， 没有一个行善的。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚顽人心里说：没有神。 他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的事； 没有一个人行善。
verses.textEnNiv: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.
verses.textEnEsv: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, they do abominable deeds; there is none who does good.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fool has said in his heart, "Thereis no God." They are corrupt, They have done abominable works, There is none who does good.
verses.textEnNlt: Only fools say in their hearts, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and their actions are evil; not one of them does good!
verses.textEnNasb: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, they have committed detestable acts; There is no one who does good.
verses.textEn: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.

verses.textZh: 耶和华从天上察看世人， 要看看有明慧的没有， 有寻求神的没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华从天上察看世人， 要看看有明慧的没有， 有寻求神的没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华从天上垂看世人， 要看有明白的没有， 有寻求神的没有。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord looks down from heaven on the children of man, to see if there are any who understand, who seek after God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord looks down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there are any who understand, who seek God.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord looks down from heaven on the entire human race; he looks to see if anyone is truly wise, if anyone seeks God.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has looked down from heaven upon the sons of mankind To see if there are any who understand, Who seek God.
verses.textEn: The Lord looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

verses.textZh: 人人都偏离了正道，一同变成污秽； 没有行善的，连一个也没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人人都偏离了正道，一同变成污秽； 没有行善的，连一个也没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都偏离正路， 一同变为污秽； 并没有行善的， 连一个也没有。
verses.textEnNiv: All have turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
verses.textEnEsv: They have all turned aside; together they have become corrupt; there is none who does good, not even one.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have all turned aside, They have together become corrupt; Thereis none who does good, No, not one.
verses.textEnNlt: But no, all have turned away; all have become corrupt. No one does good, not a single one!
verses.textEnNasb: They have all turned aside, together they are corrupt; There is no one who does good, not even one.
verses.textEn: All have turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

verses.textZh: 所有作恶的都是无知的吗？ 他们吞吃我的子民好象吃饭一样， 并不求告耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有作恶的都是无知的吗？ 他们吞吃我的子民好象吃饭一样， 并不求告耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 作孽的都没有知识吗？ 他们吞吃我的百姓，如同吃饭一样， 并不求告耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Have they no knowledge, all the evildoers who eat up my people as they eat bread and do not call upon the Lord ?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And do not call on the Lord?
verses.textEnNlt: Will those who do evil never learn? They eat up my people like bread and wouldn’t think of praying to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Do all the workers of injustice not know, Who devour my people as they eat bread, And do not call upon the Lord?
verses.textEn: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们必大大震惊， 因为神在义人的群体中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必大大震惊， 因为神在义人的群体中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在那里大大地害怕， 因为神在义人的族类中。
verses.textEnNiv: But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is present in the company of the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: There they are in great terror, for God is with the generation of the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: There they are in great fear, For God is with the generation of the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: Terror will grip them, for God is with those who obey him.
verses.textEnNasb: There they are in great dread, For God is with a righteous generation.
verses.textEn: But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is present in the company of the righteous.

verses.textZh: 你们要使困苦人的计划失败， 但耶和华是他的避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要使困苦人的计划失败， 但耶和华是他的避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们叫困苦人的谋算变为羞辱； 然而耶和华是他的避难所。
verses.textEnNiv: You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor, but the Lord is their refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: You would shame the plans of the poor, but the Lord is his refuge.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shame the counsel of the poor, But the Lordis his refuge.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked frustrate the plans of the oppressed, but the Lord will protect his people.
verses.textEnNasb: You would put to shame the plan of the poor, But the Lord is his refuge.
verses.textEn: You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor, but the Lord is their refuge.

verses.textZh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出； 耶和华给他子民带来复兴的时候 ， 雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出； 耶和华给他子民带来复兴的时候 ， 雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。 耶和华救回他被掳的子民那时， 雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the Lord restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the Lord restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that the salvation of Israel wouldcome out of Zion! When the Lord brings back the captivity of His people, Let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad.
verses.textEnNlt: Who will come from Mount Zion to rescue Israel? When the Lord restores his people, Jacob will shout with joy, and Israel will rejoice.
verses.textEnNasb: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the Lord restores the fortunes of His people, Jacob will rejoice, Israel will be glad.
verses.textEn: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the Lord restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！谁能在你的帐幕里寄居？ 谁能在你的圣山上居住呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！谁能在你的帐幕里寄居？ 谁能在你的圣山上居住呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，谁能寄居你的帐幕？ 谁能住在你的圣山？
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , who may dwell in your sacred tent? Who may live on your holy mountain?
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , who shall sojourn in your tent? Who shall dwell on your holy hill?
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, who may abide in Your tabernacle? Who may dwell in Your holy hill?
verses.textEnNlt: Who may worship in your sanctuary, Lord ? Who may enter your presence on your holy hill?
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, who may reside in Your tent? Who may settle on Your holy hill?
verses.textEn: Lord , who may dwell in your sacred tent? Who may live on your holy mountain?

verses.textZh: 就是行为完全，作事公义， 心里说诚实话的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是行为完全，作事公义， 心里说诚实话的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是行为正直、做事公义、 心里说实话的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The one whose walk is blameless, who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from their heart;
verses.textEnEsv: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right and speaks truth in his heart;
verses.textEnNkjv: He who walks uprightly, And works righteousness, And speaks the truth in his heart;
verses.textEnNlt: Those who lead blameless lives and do what is right, speaking the truth from sincere hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: One who walks with integrity, practices righteousness, And speaks truth in his heart.
verses.textEn: The one whose walk is blameless, who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from their heart;

verses.textZh: 他不以舌头诋毁人， 不恶待朋友， 也不毁谤他的邻居。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不以舌头诋毁人， 不恶待朋友， 也不毁谤他的邻居。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不以舌头谗谤人， 不恶待朋友， 也不随伙毁谤邻里。
verses.textEnNiv: whose tongue utters no slander, who does no wrong to a neighbor, and casts no slur on others;
verses.textEnEsv: who does not slander with his tongue and does no evil to his neighbor, nor takes up a reproach against his friend;
verses.textEnNkjv: He who does not backbite with his tongue, Nor does evil to his neighbor, Nor does he take up a reproach against his friend;
verses.textEnNlt: Those who refuse to gossip or harm their neighbors or speak evil of their friends.
verses.textEnNasb: He does not slander with his tongue, Nor do evil to his neighbor, Nor bring shame on his friend;
verses.textEn: whose tongue utters no slander, who does no wrong to a neighbor, and casts no slur on others;

verses.textZh: 他眼中藐视卑鄙的人， 却尊重敬畏耶和华的人。 他起了誓，纵然自己吃亏，也不更改。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他眼中藐视卑鄙的人， 却尊重敬畏耶和华的人。 他起了誓，纵然自己吃亏，也不更改。
verses.textZhCuv: 他眼中藐视匪类， 却尊重那敬畏耶和华的人。 他发了誓，虽然自己吃亏也不更改。
verses.textEnNiv: who despises a vile person but honors those who fear the Lord ; who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and does not change their mind;
verses.textEnEsv: in whose eyes a vile person is despised, but who honors those who fear the Lord ; who swears to his own hurt and does not change;
verses.textEnNkjv: In whose eyes a vile person is despised, But he honors those who fear the Lord; He who swears to his own hurt and does not change;
verses.textEnNlt: Those who despise flagrant sinners, and honor the faithful followers of the Lord , and keep their promises even when it hurts.
verses.textEnNasb: A despicable person is despised in his eyes, But he honors those who fear the Lord; He takes an oath to his own detriment, and does not change;
verses.textEn: who despises a vile person but honors those who fear the Lord ; who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and does not change their mind;

verses.textZh: 他不拿自己的银子放债取利， 也不收受贿赂陷害无辜； 行这些事的人，必永不动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不拿自己的银子放债取利， 也不收受贿赂陷害无辜； 行这些事的人，必永不动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不放债取利， 不受贿赂以害无辜。 行这些事的人必永不动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: who lends money to the poor without interest; who does not accept a bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.
verses.textEnEsv: who does not put out his money at interest and does not take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be moved.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who does not put out his money at usury, Nor does he take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who lend money without charging interest, and who cannot be bribed to lie about the innocent. Such people will stand firm forever.
verses.textEnNasb: He does not lend his money at interest, Nor does he take a bribe against the innocent. One who does these things will never be shaken.
verses.textEn: who lends money to the poor without interest; who does not accept a bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.

verses.textZh: 大卫的金诗。神啊！求你保守我，因为我投靠你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的金诗。神啊！求你保守我，因为我投靠你。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你保佑我， 因为我投靠你。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep me safe, my God, for in you I take refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: Preserve me, O God, for in you I take refuge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Preserve me, O God, for in You I put my trust.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep me safe, O God, for I have come to you for refuge.
verses.textEnNasb: Protect me, God, for I take refuge in You.
verses.textEn: Keep me safe, my God, for in you I take refuge.

verses.textZh: 我 曾对耶和华说："你是我的主， 我的好处不在你以外。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我 曾对耶和华说："你是我的主， 我的好处不在你以外。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心哪，你曾对耶和华说：你是我的主； 我的好处不在你以外。
verses.textEnNiv: I say to the Lord , "You are my Lord; apart from you I have no good thing."
verses.textEnEsv: I say to the Lord , "You are my Lord; I have no good apart from you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Omysoul, you have said to the Lord, "You are my Lord, My goodness is nothing apart from You."
verses.textEnNlt: I said to the Lord , "You are my Master! Every good thing I have comes from you."
verses.textEnNasb: I said to the Lord, "You are my Lord; I have nothing good besides You."
verses.textEn: I say to the Lord , "You are my Lord; apart from you I have no good thing."

verses.textZh: 至于世上的圣民， 他们都是尊贵荣美的人，全是我所喜爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于世上的圣民， 他们都是尊贵荣美的人，全是我所喜爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到世上的圣民，他们又美又善， 是我最喜悦的。
verses.textEnNiv: I say of the holy people who are in the land, "They are the noble ones in whom is all my delight."
verses.textEnEsv: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellent ones, in whom is all my delight.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the saints who are on the earth, "They are the excellent ones, in whom is all my delight."
verses.textEnNlt: The godly people in the land are my true heroes! I take pleasure in them!
verses.textEnNasb: As for the saints who are on the earth, They are the majestic ones; all my delight is in them.
verses.textEn: I say of the holy people who are in the land, "They are the noble ones in whom is all my delight."

verses.textZh: 追求别神的，他们的愁苦必定加多。 他们所奠的血祭，我不祭奠； 我的嘴唇也不提别神的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 追求别神的，他们的愁苦必定加多。 他们所奠的血祭，我不祭奠； 我的嘴唇也不提别神的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 以别神代替耶和华的 ， 他们的愁苦必加增； 他们所浇奠的血我不献上； 我嘴唇也不提别神的名号。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who run after other gods will suffer more and more. I will not pour out libations of blood to such gods or take up their names on my lips.
verses.textEnEsv: The sorrows of those who run after another god shall multiply; their drink offerings of blood I will not pour out or take their names on my lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who hasten after another god; Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, Nor take up their names on my lips.
verses.textEnNlt: Troubles multiply for those who chase after other gods. I will not take part in their sacrifices of blood or even speak the names of their gods.
verses.textEnNasb: The pains of those who have acquired another god will be multiplied; I will not pour out their drink offerings of blood, Nor will I take their names upon my lips.
verses.textEn: Those who run after other gods will suffer more and more. I will not pour out libations of blood to such gods or take up their names on my lips.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是我的产业，是我杯中的分； 我所得的业分，你亲自为我持守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是我的产业，是我杯中的分； 我所得的业分，你亲自为我持守。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是我的产业， 是我杯中的分； 我所得的，你为我持守。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , you alone are my portion and my cup; you make my lot secure.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is my chosen portion and my cup; you hold my lot.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, Youare the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You maintain my lot.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you alone are my inheritance, my cup of blessing. You guard all that is mine.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You support my lot.
verses.textEn: Lord , you alone are my portion and my cup; you make my lot secure.

verses.textZh: 准绳量给我的是佳美之地， 我的产业实在令我喜悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 准绳量给我的是佳美之地， 我的产业实在令我喜悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 用绳量给我的地界，坐落在佳美之处； 我的产业实在美好。
verses.textEnNiv: The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; surely I have a delightful inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: The lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; indeed, I have a beautiful inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places; Yes, I have a good inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: The land you have given me is a pleasant land. What a wonderful inheritance!
verses.textEnNasb: The measuring lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; Indeed, my inheritance is beautiful to me.
verses.textEn: The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; surely I have a delightful inheritance.

verses.textZh: 我要称颂那指导我的耶和华， 我的心在夜间也劝戒我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要称颂那指导我的耶和华， 我的心在夜间也劝戒我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必称颂那指教我的耶和华； 我的心肠在夜间也警戒我。
verses.textEnNiv: I will praise the Lord , who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.
verses.textEnEsv: I bless the Lord who gives me counsel; in the night also my heart instructs me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bless the Lord who has given me counsel; My heart also instructs me in the night seasons.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bless the Lord who guides me; even at night my heart instructs me.
verses.textEnNasb: I will bless the Lord who has advised me; Indeed, my mind instructs me in the night.
verses.textEn: I will praise the Lord , who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.

verses.textZh: 我常常把耶和华摆在我面前， 因他在我右边，我必不会动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我常常把耶和华摆在我面前， 因他在我右边，我必不会动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将耶和华常摆在我面前， 因他在我右边，我便不致摇动。
verses.textEnNiv: I keep my eyes always on the Lord . With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
verses.textEnEsv: I have set the Lord always before me; because he is at my right hand, I shall not be shaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have set the Lord always before me; Because Heis at my right hand I shall not be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: I know the Lord is always with me. I will not be shaken, for he is right beside me.
verses.textEnNasb: I have set the Lord continually before me; Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
verses.textEn: I keep my eyes always on the Lord . With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

verses.textZh: 为此我的心快乐，我的灵 欢欣， 我的肉身也必安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为此我的心快乐，我的灵 欢欣， 我的肉身也必安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我的心欢喜，我的灵 快乐； 我的肉身也要安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore my heart is glad, and my whole being rejoices; my flesh also dwells secure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices; My flesh also will rest in hope.
verses.textEnNlt: No wonder my heart is glad, and I rejoice. My body rests in safety.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore my heart is glad and my glory rejoices; My flesh also will dwell securely.
verses.textEn: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure,

verses.textZh: 因为你必不把我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也必不容你的圣者见朽坏 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你必不把我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也必不容你的圣者见朽坏 。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。
verses.textEnNiv: because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, nor will you let your faithful one see decay.
verses.textEnEsv: For you will not abandon my soul to Sheol, or let your holy one see corruption.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You will not leave my soul in Sheol, Nor will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.
verses.textEnNlt: For you will not leave my soul among the dead or allow your holy one to rot in the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol; You will not allow Your Holy One to undergo decay.
verses.textEn: because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, nor will you let your faithful one see decay.

verses.textZh: 你必把生命的路指示我， 在你面前有满足的喜乐， 在你的右手中有永远的福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必把生命的路指示我， 在你面前有满足的喜乐， 在你的右手中有永远的福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必将生命的道路指示我。 在你面前有满足的喜乐； 在你右手中有永远的福乐。
verses.textEnNiv: You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.
verses.textEnEsv: You make known to me the path of life; in your presence there is fullness of joy; at your right hand are pleasures forevermore.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will show me the path of life; In Your presence is fullness of joy; At Your right hand are pleasures forevermore.
verses.textEnNlt: You will show me the way of life, granting me the joy of your presence and the pleasures of living with you forever.
verses.textEnNasb: You will make known to me the way of life; In Your presence is fullness of joy; In Your right hand there are pleasures forever.
verses.textEn: You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

verses.textZh: 大卫的祷告。 耶和华啊！求你垂听我公义的案件， 倾听我的申诉； 求你留心听我的祷告， 这不是出于诡诈嘴唇的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的祷告。 耶和华啊！求你垂听我公义的案件， 倾听我的申诉； 求你留心听我的祷告， 这不是出于诡诈嘴唇的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你听闻公义， 侧耳听我的呼吁！ 求你留心听我这不出于诡诈嘴唇的祈祷！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear me, Lord , my plea is just; listen to my cry. Hear my prayer— it does not rise from deceitful lips.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear a just cause, O Lord ; attend to my cry! Give ear to my prayer from lips free of deceit!
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear a just cause, O Lord, Attend to my cry; Give ear to my prayer whichis not from deceitful lips.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , hear my plea for justice. Listen to my cry for help. Pay attention to my prayer, for it comes from honest lips.
verses.textEnNasb: Hear a just cause, Lord, give Your attention to my cry; Listen to my prayer, which is not from deceitful lips.
verses.textEn: Hear me, Lord , my plea is just; listen to my cry. Hear my prayer— it does not rise from deceitful lips.

verses.textZh: 愿我的判词从你面前发出， 愿你的眼睛察看正直的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我的判词从你面前发出， 愿你的眼睛察看正直的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我的判语从你面前发出； 愿你的眼睛观看公正。
verses.textEnNiv: Let my vindication come from you; may your eyes see what is right.
verses.textEnEsv: From your presence let my vindication come! Let your eyes behold the right!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let my vindication come from Your presence; Let Your eyes look on the things that are upright.
verses.textEnNlt: Declare me innocent, for you see those who do right.
verses.textEnNasb: Let my judgment come forth from Your presence; Let Your eyes look with integrity.
verses.textEn: Let my vindication come from you; may your eyes see what is right.

verses.textZh: 你试验了我的心，在夜间鉴察了我； 你熬炼了我，还是找不到甚么， 因为我立志使我的口没有过犯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你试验了我的心，在夜间鉴察了我； 你熬炼了我，还是找不到甚么， 因为我立志使我的口没有过犯。
verses.textZhCuv: 你已经试验我的心； 你在夜间鉴察我； 你熬炼我，却找不着什么； 我立志叫我口中没有过失。
verses.textEnNiv: Though you probe my heart, though you examine me at night and test me, you will find that I have planned no evil; my mouth has not transgressed.
verses.textEnEsv: You have tried my heart, you have visited me by night, you have tested me, and you will find nothing; I have purposed that my mouth will not transgress.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have tested my heart; You have visited me in the night; You have tried me and have found nothing; I have purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.textEnNlt: You have tested my thoughts and examined my heart in the night. You have scrutinized me and found nothing wrong. I am determined not to sin in what I say.
verses.textEnNasb: You have put my heart to the test; You have visited me by night; You have sifted me and You find nothing; My intent is that my mouth will not offend.
verses.textEn: Though you probe my heart, though you examine me at night and test me, you will find that I have planned no evil; my mouth has not transgressed.

verses.textZh: 至于世人的行为， 我借着你嘴唇所出的话，保护了自己， 不行强暴人的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于世人的行为， 我借着你嘴唇所出的话，保护了自己， 不行强暴人的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到人的行为，我藉着你嘴唇的言语自己谨守， 不行强暴人的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: Though people tried to bribe me, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent through what your lips have commanded.
verses.textEnEsv: With regard to the works of man, by the word of your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Concerning the works of men, By the word of Your lips, I have kept away from the paths of the destroyer.
verses.textEnNlt: I have followed your commands, which keep me from following cruel and evil people.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the works of mankind, by the word of Your lips I have kept from the ways of the violent.
verses.textEn: Though people tried to bribe me, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent through what your lips have commanded.

verses.textZh: 我的脚步稳踏在你的路径上， 我的两脚没有动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的脚步稳踏在你的路径上， 我的两脚没有动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的脚踏定了你的路径； 我的两脚未曾滑跌。
verses.textEnNiv: My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not stumbled.
verses.textEnEsv: My steps have held fast to your paths; my feet have not slipped.
verses.textEnNkjv: Uphold my steps in Your paths, That my footsteps may not slip.
verses.textEnNlt: My steps have stayed on your path; I have not wavered from following you.
verses.textEnNasb: My steps have held to Your paths. My feet have not slipped.
verses.textEn: My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not stumbled.

verses.textZh: 神啊！我向你呼求，因为你必应允我； 求你侧耳听我，垂听我的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！我向你呼求，因为你必应允我； 求你侧耳听我，垂听我的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我曾求告你，因为你必应允我； 求你向我侧耳，听我的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: I call on you, my God, for you will answer me; turn your ear to me and hear my prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: I call upon you, for you will answer me, O God; incline your ear to me; hear my words.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have called upon You, for You will hear me, O God; Incline Your ear to me, and hear my speech.
verses.textEnNlt: I am praying to you because I know you will answer, O God. Bend down and listen as I pray.
verses.textEnNasb: I have called upon You, for You will answer me, God; Incline Your ear to me, hear my speech.
verses.textEn: I call on you, my God, for you will answer me; turn your ear to me and hear my prayer.

verses.textZh: 求你把你的慈爱奇妙地彰显， 用右手拯救那些投靠你的， 脱离那些起来攻击他们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你把你的慈爱奇妙地彰显， 用右手拯救那些投靠你的， 脱离那些起来攻击他们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你显出你奇妙的慈爱来； 你是那用右手拯救投靠你的脱离起来攻击他们的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Show me the wonders of your great love, you who save by your right hand those who take refuge in you from their foes.
verses.textEnEsv: Wondrously show your steadfast love, O Savior of those who seek refuge from their adversaries at your right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Show Your marvelous lovingkindness by Your right hand, O You who save those who trust inYou From those who rise up againstthem.
verses.textEnNlt: Show me your unfailing love in wonderful ways. By your mighty power you rescue those who seek refuge from their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: Show Your wonderful faithfulness, Savior of those who take refuge at Your right hand From those who rise up against them.
verses.textEn: Show me the wonders of your great love, you who save by your right hand those who take refuge in you from their foes.

verses.textZh: 求你保护我，像保护眼中的瞳人， 把我隐藏在你的翅膀荫下；
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你保护我，像保护眼中的瞳人， 把我隐藏在你的翅膀荫下；
verses.textZhCuv: 求你保护我，如同保护眼中的瞳人； 将我隐藏在你翅膀的荫下，
verses.textEnNiv: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings
verses.textEnEsv: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings,
verses.textEnNkjv: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; Hide me under the shadow of Your wings,
verses.textEnNlt: Guard me as you would guard your own eyes. Hide me in the shadow of your wings.
verses.textEnNasb: Keep me as the apple of the eye; Hide me in the shadow of Your wings
verses.textEn: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings

verses.textZh: 使我脱离那些欺压我的恶人， 脱离那些围绕我的死敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使我脱离那些欺压我的恶人， 脱离那些围绕我的死敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 使我脱离那欺压我的恶人， 就是围困我要害我命的仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: from the wicked who are out to destroy me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.
verses.textEnEsv: from the wicked who do me violence, my deadly enemies who surround me.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the wicked who oppress me, From my deadly enemies who surround me.
verses.textEnNlt: Protect me from wicked people who attack me, from murderous enemies who surround me.
verses.textEnNasb: From the wicked who deal violently with me, My deadly enemies who surround me.
verses.textEn: from the wicked who are out to destroy me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

verses.textZh: 他们闭塞了怜悯的心 ， 口里说出骄傲的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们闭塞了怜悯的心 ， 口里说出骄傲的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的心被脂油包裹； 他们用口说骄傲的话。
verses.textEnNiv: They close up their callous hearts, and their mouths speak with arrogance.
verses.textEnEsv: They close their hearts to pity; with their mouths they speak arrogantly.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have closed up their fat hearts; With their mouths they speak proudly.
verses.textEnNlt: They are without pity. Listen to their boasting!
verses.textEnNasb: They have closed their unfeeling hearts, With their mouths they speak proudly.
verses.textEn: They close up their callous hearts, and their mouths speak with arrogance.

verses.textZh: 他们追踪我，现在把我围困了 ； 他们瞪着眼，要把我推倒在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们追踪我，现在把我围困了 ； 他们瞪着眼，要把我推倒在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们围困了我们的脚步； 他们瞪着眼，要把我们推倒在地。
verses.textEnNiv: They have tracked me down, they now surround me, with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: They have now surrounded our steps; they set their eyes to cast us to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have now surrounded us in our steps; They have set their eyes, crouching down to the earth,
verses.textEnNlt: They track me down and surround me, watching for the chance to throw me to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: They have now surrounded us in our steps; They set their eyes to cast us down to the ground.
verses.textEn: They have tracked me down, they now surround me, with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.

verses.textZh: 他们像急于撕碎猎物的狮子， 又像蹲伏在隐密处的幼狮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们像急于撕碎猎物的狮子， 又像蹲伏在隐密处的幼狮。
verses.textZhCuv: 他像狮子急要抓食， 又像少壮狮子蹲伏在暗处。
verses.textEnNiv: They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a fierce lion crouching in cover.
verses.textEnEsv: He is like a lion eager to tear, as a young lion lurking in ambush.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a lion is eager to tear his prey, And like a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.textEnNlt: They are like hungry lions, eager to tear me apart— like young lions hiding in ambush.
verses.textEnNasb: He is like a lion that is eager to tear, And as a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.textEn: They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a fierce lion crouching in cover.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你起来，迎面攻击他们，把他们打倒； 用你的刀救我的命脱离恶人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你起来，迎面攻击他们，把他们打倒； 用你的刀救我的命脱离恶人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你起来，前去迎敌，将他打倒！ 用你的刀救护我命脱离恶人。
verses.textEnNiv: Rise up, Lord , confront them, bring them down; with your sword rescue me from the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, O Lord ! Confront him, subdue him! Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, O Lord, Confront him, cast him down; Deliver my life from the wicked with Your sword,
verses.textEnNlt: Arise, O Lord ! Stand against them, and bring them to their knees! Rescue me from the wicked with your sword!
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, Lord, confront him, make him bow down; Save my soul from the wicked with Your sword,
verses.textEn: Rise up, Lord , confront them, bring them down; with your sword rescue me from the wicked.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你用手救我脱离世人， 脱离那些只在今生有分的世人。 求你用你为他们储存的充满他们的肚腹， 使他们的儿女都可以饱尝， 他们还有剩余的留给他们的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你用手救我脱离世人， 脱离那些只在今生有分的世人。 求你用你为他们储存的充满他们的肚腹， 使他们的儿女都可以饱尝， 他们还有剩余的留给他们的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你用手救我脱离世人， 脱离那只在今生有福分的世人！ 你把你的财宝充满他们的肚腹； 他们因有儿女就心满意足， 将其余的财物留给他们的婴孩。
verses.textEnNiv: By your hand save me from such people, Lord , from those of this world whose reward is in this life. May what you have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies; may their children gorge themselves on it, and may there be leftovers for their little ones.
verses.textEnEsv: from men by your hand, O Lord , from men of the world whose portion is in this life. You fill their womb with treasure; they are satisfied with children, and they leave their abundance to their infants.
verses.textEnNkjv: With Your hand from men, O Lord, From men of the world whohave their portion in this life, And whose belly You fill with Your hidden treasure. They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their possession for their babes.
verses.textEnNlt: By the power of your hand, O Lord , destroy those who look to this world for their reward. But satisfy the hunger of your treasured ones. May their children have plenty, leaving an inheritance for their descendants.
verses.textEnNasb: From people by Your hand, Lord, From people of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly You fill with Your treasure; They are satisfied with children, And leave their abundance to their babies.
verses.textEn: By your hand save me from such people, Lord , from those of this world whose reward is in this life. May what you have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies; may their children gorge themselves on it, and may there be leftovers for their little ones.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我必在义中得见你的面； 我醒来的时候， 得见你的形象就心满意足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我必在义中得见你的面； 我醒来的时候， 得见你的形象就心满意足。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我必在义中见你的面； 我醒了的时候，得见 你的形象就心满意足了。
verses.textEnNiv: As for me, I will be vindicated and will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.
verses.textEnEsv: As for me, I shall behold your face in righteousness; when I awake, I shall be satisfied with your likeness.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for me, I will see Your face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied when I awake in Your likeness.
verses.textEnNlt: Because I am righteous, I will see you. When I awake, I will see you face to face and be satisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: As for me, I shall behold Your face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied with Your likeness when I awake.
verses.textEn: As for me, I will be vindicated and will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交给诗班长。在耶和华拯救他脱离所有仇敌和扫罗的手的日子，他向耶和华唱出这首歌的歌词。他说： 耶和华我的力量啊！我爱你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交给诗班长。在耶和华拯救他脱离所有仇敌和扫罗的手的日子，他向耶和华唱出这首歌的歌词。他说： 耶和华我的力量啊！我爱你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华，我的力量啊，我爱你！
verses.textEnNiv: I love you, Lord , my strength.
verses.textEnEsv: I love you, O Lord , my strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will love You, O Lord, my strength.
verses.textEnNlt: I love you, Lord ; you are my strength.
verses.textEnNasb: "I love You, Lord, my strength."
verses.textEn: I love you, Lord , my strength.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是我的岩石、我的山寨、我的救主、 我的神、我的盘石、我所投靠的、 我的盾牌、我救恩的角、我的高台。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是我的岩石、我的山寨、我的救主、 我的神、我的盘石、我所投靠的、 我的盾牌、我救恩的角、我的高台。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是我的岩石，我的山寨，我的救主， 我的神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。 他是我的盾牌， 是拯救我的角，是我的高台。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer, my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer; My God, my strength, in whom I will trust; My shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my savior; my God is my rock, in whom I find protection. He is my shield, the power that saves me, and my place of safety.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my savior, My God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; My shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
verses.textEn: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

verses.textZh: 我向那当受赞美的耶和华呼求， 就得到拯救，脱离我的仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向那当受赞美的耶和华呼求， 就得到拯救，脱离我的仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要求告当赞美的耶和华； 这样我必从仇敌手中被救出来。
verses.textEnNiv: I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and I have been saved from my enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: I call upon the Lord , who is worthy to be praised, and I am saved from my enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will call upon the Lord, whoisworthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: I called on the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and he saved me from my enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: I call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised, And I am saved from my enemies.
verses.textEn: I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and I have been saved from my enemies.

verses.textZh: 死亡的绳索环绕我， 毁灭的急流淹没了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 死亡的绳索环绕我， 毁灭的急流淹没了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 曾有死亡的绳索缠绕我， 匪类的急流使我惊惧，
verses.textEnNiv: The cords of death entangled me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.
verses.textEnEsv: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of destruction assailed me;
verses.textEnNkjv: The pangs of death surrounded me, And the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: The ropes of death entangled me; floods of destruction swept over me.
verses.textEnNasb: The ropes of death encompassed me, And the torrents of destruction terrified me.
verses.textEn: The cords of death entangled me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

verses.textZh: 阴间的绳索围绕着我， 死亡的网罗迎面而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阴间的绳索围绕着我， 死亡的网罗迎面而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 阴间的绳索缠绕我， 死亡的网罗临到我。
verses.textEnNiv: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.
verses.textEnEsv: the cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sorrows of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.
verses.textEnNlt: The grave wrapped its ropes around me; death laid a trap in my path.
verses.textEnNasb: The ropes of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.
verses.textEn: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.

verses.textZh: 急难临到我的时候，我求告耶和华， 我向我的神呼求； 他从殿中听了我的声音， 我在他面前的呼求进了他的耳中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 急难临到我的时候，我求告耶和华， 我向我的神呼求； 他从殿中听了我的声音， 我在他面前的呼求进了他的耳中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 向我的神呼求。 他从殿中听了我的声音； 我在他面前的呼求入了他的耳中。
verses.textEnNiv: In my distress I called to the Lord ; I cried to my God for help. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came before him, into his ears.
verses.textEnEsv: In my distress I called upon the Lord ; to my God I cried for help. From his temple he heard my voice, and my cry to him reached his ears.
verses.textEnNkjv: In my distress I called upon the Lord, And cried out to my God; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry came before Him, even to His ears.
verses.textEnNlt: But in my distress I cried out to the Lord ; yes, I prayed to my God for help. He heard me from his sanctuary; my cry to him reached his ears.
verses.textEnNasb: In my distress I called upon the Lord, And cried to my God for help; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry for help before Him came into His ears.
verses.textEn: In my distress I called to the Lord ; I cried to my God for help. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came before him, into his ears.

verses.textZh: 那时大地摇撼震动， 群山的根基也都动摇， 它们摇撼，是因为耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时大地摇撼震动， 群山的根基也都动摇， 它们摇撼，是因为耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，因他发怒，地就摇撼战抖； 山的根基也震动摇撼。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth trembled and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shook; they trembled because he was angry.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the earth reeled and rocked; the foundations also of the mountains trembled and quaked, because he was angry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations of the hills also quaked and were shaken, Because He was angry.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the earth quaked and trembled. The foundations of the mountains shook; they quaked because of his anger.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the earth shook and quaked; And the foundations of the mountains were trembling And were shaken, because He was angry.
verses.textEn: The earth trembled and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shook; they trembled because he was angry.

verses.textZh: 浓烟从他的鼻孔往上冒， 烈火从他的口中喷出来， 连炭也烧着了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 浓烟从他的鼻孔往上冒， 烈火从他的口中喷出来， 连炭也烧着了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从他鼻孔冒烟上腾； 从他口中发火焚烧，连炭也着了。
verses.textEnNiv: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.
verses.textEnEsv: Smoke went up from his nostrils, and devouring fire from his mouth; glowing coals flamed forth from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Smoke went up from His nostrils, And devouring fire from His mouth; Coals were kindled by it.
verses.textEnNlt: Smoke poured from his nostrils; fierce flames leaped from his mouth. Glowing coals blazed forth from him.
verses.textEnNasb: Smoke went up out of His nostrils, And fire from His mouth was devouring; Coals burned from it.
verses.textEn: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

verses.textZh: 他使天下垂，亲自降临； 在他的脚下黑云密布。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使天下垂，亲自降临； 在他的脚下黑云密布。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又使天下垂，亲自降临， 有黑云在他脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.
verses.textEnEsv: He bowed the heavens and came down; thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down With darkness under His feet.
verses.textEnNlt: He opened the heavens and came down; dark storm clouds were beneath his feet.
verses.textEnNasb: He also bowed the heavens down low, and came down With thick darkness under His feet.
verses.textEn: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.

verses.textZh: 他乘着基路伯飞行， 借着风的翅膀急飞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他乘着基路伯飞行， 借着风的翅膀急飞。
verses.textZhCuv: 他坐着基路伯飞行； 他藉着风的翅膀快飞。
verses.textEnNiv: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnEsv: He rode on a cherub and flew; he came swiftly on the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He rode upon a cherub, and flew; He flew upon the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnNlt: Mounted on a mighty angelic being, he flew, soaring on the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnNasb: He rode on a cherub and flew; And He sped on the wings of the wind.
verses.textEn: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

verses.textZh: 他以黑暗作他的隐密处， 他以浓黑的水气，就是天空的密云， 作他四周的帷帐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以黑暗作他的隐密处， 他以浓黑的水气，就是天空的密云， 作他四周的帷帐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他以黑暗为藏身之处， 以水的黑暗、天空的厚云为他四围的行宫。
verses.textEnNiv: He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.
verses.textEnEsv: He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him, thick clouds dark with water.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made darkness His secret place; His canopy around Him was dark waters And thick clouds of the skies.
verses.textEnNlt: He shrouded himself in darkness, veiling his approach with dark rain clouds.
verses.textEnNasb: He made darkness His hiding place, His canopy around Him, Darkness of waters, thick clouds.
verses.textEn: He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.

verses.textZh: 密云、冰雹与火炭， 从他面前的光辉经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 密云、冰雹与火炭， 从他面前的光辉经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他面前的光辉， 他的厚云行过便有冰雹火炭。
verses.textEnNiv: Out of the brightness of his presence clouds advanced, with hailstones and bolts of lightning.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of the brightness before him hailstones and coals of fire broke through his clouds.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the brightness before Him, His thick clouds passed with hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Thick clouds shielded the brightness around him and rained down hail and burning coals.
verses.textEnNasb: From the brightness before Him passed His thick clouds, Hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.textEn: Out of the brightness of his presence clouds advanced, with hailstones and bolts of lightning.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在天上打雷， 至高者发出声音， 发出冰雹和火炭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在天上打雷， 至高者发出声音， 发出冰雹和火炭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华也在天上打雷； 至高者发出声音便有冰雹火炭。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Most High uttered his voice, hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded amid the hail and burning coals.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, And the Most High uttered His voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.textEn: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

verses.textZh: 他射出箭来，使它们四散； 他连连发出闪电，使它们混乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他射出箭来，使它们四散； 他连连发出闪电，使它们混乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他射出箭来，使仇敌四散； 多多发出闪电，使他们扰乱。
verses.textEnNiv: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent out his arrows and scattered them; he flashed forth lightnings and routed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent out His arrows and scattered the foe, Lightnings in abundance, and He vanquished them.
verses.textEnNlt: He shot his arrows and scattered his enemies; great bolts of lightning flashed, and they were confused.
verses.textEnNasb: He sent out His arrows, and scattered them, And lightning flashes in abundance, and routed them.
verses.textEn: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华斥责一发， 你鼻孔的气一出， 海底就出现， 大地的根基也显露。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华斥责一发， 你鼻孔的气一出， 海底就出现， 大地的根基也显露。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的斥责一发， 你鼻孔的气一出， 海底就出现， 大地的根基也显露。
verses.textEnNiv: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at your rebuke, Lord , at the blast of breath from your nostrils.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the channels of the sea were seen, and the foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, O Lord , at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the channels of the sea were seen, The foundations of the world were uncovered At Your rebuke, O Lord, At the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
verses.textEnNlt: Then at your command, O Lord , at the blast of your breath, the bottom of the sea could be seen, and the foundations of the earth were laid bare.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the channels of water appeared, And the foundations of the world were exposed By Your rebuke, Lord, At the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
verses.textEn: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at your rebuke, Lord , at the blast of breath from your nostrils.

verses.textZh: 他从高处伸手抓住我， 把我从大水中拉上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从高处伸手抓住我， 把我从大水中拉上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从高天伸手抓住我， 把我从大水中拉上来。
verses.textEnNiv: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.
verses.textEnEsv: He sent from on high, he took me; he drew me out of many waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent from above, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.
verses.textEnNlt: He reached down from heaven and rescued me; he drew me out of deep waters.
verses.textEnNasb: He sent from on high, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.
verses.textEn: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.

verses.textZh: 他救我脱离我的强敌， 脱离那些恨我的人，因为他们比我强盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救我脱离我的强敌， 脱离那些恨我的人，因为他们比我强盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 他救我脱离我的劲敌和那些恨我的人， 因为他们比我强盛。
