verses.textEnNiv: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.
verses.textEnEsv: He rescued me from my strong enemy and from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, From those who hated me, For they were too strong for me.
verses.textEnNlt: He rescued me from my powerful enemies, from those who hated me and were too strong for me.
verses.textEnNasb: He saved me from my strong enemy, And from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
verses.textEn: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

verses.textZh: 在我遭难的日子，他们来攻击我， 但耶和华是我的支持。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我遭难的日子，他们来攻击我， 但耶和华是我的支持。
verses.textZhCuv: 我遭遇灾难的日子，他们来攻击我； 但耶和华是我的倚靠。
verses.textEnNiv: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.
verses.textEnEsv: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, but the Lord was my support.
verses.textEnNkjv: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But the Lord was my support.
verses.textEnNlt: They attacked me at a moment when I was in distress, but the Lord supported me.
verses.textEnNasb: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, But the Lord was my support.
verses.textEn: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.

verses.textZh: 他又领我出去，到那宽阔之地； 他搭救我，因为他喜悦我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又领我出去，到那宽阔之地； 他搭救我，因为他喜悦我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又领我到宽阔之处； 他救拔我，因他喜悦我。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.
verses.textEnEsv: He brought me out into a broad place; he rescued me, because he delighted in me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also brought me out into a broad place; He delivered me because He delighted in me.
verses.textEnNlt: He led me to a place of safety; he rescued me because he delights in me.
verses.textEnNasb: He also brought me out into an open place; He rescued me, because He delighted in me.
verses.textEn: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我， 照着我手中的清洁回报我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我， 照着我手中的清洁回报我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华按着我的公义报答我， 按着我手中的清洁赏赐我。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he rewarded me.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has recompensed me.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord rewarded me for doing right; he restored me because of my innocence.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has repaid me.
verses.textEn: The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

verses.textZh: 因为我谨守了耶和华的道， 未曾作恶离开我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我谨守了耶和华的道， 未曾作恶离开我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我遵守了耶和华的道， 未曾作恶离开我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I am not guilty of turning from my God.
verses.textEnEsv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord , and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.textEnNlt: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I have not turned from my God to follow evil.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, And have not acted wickedly against my God.
verses.textEn: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I am not guilty of turning from my God.

verses.textZh: 因为他的一切典章常摆在我面前， 他的律例，我未曾丢弃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他的一切典章常摆在我面前， 他的律例，我未曾丢弃。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的一切典章常在我面前； 他的律例我也未曾丢弃。
verses.textEnNiv: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: For all his rules were before me, and his statutes I did not put away from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all His judgments were before me, And I did not put away His statutes from me.
verses.textEnNlt: I have followed all his regulations; I have never abandoned his decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: For all His judgments were before me, And I did not put away His statutes from me.
verses.textEn: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.

verses.textZh: 我在他面前作完全的人， 我也谨慎自己，脱离我的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在他面前作完全的人， 我也谨慎自己，脱离我的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在他面前作了完全人； 我也保守自己远离我的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.
verses.textEnEsv: I was blameless before him, and I kept myself from my guilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was also blameless before Him, And I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: I am blameless before God; I have kept myself from sin.
verses.textEnNasb: I was also blameless with Him, And I kept myself from my wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华按着我的公义， 照着我在他眼前手中的清洁回报我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华按着我的公义， 照着我在他眼前手中的清洁回报我。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华按我的公义， 按我在他眼前手中的清洁偿还我。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord has recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord rewarded me for doing right. He has seen my innocence.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord has repaid me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in His eyes.
verses.textEn: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

verses.textZh: 对慈爱的人，你显出你的慈爱； 对完全的人，你显出你的完全；
verses.textZhCnvs: 对慈爱的人，你显出你的慈爱； 对完全的人，你显出你的完全；
verses.textZhCuv: 慈爱的人，你以慈爱待他； 完全的人，你以完全待他。
verses.textEnNiv: To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,
verses.textEnEsv: With the merciful you show yourself merciful; with the blameless man you show yourself blameless;
verses.textEnNkjv: With the merciful You will show Yourself merciful; With a blameless man You will show Yourself blameless;
verses.textEnNlt: To the faithful you show yourself faithful; to those with integrity you show integrity.
verses.textEnNasb: With the faithful You show Yourself faithful; With the blameless You prove Yourself blameless;
verses.textEn: To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

verses.textZh: 对清洁的人，你显出你的清洁； 对狡诈的人，你显出你的机巧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对清洁的人，你显出你的清洁； 对狡诈的人，你显出你的机巧。
verses.textZhCuv: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他； 乖僻的人，你以弯曲待他。
verses.textEnNiv: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.
verses.textEnEsv: with the purified you show yourself pure; and with the crooked you make yourself seem tortuous.
verses.textEnNkjv: With the pure You will show Yourself pure; And with the devious You will show Yourself shrewd.
verses.textEnNlt: To the pure you show yourself pure, but to the crooked you show yourself shrewd.
verses.textEnNasb: With the pure You show Yourself pure, And with the crooked You show Yourself astute.
verses.textEn: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.

verses.textZh: 谦卑的人，你要拯救； 高傲的眼睛，你要贬低。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谦卑的人，你要拯救； 高傲的眼睛，你要贬低。
verses.textZhCuv: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救； 高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。
verses.textEnNiv: You save the humble but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.
verses.textEnEsv: For you save a humble people, but the haughty eyes you bring down.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You will save the humble people, But will bring down haughty looks.
verses.textEnNlt: You rescue the humble, but you humiliate the proud.
verses.textEnNasb: For You save an afflicted people, But You humiliate haughty eyes.
verses.textEn: You save the humble but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你点亮了我的灯； 我的神照明了我的黑暗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你点亮了我的灯； 我的神照明了我的黑暗。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必点着我的灯； 耶和华－我的神必照明我的黑暗。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord , keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is you who light my lamp; the Lord my God lightens my darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You will light my lamp; The Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: You light a lamp for me. The Lord , my God, lights up my darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: For You light my lamp; The Lord my God illumines my darkness.
verses.textEn: You, Lord , keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.

verses.textZh: 借着你，我攻破敌军； 靠着我的神，我跳过墙垣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 借着你，我攻破敌军； 靠着我的神，我跳过墙垣。
verses.textZhCuv: 我藉着你冲入敌军， 藉着我的神跳过墙垣。
verses.textEnNiv: With your help I can advance against a troop ; with my God I can scale a wall.
verses.textEnEsv: For by you I can run against a troop, and by my God I can leap over a wall.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by You I can run against a troop, By my God I can leap over a wall.
verses.textEnNlt: In your strength I can crush an army; with my God I can scale any wall.
verses.textEnNasb: For by You I can run at a troop of warriors; And by my God I can leap over a wall.
verses.textEn: With your help I can advance against a troop ; with my God I can scale a wall.

verses.textZh: 这位神，他的道路是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的； 凡是投靠他的，他都作他们的盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这位神，他的道路是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的； 凡是投靠他的，他都作他们的盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于神，他的道是完全的； 耶和华的话是炼净的。 凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord ’s word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.
verses.textEnEsv: This God—his way is perfect; the word of the Lord proves true; he is a shield for all those who take refuge in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor God, His way is perfect; The word of the Lord is proven; He is a shield to all who trust in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: God’s way is perfect. All the Lord ’s promises prove true. He is a shield for all who look to him for protection.
verses.textEnNasb: As for God, His way is blameless; The word of the Lord is refined; He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
verses.textEn: As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord ’s word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.

verses.textZh: 除了耶和华，谁是神呢？ 除了我们的神，谁是盘石呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了耶和华，谁是神呢？ 除了我们的神，谁是盘石呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 除了耶和华，谁是神呢？ 除了我们的神，谁是磐石呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?
verses.textEnEsv: For who is God, but the Lord ? And who is a rock, except our God?—
verses.textEnNkjv: For who is God, except the Lord? And who is a rock, except our God?
verses.textEnNlt: For who is God except the Lord ? Who but our God is a solid rock?
verses.textEnNasb: For who is God, but the Lord? And who is a rock, except our God,
verses.textEn: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?

verses.textZh: 他是那位以能力给我束腰的神， 他使我的道路完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是那位以能力给我束腰的神， 他使我的道路完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、 使我行为完全的，他是神。
verses.textEnNiv: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.
verses.textEnEsv: the God who equipped me with strength and made my way blameless.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis God who arms me with strength, And makes my way perfect.
verses.textEnNlt: God arms me with strength, and he makes my way perfect.
verses.textEnNasb: The God who encircles me with strength, And makes my way blameless?
verses.textEn: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.

verses.textZh: 他使我的脚像母鹿的蹄， 又使我站稳在高处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我的脚像母鹿的蹄， 又使我站稳在高处。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄， 又使我在高处安稳。
verses.textEnNiv: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.
verses.textEnEsv: He made my feet like the feet of a deer and set me secure on the heights.
verses.textEnNkjv: He makes my feet like the feetof deer, And sets me on my high places.
verses.textEnNlt: He makes me as surefooted as a deer, enabling me to stand on mountain heights.
verses.textEnNasb: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, And sets me up on my high places.
verses.textEn: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.

verses.textZh: 他教导我的手怎样作战， 又使我的手臂可以拉开铜弓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他教导我的手怎样作战， 又使我的手臂可以拉开铜弓。
verses.textZhCuv: 他教导我的手能以争战， 甚至我的膀臂能开铜弓。
verses.textEnNiv: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: He trains my hands for war, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: He teaches my hands to make war, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: He trains my hands for battle; he strengthens my arm to draw a bronze bow.
verses.textEnNasb: He trains my hands for battle, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
verses.textEn: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

verses.textZh: 你把你救恩的盾牌赐给我， 你的右手扶持我， 你的温柔使我昌大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把你救恩的盾牌赐给我， 你的右手扶持我， 你的温柔使我昌大。
verses.textZhCuv: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌； 你的右手扶持我； 你的温和使我为大。
verses.textEnNiv: You make your saving help my shield, and your right hand sustains me; your help has made me great.
verses.textEnEsv: You have given me the shield of your salvation, and your right hand supported me, and your gentleness made me great.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have also given me the shield of Your salvation; Your right hand has held me up, Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.textEnNlt: You have given me your shield of victory. Your right hand supports me; your help has made me great.
verses.textEnNasb: You have also given me the shield of Your salvation, And Your right hand upholds me; And Your gentleness makes me great.
verses.textEn: You make your saving help my shield, and your right hand sustains me; your help has made me great.

verses.textZh: 你使我脚底下的路径宽阔， 我的两膝没有动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我脚底下的路径宽阔， 我的两膝没有动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔； 我的脚未曾滑跌。
verses.textEnNiv: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.
verses.textEnEsv: You gave a wide place for my steps under me, and my feet did not slip.
verses.textEnNkjv: You enlarged my path under me, So my feet did not slip.
verses.textEnNlt: You have made a wide path for my feet to keep them from slipping.
verses.textEnNasb: You enlarge my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.
verses.textEn: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.

verses.textZh: 我追赶仇敌，把他们追上； 不消灭他们，我必不归回。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我追赶仇敌，把他们追上； 不消灭他们，我必不归回。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要追赶我的仇敌，并要追上他们； 不将他们灭绝，我总不归回。
verses.textEnNiv: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: I pursued my enemies and overtook them, and did not turn back till they were consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have pursued my enemies and overtaken them; Neither did I turn back again till they were destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: I chased my enemies and caught them; I did not stop until they were conquered.
verses.textEnNasb: I pursued my enemies and overtook them, And I did not turn back until they were consumed.
verses.textEn: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

verses.textZh: 我重创他们，使他们不能起来； 他们都倒在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我重创他们，使他们不能起来； 他们都倒在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要打伤他们，使他们不能起来； 他们必倒在我的脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: I crushed them so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.
verses.textEnEsv: I thrust them through, so that they were not able to rise; they fell under my feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have wounded them, So that they could not rise; They have fallen under my feet.
verses.textEnNlt: I struck them down so they could not get up; they fell beneath my feet.
verses.textEnNasb: I shattered them, so that they were not able to rise; They fell under my feet.
verses.textEn: I crushed them so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

verses.textZh: 你以能力给我束腰，使我能够作战； 你又使那些起来攻击我的人都屈服在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你以能力给我束腰，使我能够作战； 你又使那些起来攻击我的人都屈服在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战； 你也使那起来攻击我的都服在我以下。
verses.textEnNiv: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.
verses.textEnEsv: For you equipped me with strength for the battle; you made those who rise against me sink under me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have armed me with strength for the battle; You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
verses.textEnNlt: You have armed me with strength for the battle; you have subdued my enemies under my feet.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have encircled me with strength for battle; You have forced those who rose up against me to bow down under me.
verses.textEn: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.

verses.textZh: 你使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 使我可以歼灭恨我的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 使我可以歼灭恨我的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑， 叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
verses.textEnNiv: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.
verses.textEnEsv: You made my enemies turn their backs to me, and those who hated me I destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have also given me the necks of my enemies, So that I destroyed those who hated me.
verses.textEnNlt: You placed my foot on their necks. I have destroyed all who hated me.
verses.textEnNasb: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, And I destroyed those who hated me.
verses.textEn: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.

verses.textZh: 他们呼叫，却没有人拯救； 就算向耶和华呼求，他也不答应他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们呼叫，却没有人拯救； 就算向耶和华呼求，他也不答应他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们呼求，却无人拯救； 就是呼求耶和华，他也不应允。
verses.textEnNiv: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the Lord , but he did not answer.
verses.textEnEsv: They cried for help, but there was none to save; they cried to the Lord , but he did not answer them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They cried out, but therewas none to save; Even to the Lord, but He did not answer them.
verses.textEnNlt: They called for help, but no one came to their rescue. They even cried to the Lord , but he refused to answer.
verses.textEnNasb: They cried for help, but there was no one to save, They cried to the Lord, but He did not answer them.
verses.textEn: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the Lord , but he did not answer.

verses.textZh: 我捣碎他们，像风前的尘土， 我倾倒他们，像街上的烂泥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我捣碎他们，像风前的尘土， 我倾倒他们，像街上的烂泥。
verses.textZhCuv: 我捣碎他们，如同风前的灰尘， 倒出他们，如同街上的泥土。
verses.textEnNiv: I beat them as fine as windblown dust; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
verses.textEnEsv: I beat them fine as dust before the wind; I cast them out like the mire of the streets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I beat them as fine as the dust before the wind; I cast them out like dirt in the streets.
verses.textEnNlt: I ground them as fine as dust in the wind. I swept them into the gutter like dirt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I beat them fine like the dust before the wind; I emptied them out like the mud of the streets.
verses.textEn: I beat them as fine as windblown dust; I trampled them like mud in the streets.

verses.textZh: 你救我脱离了人民的争竞， 你立我作列国的元首； 我不认识的人民要服事我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你救我脱离了人民的争竞， 你立我作列国的元首； 我不认识的人民要服事我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你救我脱离百姓的争竞， 立我作列国的元首； 我素不认识的民必事奉我。
verses.textEnNiv: You have delivered me from the attacks of the people; you have made me the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,
verses.textEnEsv: You delivered me from strife with the people; you made me the head of the nations; people whom I had not known served me.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people; You have made me the head of the nations; A people I have not known shall serve me.
verses.textEnNlt: You gave me victory over my accusers. You appointed me ruler over nations; people I don’t even know now serve me.
verses.textEnNasb: You have rescued me from the contentions of the people; You have placed me as head of the nations; A people whom I have not known serve me.
verses.textEn: You have delivered me from the attacks of the people; you have made me the head of nations. People I did not know now serve me,

verses.textZh: 他们一听见，就服从我； 外族人都向我假意归顺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们一听见，就服从我； 外族人都向我假意归顺。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们一听见我的名声就必顺从我； 外邦人要投降我。
verses.textEnNiv: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as they heard of me they obeyed me; foreigners came cringing to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: As soon as they hear of me they obey me; The foreigners submit to me.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as they hear of me, they submit; foreign nations cringe before me.
verses.textEnNasb: As soon as they hear, they obey me; Foreigners pretend to obey me.
verses.textEn: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.

verses.textZh: 外族人大势已去， 战战兢兢地从他们的要塞走出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外族人大势已去， 战战兢兢地从他们的要塞走出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人要衰残， 战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。
verses.textEnNiv: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.
verses.textEnEsv: Foreigners lost heart and came trembling out of their fortresses.
verses.textEnNkjv: The foreigners fade away, And come frightened from their hideouts.
verses.textEnNlt: They all lose their courage and come trembling from their strongholds.
verses.textEnNasb: Foreigners lose heart, And come trembling out of their fortresses.
verses.textEn: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是永活的，我的盘石是应当称颂的， 拯救我的神是应当被尊为至高的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是永活的，我的盘石是应当称颂的， 拯救我的神是应当被尊为至高的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是活神。 愿我的磐石被人称颂； 愿救我的神被人尊崇。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be God my Savior!
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord lives, and blessed be my rock, and exalted be the God of my salvation—
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord lives! Blessed be my Rock! Let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord lives! Praise to my Rock! May the God of my salvation be exalted!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord lives, and blessed be my rock; And exalted be the God of my salvation,
verses.textEn: The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be God my Savior!

verses.textZh: 他是那位为我伸冤的神， 他使万民服在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是那位为我伸冤的神， 他使万民服在我的脚下。
verses.textZhCuv: 这位神，就是那为我伸冤、 使众民服在我以下的。
verses.textEnNiv: He is the God who avenges me, who subdues nations under me,
verses.textEnEsv: the God who gave me vengeance and subdued peoples under me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis God who avenges me, And subdues the peoples under me;
verses.textEnNlt: He is the God who pays back those who harm me; he subdues the nations under me
verses.textEnNasb: The God who executes vengeance for me, And subdues peoples under me.
verses.textEn: He is the God who avenges me, who subdues nations under me,

verses.textZh: 他救我脱离我的仇敌。 你还把我高举起来，高过那些起来攻击我的人， 又救我脱离了强暴的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救我脱离我的仇敌。 你还把我高举起来，高过那些起来攻击我的人， 又救我脱离了强暴的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你救我脱离仇敌， 又把我举起，高过那些起来攻击我的； 你救我脱离强暴的人。
verses.textEnNiv: who saves me from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.
verses.textEnEsv: who rescued me from my enemies; yes, you exalted me above those who rose against me; you delivered me from the man of violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: He delivers me from my enemies. You also lift me up above those who rise against me; You have delivered me from the violent man.
verses.textEnNlt: and rescues me from my enemies. You hold me safe beyond the reach of my enemies; you save me from violent opponents.
verses.textEnNasb: He rescues me from my enemies; You indeed lift me above those who rise up against me; You rescue me from a violent man.
verses.textEn: who saves me from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华啊！我要在列国中称赞你，歌颂你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华啊！我要在列国中称赞你，歌颂你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，因此我要在外邦中称谢你， 歌颂你的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.
verses.textEnEsv: For this I will praise you, O Lord , among the nations, and sing to your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will give thanks to You, O Lord, among the Gentiles, And sing praises to Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: For this, O Lord , I will praise you among the nations; I will sing praises to your name.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I will give thanks to You among the nations, Lord, And I will sing praises to Your name.
verses.textEn: Therefore I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing the praises of your name.

verses.textZh: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王， 又向他的受膏者施慈爱， 就是向大卫和他的后裔施慈爱，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王， 又向他的受膏者施慈爱， 就是向大卫和他的后裔施慈爱，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王， 施慈爱给他的受膏者， 就是给大卫和他的后裔，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing love to his anointed, to David and to his descendants forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Great salvation he brings to his king, and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to David and his offspring forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Great deliverance He gives to His king, And shows mercy to His anointed, To David and his descendants forevermore.
verses.textEnNlt: You give great victories to your king; you show unfailing love to your anointed, to David and all his descendants forever.
verses.textEnNasb: He gives great salvation to His king, And shows faithfulness to His anointed, To David and his descendants forever.
verses.textEn: He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing love to his anointed, to David and to his descendants forever.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 诸天述说神的荣耀， 穹苍传扬他的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 诸天述说神的荣耀， 穹苍传扬他的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸天述说神的荣耀； 穹苍传扬他的手段。
verses.textEnNiv: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: The heavens declare the glory of God, and the sky above proclaims his handiwork.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament shows His handiwork.
verses.textEnNlt: The heavens proclaim the glory of God. The skies display his craftsmanship.
verses.textEnNasb: The heavens tell of the glory of God; And their expanse declares the work of His hands.
verses.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

verses.textZh: 天天发出言语， 夜夜传出知识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天天发出言语， 夜夜传出知识。
verses.textZhCuv: 这日到那日发出言语； 这夜到那夜传出知识。
verses.textEnNiv: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: Day to day pours out speech, and night to night reveals knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Day unto day utters speech, And night unto night reveals knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: Day after day they continue to speak; night after night they make him known.
verses.textEnNasb: Day to day pours forth speech, And night to night reveals knowledge.
verses.textEn: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.

verses.textZh: 没有话语，没有言词， 人也听不到它们的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有话语，没有言词， 人也听不到它们的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 无言无语， 也无声音可听。
verses.textEnNiv: They have no speech, they use no words; no sound is heard from them.
verses.textEnEsv: There is no speech, nor are there words, whose voice is not heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis no speech nor language Where their voice is not heard.
verses.textEnNlt: They speak without a sound or word; their voice is never heard.
verses.textEnNasb: There is no speech, nor are there words; Their voice is not heard.
verses.textEn: They have no speech, they use no words; no sound is heard from them.

verses.textZh: 它们的声音 传遍全地， 它们的言语传到地极，神在它们中间为太阳安设帐幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们的声音 传遍全地， 它们的言语传到地极，神在它们中间为太阳安设帐幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 它的量带通遍天下， 它的言语传到地极。神在其间为太阳安设帐幕；
verses.textEnNiv: Yet their voice goes out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens God has pitched a tent for the sun.
verses.textEnEsv: Their voice goes out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
verses.textEnNkjv: Their line has gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.textEnNlt: Yet their message has gone throughout the earth, and their words to all the world. God has made a home in the heavens for the sun.
verses.textEnNasb: Their line has gone out into all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them He has placed a tent for the sun,
verses.textEn: Yet their voice goes out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens God has pitched a tent for the sun.

verses.textZh: 太阳如同新郎出洞房， 又像勇士欢欢喜喜地跑路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 太阳如同新郎出洞房， 又像勇士欢欢喜喜地跑路。
verses.textZhCuv: 太阳如同新郎出洞房， 又如勇士欢然奔路。
verses.textEnNiv: It is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course.
verses.textEnEsv: which comes out like a bridegroom leaving his chamber, and, like a strong man, runs its course with joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Which is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoices like a strong man to run its race.
verses.textEnNlt: It bursts forth like a radiant bridegroom after his wedding. It rejoices like a great athlete eager to run the race.
verses.textEnNasb: Which is like a groom coming out of his chamber; It rejoices like a strong person to run his course.
verses.textEn: It is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course.

verses.textZh: 它从天的这边出来， 绕行到天的那边； 没有甚么可以隐藏，得不到它的温暖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它从天的这边出来， 绕行到天的那边； 没有甚么可以隐藏，得不到它的温暖。
verses.textZhCuv: 它从天这边出来，绕到天那边， 没有一物被隐藏不得它的热气。
verses.textEnNiv: It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
verses.textEnEsv: Its rising is from the end of the heavens, and its circuit to the end of them, and there is nothing hidden from its heat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its rising is from one end of heaven, And its circuit to the other end; And there is nothing hidden from its heat.
verses.textEnNlt: The sun rises at one end of the heavens and follows its course to the other end. Nothing can hide from its heat.
verses.textEnNasb: Its rising is from one end of the heavens, And its circuit to the other end of them; And there is nothing hidden from its heat.
verses.textEn: It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的律法是完全的，能使人心苏醒； 耶和华的法度是坚定的，能使愚人有智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的律法是完全的，能使人心苏醒； 耶和华的法度是坚定的，能使愚人有智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的律法全备，能苏醒人心； 耶和华的法度确定，能使愚人有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: The law of the Lord is perfect, refreshing the soul. The statutes of the Lord are trustworthy, making wise the simple.
verses.textEnEsv: The law of the Lord is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple;
verses.textEnNkjv: The law of the Lordis perfect, converting the soul; The testimony of the Lordis sure, making wise the simple;
verses.textEnNlt: The instructions of the Lord are perfect, reviving the soul. The decrees of the Lord are trustworthy, making wise the simple.
verses.textEnNasb: The Law of the Lord is perfect, restoring the soul; The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.textEn: The law of the Lord is perfect, refreshing the soul. The statutes of the Lord are trustworthy, making wise the simple.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的训词是正直的，能使人心快乐； 耶和华的命令是清洁的，能使人的眼睛明亮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的训词是正直的，能使人心快乐； 耶和华的命令是清洁的，能使人的眼睛明亮。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的训词正直，能快活人的心； 耶和华的命令清洁，能明亮人的眼目。
verses.textEnNiv: The precepts of the Lord are right, giving joy to the heart. The commands of the Lord are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: the precepts of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes;
verses.textEnNkjv: The statutes of the Lordare right, rejoicing the heart; The commandment of the Lordis pure, enlightening the eyes;
verses.textEnNlt: The commandments of the Lord are right, bringing joy to the heart. The commands of the Lord are clear, giving insight for living.
verses.textEnNasb: The precepts of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart; The commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.textEn: The precepts of the Lord are right, giving joy to the heart. The commands of the Lord are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话语 是洁净的，能坚立到永远； 耶和华的典章是真实的，完全公义；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话语 是洁净的，能坚立到永远； 耶和华的典章是真实的，完全公义；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的道理洁净，存到永远； 耶和华的典章真实，全然公义－
verses.textEnNiv: The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring forever. The decrees of the Lord are firm, and all of them are righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: the fear of the Lord is clean, enduring forever; the rules of the Lord are true, and righteous altogether.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of the Lordis clean, enduring forever; The judgments of the Lordare true and righteous altogether.
verses.textEnNlt: Reverence for the Lord is pure, lasting forever. The laws of the Lord are true; each one is fair.
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring forever; The judgments of the Lord are true; they are righteous altogether.
verses.textEn: The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring forever. The decrees of the Lord are firm, and all of them are righteous.

verses.textZh: 都比金子宝贵，比大量的精金更宝贵； 比蜜甘甜，比蜂房滴下来的蜜更甘甜；
verses.textZhCnvs: 都比金子宝贵，比大量的精金更宝贵； 比蜜甘甜，比蜂房滴下来的蜜更甘甜；
verses.textZhCuv: 都比金子可羡慕，且比极多的精金可羡慕； 比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。
verses.textEnNiv: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the honeycomb.
verses.textEnEsv: More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and drippings of the honeycomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: More to be desired arethey than gold, Yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.textEnNlt: They are more desirable than gold, even the finest gold. They are sweeter than honey, even honey dripping from the comb.
verses.textEnNasb: They are more desirable than gold, yes, than much pure gold; Sweeter also than honey and drippings of the honeycomb.
verses.textEn: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the honeycomb.

verses.textZh: 并且你的仆人也借着这些得到警戒， 谨守这些就得着大赏赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且你的仆人也借着这些得到警戒， 谨守这些就得着大赏赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 况且你的仆人因此受警戒， 守着这些便有大赏。
verses.textEnNiv: By them your servant is warned; in keeping them there is great reward.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, by them is your servant warned; in keeping them there is great reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover by them Your servant is warned, And in keeping them thereis great reward.
verses.textEnNlt: They are a warning to your servant, a great reward for those who obey them.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Your servant is warned by them; In keeping them there is great reward.
verses.textEn: By them your servant is warned; in keeping them there is great reward.

verses.textZh: 谁能知道自己的错误呢？ 求你赦免我隐而未现的过失。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能知道自己的错误呢？ 求你赦免我隐而未现的过失。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能知道自己的错失呢？ 愿你赦免我隐而未现的过错。
verses.textEnNiv: But who can discern their own errors? Forgive my hidden faults.
verses.textEnEsv: Who can discern his errors? Declare me innocent from hidden faults.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can understand his errors? Cleanse me from secret faults.
verses.textEnNlt: How can I know all the sins lurking in my heart? Cleanse me from these hidden faults.
verses.textEnNasb: Who can discern his errors? Acquit me of hidden faults.
verses.textEn: But who can discern their own errors? Forgive my hidden faults.

verses.textZh: 求你拦阻你仆人，不犯任意妄为的罪， 不许它们辖制我； 我才可以完全，不犯大过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你拦阻你仆人，不犯任意妄为的罪， 不许它们辖制我； 我才可以完全，不犯大过。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你拦阻仆人不犯任意妄为的罪， 不容这罪辖制我， 我便完全，免犯大罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless, innocent of great transgression.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me! Then I shall be blameless, and innocent of great transgression.
verses.textEnNkjv: Keep back Your servant also from presumptuous sins; Let them not have dominion over me. Then I shall be blameless, And I shall be innocent of great transgression.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep your servant from deliberate sins! Don’t let them control me. Then I will be free of guilt and innocent of great sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Also keep Your servant back from presumptuous sins; Let them not rule over me; Then I will be innocent, And I will be blameless of great wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: Keep your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless, innocent of great transgression.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的盘石、我的救赎主啊！ 愿我口中的言语、心里的意念， 都在你面前蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的盘石、我的救赎主啊！ 愿我口中的言语、心里的意念， 都在你面前蒙悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的磐石，我的救赎主啊， 愿我口中的言语、心里的意念在你面前蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, Lord , my Rock and my Redeemer.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, O Lord , my rock and my redeemer.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, my strength and my Redeemer.
verses.textEnNlt: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing to you, O Lord , my rock and my redeemer.
verses.textEnNasb: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in Your sight, Lord, my rock and my Redeemer.
verses.textEn: May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, Lord , my Rock and my Redeemer.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 愿耶和华在你遭难的日子应允你， 愿雅各的神的名保护你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 愿耶和华在你遭难的日子应允你， 愿雅各的神的名保护你。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华在你遭难的日子应允你； 愿名为雅各神的高举你。
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord answer you when you are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord answer you in the day of trouble! May the name of the God of Jacob protect you!
verses.textEnNkjv: May the Lord answer you in the day of trouble; May the name of the God of Jacob defend you;
verses.textEnNlt: In times of trouble, may the Lord answer your cry. May the name of the God of Jacob keep you safe from all harm.
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord answer you on a day of trouble! May the name of the God of Jacob protect you!
verses.textEn: May the Lord answer you when you are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

verses.textZh: 愿他从圣所帮助你， 从锡安扶持你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他从圣所帮助你， 从锡安扶持你。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他从圣所救助你， 从锡安坚固你，
verses.textEnNiv: May he send you help from the sanctuary and grant you support from Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: May he send you help from the sanctuary and give you support from Zion!
verses.textEnNkjv: May He send you help from the sanctuary, And strengthen you out of Zion;
verses.textEnNlt: May he send you help from his sanctuary and strengthen you from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: May He send you help from the sanctuary, And support you from Zion!
verses.textEn: May he send you help from the sanctuary and grant you support from Zion.

verses.textZh: 愿他记念你的一切素祭， 悦纳你的燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他记念你的一切素祭， 悦纳你的燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 记念你的一切供献， 悦纳你的燔祭， （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: May he remember all your sacrifices and accept your burnt offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: May he remember all your offerings and regard with favor your burnt sacrifices! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: May He remember all your offerings, And accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: May he remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: May He remember all your meal offerings And accept your burnt offering! Selah
verses.textEn: May he remember all your sacrifices and accept your burnt offerings.

verses.textZh: 愿他照着你的心愿赏赐你， 实现你的一切计划。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他照着你的心愿赏赐你， 实现你的一切计划。
verses.textZhCuv: 将你心所愿的赐给你， 成就你的一切筹算。
verses.textEnNiv: May he give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
verses.textEnEsv: May he grant you your heart’s desire and fulfill all your plans!
verses.textEnNkjv: May He grant you according to your heart’s desire, And fulfill all your purpose.
verses.textEnNlt: May he grant your heart’s desires and make all your plans succeed.
verses.textEnNasb: May He grant you your heart’s desire And fulfill your whole plan!
verses.textEn: May he give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed.

verses.textZh: 我们要因你的胜利欢呼， 因我们神的名高举旗帜； 愿耶和华实现你所求的一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要因你的胜利欢呼， 因我们神的名高举旗帜； 愿耶和华实现你所求的一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要因你的救恩夸胜， 要奉我们神的名竖立旌旗。 愿耶和华成就你一切所求的！
verses.textEnNiv: May we shout for joy over your victory and lift up our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord grant all your requests.
verses.textEnEsv: May we shout for joy over your salvation, and in the name of our God set up our banners! May the Lord fulfill all your petitions!
verses.textEnNkjv: We will rejoice in your salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners! May the Lord fulfill all your petitions.
verses.textEnNlt: May we shout for joy when we hear of your victory and raise a victory banner in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers.
verses.textEnNasb: We will sing for joy over your victory, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners. May the Lord fulfill all your desires.
verses.textEn: May we shout for joy over your victory and lift up our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord grant all your requests.

verses.textZh: 现在我确知，耶和华拯救自己的受膏者； 他必从他的圣天上应允他， 用自己右手的能力拯救他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我确知，耶和华拯救自己的受膏者； 他必从他的圣天上应允他， 用自己右手的能力拯救他。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我知道耶和华救护他的受膏者， 必从他的圣天上应允他， 用右手的能力救护他。
verses.textEnNiv: Now this I know: The Lord gives victory to his anointed. He answers him from his heavenly sanctuary with the victorious power of his right hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Now I know that the Lord saves his anointed; he will answer him from his holy heaven with the saving might of his right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I know that the Lord saves His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven With the saving strength of His right hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I know that the Lord rescues his anointed king. He will answer him from his holy heaven and rescue him by his great power.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I know that the Lord saves His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven With the saving strength of His right hand.
verses.textEn: Now this I know: The Lord gives victory to his anointed. He answers him from his heavenly sanctuary with the victorious power of his right hand.

verses.textZh: 有人靠车，有人靠马。 我们却靠耶和华我们神的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人靠车，有人靠马。 我们却靠耶和华我们神的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人靠车，有人靠马， 但我们要提到耶和华－我们神的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the Lord our God.
verses.textEnEsv: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will remember the name of the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNlt: Some nations boast of their chariots and horses, but we boast in the name of the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNasb: Some praise their chariots and some their horses, But we will praise the name of the Lord, our God.
verses.textEn: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the Lord our God.

verses.textZh: 他们都屈身跌倒， 我们却起来，挺身而立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都屈身跌倒， 我们却起来，挺身而立。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都屈身仆倒， 我们却起来，立得正直。
verses.textEnNiv: They are brought to their knees and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
verses.textEnEsv: They collapse and fall, but we rise and stand upright.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have bowed down and fallen; But we have risen and stand upright.
verses.textEnNlt: Those nations will fall down and collapse, but we will rise up and stand firm.
verses.textEnNasb: They have bowed down and fallen, But we have risen and stood upright.
verses.textEn: They are brought to their knees and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你拯救君王！ 我们呼求的时候，愿你应允我们 。 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你拯救君王！ 我们呼求的时候，愿你应允我们 。 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCuv: 求耶和华施行拯救； 我们呼求的时候，愿王应允我们！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , give victory to the king! Answer us when we call!
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , save the king! May he answer us when we call.
verses.textEnNkjv: Save, Lord! May the King answer us when we call.
verses.textEnNlt: Give victory to our king, O Lord ! Answer our cry for help.
verses.textEnNasb: Save, Lord; May the King answer us on the day we call.
verses.textEn: Lord , give victory to the king! Answer us when we call!

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！王因你的力量快乐， 因你的救恩大大欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！王因你的力量快乐， 因你的救恩大大欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，王必因你的能力欢喜； 因你的救恩，他的快乐何其大！
verses.textEnNiv: The king rejoices in your strength, Lord . How great is his joy in the victories you give!
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , in your strength the king rejoices, and in your salvation how greatly he exults!
verses.textEnNkjv: The king shall have joy in Your strength, O Lord; And in Your salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.textEnNlt: How the king rejoices in your strength, O Lord ! He shouts with joy because you give him victory.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, in Your strength the king will be glad, And in Your salvation how greatly he will rejoice!
verses.textEn: The king rejoices in your strength, Lord . How great is his joy in the victories you give!

verses.textZh: 他心里所愿的，你赐给了他； 他嘴唇所求的，你没有拒绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他心里所愿的，你赐给了他； 他嘴唇所求的，你没有拒绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他心里所愿的，你已经赐给他； 他嘴唇所求的，你未尝不应允。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: You have granted him his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips.
verses.textEnEsv: You have given him his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: You have given him his heart’s desire, And have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: For you have given him his heart’s desire; you have withheld nothing he requested. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: You have given him his heart’s desire, And You have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
verses.textEn: You have granted him his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips.

verses.textZh: 你以美福迎接他， 把精金的冠冕戴在他头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你以美福迎接他， 把精金的冠冕戴在他头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你以美福迎接他， 把精金的冠冕戴在他头上。
verses.textEnNiv: You came to greet him with rich blessings and placed a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.textEnEsv: For you meet him with rich blessings; you set a crown of fine gold upon his head.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You meet him with the blessings of goodness; You set a crown of pure gold upon his head.
verses.textEnNlt: You welcomed him back with success and prosperity. You placed a crown of finest gold on his head.
verses.textEnNasb: For You meet him with the blessings of good things; You set a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.textEn: You came to greet him with rich blessings and placed a crown of pure gold on his head.

verses.textZh: 他向你求寿，你就赐给他， 就是长久的日子，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向你求寿，你就赐给他， 就是长久的日子，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 他向你求寿，你便赐给他， 就是日子长久，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him— length of days, for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: He asked life of you; you gave it to him, length of days forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: He asked life from You, and You gave it to him— Length of days forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: He asked you to preserve his life, and you granted his request. The days of his life stretch on forever.
verses.textEnNasb: He asked for life from You, You gave it to him, Length of days forever and ever.
verses.textEn: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him— length of days, for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 他因你的救恩大有荣耀， 你又把尊荣和威严加给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他因你的救恩大有荣耀， 你又把尊荣和威严加给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他因你的救恩大有荣耀； 你又将尊荣威严加在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Through the victories you gave, his glory is great; you have bestowed on him splendor and majesty.
verses.textEnEsv: His glory is great through your salvation; splendor and majesty you bestow on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: His glory is great in Your salvation; Honor and majesty You have placed upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: Your victory brings him great honor, and you have clothed him with splendor and majesty.
verses.textEnNasb: His glory is great through Your salvation, Splendor and majesty You place upon him.
verses.textEn: Through the victories you gave, his glory is great; you have bestowed on him splendor and majesty.

verses.textZh: 你把永远的福分赐给他， 又使他因与你同在的喜乐欢欣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把永远的福分赐给他， 又使他因与你同在的喜乐欢欣。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使他有洪福，直到永远， 又使他在你面前欢喜快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely you have granted him unending blessings and made him glad with the joy of your presence.
verses.textEnEsv: For you make him most blessed forever; you make him glad with the joy of your presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have made him most blessed forever; You have made him exceedingly glad with Your presence.
verses.textEnNlt: You have endowed him with eternal blessings and given him the joy of your presence.
verses.textEnNasb: For You make him most blessed forever; You make him joyful with the joy of Your presence.
verses.textEn: Surely you have granted him unending blessings and made him glad with the joy of your presence.

verses.textZh: 王倚靠耶和华， 靠着至高者的慈爱，他必不至动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王倚靠耶和华， 靠着至高者的慈爱，他必不至动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 王倚靠耶和华， 因至高者的慈爱必不摇动。
verses.textEnNiv: For the king trusts in the Lord ; through the unfailing love of the Most High he will not be shaken.
verses.textEnEsv: For the king trusts in the Lord , and through the steadfast love of the Most High he shall not be moved.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the king trusts in the Lord, And through the mercy of the Most High he shall not be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: For the king trusts in the Lord . The unfailing love of the Most High will keep him from stumbling.
verses.textEnNasb: For the king trusts in the Lord, And through the faithfulness of the Most High he will not be shaken.
verses.textEn: For the king trusts in the Lord ; through the unfailing love of the Most High he will not be shaken.

verses.textZh: 你的手要搜出你所有的仇敌， 你的右手必搜出那些恨你的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的手要搜出你所有的仇敌， 你的右手必搜出那些恨你的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敌； 你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Your hand will lay hold on all your enemies; your right hand will seize your foes.
verses.textEnEsv: Your hand will find out all your enemies; your right hand will find out those who hate you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your hand will find all Your enemies; Your right hand will find those who hate You.
verses.textEnNlt: You will capture all your enemies. Your strong right hand will seize all who hate you.
verses.textEnNasb: Your hand will find all your enemies; Your right hand will find those who hate you.
verses.textEn: Your hand will lay hold on all your enemies; your right hand will seize your foes.

verses.textZh: 你出现的时候，就要使他们像炽热的火炉； 耶和华必在他的震怒中吞灭他们，火必烧灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你出现的时候，就要使他们像炽热的火炉； 耶和华必在他的震怒中吞灭他们，火必烧灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你发怒的时候，要使他们如在炎热的火炉中。 耶和华要在他的震怒中吞灭他们； 那火要把他们烧尽了。
verses.textEnNiv: When you appear for battle, you will burn them up as in a blazing furnace. The Lord will swallow them up in his wrath, and his fire will consume them.
verses.textEnEsv: You will make them as a blazing oven when you appear. The Lord will swallow them up in his wrath, and fire will consume them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make them as a fiery oven in the time of Your anger; The Lord shall swallow them up in His wrath, And the fire shall devour them.
verses.textEnNlt: You will throw them in a flaming furnace when you appear. The Lord will consume them in his anger; fire will devour them.
verses.textEnNasb: You will make them as a fiery oven in the time of your anger; The Lord will swallow them up in His wrath, And fire will devour them.
verses.textEn: When you appear for battle, you will burn them up as in a blazing furnace. The Lord will swallow them up in his wrath, and his fire will consume them.

verses.textZh: 你必从地上除灭他们的子孙， 从人间除灭他们的后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必从地上除灭他们的子孙， 从人间除灭他们的后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必从世上灭绝他们的子孙 ， 从人间灭绝他们的后裔。
verses.textEnNiv: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from among the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their offspring You shall destroy from the earth, And their descendants from among the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: You will wipe their children from the face of the earth; they will never have descendants.
verses.textEnNasb: You will eliminate their descendants from the earth, And their children from among the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from mankind.

verses.textZh: 虽然他们定下恶计害你， 他们所设的阴谋却不能成功。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然他们定下恶计害你， 他们所设的阴谋却不能成功。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们有意加害于你； 他们想出计谋，却不能作成。
verses.textEnNiv: Though they plot evil against you and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed.
verses.textEnEsv: Though they plan evil against you, though they devise mischief, they will not succeed.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they intended evil against You; They devised a plot which they are not able to perform.
verses.textEnNlt: Although they plot against you, their evil schemes will never succeed.
verses.textEnNasb: Though they intended evil against You And devised a plot, They will not succeed.
verses.textEn: Though they plot evil against you and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed.

verses.textZh: 你的箭扣上弦，对准他们的脸的时候， 他们必转身而逃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的箭扣上弦，对准他们的脸的时候， 他们必转身而逃。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必使他们转背逃跑， 向他们的脸搭箭在弦。
verses.textEnNiv: You will make them turn their backs when you aim at them with drawn bow.
verses.textEnEsv: For you will put them to flight; you will aim at their faces with your bows.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore You will make them turn their back; You will make ready Yourarrows on Your string toward their faces.
verses.textEnNlt: For they will turn and run when they see your arrows aimed at them.
verses.textEnNasb: For You will make them turn their back; You will take aim at their faces with Your bowstrings.
verses.textEn: You will make them turn their backs when you aim at them with drawn bow.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！愿你因自己的能力被尊崇， 好让我们歌唱，颂赞你的大能。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！愿你因自己的能力被尊崇， 好让我们歌唱，颂赞你的大能。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，愿你因自己的能力显为至高！ 这样，我们就唱诗，歌颂你的大能。
verses.textEnNiv: Be exalted in your strength, Lord ; we will sing and praise your might.
verses.textEnEsv: Be exalted, O Lord , in your strength! We will sing and praise your power.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be exalted, O Lord, in Your own strength! We will sing and praise Your power.
verses.textEnNlt: Rise up, O Lord , in all your power. With music and singing we celebrate your mighty acts.
verses.textEnNasb: Be exalted, Lord, in Your strength; We will sing and praise Your power.
verses.textEn: Be exalted in your strength, Lord ; we will sing and praise your might.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，调用"黎明的鹿"。 我的神！我的神！你为甚么离弃我？ 为甚么远离不救我，不听我呻吟的话呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，调用"黎明的鹿"。 我的神！我的神！你为甚么离弃我？ 为甚么远离不救我，不听我呻吟的话呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神，我的神！为什么离弃我？ 为什么远离不救我？不听我唉哼的言语？
verses.textEnNiv: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from my cries of anguish?
verses.textEnEsv: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, from the words of my groaning?
verses.textEnNkjv: My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me? WhyareYouso far from helping Me, Andfrom the words of My groaning?
verses.textEnNlt: My God, my God, why have you abandoned me? Why are you so far away when I groan for help?
verses.textEnNasb: My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Far from my help are the words of my groaning.
verses.textEn: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from my cries of anguish?

verses.textZh: 我的神啊！我日间呼求，你不应允； 在晚上我还是不停止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神啊！我日间呼求，你不应允； 在晚上我还是不停止。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，我白日呼求，你不应允， 夜间呼求，并不住声。
verses.textEnNiv: My God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, by night, but I find no rest.
verses.textEnEsv: O my God, I cry by day, but you do not answer, and by night, but I find no rest.
verses.textEnNkjv: O My God, I cry in the daytime, but You do not hear; And in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.textEnNlt: Every day I call to you, my God, but you do not answer. Every night I lift my voice, but I find no relief.
verses.textEnNasb: My God, I cry out by day, but You do not answer; And by night, but I have no rest.
verses.textEn: My God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, by night, but I find no rest.

verses.textZh: 但你是圣洁的， 是用以色列的赞美为宝座的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你是圣洁的， 是用以色列的赞美为宝座的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你是圣洁的， 是用以色列的赞美为宝座 的。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One; you are the one Israel praises.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You are holy, Enthroned in the praises of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet you are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet You are holy, You who are enthroned upon the praises of Israel.
verses.textEn: Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One; you are the one Israel praises.

verses.textZh: 我们的列祖倚靠你， 他们倚靠你，你就救他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的列祖倚靠你， 他们倚靠你，你就救他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的祖宗倚靠你； 他们倚靠你，你便解救他们。
verses.textEnNiv: In you our ancestors put their trust; they trusted and you delivered them.
verses.textEnEsv: In you our fathers trusted; they trusted, and you delivered them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our fathers trusted in You; They trusted, and You delivered them.
verses.textEnNlt: Our ancestors trusted in you, and you rescued them.
verses.textEnNasb: In You our fathers trusted; They trusted and You rescued them.
verses.textEn: In you our ancestors put their trust; they trusted and you delivered them.

verses.textZh: 他们向你哀求，就得拯救； 他们倚靠你，就不失望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们向你哀求，就得拯救； 他们倚靠你，就不失望。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们哀求你，便蒙解救； 他们倚靠你，就不羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: To you they cried out and were saved; in you they trusted and were not put to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: To you they cried and were rescued; in you they trusted and were not put to shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: They cried to You, and were delivered; They trusted in You, and were not ashamed.
verses.textEnNlt: They cried out to you and were saved. They trusted in you and were never disgraced.
verses.textEnNasb: To You they cried out and they fled to safety; In You they trusted and were not disappointed.
verses.textEn: To you they cried out and were saved; in you they trusted and were not put to shame.

verses.textZh: 但我是虫，不是人， 是世上所羞辱的，也是众人所藐视的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我是虫，不是人， 是世上所羞辱的，也是众人所藐视的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我是虫，不是人， 被众人羞辱，被百姓藐视。
verses.textEnNiv: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by everyone, despised by the people.
verses.textEnEsv: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by mankind and despised by the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised by the people.
verses.textEnNlt: But I am a worm and not a man. I am scorned and despised by all!
verses.textEnNasb: But I am a worm and not a person, A disgrace of mankind and despised by the people.
verses.textEn: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by everyone, despised by the people.

verses.textZh: 看见我的，都嘲笑我； 他们撇着嘴，摇着头，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见我的，都嘲笑我； 他们撇着嘴，摇着头，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 凡看见我的都嗤笑我； 他们撇嘴摇头，说：
verses.textEnNiv: All who see me mock me; they hurl insults, shaking their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: All who see me mock me; they make mouths at me; they wag their heads;
verses.textEnNkjv: All those who see Me ridicule Me; They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who sees me mocks me. They sneer and shake their heads, saying,
verses.textEnNasb: All who see me deride me; They sneer, they shake their heads, saying,
verses.textEn: All who see me mock me; they hurl insults, shaking their heads.

verses.textZh: "他既然把自己交托耶和华， 就让耶和华搭救他吧！ 耶和华既然喜悦他，就让耶和华拯救他吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: "他既然把自己交托耶和华， 就让耶和华搭救他吧！ 耶和华既然喜悦他，就让耶和华拯救他吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他把自己交托耶和华，耶和华可以救他吧！ 耶和华既喜悦他，可以搭救他吧！
verses.textEnNiv: "He trusts in the Lord ," they say, "let the Lord rescue him. Let him deliver him, since he delights in him."
verses.textEnEsv: "He trusts in the Lord ; let him deliver him; let him rescue him, for he delights in him!"
verses.textEnNkjv: "He trusted in the Lord, let Him rescue Him; Let Him deliver Him, since He delights in Him!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Is this the one who relies on the Lord ? Then let the Lord save him! If the Lord loves him so much, let the Lord rescue him!"
verses.textEnNasb: " Turn him over to the Lord; let Him save him; Let Him rescue him, because He delights in him."
verses.textEn: "He trusts in the Lord ," they say, "let the Lord rescue him. Let him deliver him, since he delights in him."

verses.textZh: 然而，是你使我从母腹中出来的； 我在母亲的怀里，你就使我有倚靠的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，是你使我从母腹中出来的； 我在母亲的怀里，你就使我有倚靠的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你是叫我出母腹的； 我在母怀里，你就使我有倚靠的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you brought me out of the womb; you made me trust in you, even at my mother’s breast.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you are he who took me from the womb; you made me trust you at my mother’s breasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You are He who took Me out of the womb; You made Me trust while on My mother’s breasts.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet you brought me safely from my mother’s womb and led me to trust you at my mother’s breast.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet You are He who brought me forth from the womb; You made me trust when upon my mother’s breasts.
verses.textEn: Yet you brought me out of the womb; you made me trust in you, even at my mother’s breast.

verses.textZh: 我自出母胎，就被交托给你； 我一出母腹，你就是我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我自出母胎，就被交托给你； 我一出母腹，你就是我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我自出母胎就被交在你手里； 从我母亲生我，你就是我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: From birth I was cast on you; from my mother’s womb you have been my God.
verses.textEnEsv: On you was I cast from my birth, and from my mother’s womb you have been my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was cast upon You from birth. From My mother’s womb You havebeen My God.
verses.textEnNlt: I was thrust into your arms at my birth. You have been my God from the moment I was born.
verses.textEnNasb: I was cast upon You from birth; You have been my God from my mother’s womb.
verses.textEn: From birth I was cast on you; from my mother’s womb you have been my God.

verses.textZh: 求你不要远离我，因为灾难临近了， 却没有人帮助我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要远离我，因为灾难临近了， 却没有人帮助我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你不要远离我！ 因为急难临近了，没有人帮助我。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
verses.textEnEsv: Be not far from me, for trouble is near, and there is none to help.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be not far from Me, For trouble is near; For thereis none to help.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not stay so far from me, for trouble is near, and no one else can help me.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near; For there is no one to help.
verses.textEn: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

verses.textZh: 有许多公牛围着我， 巴珊强壮的公牛困住了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多公牛围着我， 巴珊强壮的公牛困住了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 有许多公牛围绕我， 巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。
verses.textEnNiv: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
verses.textEnEsv: Many bulls encompass me; strong bulls of Bashan surround me;
verses.textEnNkjv: Many bulls have surrounded Me; Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled Me.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies surround me like a herd of bulls; fierce bulls of Bashan have hemmed me in!
verses.textEnNasb: Many bulls have surrounded me; Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
verses.textEn: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.

verses.textZh: 他们向我大大地张嘴， 像抓撕吼叫的狮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们向我大大地张嘴， 像抓撕吼叫的狮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 它们向我张口， 好像抓撕吼叫的狮子。
verses.textEnNiv: Roaring lions that tear their prey open their mouths wide against me.
verses.textEnEsv: they open wide their mouths at me, like a ravening and roaring lion.
verses.textEnNkjv: They gape at Me with their mouths, Like a raging and roaring lion.
verses.textEnNlt: Like lions they open their jaws against me, roaring and tearing into their prey.
verses.textEnNasb: They open their mouths wide at me, As a ravening and roaring lion.
verses.textEn: Roaring lions that tear their prey open their mouths wide against me.

verses.textZh: 我好象水被倾倒出去， 我全身的骨头都散脱了， 我的心在我里面像蜡融化。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我好象水被倾倒出去， 我全身的骨头都散脱了， 我的心在我里面像蜡融化。
verses.textZhCuv: 我如水被倒出来； 我的骨头都脱了节； 我心在我里面如蜡熔化。
verses.textEnNiv: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart has turned to wax; it has melted within me.
verses.textEnEsv: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint; my heart is like wax; it is melted within my breast;
verses.textEnNkjv: I am poured out like water, And all My bones are out of joint; My heart is like wax; It has melted within Me.
verses.textEnNlt: My life is poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax, melting within me.
verses.textEnNasb: I am poured out like water, And all my bones are out of joint; My heart is like wax; It is melted within me.
verses.textEn: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart has turned to wax; it has melted within me.

verses.textZh: 我的精力像瓦片一样枯干， 我的舌头紧黏着上颚， 你把我放在死亡的尘土中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的精力像瓦片一样枯干， 我的舌头紧黏着上颚， 你把我放在死亡的尘土中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的精力枯干，如同瓦片； 我的舌头贴在我牙床上。 你将我安置在死地的尘土中。
verses.textEnNiv: My mouth is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me in the dust of death.
verses.textEnEsv: my strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to my jaws; you lay me in the dust of death.
verses.textEnNkjv: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, And My tongue clings to My jaws; You have brought Me to the dust of death.
verses.textEnNlt: My strength has dried up like sunbaked clay. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have laid me in the dust and left me for dead.
verses.textEnNasb: My strength is dried up like a piece of pottery, And my tongue clings to my jaws; And You lay me in the dust of death.
verses.textEn: My mouth is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me in the dust of death.

verses.textZh: 犬类围着我， 恶党环绕我， 他们扎了 我的手我的脚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犬类围着我， 恶党环绕我， 他们扎了 我的手我的脚。
verses.textZhCuv: 犬类围着我，恶党环绕我； 他们扎了我的手，我的脚。
verses.textEnNiv: Dogs surround me, a pack of villains encircles me; they pierce my hands and my feet.
verses.textEnEsv: For dogs encompass me; a company of evildoers encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet —
verses.textEnNkjv: For dogs have surrounded Me; The congregation of the wicked has enclosed Me. They pierced My hands and My feet;
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies surround me like a pack of dogs; an evil gang closes in on me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
verses.textEnNasb: For dogs have surrounded me; A band of evildoers has encompassed me; They pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.textEn: Dogs surround me, a pack of villains encircles me; they pierce my hands and my feet.

verses.textZh: 我能数算我全身的骨头， 他们却瞪着眼看我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我能数算我全身的骨头， 他们却瞪着眼看我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的骨头，我都能数过； 他们瞪着眼看我。
verses.textEnNiv: All my bones are on display; people stare and gloat over me.
verses.textEnEsv: I can count all my bones— they stare and gloat over me;
verses.textEnNkjv: I can count all My bones. They look and stare at Me.
verses.textEnNlt: I can count all my bones. My enemies stare at me and gloat.
verses.textEnNasb: I can count all my bones. They look, they stare at me;
verses.textEn: All my bones are on display; people stare and gloat over me.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此分了我的外衣， 又为我的内衣抽签。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此分了我的外衣， 又为我的内衣抽签。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们分我的外衣， 为我的里衣拈阄。
verses.textEnNiv: They divide my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment.
verses.textEnEsv: they divide my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast lots.
verses.textEnNkjv: They divide My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots.
verses.textEnNlt: They divide my garments among themselves and throw dice for my clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: They divide my garments among them, And they cast lots for my clothing.
verses.textEn: They divide my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment.

verses.textZh: 至于你，耶和华啊！求你不要远离我； 我的力量啊！求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，耶和华啊！求你不要远离我； 我的力量啊！求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你不要远离我！ 我的救主啊，求你快来帮助我！
verses.textEnNiv: But you, Lord , do not be far from me. You are my strength; come quickly to help me.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O Lord , do not be far off! O you my help, come quickly to my aid!
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, O Lord, do not be far from Me; O My Strength, hasten to help Me!
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , do not stay far away! You are my strength; come quickly to my aid!
verses.textEnNasb: But You, Lord, do not be far away; You who are my help, hurry to my assistance.
verses.textEn: But you, Lord , do not be far from me. You are my strength; come quickly to help me.

verses.textZh: 求你搭救我的性命脱离刀剑， 搭救我的生命脱离恶狗的爪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你搭救我的性命脱离刀剑， 搭救我的生命脱离恶狗的爪。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你救我的灵魂脱离刀剑， 救我的生命 脱离犬类，
verses.textEnNiv: Deliver me from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dogs.
verses.textEnEsv: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog!
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver Me from the sword, My precious life from the power of the dog.
verses.textEnNlt: Save me from the sword; spare my precious life from these dogs.
verses.textEnNasb: Save my soul from the sword, My only life from the power of the dog.
verses.textEn: Deliver me from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dogs.

verses.textZh: 求你拯救我脱离狮子的口， 拯救我脱离野牛的角。 你已经应允了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你拯救我脱离狮子的口， 拯救我脱离野牛的角。 你已经应允了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 救我脱离狮子的口； 你已经应允我，使我脱离野牛的角。
verses.textEnNiv: Rescue me from the mouth of the lions; save me from the horns of the wild oxen.
verses.textEnEsv: Save me from the mouth of the lion! You have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen!
verses.textEnNkjv: Save Me from the lion’s mouth And from the horns of the wild oxen! You have answered Me.
verses.textEnNlt: Snatch me from the lion’s jaws and from the horns of these wild oxen.
verses.textEnNasb: Save me from the lion’s mouth; From the horns of the wild oxen You answer me.
verses.textEn: Rescue me from the mouth of the lions; save me from the horns of the wild oxen.

verses.textZh: 我要向我的兄弟宣扬你的名， 我要在聚会中赞美你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要向我的兄弟宣扬你的名， 我要在聚会中赞美你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将你的名传与我的弟兄， 在会中我要赞美你。
verses.textEnNiv: I will declare your name to my people; in the assembly I will praise you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will tell of your name to my brothers; in the midst of the congregation I will praise you:
verses.textEnNkjv: I will declare Your name to My brethren; In the midst of the assembly I will praise You.
verses.textEnNlt: I will proclaim your name to my brothers and sisters. I will praise you among your assembled people.
verses.textEnNasb: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; In the midst of the assembly I will praise You.
verses.textEn: I will declare your name to my people; in the assembly I will praise you.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华的人哪！你们要赞美他； 雅各所有的后裔啊！你们都要尊敬他； 以色列所有的后裔啊！你们都要惧怕他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华的人哪！你们要赞美他； 雅各所有的后裔啊！你们都要尊敬他； 以色列所有的后裔啊！你们都要惧怕他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们敬畏耶和华的人要赞美他！ 雅各的后裔都要荣耀他！ 以色列的后裔都要惧怕他！
verses.textEnNiv: You who fear the Lord , praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor him! Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!
verses.textEnEsv: You who fear the Lord , praise him! All you offspring of Jacob, glorify him, and stand in awe of him, all you offspring of Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: You who fear the Lord, praise Him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify Him, And fear Him, all you offspring of Israel!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , all you who fear him! Honor him, all you descendants of Jacob! Show him reverence, all you descendants of Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: You who fear the Lord, praise Him; All you descendants of Jacob, glorify Him, And stand in awe of Him, all you descendants of Israel.
verses.textEn: You who fear the Lord , praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor him! Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!

verses.textZh: 因为他不轻看，不厌恶受苦的人的痛苦，也没有掩面不顾他； 受苦的人呼求的时候，他就垂听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他不轻看，不厌恶受苦的人的痛苦，也没有掩面不顾他； 受苦的人呼求的时候，他就垂听。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他没有藐视憎恶受苦的人， 也没有向他掩面； 那受苦之人呼吁的时候，他就垂听。
verses.textEnNiv: For he has not despised or scorned the suffering of the afflicted one; he has not hidden his face from him but has listened to his cry for help.
verses.textEnEsv: For he has not despised or abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, and he has not hidden his face from him, but has heard, when he cried to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Nor has He hidden His face from Him; But when He cried to Him, He heard.
verses.textEnNlt: For he has not ignored or belittled the suffering of the needy. He has not turned his back on them, but has listened to their cries for help.
verses.textEnNasb: For He has not despised nor scorned the suffering of the afflicted; Nor has He hidden His face from him; But when he cried to Him for help, He heard.
verses.textEn: For he has not despised or scorned the suffering of the afflicted one; he has not hidden his face from him but has listened to his cry for help.

verses.textZh: 在大会中，我赞美你的话是从你而来的； 在敬畏耶和华的人面前，我要还我的愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在大会中，我赞美你的话是从你而来的； 在敬畏耶和华的人面前，我要还我的愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在大会中赞美你的话是从你而来的； 我要在敬畏耶和华的人面前还我的愿。
verses.textEnNiv: From you comes the theme of my praise in the great assembly; before those who fear you I will fulfill my vows.
verses.textEnEsv: From you comes my praise in the great congregation; my vows I will perform before those who fear him.
verses.textEnNkjv: My praise shallbe of You in the great assembly; I will pay My vows before those who fear Him.
verses.textEnNlt: I will praise you in the great assembly. I will fulfill my vows in the presence of those who worship you.
verses.textEnNasb: From You comes my praise in the great assembly; I shall pay my vows before those who fear Him.
verses.textEn: From you comes the theme of my praise in the great assembly; before those who fear you I will fulfill my vows.

verses.textZh: 受苦的人必吃得饱足， 寻求耶和华的人必赞美他， 愿你们的心永远活着！
verses.textZhCnvs: 受苦的人必吃得饱足， 寻求耶和华的人必赞美他， 愿你们的心永远活着！
verses.textZhCuv: 谦卑的人必吃得饱足； 寻求耶和华的人必赞美他。 愿你们的心永远活着！
verses.textEnNiv: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the Lord will praise him— may your hearts live forever!
verses.textEnEsv: The afflicted shall eat and be satisfied; those who seek him shall praise the Lord ! May your hearts live forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: The poor shall eat and be satisfied; Those who seek Him will praise the Lord. Let your heart live forever!
verses.textEnNlt: The poor will eat and be satisfied. All who seek the Lord will praise him. Their hearts will rejoice with everlasting joy.
verses.textEnNasb: The afflicted will eat and be satisfied; Those who seek Him will praise the Lord. May your heart live forever!
verses.textEn: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the Lord will praise him— may your hearts live forever!

verses.textZh: 地的四极，都要记念耶和华，并且归向他。 列国的万族，都要在他 面前敬拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地的四极，都要记念耶和华，并且归向他。 列国的万族，都要在他 面前敬拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 地的四极都要想念耶和华，并且归顺他； 列国的万族都要在你面前敬拜。
verses.textEnNiv: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord , and all the families of the nations will bow down before him,
verses.textEnEsv: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the Lord , and all the families of the nations shall worship before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the ends of the world Shall remember and turn to the Lord, And all the families of the nations Shall worship before You.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole earth will acknowledge the Lord and return to him. All the families of the nations will bow down before him.
verses.textEnNasb: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, And all the families of the nations will worship before You.
verses.textEn: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord , and all the families of the nations will bow down before him,

verses.textZh: 因为国度是属于耶和华的， 他是掌管万国的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为国度是属于耶和华的， 他是掌管万国的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为国权是耶和华的； 他是管理万国的。
verses.textEnNiv: for dominion belongs to the Lord and he rules over the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: For kingship belongs to the Lord , and he rules over the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the kingdom is the Lord’s, And He rules over the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: For royal power belongs to the Lord . He rules all the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: For the kingdom is the Lord’s And He rules over the nations.
verses.textEn: for dominion belongs to the Lord and he rules over the nations.

verses.textZh: 地上所有富足的人，都必吃喝、敬拜； 所有下到尘土中，不再存活的人， 都在他面前屈身下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上所有富足的人，都必吃喝、敬拜； 所有下到尘土中，不再存活的人， 都在他面前屈身下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 地上一切丰肥的人必吃喝而敬拜； 凡下到尘土中－不能存活自己性命的人 －都要在他面前下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before him— those who cannot keep themselves alive.
verses.textEnEsv: All the prosperous of the earth eat and worship; before him shall bow all who go down to the dust, even the one who could not keep himself alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the prosperous of the earth Shall eat and worship; All those who go down to the dust Shall bow before Him, Even he who cannot keep himself alive.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the rich of the earth feast and worship. Bow before him, all who are mortal, all whose lives will end as dust.
verses.textEnNasb: All the prosperous of the earth will eat and worship, All those who go down to the dust will kneel before Him, Even he who cannot keep his soul alive.
verses.textEn: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before him— those who cannot keep themselves alive.

verses.textZh: 必有后裔服事他， 必有人把主的事向后代述说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有后裔服事他， 必有人把主的事向后代述说。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必有后裔事奉他； 主所行的事必传与后代。
verses.textEnNiv: Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Posterity shall serve him; it shall be told of the Lord to the coming generation;
verses.textEnNkjv: A posterity shall serve Him. It will be recounted of the Lord to the next generation,
verses.textEnNlt: Our children will also serve him. Future generations will hear about the wonders of the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: A posterity will serve Him; It will be told of the Lord to the coming generation.
verses.textEn: Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord.

verses.textZh: 他们要把他的公义传给以后出生的民， 说明这是他所作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要把他的公义传给以后出生的民， 说明这是他所作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必来把他的公义传给将要生的民， 言明这事是他所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: They will proclaim his righteousness, declaring to a people yet unborn: He has done it!
verses.textEnEsv: they shall come and proclaim his righteousness to a people yet unborn, that he has done it.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will come and declare His righteousness to a people who will be born, That He has done this.
verses.textEnNlt: His righteous acts will be told to those not yet born. They will hear about everything he has done.
verses.textEnNasb: They will come and will declare His righteousness To a people who will be born, that He has performed it.
verses.textEn: They will proclaim his righteousness, declaring to a people yet unborn: He has done it!

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华是我的牧人，我必不会缺乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 耶和华是我的牧人，我必不会缺乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是我的牧者， 我必不致缺乏。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
