verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is my shepherd; I have all that I need.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is my shepherd, I will not be in need.
verses.textEn: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

verses.textZh: 他使我躺卧在青草地上， 领我到安静的水边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我躺卧在青草地上， 领我到安静的水边。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我躺卧在青草地上， 领我在可安歇的水边。
verses.textEnNiv: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters,
verses.textEnEsv: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: He makes me to lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside the still waters.
verses.textEnNlt: He lets me rest in green meadows; he leads me beside peaceful streams.
verses.textEnNasb: He lets me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
verses.textEn: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters,

verses.textZh: 他使我的灵魂苏醒； 为了自己的名，他引导我走义路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我的灵魂苏醒； 为了自己的名，他引导我走义路。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我的灵魂苏醒， 为自己的名引导我走义路。
verses.textEnNiv: he refreshes my soul. He guides me along the right paths for his name’s sake.
verses.textEnEsv: He restores my soul. He leads me in paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.textEnNkjv: He restores my soul; He leads me in the paths of righteousness For His name’s sake.
verses.textEnNlt: He renews my strength. He guides me along right paths, bringing honor to his name.
verses.textEnNasb: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness For the sake of His name.
verses.textEn: he refreshes my soul. He guides me along the right paths for his name’s sake.

verses.textZh: 我虽然行过死荫的山谷，也不怕遭受伤害， 因为你与我同在； 你的杖你的竿都安慰我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然行过死荫的山谷，也不怕遭受伤害， 因为你与我同在； 你的杖你的竿都安慰我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽然行过死荫的幽谷， 也不怕遭害， 因为你与我同在； 你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
verses.textEnNiv: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verses.textEnEsv: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
verses.textEnNlt: Even when I walk through the darkest valley, I will not be afraid, for you are close beside me. Your rod and your staff protect and comfort me.
verses.textEnNasb: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
verses.textEn: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

verses.textZh: 在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席； 你用油膏了我的头， 使我的杯满溢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席； 你用油膏了我的头， 使我的杯满溢。
verses.textZhCuv: 在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席； 你用油膏了我的头，使我的福杯满溢。
verses.textEnNiv: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
verses.textEnEsv: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; you anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
verses.textEnNkjv: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over.
verses.textEnNlt: You prepare a feast for me in the presence of my enemies. You honor me by anointing my head with oil. My cup overflows with blessings.
verses.textEnNasb: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You have anointed my head with oil; My cup overflows.
verses.textEn: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

verses.textZh: 我一生的日子，必有恩惠慈爱紧随着我； 我也要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我一生的日子，必有恩惠慈爱紧随着我； 我也要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈爱随着我； 我且要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life, and I shall dwell in the house of the Lord forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the Lord Forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Surely your goodness and unfailing love will pursue me all the days of my life, and I will live in the house of the Lord forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Certainly goodness and faithfulness will follow me all the days of my life, And my dwelling will be in the house of the Lord forever.
verses.textEn: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 地和地上所充满的， 世界和住在世上的，都是属于耶和华的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 地和地上所充满的， 世界和住在世上的，都是属于耶和华的。
verses.textZhCuv: 地和其中所充满的， 世界和住在其间的，都属耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth is the Lord ’s, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;
verses.textEnEsv: The earth is the Lord ’s and the fullness thereof, the world and those who dwell therein,
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth is the Lord’s, and all its fullness, The world and those who dwell therein.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth is the Lord ’s, and everything in it. The world and all its people belong to him.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth is the Lord’s, and all it contains, The world, and those who live in it.
verses.textEn: The earth is the Lord ’s, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;

verses.textZh: 因为他把地奠定在海上， 使世界安定在众水之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他把地奠定在海上， 使世界安定在众水之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他把地建立在海上， 安定在大水之上。
verses.textEnNiv: for he founded it on the seas and established it on the waters.
verses.textEnEsv: for he has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the rivers.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He has founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the waters.
verses.textEnNlt: For he laid the earth’s foundation on the seas and built it on the ocean depths.
verses.textEnNasb: For He has founded it upon the seas And established it upon the rivers.
verses.textEn: for he founded it on the seas and established it on the waters.

verses.textZh: 谁能登上耶和华的山？ 谁能站在他的圣所中呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能登上耶和华的山？ 谁能站在他的圣所中呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能登耶和华的山？ 谁能站在他的圣所？
verses.textEnNiv: Who may ascend the mountain of the Lord ? Who may stand in his holy place?
verses.textEnEsv: Who shall ascend the hill of the Lord ? And who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who may ascend into the hill of the Lord? Or who may stand in His holy place?
verses.textEnNlt: Who may climb the mountain of the Lord ? Who may stand in his holy place?
verses.textEnNasb: Who may ascend onto the hill of the Lord? And who may stand in His holy place?
verses.textEn: Who may ascend the mountain of the Lord ? Who may stand in his holy place?

verses.textZh: 就是手洁心清的人， 他不倾向虚妄， 起誓不怀诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是手洁心清的人， 他不倾向虚妄， 起誓不怀诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是手洁心清，不向虚妄， 起誓不怀诡诈的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not trust in an idol or swear by a false god.
verses.textEnEsv: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to what is false and does not swear deceitfully.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, Who has not lifted up his soul to an idol, Nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.textEnNlt: Only those whose hands and hearts are pure, who do not worship idols and never tell lies.
verses.textEnNasb: One who has clean hands and a pure heart, Who has not lifted up his soul to deceit And has not sworn deceitfully.
verses.textEn: The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not trust in an idol or swear by a false god.

verses.textZh: 他必领受从耶和华来的福分， 也必蒙拯救他的神称他为义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必领受从耶和华来的福分， 也必蒙拯救他的神称他为义。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必蒙耶和华赐福， 又蒙救他的神使他成义。
verses.textEnNiv: They will receive blessing from the Lord and vindication from God their Savior.
verses.textEnEsv: He will receive blessing from the Lord and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall receive blessing from the Lord, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: They will receive the Lord ’s blessing and have a right relationship with God their savior.
verses.textEnNasb: He will receive a blessing from the Lord And righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.textEn: They will receive blessing from the Lord and vindication from God their Savior.

verses.textZh: 这就是求问耶和华的那一类人， 就是寻求你面的雅各。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是求问耶和华的那一类人， 就是寻求你面的雅各。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是寻求耶和华的族类， 是寻求你面的雅各。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face, God of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek the face of the God of Jacob. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: This is Jacob, the generation of those who seek Him, Who seek Your face. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Such people may seek you and worship in your presence, O God of Jacob. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: This is the generation of those who seek Him, Who seek Your face—even Jacob. Selah
verses.textEn: Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face, God of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 众城门哪！抬起你们的头来； 古老的门户啊！你们要被举起， 好让荣耀的王进来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众城门哪！抬起你们的头来； 古老的门户啊！你们要被举起， 好让荣耀的王进来。
verses.textZhCuv: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！ 永久的门户，你们要被举起！ 那荣耀的王将要进来！
verses.textEnNiv: Lift up your heads, you gates; be lifted up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.
verses.textEnEsv: Lift up your heads, O gates! And be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lift up your heads, O you gates! And be lifted up, you everlasting doors! And the King of glory shall come in.
verses.textEnNlt: Open up, ancient gates! Open up, ancient doors, and let the King of glory enter.
verses.textEnNasb: Lift up your heads, you gates, And be lifted up, you ancient doors, That the King of glory may come in!
verses.textEn: Lift up your heads, you gates; be lifted up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

verses.textZh: 那荣耀的王是谁呢？ 就是强而有力的耶和华， 在战场上大有能力的耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那荣耀的王是谁呢？ 就是强而有力的耶和华， 在战场上大有能力的耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 荣耀的王是谁呢？ 就是有力有能的耶和华， 在战场上有能的耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is this King of glory? The Lord , strong and mighty, the Lord , mighty in battle!
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, The Lord mighty in battle.
verses.textEnNlt: Who is the King of glory? The Lord , strong and mighty; the Lord , invincible in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: Who is the King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, The Lord mighty in battle.
verses.textEn: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

verses.textZh: 众城门哪！抬起你们的头来； 古老的门户啊！你们要被举起， 好让荣耀的王进来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众城门哪！抬起你们的头来； 古老的门户啊！你们要被举起， 好让荣耀的王进来。
verses.textZhCuv: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！ 永久的门户，你们要把头抬起！ 那荣耀的王将要进来！
verses.textEnNiv: Lift up your heads, you gates; lift them up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.
verses.textEnEsv: Lift up your heads, O gates! And lift them up, O ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lift up your heads, O you gates! Lift up, you everlasting doors! And the King of glory shall come in.
verses.textEnNlt: Open up, ancient gates! Open up, ancient doors, and let the King of glory enter.
verses.textEnNasb: Lift up your heads, you gates, And lift them up, you ancient doors, That the King of glory may come in!
verses.textEn: Lift up your heads, you gates; lift them up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

verses.textZh: 那荣耀的王是谁呢？ 万军之耶和华，他就是那荣耀的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那荣耀的王是谁呢？ 万军之耶和华，他就是那荣耀的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 荣耀的王是谁呢？ 万军之耶和华， 他是荣耀的王！ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Who is he, this King of glory? The Lord Almighty— he is the King of glory.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, He is the King of glory. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Who is the King of glory? The Lord of Heaven’s Armies— he is the King of glory. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of armies, He is the King of glory. Selah
verses.textEn: Who is he, this King of glory? The Lord Almighty— he is the King of glory.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！我的心仰望你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！我的心仰望你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我的心仰望你。
verses.textEnNiv: In you, Lord my God, I put my trust.
verses.textEnEsv: To you, O Lord , I lift up my soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: To You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , I give my life to you.
verses.textEnNasb: To You, Lord, I lift up my soul.
verses.textEn: In you, Lord my God, I put my trust.

verses.textZh: 我的神啊！我倚靠你，求你不要使我羞愧， 也不要使我的仇敌胜过我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神啊！我倚靠你，求你不要使我羞愧， 也不要使我的仇敌胜过我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，我素来倚靠你； 求你不要叫我羞愧， 不要叫我的仇敌向我夸胜。
verses.textEnNiv: I trust in you; do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.textEnEsv: O my God, in you I trust; let me not be put to shame; let not my enemies exult over me.
verses.textEnNkjv: O my God, I trust in You; Let me not be ashamed; Let not my enemies triumph over me.
verses.textEnNlt: I trust in you, my God! Do not let me be disgraced, or let my enemies rejoice in my defeat.
verses.textEnNasb: My God, in You I trust, Do not let me be ashamed; Do not let my enemies rejoice over me.
verses.textEn: I trust in you; do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies triumph over me.

verses.textZh: 等候你的必不羞愧， 但那些无故以诡诈待人的必要羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等候你的必不羞愧， 但那些无故以诡诈待人的必要羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡等候你的必不羞愧； 惟有那无故行奸诈的必要羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: No one who hopes in you will ever be put to shame, but shame will come on those who are treacherous without cause.
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed, none who wait for you shall be put to shame; they shall be ashamed who are wantonly treacherous.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, let no one who waits on You be ashamed; Let those be ashamed who deal treacherously without cause.
verses.textEnNlt: No one who trusts in you will ever be disgraced, but disgrace comes to those who try to deceive others.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, none of those who wait for You will be ashamed; Those who deal treacherously without cause will be ashamed.
verses.textEn: No one who hopes in you will ever be put to shame, but shame will come on those who are treacherous without cause.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你把你的道路指示我， 求你把你的路径教导我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你把你的道路指示我， 求你把你的路径教导我，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指示我， 将你的路教训我！
verses.textEnNiv: Show me your ways, Lord , teach me your paths.
verses.textEnEsv: Make me to know your ways, O Lord ; teach me your paths.
verses.textEnNkjv: Show me Your ways, O Lord; Teach me Your paths.
verses.textEnNlt: Show me the right path, O Lord ; point out the road for me to follow.
verses.textEnNasb: Make me know Your ways, Lord; Teach me Your paths.
verses.textEn: Show me your ways, Lord , teach me your paths.

verses.textZh: 求你以你的真理引导我，教训我， 因为你是拯救我的神； 我整天等候的就是你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你以你的真理引导我，教训我， 因为你是拯救我的神； 我整天等候的就是你。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你以你的真理引导我，教训我， 因为你是救我的神。 我终日等候你。
verses.textEnNiv: Guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; for you I wait all the day long.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lead me in Your truth and teach me, For You are the God of my salvation; On You I wait all the day.
verses.textEnNlt: Lead me by your truth and teach me, for you are the God who saves me. All day long I put my hope in you.
verses.textEnNasb: Lead me in Your truth and teach me, For You are the God of my salvation; For You I wait all the day.
verses.textEn: Guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你记念你的怜悯和慈爱， 因为它们自古以来就存在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你记念你的怜悯和慈爱， 因为它们自古以来就存在。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你记念你的怜悯和慈爱， 因为这是亘古以来所常有的。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember, Lord , your great mercy and love, for they are from of old.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember your mercy, O Lord , and your steadfast love, for they have been from of old.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember, O Lord, Your tender mercies and Your lovingkindnesses, For they are from of old.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember, O Lord , your compassion and unfailing love, which you have shown from long ages past.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember, Lord, Your compassion and Your faithfulness, For they have been from of old.
verses.textEn: Remember, Lord , your great mercy and love, for they are from of old.

verses.textZh: 求你不要记念我幼年的罪恶和我的过犯； 耶和华啊！求你因你的恩惠， 按着你的慈爱记念我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要记念我幼年的罪恶和我的过犯； 耶和华啊！求你因你的恩惠， 按着你的慈爱记念我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你不要记念我幼年的罪愆和我的过犯； 耶和华啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈爱记念我。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not remember the sins of my youth and my rebellious ways; according to your love remember me, for you, Lord , are good.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember not the sins of my youth or my transgressions; according to your steadfast love remember me, for the sake of your goodness, O Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions; According to Your mercy remember me, For Your goodness’ sake, O Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not remember the rebellious sins of my youth. Remember me in the light of your unfailing love, for you are merciful, O Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Do not remember the sins of my youth or my wrongdoings; Remember me according to Your faithfulness, For Your goodness’ sake, Lord.
verses.textEn: Do not remember the sins of my youth and my rebellious ways; according to your love remember me, for you, Lord , are good.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是良善和正直的， 因此他必指示罪人走正路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是良善和正直的， 因此他必指示罪人走正路。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是良善正直的， 所以他必指示罪人走正路。
verses.textEnNiv: Good and upright is the Lord ; therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.
verses.textEnEsv: Good and upright is the Lord ; therefore he instructs sinners in the way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Good and upright is the Lord; Therefore He teaches sinners in the way.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is good and does what is right; he shows the proper path to those who go astray.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is good and upright; Therefore He instructs sinners in the way.
verses.textEn: Good and upright is the Lord ; therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.

verses.textZh: 他必引导谦卑的人行正义， 把他的道路教导谦卑的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必引导谦卑的人行正义， 把他的道路教导谦卑的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必按公平引领谦卑人， 将他的道教训他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them his way.
verses.textEnEsv: He leads the humble in what is right, and teaches the humble his way.
verses.textEnNkjv: The humble He guides in justice, And the humble He teaches His way.
verses.textEnNlt: He leads the humble in doing right, teaching them his way.
verses.textEnNasb: He leads the humble in justice, And He teaches the humble His way.
verses.textEn: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them his way.

verses.textZh: 遵守耶和华的约和法度的人， 耶和华都以慈爱和信实待他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遵守耶和华的约和法度的人， 耶和华都以慈爱和信实待他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡遵守他的约和他法度的人， 耶和华都以慈爱诚实待他。
verses.textEnNiv: All the ways of the Lord are loving and faithful toward those who keep the demands of his covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: All the paths of the Lord are steadfast love and faithfulness, for those who keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the paths of the Lordare mercy and truth, To such as keep His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord leads with unfailing love and faithfulness all who keep his covenant and obey his demands.
verses.textEnNasb: All the paths of the Lord are faithfulness and truth To those who comply with His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.textEn: All the ways of the Lord are loving and faithful toward those who keep the demands of his covenant.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！因你名的缘故， 求你赦免我的罪孽，因为我的罪孽重大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！因你名的缘故， 求你赦免我的罪孽，因为我的罪孽重大。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪， 因为我的罪重大。
verses.textEnNiv: For the sake of your name, Lord , forgive my iniquity, though it is great.
verses.textEnEsv: For your name’s sake, O Lord , pardon my guilt, for it is great.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Your name’s sake, O Lord, Pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
verses.textEnNlt: For the honor of your name, O Lord , forgive my many, many sins.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sake of Your name, Lord, Forgive my wrongdoing, for it is great.
verses.textEn: For the sake of your name, Lord , forgive my iniquity, though it is great.

verses.textZh: 谁是那敬畏耶和华的人？ 耶和华必指示他应选择的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁是那敬畏耶和华的人？ 耶和华必指示他应选择的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁敬畏耶和华， 耶和华必指示他当选择的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: Who, then, are those who fear the Lord ? He will instruct them in the ways they should choose.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is the man who fears the Lord ? Him will he instruct in the way that he should choose.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is the man that fears the Lord? Him shall He teach in the way He chooses.
verses.textEnNlt: Who are those who fear the Lord ? He will show them the path they should choose.
verses.textEnNasb: Who is the person who fears the Lord? He will instruct him in the way he should choose.
verses.textEn: Who, then, are those who fear the Lord ? He will instruct them in the ways they should choose.

verses.textZh: 他必安享福乐， 他的后裔要承受地土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必安享福乐， 他的后裔要承受地土。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必安然居住； 他的后裔必承受地土。
verses.textEnNiv: They will spend their days in prosperity, and their descendants will inherit the land.
verses.textEnEsv: His soul shall abide in well-being, and his offspring shall inherit the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: He himself shall dwell in prosperity, And his descendants shall inherit the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: They will live in prosperity, and their children will inherit the land.
verses.textEnNasb: His soul will dwell in prosperity, And his descendants will inherit the land.
verses.textEn: They will spend their days in prosperity, and their descendants will inherit the land.

verses.textZh: 耶和华把心意向敬畏他的人显示， 又使他们认识他的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把心意向敬畏他的人显示， 又使他们认识他的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华与敬畏他的人亲密； 他必将自己的约指示他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord confides in those who fear him; he makes his covenant known to them.
verses.textEnEsv: The friendship of the Lord is for those who fear him, and he makes known to them his covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: The secret of the Lordis with those who fear Him, And He will show them His covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is a friend to those who fear him. He teaches them his covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: The secret of the Lord is for those who fear Him, And He will make them know His covenant.
verses.textEn: The Lord confides in those who fear him; he makes his covenant known to them.

verses.textZh: 我的眼睛时常仰望耶和华， 因为他必使我的脚脱离网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼睛时常仰望耶和华， 因为他必使我的脚脱离网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的眼目时常仰望耶和华， 因为他必将我的脚从网里拉出来。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes are ever on the Lord , for only he will release my feet from the snare.
verses.textEnEsv: My eyes are ever toward the Lord , for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eyes are ever toward the Lord, For He shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.textEnNlt: My eyes are always on the Lord , for he rescues me from the traps of my enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes are continually toward the Lord, For He will rescue my feet from the net.
verses.textEn: My eyes are ever on the Lord , for only he will release my feet from the snare.

verses.textZh: 求你转向我，恩待我， 因为我孤独困苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你转向我，恩待我， 因为我孤独困苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你转向我，怜恤我， 因为我是孤独困苦。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Turn Yourself to me, and have mercy on me, For I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.textEnNlt: Turn to me and have mercy, for I am alone and in deep distress.
verses.textEnNasb: Turn to me and be gracious to me, For I am lonely and afflicted.
verses.textEn: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.

verses.textZh: 我心中的愁苦增多， 求你使我从痛苦中得释放。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心中的愁苦增多， 求你使我从痛苦中得释放。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心里的愁苦甚多， 求你救我脱离我的祸患。
verses.textEnNiv: Relieve the troubles of my heart and free me from my anguish.
verses.textEnEsv: The troubles of my heart are enlarged; bring me out of my distresses.
verses.textEnNkjv: The troubles of my heart have enlarged; Bring me out of my distresses!
verses.textEnNlt: My problems go from bad to worse. Oh, save me from them all!
verses.textEnNasb: The troubles of my heart are enlarged; Bring me out of my distresses.
verses.textEn: Relieve the troubles of my heart and free me from my anguish.

verses.textZh: 求你看看我的困苦和艰难， 赦免我的一切罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你看看我的困苦和艰难， 赦免我的一切罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你看顾我的困苦，我的艰难， 赦免我一切的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Look on my affliction and my distress and take away all my sins.
verses.textEnEsv: Consider my affliction and my trouble, and forgive all my sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look on my affliction and my pain, And forgive all my sins.
verses.textEnNlt: Feel my pain and see my trouble. Forgive all my sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Look at my misery and my trouble, And forgive all my sins.
verses.textEn: Look on my affliction and my distress and take away all my sins.

verses.textZh: 求你看看我的仇敌，因为他们人数众多， 他们深深痛恨我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你看看我的仇敌，因为他们人数众多， 他们深深痛恨我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你察看我的仇敌， 因为他们人多，并且痛痛地恨我。
verses.textEnNiv: See how numerous are my enemies and how fiercely they hate me!
verses.textEnEsv: Consider how many are my foes, and with what violent hatred they hate me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Consider my enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.textEnNlt: See how many enemies I have and how viciously they hate me!
verses.textEnNasb: Look at my enemies, for they are many, And they hate me with violent hatred.
verses.textEn: See how numerous are my enemies and how fiercely they hate me!

verses.textZh: 求你护卫我的性命，搭救我； 不要叫我羞愧，因为我投靠你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你护卫我的性命，搭救我； 不要叫我羞愧，因为我投靠你。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你保护我的性命，搭救我， 使我不致羞愧，因为我投靠你。
verses.textEnNiv: Guard my life and rescue me; do not let me be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, guard my soul, and deliver me! Let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Keep my soul, and deliver me; Let me not be ashamed, for I put my trust in You.
verses.textEnNlt: Protect me! Rescue my life from them! Do not let me be disgraced, for in you I take refuge.
verses.textEnNasb: Guard my soul and save me; Do not let me be ashamed, for I take refuge in You.
verses.textEn: Guard my life and rescue me; do not let me be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.

verses.textZh: 愿纯全和正直保护我， 因为我等候你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿纯全和正直保护我， 因为我等候你。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿纯全、正直保守我， 因为我等候你。
verses.textEnNiv: May integrity and uprightness protect me, because my hope, Lord , is in you.
verses.textEnEsv: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for You.
verses.textEnNlt: May integrity and honesty protect me, for I put my hope in you.
verses.textEnNasb: Let integrity and uprightness protect me, For I wait for You.
verses.textEn: May integrity and uprightness protect me, because my hope, Lord , is in you.

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你救赎以色列， 救他脱离一切困苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你救赎以色列， 救他脱离一切困苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你救赎以色列脱离他一切的愁苦。
verses.textEnNiv: Deliver Israel, O God, from all their troubles!
verses.textEnEsv: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all their troubles!
verses.textEnNlt: O God, ransom Israel from all its troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: Redeem Israel, God, From all his distress.
verses.textEn: Deliver Israel, O God, from all their troubles!

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！求你为我伸冤， 因为我向来行事正直； 我倚靠耶和华，并不动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！求你为我伸冤， 因为我向来行事正直； 我倚靠耶和华，并不动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你为我伸冤， 因我向来行事纯全； 我又倚靠耶和华，并不摇动。
verses.textEnNiv: Vindicate me, Lord , for I have led a blameless life; I have trusted in the Lord and have not faltered.
verses.textEnEsv: Vindicate me, O Lord , for I have walked in my integrity, and I have trusted in the Lord without wavering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Vindicate me, O Lord, For I have walked in my integrity. I have also trusted in the Lord; I shall not slip.
verses.textEnNlt: Declare me innocent, O Lord , for I have acted with integrity; I have trusted in the Lord without wavering.
verses.textEnNasb: Vindicate me, Lord, for I have walked in my integrity, And I have trusted in the Lord without wavering.
verses.textEn: Vindicate me, Lord , for I have led a blameless life; I have trusted in the Lord and have not faltered.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你试验我，鉴察我， 熬炼我的肺腑心肠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你试验我，鉴察我， 熬炼我的肺腑心肠。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你察看我，试验我， 熬炼我的肺腑心肠。
verses.textEnNiv: Test me, Lord , and try me, examine my heart and my mind;
verses.textEnEsv: Prove me, O Lord , and try me; test my heart and my mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; Try my mind and my heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Put me on trial, Lord , and cross-examine me. Test my motives and my heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Examine me, Lord, and put me to the test; Refine my mind and my heart.
verses.textEn: Test me, Lord , and try me, examine my heart and my mind;

verses.textZh: 因为你的慈爱常在我的眼前， 我行事为人都按着你的真理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你的慈爱常在我的眼前， 我行事为人都按着你的真理。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你的慈爱常在我眼前， 我也按你的真理而行。
verses.textEnNiv: for I have always been mindful of your unfailing love and have lived in reliance on your faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: For your steadfast love is before my eyes, and I walk in your faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Your lovingkindness is before my eyes, And I have walked in Your truth.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am always aware of your unfailing love, and I have lived according to your truth.
verses.textEnNasb: For Your goodness is before my eyes, And I have walked in Your truth.
verses.textEn: for I have always been mindful of your unfailing love and have lived in reliance on your faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 我决不与奸诈的人同坐， 也不和虚伪的人来往。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我决不与奸诈的人同坐， 也不和虚伪的人来往。
verses.textZhCuv: 我没有和虚谎人同坐， 也不与瞒哄人的同群。
verses.textEnNiv: I do not sit with the deceitful, nor do I associate with hypocrites.
verses.textEnEsv: I do not sit with men of falsehood, nor do I consort with hypocrites.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have not sat with idolatrous mortals, Nor will I go in with hypocrites.
verses.textEnNlt: I do not spend time with liars or go along with hypocrites.
verses.textEnNasb: I do not sit with deceitful people, Nor will I go with pretenders.
verses.textEn: I do not sit with the deceitful, nor do I associate with hypocrites.

verses.textZh: 我恨恶恶人的聚会， 也不与作恶的同坐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我恨恶恶人的聚会， 也不与作恶的同坐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我恨恶恶人的会， 必不与恶人同坐。
verses.textEnNiv: I abhor the assembly of evildoers and refuse to sit with the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and I will not sit with the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have hated the assembly of evildoers, And will not sit with the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: I hate the gatherings of those who do evil, and I refuse to join in with the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: I hate the assembly of evildoers, And I will not sit with the wicked.
verses.textEn: I abhor the assembly of evildoers and refuse to sit with the wicked.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我要洗手表明无辜， 才来绕着你的祭坛行走；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我要洗手表明无辜， 才来绕着你的祭坛行走；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我要洗手表明无辜， 才环绕你的祭坛；
verses.textEnNiv: I wash my hands in innocence, and go about your altar, Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: I wash my hands in innocence and go around your altar, O Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will wash my hands in innocence; So I will go about Your altar, O Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: I wash my hands to declare my innocence. I come to your altar, O Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: I will wash my hands in innocence, And I will go around Your altar, Lord,
verses.textEn: I wash my hands in innocence, and go about your altar, Lord ,

verses.textZh: 好使我发出称谢的声音， 述说你一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使我发出称谢的声音， 述说你一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 我好发称谢的声音， 也要述说你一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: proclaiming aloud your praise and telling of all your wonderful deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: proclaiming thanksgiving aloud, and telling all your wondrous deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: That I may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving, And tell of all Your wondrous works.
verses.textEnNlt: singing a song of thanksgiving and telling of all your wonders.
verses.textEnNasb: That I may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving And declare all Your wonders.
verses.textEn: proclaiming aloud your praise and telling of all your wonderful deeds.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我喜爱你住宿的殿， 你荣耀居住的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我喜爱你住宿的殿， 你荣耀居住的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我喜爱你所住的殿 和你显荣耀的居所。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , I love the house where you live, the place where your glory dwells.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , I love the habitation of your house and the place where your glory dwells.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, I have loved the habitation of Your house, And the place where Your glory dwells.
verses.textEnNlt: I love your sanctuary, Lord , the place where your glorious presence dwells.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, I love the dwelling of Your house, And the place where Your glory remains.
verses.textEn: Lord , I love the house where you live, the place where your glory dwells.

verses.textZh: 求你不要把我的性命和罪人一同除掉， 也不要把我的生命和流人血的人一起消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要把我的性命和罪人一同除掉， 也不要把我的生命和流人血的人一起消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要把我的灵魂和罪人一同除掉； 不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, my life with those who are bloodthirsty,
verses.textEnEsv: Do not sweep my soul away with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men,
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not gather my soul with sinners, Nor my life with bloodthirsty men,
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let me suffer the fate of sinners. Don’t condemn me along with murderers.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not take my soul away along with sinners, Nor my life with men of bloodshed,
verses.textEn: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, my life with those who are bloodthirsty,

verses.textZh: 他们的手中有恶计， 他们的右手充满贿赂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的手中有恶计， 他们的右手充满贿赂。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的手中有奸恶， 右手满有贿赂。
verses.textEnNiv: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
verses.textEnEsv: in whose hands are evil devices, and whose right hands are full of bribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: In whose hands is a sinister scheme, And whose right hand is full of bribes.
verses.textEnNlt: Their hands are dirty with evil schemes, and they constantly take bribes.
verses.textEnNasb: In whose hands is a wicked scheme, And whose right hand is full of bribes.
verses.textEn: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我要按正直行事为人， 求你救赎我，恩待我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我要按正直行事为人， 求你救赎我，恩待我。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，却要行事纯全； 求你救赎我，怜恤我！
verses.textEnNiv: I lead a blameless life; deliver me and be merciful to me.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for me, I shall walk in my integrity; redeem me, and be gracious to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity; Redeem me and be merciful to me.
verses.textEnNlt: But I am not like that; I live with integrity. So redeem me and show me mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity; Redeem me, and be gracious to me.
verses.textEn: I lead a blameless life; deliver me and be merciful to me.

verses.textZh: 我的脚站在平坦的地方， 我要在众会中称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的脚站在平坦的地方， 我要在众会中称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的脚站在平坦地方； 在众会中我要称颂耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: My feet stand on level ground; in the great congregation I will praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: My foot stands on level ground; in the great assembly I will bless the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: My foot stands in an even place; In the congregations I will bless the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I stand on solid ground, and I will publicly praise the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: My foot stands on level ground; In the congregations I will bless the Lord.
verses.textEn: My feet stand on level ground; in the great congregation I will praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华是我的亮光，是我的救恩， 我还怕谁呢？ 耶和华是我性命的避难所， 我还惧谁呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 耶和华是我的亮光，是我的救恩， 我还怕谁呢？ 耶和华是我性命的避难所， 我还惧谁呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是我的亮光，是我的拯救， 我还怕谁呢？ 耶和华是我性命的保障 ， 我还惧谁呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life— of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? The Lordis the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is my light and my salvation— so why should I be afraid? The Lord is my fortress, protecting me from danger, so why should I tremble?
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is my light and my salvation; Whom should I fear? The Lord is the defense of my life; Whom should I dread?
verses.textEn: The Lord is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life— of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.textZh: 那些作恶的，就是我的敌人、我的仇敌， 他们逼近我，要吃我肉的时候， 就绊跌仆倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些作恶的，就是我的敌人、我的仇敌， 他们逼近我，要吃我肉的时候， 就绊跌仆倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那作恶的就是我的仇敌， 前来吃我肉的时候就绊跌仆倒。
verses.textEnNiv: When the wicked advance against me to devour me, it is my enemies and my foes who will stumble and fall.
verses.textEnEsv: When evildoers assail me to eat up my flesh, my adversaries and foes, it is they who stumble and fall.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the wicked came against me To eat up my flesh, My enemies and foes, They stumbled and fell.
verses.textEnNlt: When evil people come to devour me, when my enemies and foes attack me, they will stumble and fall.
verses.textEnNasb: When evildoers came upon me to devour my flesh, My adversaries and my enemies, they stumbled and fell.
verses.textEn: When the wicked advance against me to devour me, it is my enemies and my foes who will stumble and fall.

verses.textZh: 虽有军兵扎营攻击我， 我的心也不害怕； 虽然发动战争攻击我， 我仍旧安稳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽有军兵扎营攻击我， 我的心也不害怕； 虽然发动战争攻击我， 我仍旧安稳。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有军兵安营攻击我，我的心也不害怕； 虽然兴起刀兵攻击我，我必仍旧安稳。
verses.textEnNiv: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then I will be confident.
verses.textEnEsv: Though an army encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; though war arise against me, yet I will be confident.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though an army may encamp against me, My heart shall not fear; Though war may rise against me, In this I willbe confident.
verses.textEnNlt: Though a mighty army surrounds me, my heart will not be afraid. Even if I am attacked, I will remain confident.
verses.textEnNasb: If an army encamps against me, My heart will not fear; If war arises against me, In spite of this I am confident.
verses.textEn: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then I will be confident.

verses.textZh: 有一件事我求过耶和华，我还要寻求； 我要一生一世住在耶和华的殿里， 瞻仰他的荣美，在他的殿中求问。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一件事我求过耶和华，我还要寻求； 我要一生一世住在耶和华的殿里， 瞻仰他的荣美，在他的殿中求问。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一件事，我曾求耶和华，我仍要寻求： 就是一生一世住在耶和华的殿中， 瞻仰他的荣美，在他的殿里求问。
verses.textEnNiv: One thing I ask from the Lord , this only do I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the Lord and to seek him in his temple.
verses.textEnEsv: One thing have I asked of the Lord , that will I seek after: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze upon the beauty of the Lord and to inquire in his temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: One thing I have desired of the Lord, That will I seek: That I may dwell in the house of the Lord All the days of my life, To behold the beauty of the Lord, And to inquire in His temple.
verses.textEnNlt: The one thing I ask of the Lord — the thing I seek most— is to live in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, delighting in the Lord ’s perfections and meditating in his Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: One thing I have asked from the Lord, that I shall seek: That I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of the Lord And to meditate in His temple.
verses.textEn: One thing I ask from the Lord , this only do I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the Lord and to seek him in his temple.

verses.textZh: 因为在我遭难的日子， 他必把我藏在他的帐棚里， 把我隐藏在他帐幕的隐密处， 又把我高举在盘石上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在我遭难的日子， 他必把我藏在他的帐棚里， 把我隐藏在他帐幕的隐密处， 又把我高举在盘石上。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我遭遇患难，他必暗暗地保守我； 在他亭子里，把我藏在他帐幕的隐密处， 将我高举在磐石上。
verses.textEnNiv: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his sacred tent and set me high upon a rock.
verses.textEnEsv: For he will hide me in his shelter in the day of trouble; he will conceal me under the cover of his tent; he will lift me high upon a rock.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in the time of trouble He shall hide me in His pavilion; In the secret place of His tabernacle He shall hide me; He shall set me high upon a rock.
verses.textEnNlt: For he will conceal me there when troubles come; he will hide me in his sanctuary. He will place me out of reach on a high rock.
verses.textEnNasb: For on the day of trouble He will conceal me in His tabernacle; He will hide me in the secret place of His tent; He will lift me up on a rock.
verses.textEn: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his sacred tent and set me high upon a rock.

verses.textZh: 现在，我可以抬起头来， 高过我四周的仇敌； 我要在他的帐幕里，献上欢呼的祭； 我要歌唱，颂赞耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，我可以抬起头来， 高过我四周的仇敌； 我要在他的帐幕里，献上欢呼的祭； 我要歌唱，颂赞耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我得以昂首，高过四面的仇敌。 我要在他的帐幕里欢然献祭； 我要唱诗歌颂耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Then my head will be exalted above the enemies who surround me; at his sacred tent I will sacrifice with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And now my head shall be lifted up above my enemies all around me, and I will offer in his tent sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make melody to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And now my head shall be lifted up above my enemies all around me; Therefore I will offer sacrifices of joy in His tabernacle; I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will hold my head high above my enemies who surround me. At his sanctuary I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy, singing and praising the Lord with music.
verses.textEnNasb: And now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me, And I will offer sacrifices in His tent with shouts of joy; I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then my head will be exalted above the enemies who surround me; at his sacred tent I will sacrifice with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我发声呼求的时候，求你垂听； 求你恩待我，应允我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我发声呼求的时候，求你垂听； 求你恩待我，应允我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我用声音呼吁的时候，求你垂听； 并求你怜恤我，应允我。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear my voice when I call, Lord ; be merciful to me and answer me.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, O Lord , when I cry aloud; be gracious to me and answer me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice! Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
verses.textEnNlt: Hear me as I pray, O Lord . Be merciful and answer me!
verses.textEnNasb: Hear, Lord, when I cry with my voice, And be gracious to me and answer me.
verses.textEn: Hear my voice when I call, Lord ; be merciful to me and answer me.

verses.textZh: 你说："你们要寻求我的面！" 那时我的心对你说： "耶和华啊！你的面我正要寻求。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你说："你们要寻求我的面！" 那时我的心对你说： "耶和华啊！你的面我正要寻求。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你说：你们当寻求我的面。 那时我心向你说：耶和华啊， 你的面我正要寻求。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart says of you, "Seek his face!" Your face, Lord , I will seek.
verses.textEnEsv: You have said, "Seek my face." My heart says to you, "Your face, Lord , do I seek."
verses.textEnNkjv: WhenYousaid, "Seek My face," My heart said to You, "Your face, Lord, I will seek."
verses.textEnNlt: My heart has heard you say, "Come and talk with me." And my heart responds, " Lord , I am coming."
verses.textEnNasb: When You said, "Seek My face," my heart said to You, "I shall seek Your face, Lord."
verses.textEn: My heart says of you, "Seek his face!" Your face, Lord , I will seek.

verses.textZh: 求你不要向我掩面， 不要发怒赶逐你的仆人， 你一向是帮助我的。 拯救我的神啊！ 求你不要撇下我，也不要离弃我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要向我掩面， 不要发怒赶逐你的仆人， 你一向是帮助我的。 拯救我的神啊！ 求你不要撇下我，也不要离弃我。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要向我掩面。 不要发怒赶逐仆人， 你向来是帮助我的。 救我的神啊，不要丢掉我， 也不要离弃我。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not hide your face from me, do not turn your servant away in anger; you have been my helper. Do not reject me or forsake me, God my Savior.
verses.textEnEsv: Hide not your face from me. Turn not your servant away in anger, O you who have been my help. Cast me not off; forsake me not, O God of my salvation!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not hide Your face from me; Do not turn Your servant away in anger; You have been my help; Do not leave me nor forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not turn your back on me. Do not reject your servant in anger. You have always been my helper. Don’t leave me now; don’t abandon me, O God of my salvation!
verses.textEnNasb: Do not hide Your face from me, Do not turn Your servant away in anger; You have been my help; Do not abandon me nor forsake me, God of my salvation!
verses.textEn: Do not hide your face from me, do not turn your servant away in anger; you have been my helper. Do not reject me or forsake me, God my Savior.

verses.textZh: 虽然我的父母离弃我， 耶和华却收留我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我的父母离弃我， 耶和华却收留我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我父母离弃我， 耶和华必收留我。
verses.textEnNiv: Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me.
verses.textEnEsv: For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord will take me in.
verses.textEnNkjv: When my father and my mother forsake me, Then the Lord will take care of me.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if my father and mother abandon me, the Lord will hold me close.
verses.textEnNasb: For my father and my mother have forsaken me, But the Lord will take me up.
verses.textEn: Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你指示我你的道路； 为我仇敌的缘故引导我走平坦的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你指示我你的道路； 为我仇敌的缘故引导我走平坦的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我， 因我仇敌的缘故引导我走平坦的路。
verses.textEnNiv: Teach me your way, Lord ; lead me in a straight path because of my oppressors.
verses.textEnEsv: Teach me your way, O Lord , and lead me on a level path because of my enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Teach me Your way, O Lord, And lead me in a smooth path, because of my enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach me how to live, O Lord . Lead me along the right path, for my enemies are waiting for me.
verses.textEnNasb: Teach me Your way, Lord, And lead me on a level path Because of my enemies.
verses.textEn: Teach me your way, Lord ; lead me in a straight path because of my oppressors.

verses.textZh: 求你不要照着我敌人的心愿，把我交给他们， 因为有作假见证的人起来攻击我， 并且口出凶暴的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要照着我敌人的心愿，把我交给他们， 因为有作假见证的人起来攻击我， 并且口出凶暴的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你不要把我交给敌人，遂其所愿； 因为妄作见证的和口吐凶言的，起来攻击我。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not turn me over to the desire of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, spouting malicious accusations.
verses.textEnEsv: Give me not up to the will of my adversaries; for false witnesses have risen against me, and they breathe out violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not deliver me to the will of my adversaries; For false witnesses have risen against me, And such as breathe out violence.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not let me fall into their hands. For they accuse me of things I’ve never done; with every breath they threaten me with violence.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not turn me over to the desire of my enemies, For false witnesses have risen against me, And the violent witness.
verses.textEn: Do not turn me over to the desire of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, spouting malicious accusations.

verses.textZh: 我还是相信，在活人之地， 我可以看见耶和华的恩惠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我还是相信，在活人之地， 我可以看见耶和华的恩惠。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若不信在活人之地得见耶和华的恩惠， 就早已丧胆了。
verses.textEnNiv: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.textEnEsv: I believe that I shall look upon the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living!
verses.textEnNkjv: Iwouldhavelostheart, unless I had believed That I would see the goodness of the Lord In the land of the living.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I am confident I will see the Lord ’s goodness while I am here in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNasb: I certainly believed that I would see the goodness of the Lord In the land of the living.
verses.textEn: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.textZh: 你要等候耶和华， 要刚强，要坚定你的心， 要等候耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要等候耶和华， 要刚强，要坚定你的心， 要等候耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 要等候耶和华！ 当壮胆，坚固你的心！ 我再说，要等候耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Wait for the Lord ; be strong and take heart and wait for the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Wait for the Lord ; be strong, and let your heart take courage; wait for the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Wait on the Lord; Be of good courage, And He shall strengthen your heart; Wait, I say, on the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Wait patiently for the Lord . Be brave and courageous. Yes, wait patiently for the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Wait for the Lord; Be strong and let your heart take courage; Yes, wait for the Lord.
verses.textEn: Wait for the Lord ; be strong and take heart and wait for the Lord .

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！我向你呼求； 我的盘石啊！不要不听我； 如果你缄默不理我， 我就跟那些下坑的人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！我向你呼求； 我的盘石啊！不要不听我； 如果你缄默不理我， 我就跟那些下坑的人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我要求告你！ 我的磐石啊，不要向我缄默！ 倘若你向我闭口， 我就如将死的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: To you, Lord , I call; you are my Rock, do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you remain silent, I will be like those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: To you, O Lord , I call; my rock, be not deaf to me, lest, if you be silent to me, I become like those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: To You I will cry, O Lord my Rock: Do not be silent to me, Lest, if You are silent to me, I become like those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnNlt: I pray to you, O Lord , my rock. Do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you are silent, I might as well give up and die.
verses.textEnNasb: To You, Lord, I call; My rock, do not be deaf to me, For if You are silent to me, I will become like those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEn: To you, Lord , I call; you are my Rock, do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you remain silent, I will be like those who go down to the pit.

verses.textZh: 我向你呼求， 向你的至圣所举手祷告的时候， 求你垂听我恳求的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向你呼求， 向你的至圣所举手祷告的时候， 求你垂听我恳求的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 我呼求你，向你至圣所举手的时候， 求你垂听我恳求的声音！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear my cry for mercy as I call to you for help, as I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear the voice of my pleas for mercy, when I cry to you for help, when I lift up my hands toward your most holy sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear the voice of my supplications When I cry to You, When I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to my prayer for mercy as I cry out to you for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: Hear the sound of my pleadings when I cry to You for help, When I raise my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
verses.textEn: Hear my cry for mercy as I call to you for help, as I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

verses.textZh: 求你不要把我和坏人， 跟作恶的人一同除掉； 他们与邻居说平安的话， 心里却存着奸恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要把我和坏人， 跟作恶的人一同除掉； 他们与邻居说平安的话， 心里却存着奸恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要把我和恶人并作孽的一同除掉； 他们与邻舍说和平话，心里却是奸恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not drag me off with the wicked, with the workers of evil, who speak peace with their neighbors while evil is in their hearts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not take me away with the wicked And with the workers of iniquity, Who speak peace to their neighbors, But evil is in their hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not drag me away with the wicked— with those who do evil— those who speak friendly words to their neighbors while planning evil in their hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not drag me away with the wicked And with those who practice injustice, Who speak peace with their neighbors, While evil is in their hearts.
verses.textEn: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.

verses.textZh: 愿你按着他们所作的，照着他们所行的恶报应他们； 愿你照着他们手所作的报应他们， 把他们应得的报应加给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你按着他们所作的，照着他们所行的恶报应他们； 愿你照着他们手所作的报应他们， 把他们应得的报应加给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你按着他们所做的， 并他们所行的恶事待他们。 愿你照着他们手所做的待他们， 将他们所应得的报应加给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back on them what they deserve.
verses.textEnEsv: Give to them according to their work and according to the evil of their deeds; give to them according to the work of their hands; render them their due reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give them according to their deeds, And according to the wickedness of their endeavors; Give them according to the work of their hands; Render to them what they deserve.
verses.textEnNlt: Give them the punishment they so richly deserve! Measure it out in proportion to their wickedness. Pay them back for all their evil deeds! Give them a taste of what they have done to others.
verses.textEnNasb: Give back to them according to their work and according to the evil of their practices; Give back to them according to the work of their hands; Repay them what is due them.
verses.textEn: Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back on them what they deserve.

verses.textZh: 他们既然不关心耶和华的作为，和他手所作的， 耶和华就必拆毁他们，不建立他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们既然不关心耶和华的作为，和他手所作的， 耶和华就必拆毁他们，不建立他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们既然不留心耶和华所行的和他手所做的， 他就必毁坏他们，不建立他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Because they have no regard for the deeds of the Lord and what his hands have done, he will tear them down and never build them up again.
verses.textEnEsv: Because they do not regard the works of the Lord or the work of his hands, he will tear them down and build them up no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because they do not regard the works of the Lord, Nor the operation of His hands, He shall destroy them And not build them up.
verses.textEnNlt: They care nothing for what the Lord has done or for what his hands have made. So he will tear them down, and they will never be rebuilt!
verses.textEnNasb: Because they do not regard the works of the Lord Nor the deeds of His hands, He will tear them down and not build them up.
verses.textEn: Because they have no regard for the deeds of the Lord and what his hands have done, he will tear them down and never build them up again.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为他听了我恳求的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为他听了我恳求的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为他听了我恳求的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord , for he has heard my cry for mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord ! For he has heard the voice of my pleas for mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord, Because He has heard the voice of my supplications!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! For he has heard my cry for mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord, Because He has heard the sound of my pleading.
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord , for he has heard my cry for mercy.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的盾牌； 我的心倚靠他，我就得到帮助； 所以我的心欢乐。 我要用诗歌颂赞他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的盾牌； 我的心倚靠他，我就得到帮助； 所以我的心欢乐。 我要用诗歌颂赞他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的盾牌； 我心里倚靠他就得帮助。 所以我心中欢乐， 我必用诗歌颂赞他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is my strength and my shield; in him my heart trusts, and I am helped; my heart exults, and with my song I give thanks to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis my strength and my shield; My heart trusted in Him, and I am helped; Therefore my heart greatly rejoices, And with my song I will praise Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is my strength and shield. I trust him with all my heart. He helps me, and my heart is filled with joy. I burst out in songs of thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is my strength and my shield; My heart trusts in Him, and I am helped; Therefore my heart triumphs, And with my song I shall thank Him.
verses.textEn: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是他子民的力量， 又是他受膏者得救的保障。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是他子民的力量， 又是他受膏者得救的保障。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是他百姓的力量， 又是他受膏者得救的保障。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is the strength of his people; he is the saving refuge of his anointed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis their strength, And He is the saving refuge of His anointed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gives his people strength. He is a safe fortress for his anointed king.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is their strength, And He is a refuge of salvation to His anointed.
verses.textEn: The Lord is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.

verses.textZh: 求你拯救你的子民， 赐福给你的产业， 牧养他们，怀抱他们，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你拯救你的子民， 赐福给你的产业， 牧养他们，怀抱他们，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你拯救你的百姓，赐福给你的产业， 牧养他们，扶持他们，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, save your people and bless your heritage! Be their shepherd and carry them forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Save Your people, And bless Your inheritance; Shepherd them also, And bear them up forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Save your people! Bless Israel, your special possession. Lead them like a shepherd, and carry them in your arms forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; Be their shepherd also, and carry them forever.
verses.textEn: Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。神的众子啊！要归给耶和华， 你们要把荣耀和能力归给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。神的众子啊！要归给耶和华， 你们要把荣耀和能力归给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的众子啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华， 归给耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Ascribe to the Lord , you heavenly beings, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEnEsv: Ascribe to the Lord , O heavenly beings, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give unto the Lord, O you mighty ones, Give unto the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Honor the Lord , you heavenly beings ; honor the Lord for his glory and strength.
verses.textEnNasb: Ascribe to the Lord, sons of the mighty, Ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEn: Ascribe to the Lord , you heavenly beings, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

verses.textZh: 要把耶和华的名的荣耀归给他， 要以圣洁的装束敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把耶和华的名的荣耀归给他， 要以圣洁的装束敬拜耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 以圣洁的 妆饰敬拜耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.
verses.textEnEsv: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; worship the Lord in the splendor of holiness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due to His name; Worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
verses.textEnNlt: Honor the Lord for the glory of his name. Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.
verses.textEnNasb: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due His name; Worship the Lord in holy attire.
verses.textEn: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的声音在众水之上， 荣耀的神打雷， 耶和华打雷在大水之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的声音在众水之上， 荣耀的神打雷， 耶和华打雷在大水之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的声音发在水上； 荣耀的神打雷， 耶和华打雷在大水之上。
verses.textEnNiv: The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the Lord thunders over the mighty waters.
verses.textEnEsv: The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the Lord , over many waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of the Lordis over the waters; The God of glory thunders; The Lordis over many waters.
verses.textEnNlt: The voice of the Lord echoes above the sea. The God of glory thunders. The Lord thunders over the mighty sea.
verses.textEnNasb: The voice of the Lord is on the waters; The God of glory thunders, The Lord is over many waters.
verses.textEn: The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the Lord thunders over the mighty waters.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的声音大有能力， 耶和华的声音充满威严。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的声音大有能力， 耶和华的声音充满威严。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的声音大有能力； 耶和华的声音满有威严。
verses.textEnNiv: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is majestic.
verses.textEnEsv: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of the Lordis powerful; The voice of the Lordis full of majesty.
verses.textEnNlt: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is majestic.
verses.textEnNasb: The voice of the Lord is powerful, The voice of the Lord is majestic.
verses.textEn: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is majestic.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的声音震断了香柏树， 耶和华震断了黎巴嫩的香柏树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的声音震断了香柏树， 耶和华震断了黎巴嫩的香柏树。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的声音震破香柏树； 耶和华震碎黎巴嫩的香柏树。
verses.textEnNiv: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; the Lord breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEnEsv: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; the Lord breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars, Yes, the Lord splinters the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNlt: The voice of the Lord splits the mighty cedars; the Lord shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; Yes, the Lord breaks the cedars of Lebanon in pieces.
verses.textEn: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; the Lord breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.textZh: 他使黎巴嫩山跳跃像牛犊， 使西连山跳跃像野牛犊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使黎巴嫩山跳跃像牛犊， 使西连山跳跃像野牛犊。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也使之跳跃如牛犊， 使黎巴嫩和西连跳跃如野牛犊。
verses.textEnNiv: He makes Lebanon leap like a calf, Sirion like a young wild ox.
verses.textEnEsv: He makes Lebanon to skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
verses.textEnNkjv: He makes them also skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.
verses.textEnNlt: He makes Lebanon’s mountains skip like a calf; he makes Mount Hermon leap like a young wild ox.
verses.textEnNasb: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, And Sirion like a young wild ox.
verses.textEn: He makes Lebanon leap like a calf, Sirion like a young wild ox.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的声音带着火焰劈下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的声音带着火焰劈下。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的声音使火焰分岔。
verses.textEnNiv: The voice of the Lord strikes with flashes of lightning.
verses.textEnEsv: The voice of the Lord flashes forth flames of fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of the Lord divides the flames of fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The voice of the Lord strikes with bolts of lightning.
verses.textEnNasb: The voice of the Lord divides flames of fire.
verses.textEn: The voice of the Lord strikes with flashes of lightning.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的声音震撼旷野， 耶和华震撼加低斯的旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的声音震撼旷野， 耶和华震撼加低斯的旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的声音震动旷野； 耶和华震动加低斯的旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: The voice of the Lord shakes the desert; the Lord shakes the Desert of Kadesh.
verses.textEnEsv: The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; the Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; The Lord shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.textEnNlt: The voice of the Lord makes the barren wilderness quake; the Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.textEnNasb: The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; The Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.textEn: The voice of the Lord shakes the desert; the Lord shakes the Desert of Kadesh.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的声音惊动母鹿生产， 使林中的树木光秃凋零； 凡是在他殿中的都说："荣耀啊！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的声音惊动母鹿生产， 使林中的树木光秃凋零； 凡是在他殿中的都说："荣耀啊！"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的声音惊动母鹿落胎， 树木也脱落净光。 凡在他殿中的，都称说他的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: The voice of the Lord twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in his temple all cry, "Glory!"
verses.textEnEsv: The voice of the Lord makes the deer give birth and strips the forests bare, and in his temple all cry, "Glory!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of the Lord makes the deer give birth, And strips the forests bare; And in His temple everyone says, "Glory!"
verses.textEnNlt: The voice of the Lord twists mighty oaks and strips the forests bare. In his Temple everyone shouts, "Glory!"
verses.textEnNasb: The voice of the Lord makes the deer give birth And strips the forests bare; And in His temple everything says, "Glory!"
verses.textEn: The voice of the Lord twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in his temple all cry, "Glory!"

verses.textZh: 耶和华坐在洪水之上， 耶和华坐着为王直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华坐在洪水之上， 耶和华坐着为王直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 洪水氾滥之时，耶和华坐着为王； 耶和华坐着为王，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord sits enthroned over the flood; the Lord is enthroned as King forever.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord sits enthroned over the flood; the Lord sits enthroned as king forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord sat enthroned at the Flood, And the Lord sits as King forever.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord rules over the floodwaters. The Lord reigns as king forever.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord sat as King at the flood; Yes, the Lord sits as King forever.
verses.textEn: The Lord sits enthroned over the flood; the Lord is enthroned as King forever.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华赐力量给他的子民， 愿耶和华赐平安的福给他的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华赐力量给他的子民， 愿耶和华赐平安的福给他的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必赐力量给他的百姓； 耶和华必赐平安的福给他的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord give strength to his people! May the Lord bless his people with peace!
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will give strength to His people; The Lord will bless His people with peace.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gives his people strength. The Lord blesses them with peace.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will give strength to His people; The Lord will bless His people with peace.
verses.textEn: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗：献殿之歌。 耶和华啊！我要尊崇你，因为你曾救拔我， 不容我的仇敌向我夸耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗：献殿之歌。 耶和华啊！我要尊崇你，因为你曾救拔我， 不容我的仇敌向我夸耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我要尊崇你， 因为你曾提拔我，不叫仇敌向我夸耀。
verses.textEnNiv: I will exalt you, Lord , for you lifted me out of the depths and did not let my enemies gloat over me.
verses.textEnEsv: I will extol you, O Lord , for you have drawn me up and have not let my foes rejoice over me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will extol You, O Lord, for You have lifted me up, And have not let my foes rejoice over me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will exalt you, Lord , for you rescued me. You refused to let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.textEnNasb: I will exalt You, Lord, for You have lifted me up, And have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
verses.textEn: I will exalt you, Lord , for you lifted me out of the depths and did not let my enemies gloat over me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神啊！ 我曾向你呼求， 你也医治了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神啊！ 我曾向你呼求， 你也医治了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神啊， 我曾呼求你，你医治了我。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord my God, I called to you for help, and you healed me.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord my God, I cried to you for help, and you have healed me.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord my God, I cried out to You, And You healed me.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord my God, I cried to you for help, and you restored my health.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
verses.textEn: Lord my God, I called to you for help, and you healed me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你曾把我从阴间救上来， 使我存活，不至于下坑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你曾把我从阴间救上来， 使我存活，不至于下坑。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你曾把我的灵魂从阴间救上来， 使我存活，不至于下坑。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord , brought me up from the realm of the dead; you spared me from going down to the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , you have brought up my soul from Sheol; you restored me to life from among those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, You brought my soul up from the grave; You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.textEnNlt: You brought me up from the grave, O Lord . You kept me from falling into the pit of death.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, You have brought up my soul from Sheol; You have kept me alive, that I would not go down to the pit.
verses.textEn: You, Lord , brought me up from the realm of the dead; you spared me from going down to the pit.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的圣民哪！你们要歌颂耶和华， 赞美他的圣名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的圣民哪！你们要歌颂耶和华， 赞美他的圣名。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们要歌颂他， 称赞他可记念的圣名。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing the praises of the Lord , you his faithful people; praise his holy name.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing praises to the Lord , O you his saints, and give thanks to his holy name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing praise to the Lord, you saints of His, And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing to the Lord , all you godly ones! Praise his holy name.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing praise to the Lord, you His godly ones, And praise the mention of His holiness.
verses.textEn: Sing the praises of the Lord , you his faithful people; praise his holy name.

verses.textZh: 因为他的怒气只是短暂的， 他的恩惠却是一生一世的； 夜间虽然不断有哭泣， 早晨却必欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他的怒气只是短暂的， 他的恩惠却是一生一世的； 夜间虽然不断有哭泣， 早晨却必欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，他的怒气不过是转眼之间； 他的恩典乃是一生之久。 一宿虽然有哭泣， 早晨便必欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verses.textEnEsv: For his anger is but for a moment, and his favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may tarry for the night, but joy comes with the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: For His anger isbutfor a moment, His favor isfor life; Weeping may endure for a night, But joy comes in the morning.
verses.textEnNlt: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime! Weeping may last through the night, but joy comes with the morning.
verses.textEnNasb: For His anger is but for a moment, His favor is for a lifetime; Weeping may last for the night, But a shout of joy comes in the morning.
verses.textEn: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我在安稳的时候曾说： "我必永不动摇。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我在安稳的时候曾说： "我必永不动摇。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我凡事平顺，便说： 我永不动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: When I felt secure, I said, "I will never be shaken."
verses.textEnEsv: As for me, I said in my prosperity, "I shall never be moved."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in my prosperity I said, "I shall never be moved."
verses.textEnNlt: When I was prosperous, I said, "Nothing can stop me now!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for me, I said in my prosperity, "I will never be moved."
verses.textEn: When I felt secure, I said, "I will never be shaken."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的恩宠，使我坚立，如同大山； 你一掩面，我就惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的恩宠，使我坚立，如同大山； 你一掩面，我就惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你曾施恩，叫我的江山稳固； 你掩了面，我就惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , when you favored me, you made my royal mountain stand firm; but when you hid your face, I was dismayed.
verses.textEnEsv: By your favor, O Lord , you made my mountain stand strong; you hid your face; I was dismayed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, by Your favor You have made my mountain stand strong; You hid Your face, and I was troubled.
verses.textEnNlt: Your favor, O Lord , made me as secure as a mountain. Then you turned away from me, and I was shattered.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, by Your favor You have made my mountain to stand strong; You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
verses.textEn: Lord , when you favored me, you made my royal mountain stand firm; but when you hid your face, I was dismayed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我曾向你呼求； 我曾向我主恳求，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我曾向你呼求； 我曾向我主恳求，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我曾求告你； 我向耶和华恳求，说：
verses.textEnNiv: To you, Lord , I called; to the Lord I cried for mercy:
verses.textEnEsv: To you, O Lord , I cry, and to the Lord I plead for mercy:
verses.textEnNkjv: I cried out to You, O Lord; And to the Lord I made supplication:
verses.textEnNlt: I cried out to you, O Lord . I begged the Lord for mercy, saying,
verses.textEnNasb: To You, Lord, I called, And to the Lord I pleaded for compassion:
verses.textEn: To you, Lord , I called; to the Lord I cried for mercy:

verses.textZh: "我被害流血，下到深坑，有甚么益处呢？ 尘土还能称赞你，还能传扬你的信实吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "我被害流血，下到深坑，有甚么益处呢？ 尘土还能称赞你，还能传扬你的信实吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有什么益处呢？ 尘土岂能称赞你，传说你的诚实吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "What is gained if I am silenced, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your faithfulness?
verses.textEnEsv: "What profit is there in my death, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it tell of your faithfulness?
verses.textEnNkjv: "What profit isthere in my blood, When I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it declare Your truth?
verses.textEnNlt: "What will you gain if I die, if I sink into the grave? Can my dust praise you? Can it tell of your faithfulness?
verses.textEnNasb: "What gain is there in my blood, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it declare Your faithfulness?
verses.textEn: "What is gained if I am silenced, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your faithfulness?

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你垂听，恩待我； 耶和华啊！求你帮助我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你垂听，恩待我； 耶和华啊！求你帮助我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，怜恤我！ 耶和华啊，求你帮助我！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear, Lord , and be merciful to me; Lord , be my help."
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, O Lord , and be merciful to me! O Lord , be my helper!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy on me; Lord, be my helper!"
verses.textEnNlt: Hear me, Lord , and have mercy on me. Help me, O Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear, Lord, and be gracious to me; Lord, be my helper."
verses.textEn: Hear, Lord , and be merciful to me; Lord , be my help."

verses.textZh: 你已经把我的悲哀变为舞蹈， 把我的麻衣脱去，又给我穿上欢乐；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你已经把我的悲哀变为舞蹈， 把我的麻衣脱去，又给我穿上欢乐；
verses.textZhCuv: 你已将我的哀哭变为跳舞， 将我的麻衣脱去，给我披上喜乐，
verses.textEnNiv: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
verses.textEnEsv: You have turned for me my mourning into dancing; you have loosed my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness,
verses.textEnNkjv: You have turned for me my mourning into dancing; You have put off my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness,
verses.textEnNlt: You have turned my mourning into joyful dancing. You have taken away my clothes of mourning and clothed me with joy,
verses.textEnNasb: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me; You have untied my sackcloth and encircled me with joy,
verses.textEn: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

verses.textZh: 好让我的灵 歌颂你，永不停止。 耶和华我的神啊！我要永远称赞你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好让我的灵 歌颂你，永不停止。 耶和华我的神啊！我要永远称赞你。
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫我的灵 歌颂你，并不住声。 耶和华－我的神啊，我要称谢你，直到永远！
verses.textEnNiv: that my heart may sing your praises and not be silent. Lord my God, I will praise you forever.
verses.textEnEsv: that my glory may sing your praise and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: To the end that my glory may sing praise to You and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to You forever.
verses.textEnNlt: that I might sing praises to you and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give you thanks forever!
verses.textEnNasb: That my soul may sing praise to You and not be silent. Lord my God, I will give thanks to You forever.
verses.textEn: that my heart may sing your praises and not be silent. Lord my God, I will praise you forever.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 耶和华啊！我投靠你； 求你使我永不羞愧， 求你按着你的公义搭救我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 耶和华啊！我投靠你； 求你使我永不羞愧， 求你按着你的公义搭救我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我投靠你； 求你使我永不羞愧； 凭你的公义搭救我！
verses.textEnNiv: In you, Lord , I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: In you, O Lord , do I take refuge; let me never be put to shame; in your righteousness deliver me!
verses.textEnNkjv: In You, O Lord, I put my trust; Let me never be ashamed; Deliver me in Your righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , I have come to you for protection; don’t let me be disgraced. Save me, for you do what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: In You, Lord, I have taken refuge; Let me never be put to shame; In Your righteousness rescue me.
verses.textEn: In you, Lord , I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness.

verses.textZh: 求你留心听我，赶快拯救我； 求你作我坚固的盘石， 作拯救我的坚垒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你留心听我，赶快拯救我； 求你作我坚固的盘石， 作拯救我的坚垒。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你侧耳而听， 快快救我！ 作我坚固的磐石， 拯救我的保障！
verses.textEnNiv: Turn your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me.
verses.textEnEsv: Incline your ear to me; rescue me speedily! Be a rock of refuge for me, a strong fortress to save me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Bow down Your ear to me, Deliver me speedily; Be my rock of refuge, A fortress of defense to save me.
verses.textEnNlt: Turn your ear to listen to me; rescue me quickly. Be my rock of protection, a fortress where I will be safe.
verses.textEnNasb: Incline Your ear to me, rescue me quickly; Be a rock of strength for me, A stronghold to save me.
verses.textEn: Turn your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me.

verses.textZh: 因为你是我的岩石、我的坚垒； 为你名的缘故，求你带领我，引导我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你是我的岩石、我的坚垒； 为你名的缘故，求你带领我，引导我。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨； 所以，求你为你名的缘故引导我，指点我。
verses.textEnNiv: Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me.
verses.textEnEsv: For you are my rock and my fortress; and for your name’s sake you lead me and guide me;
verses.textEnNkjv: For You are my rock and my fortress; Therefore, for Your name’s sake, Lead me and guide me.
verses.textEnNlt: You are my rock and my fortress. For the honor of your name, lead me out of this danger.
verses.textEnNasb: For You are my rock and my fortress; For the sake of Your name You will lead me and guide me.
verses.textEn: Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me.

verses.textZh: 求你救我脱离人为我暗设的网罗， 因为你是我的避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你救我脱离人为我暗设的网罗， 因为你是我的避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你救我脱离人为我暗设的网罗， 因为你是我的保障。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep me free from the trap that is set for me, for you are my refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: you take me out of the net they have hidden for me, for you are my refuge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pull me out of the net which they have secretly laid for me, For You are my strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Pull me from the trap my enemies set for me, for I find protection in you alone.
verses.textEnNasb: You will pull me out of the net which they have secretly laid for me, For You are my strength.
verses.textEn: Keep me free from the trap that is set for me, for you are my refuge.

verses.textZh: 我把我的灵魂交在你手里， 耶和华信实的神啊！你救赎了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把我的灵魂交在你手里， 耶和华信实的神啊！你救赎了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将我的灵魂交在你手里； 耶和华诚实的神啊，你救赎了我。
verses.textEnNiv: Into your hands I commit my spirit; deliver me, Lord , my faithful God.
verses.textEnEsv: Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, O Lord , faithful God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Into Your hand I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.
