verses.textEnNlt: I entrust my spirit into your hand. Rescue me, Lord , for you are a faithful God.
verses.textEnNasb: Into Your hand I entrust my spirit; You have redeemed me, Lord, God of truth.
verses.textEn: Into your hands I commit my spirit; deliver me, Lord , my faithful God.

verses.textZh: 我恨恶那些信奉虚无偶像的人； 至于我，我却倚靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我恨恶那些信奉虚无偶像的人； 至于我，我却倚靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我恨恶那信奉虚无之神的人； 我却倚靠耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I hate those who cling to worthless idols; as for me, I trust in the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I hate those who pay regard to worthless idols, but I trust in the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I have hated those who regard useless idols; But I trust in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I hate those who worship worthless idols. I trust in the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: I hate those who devote themselves to worthless idols, But I trust in the Lord.
verses.textEn: I hate those who cling to worthless idols; as for me, I trust in the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我要因你的慈爱欢喜快乐， 因为你看见了我的困苦， 知道我心中的痛苦；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要因你的慈爱欢喜快乐， 因为你看见了我的困苦， 知道我心中的痛苦；
verses.textZhCuv: 我要为你的慈爱高兴欢喜； 因为你见过我的困苦，知道我心中的艰难。
verses.textEnNiv: I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction and knew the anguish of my soul.
verses.textEnEsv: I will rejoice and be glad in your steadfast love, because you have seen my affliction; you have known the distress of my soul,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will be glad and rejoice in Your mercy, For You have considered my trouble; You have known my soul in adversities,
verses.textEnNlt: I will be glad and rejoice in your unfailing love, for you have seen my troubles, and you care about the anguish of my soul.
verses.textEnNasb: I will rejoice and be glad in Your faithfulness, Because You have seen my misery; You have known the troubles of my soul,
verses.textEn: I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction and knew the anguish of my soul.

verses.textZh: 你没有把我交在仇敌的手里， 你使我的脚站稳在宽阔之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你没有把我交在仇敌的手里， 你使我的脚站稳在宽阔之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你未曾把我交在仇敌手里； 你使我的脚站在宽阔之处。
verses.textEnNiv: You have not given me into the hands of the enemy but have set my feet in a spacious place.
verses.textEnEsv: and you have not delivered me into the hand of the enemy; you have set my feet in a broad place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; You have set my feet in a wide place.
verses.textEnNlt: You have not handed me over to my enemies but have set me in a safe place.
verses.textEnNasb: And You have not handed me over to the enemy; You have set my feet in a large place.
verses.textEn: You have not given me into the hands of the enemy but have set my feet in a spacious place.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你恩待我，因为我在患难之中； 我的眼睛因愁烦昏花， 我的身、我的心也都衰残。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你恩待我，因为我在患难之中； 我的眼睛因愁烦昏花， 我的身、我的心也都衰残。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我， 因为我在急难之中； 我的眼睛因忧愁而干瘪， 连我的身心也不安舒。
verses.textEnNiv: Be merciful to me, Lord , for I am in distress; my eyes grow weak with sorrow, my soul and body with grief.
verses.textEnEsv: Be gracious to me, O Lord , for I am in distress; my eye is wasted from grief; my soul and my body also.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am in trouble; My eye wastes away with grief, Yes, my soul and my body!
verses.textEnNlt: Have mercy on me, Lord , for I am in distress. Tears blur my eyes. My body and soul are withering away.
verses.textEnNasb: Be gracious to me, Lord, for I am in distress; My eye is wasted away from grief, my soul and my body too.
verses.textEn: Be merciful to me, Lord , for I am in distress; my eyes grow weak with sorrow, my soul and body with grief.

verses.textZh: 我的生命因愁苦耗尽， 我的岁月在叹息中消逝， 我的力量因罪孽衰退， 我的骨头也枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的生命因愁苦耗尽， 我的岁月在叹息中消逝， 我的力量因罪孽衰退， 我的骨头也枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的生命为愁苦所消耗； 我的年岁为叹息所旷废。 我的力量因我的罪孽衰败； 我的骨头也枯干。
verses.textEnNiv: My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones grow weak.
verses.textEnEsv: For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with sighing; my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones waste away.
verses.textEnNkjv: For my life is spent with grief, And my years with sighing; My strength fails because of my iniquity, And my bones waste away.
verses.textEnNlt: I am dying from grief; my years are shortened by sadness. Sin has drained my strength; I am wasting away from within.
verses.textEnNasb: For my life is spent with sorrow And my years with sighing; My strength has failed because of my guilt, And my body has wasted away.
verses.textEn: My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones grow weak.

verses.textZh: 我因众仇敌的缘故，成了众人羞辱的对象， 在我的邻居面前更是这样； 认识我的人都惧怕我； 在街上看见我的，都避开我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因众仇敌的缘故，成了众人羞辱的对象， 在我的邻居面前更是这样； 认识我的人都惧怕我； 在街上看见我的，都避开我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因一切敌人成了羞辱， 在我的邻舍跟前更甚； 那认识我的都惧怕我， 在外头看见我的都躲避我。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of all my enemies, I am the utter contempt of my neighbors and an object of dread to my closest friends— those who see me on the street flee from me.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of all my adversaries I have become a reproach, especially to my neighbors, and an object of dread to my acquaintances; those who see me in the street flee from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am a reproach among all my enemies, But especially among my neighbors, And am repulsive to my acquaintances; Those who see me outside flee from me.
verses.textEnNlt: I am scorned by all my enemies and despised by my neighbors— even my friends are afraid to come near me. When they see me on the street, they run the other way.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of all my adversaries, I have become a disgrace, Especially to my neighbors, And an object of dread to my acquaintances; Those who see me in the street flee from me.
verses.textEn: Because of all my enemies, I am the utter contempt of my neighbors and an object of dread to my closest friends— those who see me on the street flee from me.

verses.textZh: 我被人完全忘记，如同死了的人， 我好象破碎的器皿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我被人完全忘记，如同死了的人， 我好象破碎的器皿，
verses.textZhCuv: 我被人忘记，如同死人，无人记念； 我好像破碎的器皿。
verses.textEnNiv: I am forgotten as though I were dead; I have become like broken pottery.
verses.textEnEsv: I have been forgotten like one who is dead; I have become like a broken vessel.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind; I am like a broken vessel.
verses.textEnNlt: I am ignored as if I were dead, as if I were a broken pot.
verses.textEnNasb: I am forgotten like a dead person, out of mind; I am like a broken vessel.
verses.textEn: I am forgotten as though I were dead; I have become like broken pottery.

verses.textZh: 我听见许多人的毁谤， 四周都有惊吓； 他们一同商议攻击我， 图谋要取我的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见许多人的毁谤， 四周都有惊吓； 他们一同商议攻击我， 图谋要取我的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见了许多人的谗谤， 四围都是惊吓； 他们一同商议攻击我的时候， 就图谋要害我的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: For I hear many whispering, "Terror on every side!" They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
verses.textEnEsv: For I hear the whispering of many— terror on every side!— as they scheme together against me, as they plot to take my life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I hear the slander of many; Fear is on every side; While they take counsel together against me, They scheme to take away my life.
verses.textEnNlt: I have heard the many rumors about me, and I am surrounded by terror. My enemies conspire against me, plotting to take my life.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have heard the slander of many, Terror is on every side; While they took counsel together against me, They schemed to take away my life.
verses.textEn: For I hear many whispering, "Terror on every side!" They conspire against me and plot to take my life.

verses.textZh: 但是，耶和华啊！我还是倚靠你； 我说："你是我的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，耶和华啊！我还是倚靠你； 我说："你是我的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我仍旧倚靠你； 我说：你是我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: But I trust in you, Lord ; I say, "You are my God."
verses.textEnEsv: But I trust in you, O Lord ; I say, "You are my God."
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for me, I trust in You, O Lord; I say, "You are my God."
verses.textEnNlt: But I am trusting you, O Lord , saying, "You are my God!"
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, I trust in You, Lord, I say, "You are my God."
verses.textEn: But I trust in you, Lord ; I say, "You are my God."

verses.textZh: 我的一生都在你的手中； 求你救我脱离我仇敌的手，和那些迫害我的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的一生都在你的手中； 求你救我脱离我仇敌的手，和那些迫害我的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我终身的事在你手中； 求你救我脱离仇敌的手和那些逼迫我的人。
verses.textEnNiv: My times are in your hands; deliver me from the hands of my enemies, from those who pursue me.
verses.textEnEsv: My times are in your hand; rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from my persecutors!
verses.textEnNkjv: My times are in Your hand; Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, And from those who persecute me.
verses.textEnNlt: My future is in your hands. Rescue me from those who hunt me down relentlessly.
verses.textEnNasb: My times are in Your hand; Rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those who persecute me.
verses.textEn: My times are in your hands; deliver me from the hands of my enemies, from those who pursue me.

verses.textZh: 求你用你的脸光照你的仆人， 以你的慈爱拯救我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你用你的脸光照你的仆人， 以你的慈爱拯救我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使你的脸光照仆人， 凭你的慈爱拯救我。
verses.textEnNiv: Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your unfailing love.
verses.textEnEsv: Make your face shine on your servant; save me in your steadfast love!
verses.textEnNkjv: Make Your face shine upon Your servant; Save me for Your mercies’ sake.
verses.textEnNlt: Let your favor shine on your servant. In your unfailing love, rescue me.
verses.textEnNasb: Make Your face shine upon Your servant; Save me in Your faithfulness.
verses.textEn: Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your unfailing love.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你不要使我羞愧， 因为我向你呼求； 求你使恶人羞愧，使他们在阴间静寂无声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你不要使我羞愧， 因为我向你呼求； 求你使恶人羞愧，使他们在阴间静寂无声。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你叫我不致羞愧， 因为我曾呼吁你； 求你使恶人羞愧， 使他们在阴间缄默无声。
verses.textEnNiv: Let me not be put to shame, Lord , for I have cried out to you; but let the wicked be put to shame and be silent in the realm of the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , let me not be put to shame, for I call upon you; let the wicked be put to shame; let them go silently to Sheol.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not let me be ashamed, O Lord, for I have called upon You; Let the wicked be ashamed; Let them be silent in the grave.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let me be disgraced, O Lord , for I call out to you for help. Let the wicked be disgraced; let them lie silent in the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: Let me not be put to shame, Lord, for I call upon You; Let the wicked be put to shame, let them be silent in Sheol.
verses.textEn: Let me not be put to shame, Lord , for I have cried out to you; but let the wicked be put to shame and be silent in the realm of the dead.

verses.textZh: 那些逞骄傲，态度轻慢， 说话狂傲攻击义人的， 愿他们说谎的嘴唇哑而无声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些逞骄傲，态度轻慢， 说话狂傲攻击义人的， 愿他们说谎的嘴唇哑而无声。
verses.textZhCuv: 那撒谎的人逞骄傲轻慢， 出狂妄的话攻击义人； 愿他的嘴哑而无言。
verses.textEnNiv: Let their lying lips be silenced, for with pride and contempt they speak arrogantly against the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak insolently against the righteous in pride and contempt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the lying lips be put to silence, Which speak insolent things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: Silence their lying lips— those proud and arrogant lips that accuse the godly.
verses.textEnNasb: Let the lying lips be speechless, Which speak arrogantly against the righteous With pride and contempt.
verses.textEn: Let their lying lips be silenced, for with pride and contempt they speak arrogantly against the righteous.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你为敬畏你的人所珍藏的好处， 为投靠你的人在世人面前所施行的恩惠， 是多么丰盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你为敬畏你的人所珍藏的好处， 为投靠你的人在世人面前所施行的恩惠， 是多么丰盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏你、投靠你的人，你为他们所积存的， 在世人面前所施行的恩惠是何等大呢！
verses.textEnNiv: How abundant are the good things that you have stored up for those who fear you, that you bestow in the sight of all, on those who take refuge in you.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, how abundant is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you and worked for those who take refuge in you, in the sight of the children of mankind!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, how great is Your goodness, Which You have laid up for those who fear You, Which You have prepared for those who trust in You In the presence of the sons of men!
verses.textEnNlt: How great is the goodness you have stored up for those who fear you. You lavish it on those who come to you for protection, blessing them before the watching world.
verses.textEnNasb: How great is Your goodness, Which You have stored up for those who fear You, Which You have performed for those who take refuge in You, Before the sons of mankind!
verses.textEn: How abundant are the good things that you have stored up for those who fear you, that you bestow in the sight of all, on those who take refuge in you.

verses.textZh: 你把他们藏在你面前的隐密处， 免得他们陷在世人的阴谋里； 又把他们保护在帐棚内，以免落在口舌的争竞中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把他们藏在你面前的隐密处， 免得他们陷在世人的阴谋里； 又把他们保护在帐棚内，以免落在口舌的争竞中。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必把他们藏在你面前的隐密处， 免得遇见人的计谋； 你必暗暗地保守他们在亭子里， 免受口舌的争闹。
verses.textEnNiv: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from all human intrigues; you keep them safe in your dwelling from accusing tongues.
verses.textEnEsv: In the cover of your presence you hide them from the plots of men; you store them in your shelter from the strife of tongues.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall hide them in the secret place of Your presence From the plots of man; You shall keep them secretly in a pavilion From the strife of tongues.
verses.textEnNlt: You hide them in the shelter of your presence, safe from those who conspire against them. You shelter them in your presence, far from accusing tongues.
verses.textEnNasb: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the conspiracies of mankind; You keep them secretly in a shelter from the strife of tongues.
verses.textEn: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from all human intrigues; you keep them safe in your dwelling from accusing tongues.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为我在被围困的城里， 他就向我显出他奇妙的慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为我在被围困的城里， 他就向我显出他奇妙的慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 因为他在坚固城里向我施展奇妙的慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord , for he showed me the wonders of his love when I was in a city under siege.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord , for he has wondrously shown his steadfast love to me when I was in a besieged city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord, For He has shown me His marvelous kindness in a strong city!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , for he has shown me the wonders of his unfailing love. He kept me safe when my city was under attack.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord, For He has shown His marvelous faithfulness to me in a besieged city.
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord , for he showed me the wonders of his love when I was in a city under siege.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我曾在惊恐中说： "我从你眼前被隔绝"； 可是我向你呼求的时候， 你还是垂听了我恳求的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我曾在惊恐中说： "我从你眼前被隔绝"； 可是我向你呼求的时候， 你还是垂听了我恳求的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我曾急促地说： 我从你眼前被隔绝。 然而，我呼求你的时候， 你仍听我恳求的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: In my alarm I said, "I am cut off from your sight!" Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.
verses.textEnEsv: I had said in my alarm, "I am cut off from your sight." But you heard the voice of my pleas for mercy when I cried to you for help.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I said in my haste, "I am cut off from before Your eyes"; Nevertheless You heard the voice of my supplications When I cried out to You.
verses.textEnNlt: In panic I cried out, "I am cut off from the Lord !" But you heard my cry for mercy and answered my call for help.
verses.textEnNasb: As for me, I said in my alarm, "I am cut off from Your eyes"; Nevertheless You heard the sound of my pleadings When I called to You for help.
verses.textEn: In my alarm I said, "I am cut off from your sight!" Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的众圣民哪！你们都要爱耶和华； 耶和华保护诚实的人， 却严厉地报应行事骄傲的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的众圣民哪！你们都要爱耶和华； 耶和华保护诚实的人， 却严厉地报应行事骄傲的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们都要爱他！ 耶和华保护诚实人， 足足报应行事骄傲的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Love the Lord , all his faithful people! The Lord preserves those who are true to him, but the proud he pays back in full.
verses.textEnEsv: Love the Lord , all you his saints! The Lord preserves the faithful but abundantly repays the one who acts in pride.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, love the Lord, all you His saints! For the Lord preserves the faithful, And fully repays the proud person.
verses.textEnNlt: Love the Lord , all you godly ones! For the Lord protects those who are loyal to him, but he harshly punishes the arrogant.
verses.textEnNasb: Love the Lord, all His godly ones! The Lord watches over the faithful But fully repays the one who acts arrogantly.
verses.textEn: Love the Lord , all his faithful people! The Lord preserves those who are true to him, but the proud he pays back in full.

verses.textZh: 所有仰望耶和华的人， 你们都要刚强，坚固你们的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有仰望耶和华的人， 你们都要刚强，坚固你们的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡仰望耶和华的人， 你们都要壮胆，坚固你们的心！
verses.textEnNiv: Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who wait for the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Be of good courage, And He shall strengthen your heart, All you who hope in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So be strong and courageous, all you who put your hope in the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Be strong and let your heart take courage, All you who wait for the Lord.
verses.textEn: Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the Lord .

verses.textZh: 大卫的训诲诗。 过犯得蒙赦免， 罪恶得到遮盖的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的训诲诗。 过犯得蒙赦免， 罪恶得到遮盖的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 得赦免其过、遮盖其罪的， 这人是有福的！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the one whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed ishewhose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, what joy for those whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is put out of sight!
verses.textEnNasb: How blessed is he whose wrongdoing is forgiven, Whose sin is covered!
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

verses.textZh: 心里没有诡诈， 耶和华不算为有罪的，这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心里没有诡诈， 耶和华不算为有罪的，这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡心里没有诡诈、耶和华不算为有罪的， 这人是有福的！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one whose sin the Lord does not count against them and in whose spirit is no deceit.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the man against whom the Lord counts no iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord does not impute iniquity, And in whose spirit thereis no deceit.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, what joy for those whose record the Lord has cleared of guilt, whose lives are lived in complete honesty!
verses.textEnNasb: How blessed is a person whose guilt the Lord does not take into account, And in whose spirit there is no deceit!
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one whose sin the Lord does not count against them and in whose spirit is no deceit.

verses.textZh: 我闭口不认罪的时候， 就整天唉哼，以致骨头衰残。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我闭口不认罪的时候， 就整天唉哼，以致骨头衰残。
verses.textZhCuv: 我闭口不认罪的时候， 因终日唉哼而骨头枯干。
verses.textEnNiv: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: For when I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I kept silent, my bones grew old Through my groaning all the day long.
verses.textEnNlt: When I refused to confess my sin, my body wasted away, and I groaned all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: When I kept silent about my sin, my body wasted away Through my groaning all day long.
verses.textEn: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

verses.textZh: 因为你的手昼夜重压在我身上， 我的精力耗尽，好象盛暑的干旱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你的手昼夜重压在我身上， 我的精力耗尽，好象盛暑的干旱。
verses.textZhCuv: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重； 我的精液耗尽，如同夏天的干旱。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: For day and night your hand was heavy on me; my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer.
verses.textEnEsv: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was dried up as by the heat of summer. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; My vitality was turned into the drought of summer. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Day and night your hand of discipline was heavy on me. My strength evaporated like water in the summer heat. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; My vitality failed as with the dry heat of summer. Selah
verses.textEn: For day and night your hand was heavy on me; my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer.

verses.textZh: 我向你承认我的罪， 没有隐藏我的罪孽； 我说："我要向耶和华承认我的过犯"； 你就赦免我的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向你承认我的罪， 没有隐藏我的罪孽； 我说："我要向耶和华承认我的过犯"； 你就赦免我的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我向你陈明我的罪， 不隐瞒我的恶。 我说：我要向耶和华承认我的过犯， 你就赦免我的罪恶。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Then I acknowledged my sin to you and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the Lord ." And you forgave the guilt of my sin.
verses.textEnEsv: I acknowledged my sin to you, and I did not cover my iniquity; I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the Lord ," and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: I acknowledged my sin to You, And my iniquity I have not hidden. I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the Lord," And You forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, I confessed all my sins to you and stopped trying to hide my guilt. I said to myself, "I will confess my rebellion to the Lord ." And you forgave me! All my guilt is gone. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: I acknowledged my sin to You, And I did not hide my guilt; I said, "I will confess my wrongdoings to the Lord"; And You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
verses.textEn: Then I acknowledged my sin to you and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the Lord ." And you forgave the guilt of my sin.

verses.textZh: 因此，凡是敬虔的人，都当趁你可寻找的时候，向你祷告； 大水泛滥的时候，必不能达到他那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，凡是敬虔的人，都当趁你可寻找的时候，向你祷告； 大水泛滥的时候，必不能达到他那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 为此，凡虔诚人都当趁你可寻找的时候祷告你； 大水氾溢的时候，必不能到他那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore let all the faithful pray to you while you may be found; surely the rising of the mighty waters will not reach them.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let everyone who is godly offer prayer to you at a time when you may be found; surely in the rush of great waters, they shall not reach him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this cause everyone who is godly shall pray to You In a time when You may be found; Surely in a flood of great waters They shall not come near him.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, let all the godly pray to you while there is still time, that they may not drown in the floodwaters of judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, let everyone who is godly pray to You in a time when You may be found; Certainly in a flood of great waters, they will not reach him.
verses.textEn: Therefore let all the faithful pray to you while you may be found; surely the rising of the mighty waters will not reach them.

verses.textZh: 你是我藏身之处， 你必保护我脱离患难， 以得救的欢呼四面环绕我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是我藏身之处， 你必保护我脱离患难， 以得救的欢呼四面环绕我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是我藏身之处； 你必保佑我脱离苦难， 以得救的乐歌四面环绕我。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.
verses.textEnEsv: You are a hiding place for me; you preserve me from trouble; you surround me with shouts of deliverance. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: You are my hiding place; You shall preserve me from trouble; You shall surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: For you are my hiding place; you protect me from trouble. You surround me with songs of victory. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: You are my hiding place; You keep me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
verses.textEn: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.

verses.textZh: 我要教导你，指示你应走的路； 我要劝戒你，我的眼睛看顾你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要教导你，指示你应走的路； 我要劝戒你，我的眼睛看顾你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要教导你，指示你当行的路； 我要定睛在你身上劝戒你。
verses.textEnNiv: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my eye upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will guide you with My eye.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "I will guide you along the best pathway for your life. I will advise you and watch over you.
verses.textEnNasb: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you should go; I will advise you with My eye upon you.
verses.textEn: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.

verses.textZh: 你不可像无知的骡马， 如果不用嚼环辔头勒住牠们， 牠们就不肯走近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不可像无知的骡马， 如果不用嚼环辔头勒住牠们， 牠们就不肯走近。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不可像那无知的骡马， 必用嚼环辔头勒住它； 不然，就不能驯服。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle or they will not come to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Be not like a horse or a mule, without understanding, which must be curbed with bit and bridle, or it will not stay near you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be like the horse or like the mule, Which have no understanding, Which must be harnessed with bit and bridle, Else they will not come near you.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not be like a senseless horse or mule that needs a bit and bridle to keep it under control."
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be like the horse or like the mule, which have no understanding, Whose trappings include bit and bridle to hold them in check, Otherwise they will not come near to you.
verses.textEn: Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle or they will not come to you.

verses.textZh: 恶人必受许多痛苦； 但倚靠耶和华的，必有慈爱四面环绕他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人必受许多痛苦； 但倚靠耶和华的，必有慈爱四面环绕他。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人必多受苦楚； 惟独倚靠耶和华的必有慈爱四面环绕他。
verses.textEnNiv: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the Lord ’s unfailing love surrounds the one who trusts in him.
verses.textEnEsv: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but steadfast love surrounds the one who trusts in the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Many sorrows shallbe to the wicked; But he who trusts in the Lord, mercy shall surround him.
verses.textEnNlt: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but unfailing love surrounds those who trust the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The sorrows of the wicked are many, But the one who trusts in the Lord, goodness will surround him.
verses.textEn: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the Lord ’s unfailing love surrounds the one who trusts in him.

verses.textZh: 义人哪！你们要靠着耶和华欢喜快乐； 所有心里正直的人哪！你们都要欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人哪！你们要靠着耶和华欢喜快乐； 所有心里正直的人哪！你们都要欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们义人应当靠耶和华欢喜快乐； 你们心里正直的人都当欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: Rejoice in the Lord and be glad, you righteous; sing, all you who are upright in heart!
verses.textEnEsv: Be glad in the Lord , and rejoice, O righteous, and shout for joy, all you upright in heart!
verses.textEnNkjv: Be glad in the Lord and rejoice, you righteous; And shout for joy, all you upright in heart!
verses.textEnNlt: So rejoice in the Lord and be glad, all you who obey him! Shout for joy, all you whose hearts are pure!
verses.textEnNasb: Be glad in the Lord and rejoice, you righteous ones; And shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart.
verses.textEn: Rejoice in the Lord and be glad, you righteous; sing, all you who are upright in heart!

verses.textZh: 义人哪！你们要靠着耶和华欢呼； 正直人赞美主是合宜的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人哪！你们要靠着耶和华欢呼； 正直人赞美主是合宜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人哪，你们应当靠耶和华欢乐； 正直人的赞美是合宜的。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing joyfully to the Lord , you righteous; it is fitting for the upright to praise him.
verses.textEnEsv: Shout for joy in the Lord , O you righteous! Praise befits the upright.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous! For praise from the upright is beautiful.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the godly sing for joy to the Lord ; it is fitting for the pure to praise him.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing for joy in the Lord, you righteous ones; Praise is becoming to the upright.
verses.textEn: Sing joyfully to the Lord , you righteous; it is fitting for the upright to praise him.

verses.textZh: 你们要弹琴称谢耶和华， 用十弦瑟歌颂他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要弹琴称谢耶和华， 用十弦瑟歌颂他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们应当弹琴称谢耶和华， 用十弦瑟歌颂他。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord with the harp; make music to him on the ten-stringed lyre.
verses.textEnEsv: Give thanks to the Lord with the lyre; make melody to him with the harp of ten strings!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord with the harp; Make melody to Him with an instrument of ten strings.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord with melodies on the lyre; make music for him on the ten-stringed harp.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the Lord with the lyre; Sing praises to Him with a harp of ten strings.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord with the harp; make music to him on the ten-stringed lyre.

verses.textZh: 你们要向他唱新歌， 在欢呼声中巧妙地弹奏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要向他唱新歌， 在欢呼声中巧妙地弹奏。
verses.textZhCuv: 应当向他唱新歌， 弹得巧妙，声音洪亮。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully, and shout for joy.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully on the strings, with loud shouts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to Him a new song; Play skillfully with a shout of joy.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing a new song of praise to him; play skillfully on the harp, and sing with joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to Him a new song; Play skillfully with a shout of joy.
verses.textEn: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully, and shout for joy.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华的话是正直的， 他的一切作为都是诚实的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华的话是正直的， 他的一切作为都是诚实的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华的言语正直； 凡他所做的尽都诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: For the word of the Lord is right and true; he is faithful in all he does.
verses.textEnEsv: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all his work is done in faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the word of the Lordis right, And all His work isdone in truth.
verses.textEnNlt: For the word of the Lord holds true, and we can trust everything he does.
verses.textEnNasb: For the word of the Lord is right, And all His work is done in faithfulness.
verses.textEn: For the word of the Lord is right and true; he is faithful in all he does.

verses.textZh: 耶和华喜爱公义和公正， 全地充满耶和华的慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华喜爱公义和公正， 全地充满耶和华的慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他喜爱仁义公平； 遍地满了耶和华的慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of his unfailing love.
verses.textEnEsv: He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the steadfast love of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He loves righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He loves whatever is just and good; the unfailing love of the Lord fills the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: He loves righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Lord loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of his unfailing love.

verses.textZh: 诸天借着耶和华的话而造， 天上的万象借着他口中的气而成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诸天借着耶和华的话而造， 天上的万象借着他口中的气而成。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸天藉耶和华的命而造； 万象藉他口中的气而成。
verses.textEnNiv: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, their starry host by the breath of his mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all their host.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, And all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord merely spoke, and the heavens were created. He breathed the word, and all the stars were born.
verses.textEnNasb: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, And by the breath of His mouth all their lights.
verses.textEn: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, their starry host by the breath of his mouth.

verses.textZh: 他把海水聚集成垒 ， 把深海安放在库房中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把海水聚集成垒 ， 把深海安放在库房中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他聚集海水如垒， 收藏深洋在库房。
verses.textEnNiv: He gathers the waters of the sea into jars ; he puts the deep into storehouses.
verses.textEnEsv: He gathers the waters of the sea as a heap; he puts the deeps in storehouses.
verses.textEnNkjv: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap; He lays up the deep in storehouses.
verses.textEnNlt: He assigned the sea its boundaries and locked the oceans in vast reservoirs.
verses.textEnNasb: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap; He puts the depths in storehouses.
verses.textEn: He gathers the waters of the sea into jars ; he puts the deep into storehouses.

verses.textZh: 愿全地都敬畏耶和华， 愿世上的居民都惧怕他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿全地都敬畏耶和华， 愿世上的居民都惧怕他。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿全地都敬畏耶和华！ 愿世上的居民都惧怕他！
verses.textEnNiv: Let all the earth fear the Lord ; let all the people of the world revere him.
verses.textEnEsv: Let all the earth fear the Lord ; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all the earth fear the Lord; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the whole world fear the Lord , and let everyone stand in awe of him.
verses.textEnNasb: Let all the earth fear the Lord; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
verses.textEn: Let all the earth fear the Lord ; let all the people of the world revere him.

verses.textZh: 因为他说有，就有； 命立，就立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他说有，就有； 命立，就立。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他说有，就有， 命立，就立。
verses.textEnNiv: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.textEnEsv: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He spoke, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.textEnNlt: For when he spoke, the world began! It appeared at his command.
verses.textEnNasb: For He spoke, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.textEn: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.

verses.textZh: 耶和华破坏列国的谋略， 使万民的计划挫败。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华破坏列国的谋略， 使万民的计划挫败。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使列国的筹算归于无有， 使众民的思念无有功效。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord foils the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; he frustrates the plans of the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; He makes the plans of the peoples of no effect.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord frustrates the plans of the nations and thwarts all their schemes.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord nullifies the plan of nations; He frustrates the plans of peoples.
verses.textEn: The Lord foils the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的谋略永远立定， 他心中的计划万代长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的谋略永远立定， 他心中的计划万代长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的筹算永远立定； 他心中的思念万代常存。
verses.textEnNiv: But the plans of the Lord stand firm forever, the purposes of his heart through all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: The counsel of the Lord stands forever, the plans of his heart to all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: The counsel of the Lord stands forever, The plans of His heart to all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord ’s plans stand firm forever; his intentions can never be shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: The plan of the Lord stands forever, The plans of His heart from generation to generation.
verses.textEn: But the plans of the Lord stand firm forever, the purposes of his heart through all generations.

verses.textZh: 以耶和华为神的，那国是有福的； 耶和华拣选作自己产业的，那民是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以耶和华为神的，那国是有福的； 耶和华拣选作自己产业的，那民是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以耶和华为神的，那国是有福的！ 他所拣选为自己产业的，那民是有福的！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord , the people he chose for his inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord , the people whom he has chosen as his heritage!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, The people He has chosen as His own inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: What joy for the nation whose God is the Lord , whose people he has chosen as his inheritance.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, The people He has chosen for His own inheritance.
verses.textEn: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord , the people he chose for his inheritance.

verses.textZh: 耶和华从天上观看， 他看见全人类。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华从天上观看， 他看见全人类。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华从天上观看； 他看见一切的世人。
verses.textEnNiv: From heaven the Lord looks down and sees all mankind;
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord looks down from heaven; he sees all the children of man;
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord looks from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord looks down from heaven and sees the whole human race.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord looks from heaven; He sees all the sons of mankind;
verses.textEn: From heaven the Lord looks down and sees all mankind;

verses.textZh: 从自己的住处， 他察看地上所有的居民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从自己的住处， 他察看地上所有的居民。
verses.textZhCuv: 从他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民－
verses.textEnNiv: from his dwelling place he watches all who live on earth—
verses.textEnEsv: from where he sits enthroned he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: From the place of His dwelling He looks On all the inhabitants of the earth;
verses.textEnNlt: From his throne he observes all who live on the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: From His dwelling place He looks out On all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.textEn: from his dwelling place he watches all who live on earth—

verses.textZh: 他是那创造众人的心， 了解他们一切作为的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是那创造众人的心， 了解他们一切作为的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是那造成他们众人心的， 留意他们一切作为的。
verses.textEnNiv: he who forms the hearts of all, who considers everything they do.
verses.textEnEsv: he who fashions the hearts of them all and observes all their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: He fashions their hearts individually; He considers all their works.
verses.textEnNlt: He made their hearts, so he understands everything they do.
verses.textEnNasb: He who fashions the hearts of them all, He who understands all their works.
verses.textEn: he who forms the hearts of all, who considers everything they do.

verses.textZh: 君王不是因兵多得胜， 勇士不是因力大得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王不是因兵多得胜， 勇士不是因力大得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 君王不能因兵多得胜； 勇士不能因力大得救。
verses.textEnNiv: No king is saved by the size of his army; no warrior escapes by his great strength.
verses.textEnEsv: The king is not saved by his great army; a warrior is not delivered by his great strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: No king is saved by the multitude of an army; A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
verses.textEnNlt: The best-equipped army cannot save a king, nor is great strength enough to save a warrior.
verses.textEnNasb: The king is not saved by a mighty army; A warrior is not rescued by great strength.
verses.textEn: No king is saved by the size of his army; no warrior escapes by his great strength.

verses.textZh: 想靠马得胜是枉然的； 马虽然力大，也不能救人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 想靠马得胜是枉然的； 马虽然力大，也不能救人。
verses.textZhCuv: 靠马得救是枉然的； 马也不能因力大救人。
verses.textEnNiv: A horse is a vain hope for deliverance; despite all its great strength it cannot save.
verses.textEnEsv: The war horse is a false hope for salvation, and by its great might it cannot rescue.
verses.textEnNkjv: A horse is a vain hope for safety; Neither shall it deliver any by its great strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t count on your warhorse to give you victory— for all its strength, it cannot save you.
verses.textEnNasb: A horse is a false hope for victory; Nor does it rescue anyone by its great strength.
verses.textEn: A horse is a vain hope for deliverance; despite all its great strength it cannot save.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的眼睛看顾敬畏他的人， 和那些仰望他慈爱的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的眼睛看顾敬畏他的人， 和那些仰望他慈爱的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的眼目看顾敬畏他的人 和仰望他慈爱的人，
verses.textEnNiv: But the eyes of the Lord are on those who fear him, on those whose hope is in his unfailing love,
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, the eye of the Lord is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his steadfast love,
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, the eye of the Lordis on those who fear Him, On those who hope in His mercy,
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord watches over those who fear him, those who rely on his unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, the eye of the Lord is on those who fear Him, On those who wait for His faithfulness,
verses.textEn: But the eyes of the Lord are on those who fear him, on those whose hope is in his unfailing love,

verses.textZh: 要搭救他们的性命脱离死亡， 使他们在饥荒中可以存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要搭救他们的性命脱离死亡， 使他们在饥荒中可以存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 要救他们的命脱离死亡， 并使他们在饥荒中存活。
verses.textEnNiv: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
verses.textEnEsv: that he may deliver their soul from death and keep them alive in famine.
verses.textEnNkjv: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.
verses.textEnNlt: He rescues them from death and keeps them alive in times of famine.
verses.textEnNasb: To rescue their soul from death And to keep them alive in famine.
verses.textEn: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

verses.textZh: 我们的心等候耶和华， 他是我们的帮助、我们的盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的心等候耶和华， 他是我们的帮助、我们的盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的心向来等候耶和华； 他是我们的帮助，我们的盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: We wait in hope for the Lord ; he is our help and our shield.
verses.textEnEsv: Our soul waits for the Lord ; he is our help and our shield.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our soul waits for the Lord; He is our help and our shield.
verses.textEnNlt: We put our hope in the Lord . He is our help and our shield.
verses.textEnNasb: Our soul waits for the Lord; He is our help and our shield.
verses.textEn: We wait in hope for the Lord ; he is our help and our shield.

verses.textZh: 我们的心因他欢乐， 因为我们倚靠他的圣名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的心因他欢乐， 因为我们倚靠他的圣名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的心必靠他欢喜， 因为我们向来倚靠他的圣名。
verses.textEnNiv: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.
verses.textEnEsv: For our heart is glad in him, because we trust in his holy name.
verses.textEnNkjv: For our heart shall rejoice in Him, Because we have trusted in His holy name.
verses.textEnNlt: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.
verses.textEnNasb: For our heart rejoices in Him, Because we trust in His holy name.
verses.textEn: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你照着我们所仰望你的， 向我们施慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你照着我们所仰望你的， 向我们施慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你照着我们所仰望你的， 向我们施行慈爱！
verses.textEnNiv: May your unfailing love be with us, Lord , even as we put our hope in you.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your steadfast love, O Lord , be upon us, even as we hope in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Your mercy, O Lord, be upon us, Just as we hope in You.
verses.textEnNlt: Let your unfailing love surround us, Lord , for our hope is in you alone.
verses.textEnNasb: Let Your favor, Lord, be upon us, Just as we have waited for You.
verses.textEn: May your unfailing love be with us, Lord , even as we put our hope in you.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，是他在亚比米勒面前装疯，被驱逐离去时作的。 我要时常称颂耶和华， 赞美他的话必常在我口中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，是他在亚比米勒面前装疯，被驱逐离去时作的。 我要时常称颂耶和华， 赞美他的话必常在我口中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要时时称颂耶和华； 赞美他的话必常在我口中。
verses.textEnNiv: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.
verses.textEnEsv: I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bless the Lord at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: I will praise the Lord at all times. I will constantly speak his praises.
verses.textEnNasb: I will bless the Lord at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.textEn: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.

verses.textZh: 我的心要因耶和华夸耀， 困苦的人听见了就喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心要因耶和华夸耀， 困苦的人听见了就喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心必因耶和华夸耀； 谦卑人听见就要喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: I will glory in the Lord ; let the afflicted hear and rejoice.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul makes its boast in the Lord ; let the humble hear and be glad.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul shall make its boast in the Lord; The humble shall hear ofit and be glad.
verses.textEnNlt: I will boast only in the Lord ; let all who are helpless take heart.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul will make its boast in the Lord; The humble will hear it and rejoice.
verses.textEn: I will glory in the Lord ; let the afflicted hear and rejoice.

verses.textZh: 你们要跟我一起尊耶和华为大， 我们来一同高举他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要跟我一起尊耶和华为大， 我们来一同高举他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们和我当称耶和华为大， 一同高举他的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Glorify the Lord with me; let us exalt his name together.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, magnify the Lord with me, And let us exalt His name together.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, let us tell of the Lord ’s greatness; let us exalt his name together.
verses.textEnNasb: Exalt the Lord with me, And let’s exalt His name together.
verses.textEn: Glorify the Lord with me; let us exalt his name together.

verses.textZh: 我曾求问耶和华，他应允了我， 救我脱离一切恐惧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾求问耶和华，他应允了我， 救我脱离一切恐惧。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾寻求耶和华，他就应允我， 救我脱离了一切的恐惧。
verses.textEnNiv: I sought the Lord , and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.
verses.textEnEsv: I sought the Lord , and he answered me and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.textEnNkjv: I sought the Lord, and He heard me, And delivered me from all my fears.
verses.textEnNlt: I prayed to the Lord , and he answered me. He freed me from all my fears.
verses.textEnNasb: I sought the Lord and He answered me, And rescued me from all my fears.
verses.textEn: I sought the Lord , and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

verses.textZh: 人仰望他，就有光彩， 他们的脸必不蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人仰望他，就有光彩， 他们的脸必不蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡仰望他的，便有光荣； 他们的脸必不蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who look to him are radiant, and their faces shall never be ashamed.
verses.textEnNkjv: They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces were not ashamed.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who look to him for help will be radiant with joy; no shadow of shame will darken their faces.
verses.textEnNasb: They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces will never be ashamed.
verses.textEn: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.

verses.textZh: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华就垂听， 拯救我脱离一切患难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华就垂听， 拯救我脱离一切患难。
verses.textZhCuv: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华便垂听， 救我脱离一切患难。
verses.textEnNiv: This poor man called, and the Lord heard him; he saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.textEnEsv: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.textEnNkjv: This poor man cried out, and the Lord heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.textEnNlt: In my desperation I prayed, and the Lord listened; he saved me from all my troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: This wretched man cried out, and the Lord heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.textEn: This poor man called, and the Lord heard him; he saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者，在敬畏他的人周围扎营， 搭救他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者，在敬畏他的人周围扎营， 搭救他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者在敬畏他的人四围安营， 搭救他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them.
verses.textEnEsv: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The angel of the Lord encamps all around those who fear Him, And delivers them.
verses.textEnNlt: For the angel of the Lord is a guard; he surrounds and defends all who fear him.
verses.textEnNasb: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear Him, And rescues them.
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them.

verses.textZh: 你们要亲自体验，就知道耶和华是美善的； 投靠他的人，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要亲自体验，就知道耶和华是美善的； 投靠他的人，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要尝尝主恩的滋味，便知道他是美善； 投靠他的人有福了！
verses.textEnNiv: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, taste and see that the Lord is good! Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, taste and see that the Lordis good; Blessed is the man who trusts in Him!
verses.textEnNlt: Taste and see that the Lord is good. Oh, the joys of those who take refuge in him!
verses.textEnNasb: Taste and see that the Lord is good; How blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
verses.textEn: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的圣民哪！你们要敬畏他， 因为敬畏他的一无所缺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的圣民哪！你们要敬畏他， 因为敬畏他的一无所缺。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们当敬畏他， 因敬畏他的一无所缺。
verses.textEnNiv: Fear the Lord , you his holy people, for those who fear him lack nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, fear the Lord , you his saints, for those who fear him have no lack!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, fear the Lord, you His saints! Thereis no want to those who fear Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear the Lord , you his godly people, for those who fear him will have all they need.
verses.textEnNasb: Fear the Lord, you His saints; For to those who fear Him there is no lack of anything.
verses.textEn: Fear the Lord , you his holy people, for those who fear him lack nothing.

verses.textZh: 少壮狮子有时还缺食挨饿， 但寻求耶和华的，甚么好处都不缺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 少壮狮子有时还缺食挨饿， 但寻求耶和华的，甚么好处都不缺。
verses.textZhCuv: 少壮狮子还缺食忍饿， 但寻求耶和华的什么好处都不缺。
verses.textEnNiv: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.
verses.textEnEsv: The young lions suffer want and hunger; but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: The young lions lack and suffer hunger; But those who seek the Lord shall not lack any good thing.
verses.textEnNlt: Even strong young lions sometimes go hungry, but those who trust in the Lord will lack no good thing.
verses.textEnNasb: The young lions do without and suffer hunger; But they who seek the Lord will not lack any good thing.
verses.textEn: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.

verses.textZh: 孩子们！你们要来听我； 我要教导你们敬畏耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子们！你们要来听我； 我要教导你们敬畏耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 众弟子啊，你们当来听我的话！ 我要将敬畏耶和华的道教训你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Come, my children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Come, O children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, my children, and listen to me, and I will teach you to fear the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Come, my children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 谁喜爱生命， 爱慕长寿，享受美福，
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁喜爱生命， 爱慕长寿，享受美福，
verses.textZhCuv: 有何人喜好存活， 爱慕长寿，得享美福，
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever of you loves life and desires to see many good days,
verses.textEnEsv: What man is there who desires life and loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is the man who desires life, And loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.textEnNlt: Does anyone want to live a life that is long and prosperous?
verses.textEnNasb: Who is the person who desires life And loves length of days, that he may see good?
verses.textEn: Whoever of you loves life and desires to see many good days,

verses.textZh: 就应谨守舌头，不出恶言， 嘴唇不说欺诈的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就应谨守舌头，不出恶言， 嘴唇不说欺诈的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 就要禁止舌头不出恶言， 嘴唇不说诡诈的话。
verses.textEnNiv: keep your tongue from evil and your lips from telling lies.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Keep your tongue from evil, And your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.textEnNlt: Then keep your tongue from speaking evil and your lips from telling lies!
verses.textEnNasb: Keep your tongue from evil And your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.textEn: keep your tongue from evil and your lips from telling lies.

verses.textZh: 也要离恶行善， 寻找并追求和睦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要离恶行善， 寻找并追求和睦。
verses.textZhCuv: 要离恶行善， 寻求和睦，一心追赶。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Depart from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.
verses.textEnNlt: Turn away from evil and do good. Search for peace, and work to maintain it.
verses.textEnNasb: Turn from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.
verses.textEn: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的眼睛看顾义人， 他的耳朵垂听他们的呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的眼睛看顾义人， 他的耳朵垂听他们的呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的眼目看顾义人； 他的耳朵听他们的呼求。
verses.textEnNiv: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are attentive to their cry;
verses.textEnEsv: The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous and his ears toward their cry.
verses.textEnNkjv: The eyes of the Lordare on the righteous, And His ears areopen to their cry.
verses.textEnNlt: The eyes of the Lord watch over those who do right; his ears are open to their cries for help.
verses.textEnNasb: The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous, And His ears are toward their cry for help.
verses.textEn: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are attentive to their cry;

verses.textZh: 耶和华的脸敌对作恶的人， 要把他们的名从世上除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的脸敌对作恶的人， 要把他们的名从世上除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向行恶的人变脸， 要从世上除灭他们的名号。
verses.textEnNiv: but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to blot out their name from the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The face of the Lordis against those who do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord turns his face against those who do evil; he will erase their memory from the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: The face of the Lord is against evildoers, To eliminate the memory of them from the earth.
verses.textEn: but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to blot out their name from the earth.

verses.textZh: 义人哀求，耶和华就垂听， 搭救他们脱离一切患难，
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人哀求，耶和华就垂听， 搭救他们脱离一切患难，
verses.textZhCuv: 义人呼求，耶和华听见了， 便救他们脱离一切患难。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them; he delivers them from all their troubles.
verses.textEnEsv: When the righteous cry for help, the Lord hears and delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therighteous cry out, and the Lord hears, And delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord hears his people when they call to him for help. He rescues them from all their troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears And rescues them from all their troubles.
verses.textEn: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them; he delivers them from all their troubles.

verses.textZh: 耶和华亲近心中破碎的人， 拯救灵里痛悔的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华亲近心中破碎的人， 拯救灵里痛悔的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华靠近伤心的人， 拯救灵性痛悔的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis near to those who have a broken heart, And saves such as have a contrite spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted; he rescues those whose spirits are crushed.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted And saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verses.textEn: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

verses.textZh: 义人虽有许多苦难， 但耶和华搭救他脱离这一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人虽有许多苦难， 但耶和华搭救他脱离这一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人多有苦难， 但耶和华救他脱离这一切，
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous person may have many troubles, but the Lord delivers him from them all;
verses.textEnEsv: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord delivers him out of them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, But the Lord delivers him out of them all.
verses.textEnNlt: The righteous person faces many troubles, but the Lord comes to the rescue each time.
verses.textEnNasb: The afflictions of the righteous are many, But the Lord rescues him from them all.
verses.textEn: The righteous person may have many troubles, but the Lord delivers him from them all;

verses.textZh: 耶和华保全他一身的骨头， 连一根也不容折断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华保全他一身的骨头， 连一根也不容折断。
verses.textZhCuv: 又保全他一身的骨头， 连一根也不折断。
verses.textEnNiv: he protects all his bones, not one of them will be broken.
verses.textEnEsv: He keeps all his bones; not one of them is broken.
verses.textEnNkjv: He guards all his bones; Not one of them is broken.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord protects the bones of the righteous; not one of them is broken!
verses.textEnNasb: He protects all his bones, Not one of them is broken.
verses.textEn: he protects all his bones, not one of them will be broken.

verses.textZh: 恶人必被恶害死； 憎恨义人的，必被定罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人必被恶害死； 憎恨义人的，必被定罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶必害死恶人； 恨恶义人的，必被定罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Evil will slay the wicked; the foes of the righteous will be condemned.
verses.textEnEsv: Affliction will slay the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be condemned.
verses.textEnNkjv: Evil shall slay the wicked, And those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
verses.textEnNlt: Calamity will surely destroy the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be punished.
verses.textEnNasb: Evil will bring death to the wicked, And those who hate the righteous will suffer for their guilt.
verses.textEn: Evil will slay the wicked; the foes of the righteous will be condemned.

verses.textZh: 耶和华救赎他仆人的性命； 凡是投靠他的，必不被定罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华救赎他仆人的性命； 凡是投靠他的，必不被定罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华救赎他仆人的灵魂； 凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will rescue his servants; no one who takes refuge in him will be condemned.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord redeems the life of his servants; none of those who take refuge in him will be condemned.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord redeems the soul of His servants, And none of those who trust in Him shall be condemned.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord will redeem those who serve him. No one who takes refuge in him will be condemned.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord redeems the souls of His servants, And none of those who take refuge in Him will suffer for their guilt.
verses.textEn: The Lord will rescue his servants; no one who takes refuge in him will be condemned.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！与我相争的，求你与他们相争； 与我作战的，求你与他们作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 耶和华啊！与我相争的，求你与他们相争； 与我作战的，求你与他们作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，与我相争的，求你与他们相争！ 与我相战的，求你与他们相战！
verses.textEnNiv: Contend, Lord , with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.
verses.textEnEsv: Contend, O Lord , with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Plead mycause, O Lord, with those who strive with me; Fight against those who fight against me.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , oppose those who oppose me. Fight those who fight against me.
verses.textEnNasb: Contend, Lord, with those who contend with me; Fight against those who fight against me.
verses.textEn: Contend, Lord , with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.

verses.textZh: 求你紧握大小的盾牌， 起来帮助我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你紧握大小的盾牌， 起来帮助我。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿着大小的盾牌， 起来帮助我。
verses.textEnNiv: Take up shield and armor; arise and come to my aid.
verses.textEnEsv: Take hold of shield and buckler and rise for my help!
verses.textEnNkjv: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for my help.
verses.textEnNlt: Put on your armor, and take up your shield. Prepare for battle, and come to my aid.
verses.textEnNasb: Take hold of buckler and shield And rise up as my help.
verses.textEn: Take up shield and armor; arise and come to my aid.

verses.textZh: 拔出矛枪战斧， 迎击那些追赶我的； 求你对我说： "我是你的拯救。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拔出矛枪战斧， 迎击那些追赶我的； 求你对我说： "我是你的拯救。"
verses.textZhCuv: 抽出枪来，挡住那追赶我的； 求你对我的灵魂说：我是拯救你的。
verses.textEnNiv: Brandish spear and javelin against those who pursue me. Say to me, "I am your salvation."
verses.textEnEsv: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers! Say to my soul, "I am your salvation!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Also draw out the spear, And stop those who pursue me. Say to my soul, "I am your salvation."
verses.textEnNlt: Lift up your spear and javelin against those who pursue me. Let me hear you say, "I will give you victory!"
verses.textEnNasb: Draw also the spear and the battle-axe to meet those who pursue me; Say to my soul, "I am your salvation."
verses.textEn: Brandish spear and javelin against those who pursue me. Say to me, "I am your salvation."

verses.textZh: 愿那些寻索我命的，蒙羞受辱； 愿设计陷害我的，退后羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那些寻索我命的，蒙羞受辱； 愿设计陷害我的，退后羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那寻索我命的，蒙羞受辱！ 愿那谋害我的，退后羞愧！
verses.textEnNiv: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plot my ruin be turned back in dismay.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be put to shame and dishonor who seek after my life! Let them be turned back and disappointed who devise evil against me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let those be put to shame and brought to dishonor Who seek after my life; Let those be turned back and brought to confusion Who plot my hurt.
verses.textEnNlt: Bring shame and disgrace on those trying to kill me; turn them back and humiliate those who want to harm me.
verses.textEnNasb: Let those be ashamed and dishonored who seek my life; Let those be turned back and humiliated who devise evil against me.
verses.textEn: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plot my ruin be turned back in dismay.

verses.textZh: 愿他们像风前的糠秕， 有耶和华的使者驱逐他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们像风前的糠秕， 有耶和华的使者驱逐他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们像风前的糠， 有耶和华的使者赶逐他们。
verses.textEnNiv: May they be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the Lord driving them away;
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the Lord driving them away!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be like chaff before the wind, And let the angel of the Lord chase them.
verses.textEnNlt: Blow them away like chaff in the wind— a wind sent by the angel of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Let them be like chaff before the wind, With the angel of the Lord driving them on.
verses.textEn: May they be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the Lord driving them away;

verses.textZh: 愿他们的路又暗又滑， 有耶和华的使者追赶他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们的路又暗又滑， 有耶和华的使者追赶他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们的道路又暗又滑， 有耶和华的使者追赶他们。
verses.textEnNiv: may their path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the Lord pursuing them.
verses.textEnEsv: Let their way be dark and slippery, with the angel of the Lord pursuing them!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let their way be dark and slippery, And let the angel of the Lord pursue them.
verses.textEnNlt: Make their path dark and slippery, with the angel of the Lord pursuing them.
verses.textEnNasb: Let their way be dark and slippery, With the angel of the Lord pursuing them.
verses.textEn: may their path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the Lord pursuing them.

verses.textZh: 因为他们无故为我暗设网罗， 无故挖坑要陷害我的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们无故为我暗设网罗， 无故挖坑要陷害我的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们无故地为我暗设网罗， 无故地挖坑，要害我的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: Since they hid their net for me without cause and without cause dug a pit for me,
verses.textEnEsv: For without cause they hid their net for me; without cause they dug a pit for my life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For without cause they have hidden their net for me in a pit, Which they have dug without cause for my life.
verses.textEnNlt: I did them no wrong, but they laid a trap for me. I did them no wrong, but they dug a pit to catch me.
verses.textEnNasb: For they hid their net for me without cause; Without cause they dug a pit for my soul.
verses.textEn: Since they hid their net for me without cause and without cause dug a pit for me,

verses.textZh: 愿毁灭在不知不觉间临到他身上， 愿他暗设的网罗缠住自己， 愿他落在其中遭毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿毁灭在不知不觉间临到他身上， 愿他暗设的网罗缠住自己， 愿他落在其中遭毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿灾祸忽然临到他身上！ 愿他暗设的网缠住自己！ 愿他落在其中遭灾祸！
verses.textEnNiv: may ruin overtake them by surprise— may the net they hid entangle them, may they fall into the pit, to their ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: Let destruction come upon him when he does not know it! And let the net that he hid ensnare him; let him fall into it—to his destruction!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let destruction come upon him unexpectedly, And let his net that he has hidden catch himself; Into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.textEnNlt: So let sudden ruin come upon them! Let them be caught in the trap they set for me! Let them be destroyed in the pit they dug for me.
verses.textEnNasb: Let destruction come upon him when he is unaware, And let the net which he hid catch him; Let him fall into that very destruction.
verses.textEn: may ruin overtake them by surprise— may the net they hid entangle them, may they fall into the pit, to their ruin.

verses.textZh: 我的心必因耶和华快乐， 因他的救恩高兴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心必因耶和华快乐， 因他的救恩高兴。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心必靠耶和华快乐， 靠他的救恩高兴。
verses.textEnNiv: Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord and delight in his salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord , exulting in his salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord; It shall rejoice in His salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will rejoice in the Lord . I will be glad because he rescues me.
verses.textEnNasb: So my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; It shall rejoice in His salvation.
verses.textEn: Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord and delight in his salvation.

verses.textZh: 我全身的骨头都要说： "耶和华啊！有谁像你呢？ 你搭救困苦的人，脱离那些比他强盛的； 搭救困苦和穷乏的人，脱离那些抢夺他的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我全身的骨头都要说： "耶和华啊！有谁像你呢？ 你搭救困苦的人，脱离那些比他强盛的； 搭救困苦和穷乏的人，脱离那些抢夺他的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的骨头都要说： 耶和华啊，谁能像你 救护困苦人脱离那比他强壮的， 救护困苦穷乏人脱离那抢夺他的？
verses.textEnNiv: My whole being will exclaim, "Who is like you, Lord ? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them."
verses.textEnEsv: All my bones shall say, "O Lord , who is like you, delivering the poor from him who is too strong for him, the poor and needy from him who robs him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: All my bones shall say, "Lord, who is like You, Delivering the poor from him who is too strong for him, Yes, the poor and the needy from him who plunders him?"
verses.textEnNlt: With every bone in my body I will praise him: " Lord , who can compare with you? Who else rescues the helpless from the strong? Who else protects the helpless and poor from those who rob them?"
verses.textEnNasb: All my bones will say, "Lord, who is like You, Who rescues the afflicted from one who is too strong for him, And the afflicted and the poor from one who robs him?"
verses.textEn: My whole being will exclaim, "Who is like you, Lord ? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them."

verses.textZh: 强暴的见证人起来， 盘问我所不知道的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 强暴的见证人起来， 盘问我所不知道的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 凶恶的见证人起来， 盘问我所不知道的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Ruthless witnesses come forward; they question me on things I know nothing about.
verses.textEnEsv: Malicious witnesses rise up; they ask me of things that I do not know.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fierce witnesses rise up; They ask me things that I do not know.
verses.textEnNlt: Malicious witnesses testify against me. They accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
verses.textEnNasb: Malicious witnesses rise up; They ask me things that I do not know.
verses.textEn: Ruthless witnesses come forward; they question me on things I know nothing about.

verses.textZh: 他们对我以恶报善， 使我孤苦无依。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对我以恶报善， 使我孤苦无依。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们向我以恶报善， 使我的灵魂孤苦。
verses.textEnNiv: They repay me evil for good and leave me like one bereaved.
verses.textEnEsv: They repay me evil for good; my soul is bereft.
verses.textEnNkjv: They reward me evil for good, To the sorrow of my soul.
verses.textEnNlt: They repay me evil for good. I am sick with despair.
verses.textEnNasb: They repay me evil for good, To the bereavement of my soul.
verses.textEn: They repay me evil for good and leave me like one bereaved.

verses.textZh: 至于我，他们有病的时候， 我就穿上麻衣， 禁食刻苦己心； 我心里也不住地祷告 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，他们有病的时候， 我就穿上麻衣， 禁食刻苦己心； 我心里也不住地祷告 。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，当他们有病的时候， 我便穿麻衣，禁食，刻苦己心； 我所求的都归到自己的怀中。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. When my prayers returned to me unanswered,
verses.textEnEsv: But I, when they were sick— I wore sackcloth; I afflicted myself with fasting; I prayed with head bowed on my chest.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for me, when they were sick, My clothing was sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting; And my prayer would return to my own heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet when they were ill, I grieved for them. I denied myself by fasting for them, but my prayers returned unanswered.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth; I humbled my soul with fasting, But my prayer kept returning to me.
verses.textEn: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. When my prayers returned to me unanswered,

verses.textZh: 我往来奔走，看他们像自己的朋友兄弟； 我哀痛屈身，如同哀悼母亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我往来奔走，看他们像自己的朋友兄弟； 我哀痛屈身，如同哀悼母亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 我这样行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄； 我屈身悲哀，如同人为母亲哀痛。
verses.textEnNiv: I went about mourning as though for my friend or brother. I bowed my head in grief as though weeping for my mother.
verses.textEnEsv: I went about as though I grieved for my friend or my brother; as one who laments his mother, I bowed down in mourning.
verses.textEnNkjv: I paced about as though hewere my friend or brother; I bowed down heavily, as one who mourns forhis mother.
verses.textEnNlt: I was sad, as though they were my friends or family, as if I were grieving for my own mother.
verses.textEnNasb: I went about as though it were my friend or brother; I bowed down in mourning, like one who mourns for a mother.
verses.textEn: I went about mourning as though for my friend or brother. I bowed my head in grief as though weeping for my mother.

verses.textZh: 但我跌倒的时候，他们竟聚集一起欢庆； 我素不相识的聚集一起攻击我， 他们不住地欺凌我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我跌倒的时候，他们竟聚集一起欢庆； 我素不相识的聚集一起攻击我， 他们不住地欺凌我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在患难中，他们却欢喜，大家聚集。 我所不认识的那些下流人聚集攻击我； 他们不住地把我撕裂。
verses.textEnNiv: But when I stumbled, they gathered in glee; assailants gathered against me without my knowledge. They slandered me without ceasing.
verses.textEnEsv: But at my stumbling they rejoiced and gathered; they gathered together against me; wretches whom I did not know tore at me without ceasing;
verses.textEnNkjv: But in my adversity they rejoiced And gathered together; Attackers gathered against me, And I did not know it; They tore atme and did not cease;
verses.textEnNlt: But they are glad now that I am in trouble; they gleefully join together against me. I am attacked by people I don’t even know; they slander me constantly.
verses.textEnNasb: But at my stumbling they rejoiced and gathered themselves together; The afflicted people whom I did not know gathered together against me, They slandered me without ceasing.
verses.textEn: But when I stumbled, they gathered in glee; assailants gathered against me without my knowledge. They slandered me without ceasing.

verses.textZh: 他们以最粗鄙的话讥笑我 ， 向我咬牙切齿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们以最粗鄙的话讥笑我 ， 向我咬牙切齿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。
verses.textEnNiv: Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked; they gnashed their teeth at me.
verses.textEnEsv: like profane mockers at a feast, they gnash at me with their teeth.
verses.textEnNkjv: With ungodly mockers at feasts They gnashed at me with their teeth.
verses.textEnNlt: They mock me and call me names; they snarl at me.
verses.textEnNasb: Like godless jesters at a feast, They gnashed at me with their teeth.
verses.textEn: Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked; they gnashed their teeth at me.

verses.textZh: 主啊！你还要看多久？ 求你救我的性命脱离他们的残害， 救我的生命脱离少壮狮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！你还要看多久？ 求你救我的性命脱离他们的残害， 救我的生命脱离少壮狮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，你看着不理要到几时呢？ 求你救我的灵魂脱离他们的残害！ 救我的生命 脱离少壮狮子！
verses.textEnNiv: How long, Lord, will you look on? Rescue me from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
verses.textEnEsv: How long, O Lord, will you look on? Rescue me from their destruction, my precious life from the lions!
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, how long will You look on? Rescue me from their destructions, My precious life from the lions.
verses.textEnNlt: How long, O Lord, will you look on and do nothing? Rescue me from their fierce attacks. Protect my life from these lions!
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, how long will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, My only life from the lions.
verses.textEn: How long, Lord, will you look on? Rescue me from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

verses.textZh: 我要在大会中称谢你， 我要在众民中赞美你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在大会中称谢你， 我要在众民中赞美你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在大会中要称谢你， 在众民中要赞美你。
verses.textEnNiv: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among the throngs I will praise you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will thank you in the great congregation; in the mighty throng I will praise you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will thank you in front of the great assembly. I will praise you before all the people.
verses.textEnNasb: I will give You thanks in the great congregation; I will praise You among a mighty people.
verses.textEn: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among the throngs I will praise you.

verses.textZh: 求你不容那些无理与我为敌的，向我夸耀； 不让那些无故恨我的，向我挤眼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不容那些无理与我为敌的，向我夸耀； 不让那些无故恨我的，向我挤眼。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你不容那无理与我为仇的向我夸耀！ 不容那无故恨我的向我挤眼！
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let those gloat over me who are my enemies without cause; do not let those who hate me without reason maliciously wink the eye.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not those rejoice over me who are wrongfully my foes, and let not those wink the eye who hate me without cause.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them not rejoice over me who are wrongfully my enemies; Nor let them wink with the eye who hate me without a cause.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let my treacherous enemies rejoice over my defeat. Don’t let those who hate me without cause gloat over my sorrow.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not let those who are wrongfully my enemies rejoice over me; Nor let those who hate me for no reason wink maliciously.
verses.textEn: Do not let those gloat over me who are my enemies without cause; do not let those who hate me without reason maliciously wink the eye.

verses.textZh: 因为他们不说和睦的话， 却计划诡诈的事， 陷害世上的安静人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们不说和睦的话， 却计划诡诈的事， 陷害世上的安静人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们不说和平话， 倒想出诡诈的言语害地上的安静人。
verses.textEnNiv: They do not speak peaceably, but devise false accusations against those who live quietly in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: For they do not speak peace, but against those who are quiet in the land they devise words of deceit.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they do not speak peace, But they devise deceitful matters Against the quiet ones in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: They don’t talk of peace; they plot against innocent people who mind their own business.
verses.textEnNasb: For they do not speak peace, But they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.
verses.textEn: They do not speak peaceably, but devise false accusations against those who live quietly in the land.

verses.textZh: 他们张大嘴巴攻击我， 说："啊哈！啊哈！ 我们亲眼看见了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们张大嘴巴攻击我， 说："啊哈！啊哈！ 我们亲眼看见了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们大大张口攻击我，说： 阿哈，阿哈，我们的眼已经看见了！
verses.textEnNiv: They sneer at me and say, "Aha! Aha! With our own eyes we have seen it."
verses.textEnEsv: They open wide their mouths against me; they say, "Aha, Aha! Our eyes have seen it!"
verses.textEnNkjv: They also opened their mouth wide against me, And said, "Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen it."
verses.textEnNlt: They shout, "Aha! Aha! With our own eyes we saw him do it!"
verses.textEnNasb: They opened their mouth wide against me; They said, "Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen it!"
verses.textEn: They sneer at me and say, "Aha! Aha! With our own eyes we have seen it."

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你已经看见了，求你不要缄默； 主啊！求你不要远离我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你已经看见了，求你不要缄默； 主啊！求你不要远离我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你已经看见了，求你不要闭口！ 主啊，求你不要远离我！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , you have seen this; do not be silent. Do not be far from me, Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: You have seen, O Lord ; be not silent! O Lord, be not far from me!
verses.textEnNkjv: This You have seen, O Lord; Do not keep silence. O Lord, do not be far from me.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , you know all about this. Do not stay silent. Do not abandon me now, O Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: You have seen it, Lord, do not keep silent; Lord, do not be far from me.
verses.textEn: Lord , you have seen this; do not be silent. Do not be far from me, Lord.

verses.textZh: 我的神，我的主啊！ 求你激动醒起，为我伸冤辩护。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神，我的主啊！ 求你激动醒起，为我伸冤辩护。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神我的主啊，求你奋兴醒起， 判清我的事，伸明我的冤！
verses.textEnNiv: Awake, and rise to my defense! Contend for me, my God and Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Awake and rouse yourself for my vindication, for my cause, my God and my Lord!
verses.textEnNkjv: Stir up Yourself, and awake to my vindication, To my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Wake up! Rise to my defense! Take up my case, my God and my Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Stir Yourself, and awake to my right And to my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.textEn: Awake, and rise to my defense! Contend for me, my God and Lord.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神啊！求你按着你的公义判断我， 不容他们向我夸耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神啊！求你按着你的公义判断我， 不容他们向我夸耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神啊，求你按你的公义判断我， 不容他们向我夸耀！
verses.textEnNiv: Vindicate me in your righteousness, Lord my God; do not let them gloat over me.
verses.textEnEsv: Vindicate me, O Lord , my God, according to your righteousness, and let them not rejoice over me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Vindicate me, O Lord my God, according to Your righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.
verses.textEnNlt: Declare me not guilty, O Lord my God, for you give justice. Don’t let my enemies laugh about me in my troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: Judge me, Lord my God, according to Your righteousness, And do not let them rejoice over me.
verses.textEn: Vindicate me in your righteousness, Lord my God; do not let them gloat over me.

verses.textZh: 不要让他们心里说： "啊哈！这正是我们的心愿！" 不要让他们说："我们把他吞下去了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要让他们心里说： "啊哈！这正是我们的心愿！" 不要让他们说："我们把他吞下去了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 不容他们心里说：阿哈，遂我们的心愿了！ 不容他们说：我们已经把他吞了！
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let them think, "Aha, just what we wanted!" or say, "We have swallowed him up."
verses.textEnEsv: Let them not say in their hearts, "Aha, our heart’s desire!" Let them not say, "We have swallowed him up."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them not say in their hearts, "Ah, so we would have it!" Let them not say, "We have swallowed him up."
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let them say, "Look, we got what we wanted! Now we will eat him alive!"
verses.textEnNasb: Do not let them say in their heart, "Aha, our desire!" Do not let them say, "We have swallowed him up!"
verses.textEn: Do not let them think, "Aha, just what we wanted!" or say, "We have swallowed him up."

verses.textZh: 愿那些喜欢我遭难的， 一同蒙羞抱愧； 愿那些对我妄自尊大的， 都披上惭愧和耻辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那些喜欢我遭难的， 一同蒙羞抱愧； 愿那些对我妄自尊大的， 都披上惭愧和耻辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那喜欢我遭难的一同抱愧蒙羞！ 愿那向我妄自尊大的披惭愧，蒙羞辱！
verses.textEnNiv: May all who gloat over my distress be put to shame and confusion; may all who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be put to shame and disappointed altogether who rejoice at my calamity! Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be ashamed and brought to mutual confusion Who rejoice at my hurt; Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor Who exalt themselves against me.
