verses.textEnNlt: May those who rejoice at my troubles be humiliated and disgraced. May those who triumph over me be covered with shame and dishonor.
verses.textEnNasb: May those be ashamed and altogether humiliated who rejoice at my distress; May those who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and dishonor.
verses.textEn: May all who gloat over my distress be put to shame and confusion; may all who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.

verses.textZh: 愿那些喜悦我冤屈昭雪的， 都欢呼快乐； 愿他们不住地说： "要尊耶和华为大，他喜悦他的仆人平安。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那些喜悦我冤屈昭雪的， 都欢呼快乐； 愿他们不住地说： "要尊耶和华为大，他喜悦他的仆人平安。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那喜悦我冤屈得伸的 欢呼快乐； 愿他们常说：当尊耶和华为大！ 耶和华喜悦他的仆人平安。
verses.textEnNiv: May those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, "The Lord be exalted, who delights in the well-being of his servant."
verses.textEnEsv: Let those who delight in my righteousness shout for joy and be glad and say evermore, "Great is the Lord , who delights in the welfare of his servant!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them shout for joy and be glad, Who favor my righteous cause; And let them say continually, "Let the Lord be magnified, Who has pleasure in the prosperity of His servant."
verses.textEnNlt: But give great joy to those who came to my defense. Let them continually say, "Great is the Lord , who delights in blessing his servant with peace!"
verses.textEnNasb: May those shout for joy and rejoice, who take delight in my vindication; And may they say continually, "The Lord be exalted, Who delights in the prosperity of His servant."
verses.textEn: May those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, "The Lord be exalted, who delights in the well-being of his servant."

verses.textZh: 我的舌头要述说你的公义， 终日赞美你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的舌头要述说你的公义， 终日赞美你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的舌头要终日论说你的公义， 时常赞美你。
verses.textEnNiv: My tongue will proclaim your righteousness, your praises all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: Then my tongue shall tell of your righteousness and of your praise all the day long.
verses.textEnNkjv: And my tongue shall speak of Your righteousness And of Your praise all the day long.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will proclaim your justice, and I will praise you all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: And my tongue shall proclaim Your righteousness And Your praise all day long.
verses.textEn: My tongue will proclaim your righteousness, your praises all day long.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 恶人的罪过在他心中深处说话， 他眼中也不怕神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 恶人的罪过在他心中深处说话， 他眼中也不怕神。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的罪过在他心里说： 我眼中不怕神！
verses.textEnNiv: I have a message from God in my heart concerning the sinfulness of the wicked: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Transgression speaks to the wicked deep in his heart; there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: An oracle within my heart concerning the transgression of the wicked: Thereis no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: Sin whispers to the wicked, deep within their hearts. They have no fear of God at all.
verses.textEnNasb: Wrongdoing speaks to the ungodly within his heart; There is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.textEn: I have a message from God in my heart concerning the sinfulness of the wicked: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

verses.textZh: 罪过媚惑他， 因此在他眼中看来， 自己的罪孽不会揭发，也不会被恨恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罪过媚惑他， 因此在他眼中看来， 自己的罪孽不会揭发，也不会被恨恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 他自夸自媚， 以为他的罪孽终不显露，不被恨恶。
verses.textEnNiv: In their own eyes they flatter themselves too much to detect or hate their sin.
verses.textEnEsv: For he flatters himself in his own eyes that his iniquity cannot be found out and hated.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, When he finds out his iniquity and when he hates.
verses.textEnNlt: In their blind conceit, they cannot see how wicked they really are.
verses.textEnNasb: For it flatters him in his own eyes Concerning the discovery of his wrongful deed and the hatred of it.
verses.textEn: In their own eyes they flatter themselves too much to detect or hate their sin.

verses.textZh: 他口中的话语都是罪恶和诡诈， 他不再是明慧的，也不再行善。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他口中的话语都是罪恶和诡诈， 他不再是明慧的，也不再行善。
verses.textZhCuv: 他口中的言语尽是罪孽诡诈； 他与智慧善行已经断绝。
verses.textEnNiv: The words of their mouths are wicked and deceitful; they fail to act wisely or do good.
verses.textEnEsv: The words of his mouth are trouble and deceit; he has ceased to act wisely and do good.
verses.textEnNkjv: The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit; He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
verses.textEnNlt: Everything they say is crooked and deceitful. They refuse to act wisely or do good.
verses.textEnNasb: The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit; He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
verses.textEn: The words of their mouths are wicked and deceitful; they fail to act wisely or do good.

verses.textZh: 他在床上密谋作恶， 定意行在不善的道路上， 并不弃绝恶事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在床上密谋作恶， 定意行在不善的道路上， 并不弃绝恶事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在床上图谋罪孽， 定意行不善的道，不憎恶恶事。
verses.textEnNiv: Even on their beds they plot evil; they commit themselves to a sinful course and do not reject what is wrong.
verses.textEnEsv: He plots trouble while on his bed; he sets himself in a way that is not good; he does not reject evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: He devises wickedness on his bed; He sets himself in a way thatis not good; He does not abhor evil.
verses.textEnNlt: They lie awake at night, hatching sinful plots. Their actions are never good. They make no attempt to turn from evil.
verses.textEnNasb: He plans wickedness on his bed; He sets himself on a path that is not good; He does not reject evil.
verses.textEn: Even on their beds they plot evil; they commit themselves to a sinful course and do not reject what is wrong.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的慈爱上及诸天， 你的信实高达云霄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的慈爱上及诸天， 你的信实高达云霄。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱上及诸天； 你的信实达到穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: Your love, Lord , reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies.
verses.textEnEsv: Your steadfast love, O Lord , extends to the heavens, your faithfulness to the clouds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
verses.textEnNlt: Your unfailing love, O Lord , is as vast as the heavens; your faithfulness reaches beyond the clouds.
verses.textEnNasb: Your mercy, Lord, extends to the heavens, Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.textEn: Your love, Lord , reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies.

verses.textZh: 你的公义好象大山， 你的公正如同深渊； 耶和华啊！人和牲畜，你都庇佑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的公义好象大山， 你的公正如同深渊； 耶和华啊！人和牲畜，你都庇佑。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的公义好像高山； 你的判断如同深渊。 耶和华啊，人民、牲畜，你都救护。
verses.textEnNiv: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains, your justice like the great deep. You, Lord , preserve both people and animals.
verses.textEnEsv: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; your judgments are like the great deep; man and beast you save, O Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Your righteousness is like the great mountains; Your judgments are a great deep; O Lord, You preserve man and beast.
verses.textEnNlt: Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains, your justice like the ocean depths. You care for people and animals alike, O Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; Your judgments are like the great deep. Lord, You protect mankind and animals.
verses.textEn: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains, your justice like the great deep. You, Lord , preserve both people and animals.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你的慈爱多么宝贵； 世人都投靠在你的翅膀荫下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你的慈爱多么宝贵； 世人都投靠在你的翅膀荫下。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你的慈爱何其宝贵！ 世人投靠在你翅膀的荫下。
verses.textEnNiv: How priceless is your unfailing love, O God! People take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
verses.textEnEsv: How precious is your steadfast love, O God! The children of mankind take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
verses.textEnNkjv: How precious is Your lovingkindness, O God! Therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of Your wings.
verses.textEnNlt: How precious is your unfailing love, O God! All humanity finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
verses.textEnNasb: How precious is Your mercy, God! And the sons of mankind take refuge in the shadow of Your wings.
verses.textEn: How priceless is your unfailing love, O God! People take refuge in the shadow of your wings.

verses.textZh: 他们必饱尝你殿里的盛筵， 你必使他们喝你乐河的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必饱尝你殿里的盛筵， 你必使他们喝你乐河的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必因你殿里的肥甘得以饱足； 你也必叫他们喝你乐河的水。
verses.textEnNiv: They feast on the abundance of your house; you give them drink from your river of delights.
verses.textEnEsv: They feast on the abundance of your house, and you give them drink from the river of your delights.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are abundantly satisfied with the fullness of Your house, And You give them drink from the river of Your pleasures.
verses.textEnNlt: You feed them from the abundance of your own house, letting them drink from your river of delights.
verses.textEnNasb: They drink their fill of the abundance of Your house; And You allow them to drink from the river of Your delights.
verses.textEn: They feast on the abundance of your house; you give them drink from your river of delights.

verses.textZh: 因为生命的泉源在你那里； 在你的光中，我们才能看见光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为生命的泉源在你那里； 在你的光中，我们才能看见光。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，在你那里有生命的源头； 在你的光中，我们必得见光。
verses.textEnNiv: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
verses.textEnEsv: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light do we see light.
verses.textEnNkjv: For with You is the fountain of life; In Your light we see light.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are the fountain of life, the light by which we see.
verses.textEnNasb: For the fountain of life is with You; In Your light we see light.
verses.textEn: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.

verses.textZh: 求你常施慈爱给认识你的人， 常施公义给心里正直的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你常施慈爱给认识你的人， 常施公义给心里正直的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你常施慈爱给认识你的人， 常以公义待心里正直的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Continue your love to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, continue your steadfast love to those who know you, and your righteousness to the upright of heart!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, continue Your lovingkindness to those who know You, And Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Pour out your unfailing love on those who love you; give justice to those with honest hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: Prolong Your mercy to those who know You, And Your righteousness to the upright of heart.
verses.textEn: Continue your love to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.textZh: 求你不容骄傲人的脚践踏 我， 不让恶人的手使我流离飘荡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不容骄傲人的脚践踏 我， 不让恶人的手使我流离飘荡。
verses.textZhCuv: 不容骄傲人的脚践踏我； 不容凶恶人的手赶逐我。
verses.textEnNiv: May the foot of the proud not come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not the foot of arrogance come upon me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let the proud trample me or the wicked push me around.
verses.textEnNasb: May the foot of pride not come upon me, And may the hand of the wicked not drive me away.
verses.textEn: May the foot of the proud not come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

verses.textZh: 作恶的人必跌倒； 他们被推倒，不能再起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作恶的人必跌倒； 他们被推倒，不能再起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里，作孽的人已经仆倒； 他们被推倒，不能再起来。
verses.textEnNiv: See how the evildoers lie fallen— thrown down, not able to rise!
verses.textEnEsv: There the evildoers lie fallen; they are thrust down, unable to rise.
verses.textEnNkjv: There the workers of iniquity have fallen; They have been cast down and are not able to rise.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! Those who do evil have fallen! They are thrown down, never to rise again.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who do injustice have fallen there; They have been thrust down and cannot rise.
verses.textEn: See how the evildoers lie fallen— thrown down, not able to rise!

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 不要因作恶的人心怀不平， 不要因犯罪的人产生嫉妒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 不要因作恶的人心怀不平， 不要因犯罪的人产生嫉妒。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要为作恶的心怀不平， 也不要向那行不义的生出嫉妒。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not fret because of those who are evil or be envious of those who do wrong;
verses.textEnEsv: Fret not yourself because of evildoers; be not envious of wrongdoers!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not fret because of evildoers, Nor be envious of the workers of iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t worry about the wicked or envy those who do wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not get upset because of evildoers, Do not be envious of wrongdoers.
verses.textEn: Do not fret because of those who are evil or be envious of those who do wrong;

verses.textZh: 因为他们好象草快要枯干， 像即将凋萎的青草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们好象草快要枯干， 像即将凋萎的青草。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们如草快被割下， 又如青菜快要枯干。
verses.textEnNiv: for like the grass they will soon wither, like green plants they will soon die away.
verses.textEnEsv: For they will soon fade like the grass and wither like the green herb.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb.
verses.textEnNlt: For like grass, they soon fade away. Like spring flowers, they soon wither.
verses.textEnNasb: For they will wither quickly like the grass, And decay like the green plants.
verses.textEn: for like the grass they will soon wither, like green plants they will soon die away.

verses.textZh: 你要倚靠耶和华，并要行善； 你要住在地上，以信实为粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要倚靠耶和华，并要行善； 你要住在地上，以信实为粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当倚靠耶和华而行善， 住在地上，以他的信实为粮；
verses.textEnNiv: Trust in the Lord and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.
verses.textEnEsv: Trust in the Lord , and do good; dwell in the land and befriend faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Trust in the Lord, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on His faithfulness.
verses.textEnNlt: Trust in the Lord and do good. Then you will live safely in the land and prosper.
verses.textEnNasb: Trust in the Lord and do good; Live in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
verses.textEn: Trust in the Lord and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.

verses.textZh: 你要以耶和华为乐， 他就把你心里所求的赐给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要以耶和华为乐， 他就把你心里所求的赐给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要以耶和华为乐， 他就将你心里所求的赐给你。
verses.textEnNiv: Take delight in the Lord , and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Delight yourself in the Lord , and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Delight yourself also in the Lord, And He shall give you the desires of your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Take delight in the Lord , and he will give you your heart’s desires.
verses.textEnNasb: Delight yourself in the Lord; And He will give you the desires of your heart.
verses.textEn: Take delight in the Lord , and he will give you the desires of your heart.

verses.textZh: 你要把你的道路交托耶和华， 并倚靠他，他就必成全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把你的道路交托耶和华， 并倚靠他，他就必成全。
verses.textZhCuv: 当将你的事交托耶和华， 并倚靠他，他就必成全。
verses.textEnNiv: Commit your way to the Lord ; trust in him and he will do this:
verses.textEnEsv: Commit your way to the Lord ; trust in him, and he will act.
verses.textEnNkjv: Commit your way to the Lord, Trust also in Him, And He shall bring it to pass.
verses.textEnNlt: Commit everything you do to the Lord . Trust him, and he will help you.
verses.textEnNasb: Commit your way to the Lord, Trust also in Him, and He will do it.
verses.textEn: Commit your way to the Lord ; trust in him and he will do this:

verses.textZh: 他必使你的公义好象光发出， 使你的公正如日中天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必使你的公义好象光发出， 使你的公正如日中天。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要使你的公义如光发出， 使你的公平明如正午。
verses.textEnNiv: He will make your righteous reward shine like the dawn, your vindication like the noonday sun.
verses.textEnEsv: He will bring forth your righteousness as the light, and your justice as the noonday.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, And your justice as the noonday.
verses.textEnNlt: He will make your innocence radiate like the dawn, and the justice of your cause will shine like the noonday sun.
verses.textEnNasb: He will bring out your righteousness as the light, And your judgment as the noonday.
verses.textEn: He will make your righteous reward shine like the dawn, your vindication like the noonday sun.

verses.textZh: 你要在耶和华面前静默无声， 耐心地等候他； 不要因那凡事顺利的， 和那恶谋得逞的，心怀不平。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在耶和华面前静默无声， 耐心地等候他； 不要因那凡事顺利的， 和那恶谋得逞的，心怀不平。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当默然倚靠耶和华，耐性等候他； 不要因那道路通达的和那恶谋成就的心怀不平。
verses.textEnNiv: Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for him; do not fret when people succeed in their ways, when they carry out their wicked schemes.
verses.textEnEsv: Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for him; fret not yourself over the one who prospers in his way, over the man who carries out evil devices!
verses.textEnNkjv: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for Him; Do not fret because of him who prospers in his way, Because of the man who brings wicked schemes to pass.
verses.textEnNlt: Be still in the presence of the Lord , and wait patiently for him to act. Don’t worry about evil people who prosper or fret about their wicked schemes.
verses.textEnNasb: Rest in the Lord and wait patiently for Him; Do not get upset because of one who is successful in his way, Because of the person who carries out wicked schemes.
verses.textEn: Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for him; do not fret when people succeed in their ways, when they carry out their wicked schemes.

verses.textZh: 你要抑制怒气，消除烈怒； 不要心怀不平，那只会导致你作恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要抑制怒气，消除烈怒； 不要心怀不平，那只会导致你作恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 当止住怒气，离弃忿怒； 不要心怀不平，以致作恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Refrain from anger and turn from wrath; do not fret—it leads only to evil.
verses.textEnEsv: Refrain from anger, and forsake wrath! Fret not yourself; it tends only to evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; Do not fret—it only causes harm.
verses.textEnNlt: Stop being angry! Turn from your rage! Do not lose your temper— it only leads to harm.
verses.textEnNasb: Cease from anger and abandon wrath; Do not get upset; it leads only to evildoing.
verses.textEn: Refrain from anger and turn from wrath; do not fret—it leads only to evil.

verses.textZh: 因为作恶的必被剪除， 但等候耶和华的必承受地土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为作恶的必被剪除， 但等候耶和华的必承受地土。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为作恶的必被剪除； 惟有等候耶和华的必承受地土。
verses.textEnNiv: For those who are evil will be destroyed, but those who hope in the Lord will inherit the land.
verses.textEnEsv: For the evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the Lord shall inherit the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: For evildoers shall be cut off; But those who wait on the Lord, They shall inherit the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: For the wicked will be destroyed, but those who trust in the Lord will possess the land.
verses.textEnNasb: For evildoers will be eliminated, But those who wait for the Lord, they will inherit the land.
verses.textEn: For those who are evil will be destroyed, but those who hope in the Lord will inherit the land.

verses.textZh: 再过不久，恶人就不存在了； 你到他的地方寻找，也找不到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再过不久，恶人就不存在了； 你到他的地方寻找，也找不到。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有片时，恶人要归于无有； 你就是细察他的住处也要归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: A little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
verses.textEnEsv: In just a little while, the wicked will be no more; though you look carefully at his place, he will not be there.
verses.textEnNkjv: For yet a little while and the wicked shallbe no more; Indeed, you will look carefully for his place, But it shallbe no more.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon the wicked will disappear. Though you look for them, they will be gone.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet a little while and the wicked person will be no more; And you will look carefully for his place and he will not be there.
verses.textEn: A little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

verses.textZh: 但谦卑的人必承受地土， 可以享受丰盛的平安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但谦卑的人必承受地土， 可以享受丰盛的平安。
verses.textZhCuv: 但谦卑人必承受地土， 以丰盛的平安为乐。
verses.textEnNiv: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy peace and prosperity.
verses.textEnEsv: But the meek shall inherit the land and delight themselves in abundant peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the meek shall inherit the earth, And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.textEnNlt: The lowly will possess the land and will live in peace and prosperity.
verses.textEnNasb: But the humble will inherit the land And will delight themselves in abundant prosperity.
verses.textEn: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy peace and prosperity.

verses.textZh: 恶人谋害义人， 向他咬牙切齿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人谋害义人， 向他咬牙切齿；
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人设谋害义人， 又向他咬牙。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked plot against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them;
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked plots against the righteous and gnashes his teeth at him,
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked plots against the just, And gnashes at him with his teeth.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked plot against the godly; they snarl at them in defiance.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked plots against the righteous, And gnashes at him with his teeth.
verses.textEn: The wicked plot against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them;

verses.textZh: 但主必笑他， 因为知道他遭报的日子快要来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但主必笑他， 因为知道他遭报的日子快要来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 主要笑他， 因见他受罚的日子将要来到。
verses.textEnNiv: but the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he knows their day is coming.
verses.textEnEsv: but the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he sees that his day is coming.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord laughs at him, For He sees that his day is coming.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord just laughs, for he sees their day of judgment coming.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord laughs at him, For He sees that his day is coming.
verses.textEn: but the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he knows their day is coming.

verses.textZh: 恶人已经拔出刀来，拉开了弓， 要打倒困苦和贫穷的人， 杀害行为正直的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人已经拔出刀来，拉开了弓， 要打倒困苦和贫穷的人， 杀害行为正直的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人已经弓上弦，刀出鞘， 要打倒困苦穷乏的人， 要杀害行动正直的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked draw the sword and bend the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked draw the sword and bend their bows to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose way is upright;
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked have drawn the sword And have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, To slay those who are of upright conduct.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked draw their swords and string their bows to kill the poor and the oppressed, to slaughter those who do right.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent their bow To take down the afflicted and the needy, To kill off those who are upright in conduct.
verses.textEn: The wicked draw the sword and bend the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.

verses.textZh: 他们的刀必刺入自己的心， 他们的弓必被折断。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的刀必刺入自己的心， 他们的弓必被折断。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的刀必刺入自己的心； 他们的弓必被折断。
verses.textEnNiv: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
verses.textEnEsv: their sword shall enter their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their sword shall enter their own heart, And their bows shall be broken.
verses.textEnNlt: But their swords will stab their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
verses.textEnNasb: Their sword will enter their own heart, And their bows will be broken.
verses.textEn: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

verses.textZh: 一个义人拥有的虽少， 胜过许多恶人的财富。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一个义人拥有的虽少， 胜过许多恶人的财富。
verses.textZhCuv: 一个义人所有的虽少， 强过许多恶人的富余。
verses.textEnNiv: Better the little that the righteous have than the wealth of many wicked;
verses.textEnEsv: Better is the little that the righteous has than the abundance of many wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: A little that a righteous man has Is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: It is better to be godly and have little than to be evil and rich.
verses.textEnNasb: Better is the little of the righteous Than the abundance of many wicked.
verses.textEn: Better the little that the righteous have than the wealth of many wicked;

verses.textZh: 因为恶人的膀臂必被折断， 耶和华却扶持义人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为恶人的膀臂必被折断， 耶和华却扶持义人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为恶人的膀臂必被折断； 但耶和华是扶持义人。
verses.textEnNiv: for the power of the wicked will be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, But the Lord upholds the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: For the strength of the wicked will be shattered, but the Lord takes care of the godly.
verses.textEnNasb: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, But the Lord sustains the righteous.
verses.textEn: for the power of the wicked will be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.

verses.textZh: 耶和华眷顾完全人在世的日子， 他们的产业必存到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华眷顾完全人在世的日子， 他们的产业必存到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华知道完全人的日子； 他们的产业要存到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: The blameless spend their days under the Lord ’s care, and their inheritance will endure forever.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord knows the days of the blameless, and their heritage will remain forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord knows the days of the upright, And their inheritance shall be forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Day by day the Lord takes care of the innocent, and they will receive an inheritance that lasts forever.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord knows the days of the blameless, And their inheritance will be forever.
verses.textEn: The blameless spend their days under the Lord ’s care, and their inheritance will endure forever.

verses.textZh: 在患难的时候，他们必不蒙羞； 在饥荒的日子，他们必得饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在患难的时候，他们必不蒙羞； 在饥荒的日子，他们必得饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在急难的时候不致羞愧， 在饥荒的日子必得饱足。
verses.textEnNiv: In times of disaster they will not wither; in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.
verses.textEnEsv: they are not put to shame in evil times; in the days of famine they have abundance.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time, And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.textEnNlt: They will not be disgraced in hard times; even in famine they will have more than enough.
verses.textEnNasb: They will not be ashamed in the time of evil, And in the days of famine they will have plenty.
verses.textEn: In times of disaster they will not wither; in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.

verses.textZh: 恶人却必灭亡； 耶和华的仇敌好象草场的华美， 他们必要消失，像烟一般消失。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人却必灭亡； 耶和华的仇敌好象草场的华美， 他们必要消失，像烟一般消失。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人却要灭亡。 耶和华的仇敌要像羊羔的脂油 ； 他们要消灭，要如烟消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: But the wicked will perish: Though the Lord ’s enemies are like the flowers of the field, they will be consumed, they will go up in smoke.
verses.textEnEsv: But the wicked will perish; the enemies of the Lord are like the glory of the pastures; they vanish—like smoke they vanish away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the wicked shall perish; And the enemies of the Lord, Like the splendor of the meadows, shall vanish. Into smoke they shall vanish away.
verses.textEnNlt: But the wicked will die. The Lord ’s enemies are like flowers in a field— they will disappear like smoke.
verses.textEnNasb: But the wicked will perish; And the enemies of the Lord will be like the glory of the pastures, They vanish—like smoke they vanish away.
verses.textEn: But the wicked will perish: Though the Lord ’s enemies are like the flowers of the field, they will be consumed, they will go up in smoke.

verses.textZh: 恶人借贷总不偿还， 义人却慷慨施舍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人借贷总不偿还， 义人却慷慨施舍。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人借贷而不偿还； 义人却恩待人，并且施舍。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous give generously;
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked borrows but does not pay back, but the righteous is generous and gives;
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked borrows and does not repay, But the righteous shows mercy and gives.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked borrow and never repay, but the godly are generous givers.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked borrows and does not pay back, But the righteous is gracious and gives.
verses.textEn: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous give generously;

verses.textZh: 蒙耶和华赐福的，必承受地土； 受他咒诅的，必被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蒙耶和华赐福的，必承受地土； 受他咒诅的，必被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 蒙耶和华赐福的必承受地土； 被他咒诅的必被剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: those the Lord blesses will inherit the land, but those he curses will be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: for those blessed by the Lord shall inherit the land, but those cursed by him shall be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: For those blessed by Him shall inherit the earth, But those cursed by Him shall be cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: Those the Lord blesses will possess the land, but those he curses will die.
verses.textEnNasb: For those blessed by Him will inherit the land, But those cursed by Him will be eliminated.
verses.textEn: those the Lord blesses will inherit the land, but those he curses will be destroyed.

verses.textZh: 人的脚步是耶和华立定的， 他的道路也是耶和华喜悦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的脚步是耶和华立定的， 他的道路也是耶和华喜悦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的脚步被耶和华立定； 他的道路，耶和华也喜爱。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord makes firm the steps of the one who delights in him;
verses.textEnEsv: The steps of a man are established by the Lord , when he delights in his way;
verses.textEnNkjv: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, And He delights in his way.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord directs the steps of the godly. He delights in every detail of their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: The steps of a man are established by the Lord, And He delights in his way.
verses.textEn: The Lord makes firm the steps of the one who delights in him;

verses.textZh: 他虽然跌跤，却不至仆倒； 因为耶和华用手扶持他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他虽然跌跤，却不至仆倒； 因为耶和华用手扶持他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他虽失脚也不至全身仆倒， 因为耶和华用手搀扶他 。
verses.textEnNiv: though he may stumble, he will not fall, for the Lord upholds him with his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: though he fall, he shall not be cast headlong, for the Lord upholds his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For the Lord upholds himwith His hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Though they stumble, they will never fall, for the Lord holds them by the hand.
verses.textEnNasb: When he falls, he will not be hurled down, Because the Lord is the One who holds his hand.
verses.textEn: though he may stumble, he will not fall, for the Lord upholds him with his hand.

verses.textZh: 我从前年幼，现在年老， 从未见过义人被弃， 也从未见过他的后裔讨饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从前年幼，现在年老， 从未见过义人被弃， 也从未见过他的后裔讨饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从前年幼，现在年老， 却未见过义人被弃， 也未见过他的后裔讨饭。
verses.textEnNiv: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.
verses.textEnEsv: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken or his children begging for bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have been young, and now am old; Yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his descendants begging bread.
verses.textEnNlt: Once I was young, and now I am old. Yet I have never seen the godly abandoned or their children begging for bread.
verses.textEnNasb: I have been young and now I am old, Yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken Or his descendants begging for bread.
verses.textEn: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.

verses.textZh: 他常常慷慨借给人； 他的后裔必定蒙福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他常常慷慨借给人； 他的后裔必定蒙福。
verses.textZhCuv: 他终日恩待人，借给人； 他的后裔也蒙福！
verses.textEnNiv: They are always generous and lend freely; their children will be a blessing.
verses.textEnEsv: He is ever lending generously, and his children become a blessing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heis ever merciful, and lends; And his descendants are blessed.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly always give generous loans to others, and their children are a blessing.
verses.textEnNasb: All day long he is gracious and lends, And his descendants are a blessing.
verses.textEn: They are always generous and lend freely; their children will be a blessing.

verses.textZh: 应当离恶行善， 你就可以永远安居。
verses.textZhCnvs: 应当离恶行善， 你就可以永远安居。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当离恶行善， 就可永远安居。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn from evil and do good; then you will dwell in the land forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn away from evil and do good; so shall you dwell forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell forevermore.
verses.textEnNlt: Turn from evil and do good, and you will live in the land forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Turn from evil and do good, So that you will dwell forever.
verses.textEn: Turn from evil and do good; then you will dwell in the land forever.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华喜爱公正， 也不撇弃他的圣民； 他们必永远蒙庇佑， 恶人的后裔却必被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华喜爱公正， 也不撇弃他的圣民； 他们必永远蒙庇佑， 恶人的后裔却必被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，耶和华喜爱公平， 不撇弃他的圣民； 他们永蒙保佑， 但恶人的后裔必被剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord loves the just and will not forsake his faithful ones. Wrongdoers will be completely destroyed ; the offspring of the wicked will perish.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord loves justice; he will not forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord loves justice, And does not forsake His saints; They are preserved forever, But the descendants of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord loves justice, and he will never abandon the godly. He will keep them safe forever, but the children of the wicked will die.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord loves justice And does not abandon His godly ones; They are protected forever, But the descendants of the wicked will be eliminated.
verses.textEn: For the Lord loves the just and will not forsake his faithful ones. Wrongdoers will be completely destroyed ; the offspring of the wicked will perish.

verses.textZh: 义人必承受地土， 永远居住在自己的地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人必承受地土， 永远居住在自己的地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人必承受地土， 永居其上。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous shall inherit the land and dwell upon it forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell in it forever.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly will possess the land and will live there forever.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous will inherit the land And dwell in it forever.
verses.textEn: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

verses.textZh: 义人的口说出智慧， 他的舌头讲论正义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的口说出智慧， 他的舌头讲论正义。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人的口谈论智慧； 他的舌头讲说公平。
verses.textEnNiv: The mouths of the righteous utter wisdom, and their tongues speak what is just.
verses.textEnEsv: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, And his tongue talks of justice.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly offer good counsel; they teach right from wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, And his tongue speaks justice.
verses.textEn: The mouths of the righteous utter wisdom, and their tongues speak what is just.

verses.textZh: 神的律法在他心里， 他的脚步必不滑跌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的律法在他心里， 他的脚步必不滑跌。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的律法在他心里； 他的脚总不滑跌。
verses.textEnNiv: The law of their God is in their hearts; their feet do not slip.
verses.textEnEsv: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not slip.
verses.textEnNkjv: The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps shall slide.
verses.textEnNlt: They have made God’s law their own, so they will never slip from his path.
verses.textEnNasb: The Law of his God is in his heart; His steps do not slip.
verses.textEn: The law of their God is in their hearts; their feet do not slip.

verses.textZh: 恶人窥伺义人， 想要杀死他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人窥伺义人， 想要杀死他。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人窥探义人， 想要杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked lie in wait for the righteous, intent on putting them to death;
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked watches for the righteous and seeks to put him to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked watches the righteous, And seeks to slay him.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked wait in ambush for the godly, looking for an excuse to kill them.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked spies upon the righteous And seeks to kill him.
verses.textEn: The wicked lie in wait for the righteous, intent on putting them to death;

verses.textZh: 耶和华必不把他撇弃在恶人的手中， 在审判的时候，也不定他的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必不把他撇弃在恶人的手中， 在审判的时候，也不定他的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必不撇他在恶人手中； 当审判的时候，也不定他的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: but the Lord will not leave them in the power of the wicked or let them be condemned when brought to trial.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will not abandon him to his power or let him be condemned when he is brought to trial.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord will not let the wicked succeed or let the godly be condemned when they are put on trial.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will not leave him in his hand Or let him be condemned when he is judged.
verses.textEn: but the Lord will not leave them in the power of the wicked or let them be condemned when brought to trial.

verses.textZh: 你要等候耶和华，谨守他的道； 他必高举你，使你承受地土； 恶人被剪除的时候，你必看见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要等候耶和华，谨守他的道； 他必高举你，使你承受地土； 恶人被剪除的时候，你必看见。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当等候耶和华，遵守他的道， 他就抬举你，使你承受地土； 恶人被剪除的时候，你必看见。
verses.textEnNiv: Hope in the Lord and keep his way. He will exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are destroyed, you will see it.
verses.textEnEsv: Wait for the Lord and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land; you will look on when the wicked are cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wait on the Lord, And keep His way, And He shall exalt you to inherit the land; When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
verses.textEnNlt: Put your hope in the Lord . Travel steadily along his path. He will honor you by giving you the land. You will see the wicked destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: Wait for the Lord and keep His way, And He will exalt you to inherit the land; When the wicked are eliminated, you will see it.
verses.textEn: Hope in the Lord and keep his way. He will exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are destroyed, you will see it.

verses.textZh: 我曾看见强暴的恶人兴旺， 像树木在本土茂盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾看见强暴的恶人兴旺， 像树木在本土茂盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见过恶人大有势力， 好像一棵青翠树在本土生发。
verses.textEnNiv: I have seen a wicked and ruthless man flourishing like a luxuriant native tree,
verses.textEnEsv: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man, spreading himself like a green laurel tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a native green tree.
verses.textEnNlt: I have seen wicked and ruthless people flourishing like a tree in its native soil.
verses.textEnNasb: I have seen a wicked, violent person Spreading himself like a luxuriant tree in its native soil.
verses.textEn: I have seen a wicked and ruthless man flourishing like a luxuriant native tree,

verses.textZh: 但他很快就消逝，不再存在了； 我寻找他，却找不到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他很快就消逝，不再存在了； 我寻找他，却找不到。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人从那里经过，不料，他没有了； 我也寻找他，却寻不着。
verses.textEnNiv: but he soon passed away and was no more; though I looked for him, he could not be found.
verses.textEnEsv: But he passed away, and behold, he was no more; though I sought him, he could not be found.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet he passed away, and behold, he was no more; Indeed I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.textEnNlt: But when I looked again, they were gone! Though I searched for them, I could not find them!
verses.textEnNasb: Then he passed away, and behold, he was no more; I searched for him, but he could not be found.
verses.textEn: but he soon passed away and was no more; though I looked for him, he could not be found.

verses.textZh: 你要细察完全人，观看正直人； 因为爱和平的必有后代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要细察完全人，观看正直人； 因为爱和平的必有后代。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要细察那完全人，观看那正直人， 因为和平人有好结局。
verses.textEnNiv: Consider the blameless, observe the upright; a future awaits those who seek peace.
verses.textEnEsv: Mark the blameless and behold the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mark the blameless man, and observe the upright; For the future of that man is peace.
verses.textEnNlt: Look at those who are honest and good, for a wonderful future awaits those who love peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Observe the blameless person, and look at the upright; For the person of peace will have a future.
verses.textEn: Consider the blameless, observe the upright; a future awaits those who seek peace.

verses.textZh: 犯罪的人必一同灭绝， 恶人的后代必被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犯罪的人必一同灭绝， 恶人的后代必被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于犯法的人，必一同灭绝； 恶人终必剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: But all sinners will be destroyed; there will be no future for the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: But transgressors shall be altogether destroyed; the future of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together; The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: But the rebellious will be destroyed; they have no future.
verses.textEnNasb: But wrongdoers will altogether be destroyed; The future of the wicked will be eliminated.
verses.textEn: But all sinners will be destroyed; there will be no future for the wicked.

verses.textZh: 义人的拯救是由耶和华而来； 在患难的时候，他作他们的避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人的拯救是由耶和华而来； 在患难的时候，他作他们的避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 但义人得救是由于耶和华； 他在患难时作他们的营寨。
verses.textEnNiv: The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord ; he is their stronghold in time of trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: The salvation of the righteous is from the Lord ; he is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord; Heis their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord rescues the godly; he is their fortress in times of trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: But the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord; He is their strength in time of trouble.
verses.textEn: The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord ; he is their stronghold in time of trouble.

verses.textZh: 耶和华帮助他们，搭救他们； 他搭救他们脱离恶人，拯救他们， 因为他们投靠他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华帮助他们，搭救他们； 他搭救他们脱离恶人，拯救他们， 因为他们投靠他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华帮助他们，解救他们； 他解救他们脱离恶人，把他们救出来， 因为他们投靠他。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord helps them and delivers them; he delivers them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord helps them and delivers them; he delivers them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord shall help them and deliver them; He shall deliver them from the wicked, And save them, Because they trust in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord helps them, rescuing them from the wicked. He saves them, and they find shelter in him.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord helps them and rescues them; He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, Because they take refuge in Him.
verses.textEn: The Lord helps them and delivers them; he delivers them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.

verses.textZh: 大卫的记念诗。 耶和华啊！求你不要在忿怒中责备我， 也不要在烈怒中管教我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的记念诗。 耶和华啊！求你不要在忿怒中责备我， 也不要在烈怒中管教我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你不要在怒中责备我， 不要在烈怒中惩罚我！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , rebuke me not in your anger, nor discipline me in your wrath!
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, do not rebuke me in Your wrath, Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure!
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , don’t rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your rage!
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, do not rebuke me in Your wrath, And do not punish me in Your burning anger.
verses.textEn: Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.

verses.textZh: 因为你的箭射入我身， 你的手压住我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你的箭射入我身， 你的手压住我。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，你的箭射入我身； 你的手压住我。
verses.textEnNiv: Your arrows have pierced me, and your hand has come down on me.
verses.textEnEsv: For your arrows have sunk into me, and your hand has come down on me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Your arrows pierce me deeply, And Your hand presses me down.
verses.textEnNlt: Your arrows have struck deep, and your blows are crushing me.
verses.textEnNasb: For Your arrows have sunk deep into me, And Your hand has pressed down on me.
verses.textEn: Your arrows have pierced me, and your hand has come down on me.

verses.textZh: 因你的忿怒，我体无完肤； 因我的罪恶，我的骨头都不安妥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你的忿怒，我体无完肤； 因我的罪恶，我的骨头都不安妥。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你的恼怒，我的肉无一完全； 因我的罪过，我的骨头也不安宁。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of your wrath there is no health in my body; there is no soundness in my bones because of my sin.
verses.textEnEsv: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation; there is no health in my bones because of my sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis no soundness in my flesh Because of Your anger, Nor any health in my bones Because of my sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of your anger, my whole body is sick; my health is broken because of my sins.
verses.textEnNasb: There is no healthy part in my flesh because of Your indignation; There is no health in my bones because of my sin.
verses.textEn: Because of your wrath there is no health in my body; there is no soundness in my bones because of my sin.

verses.textZh: 我的罪孽高过我的头， 如同重担，使我担当不起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的罪孽高过我的头， 如同重担，使我担当不起。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的罪孽高过我的头， 如同重担叫我担当不起。
verses.textEnNiv: My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.
verses.textEnEsv: For my iniquities have gone over my head; like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For my iniquities have gone over my head; Like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.textEnNlt: My guilt overwhelms me— it is a burden too heavy to bear.
verses.textEnNasb: For my guilty deeds have gone over my head; Like a heavy burden they weigh too much for me.
verses.textEn: My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.

verses.textZh: 因为我的愚昧， 我的伤口发臭流脓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我的愚昧， 我的伤口发臭流脓。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我的愚昧， 我的伤发臭流脓。
verses.textEnNiv: My wounds fester and are loathsome because of my sinful folly.
verses.textEnEsv: My wounds stink and fester because of my foolishness,
verses.textEnNkjv: My wounds are foul and festering Because of my foolishness.
verses.textEnNlt: My wounds fester and stink because of my foolish sins.
verses.textEnNasb: My wounds grow foul and fester Because of my foolishness.
verses.textEn: My wounds fester and are loathsome because of my sinful folly.

verses.textZh: 我屈身弯腰，弯到极低， 整天哀痛，到处行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我屈身弯腰，弯到极低， 整天哀痛，到处行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 我疼痛，大大拳曲， 终日哀痛。
verses.textEnNiv: I am bowed down and brought very low; all day long I go about mourning.
verses.textEnEsv: I am utterly bowed down and prostrate; all the day I go about mourning.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am troubled, I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.textEnNlt: I am bent over and racked with pain. All day long I walk around filled with grief.
verses.textEnNasb: I am bent over and greatly bowed down; I go in mourning all day long.
verses.textEn: I am bowed down and brought very low; all day long I go about mourning.

verses.textZh: 我的两腰灼痛， 我体无完肤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的两腰灼痛， 我体无完肤。
verses.textZhCuv: 我满腰是火； 我的肉无一完全。
verses.textEnNiv: My back is filled with searing pain; there is no health in my body.
verses.textEnEsv: For my sides are filled with burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: For my loins are full of inflammation, And thereis no soundness in my flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: A raging fever burns within me, and my health is broken.
verses.textEnNasb: For my sides are filled with burning, And there is no healthy part in my flesh.
verses.textEn: My back is filled with searing pain; there is no health in my body.

verses.textZh: 我已经疲乏无力，被压得粉碎了； 我因心里痛苦而唉哼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已经疲乏无力，被压得粉碎了； 我因心里痛苦而唉哼。
verses.textZhCuv: 我被压伤，身体疲倦； 因心里不安，我就唉哼。
verses.textEnNiv: I am feeble and utterly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
verses.textEnEsv: I am feeble and crushed; I groan because of the tumult of my heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am feeble and severely broken; I groan because of the turmoil of my heart.
verses.textEnNlt: I am exhausted and completely crushed. My groans come from an anguished heart.
verses.textEnNasb: I feel faint and badly crushed; I groan because of the agitation of my heart.
verses.textEn: I am feeble and utterly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

verses.textZh: 主啊！我的心愿都在你面前， 我不向你隐瞒我的叹息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！我的心愿都在你面前， 我不向你隐瞒我的叹息。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，我的心愿都在你面前； 我的叹息不向你隐瞒。
verses.textEnNiv: All my longings lie open before you, Lord; my sighing is not hidden from you.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord, all my longing is before you; my sighing is not hidden from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, all my desire is before You; And my sighing is not hidden from You.
verses.textEnNlt: You know what I long for, Lord; you hear my every sigh.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, all my desire is before You; And my sighing is not hidden from You.
verses.textEn: All my longings lie open before you, Lord; my sighing is not hidden from you.

verses.textZh: 我的心剧烈跳动，我的力量衰退； 连我眼中的光彩也消逝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心剧烈跳动，我的力量衰退； 连我眼中的光彩也消逝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心跳动，我力衰微， 连我眼中的光也没有了。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light has gone from my eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: My heart throbs; my strength fails me, and the light of my eyes—it also has gone from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My heart pants, my strength fails me; As for the light of my eyes, it also has gone from me.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart beats wildly, my strength fails, and I am going blind.
verses.textEnNasb: My heart throbs, my strength fails me; And the light of my eyes, even that has gone from me.
verses.textEn: My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light has gone from my eyes.

verses.textZh: 我的良朋密友因我的灾祸，都站到一旁去； 我的亲人也都站得远远的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良朋密友因我的灾祸，都站到一旁去； 我的亲人也都站得远远的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良朋密友因我的灾病都躲在旁边站着； 我的亲戚本家也远远地站立。
verses.textEnNiv: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.
verses.textEnEsv: My friends and companions stand aloof from my plague, and my nearest kin stand far off.
verses.textEnNkjv: My loved ones and my friends stand aloof from my plague, And my relatives stand afar off.
verses.textEnNlt: My loved ones and friends stay away, fearing my disease. Even my own family stands at a distance.
verses.textEnNasb: My loved ones and my friends stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand far away.
verses.textEn: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.

verses.textZh: 那些寻索我命的，设下网罗； 那些想要害我的，口说威吓的话， 他们整天思想诡计。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些寻索我命的，设下网罗； 那些想要害我的，口说威吓的话， 他们整天思想诡计。
verses.textZhCuv: 那寻索我命的设下网罗； 那想要害我的口出恶言， 终日思想诡计。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who want to kill me set their traps, those who would harm me talk of my ruin; all day long they scheme and lie.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who seek my life lay their snares; those who seek my hurt speak of ruin and meditate treachery all day long.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those also who seek my life lay snares forme; Those who seek my hurt speak of destruction, And plan deception all the day long.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, my enemies lay traps to kill me. Those who wish me harm make plans to ruin me. All day long they plan their treachery.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who seek my life lay snares for me; And those who seek to injure me have threatened destruction, And they plot deception all day long.
verses.textEn: Those who want to kill me set their traps, those who would harm me talk of my ruin; all day long they scheme and lie.

verses.textZh: 至于我，像个聋子，不能听见； 像个哑巴，不能开口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，像个聋子，不能听见； 像个哑巴，不能开口。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我如聋子不听， 像哑巴不开口。
verses.textEnNiv: I am like the deaf, who cannot hear, like the mute, who cannot speak;
verses.textEnEsv: But I am like a deaf man; I do not hear, like a mute man who does not open his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I, like a deaf man, do not hear; And Iam like a mute who does not open his mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: But I am deaf to all their threats. I am silent before them as one who cannot speak.
verses.textEnNasb: But I, like a person who is deaf, do not hear; And I am like a person who cannot speak, who does not open his mouth.
verses.textEn: I am like the deaf, who cannot hear, like the mute, who cannot speak;

verses.textZh: 我竟变成了一个像是不能听见的人， 变成了一个口中不能反驳的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我竟变成了一个像是不能听见的人， 变成了一个口中不能反驳的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我如不听见的人， 口中没有回话。
verses.textEnNiv: I have become like one who does not hear, whose mouth can offer no reply.
verses.textEnEsv: I have become like a man who does not hear, and in whose mouth are no rebukes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I am like a man who does not hear, And in whose mouth is no response.
verses.textEnNlt: I choose to hear nothing, and I make no reply.
verses.textEnNasb: Yes, I am like a person who does not hear, And in whose mouth are no arguments.
verses.textEn: I have become like one who does not hear, whose mouth can offer no reply.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我等候你； 主我的神啊！你必应允我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我等候你； 主我的神啊！你必应允我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我仰望你！ 主－我的神啊，你必应允我！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , I wait for you; you will answer, Lord my God.
verses.textEnEsv: But for you, O Lord , do I wait; it is you, O Lord my God, who will answer.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in You, O Lord, I hope; You will hear, O Lord my God.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am waiting for you, O Lord . You must answer for me, O Lord my God.
verses.textEnNasb: For I wait for You, Lord; You will answer, Lord my God.
verses.textEn: Lord , I wait for you; you will answer, Lord my God.

verses.textZh: 因为我曾说："恐怕他们向我夸耀； 我的脚滑跌的时候，不要让他们向我夸口。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我曾说："恐怕他们向我夸耀； 我的脚滑跌的时候，不要让他们向我夸口。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾说：恐怕他们向我夸耀； 我失脚的时候，他们向我夸大。
verses.textEnNiv: For I said, "Do not let them gloat or exalt themselves over me when my feet slip."
verses.textEnEsv: For I said, "Only let them not rejoice over me, who boast against me when my foot slips!"
verses.textEnNkjv: For I said, "Hear me, lest they rejoice over me, Lest, when my foot slips, they exalt themselves against me."
verses.textEnNlt: I prayed, "Don’t let my enemies gloat over me or rejoice at my downfall."
verses.textEnNasb: For I said, "May they not rejoice over me, Who, when my foot slips, would exalt themselves over me."
verses.textEn: For I said, "Do not let them gloat or exalt themselves over me when my feet slip."

verses.textZh: 我随时会跌倒， 我的痛苦常在我面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我随时会跌倒， 我的痛苦常在我面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 我几乎跌倒； 我的痛苦常在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
verses.textEnEsv: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.textEnNlt: I am on the verge of collapse, facing constant pain.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.textEn: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

verses.textZh: 我要承认我的罪孽， 我要因我的罪忧伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要承认我的罪孽， 我要因我的罪忧伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要承认我的罪孽； 我要因我的罪忧愁。
verses.textEnNiv: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
verses.textEnEsv: I confess my iniquity; I am sorry for my sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will declare my iniquity; I will be in anguish over my sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But I confess my sins; I am deeply sorry for what I have done.
verses.textEnNasb: For I admit my guilt; I am full of anxiety because of my sin.
verses.textEn: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

verses.textZh: 但我强悍的仇敌众多， 无理憎恨我的不断增加。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我强悍的仇敌众多， 无理憎恨我的不断增加。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我的仇敌又活泼又强壮， 无理恨我的增多了。
verses.textEnNiv: Many have become my enemies without cause ; those who hate me without reason are numerous.
verses.textEnEsv: But my foes are vigorous, they are mighty, and many are those who hate me wrongfully.
verses.textEnNkjv: But my enemies are vigorous, and they are strong; And those who hate me wrongfully have multiplied.
verses.textEnNlt: I have many aggressive enemies; they hate me without reason.
verses.textEnNasb: But my enemies are vigorous and strong, And those who wrongfully hate me are many.
verses.textEn: Many have become my enemies without cause ; those who hate me without reason are numerous.

verses.textZh: 那些以恶报善的都与我作对， 因为我追求良善。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些以恶报善的都与我作对， 因为我追求良善。
verses.textZhCuv: 以恶报善的与我作对， 因我是追求良善。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who repay my good with evil lodge accusations against me, though I seek only to do what is good.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who render me evil for good accuse me because I follow after good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those also who render evil for good, They are my adversaries, because I follow whatis good.
verses.textEnNlt: They repay me evil for good and oppose me for pursuing good.
verses.textEnNasb: And those who repay evil for good, They become my enemies, because I follow what is good.
verses.textEn: Those who repay my good with evil lodge accusations against me, though I seek only to do what is good.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你不要离弃我； 我的神啊，求你不要远离我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你不要离弃我； 我的神啊，求你不要远离我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你不要撇弃我！ 我的神啊，求你不要远离我！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , do not forsake me; do not be far from me, my God.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not forsake me, O Lord ! O my God, be not far from me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not forsake me, O Lord; O my God, be not far from me!
verses.textEnNlt: Do not abandon me, O Lord . Do not stand at a distance, my God.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not abandon me, Lord; My God, do not be far from me!
verses.textEn: Lord , do not forsake me; do not be far from me, my God.

verses.textZh: 拯救我的主啊！ 求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拯救我的主啊！ 求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCuv: 拯救我的主啊，求你快快帮助我！
verses.textEnNiv: Come quickly to help me, my Lord and my Savior.
verses.textEnEsv: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation!
verses.textEnNkjv: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation!
verses.textEnNlt: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my savior.
verses.textEnNasb: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation!
verses.textEn: Come quickly to help me, my Lord and my Savior.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长耶杜顿。 我曾说："我要谨慎我的行为， 不让我的舌头犯罪； 恶人在我面前的时候， 我总要用罩子约束我的嘴。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长耶杜顿。 我曾说："我要谨慎我的行为， 不让我的舌头犯罪； 恶人在我面前的时候， 我总要用罩子约束我的嘴。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾说：我要谨慎我的言行， 免得我舌头犯罪； 恶人在我面前的时候， 我要用嚼环勒住我的口。
verses.textEnNiv: I said, "I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth while in the presence of the wicked."
verses.textEnEsv: I said, "I will guard my ways, that I may not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle, so long as the wicked are in my presence."
verses.textEnNkjv: I said, "I will guard my ways, Lest I sin with my tongue; I will restrain my mouth with a muzzle, While the wicked are before me."
verses.textEnNlt: I said to myself, "I will watch what I do and not sin in what I say. I will hold my tongue when the ungodly are around me."
verses.textEnNasb: I said, "I will keep watch over my ways So that I do not sin with my tongue; I will keep watch over my mouth as with a muzzle While the wicked are in my presence."
verses.textEn: I said, "I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth while in the presence of the wicked."

verses.textZh: 我静默不出声， 甚至连好话也不说 ， 我的痛苦就更加剧烈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我静默不出声， 甚至连好话也不说 ， 我的痛苦就更加剧烈。
verses.textZhCuv: 我默然无声，连好话也不出口； 我的愁苦就发动了，
verses.textEnNiv: So I remained utterly silent, not even saying anything good. But my anguish increased;
verses.textEnEsv: I was mute and silent; I held my peace to no avail, and my distress grew worse.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was mute with silence, I held my peace even from good; And my sorrow was stirred up.
verses.textEnNlt: But as I stood there in silence— not even speaking of good things— the turmoil within me grew worse.
verses.textEnNasb: I was mute and silent, I refused to say even something good, And my pain was stirred up.
verses.textEn: So I remained utterly silent, not even saying anything good. But my anguish increased;

verses.textZh: 我的心在我里面发热； 我默想的时候，心里火烧； 我就用舌头说话：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心在我里面发热； 我默想的时候，心里火烧； 我就用舌头说话：
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心在我里面发热。 我默想的时候，火就烧起， 我便用舌头说话。
verses.textEnNiv: my heart grew hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:
verses.textEnEsv: My heart became hot within me. As I mused, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:
verses.textEnNkjv: My heart was hot within me; While I was musing, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
verses.textEnNlt: The more I thought about it, the hotter I got, igniting a fire of words:
verses.textEnNasb: My heart was hot within me, While I was musing the fire burned; Then I spoke with my tongue:
verses.textEn: my heart grew hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:

verses.textZh: "耶和华啊！求你使我知道我的结局， 我的寿数有多少， 使我知道我的生命多么短促。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华啊！求你使我知道我的结局， 我的寿数有多少， 使我知道我的生命多么短促。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你叫我晓得我身之终！ 我的寿数几何？ 叫我知道我的生命不长！
verses.textEnNiv: "Show me, Lord , my life’s end and the number of my days; let me know how fleeting my life is.
verses.textEnEsv: "O Lord , make me know my end and what is the measure of my days; let me know how fleeting I am!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lord, make me to know my end, And what is the measure of my days, That I may know how frail I am.
verses.textEnNlt: " Lord , remind me how brief my time on earth will be. Remind me that my days are numbered— how fleeting my life is.
verses.textEnNasb: "Lord, let me know my end, And what is the extent of my days; Let me know how transient I am.
verses.textEn: "Show me, Lord , my life’s end and the number of my days; let me know how fleeting my life is.

verses.textZh: 你使我的日子窄如手掌， 我的一生在你面前如同无有； 各人站得最稳的时候，也只不过是一口气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我的日子窄如手掌， 我的一生在你面前如同无有； 各人站得最稳的时候，也只不过是一口气。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我的年日窄如手掌； 我一生的年数，在你面前如同无有。 各人最稳妥的时候，真是全然虚幻。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: You have made my days a mere handbreadth; the span of my years is as nothing before you. Everyone is but a breath, even those who seem secure.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you have made my days a few handbreadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely all mankind stands as a mere breath! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, You have made my days as handbreadths, And my age is as nothing before You; Certainly every man at his best state is but vapor. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: You have made my life no longer than the width of my hand. My entire lifetime is just a moment to you; at best, each of us is but a breath." Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, You have made my days like hand widths, And my lifetime as nothing in Your sight; Certainly all mankind standing is a mere breath. Selah
verses.textEn: You have made my days a mere handbreadth; the span of my years is as nothing before you. Everyone is but a breath, even those who seem secure.

verses.textZh: 世人来来往往只是幻影， 他们忙乱也是虚空； 积聚财物，却不知道谁要来收取。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世人来来往往只是幻影， 他们忙乱也是虚空； 积聚财物，却不知道谁要来收取。
verses.textZhCuv: 世人行动实系幻影。 他们忙乱，真是枉然； 积蓄财宝，不知将来有谁收取。
verses.textEnNiv: "Surely everyone goes around like a mere phantom; in vain they rush about, heaping up wealth without knowing whose it will finally be.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely a man goes about as a shadow! Surely for nothing they are in turmoil; man heaps up wealth and does not know who will gather!
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely every man walks about like a shadow; Surely they busy themselves in vain; He heaps up riches, And does not know who will gather them.
verses.textEnNlt: We are merely moving shadows, and all our busy rushing ends in nothing. We heap up wealth, not knowing who will spend it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Certainly every person walks around as a fleeting shadow; They certainly make an uproar for nothing; He amasses riches and does not know who will gather them.
verses.textEn: "Surely everyone goes around like a mere phantom; in vain they rush about, heaping up wealth without knowing whose it will finally be.

verses.textZh: 主啊！现在我还等候甚么呢？ 我的指望在乎你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！现在我还等候甚么呢？ 我的指望在乎你。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，如今我等什么呢？ 我的指望在乎你！
verses.textEnNiv: "But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in you.
verses.textEnEsv: "And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in You.
verses.textEnNlt: And so, Lord, where do I put my hope? My only hope is in you.
verses.textEnNasb: "And now, Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
verses.textEn: "But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in you.

verses.textZh: 求你救我脱离我的一切过犯， 不要使我遭受愚顽人的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你救我脱离我的一切过犯， 不要使我遭受愚顽人的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你救我脱离一切的过犯， 不要使我受愚顽人的羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: Save me from all my transgressions; do not make me the scorn of fools.
verses.textEnEsv: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Do not make me the scorn of the fool!
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver me from all my transgressions; Do not make me the reproach of the foolish.
verses.textEnNlt: Rescue me from my rebellion. Do not let fools mock me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Save me from all my wrongdoings; Do not make me an object of reproach for the foolish.
verses.textEn: Save me from all my transgressions; do not make me the scorn of fools.

verses.textZh: 因为是你作了这事， 我就静默不开口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为是你作了这事， 我就静默不开口。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我所遭遇的是出于你， 我就默然不语。
verses.textEnNiv: I was silent; I would not open my mouth, for you are the one who has done this.
verses.textEnEsv: I am mute; I do not open my mouth, for it is you who have done it.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was mute, I did not open my mouth, Because it was You who did it.
verses.textEnNlt: I am silent before you; I won’t say a word, for my punishment is from you.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have become mute, I do not open my mouth, Because it is You who have done it.
verses.textEn: I was silent; I would not open my mouth, for you are the one who has done this.

verses.textZh: 求你除掉你降在我身上的灾祸； 因你手的责打，我就消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你除掉你降在我身上的灾祸； 因你手的责打，我就消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你把你的责罚从我身上免去； 因你手的责打，我便消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Remove your scourge from me; I am overcome by the blow of your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Remove your stroke from me; I am spent by the hostility of your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remove Your plague from me; I am consumed by the blow of Your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: But please stop striking me! I am exhausted by the blows from your hand.
verses.textEnNasb: "Remove Your plague from me; Because of the opposition of Your hand I am perishing.
verses.textEn: Remove your scourge from me; I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

verses.textZh: 你因人的罪孽，借着责罚管教他们， 叫他们所宝贵的消失，像被虫蛀蚀； 世人都不过是一口气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你因人的罪孽，借着责罚管教他们， 叫他们所宝贵的消失，像被虫蛀蚀； 世人都不过是一口气。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因人的罪恶惩罚他的时候， 叫他的笑容 消灭，如衣被虫所咬。 世人真是虚幻！ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: When you rebuke and discipline anyone for their sin, you consume their wealth like a moth— surely everyone is but a breath.
verses.textEnEsv: When you discipline a man with rebukes for sin, you consume like a moth what is dear to him; surely all mankind is a mere breath! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: When with rebukes You correct man for iniquity, You make his beauty melt away like a moth; Surely every man is vapor. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: When you discipline us for our sins, you consume like a moth what is precious to us. Each of us is but a breath. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: "With rebukes You punish a person for wrongdoing; You consume like a moth what is precious to him; Certainly all mankind is mere breath! Selah
verses.textEn: When you rebuke and discipline anyone for their sin, you consume their wealth like a moth— surely everyone is but a breath.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你垂听我的祷告， 留心听我的呼求； 我流泪，求你不要缄默； 因为我在你面前是客旅， 是寄居的，像我所有的祖先一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你垂听我的祷告， 留心听我的呼求； 我流泪，求你不要缄默； 因为我在你面前是客旅， 是寄居的，像我所有的祖先一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告， 留心听我的呼求！ 我流泪，求你不要静默无声！ 因为我在你面前是客旅， 是寄居的，像我列祖一般。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hear my prayer, Lord , listen to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. I dwell with you as a foreigner, a stranger, as all my ancestors were.
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear my prayer, O Lord , and give ear to my cry; hold not your peace at my tears! For I am a sojourner with you, a guest, like all my fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear my prayer, O Lord, And give ear to my cry; Do not be silent at my tears; For I am a stranger with You, A sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.textEnNlt: Hear my prayer, O Lord ! Listen to my cries for help! Don’t ignore my tears. For I am your guest— a traveler passing through, as my ancestors were before me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear my prayer, Lord, and listen to my cry for help; Do not be silent to my tears; For I am a stranger with You, One who lives abroad, like all my fathers.
verses.textEn: "Hear my prayer, Lord , listen to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. I dwell with you as a foreigner, a stranger, as all my ancestors were.

verses.textZh: 求你不要怒视我， 使我在去而不返之先，可以喜乐。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要怒视我， 使我在去而不返之先，可以喜乐。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你宽容我， 使我在去而不返之先可以力量复原。
verses.textEnNiv: Look away from me, that I may enjoy life again before I depart and am no more."
verses.textEnEsv: Look away from me, that I may smile again, before I depart and am no more!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Remove Your gaze from me, that I may regain strength, Before I go away and am no more."
verses.textEnNlt: Leave me alone so I can smile again before I am gone and exist no more.
verses.textEnNasb: "Turn Your eyes away from me, that I may become cheerful again Before I depart and am no more."
verses.textEn: Look away from me, that I may enjoy life again before I depart and am no more."

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 我曾切切等候耶和华； 他转向我，听了我的呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 我曾切切等候耶和华； 他转向我，听了我的呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾耐性等候耶和华； 他垂听我的呼求。
verses.textEnNiv: I waited patiently for the Lord ; he turned to me and heard my cry.
verses.textEnEsv: I waited patiently for the Lord ; he inclined to me and heard my cry.
verses.textEnNkjv: I waited patiently for the Lord; And He inclined to me, And heard my cry.
verses.textEnNlt: I waited patiently for the Lord to help me, and he turned to me and heard my cry.
verses.textEnNasb: I waited patiently for the Lord; And He reached down to me and heard my cry.
verses.textEn: I waited patiently for the Lord ; he turned to me and heard my cry.

verses.textZh: 他把我从荒芜的坑里， 从泥沼中拉上来； 他使我的脚站在盘石上， 又使我的脚步稳定。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把我从荒芜的坑里， 从泥沼中拉上来； 他使我的脚站在盘石上， 又使我的脚步稳定。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从祸坑里， 从淤泥中，把我拉上来， 使我的脚立在磐石上， 使我脚步稳当。
verses.textEnNiv: He lifted me out of the slimy pit, out of the mud and mire; he set my feet on a rock and gave me a firm place to stand.
verses.textEnEsv: He drew me up from the pit of destruction, out of the miry bog, and set my feet upon a rock, making my steps secure.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also brought me up out of a horrible pit, Out of the miry clay, And set my feet upon a rock, And established my steps.
verses.textEnNlt: He lifted me out of the pit of despair, out of the mud and the mire. He set my feet on solid ground and steadied me as I walked along.
verses.textEnNasb: He brought me up out of the pit of destruction, out of the mud; And He set my feet on a rock, making my footsteps firm.
verses.textEn: He lifted me out of the slimy pit, out of the mud and mire; he set my feet on a rock and gave me a firm place to stand.

verses.textZh: 他使我口唱新歌， 赞美我们的神； 许多人看见了，就必惧怕， 并且要倚靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我口唱新歌， 赞美我们的神； 许多人看见了，就必惧怕， 并且要倚靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我口唱新歌， 就是赞美我们神的话。 许多人必看见而惧怕， 并要倚靠耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear the Lord and put their trust in him.
verses.textEnEsv: He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see and fear, and put their trust in the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He has put a new song in my mouth— Praise to our God; Many will see it and fear, And will trust in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He has given me a new song to sing, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see what he has done and be amazed. They will put their trust in the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God; Many will see and fear And will trust in the Lord.
verses.textEn: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear the Lord and put their trust in him.

verses.textZh: 那倚靠耶和华， 不转向高傲和偏向虚谎的人的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那倚靠耶和华， 不转向高傲和偏向虚谎的人的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那倚靠耶和华、 不理会狂傲和偏向虚假之辈的， 这人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord , who does not look to the proud, to those who turn aside to false gods.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the man who makes the Lord his trust, who does not turn to the proud, to those who go astray after a lie!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is that man who makes the Lord his trust, And does not respect the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, the joys of those who trust the Lord , who have no confidence in the proud or in those who worship idols.
verses.textEnNasb: How blessed is the man who has made the Lord his trust, And has not turned to the proud, nor to those who become involved in falsehood.
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord , who does not look to the proud, to those who turn aside to false gods.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神啊！ 你所行的奇事，并你向我们所怀的意念很多， 没有人可以和你相比； 如果我要述说陈明， 也多到不能胜数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神啊！ 你所行的奇事，并你向我们所怀的意念很多， 没有人可以和你相比； 如果我要述说陈明， 也多到不能胜数。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神啊，你所行的奇事， 并你向我们所怀的意念甚多，不能向你陈明； 若要陈明，其事不可胜数。
verses.textEnNiv: Many, Lord my God, are the wonders you have done, the things you planned for us. None can compare with you; were I to speak and tell of your deeds, they would be too many to declare.
verses.textEnEsv: You have multiplied, O Lord my God, your wondrous deeds and your thoughts toward us; none can compare with you! I will proclaim and tell of them, yet they are more than can be told.
verses.textEnNkjv: Many, O Lord my God, are Your wonderful works Which You have done; And Your thoughts toward us Cannot be recounted to You in order; If I would declare and speak ofthem, They are more than can be numbered.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord my God, you have performed many wonders for us. Your plans for us are too numerous to list. You have no equal. If I tried to recite all your wonderful deeds, I would never come to the end of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Many, Lord my God, are the wonders which You have done, And Your thoughts toward us; There is no one to compare with You. If I would declare and speak of them, They would be too numerous to count.
verses.textEn: Many, Lord my God, are the wonders you have done, the things you planned for us. None can compare with you; were I to speak and tell of your deeds, they would be too many to declare.

verses.textZh: 祭品和礼物不是你喜悦的。 你开通了我的耳朵； 燔祭和赎罪祭，不是你要求的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭品和礼物不是你喜悦的。 你开通了我的耳朵； 燔祭和赎罪祭，不是你要求的。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭物和礼物，你不喜悦； 你已经开通我的耳朵。 燔祭和赎罪祭非你所要。
verses.textEnNiv: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire— but my ears you have opened — burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not require.
verses.textEnEsv: In sacrifice and offering you have not delighted, but you have given me an open ear. Burnt offering and sin offering you have not required.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire; My ears You have opened. Burnt offering and sin offering You did not require.
verses.textEnNlt: You take no delight in sacrifices or offerings. Now that you have made me listen, I finally understand — you don’t require burnt offerings or sin offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: You have not desired sacrifice and meal offering; You have opened my ears; You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.
verses.textEn: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire— but my ears you have opened — burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not require.

verses.textZh: 那时我说："看哪！我来了， 经卷上已经记载我的事；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时我说："看哪！我来了， 经卷上已经记载我的事；
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我说：看哪，我来了！ 我的事在经卷上已经记载了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said, "Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, "Behold, I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written of me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, "Behold, I come; In the scroll of the book itis written of me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "Look, I have come. As is written about me in the Scriptures:
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "Behold, I have come; It is written of me in the scroll of the book.
verses.textEn: Then I said, "Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll.

verses.textZh: 我的神啊！我乐意遵行你的旨意； 你的律法常在我的心里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神啊！我乐意遵行你的旨意； 你的律法常在我的心里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，我乐意照你的旨意行； 你的律法在我心里。
verses.textEnNiv: I desire to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart."
verses.textEnEsv: I delight to do your will, O my God; your law is within my heart."
verses.textEnNkjv: I delight to do Your will, O my God, And Your law is within my heart."
verses.textEnNlt: I take joy in doing your will, my God, for your instructions are written on my heart."
verses.textEnNasb: "I delight to do Your will, my God; Your Law is within my heart."
verses.textEn: I desire to do your will, my God; your law is within my heart."

verses.textZh: 我要在大会中传扬公义的福音； 我必不禁止我的嘴唇； 耶和华啊！这是你知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在大会中传扬公义的福音； 我必不禁止我的嘴唇； 耶和华啊！这是你知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在大会中宣传公义的佳音； 我必不止住我的嘴唇。 耶和华啊，这是你所知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: I proclaim your saving acts in the great assembly; I do not seal my lips, Lord , as you know.
verses.textEnEsv: I have told the glad news of deliverance in the great congregation; behold, I have not restrained my lips, as you know, O Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I have proclaimed the good news of righteousness In the great assembly; Indeed, I do not restrain my lips, O Lord, You Yourself know.
verses.textEnNlt: I have told all your people about your justice. I have not been afraid to speak out, as you, O Lord , well know.
verses.textEnNasb: I have proclaimed good news of righteousness in the great congregation; Behold, I will not restrain my lips, Lord, You know.
verses.textEn: I proclaim your saving acts in the great assembly; I do not seal my lips, Lord , as you know.

verses.textZh: 我没有把你的公义隐藏在心里； 我已经述说了你的信实和救恩； 在大会中，我没有隐瞒你的慈爱和诚实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我没有把你的公义隐藏在心里； 我已经述说了你的信实和救恩； 在大会中，我没有隐瞒你的慈爱和诚实。
verses.textZhCuv: 我未曾把你的公义藏在心里； 我已陈明你的信实和你的救恩； 我在大会中未曾隐瞒你的慈爱和诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: I do not hide your righteousness in my heart; I speak of your faithfulness and your saving help. I do not conceal your love and your faithfulness from the great assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: I have not hidden your deliverance within my heart; I have spoken of your faithfulness and your salvation; I have not concealed your steadfast love and your faithfulness from the great congregation.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have not hidden Your righteousness within my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and Your salvation; I have not concealed Your lovingkindness and Your truth From the great assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: I have not kept the good news of your justice hidden in my heart; I have talked about your faithfulness and saving power. I have told everyone in the great assembly of your unfailing love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: I have not hidden Your righteousness within my heart; I have spoken of Your faithfulness and Your salvation; I have not concealed Your mercy and Your truth from the great congregation.
verses.textEn: I do not hide your righteousness in my heart; I speak of your faithfulness and your saving help. I do not conceal your love and your faithfulness from the great assembly.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你的怜悯不要向我止息； 愿你的慈爱和诚实常常保护我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你的怜悯不要向我止息； 愿你的慈爱和诚实常常保护我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！ 愿你的慈爱和诚实常常保佑我！
verses.textEnNiv: Do not withhold your mercy from me, Lord ; may your love and faithfulness always protect me.
verses.textEnEsv: As for you, O Lord , you will not restrain your mercy from me; your steadfast love and your faithfulness will ever preserve me!
