verses.textEnNkjv: Do not withhold Your tender mercies from me, O Lord; Let Your lovingkindness and Your truth continually preserve me.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , don’t hold back your tender mercies from me. Let your unfailing love and faithfulness always protect me.
verses.textEnNasb: You, Lord, will not withhold Your compassion from me; Your mercy and Your truth will continually watch over me.
verses.textEn: Do not withhold your mercy from me, Lord ; may your love and faithfulness always protect me.

verses.textZh: 因有无数的祸患围绕着我； 我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能看见； 它们比我的头发还多， 以致我心惊胆战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因有无数的祸患围绕着我； 我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能看见； 它们比我的头发还多， 以致我心惊胆战。
verses.textZhCuv: 因有无数的祸患围困我， 我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首； 这罪孽比我的头发还多， 我就心寒胆战。
verses.textEnNiv: For troubles without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails within me.
verses.textEnEsv: For evils have encompassed me beyond number; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I cannot see; they are more than the hairs of my head; my heart fails me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For innumerable evils have surrounded me; My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; Therefore my heart fails me.
verses.textEnNlt: For troubles surround me— too many to count! My sins pile up so high I can’t see my way out. They outnumber the hairs on my head. I have lost all courage.
verses.textEnNasb: For evils beyond number have surrounded me; My guilty deeds have overtaken me, so that I am not able to see; They are more numerous than the hairs of my head, And my heart has failed me.
verses.textEn: For troubles without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails within me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你开恩搭救我； 耶和华啊！求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你开恩搭救我； 耶和华啊！求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你开恩搭救我！ 耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！
verses.textEnNiv: Be pleased to save me, Lord ; come quickly, Lord , to help me.
verses.textEnEsv: Be pleased, O Lord , to deliver me! O Lord , make haste to help me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me; O Lord, make haste to help me!
verses.textEnNlt: Please, Lord , rescue me! Come quickly, Lord , and help me.
verses.textEnNasb: Be pleased, Lord, to rescue me; Hurry, Lord, to help me.
verses.textEn: Be pleased to save me, Lord ; come quickly, Lord , to help me.

verses.textZh: 愿那些寻找我，要毁灭我命的， 一同抱愧蒙羞； 愿那些喜悦我遭害的， 退后受辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那些寻找我，要毁灭我命的， 一同抱愧蒙羞； 愿那些喜悦我遭害的， 退后受辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那些寻找我、要灭我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！ 愿那些喜悦我受害的，退后受辱！
verses.textEnNiv: May all who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: Let those be put to shame and disappointed altogether who seek to snatch away my life; let those be turned back and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be ashamed and brought to mutual confusion Who seek to destroy my life; Let them be driven backward and brought to dishonor Who wish me evil.
verses.textEnNlt: May those who try to destroy me be humiliated and put to shame. May those who take delight in my trouble be turned back in disgrace.
verses.textEnNasb: May those be ashamed and humiliated together Who seek my life to destroy it; May those be turned back and dishonored Who delight in my hurt.
verses.textEn: May all who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

verses.textZh: 愿那些对我说："啊哈！啊哈！"的， 都因羞愧而惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那些对我说："啊哈！啊哈！"的， 都因羞愧而惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧而败亡！
verses.textEnNiv: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" be appalled at their own shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Let those be appalled because of their shame who say to me, "Aha, Aha!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be confounded because of their shame, Who say to me, "Aha, aha!"
verses.textEnNlt: Let them be horrified by their shame, for they said, "Aha! We’ve got him now!"
verses.textEnNasb: May those be appalled because of their shame Who say to me, "Aha, aha!"
verses.textEn: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" be appalled at their own shame.

verses.textZh: 愿所有寻求你的， 都因你欢喜快乐； 愿那些喜爱你救恩的， 常说："要尊耶和华为大。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿所有寻求你的， 都因你欢喜快乐； 愿那些喜爱你救恩的， 常说："要尊耶和华为大。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜！ 愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊耶和华为大！
verses.textEnNiv: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who long for your saving help always say, "The Lord is great!"
verses.textEnEsv: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation say continually, "Great is the Lord !"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; Let such as love Your salvation say continually, "The Lord be magnified!"
verses.textEnNlt: But may all who search for you be filled with joy and gladness in you. May those who love your salvation repeatedly shout, "The Lord is great!"
verses.textEnNasb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; May those who love Your salvation continually say, "The Lord be exalted!"
verses.textEn: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who long for your saving help always say, "The Lord is great!"

verses.textZh: 至于我，我是困苦贫穷的； 主仍顾念我。 你是我的帮助，我的拯救； 我的神啊！求你不要耽延。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我是困苦贫穷的； 主仍顾念我。 你是我的帮助，我的拯救； 我的神啊！求你不要耽延。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我是困苦穷乏的，主仍顾念我； 你是帮助我的，搭救我的。神啊，求你不要耽延！
verses.textEnNiv: But as for me, I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; you are my God, do not delay.
verses.textEnEsv: As for me, I am poor and needy, but the Lord takes thought for me. You are my help and my deliverer; do not delay, O my God!
verses.textEnNkjv: But I am poor and needy; Yet the Lord thinks upon me. You are my help and my deliverer; Do not delay, O my God.
verses.textEnNlt: As for me, since I am poor and needy, let the Lord keep me in his thoughts. You are my helper and my savior. O my God, do not delay.
verses.textEnNasb: But I am afflicted and needy; May the Lord be mindful of me. You are my help and my savior; Do not delay, my God.
verses.textEn: But as for me, I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; you are my God, do not delay.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 关怀穷乏人的有福了； 在遭难的日子，耶和华必救他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 关怀穷乏人的有福了； 在遭难的日子，耶和华必救他。
verses.textZhCuv: 眷顾贫穷的有福了！ 他遭难的日子，耶和华必搭救他。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those who have regard for the weak; the Lord delivers them in times of trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the one who considers the poor! In the day of trouble the Lord delivers him;
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is he who considers the poor; The Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, the joys of those who are kind to the poor! The Lord rescues them when they are in trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is one who considers the helpless; The Lord will save him on a day of trouble.
verses.textEn: Blessed are those who have regard for the weak; the Lord delivers them in times of trouble.

verses.textZh: 耶和华要保护他，使他生存； 他在地上要称为有福的； 求你不要照着他敌人的心愿把他交给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华要保护他，使他生存； 他在地上要称为有福的； 求你不要照着他敌人的心愿把他交给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必保全他，使他存活； 他必在地上享福。 求你不要把他交给仇敌，遂其所愿。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord protects and preserves them— they are counted among the blessed in the land— he does not give them over to the desire of their foes.
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord protects him and keeps him alive; he is called blessed in the land; you do not give him up to the will of his enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will preserve him and keep him alive, And he will be blessed on the earth; You will not deliver him to the will of his enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord protects them and keeps them alive. He gives them prosperity in the land and rescues them from their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will protect him and keep him alive, And he will be called blessed upon the earth; And do not turn him over to the desire of his enemies.
verses.textEn: The Lord protects and preserves them— they are counted among the blessed in the land— he does not give them over to the desire of their foes.

verses.textZh: 他患病在床，耶和华必扶持他； 在病榻中你使他恢复健康。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他患病在床，耶和华必扶持他； 在病榻中你使他恢复健康。
verses.textZhCuv: 他病重在榻，耶和华必扶持他； 他在病中，你必给他铺床。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord sustains them on their sickbed and restores them from their bed of illness.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord sustains him on his sickbed; in his illness you restore him to full health.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will strengthen him on his bed of illness; You will sustain him on his sickbed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord nurses them when they are sick and restores them to health.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will sustain him upon his sickbed; In his illness, You restore him to health.
verses.textEn: The Lord sustains them on their sickbed and restores them from their bed of illness.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我曾说："耶和华啊！求你恩待我； 求你医治我，因为我得罪了你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我曾说："耶和华啊！求你恩待我； 求你医治我，因为我得罪了你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾说：耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，医治我！ 因为我得罪了你。
verses.textEnNiv: I said, "Have mercy on me, Lord ; heal me, for I have sinned against you."
verses.textEnEsv: As for me, I said, "O Lord , be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against you!"
verses.textEnNkjv: I said, "Lord, be merciful to me; Heal my soul, for I have sinned against You."
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord ," I prayed, "have mercy on me. Heal me, for I have sinned against you."
verses.textEnNasb: As for me, I said, "Lord, be gracious to me; Heal my soul, for I have sinned against You."
verses.textEn: I said, "Have mercy on me, Lord ; heal me, for I have sinned against you."

verses.textZh: 我的仇敌用恶毒的话中伤我，说： "他甚么时候死呢？他的名字甚么时候消灭呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的仇敌用恶毒的话中伤我，说： "他甚么时候死呢？他的名字甚么时候消灭呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仇敌用恶言议论我说： 他几时死，他的名才灭亡呢？
verses.textEnNiv: My enemies say of me in malice, "When will he die and his name perish?"
verses.textEnEsv: My enemies say of me in malice, "When will he die, and his name perish?"
verses.textEnNkjv: My enemies speak evil of me: "When will he die, and his name perish?"
verses.textEnNlt: But my enemies say nothing but evil about me. "How soon will he die and be forgotten?" they ask.
verses.textEnNasb: My enemies speak evil against me, "When will he die, and his name perish?"
verses.textEn: My enemies say of me in malice, "When will he die and his name perish?"

verses.textZh: 即使他来看我，说的也是假话； 他把奸诈积存在心里， 走到外面才说出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使他来看我，说的也是假话； 他把奸诈积存在心里， 走到外面才说出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他来看我就说假话； 他心存奸恶，走到外边才说出来。
verses.textEnNiv: When one of them comes to see me, he speaks falsely, while his heart gathers slander; then he goes out and spreads it around.
verses.textEnEsv: And when one comes to see me, he utters empty words, while his heart gathers iniquity; when he goes out, he tells it abroad.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if he comes to see me, he speaks lies; His heart gathers iniquity to itself; When he goes out, he tells it.
verses.textEnNlt: They visit me as if they were my friends, but all the while they gather gossip, and when they leave, they spread it everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he comes to see me, he speaks empty words; His heart gathers wickedness to itself; When he goes outside, he tells it.
verses.textEn: When one of them comes to see me, he speaks falsely, while his heart gathers slander; then he goes out and spreads it around.

verses.textZh: 所有憎恨我的人，都交头接耳地议论我； 他们设恶计要害我，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有憎恨我的人，都交头接耳地议论我； 他们设恶计要害我，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 一切恨我的，都交头接耳地议论我； 他们设计要害我。
verses.textEnNiv: All my enemies whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: All who hate me whisper together about me; they imagine the worst for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: All who hate me whisper together against me; Against me they devise my hurt.
verses.textEnNlt: All who hate me whisper about me, imagining the worst.
verses.textEnNasb: All who hate me whisper together against me; They plot my harm against me, saying,
verses.textEn: All my enemies whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me, saying,

verses.textZh: "有恶疾临到他身上； 他既然躺下了，就必一病不起。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "有恶疾临到他身上； 他既然躺下了，就必一病不起。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：有怪病贴在他身上； 他已躺卧，必不能再起来。
verses.textEnNiv: "A vile disease has afflicted him; he will never get up from the place where he lies."
verses.textEnEsv: They say, "A deadly thing is poured out on him; he will not rise again from where he lies."
verses.textEnNkjv: "An evil disease," theysay, "clings to him. And now that he lies down, he will rise up no more."
verses.textEnNlt: "He has some fatal disease," they say. "He will never get out of that bed!"
verses.textEnNasb: "A wicked thing is poured out upon him, So that when he lies down, he will not get up again."
verses.textEn: "A vile disease has afflicted him; he will never get up from the place where he lies."

verses.textZh: 连我信任的密友， 就是那吃我饭的， 也用脚踢我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连我信任的密友， 就是那吃我饭的， 也用脚踢我。
verses.textZhCuv: 连我知己的朋友， 我所倚靠、吃过我饭的也用脚踢我。
verses.textEnNiv: Even my close friend, someone I trusted, one who shared my bread, has turned against me.
verses.textEnEsv: Even my close friend in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has lifted his heel against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even my own familiar friend in whom I trusted, Who ate my bread, Has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.textEnNlt: Even my best friend, the one I trusted completely, the one who shared my food, has turned against me.
verses.textEnNasb: Even my close friend in whom I trusted, Who ate my bread, Has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.textEn: Even my close friend, someone I trusted, one who shared my bread, has turned against me.

verses.textZh: 至于你，耶和华啊！求你恩待我， 使我康复起来，好报复他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，耶和华啊！求你恩待我， 使我康复起来，好报复他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我， 使我起来，好报复他们！
verses.textEnNiv: But may you have mercy on me, Lord ; raise me up, that I may repay them.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O Lord , be gracious to me, and raise me up, that I may repay them!
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, O Lord, be merciful to me, and raise me up, That I may repay them.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , have mercy on me. Make me well again, so I can pay them back!
verses.textEnNasb: But You, Lord, be gracious to me and raise me up, That I may repay them.
verses.textEn: But may you have mercy on me, Lord ; raise me up, that I may repay them.

verses.textZh: 因此我就知道你喜爱我， 因为我的仇敌不能向我欢呼夸胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我就知道你喜爱我， 因为我的仇敌不能向我欢呼夸胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我的仇敌不得向我夸胜， 我从此便知道你喜爱我。
verses.textEnNiv: I know that you are pleased with me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
verses.textEnEsv: By this I know that you delight in me: my enemy will not shout in triumph over me.
verses.textEnNkjv: By this I know that You are well pleased with me, Because my enemy does not triumph over me.
verses.textEnNlt: I know you are pleased with me, for you have not let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.textEnNasb: By this I know that You are pleased with me, Because my enemy does not shout in triumph over me.
verses.textEn: I know that you are pleased with me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

verses.textZh: 至于我，你因为我正直，就扶持我； 你使我永远站在你面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，你因为我正直，就扶持我； 你使我永远站在你面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因我纯正就扶持我， 使我永远站在你的面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of my integrity you uphold me and set me in your presence forever.
verses.textEnEsv: But you have upheld me because of my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for me, You uphold me in my integrity, And set me before Your face forever.
verses.textEnNlt: You have preserved my life because I am innocent; you have brought me into your presence forever.
verses.textEnNasb: As for me, You uphold me in my integrity, And You place me in Your presence forever.
verses.textEn: Because of my integrity you uphold me and set me in your presence forever.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的， 从永远直到永远。 阿们，阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的， 从永远直到永远。 阿们，阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神是应当称颂的， 从亘古直到永远。阿们！阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who lives from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and amen!
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, From everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

verses.textZh: 可拉子孙的训诲诗，交给诗班长。神啊！我的心渴慕你， 好象鹿渴慕溪水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉子孙的训诲诗，交给诗班长。神啊！我的心渴慕你， 好象鹿渴慕溪水。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我的心切慕你， 如鹿切慕溪水。
verses.textEnNiv: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God.
verses.textEnEsv: As a deer pants for flowing streams, so pants my soul for you, O God.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the deer pants for the water brooks, So pants my soul for You, O God.
verses.textEnNlt: As the deer longs for streams of water, so I long for you, O God.
verses.textEnNasb: As the deer pants for the water brooks, So my soul pants for You, God.
verses.textEn: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God.

verses.textZh: 我的心渴想神，就是永活的神； 我甚么时候可以来朝见神的面呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心渴想神，就是永活的神； 我甚么时候可以来朝见神的面呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心渴想神，就是永生神； 我几时得朝见神呢？
verses.textEnNiv: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When can I go and meet with God?
verses.textEnEsv: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?
verses.textEnNlt: I thirst for God, the living God. When can I go and stand before him?
verses.textEnNasb: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God; When shall I come and appear before God?
verses.textEn: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When can I go and meet with God?

verses.textZh: 人整天对我说："你的神在哪里呢？" 我就昼夜以眼泪当饭吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人整天对我说："你的神在哪里呢？" 我就昼夜以眼泪当饭吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 我昼夜以眼泪当饮食； 人不住地对我说：你的神在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: My tears have been my food day and night, while people say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"
verses.textEnEsv: My tears have been my food day and night, while they say to me all the day long, "Where is your God?"
verses.textEnNkjv: My tears have been my food day and night, While they continually say to me, "Where is your God?"
verses.textEnNlt: Day and night I have only tears for food, while my enemies continually taunt me, saying, "Where is this God of yours?"
verses.textEnNasb: My tears have been my food day and night, While they say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"
verses.textEn: My tears have been my food day and night, while people say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

verses.textZh: 我从前常常和群众同去， 与他们进到神的殿里， 在欢呼和称谢声中，大家守节。 每逢想起这些事，我的心就感到难过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从前常常和群众同去， 与他们进到神的殿里， 在欢呼和称谢声中，大家守节。 每逢想起这些事，我的心就感到难过。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从前与众人同往， 用欢呼称赞的声音 领他们到神的殿里，大家守节。 我追想这些事， 我的心极其悲伤。
verses.textEnNiv: These things I remember as I pour out my soul: how I used to go to the house of God under the protection of the Mighty One with shouts of joy and praise among the festive throng.
verses.textEnEsv: These things I remember, as I pour out my soul: how I would go with the throng and lead them in procession to the house of God with glad shouts and songs of praise, a multitude keeping festival.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul within me. For I used to go with the multitude; I went with them to the house of God, With the voice of joy and praise, With a multitude that kept a pilgrim feast.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart is breaking as I remember how it used to be: I walked among the crowds of worshipers, leading a great procession to the house of God, singing for joy and giving thanks amid the sound of a great celebration!
verses.textEnNasb: I remember these things and pour out my soul within me. For I used to go over with the multitude and walk them to the house of God, With a voice of joy and thanksgiving, a multitude celebrating a festival.
verses.textEn: These things I remember as I pour out my soul: how I used to go to the house of God under the protection of the Mighty One with shouts of joy and praise among the festive throng.

verses.textZh: 我的心哪！你为甚么沮丧呢？ 为甚么在我里面不安呢？ 应当等候神； 因为我还要称赞他， 他是我面前的救助、我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心哪！你为甚么沮丧呢？ 为甚么在我里面不安呢？ 应当等候神； 因为我还要称赞他， 他是我面前的救助、我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ 为何在我里面烦躁？ 应当仰望神，因他笑脸帮助我； 我还要称赞他。
verses.textEnNiv: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
verses.textEnEsv: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my salvation
verses.textEnNkjv: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him For the help of His countenance.
verses.textEnNlt: Why am I discouraged? Why is my heart so sad? I will put my hope in God! I will praise him again— my Savior and
verses.textEnNasb: Why are you in despair, my soul? And why are you restless within me? Wait for God, for I will again praise Him For the help of His presence, my God.
verses.textEn: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

verses.textZh: 我的心在我里面沮丧； 因此我从约旦地，从黑门岭， 从米萨山，记念你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心在我里面沮丧； 因此我从约旦地，从黑门岭， 从米萨山，记念你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，我的心在我里面忧闷， 所以我从约旦地， 从黑门岭，从米萨山记念你。
verses.textEnNiv: My soul is downcast within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon—from Mount Mizar.
verses.textEnEsv: and my God. My soul is cast down within me; therefore I remember you from the land of Jordan and of Hermon, from Mount Mizar.
verses.textEnNkjv: O my God, my soul is cast down within me; Therefore I will remember You from the land of the Jordan, And from the heights of Hermon, From the Hill Mizar.
verses.textEnNlt: my God! Now I am deeply discouraged, but I will remember you— even from distant Mount Hermon, the source of the Jordan, from the land of Mount Mizar.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul is in despair within me; Therefore I remember You from the land of the Jordan And the peaks of Hermon, from Mount Mizar.
verses.textEn: My soul is downcast within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon—from Mount Mizar.

verses.textZh: 你的瀑布一发声，深渊就和深渊响应； 你的洪涛和波浪都掩盖了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的瀑布一发声，深渊就和深渊响应； 你的洪涛和波浪都掩盖了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的瀑布发声，深渊就与深渊响应； 你的波浪洪涛漫过我身。
verses.textEnNiv: Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.
verses.textEnEsv: Deep calls to deep at the roar of your waterfalls; all your breakers and your waves have gone over me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deep calls unto deep at the noise of Your waterfalls; All Your waves and billows have gone over me.
verses.textEnNlt: I hear the tumult of the raging seas as your waves and surging tides sweep over me.
verses.textEnNasb: Deep calls to deep at the sound of Your waterfalls; All Your breakers and Your waves have passed over me.
verses.textEn: Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.

verses.textZh: 白天耶和华赐下他的慈爱； 夜间我要向他歌颂， 向赐我生命的神祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 白天耶和华赐下他的慈爱； 夜间我要向他歌颂， 向赐我生命的神祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 白昼，耶和华必向我施慈爱； 黑夜，我要歌颂祷告赐我生命的神。
verses.textEnNiv: By day the Lord directs his love, at night his song is with me— a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.textEnEsv: By day the Lord commands his steadfast love, and at night his song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will command His lovingkindness in the daytime, And in the night His song shallbe with me— A prayer to the God of my life.
verses.textEnNlt: But each day the Lord pours his unfailing love upon me, and through each night I sing his songs, praying to God who gives me life.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will send His goodness in the daytime; And His song will be with me in the night, A prayer to the God of my life.
verses.textEn: By day the Lord directs his love, at night his song is with me— a prayer to the God of my life.

verses.textZh: 我要对神我的盘石说： "你为甚么忘记我呢？ 我为甚么因仇敌的压迫徘徊悲哀呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要对神我的盘石说： "你为甚么忘记我呢？ 我为甚么因仇敌的压迫徘徊悲哀呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要对神－我的磐石说： 你为何忘记我呢？ 我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？
verses.textEnNiv: I say to God my Rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?"
verses.textEnEsv: I say to God, my rock: "Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"
verses.textEnNkjv: I will say to God my Rock, "Why have You forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"
verses.textEnNlt: "O God my rock," I cry, "why have you forgotten me? Why must I wander around in grief, oppressed by my enemies?"
verses.textEnNasb: I will say to God my rock, "Why have You forgotten me? Why do I go about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"
verses.textEn: I say to God my Rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?"

verses.textZh: 我的敌人整天对我说： "你的神在哪里呢？" 他们这样辱骂我的时候， 就像在击碎我的骨头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的敌人整天对我说： "你的神在哪里呢？" 他们这样辱骂我的时候， 就像在击碎我的骨头。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的敌人辱骂我， 好像打碎我的骨头， 不住地对我说： 你的神在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, "Where is your God?"
verses.textEnEsv: As with a deadly wound in my bones, my adversaries taunt me, while they say to me all the day long, "Where is your God?"
verses.textEnNkjv: As with a breaking of my bones, My enemies reproach me, While they say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"
verses.textEnNlt: Their taunts break my bones. They scoff, "Where is this God of yours?"
verses.textEnNasb: As a shattering of my bones, my adversaries taunt me, While they say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"
verses.textEn: My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

verses.textZh: 我的心哪！你为甚么沮丧呢？ 为甚么在我里面不安呢？ 应当等候神； 因为我还要称赞他， 他是我面前的救助、我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心哪！你为甚么沮丧呢？ 为甚么在我里面不安呢？ 应当等候神； 因为我还要称赞他， 他是我面前的救助、我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ 为何在我里面烦躁？ 应当仰望神，因我还要称赞他。 他是我脸上的光荣 ，是我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
verses.textEnEsv: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my salvation and my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; For I shall yet praise Him, The help of my countenance and my God.
verses.textEnNlt: Why am I discouraged? Why is my heart so sad? I will put my hope in God! I will praise him again— my Savior and my God!
verses.textEnNasb: Why are you in despair, my soul? And why are you restless within me? Wait for God, for I will again praise Him For the help of His presence, my God.
verses.textEn: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你为我伸冤， 为我的案件向不敬虔的国申辩； 求你救我脱离诡诈和不义的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你为我伸冤， 为我的案件向不敬虔的国申辩； 求你救我脱离诡诈和不义的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你伸我的冤， 向不虔诚的国为我辨屈； 求你救我脱离诡诈不义的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Vindicate me, my God, and plead my cause against an unfaithful nation. Rescue me from those who are deceitful and wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Vindicate me, O God, and defend my cause against an ungodly people, from the deceitful and unjust man deliver me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Vindicate me, O God, And plead my cause against an ungodly nation; Oh, deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man!
verses.textEnNlt: Declare me innocent, O God! Defend me against these ungodly people. Rescue me from these unjust liars.
verses.textEnNasb: Vindicate me, God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; Save me from the deceitful and unjust person!
verses.textEn: Vindicate me, my God, and plead my cause against an unfaithful nation. Rescue me from those who are deceitful and wicked.

verses.textZh: 因为你是赐我力量的神。 你为甚么弃绝我呢？ 我为甚么因仇敌的压迫徘徊悲哀呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你是赐我力量的神。 你为甚么弃绝我呢？ 我为甚么因仇敌的压迫徘徊悲哀呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你是赐我力量的神，为何丢弃我呢？ 我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？
verses.textEnNiv: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?
verses.textEnEsv: For you are the God in whom I take refuge; why have you rejected me? Why do I go about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.textEnNkjv: For You are the God of my strength; Why do You cast me off? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.textEnNlt: For you are God, my only safe haven. Why have you tossed me aside? Why must I wander around in grief, oppressed by my enemies?
verses.textEnNasb: For You are the God of my strength; why have You rejected me? Why do I go about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.textEn: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?

verses.textZh: 求你发出你的亮光和真理，好引导我， 带我到你的圣山， 到你的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你发出你的亮光和真理，好引导我， 带我到你的圣山， 到你的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你发出你的亮光和真实，好引导我， 带我到你的圣山，到你的居所！
verses.textEnNiv: Send me your light and your faithful care, let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.
verses.textEnEsv: Send out your light and your truth; let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy hill and to your dwelling!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, send out Your light and Your truth! Let them lead me; Let them bring me to Your holy hill And to Your tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: Send out your light and your truth; let them guide me. Let them lead me to your holy mountain, to the place where you live.
verses.textEnNasb: Send out Your light and Your truth, they shall lead me; They shall bring me to Your holy hill And to Your dwelling places.
verses.textEn: Send me your light and your faithful care, let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.

verses.textZh: 我就走到神的祭坛前， 到神、我极大的喜乐那里。神啊！我的神啊！ 我要弹琴称赞你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就走到神的祭坛前， 到神、我极大的喜乐那里。神啊！我的神啊！ 我要弹琴称赞你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就走到神的祭坛， 到我最喜乐的神那里。神啊，我的神， 我要弹琴称赞你！
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy, and I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will go to the altar of God, To God my exceeding joy; And on the harp I will praise You, O God, my God.
verses.textEnNlt: There I will go to the altar of God, to God—the source of all my joy. I will praise you with my harp, O God, my God!
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will go to the altar of God, To God my exceeding joy; And I will praise You on the lyre, God, my God.
verses.textEn: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God.

verses.textZh: 我的心哪！你为甚么沮丧呢？ 为甚么在我里面不安呢？ 应当等候神； 因为我还要称赞他， 他是我面前的救助、我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心哪！你为甚么沮丧呢？ 为甚么在我里面不安呢？ 应当等候神； 因为我还要称赞他， 他是我面前的救助、我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ 为何在我里面烦躁？ 应当仰望神，因我还要称赞他。 他是我脸上的光荣 ，是我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
verses.textEnEsv: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my salvation and my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; For I shall yet praise Him, The help of my countenance and my God.
verses.textEnNlt: Why am I discouraged? Why is my heart so sad? I will put my hope in God! I will praise him again— my Savior and my God!
verses.textEnNasb: Why are you in despair, my soul? And why are you restless within me? Wait for God, for I will again praise Him For the help of His presence, my God.
verses.textEn: Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

verses.textZh: 可拉子孙的训诲诗，交给诗班长。神啊！你在古时， 在我们列祖的日子所作的事， 我们亲耳听见了， 我们的列祖也给我们述说过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉子孙的训诲诗，交给诗班长。神啊！你在古时， 在我们列祖的日子所作的事， 我们亲耳听见了， 我们的列祖也给我们述说过。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你在古时， 我们列祖的日子所行的事， 我们亲耳听见了； 我们的列祖也给我们述说过。
verses.textEnNiv: We have heard it with our ears, O God; our ancestors have told us what you did in their days, in days long ago.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have told us, what deeds you performed in their days, in the days of old:
verses.textEnNkjv: We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, The deeds You did in their days, In days of old:
verses.textEnNlt: O God, we have heard it with our own ears— our ancestors have told us of all you did in their day, in days long ago:
verses.textEnNasb: God, we have heard with our ears, Our fathers have told us The work that You did in their days, In the days of old.
verses.textEn: We have heard it with our ears, O God; our ancestors have told us what you did in their days, in days long ago.

verses.textZh: 你曾亲手把列国赶出去， 却栽培了我们的列祖； 你曾苦待众民， 却使我们的列祖昌盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾亲手把列国赶出去， 却栽培了我们的列祖； 你曾苦待众民， 却使我们的列祖昌盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾用手赶出外邦人， 却栽培了我们列祖； 你苦待列邦， 却叫我们列祖发达。
verses.textEnNiv: With your hand you drove out the nations and planted our ancestors; you crushed the peoples and made our ancestors flourish.
verses.textEnEsv: you with your own hand drove out the nations, but them you planted; you afflicted the peoples, but them you set free;
verses.textEnNkjv: You drove out the nations with Your hand, But them You planted; You afflicted the peoples, and cast them out.
verses.textEnNlt: You drove out the pagan nations by your power and gave all the land to our ancestors. You crushed their enemies and set our ancestors free.
verses.textEnNasb: You with Your own hand drove out the nations; Then You planted them; You afflicted the peoples, Then You let them go free.
verses.textEn: With your hand you drove out the nations and planted our ancestors; you crushed the peoples and made our ancestors flourish.

verses.textZh: 因为他们取得那地，不是靠自己的刀剑； 他们得胜，也不是靠自己的膀臂； 而是靠你的右手、你的膀臂和你脸上的光， 因为你喜悦他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们取得那地，不是靠自己的刀剑； 他们得胜，也不是靠自己的膀臂； 而是靠你的右手、你的膀臂和你脸上的光， 因为你喜悦他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们不是靠自己的刀剑得地土， 也不是靠自己的膀臂得胜， 乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂， 和你脸上的亮光， 因为你喜悦他们。
verses.textEnNiv: It was not by their sword that they won the land, nor did their arm bring them victory; it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.
verses.textEnEsv: for not by their own sword did they win the land, nor did their own arm save them, but your right hand and your arm, and the light of your face, for you delighted in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they did not gain possession of the land by their own sword, Nor did their own arm save them; But it was Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your countenance, Because You favored them.
verses.textEnNlt: They did not conquer the land with their swords; it was not their own strong arm that gave them victory. It was your right hand and strong arm and the blinding light from your face that helped them, for you loved them.
verses.textEnNasb: For by their own sword they did not possess the land, And their own arm did not save them, But Your right hand and Your arm and the light of Your presence, For You favored them.
verses.textEn: It was not by their sword that they won the land, nor did their arm bring them victory; it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你是我的王； 求你出令，使雅各得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你是我的王； 求你出令，使雅各得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你是我的王； 求你出令使雅各得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: You are my King and my God, who decrees victories for Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: You are my King, O God; ordain salvation for Jacob!
verses.textEnNkjv: You are my King, O God; Command victories for Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: You are my King and my God. You command victories for Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: You are my King, God; Command victories for Jacob.
verses.textEn: You are my King and my God, who decrees victories for Jacob.

verses.textZh: 我们靠着你，必打倒我们的敌人； 靠着你的名，必践踏那些起来攻击我们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们靠着你，必打倒我们的敌人； 靠着你的名，必践踏那些起来攻击我们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们靠你要推倒我们的敌人， 靠你的名要践踏那起来攻击我们的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.
verses.textEnEsv: Through you we push down our foes; through your name we tread down those who rise up against us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Through You we will push down our enemies; Through Your name we will trample those who rise up against us.
verses.textEnNlt: Only by your power can we push back our enemies; only in your name can we trample our foes.
verses.textEnNasb: Through You we will push back our adversaries; Through Your name we will trample down those who rise up against us.
verses.textEn: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.

verses.textZh: 因为我不是倚靠我的弓， 我的刀剑也不能使我得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我不是倚靠我的弓， 我的刀剑也不能使我得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，我必不靠我的弓； 我的刀也不能使我得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: I put no trust in my bow, my sword does not bring me victory;
verses.textEnEsv: For not in my bow do I trust, nor can my sword save me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will not trust in my bow, Nor shall my sword save me.
verses.textEnNlt: I do not trust in my bow; I do not count on my sword to save me.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will not trust in my bow, Nor will my sword save me.
verses.textEn: I put no trust in my bow, my sword does not bring me victory;

verses.textZh: 但你使我们胜过了我们的敌人， 使憎恨我们的人都羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你使我们胜过了我们的敌人， 使憎恨我们的人都羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟你救了我们脱离敌人， 使恨我们的人羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: but you give us victory over our enemies, you put our adversaries to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: But you have saved us from our foes and have put to shame those who hate us.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You have saved us from our enemies, And have put to shame those who hated us.
verses.textEnNlt: You are the one who gives us victory over our enemies; you disgrace those who hate us.
verses.textEnNasb: But You have saved us from our adversaries, And You have put to shame those who hate us.
verses.textEn: but you give us victory over our enemies, you put our adversaries to shame.

verses.textZh: 我们整天因神夸耀， 我们要永远称赞你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们整天因神夸耀， 我们要永远称赞你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们终日因神夸耀， 还要永远称谢你的名。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: In God we make our boast all day long, and we will praise your name forever.
verses.textEnEsv: In God we have boasted continually, and we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: In God we boast all day long, And praise Your name forever. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: O God, we give glory to you all day long and constantly praise your name. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: In God we have boasted all day long, And we will give thanks to Your name forever. Selah
verses.textEn: In God we make our boast all day long, and we will praise your name forever.

verses.textZh: 现在，你却弃绝我们，使我们受辱， 不再和我们的军队一同出征。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你却弃绝我们，使我们受辱， 不再和我们的军队一同出征。
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今你丢弃了我们，使我们受辱， 不和我们的军兵同去。
verses.textEnNiv: But now you have rejected and humbled us; you no longer go out with our armies.
verses.textEnEsv: But you have rejected us and disgraced us and have not gone out with our armies.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You have cast us off and put us to shame, And You do not go out with our armies.
verses.textEnNlt: But now you have tossed us aside in dishonor. You no longer lead our armies to battle.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet You have rejected us and brought us to dishonor, And do not go out with our armies.
verses.textEn: But now you have rejected and humbled us; you no longer go out with our armies.

verses.textZh: 你使我们在敌人面前转身后退； 憎恨我们的人都任意抢掠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我们在敌人面前转身后退； 憎恨我们的人都任意抢掠。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我们向敌人转身退后； 那恨我们的人任意抢夺。
verses.textEnNiv: You made us retreat before the enemy, and our adversaries have plundered us.
verses.textEnEsv: You have made us turn back from the foe, and those who hate us have gotten spoil.
verses.textEnNkjv: You make us turn back from the enemy, And those who hate us have taken spoil for themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: You make us retreat from our enemies and allow those who hate us to plunder our land.
verses.textEnNasb: You cause us to turn back from the enemy; And those who hate us have taken spoils for themselves.
verses.textEn: You made us retreat before the enemy, and our adversaries have plundered us.

verses.textZh: 你使我们像给人宰吃的羊， 把我们分散在列国中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我们像给人宰吃的羊， 把我们分散在列国中。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我们当作快要被吃的羊， 把我们分散在列邦中。
verses.textEnNiv: You gave us up to be devoured like sheep and have scattered us among the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: You have made us like sheep for slaughter and have scattered us among the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have given us up like sheep intended for food, And have scattered us among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: You have butchered us like sheep and scattered us among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: You turn us over to be eaten like sheep, And have scattered us among the nations.
verses.textEn: You gave us up to be devoured like sheep and have scattered us among the nations.

verses.textZh: 你把你的子民廉价出售； 他们的售价并没有使你得到利益。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把你的子民廉价出售； 他们的售价并没有使你得到利益。
verses.textZhCuv: 你卖了你的子民也不赚利， 所得的价值并不加添你的资财。
verses.textEnNiv: You sold your people for a pittance, gaining nothing from their sale.
verses.textEnEsv: You have sold your people for a trifle, demanding no high price for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You sell Your people for nextto nothing, And are not enriched by selling them.
verses.textEnNlt: You sold your precious people for a pittance, making nothing on the sale.
verses.textEnNasb: You sell Your people cheaply, And have not profited by their sale.
verses.textEn: You sold your people for a pittance, gaining nothing from their sale.

verses.textZh: 你使我们成为邻居的羞辱， 成为我们四周的人讥笑和讽刺的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我们成为邻居的羞辱， 成为我们四周的人讥笑和讽刺的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我们受邻国的羞辱， 被四围的人嗤笑讥刺。
verses.textEnNiv: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, the scorn and derision of those around us.
verses.textEnEsv: You have made us the taunt of our neighbors, the derision and scorn of those around us.
verses.textEnNkjv: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, A scorn and a derision to those all around us.
verses.textEnNlt: You let our neighbors mock us. We are an object of scorn and derision to those around us.
verses.textEnNasb: You make us an object of reproach to our neighbors, Of scoffing and ridicule to those around us.
verses.textEn: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, the scorn and derision of those around us.

verses.textZh: 你使我们在列国中成为话柄， 在万民中使人摇头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我们在列国中成为话柄， 在万民中使人摇头。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我们在列邦中作了笑谈， 使众民向我们摇头。
verses.textEnNiv: You have made us a byword among the nations; the peoples shake their heads at us.
verses.textEnEsv: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: You make us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: You have made us the butt of their jokes; they shake their heads at us in scorn.
verses.textEnNasb: You make us a proverb among the nations, A laughingstock among the peoples.
verses.textEn: You have made us a byword among the nations; the peoples shake their heads at us.

verses.textZh: 我的羞辱整天在我面前， 我脸上的羞愧把我遮盖了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的羞辱整天在我面前， 我脸上的羞愧把我遮盖了；
verses.textZhCuv: 我的凌辱终日在我面前， 我脸上的羞愧将我遮蔽，
verses.textEnNiv: I live in disgrace all day long, and my face is covered with shame
verses.textEnEsv: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face
verses.textEnNkjv: My dishonor is continually before me, And the shame of my face has covered me,
verses.textEnNlt: We can’t escape the constant humiliation; shame is written across our faces.
verses.textEnNasb: All day long my dishonor is before me And I am covered with my humiliation,
verses.textEn: I live in disgrace all day long, and my face is covered with shame

verses.textZh: 都因那辱骂和毁谤的人的声音， 并因仇敌和报仇者的缘故。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都因那辱骂和毁谤的人的声音， 并因仇敌和报仇者的缘故。
verses.textZhCuv: 都因那辱骂毁谤人的声音， 又因仇敌和报仇人的缘故。
verses.textEnNiv: at the taunts of those who reproach and revile me, because of the enemy, who is bent on revenge.
verses.textEnEsv: at the sound of the taunter and reviler, at the sight of the enemy and the avenger.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the voice of him who reproaches and reviles, Because of the enemy and the avenger.
verses.textEnNlt: All we hear are the taunts of our mockers. All we see are our vengeful enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of the voice of one who taunts and reviles, Because of the presence of the enemy and the avenger.
verses.textEn: at the taunts of those who reproach and revile me, because of the enemy, who is bent on revenge.

verses.textZh: 这一切临到我们身上，我们却没有忘记你， 也没有违背你的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切临到我们身上，我们却没有忘记你， 也没有违背你的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都临到我们身上， 我们却没有忘记你， 也没有违背你的约。
verses.textEnNiv: All this came upon us, though we had not forgotten you; we had not been false to your covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten you, and we have not been false to your covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: All this has come upon us; But we have not forgotten You, Nor have we dealt falsely with Your covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: All this has happened though we have not forgotten you. We have not violated your covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: All this has come upon us, but we have not forgotten You, And we have not dealt falsely with Your covenant.
verses.textEn: All this came upon us, though we had not forgotten you; we had not been false to your covenant.

verses.textZh: 我们的心没有退后， 我们的脚步也没有偏离你的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的心没有退后， 我们的脚步也没有偏离你的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的心没有退后； 我们的脚也没有偏离你的路。
verses.textEnNiv: Our hearts had not turned back; our feet had not strayed from your path.
verses.textEnEsv: Our heart has not turned back, nor have our steps departed from your way;
verses.textEnNkjv: Our heart has not turned back, Nor have our steps departed from Your way;
verses.textEnNlt: Our hearts have not deserted you. We have not strayed from your path.
verses.textEnNasb: Our heart has not turned back, And our steps have not deviated from Your way,
verses.textEn: Our hearts had not turned back; our feet had not strayed from your path.

verses.textZh: 但你竟在野狗之地把我们压伤了， 又以死亡的阴影笼罩我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你竟在野狗之地把我们压伤了， 又以死亡的阴影笼罩我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在野狗之处压伤我们， 用死荫遮蔽我们。
verses.textEnNiv: But you crushed us and made us a haunt for jackals; you covered us over with deep darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: yet you have broken us in the place of jackals and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You have severely broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet you have crushed us in the jackal’s desert home. You have covered us with darkness and death.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet You have crushed us in a place of jackals And covered us with deep darkness.
verses.textEn: But you crushed us and made us a haunt for jackals; you covered us over with deep darkness.

verses.textZh: 如果我们忘记了我们神的名， 或是向别神伸手祷告；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们忘记了我们神的名， 或是向别神伸手祷告；
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若我们忘了神的名， 或向别神举手，
verses.textEnNiv: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
verses.textEnEsv: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
verses.textEnNkjv: If we had forgotten the name of our God, Or stretched out our hands to a foreign god,
verses.textEnNlt: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread our hands in prayer to foreign gods,
verses.textEnNasb: If we had forgotten the name of our God Or extended our hands to a strange god,
verses.textEn: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

verses.textZh: 神不会查究这事吗？ 因为他知道人心的隐秘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神不会查究这事吗？ 因为他知道人心的隐秘。
verses.textZhCuv: 神岂不鉴察这事吗？ 因为他晓得人心里的隐秘。
verses.textEnNiv: would not God have discovered it, since he knows the secrets of the heart?
verses.textEnEsv: would not God discover this? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Would not God search this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.textEnNlt: God would surely have known it, for he knows the secrets of every heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Would God not find this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.textEn: would not God have discovered it, since he knows the secrets of the heart?

verses.textZh: 为你的缘故，我们终日被置于死地； 人看我们如同将宰的羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为你的缘故，我们终日被置于死地； 人看我们如同将宰的羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们为你的缘故终日被杀； 人看我们如将宰的羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet for your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet for your sake we are killed all the day long; we are regarded as sheep to be slaughtered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet for Your sake we are killed all day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: But for your sake we are killed every day; we are being slaughtered like sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: But for Your sake we are killed all day long; We are regarded as sheep to be slaughtered.
verses.textEn: Yet for your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.

verses.textZh: 主啊！求你醒来，为甚么还睡着呢？ 求你起来，不要永远弃绝我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！求你醒来，为甚么还睡着呢？ 求你起来，不要永远弃绝我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，求你睡醒，为何尽睡呢？ 求你兴起，不要永远丢弃我们！
verses.textEnNiv: Awake, Lord! Why do you sleep? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Awake! Why are you sleeping, O Lord? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: Awake! Why do You sleep, O Lord? Arise! Do not cast us off forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Wake up, O Lord! Why do you sleep? Get up! Do not reject us forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Wake Yourself up, why do You sleep, Lord? Awake, do not reject us forever.
verses.textEn: Awake, Lord! Why do you sleep? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么掩面， 忘记了我们的苦难和压迫呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么掩面， 忘记了我们的苦难和压迫呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何掩面， 不顾我们所遭的苦难和所受的欺压？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you hide your face and forget our misery and oppression?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you hide your face? Why do you forget our affliction and oppression?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do You hide Your face, And forget our affliction and our oppression?
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you look the other way? Why do you ignore our suffering and oppression?
verses.textEnNasb: Why do You hide Your face And forget our affliction and oppression?
verses.textEn: Why do you hide your face and forget our misery and oppression?

verses.textZh: 我们俯伏在尘土之上； 我们的身体紧贴地面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们俯伏在尘土之上； 我们的身体紧贴地面。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的性命伏于尘土； 我们的肚腹紧贴地面。
verses.textEnNiv: We are brought down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly clings to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; Our body clings to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: We collapse in the dust, lying face down in the dirt.
verses.textEnNasb: For our souls have sunk down into the dust; Our bodies cling to the earth.
verses.textEn: We are brought down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.

verses.textZh: 求你起来帮助我们， 为了你慈爱的缘故救赎我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你起来帮助我们， 为了你慈爱的缘故救赎我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你起来帮助我们！ 凭你的慈爱救赎我们！
verses.textEnNiv: Rise up and help us; rescue us because of your unfailing love.
verses.textEnEsv: Rise up; come to our help! Redeem us for the sake of your steadfast love!
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise for our help, And redeem us for Your mercies’ sake.
verses.textEnNlt: Rise up! Help us! Ransom us because of your unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: Rise up, be our help, And redeem us because of Your mercy.
verses.textEn: Rise up and help us; rescue us because of your unfailing love.

verses.textZh: 可拉子孙的训诲诗，又是爱歌，交给诗班长，调用"百合花"。 我心里涌出优美的言辞； 我要为王朗诵我的作品； 我的舌头像经验丰富的作家的笔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉子孙的训诲诗，又是爱歌，交给诗班长，调用"百合花"。 我心里涌出优美的言辞； 我要为王朗诵我的作品； 我的舌头像经验丰富的作家的笔。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心里涌出美辞； 我论到我为王做的事， 我的舌头是快手笔。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
verses.textEnEsv: My heart overflows with a pleasing theme; I address my verses to the king; my tongue is like the pen of a ready scribe.
verses.textEnNkjv: My heart is overflowing with a good theme; I recite my composition concerning the King; My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.textEnNlt: Beautiful words stir my heart. I will recite a lovely poem about the king, for my tongue is like the pen of a skillful poet.
verses.textEnNasb: My heart is moved with a good theme; I address my verses to the King; My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.textEn: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

verses.textZh: 你比世人都美好； 你的嘴唇吐出恩言； 因此，神赐福给你，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你比世人都美好； 你的嘴唇吐出恩言； 因此，神赐福给你，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 你比世人更美； 在你嘴里满有恩惠； 所以神赐福给你，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: You are the most excellent of men and your lips have been anointed with grace, since God has blessed you forever.
verses.textEnEsv: You are the most handsome of the sons of men; grace is poured upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are fairer than the sons of men; Grace is poured upon Your lips; Therefore God has blessed You forever.
verses.textEnNlt: You are the most handsome of all. Gracious words stream from your lips. God himself has blessed you forever.
verses.textEnNasb: You are the most handsome of the sons of mankind; Grace is poured upon Your lips; Therefore God has blessed You forever.
verses.textEn: You are the most excellent of men and your lips have been anointed with grace, since God has blessed you forever.

verses.textZh: 大能者啊！愿你腰间佩上刀， 彰显你的尊荣和威严。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大能者啊！愿你腰间佩上刀， 彰显你的尊荣和威严。
verses.textZhCuv: 大能者啊，愿你腰间佩刀， 大有荣耀和威严！
verses.textEnNiv: Gird your sword on your side, you mighty one; clothe yourself with splendor and majesty.
verses.textEnEsv: Gird your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and majesty!
verses.textEnNkjv: Gird Your sword upon Your thigh, O Mighty One, With Your glory and Your majesty.
verses.textEnNlt: Put on your sword, O mighty warrior! You are so glorious, so majestic!
verses.textEnNasb: Strap Your sword on Your thigh, Mighty One, In Your splendor and majesty!
verses.textEn: Gird your sword on your side, you mighty one; clothe yourself with splendor and majesty.

verses.textZh: 在你的威严中，为了真理、谦卑和公义的缘故， 你胜利地乘车前进； 愿你的右手施行可畏的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你的威严中，为了真理、谦卑和公义的缘故， 你胜利地乘车前进； 愿你的右手施行可畏的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 为真理、谦卑、公义赫然坐车前往，无不得胜； 你的右手必显明可畏的事。
verses.textEnNiv: In your majesty ride forth victoriously in the cause of truth, humility and justice; let your right hand achieve awesome deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: In your majesty ride out victoriously for the cause of truth and meekness and righteousness; let your right hand teach you awesome deeds!
verses.textEnNkjv: And in Your majesty ride prosperously because of truth, humility, and righteousness; And Your right hand shall teach You awesome things.
verses.textEnNlt: In your majesty, ride out to victory, defending truth, humility, and justice. Go forth to perform awe-inspiring deeds!
verses.textEnNasb: And in Your majesty ride on victoriously, For the cause of truth, humility, and righteousness; Let Your right hand teach You awesome things.
verses.textEn: In your majesty ride forth victoriously in the cause of truth, humility and justice; let your right hand achieve awesome deeds.

verses.textZh: 你的箭锐利， 射中了王的仇敌的心； 万民都仆倒在你脚下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的箭锐利， 射中了王的仇敌的心； 万民都仆倒在你脚下。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的箭锋快，射中王敌之心； 万民仆倒在你以下。
verses.textEnNiv: Let your sharp arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s enemies; let the nations fall beneath your feet.
verses.textEnEsv: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; the peoples fall under you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the King’s enemies; The peoples fall under You.
verses.textEnNlt: Your arrows are sharp, piercing your enemies’ hearts. The nations fall beneath your feet.
verses.textEnNasb: Your arrows are sharp; The peoples fall under You; Your arrows are in the heart of the King’s enemies.
verses.textEn: Let your sharp arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s enemies; let the nations fall beneath your feet.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你的宝座是永永远远的， 你国的权杖是公平的权杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你的宝座是永永远远的， 你国的权杖是公平的权杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你的宝座是永永远远的； 你的国权是正直的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of uprightness;
verses.textEnNkjv: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; A scepter of righteousness is the scepter of Your kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever. You rule with a scepter of justice.
verses.textEnNasb: Your throne, God, is forever and ever; The scepter of Your kingdom is a scepter of justice.
verses.textEn: Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.

verses.textZh: 你喜爱公义，恨恶邪恶， 所以，神，就是你的神， 用喜乐的油膏抹你，胜过膏抹你的同伴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你喜爱公义，恨恶邪恶， 所以，神，就是你的神， 用喜乐的油膏抹你，胜过膏抹你的同伴。
verses.textZhCuv: 你喜爱公义，恨恶罪恶； 所以神－就是你的神－用喜乐油膏你， 胜过膏你的同伴。
verses.textEnNiv: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy.
verses.textEnEsv: you have loved righteousness and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions;
verses.textEnNkjv: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You With the oil of gladness more than Your companions.
verses.textEnNlt: You love justice and hate evil. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you, pouring out the oil of joy on you more than on anyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You With the oil of joy above Your companions.
verses.textEn: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy.

verses.textZh: 你的衣服都有没药、沉香和肉桂的香气； 从象牙宫里有丝弦的乐声，使你欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的衣服都有没药、沉香和肉桂的香气； 从象牙宫里有丝弦的乐声，使你欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的衣服都有没药、沉香、肉桂的香气； 象牙宫中有丝弦乐器的声音使你欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces adorned with ivory the music of the strings makes you glad.
verses.textEnEsv: your robes are all fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia. From ivory palaces stringed instruments make you glad;
verses.textEnNkjv: All Your garments are scented with myrrh and aloes and cassia, Out of the ivory palaces, by which they have made You glad.
verses.textEnNlt: Myrrh, aloes, and cassia perfume your robes. In ivory palaces the music of strings entertains you.
verses.textEnNasb: All Your garments are fragrant with myrrh, aloes, and cassia; From ivory palaces stringed instruments have made You joyful.
verses.textEn: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces adorned with ivory the music of the strings makes you glad.

verses.textZh: 你的贵妃中有众君王的女儿； 王后佩戴着俄斐的金饰，站在你的右边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的贵妃中有众君王的女儿； 王后佩戴着俄斐的金饰，站在你的右边。
verses.textZhCuv: 有君王的女儿在你尊贵妇女之中； 王后佩戴俄斐金饰站在你右边。
verses.textEnNiv: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand is the royal bride in gold of Ophir.
verses.textEnEsv: daughters of kings are among your ladies of honor; at your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.textEnNkjv: Kings’ daughters are among Your honorable women; At Your right hand stands the queen in gold from Ophir.
verses.textEnNlt: Kings’ daughters are among your noble women. At your right side stands the queen, wearing jewelry of finest gold from Ophir!
verses.textEnNasb: Kings’ daughters are among Your noble women; At Your right hand stands the queen in gold from Ophir.
verses.textEn: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand is the royal bride in gold of Ophir.

verses.textZh: 王所爱的女子啊！你要听，要看，要留心地听； 你要忘记你的本族和你的父家；
verses.textZhCnvs: 王所爱的女子啊！你要听，要看，要留心地听； 你要忘记你的本族和你的父家；
verses.textZhCuv: 女子啊，你要听，要想，要侧耳而听！ 不要记念你的民和你的父家，
verses.textEnNiv: Listen, daughter, and pay careful attention: Forget your people and your father’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, O daughter, and consider, and incline your ear: forget your people and your father’s house,
verses.textEnNkjv: Listen, O daughter, Consider and incline your ear; Forget your own people also, and your father’s house;
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to me, O royal daughter; take to heart what I say. Forget your people and your family far away.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, daughter, look and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house;
verses.textEn: Listen, daughter, and pay careful attention: Forget your people and your father’s house.

verses.textZh: 王就爱慕你的美丽； 因为他是你的主， 你要向他俯伏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王就爱慕你的美丽； 因为他是你的主， 你要向他俯伏。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就羡慕你的美貌； 因为他是你的主，你当敬拜他。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the king be enthralled by your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.
verses.textEnEsv: and the king will desire your beauty. Since he is your lord, bow to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the King will greatly desire your beauty; Because He is your Lord, worship Him.
verses.textEnNlt: For your royal husband delights in your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the King will crave your beauty. Because He is your Lord, bow down to Him.
verses.textEn: Let the king be enthralled by your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.

verses.textZh: 推罗的居民 必带着礼物而来； 民间富有的人要向你求恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 推罗的居民 必带着礼物而来； 民间富有的人要向你求恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔的民 必来送礼； 民中的富足人也必向你求恩。
verses.textEnNiv: The city of Tyre will come with a gift, people of wealth will seek your favor.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Tyre will seek your favor with gifts, the richest of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the daughter of Tyre willcome with a gift; The rich among the people will seek your favor.
verses.textEnNlt: The princess of Tyre will shower you with gifts. The wealthy will beg your favor.
verses.textEnNasb: The daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; The wealthy among the people will seek your favor.
verses.textEn: The city of Tyre will come with a gift, people of wealth will seek your favor.

verses.textZh: 王所爱的女子在宫里，极其荣华； 她的衣服全是用金线绣成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王所爱的女子在宫里，极其荣华； 她的衣服全是用金线绣成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 王女在宫里极其荣华； 她的衣服是用金线绣的。
verses.textEnNiv: All glorious is the princess within her chamber; her gown is interwoven with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: All glorious is the princess in her chamber, with robes interwoven with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: The royal daughter is all glorious within thepalace; Her clothing is woven with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: The bride, a princess, looks glorious in her golden gown.
verses.textEnNasb: The King’s daughter is all glorious within; Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
verses.textEn: All glorious is the princess within her chamber; her gown is interwoven with gold.

verses.textZh: 她身穿刺绣的衣服，被引到王的面前； 她后面伴随的童女， 也都被带到你的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她身穿刺绣的衣服，被引到王的面前； 她后面伴随的童女， 也都被带到你的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 她要穿锦绣的衣服，被引到王前； 随从她的陪伴童女也要被带到你面前。
verses.textEnNiv: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her— those brought to be with her.
verses.textEnEsv: In many-colored robes she is led to the king, with her virgin companions following behind her.
verses.textEnNkjv: She shall be brought to the King in robes of many colors; The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to You.
verses.textEnNlt: In her beautiful robes, she is led to the king, accompanied by her bridesmaids.
verses.textEnNasb: She will be brought to the King in colorful garments; The virgins, her companions who follow her, Will be brought to You.
verses.textEn: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her— those brought to be with her.

verses.textZh: 她们欢喜快乐被引到王那里； 她们要进入王宫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们欢喜快乐被引到王那里； 她们要进入王宫。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们要欢喜快乐被引导； 她们要进入王宫。
verses.textEnNiv: Led in with joy and gladness, they enter the palace of the king.
verses.textEnEsv: With joy and gladness they are led along as they enter the palace of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be brought; They shall enter the King’s palace.
verses.textEnNlt: What a joyful and enthusiastic procession as they enter the king’s palace!
verses.textEnNasb: They will be brought with joy and rejoicing; They will enter into the King’s palace.
verses.textEn: Led in with joy and gladness, they enter the palace of the king.

verses.textZh: 你的子孙必接续你的列祖； 你要立他们作全地的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的子孙必接续你的列祖； 你要立他们作全地的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的子孙要接续你的列祖； 你要立他们在全地作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
verses.textEnEsv: In place of your fathers shall be your sons; you will make them princes in all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Instead of Your fathers shall be Your sons, Whom You shall make princes in all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Your sons will become kings like their father. You will make them rulers over many lands.
verses.textEnNasb: In place of your fathers will be your sons; You shall make them princes in all the earth.
verses.textEn: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

verses.textZh: 我必使你的名被万代记念； 因此万民都必称赞你，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你的名被万代记念； 因此万民都必称赞你，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必叫你的名被万代记念， 所以万民要永永远远称谢你。
verses.textEnNiv: I will perpetuate your memory through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: I will cause your name to be remembered in all generations; therefore nations will praise you forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make Your name to be remembered in all generations; Therefore the people shall praise You forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring honor to your name in every generation. Therefore, the nations will praise you forever and ever.
verses.textEnNasb: I will make Your name known among all generations; Therefore the peoples will praise You forever and ever.
verses.textEn: I will perpetuate your memory through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 可拉子孙的歌，交给诗班长，用女高调。神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量， 是我们在患难中随时都可得到的帮助。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉子孙的歌，交给诗班长，用女高调。神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量， 是我们在患难中随时都可得到的帮助。
verses.textZhCuv: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量， 是我们在患难中随时的帮助。
verses.textEnNiv: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: God is our refuge and strength, always ready to help in times of trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: God is our refuge and strength, A very ready help in trouble.
verses.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

verses.textZh: 因此，地虽然震动， 群山虽然崩塌入海洋的深处， 我们也不害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，地虽然震动， 群山虽然崩塌入海洋的深处， 我们也不害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，地虽改变， 山虽摇动到海心，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore we will not fear though the earth give way, though the mountains be moved into the heart of the sea,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we will not fear, Even though the earth be removed, And though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.textEnNlt: So we will not fear when earthquakes come and the mountains crumble into the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth shakes And the mountains slip into the heart of the sea;
verses.textEn: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,

verses.textZh: 虽然海浪翻腾澎湃， 虽然山岳因波涛汹涌摇动， 我们也不害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然海浪翻腾澎湃， 虽然山岳因波涛汹涌摇动， 我们也不害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中的水虽匉訇翻腾， 山虽因海涨而战抖， 我们也不害怕。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging.
verses.textEnEsv: though its waters roar and foam, though the mountains tremble at its swelling. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Though its waters roar and be troubled, Though the mountains shake with its swelling. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Let the oceans roar and foam. Let the mountains tremble as the waters surge! Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Though its waters roar and foam, Though the mountains quake at its swelling pride. Selah
verses.textEn: though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging.

verses.textZh: 有一条河，它众多的支流使神的城充满快乐； 这城就是至高者居住的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一条河，它众多的支流使神的城充满快乐； 这城就是至高者居住的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一道河，这河的分汊使神的城欢喜； 这城就是至高者居住的圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
verses.textEnEsv: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy habitation of the Most High.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis a river whose streams shall make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacle of the Most High.
verses.textEnNlt: A river brings joy to the city of our God, the sacred home of the Most High.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a river whose streams make the city of God happy, The holy dwelling places of the Most High.
verses.textEn: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.

verses.textZh: 神在城中，城必不动摇； 天一亮，神必帮助它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在城中，城必不动摇； 天一亮，神必帮助它。
verses.textZhCuv: 神在其中，城必不动摇； 到天一亮，神必帮助这城。
verses.textEnNiv: God is within her, she will not fall; God will help her at break of day.
verses.textEnEsv: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved; God will help her when morning dawns.
verses.textEnNkjv: God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved; God shall help her, just at the break of dawn.
verses.textEnNlt: God dwells in that city; it cannot be destroyed. From the very break of day, God will protect it.
verses.textEnNasb: God is in the midst of her, she will not be moved; God will help her when morning dawns.
verses.textEn: God is within her, she will not fall; God will help her at break of day.

verses.textZh: 列邦喧嚷，万国动摇；神一发声，地就融化。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列邦喧嚷，万国动摇；神一发声，地就融化。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦喧嚷，列国动摇；神发声，地便熔化。
verses.textEnNiv: Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall; he lifts his voice, the earth melts.
verses.textEnEsv: The nations rage, the kingdoms totter; he utters his voice, the earth melts.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.
verses.textEnNlt: The nations are in chaos, and their kingdoms crumble! God’s voice thunders, and the earth melts!
verses.textEnNasb: The nations made an uproar, the kingdoms tottered; He raised His voice, the earth quaked.
verses.textEn: Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall; he lifts his voice, the earth melts.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的神是我们的保障。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的神是我们的保障。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的神是我们的避难所！ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies is here among us; the God of Israel is our fortress. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.

verses.textZh: 你们都来，看耶和华的作为， 看他怎样使地荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们都来，看耶和华的作为， 看他怎样使地荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们来看耶和华的作为， 看他使地怎样荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: Come and see what the Lord has done, the desolations he has brought on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Come, behold the works of the Lord , how he has brought desolations on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come, behold the works of the Lord, Who has made desolations in the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, see the glorious works of the Lord : See how he brings destruction upon the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Come, behold the works of the Lord, Who has inflicted horrific events on the earth.
verses.textEn: Come and see what the Lord has done, the desolations he has brought on the earth.

verses.textZh: 他使战争止息，直到地极； 他把弓折毁，把矛砍断， 把战车用火焚烧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使战争止息，直到地极； 他把弓折毁，把矛砍断， 把战车用火焚烧。
verses.textZhCuv: 他止息刀兵，直到地极； 他折弓、断枪，把战车焚烧在火中。
verses.textEnNiv: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth. He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; he burns the shields with fire.
verses.textEnEsv: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear; he burns the chariots with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; He breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two; He burns the chariot in the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: He causes wars to end throughout the earth. He breaks the bow and snaps the spear; he burns the shields with fire.
verses.textEnNasb: He makes wars to cease to the end of the earth; He breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two; He burns the chariots with fire.
verses.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth. He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; he burns the shields with fire.

verses.textZh: 你们要住手，要知道我是神； 我要在列国中被尊崇，我要在全地上被尊崇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要住手，要知道我是神； 我要在列国中被尊崇，我要在全地上被尊崇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要休息，要知道我是神！ 我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。
verses.textEnNiv: He says, "Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: "Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth!
verses.textEnNlt: "Be still, and know that I am God! I will be honored by every nation. I will be honored throughout the world."
verses.textEnNasb: " Stop striving and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted on the earth."
verses.textEn: He says, "Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的神是我们的保障。 可拉子孙的诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的神是我们的保障。 可拉子孙的诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华与我们同在； 雅各的神是我们的避难所！
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies is here among us; the God of Israel is our fortress. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah
verses.textEn: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.

verses.textZh: 万民哪！你们都要鼓掌， 要向神欢声呼喊；
verses.textZhCnvs: 万民哪！你们都要鼓掌， 要向神欢声呼喊；
verses.textZhCuv: 万民哪，你们都要拍掌！ 要用夸胜的声音向神呼喊！
verses.textEnNiv: Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.
verses.textEnEsv: Clap your hands, all peoples! Shout to God with loud songs of joy!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, clap your hands, all you peoples! Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
verses.textEnNlt: Come, everyone! Clap your hands! Shout to God with joyful praise!
verses.textEnNasb: Clap your hands, all you peoples; Shout to God with a voice of joy.
verses.textEn: Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华至高者是可敬畏的， 他是统治全地的大君王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华至高者是可敬畏的， 他是统治全地的大君王。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华至高者是可畏的； 他是治理全地的大君王。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord Most High is awesome, the great King over all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord , the Most High, is to be feared, a great king over all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord Most High is awesome; Heis a great King over all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord Most High is awesome. He is the great King of all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord Most High is to be feared, A great King over all the earth.
verses.textEn: For the Lord Most High is awesome, the great King over all the earth.

verses.textZh: 他要使万民臣服在我们之下， 使列国臣服在我们的脚下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要使万民臣服在我们之下， 使列国臣服在我们的脚下。
verses.textZhCuv: 他叫万民服在我们以下， 又叫列邦服在我们脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: He subdued nations under us, peoples under our feet.
verses.textEnEsv: He subdued peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will subdue the peoples under us, And the nations under our feet.
verses.textEnNlt: He subdues the nations before us, putting our enemies beneath our feet.
verses.textEnNasb: He subdues peoples under us And nations under our feet.
verses.textEn: He subdued nations under us, peoples under our feet.

verses.textZh: 他为我们选择了我们的产业， 就是他所爱的雅各的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为我们选择了我们的产业， 就是他所爱的雅各的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为我们选择产业， 就是他所爱之雅各的荣耀。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved.
verses.textEnEsv: He chose our heritage for us, the pride of Jacob whom he loves. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: He will choose our inheritance for us, The excellence of Jacob whom He loves. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: He chose the Promised Land as our inheritance, the proud possession of Jacob’s descendants, whom he loves. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: He chooses our inheritance for us, The pride of Jacob whom He loves. Selah
verses.textEn: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved.

verses.textZh: 神在欢呼声中上升， 耶和华在号角声中上升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在欢呼声中上升， 耶和华在号角声中上升。
verses.textZhCuv: 神上升，有喊声相送； 耶和华上升，有角声相送。
verses.textEnNiv: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the Lord amid the sounding of trumpets.
verses.textEnEsv: God has gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.textEnNkjv: God has gone up with a shout, The Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.textEnNlt: God has ascended with a mighty shout. The Lord has ascended with trumpets blaring.
verses.textEnNasb: God has ascended with a shout, The Lord, with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.textEn: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the Lord amid the sounding of trumpets.

verses.textZh: 你们要歌颂，歌颂神； 你们要歌颂，歌颂我们的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要歌颂，歌颂神； 你们要歌颂，歌颂我们的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要向神歌颂，歌颂！ 向我们王歌颂，歌颂！
verses.textEnNiv: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!
verses.textEnNlt: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
verses.textEnNasb: Sing praises to God, sing praises; Sing praises to our King, sing praises.
verses.textEn: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.

verses.textZh: 因为神是全地的王， 你们要用诗歌歌颂他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神是全地的王， 你们要用诗歌歌颂他。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神是全地的王； 你们要用悟性歌颂。
verses.textEnNiv: For God is the King of all the earth; sing to him a psalm of praise.
