verses.textEnEsv: For God is the King of all the earth; sing praises with a psalm!
verses.textEnNkjv: For God is the King of all the earth; Sing praises with understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: For God is the King over all the earth. Praise him with a psalm.
verses.textEnNasb: For God is the King of all the earth; Sing praises with a psalm of wisdom.
verses.textEn: For God is the King of all the earth; sing to him a psalm of praise.

verses.textZh: 神作王统治列国，神坐在他的圣宝座上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神作王统治列国，神坐在他的圣宝座上。
verses.textZhCuv: 神作王治理万国；神坐在他的圣宝座上。
verses.textEnNiv: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on his holy throne.
verses.textEnEsv: God reigns over the nations; God sits on his holy throne.
verses.textEnNkjv: God reigns over the nations; God sits on His holy throne.
verses.textEnNlt: God reigns above the nations, sitting on his holy throne.
verses.textEnNasb: God reigns over the nations, God sits on His holy throne.
verses.textEn: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on his holy throne.

verses.textZh: 万民中的显贵都聚集起来， 要作亚伯拉罕的神的子民； 因为地上的君王 都归顺神； 他被尊为至高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万民中的显贵都聚集起来， 要作亚伯拉罕的神的子民； 因为地上的君王 都归顺神； 他被尊为至高。
verses.textZhCuv: 列邦的君王聚集要作亚伯拉罕之神的民。 因为世界的盾牌是属神的； 他为至高！
verses.textEnNiv: The nobles of the nations assemble as the people of the God of Abraham, for the kings of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.
verses.textEnEsv: The princes of the peoples gather as the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God; he is highly exalted!
verses.textEnNkjv: The princes of the people have gathered together, The people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God; He is greatly exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: The rulers of the world have gathered together with the people of the God of Abraham. For all the kings of the earth belong to God. He is highly honored everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: The princes of the people have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham, For the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
verses.textEn: The nobles of the nations assemble as the people of the God of Abraham, for the kings of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.

verses.textZh: 歌一首，可拉子孙的诗。 在我们神的城中，在他的圣山上， 耶和华是至大的，应该大受赞美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌一首，可拉子孙的诗。 在我们神的城中，在他的圣山上， 耶和华是至大的，应该大受赞美。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华本为大！ 在我们神的城中， 在他的圣山上，该受大赞美。
verses.textEnNiv: Great is the Lord , and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God, his holy mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in the city of our God! His holy mountain,
verses.textEnNkjv: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised In the city of our God, In His holy mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: How great is the Lord , how deserving of praise, in the city of our God, which sits on his holy mountain!
verses.textEnNasb: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised In the city of our God, His holy mountain.
verses.textEn: Great is the Lord , and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God, his holy mountain.

verses.textZh: 在北面的锡安山、大君王的城， 美丽高耸，是全地所喜欢的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在北面的锡安山、大君王的城， 美丽高耸，是全地所喜欢的。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安山－大君王的城， 在北面居高华美， 为全地所喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: Beautiful in its loftiness, the joy of the whole earth, like the heights of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the Great King.
verses.textEnEsv: beautiful in elevation, is the joy of all the earth, Mount Zion, in the far north, the city of the great King.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beautiful in elevation, The joy of the whole earth, Is Mount Zion on the sides of the north, The city of the great King.
verses.textEnNlt: It is high and magnificent; the whole earth rejoices to see it! Mount Zion, the holy mountain, is the city of the great King!
verses.textEnNasb: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is Mount Zion in the far north, The city of the great King.
verses.textEn: Beautiful in its loftiness, the joy of the whole earth, like the heights of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the Great King.

verses.textZh: 神在城的堡垒中， 显明自己是避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在城的堡垒中， 显明自己是避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 神在其宫中， 自显为避难所。
verses.textEnNiv: God is in her citadels; he has shown himself to be her fortress.
verses.textEnEsv: Within her citadels God has made himself known as a fortress.
verses.textEnNkjv: God is in her palaces; He is known as her refuge.
verses.textEnNlt: God himself is in Jerusalem’s towers, revealing himself as its defender.
verses.textEnNasb: In its palaces, God has made Himself known as a stronghold.
verses.textEn: God is in her citadels; he has shown himself to be her fortress.

verses.textZh: 看哪！列王会合， 一同前进。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！列王会合， 一同前进。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，众王会合， 一同经过。
verses.textEnNiv: When the kings joined forces, when they advanced together,
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, the kings assembled; they came on together.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, the kings assembled, They passed by together.
verses.textEnNlt: The kings of the earth joined forces and advanced against the city.
verses.textEnNasb: For, behold, the kings arrived, They passed by together.
verses.textEn: When the kings joined forces, when they advanced together,

verses.textZh: 他们一见这城，就惊惶， 慌忙逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们一见这城，就惊惶， 慌忙逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们见了这城就惊奇丧胆， 急忙逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: they saw her and were astounded; they fled in terror.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as they saw it, they were astounded; they were in panic; they took to flight.
verses.textEnNkjv: They saw it, and so they marveled; They were troubled, they hastened away.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they saw it, they were stunned; they were terrified and ran away.
verses.textEnNasb: They saw it, then they were amazed; They were terrified, they fled in a hurry.
verses.textEn: they saw her and were astounded; they fled in terror.

verses.textZh: 他们在那里战栗恐惧； 他们痛苦好象妇人分娩时一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在那里战栗恐惧； 他们痛苦好象妇人分娩时一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在那里被战兢疼痛抓住， 好像产难的妇人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Trembling seized them there, pain like that of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnEsv: Trembling took hold of them there, anguish as of a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fear took hold of them there, And pain, as of a woman in birth pangs,
verses.textEnNlt: They were gripped with terror and writhed in pain like a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNasb: Panic seized them there, Anguish, as that of a woman in childbirth.
verses.textEn: Trembling seized them there, pain like that of a woman in labor.

verses.textZh: 你用东风摧毁他施的船队。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你用东风摧毁他施的船队。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你用东风打破他施的船只。
verses.textEnNiv: You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish shattered by an east wind.
verses.textEnEsv: By the east wind you shattered the ships of Tarshish.
verses.textEnNkjv: Aswhen You break the ships of Tarshish With an east wind.
verses.textEnNlt: You destroyed them like the mighty ships of Tarshish shattered by a powerful east wind.
verses.textEnNasb: With the east wind You smash the ships of Tarshish.
verses.textEn: You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish shattered by an east wind.

verses.textZh: 在万军之耶和华的城中， 就是在我们神的城中， 我们所看见的，正如我们所听见的：神必坚立这城，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在万军之耶和华的城中， 就是在我们神的城中， 我们所看见的，正如我们所听见的：神必坚立这城，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在万军之耶和华的城中 －就是我们神的城中－所看见的， 正如我们所听见的。神必坚立这城，直到永远。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the Lord Almighty, in the city of our God: God makes her secure forever.
verses.textEnEsv: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God, which God will establish forever. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: As we have heard, So we have seen In the city of the Lord of hosts, In the city of our God: God will establish it forever. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: We had heard of the city’s glory, but now we have seen it ourselves— the city of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies. It is the city of our God; he will make it safe forever. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Just as we have heard, so have we seen In the city of the Lord of armies, in the city of our God; God will establish her forever. Selah
verses.textEn: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the Lord Almighty, in the city of our God: God makes her secure forever.

verses.textZh: 神啊！我们在你的殿中， 想念你的慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！我们在你的殿中， 想念你的慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我们在你的殿中想念你的慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Within your temple, O God, we meditate on your unfailing love.
verses.textEnEsv: We have thought on your steadfast love, O God, in the midst of your temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have thought, O God, on Your lovingkindness, In the midst of Your temple.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, we meditate on your unfailing love as we worship in your Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: We have thought over Your goodness, God, In the midst of Your temple.
verses.textEn: Within your temple, O God, we meditate on your unfailing love.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你受的赞美， 就像你的名一样，达到地极； 你的右手满了公义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你受的赞美， 就像你的名一样，达到地极； 你的右手满了公义。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你受的赞美正与你的名相称，直到地极！ 你的右手满了公义。
verses.textEnNiv: Like your name, O God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: As your name, O God, so your praise reaches to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is filled with righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to Your name, O God, So is Your praise to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: As your name deserves, O God, you will be praised to the ends of the earth. Your strong right hand is filled with victory.
verses.textEnNasb: As is Your name, God, So is Your praise to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.textEn: Like your name, O God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with righteousness.

verses.textZh: 因你的审判，锡安山应当欢喜， 犹大的居民 应当快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你的审判，锡安山应当欢喜， 犹大的居民 应当快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你的判断，锡安山应当欢喜， 犹大的城邑 应当快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Mount Zion rejoices, the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments.
verses.textEnEsv: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Mount Zion rejoice, Let the daughters of Judah be glad, Because of Your judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the people on Mount Zion rejoice. Let all the towns of Judah be glad because of your justice.
verses.textEnNasb: Mount Zion shall be glad, The daughters of Judah shall rejoice Because of Your judgments.
verses.textEn: Mount Zion rejoices, the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments.

verses.textZh: 你们要在锡安四处巡行，绕城一周， 数点城楼，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在锡安四处巡行，绕城一周， 数点城楼，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当周游锡安， 四围旋绕，数点城楼，
verses.textEnNiv: Walk about Zion, go around her, count her towers,
verses.textEnEsv: Walk about Zion, go around her, number her towers,
verses.textEnNkjv: Walk about Zion, And go all around her. Count her towers;
verses.textEnNlt: Go, inspect the city of Jerusalem. Walk around and count the many towers.
verses.textEnNasb: Walk around Zion and encircle her; Count her towers;
verses.textEn: Walk about Zion, go around her, count her towers,

verses.textZh: 细察它的外墙， 巡视它的堡垒， 使你们可以述说给后代的人听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 细察它的外墙， 巡视它的堡垒， 使你们可以述说给后代的人听。
verses.textZhCuv: 细看她的外郭， 察看她的宫殿， 为要传说到后代。
verses.textEnNiv: consider well her ramparts, view her citadels, that you may tell of them to the next generation.
verses.textEnEsv: consider well her ramparts, go through her citadels, that you may tell the next generation
verses.textEnNkjv: Mark well her bulwarks; Consider her palaces; That you may tell it to the generation following.
verses.textEnNlt: Take note of the fortified walls, and tour all the citadels, that you may describe them to future generations.
verses.textEnNasb: Consider her ramparts; Go through her palaces, So that you may tell of her to the next generation.
verses.textEn: consider well her ramparts, view her citadels, that you may tell of them to the next generation.

verses.textZh: 因为这位神就是我们的神， 直到永永远远； 他必引导我们，直到我们死的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这位神就是我们的神， 直到永永远远； 他必引导我们，直到我们死的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这神永永远远为我们的神； 他必作我们引路的，直到死时。
verses.textEnNiv: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide even to the end.
verses.textEnEsv: that this is God, our God forever and ever. He will guide us forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is God, Our God forever and ever; He will be our guide Even to death.
verses.textEnNlt: For that is what God is like. He is our God forever and ever, and he will guide us until we die.
verses.textEnNasb: For such is God, Our God forever and ever; He will lead us until death.
verses.textEn: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide even to the end.

verses.textZh: 可拉子孙的诗，交给诗班长。 万民哪！你们要听这话； 世上的居民哪！你们要留心听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉子孙的诗，交给诗班长。 万民哪！你们要听这话； 世上的居民哪！你们要留心听。
verses.textZhCuv: 万民哪，你们都当听这话！ 世上一切的居民，
verses.textEnNiv: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in this world,
verses.textEnEsv: Hear this, all peoples! Give ear, all inhabitants of the world,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear this, all peoples; Give ear, all inhabitants of the world,
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to this, all you people! Pay attention, everyone in the world!
verses.textEnNasb: Hear this, all peoples; Listen, all inhabitants of the world,
verses.textEn: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in this world,

verses.textZh: 不论地位高低，或贫或富， 都要一同留心听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不论地位高低，或贫或富， 都要一同留心听。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论上流下流，富足贫穷， 都当留心听！
verses.textEnNiv: both low and high, rich and poor alike:
verses.textEnEsv: both low and high, rich and poor together!
verses.textEnNkjv: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.
verses.textEnNlt: High and low, rich and poor—listen!
verses.textEnNasb: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.
verses.textEn: both low and high, rich and poor alike:

verses.textZh: 我的口要说出智慧的话； 我的心要默想明智的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的口要说出智慧的话； 我的心要默想明智的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我口要说智慧的言语； 我心要想通达的道理。
verses.textEnNiv: My mouth will speak words of wisdom; the meditation of my heart will give you understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: My mouth shall speak wisdom; the meditation of my heart shall be understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: My mouth shall speak wisdom, And the meditation of my heart shallgive understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: For my words are wise, and my thoughts are filled with insight.
verses.textEnNasb: My mouth will speak wisdom, And the meditation of my heart will be understanding.
verses.textEn: My mouth will speak words of wisdom; the meditation of my heart will give you understanding.

verses.textZh: 我要留心聆听箴言； 我要弹琴解开谜语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要留心聆听箴言； 我要弹琴解开谜语。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要侧耳听比喻， 用琴解谜语。
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn my ear to a proverb; with the harp I will expound my riddle:
verses.textEnEsv: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will solve my riddle to the music of the lyre.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will disclose my dark saying on the harp.
verses.textEnNlt: I listen carefully to many proverbs and solve riddles with inspiration from a harp.
verses.textEnNasb: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle on the harp.
verses.textEn: I will turn my ear to a proverb; with the harp I will expound my riddle:

verses.textZh: 在患难的日子，暗中迫害我的恶人围绕我的时候， 我何须惧怕呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 在患难的日子，暗中迫害我的恶人围绕我的时候， 我何须惧怕呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 在患难的日子，奸恶随我脚跟，四面环绕我， 我何必惧怕？
verses.textEnNiv: Why should I fear when evil days come, when wicked deceivers surround me—
verses.textEnEsv: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when the iniquity of those who cheat me surrounds me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Why should I fear in the days of evil, When the iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
verses.textEnNlt: Why should I fear when trouble comes, when enemies surround me?
verses.textEnNasb: Why should I fear in days of adversity, When the injustice of those who betray me surrounds me,
verses.textEn: Why should I fear when evil days come, when wicked deceivers surround me—

verses.textZh: 他们倚靠财富， 自夸多财。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们倚靠财富， 自夸多财。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些倚仗财货自夸钱财多的人，
verses.textEnNiv: those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?
verses.textEnEsv: those who trust in their wealth and boast of the abundance of their riches?
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who trust in their wealth And boast in the multitude of their riches,
verses.textEnNlt: They trust in their wealth and boast of great riches.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who trust in their wealth And boast in the abundance of their riches?
verses.textEn: those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?

verses.textZh: 但他们没有一个能把他的兄弟赎回， 或把他的赎价交给神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们没有一个能把他的兄弟赎回， 或把他的赎价交给神，
verses.textZhCuv: 一个也无法赎自己的弟兄， 也不能替他将赎价给神，
verses.textEnNiv: No one can redeem the life of another or give to God a ransom for them—
verses.textEnEsv: Truly no man can ransom another, or give to God the price of his life,
verses.textEnNkjv: None ofthem can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him—
verses.textEnNlt: Yet they cannot redeem themselves from death by paying a ransom to God.
verses.textEnNasb: No one can by any means redeem another Or give God a ransom for him—
verses.textEn: No one can redeem the life of another or give to God a ransom for them—

verses.textZh: 使他永远活着， 不见朽坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他永远活着， 不见朽坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为赎他生命的价值极贵， 只可永远罢休。
verses.textEnNiv: the ransom for a life is costly, no payment is ever enough—
verses.textEnEsv: for the ransom of their life is costly and can never suffice,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the redemption of their souls is costly, And it shall cease forever—
verses.textEnNlt: Redemption does not come so easily, for no one can ever pay enough
verses.textEnNasb: For the redemption of his soul is priceless, And he should cease imagining forever—
verses.textEn: the ransom for a life is costly, no payment is ever enough—

verses.textZh: 他看见智慧人死去， 愚昧人和愚顽人一同灭亡， 把他们的财产留给别人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他看见智慧人死去， 愚昧人和愚顽人一同灭亡， 把他们的财产留给别人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必见智慧人死， 又见愚顽人和畜类人一同灭亡， 将他们的财货留给别人。
verses.textEnNiv: so that they should live on forever and not see decay.
verses.textEnEsv: that he should live on forever and never see the pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: That he should continue to live eternally, And not see the Pit.
verses.textEnNlt: to live forever and never see the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: That he might live on eternally, That he might not undergo decay.
verses.textEn: so that they should live on forever and not see decay.

verses.textZh: 他们心里想，他们的家必永存， 他们的住处必留到万代； 他们以自己的名，称自己的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们心里想，他们的家必永存， 他们的住处必留到万代； 他们以自己的名，称自己的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们心里思想： 他们的家室必永存， 住宅必留到万代； 他们以自己的名称自己的地。
verses.textEnNiv: For all can see that the wise die, that the foolish and the senseless also perish, leaving their wealth to others.
verses.textEnEsv: For he sees that even the wise die; the fool and the stupid alike must perish and leave their wealth to others.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he sees wise men die; Likewise the fool and the senseless person perish, And leave their wealth to others.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are wise must finally die, just like the foolish and senseless, leaving all their wealth behind.
verses.textEnNasb: For he sees that even wise people die; The foolish and the stupid alike perish And leave their wealth to others.
verses.textEn: For all can see that the wise die, that the foolish and the senseless also perish, leaving their wealth to others.

verses.textZh: 但是人不能长享富贵； 他们就像要灭亡的牲畜一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是人不能长享富贵； 他们就像要灭亡的牲畜一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 但人居尊贵中不能长久， 如同死亡的畜类一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Their tombs will remain their houses forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they had named lands after themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Their graves are their homes forever, their dwelling places to all generations, though they called lands by their own names.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their inner thought isthat their houses willlast forever, Their dwelling places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.
verses.textEnNlt: The grave is their eternal home, where they will stay forever. They may name their estates after themselves,
verses.textEnNasb: Their inner thought is that their houses are forever And their dwelling places to all generations; They have named their lands after their own names.
verses.textEn: Their tombs will remain their houses forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they had named lands after themselves.

verses.textZh: 这就是愚昧人的道路； 但在他们以后的人，还欣赏他们的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是愚昧人的道路； 但在他们以后的人，还欣赏他们的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们行的这道本为自己的愚昧； 但他们以后的人还佩服他们的话语。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: People, despite their wealth, do not endure; they are like the beasts that perish.
verses.textEnEsv: Man in his pomp will not remain; he is like the beasts that perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless man, though in honor, does not remain; He is like the beasts that perish.
verses.textEnNlt: but their fame will not last. They will die, just like animals.
verses.textEnNasb: But man in his splendor will not endure; He is like the animals that perish.
verses.textEn: People, despite their wealth, do not endure; they are like the beasts that perish.

verses.textZh: 他们好象羊群被派定下阴间； 死亡必作他们的牧人。 到了早晨，正直人要管辖他们； 他们的形体必被阴间消灭， 他们再没有住处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们好象羊群被派定下阴间； 死亡必作他们的牧人。 到了早晨，正直人要管辖他们； 他们的形体必被阴间消灭， 他们再没有住处。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们如同羊群派定下阴间； 死亡必作他们的牧者。 到了早晨，正直人必管辖他们； 他们的美容必被阴间所灭，以致无处可存。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the path of those who have foolish confidence; yet after them people approve of their boasts. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the way of those who are foolish, And of their posterity who approve their sayings. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: This is the fate of fools, though they are remembered as being wise. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: This is the way of those who are foolish, And of those after them who approve their words. Selah
verses.textEn: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings.

verses.textZh: 但神必救赎我的灵魂脱离阴间的权势， 因为他必把我接去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但神必救赎我的灵魂脱离阴间的权势， 因为他必把我接去。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是神必救赎我的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄， 因他必收纳我。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: They are like sheep and are destined to die; death will be their shepherd (but the upright will prevail over them in the morning). Their forms will decay in the grave, far from their princely mansions.
verses.textEnEsv: Like sheep they are appointed for Sheol; death shall be their shepherd, and the upright shall rule over them in the morning. Their form shall be consumed in Sheol, with no place to dwell.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; Death shall feed on them; The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their beauty shall be consumed in the grave, far from their dwelling.
verses.textEnNlt: Like sheep, they are led to the grave, where death will be their shepherd. In the morning the godly will rule over them. Their bodies will rot in the grave, far from their grand estates.
verses.textEnNasb: Like sheep they sink down to Sheol; Death will be their shepherd; And the upright will rule over them in the morning, And their form shall be for Sheol to consume So that they have no lofty home.
verses.textEn: They are like sheep and are destined to die; death will be their shepherd (but the upright will prevail over them in the morning). Their forms will decay in the grave, far from their princely mansions.

verses.textZh: 别人发财，家室增荣的时候， 你不要惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 别人发财，家室增荣的时候， 你不要惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 见人发财、家室增荣的时候， 你不要惧怕；
verses.textEnNiv: But God will redeem me from the realm of the dead; he will surely take me to himself.
verses.textEnEsv: But God will ransom my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave, For He shall receive me. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: But as for me, God will redeem my life. He will snatch me from the power of the grave. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, For He will receive me. Selah
verses.textEn: But God will redeem me from the realm of the dead; he will surely take me to himself.

verses.textZh: 因为他死的时候，甚么也不能带走； 他的荣华也不能随他下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他死的时候，甚么也不能带走； 他的荣华也不能随他下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，他死的时候什么也不能带去； 他的荣耀不能随他下去。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be overawed when others grow rich, when the splendor of their houses increases;
verses.textEnEsv: Be not afraid when a man becomes rich, when the glory of his house increases.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be afraid when one becomes rich, When the glory of his house is increased;
verses.textEnNlt: So don’t be dismayed when the wicked grow rich and their homes become ever more splendid.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be afraid when a person becomes rich, When the splendor of his house is increased;
verses.textEn: Do not be overawed when others grow rich, when the splendor of their houses increases;

verses.textZh: 他在世的时候，虽然自称是有福的，并且说： "只要你丰足，人就称赞你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在世的时候，虽然自称是有福的，并且说： "只要你丰足，人就称赞你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他活着的时候，虽然自夸为有福 （你若利己，人必夸奖你）；
verses.textEnNiv: for they will take nothing with them when they die, their splendor will not descend with them.
verses.textEnEsv: For when he dies he will carry nothing away; his glory will not go down after him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when he dies he shall carry nothing away; His glory shall not descend after him.
verses.textEnNlt: For when they die, they take nothing with them. Their wealth will not follow them into the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: For when he dies, he will take nothing with him; His wealth will not descend after him.
verses.textEn: for they will take nothing with them when they die, their splendor will not descend with them.

verses.textZh: 他还要归到他历代的祖宗那里去， 永不再见光明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他还要归到他历代的祖宗那里去， 永不再见光明。
verses.textZhCuv: 他仍必归到他历代的祖宗那里， 永不见光。
verses.textEnNiv: Though while they live they count themselves blessed— and people praise you when you prosper—
verses.textEnEsv: For though, while he lives, he counts himself blessed— and though you get praise when you do well for yourself—
verses.textEnNkjv: Though while he lives he blesses himself (For men will praise you when you do well for yourself),
verses.textEnNlt: In this life they consider themselves fortunate and are applauded for their success.
verses.textEnNasb: Though while he lives he congratulates himself— And though people praise you when you do well for yourself—
verses.textEn: Though while they live they count themselves blessed— and people praise you when you prosper—

verses.textZh: 人享富贵而不聪明， 就像要灭亡的牲畜一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人享富贵而不聪明， 就像要灭亡的牲畜一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 人在尊贵中而不醒悟， 就如死亡的畜类一样。
verses.textEnNiv: they will join those who have gone before them, who will never again see the light of life.
verses.textEnEsv: his soul will go to the generation of his fathers, who will never again see light.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see light.
verses.textEnNlt: But they will die like all before them and never again see the light of day.
verses.textEnNasb: He will go to the generation of his fathers; They will never see the light.
verses.textEn: they will join those who have gone before them, who will never again see the light of life.

verses.textZh: 人在尊贵中，却无知，就像灭亡的畜类一样。
verses.textEnNiv: People who have wealth but lack understanding are like the beasts that perish.
verses.textEnEsv: Man in his pomp yet without understanding is like the beasts that perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: A man whois in honor, yet does not understand, Is like the beasts that perish.
verses.textEnNlt: People who boast of their wealth don’t understand; they will die, just like animals.
verses.textEnNasb: Mankind in its splendor, yet without understanding, Is like the animals that perish.
verses.textEn: People who have wealth but lack understanding are like the beasts that perish.
verses.textZhCn: 人在尊贵中，却无知，就像灭亡的畜类一样。

verses.textZh: 亚萨的诗。 大能者神耶和华已经说话， 从日出之地到日落之处呼唤大地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的诗。 大能者神耶和华已经说话， 从日出之地到日落之处呼唤大地。
verses.textZhCuv: 大能者神－耶和华已经发言招呼天下， 从日出之地到日落之处。
verses.textEnNiv: The Mighty One, God, the Lord , speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to where it sets.
verses.textEnEsv: The Mighty One, God the Lord , speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Mighty One, God the Lord, Has spoken and called the earth From the rising of the sun to its going down.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord , the Mighty One, is God, and he has spoken; he has summoned all humanity from where the sun rises to where it sets.
verses.textEnNasb: The Mighty One, God, the Lord, has spoken And summoned the earth, from the rising of the sun to its setting.
verses.textEn: The Mighty One, God, the Lord , speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to where it sets.

verses.textZh: 神从全美的锡安， 已经彰显荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神从全美的锡安， 已经彰显荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 从全美的锡安中，神已经发光了。
verses.textEnNiv: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God will shine forth.
verses.textEnNlt: From Mount Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines in glorious radiance.
verses.textEnNasb: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shone.
verses.textEn: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.

verses.textZh: 我们的神来临，决不缄默无声； 在他面前有火燃烧， 在他四周有暴风刮起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的神来临，决不缄默无声； 在他面前有火燃烧， 在他四周有暴风刮起。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的神要来，决不闭口。 有烈火在他面前吞灭； 有暴风在他四围大刮。
verses.textEnNiv: Our God comes and will not be silent; a fire devours before him, and around him a tempest rages.
verses.textEnEsv: Our God comes; he does not keep silence; before him is a devouring fire, around him a mighty tempest.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silent; A fire shall devour before Him, And it shall be very tempestuous all around Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Our God approaches, and he is not silent. Fire devours everything in his way, and a great storm rages around him.
verses.textEnNasb: May our God come and not keep silent; Fire devours before Him, And a storm is violently raging around Him.
verses.textEn: Our God comes and will not be silent; a fire devours before him, and around him a tempest rages.

verses.textZh: 他向天上、向地下呼唤， 为要审判自己的子民，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向天上、向地下呼唤， 为要审判自己的子民，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 他招呼上天下地， 为要审判他的民，
verses.textEnNiv: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that he may judge his people:
verses.textEnEsv: He calls to the heavens above and to the earth, that he may judge his people:
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall call to the heavens from above, And to the earth, that He may judge His people:
verses.textEnNlt: He calls on the heavens above and earth below to witness the judgment of his people.
verses.textEnNasb: He summons the heavens above, And the earth, to judge His people:
verses.textEn: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that he may judge his people:

verses.textZh: "你们把我的圣民聚集到我这里来， 就是那些用祭物与我立约的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们把我的圣民聚集到我这里来， 就是那些用祭物与我立约的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：招聚我的圣民到我这里来， 就是那些用祭物与我立约的人。
verses.textEnNiv: "Gather to me this consecrated people, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice."
verses.textEnEsv: "Gather to me my faithful ones, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice!"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Gather My saints together to Me, Those who have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice."
verses.textEnNlt: "Bring my faithful people to me— those who made a covenant with me by giving sacrifices."
verses.textEnNasb: "Gather My godly ones to Me, Those who have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice."
verses.textEn: "Gather to me this consecrated people, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice."

verses.textZh: 诸天宣扬他的公义， 因为神自己就是审判者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诸天宣扬他的公义， 因为神自己就是审判者。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸天必表明他的公义， 因为神是施行审判的。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: And the heavens proclaim his righteousness, for he is a God of justice.
verses.textEnEsv: The heavens declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the heavens declare His righteousness, For God Himself is Judge. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Then let the heavens proclaim his justice, for God himself will be the judge. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: And the heavens declare His righteousness, For God Himself is judge. Selah
verses.textEn: And the heavens proclaim his righteousness, for he is a God of justice.

verses.textZh: "我的子民哪！你们要听，我要说话； 以色列啊！我要控诉你； 我是神，是你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的子民哪！你们要听，我要说话； 以色列啊！我要控诉你； 我是神，是你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的民哪，你们当听我的话！ 以色列啊，我要劝戒你； 我是神，是你的神！
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen, my people, and I will speak; I will testify against you, Israel: I am God, your God.
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you; I am God, your God!
verses.textEnNlt: "O my people, listen as I speak. Here are my charges against you, O Israel: I am God, your God!
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear, My people, and I will speak; Israel, I will testify against you; I am God, your God.
verses.textEn: "Listen, my people, and I will speak; I will testify against you, Israel: I am God, your God.

verses.textZh: 我不是因你的祭物责备你， 你的燔祭常在我面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不是因你的祭物责备你， 你的燔祭常在我面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 我并不因你的祭物责备你； 你的燔祭常在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: I bring no charges against you concerning your sacrifices or concerning your burnt offerings, which are ever before me.
verses.textEnEsv: Not for your sacrifices do I rebuke you; your burnt offerings are continually before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will not rebuke you for your sacrifices Or your burnt offerings, Whichare continually before Me.
verses.textEnNlt: I have no complaint about your sacrifices or the burnt offerings you constantly offer.
verses.textEnNasb: "I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, And your burnt offerings are continually before Me.
verses.textEn: I bring no charges against you concerning your sacrifices or concerning your burnt offerings, which are ever before me.

verses.textZh: 我不从你家里取公牛， 也不从你羊圈中取公山羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不从你家里取公牛， 也不从你羊圈中取公山羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 我不从你家中取公牛， 也不从你圈内取山羊；
verses.textEnNiv: I have no need of a bull from your stall or of goats from your pens,
verses.textEnEsv: I will not accept a bull from your house or goats from your folds.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will not take a bull from your house, Nor goats out of your folds.
verses.textEnNlt: But I do not need the bulls from your barns or the goats from your pens.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will not take a bull from your house, Nor male goats from your folds.
verses.textEn: I have no need of a bull from your stall or of goats from your pens,

verses.textZh: 因为树林中的百兽是我的， 千山上的牲畜也是我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为树林中的百兽是我的， 千山上的牲畜也是我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，树林中的百兽是我的， 千山上的牲畜也是我的。
verses.textEnNiv: for every animal of the forest is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.
verses.textEnEsv: For every beast of the forest is mine, the cattle on a thousand hills.
verses.textEnNkjv: For every beast of the forest is Mine, And the cattle on a thousand hills.
verses.textEnNlt: For all the animals of the forest are mine, and I own the cattle on a thousand hills.
verses.textEnNasb: "For every animal of the forest is Mine, The cattle on a thousand hills.
verses.textEn: for every animal of the forest is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.

verses.textZh: 山中的雀鸟我都认识， 田野的走兽也都属我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 山中的雀鸟我都认识， 田野的走兽也都属我。
verses.textZhCuv: 山中的飞鸟，我都知道； 野地的走兽也都属我。
verses.textEnNiv: I know every bird in the mountains, and the insects in the fields are mine.
verses.textEnEsv: I know all the birds of the hills, and all that moves in the field is mine.
verses.textEnNkjv: I know all the birds of the mountains, And the wild beasts of the field are Mine.
verses.textEnNlt: I know every bird on the mountains, and all the animals of the field are mine.
verses.textEnNasb: "I know every bird of the mountains, And everything that moves in the field is Mine.
verses.textEn: I know every bird in the mountains, and the insects in the fields are mine.

verses.textZh: 如果我饿了，我也不用对你说； 因为世界和其中所充满的，都是我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我饿了，我也不用对你说； 因为世界和其中所充满的，都是我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若是饥饿，我不用告诉你， 因为世界和其中所充满的都是我的。
verses.textEnNiv: If I were hungry I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.
verses.textEnEsv: "If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world and its fullness are mine.
verses.textEnNkjv: "If I were hungry, I would not tell you; For the world is Mine, and all its fullness.
verses.textEnNlt: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for all the world is mine and everything in it.
verses.textEnNasb: "If I were hungry I would not tell you, For the world is Mine, and everything it contains.
verses.textEn: If I were hungry I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

verses.textZh: 难道我要吃公牛的肉吗？ 要喝公山羊的血吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我要吃公牛的肉吗？ 要喝公山羊的血吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我岂吃公牛的肉呢？ 我岂喝山羊的血呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?
verses.textEnEsv: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, Or drink the blood of goats?
verses.textEnNlt: Do I eat the meat of bulls? Do I drink the blood of goats?
verses.textEnNasb: "Shall I eat the flesh of bulls Or drink the blood of male goats?
verses.textEn: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?

verses.textZh: 你要以感谢为祭献给神， 又要向至高者还你的愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要以感谢为祭献给神， 又要向至高者还你的愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要以感谢为祭献与神， 又要向至高者还你的愿，
verses.textEnNiv: "Sacrifice thank offerings to God, fulfill your vows to the Most High,
verses.textEnEsv: Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and perform your vows to the Most High,
verses.textEnNkjv: Offer to God thanksgiving, And pay your vows to the Most High.
verses.textEnNlt: Make thankfulness your sacrifice to God, and keep the vows you made to the Most High.
verses.textEnNasb: "Offer God a sacrifice of thanksgiving And pay your vows to the Most High;
verses.textEn: "Sacrifice thank offerings to God, fulfill your vows to the Most High,

verses.textZh: 在患难的日子，你呼求我。 我必搭救你，你也必尊敬我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在患难的日子，你呼求我。 我必搭救你，你也必尊敬我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并要在患难之日求告我； 我必搭救你，你也要荣耀我。
verses.textEnNiv: and call on me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor me."
verses.textEnEsv: and call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify Me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then call on me when you are in trouble, and I will rescue you, and you will give me glory."
verses.textEnNasb: Call upon Me on the day of trouble; I will rescue you, and you will honor Me."
verses.textEn: and call on me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor me."

verses.textZh: 但神对恶人说： "你怎么敢述说我的律例， 你的口怎么敢提到我的约呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 但神对恶人说： "你怎么敢述说我的律例， 你的口怎么敢提到我的约呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 但神对恶人说：你怎敢传说我的律例， 口中提到我的约呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But to the wicked person, God says: "What right have you to recite my laws or take my covenant on your lips?
verses.textEnEsv: But to the wicked God says: "What right have you to recite my statutes or take my covenant on your lips?
verses.textEnNkjv: But to the wicked God says: "What right have you to declare My statutes, Or take My covenant in your mouth,
verses.textEnNlt: But God says to the wicked: "Why bother reciting my decrees and pretending to obey my covenant?
verses.textEnNasb: But to the wicked God says, "What right do you have to tell of My statutes And to take My covenant in your mouth?
verses.textEn: But to the wicked person, God says: "What right have you to recite my laws or take my covenant on your lips?

verses.textZh: 至于你，你憎恨管教， 并且把我的话丢在背后。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，你憎恨管教， 并且把我的话丢在背后。
verses.textZhCuv: 其实你恨恶管教， 将我的言语丢在背后。
verses.textEnNiv: You hate my instruction and cast my words behind you.
verses.textEnEsv: For you hate discipline, and you cast my words behind you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seeing you hate instruction And cast My words behind you?
verses.textEnNlt: For you refuse my discipline and treat my words like trash.
verses.textEnNasb: "For you yourself hate discipline, And you throw My words behind you.
verses.textEn: You hate my instruction and cast my words behind you.

verses.textZh: 你看见盗贼的时候，就乐于和他在一起； 你又与行淫的人有分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看见盗贼的时候，就乐于和他在一起； 你又与行淫的人有分。
verses.textZhCuv: 你见了盗贼就乐意与他同伙， 又与行奸淫的人一同有分。
verses.textEnNiv: When you see a thief, you join with him; you throw in your lot with adulterers.
verses.textEnEsv: If you see a thief, you are pleased with him, and you keep company with adulterers.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, And have been a partaker with adulterers.
verses.textEnNlt: When you see thieves, you approve of them, and you spend your time with adulterers.
verses.textEnNasb: "When you see a thief, you become friends with him, And you associate with adulterers.
verses.textEn: When you see a thief, you join with him; you throw in your lot with adulterers.

verses.textZh: 你使你的口乱说坏话， 使你的舌头编造谎言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使你的口乱说坏话， 使你的舌头编造谎言。
verses.textZhCuv: 你口任说恶言； 你舌编造诡诈。
verses.textEnNiv: You use your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.
verses.textEnEsv: "You give your mouth free rein for evil, and your tongue frames deceit.
verses.textEnNkjv: You give your mouth to evil, And your tongue frames deceit.
verses.textEnNlt: Your mouth is filled with wickedness, and your tongue is full of lies.
verses.textEnNasb: "You let your mouth loose in evil, And your tongue harnesses deceit.
verses.textEn: You use your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.

verses.textZh: 你经常毁谤你的兄弟， 诬蔑你母亲的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你经常毁谤你的兄弟， 诬蔑你母亲的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你坐着毁谤你的兄弟， 谗毁你亲母的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: You sit and testify against your brother and slander your own mother’s son.
verses.textEnEsv: You sit and speak against your brother; you slander your own mother’s son.
verses.textEnNkjv: You sit and speak against your brother; You slander your own mother’s son.
verses.textEnNlt: You sit around and slander your brother— your own mother’s son.
verses.textEnNasb: "You sit and speak against your brother; You slander your own mother’s son.
verses.textEn: You sit and testify against your brother and slander your own mother’s son.

verses.textZh: 你作了这些事，我默不作声； 你以为我和你一样？ 其实我要责备你，要当面指控你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你作了这些事，我默不作声； 你以为我和你一样？ 其实我要责备你，要当面指控你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你行了这些事，我还闭口不言， 你想我恰和你一样； 其实我要责备你，将这些事摆在你眼前。
verses.textEnNiv: When you did these things and I kept silent, you thought I was exactly like you. But I now arraign you and set my accusations before you.
verses.textEnEsv: These things you have done, and I have been silent; you thought that I was one like yourself. But now I rebuke you and lay the charge before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things you have done, and I kept silent; You thought that I was altogether like you; But I will rebuke you, And set them in order before your eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: While you did all this, I remained silent, and you thought I didn’t care. But now I will rebuke you, listing all my charges against you.
verses.textEnNasb: "These things you have done and I kept silent; You thought that I was just like you; I will rebuke you and present the case before your eyes.
verses.textEn: When you did these things and I kept silent, you thought I was exactly like you. But I now arraign you and set my accusations before you.

verses.textZh: 忘记神的人哪！你们要思想这事， 免得我把你们撕碎，没有人能搭救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忘记神的人哪！你们要思想这事， 免得我把你们撕碎，没有人能搭救。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们忘记神的，要思想这事， 免得我把你们撕碎，无人搭救。
verses.textEnNiv: "Consider this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:
verses.textEnEsv: "Mark this, then, you who forget God, lest I tear you apart, and there be none to deliver!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now consider this, you who forget God, Lest I tear you in pieces, And therebe none to deliver:
verses.textEnNlt: Repent, all of you who forget me, or I will tear you apart, and no one will help you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now consider this, you who forget God, Or I will tear you in pieces, and there will be no one to save you.
verses.textEn: "Consider this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:

verses.textZh: 凡是以感谢为祭献上的，就是尊敬我； 那预备道路的，我必使他得见神的救恩。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是以感谢为祭献上的，就是尊敬我； 那预备道路的，我必使他得见神的救恩。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡以感谢献上为祭的便是荣耀我； 那按正路而行的，我必使他得着我的救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who sacrifice thank offerings honor me, and to the blameless I will show my salvation."
verses.textEnEsv: The one who offers thanksgiving as his sacrifice glorifies me; to one who orders his way rightly I will show the salvation of God!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever offers praise glorifies Me; And to him who orders his conduct aright I will show the salvation of God."
verses.textEnNlt: But giving thanks is a sacrifice that truly honors me. If you keep to my path, I will reveal to you the salvation of God."
verses.textEnNasb: "He who offers a sacrifice of thanksgiving honors Me; And to him who sets his way properly I will show the salvation of God."
verses.textEn: Those who sacrifice thank offerings honor me, and to the blameless I will show my salvation."

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，是大卫和拔示巴同房以后，及先知拿单来见他以后作的。神啊！求你按着你的慈爱恩待我， 照着你丰盛的怜悯涂抹我的过犯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，是大卫和拔示巴同房以后，及先知拿单来见他以后作的。神啊！求你按着你的慈爱恩待我， 照着你丰盛的怜悯涂抹我的过犯。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你按你的慈爱怜恤我！ 按你丰盛的慈悲涂抹我的过犯！
verses.textEnNiv: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions.
verses.textEnEsv: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your steadfast love; according to your abundant mercy blot out my transgressions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have mercy upon me, O God, According to Your lovingkindness; According to the multitude of Your tender mercies, Blot out my transgressions.
verses.textEnNlt: Have mercy on me, O God, because of your unfailing love. Because of your great compassion, blot out the stain of my sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Be gracious to me, God, according to Your faithfulness; According to the greatness of Your compassion, wipe out my wrongdoings.
verses.textEn: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions.

verses.textZh: 求你彻底洗净我的罪孽， 洁除我的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你彻底洗净我的罪孽， 洁除我的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你将我的罪孽洗除净尽， 并洁除我的罪！
verses.textEnNiv: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.textEnEsv: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin!
verses.textEnNkjv: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Wash me clean from my guilt. Purify me from my sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Wash me thoroughly from my guilt And cleanse me from my sin.
verses.textEn: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.textZh: 因为我知道我的过犯； 我的罪常在我面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我知道我的过犯； 我的罪常在我面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，我知道我的过犯； 我的罪常在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
verses.textEnEsv: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is ever before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I acknowledge my transgressions, And my sin is always before me.
verses.textEnNlt: For I recognize my rebellion; it haunts me day and night.
verses.textEnNasb: For I know my wrongdoings, And my sin is constantly before me.
verses.textEn: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

verses.textZh: 我得罪了你，唯独得罪你； 我行了你眼中看为恶的事， 因此，你宣判的时候，显为公义； 你审判的时候，显为清正。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我得罪了你，唯独得罪你； 我行了你眼中看为恶的事， 因此，你宣判的时候，显为公义； 你审判的时候，显为清正。
verses.textZhCuv: 我向你犯罪，惟独得罪了你； 在你眼前行了这恶， 以致你责备我的时候显为公义， 判断我的时候显为清正。
verses.textEnNiv: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight; so you are right in your verdict and justified when you judge.
verses.textEnEsv: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight, so that you may be justified in your words and blameless in your judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Against You, You only, have I sinned, And done this evil in Your sight— That You may be found just when You speak, And blameless when You judge.
verses.textEnNlt: Against you, and you alone, have I sinned; I have done what is evil in your sight. You will be proved right in what you say, and your judgment against me is just.
verses.textEnNasb: Against You, You only, I have sinned And done what is evil in Your sight, So that You are justified when You speak And blameless when You judge.
verses.textEn: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight; so you are right in your verdict and justified when you judge.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我是在罪孽里生的； 我母亲在罪中怀了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我是在罪孽里生的； 我母亲在罪中怀了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是在罪孽里生的， 在我母亲怀胎的时候就有了罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, And in sin my mother conceived me.
verses.textEnNlt: For I was born a sinner— yes, from the moment my mother conceived me.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I was brought forth in guilt, And in sin my mother conceived me.
verses.textEn: Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.

verses.textZh: 看哪！你喜爱的是内心的诚实； 在我内心的隐密处，你使我得智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！你喜爱的是内心的诚实； 在我内心的隐密处，你使我得智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所喜爱的是内里诚实； 你在我隐密处，必使我得智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you desired faithfulness even in the womb; you taught me wisdom in that secret place.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you delight in truth in the inward being, and you teach me wisdom in the secret heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts, And in the hidden part You will make me to know wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: But you desire honesty from the womb, teaching me wisdom even there.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, You desire truth in the innermost being, And in secret You will make wisdom known to me.
verses.textEn: Yet you desired faithfulness even in the womb; you taught me wisdom in that secret place.

verses.textZh: 求你用牛膝草洁净我，我就干净； 求你洗净我，我就比雪更白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你用牛膝草洁净我，我就干净； 求你洗净我，我就比雪更白。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你用牛膝草洁净我，我就干净； 求你洗涤我，我就比雪更白。
verses.textEnNiv: Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
verses.textEnEsv: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.textEnNkjv: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.textEnNlt: Purify me from my sins, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
verses.textEnNasb: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; Cleanse me, and I will be whiter than snow.
verses.textEn: Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

verses.textZh: 求你使我听见欢喜和快乐的声音， 使你所压伤的骨头可以欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使我听见欢喜和快乐的声音， 使你所压伤的骨头可以欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使我得听欢喜快乐的声音， 使你所压伤的骨头可以踊跃。
verses.textEnNiv: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.
verses.textEnEsv: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones that you have broken rejoice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make me hear joy and gladness, That the bones You have broken may rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, give me back my joy again; you have broken me— now let me rejoice.
verses.textEnNasb: Let me hear joy and gladness, Let the bones You have broken rejoice.
verses.textEn: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.

verses.textZh: 求你掩面不看我的罪恶， 求你涂抹我的一切罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你掩面不看我的罪恶， 求你涂抹我的一切罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你掩面不看我的罪， 涂抹我一切的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: Hide your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquity.
verses.textEnEsv: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hide Your face from my sins, And blot out all my iniquities.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t keep looking at my sins. Remove the stain of my guilt.
verses.textEnNasb: Hide Your face from my sins And wipe out all my guilty deeds.
verses.textEn: Hide your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquity.

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你为我造一颗清洁的心， 求你使我里面重新有坚定的灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你为我造一颗清洁的心， 求你使我里面重新有坚定的灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你为我造清洁的心， 使我里面重新有正直 的灵。
verses.textEnNiv: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
verses.textEnEsv: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Create in me a clean heart, O God, And renew a steadfast spirit within me.
verses.textEnNlt: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a loyal spirit within me.
verses.textEnNasb: Create in me a clean heart, God, And renew a steadfast spirit within me.
verses.textEn: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

verses.textZh: 不要把我从你面前丢弃， 不要从我身上收回你的圣灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要把我从你面前丢弃， 不要从我身上收回你的圣灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要丢弃我，使我离开你的面； 不要从我收回你的圣灵。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.textEnEsv: Cast me not away from your presence, and take not your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not cast me away from Your presence, And do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not banish me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not cast me away from Your presence, And do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.
verses.textEn: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.

verses.textZh: 求你使我重得你救恩的喜乐， 重新有乐意的灵支持我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使我重得你救恩的喜乐， 重新有乐意的灵支持我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使我仍得救恩之乐， 赐我乐意的灵扶持我，
verses.textEnNiv: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.
verses.textEnEsv: Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and uphold me with a willing spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, And uphold me byYour generous Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and make me willing to obey you.
verses.textEnNasb: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, And sustain me with a willing spirit.
verses.textEn: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.

verses.textZh: 我就必把你的道指教有过犯的人， 罪人必回转归向你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就必把你的道指教有过犯的人， 罪人必回转归向你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就把你的道指教有过犯的人， 罪人必归顺你。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, so that sinners will turn back to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will return to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, And sinners shall be converted to You.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will teach your ways to rebels, and they will return to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will teach wrongdoers Your ways, And sinners will be converted to You.
verses.textEn: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, so that sinners will turn back to you.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你是拯救我的神， 求你救我脱离流人血的罪； 我的舌头就必颂扬你的公义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你是拯救我的神， 求你救我脱离流人血的罪； 我的舌头就必颂扬你的公义。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你是拯救我的神； 求你救我脱离流人血的罪！ 我的舌头就高声歌唱你的公义。
verses.textEnNiv: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, you who are God my Savior, and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, O God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, The God of my salvation, And my tongue shall sing aloud of Your righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Forgive me for shedding blood, O God who saves; then I will joyfully sing of your forgiveness.
verses.textEnNasb: Save me from the guilt of bloodshed, God, the God of my salvation; Then my tongue will joyfully sing of Your righteousness.
verses.textEn: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, you who are God my Savior, and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.

verses.textZh: 主啊！求你开我的嘴， 使我的口宣扬赞美你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！求你开我的嘴， 使我的口宣扬赞美你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇张开， 我的口便传扬赞美你的话！
verses.textEnNiv: Open my lips, Lord, and my mouth will declare your praise.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, open my lips, And my mouth shall show forth Your praise.
verses.textEnNlt: Unseal my lips, O Lord, that my mouth may praise you.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, open my lips, So that my mouth may declare Your praise.
verses.textEn: Open my lips, Lord, and my mouth will declare your praise.

verses.textZh: 因为你不喜爱祭物； 我就是献上燔祭，你也不喜悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你不喜爱祭物； 我就是献上燔祭，你也不喜悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 你本不喜爱祭物，若喜爱，我就献上； 燔祭，你也不喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: For you will not delight in sacrifice, or I would give it; you will not be pleased with a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You do not desire sacrifice, or else I would give it; You do not delight in burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: You do not desire a sacrifice, or I would offer one. You do not want a burnt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: For You do not delight in sacrifice, otherwise I would give it; You do not take pleasure in burnt offering.
verses.textEn: You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.

verses.textZh: 神所要的祭，就是破碎的灵；神啊！破碎痛悔的心，你必不轻看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神所要的祭，就是破碎的灵；神啊！破碎痛悔的心，你必不轻看。
verses.textZhCuv: 神所要的祭就是忧伤的灵；神啊，忧伤痛悔的心，你必不轻看。
verses.textEnNiv: My sacrifice, O God, is a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart you, God, will not despise.
verses.textEnEsv: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit, A broken and a contrite heart— These, O God, You will not despise.
verses.textEnNlt: The sacrifice you desire is a broken spirit. You will not reject a broken and repentant heart, O God.
verses.textEnNasb: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; A broken and a contrite heart, God, You will not despise.
verses.textEn: My sacrifice, O God, is a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart you, God, will not despise.

verses.textZh: 求你按着你的美意善待锡安； 求你修筑耶路撒冷的城墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你按着你的美意善待锡安； 求你修筑耶路撒冷的城墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你随你的美意善待锡安， 建造耶路撒冷的城墙。
verses.textEnNiv: May it please you to prosper Zion, to build up the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Do good to Zion in your good pleasure; build up the walls of Jerusalem;
verses.textEnNkjv: Do good in Your good pleasure to Zion; Build the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Look with favor on Zion and help her; rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: By Your favor do good to Zion; Build the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: May it please you to prosper Zion, to build up the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 那时，你必悦纳公义的祭、燔祭和全牲的燔祭； 那时，人必把公牛献在你的祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你必悦纳公义的祭、燔祭和全牲的燔祭； 那时，人必把公牛献在你的祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，你必喜爱公义的祭 和燔祭并全牲的燔祭； 那时，人必将公牛献在你坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of the righteous, in burnt offerings offered whole; then bulls will be offered on your altar.
verses.textEnEsv: then will you delight in right sacrifices, in burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on your altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then You shall be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, With burnt offering and whole burnt offering; Then they shall offer bulls on Your altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will be pleased with sacrifices offered in the right spirit— with burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings. Then bulls will again be sacrificed on your altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, In burnt offering and whole burnt offering; Then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
verses.textEn: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of the righteous, in burnt offerings offered whole; then bulls will be offered on your altar.

verses.textZh: 大卫的训诲诗，交给诗班长，是在以东人多益来告诉扫罗："大卫到了亚希米勒家"以后作的。 勇士啊！你为甚么以作恶自夸呢？神的慈爱是常存的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的训诲诗，交给诗班长，是在以东人多益来告诉扫罗："大卫到了亚希米勒家"以后作的。 勇士啊！你为甚么以作恶自夸呢？神的慈爱是常存的。
verses.textZhCuv: 勇士啊，你为何以作恶自夸？神的慈爱是常存的。
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you boast of evil, you mighty hero? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The steadfast love of God endures all the day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you boast in evil, O mighty man? The goodness of God endures continually.
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you boast about your crimes, great warrior? Don’t you realize God’s justice continues forever?
verses.textEnNasb: Why do you boast in evil, you mighty man? The faithfulness of God endures all day long.
verses.textEn: Why do you boast of evil, you mighty hero? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?

verses.textZh: 你图谋毁灭， 你的舌头锋利像剃刀， 常弄诡诈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你图谋毁灭， 你的舌头锋利像剃刀， 常弄诡诈。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的舌头邪恶诡诈， 好像剃头刀，快利伤人。
verses.textEnNiv: You who practice deceit, your tongue plots destruction; it is like a sharpened razor.
verses.textEnEsv: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, you worker of deceit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your tongue devises destruction, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.textEnNlt: All day long you plot destruction. Your tongue cuts like a sharp razor; you’re an expert at telling lies.
verses.textEnNasb: Your tongue devises destruction, Like a sharp razor, you worker of deceit.
verses.textEn: You who practice deceit, your tongue plots destruction; it is like a sharpened razor.

verses.textZh: 你喜爱作恶过于行善， 喜爱撒谎过于说实话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你喜爱作恶过于行善， 喜爱撒谎过于说实话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你爱恶胜似爱善， 又爱说谎，不爱说公义。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: You love evil rather than good, falsehood rather than speaking the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: You love evil more than good, and lying more than speaking what is right. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: You love evil more than good, Lying rather than speaking righteousness. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: You love evil more than good and lies more than truth. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: You love evil more than good, Lies more than speaking what is right. Selah
verses.textEn: You love evil rather than good, falsehood rather than speaking the truth.

verses.textZh: 你喜爱你诡诈的舌头， 所说一切毁灭人的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你喜爱你诡诈的舌头， 所说一切毁灭人的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 诡诈的舌头啊， 你爱说一切毁灭的话！
verses.textEnNiv: You love every harmful word, you deceitful tongue!
verses.textEnEsv: You love all words that devour, O deceitful tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: You love all devouring words, You deceitful tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: You love to destroy others with your words, you liar!
verses.textEnNasb: You love all words that devour, You deceitful tongue.
verses.textEn: You love every harmful word, you deceitful tongue!

verses.textZh: 神必把你永远拆毁； 他必把你挪去，把你从帐棚中揪出来， 把你从活人之地连根拔起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神必把你永远拆毁； 他必把你挪去，把你从帐棚中揪出来， 把你从活人之地连根拔起。
verses.textZhCuv: 神也要毁灭你，直到永远； 他要把你拿去，从你的帐棚中抽出， 从活人之地将你拔出。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin: He will snatch you up and pluck you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living.
verses.textEnEsv: But God will break you down forever; he will snatch and tear you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: God shall likewise destroy you forever; He shall take you away, and pluck you out of your dwelling place, And uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: But God will strike you down once and for all. He will pull you from your home and uproot you from the land of the living. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: But God will break you down forever; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent, And uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
verses.textEn: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin: He will snatch you up and pluck you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living.

verses.textZh: 义人必看见而惧怕； 他们必讥笑他，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人必看见而惧怕； 他们必讥笑他，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 义人要看见而惧怕， 并要笑他，
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at you, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous shall see and fear, and shall laugh at him, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous also shall see and fear, And shall laugh at him, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The righteous will see it and be amazed. They will laugh and say,
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous will see and fear, And they will laugh at him, saying,
verses.textEn: The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at you, saying,

verses.textZh: "看哪！这就是那不以神为自己保障的人， 他只倚靠自己丰盛的财富， 以毁灭别人来加强自己的力量。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪！这就是那不以神为自己保障的人， 他只倚靠自己丰盛的财富， 以毁灭别人来加强自己的力量。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：看哪，这就是那不以神为他力量的人， 只倚仗他丰富的财物，在邪恶上坚立自己。
verses.textEnNiv: "Here now is the man who did not make God his stronghold but trusted in his great wealth and grew strong by destroying others!"
verses.textEnEsv: "See the man who would not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his riches and sought refuge in his own destruction!"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Here is the man who did not make God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look what happens to mighty warriors who do not trust in God. They trust their wealth instead and grow more and more bold in their wickedness."
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, the man who would not make God his refuge, But trusted in the abundance of his riches And was strong in his evil desire."
verses.textEn: "Here now is the man who did not make God his stronghold but trusted in his great wealth and grew strong by destroying others!"

verses.textZh: 至于我，我就像神殿中茂盛的橄榄树一样； 我倚靠神的慈爱，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我就像神殿中茂盛的橄榄树一样； 我倚靠神的慈爱，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，就像神殿中的青橄榄树； 我永永远远倚靠神的慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in God’s unfailing love for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God. I trust in the steadfast love of God forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: But I am like an olive tree, thriving in the house of God. I will always trust in God’s unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the faithfulness of God forever and ever.
verses.textEn: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in God’s unfailing love for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 我要永远称谢你，因为你行了这事； 我必在你圣民的面前，宣扬 你的名， 因你的名是美好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要永远称谢你，因为你行了这事； 我必在你圣民的面前，宣扬 你的名， 因你的名是美好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要称谢你，直到永远， 因为你行了这事。 我也要在你圣民面前仰望你的名； 这名本为美好。
verses.textEnNiv: For what you have done I will always praise you in the presence of your faithful people. And I will hope in your name, for your name is good.
verses.textEnEsv: I will thank you forever, because you have done it. I will wait for your name, for it is good, in the presence of the godly.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will praise You forever, Because You have done it; And in the presence of Your saints I will wait on Your name, for it is good.
verses.textEnNlt: I will praise you forever, O God, for what you have done. I will trust in your good name in the presence of your faithful people.
verses.textEnNasb: I will praise You forever, because You have done it, And I will wait on Your name, for it is good, in the presence of Your godly ones.
verses.textEn: For what you have done I will always praise you in the presence of your faithful people. And I will hope in your name, for your name is good.

verses.textZh: 大卫的训诲诗，交给诗班长，调用"麻拉"。 愚顽人心里说："没有神。" 他们都是败坏，行了可憎的不义； 没有一个行善的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的训诲诗，交给诗班长，调用"麻拉"。 愚顽人心里说："没有神。" 他们都是败坏，行了可憎的不义； 没有一个行善的。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚顽人心里说：没有神。 他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的罪孽； 没有一个人行善。
verses.textEnNiv: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and their ways are vile; there is no one who does good.
verses.textEnEsv: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, doing abominable iniquity; there is none who does good.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fool has said in his heart, "Thereis no God." They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity; Thereis none who does good.
verses.textEnNlt: Only fools say in their hearts, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and their actions are evil; not one of them does good!
verses.textEnNasb: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and have committed abominable injustice; There is no one who does good.
verses.textEn: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and their ways are vile; there is no one who does good.

verses.textZh: 神从天上察看世人， 要看看有明慧的没有， 有寻求神的没有，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神从天上察看世人， 要看看有明慧的没有， 有寻求神的没有，
verses.textZhCuv: 神从天上垂看世人，要看有明白的没有？ 有寻求他的没有？
verses.textEnNiv: God looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.
verses.textEnEsv: God looks down from heaven on the children of man to see if there are any who understand, who seek after God.
verses.textEnNkjv: God looks down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there are any who understand, who seek God.
verses.textEnNlt: God looks down from heaven on the entire human race; he looks to see if anyone is truly wise, if anyone seeks God.
verses.textEnNasb: God has looked down from heaven upon the sons of mankind To see if there is anyone who understands, Who seeks after God.
verses.textEn: God looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

verses.textZh: 他们各人都偏离了正道，一同变成污秽； 没有行善的，连一个也没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人都偏离了正道，一同变成污秽； 没有行善的，连一个也没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们各人都退后，一同变为污秽； 并没有行善的，连一个也没有。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone has turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
verses.textEnEsv: They have all fallen away; together they have become corrupt; there is none who does good, not even one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every one of them has turned aside; They have together become corrupt; Thereis none who does good, No, not one.
verses.textEnNlt: But no, all have turned away; all have become corrupt. No one does good, not a single one!
verses.textEnNasb: Every one of them has turned aside; together they have become corrupt; There is no one who does good, not even one.
verses.textEn: Everyone has turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

verses.textZh: 作恶的都是无知的吗？ 他们吞吃我的子民好象吃饭一样， 并不求告神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作恶的都是无知的吗？ 他们吞吃我的子民好象吃饭一样， 并不求告神。
verses.textZhCuv: 作孽的没有知识吗？ 他们吞吃我的百姓如同吃饭一样，并不求告神。
verses.textEnNiv: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on God.
verses.textEnEsv: Have those who work evil no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and do not call upon God?
verses.textEnNkjv: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And do not call upon God?
verses.textEnNlt: Will those who do evil never learn? They eat up my people like bread and wouldn’t think of praying to God.
verses.textEnNasb: Have the workers of injustice no knowledge, Who eat up My people like they ate bread, And have not called upon God?
verses.textEn: Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on God.

verses.textZh: 他们在无可惊惧的时候，必大大震惊； 因为神把那些扎营攻击你的人的骨头击散了； 他们蒙羞受辱，因为神弃绝了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在无可惊惧的时候，必大大震惊； 因为神把那些扎营攻击你的人的骨头击散了； 他们蒙羞受辱，因为神弃绝了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在无可惧怕之处就大大害怕， 因为神把那安营攻击你之人的骨头散开了。 你使他们蒙羞，因为神弃绝了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to dread. God scattered the bones of those who attacked you; you put them to shame, for God despised them.
verses.textEnEsv: There they are, in great terror, where there is no terror! For God scatters the bones of him who encamps against you; you put them to shame, for God has rejected them.
verses.textEnNkjv: There they are in great fear Where no fear was, For God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you; You have put them to shame, Because God has despised them.
verses.textEnNlt: Terror will grip them, terror like they have never known before. God will scatter the bones of your enemies. You will put them to shame, for God has rejected them.
verses.textEnNasb: They were in great fear there, where no fear had been; For God scattered the bones of him who encamped against you; You put them to shame, because God had rejected them.
verses.textEn: But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to dread. God scattered the bones of those who attacked you; you put them to shame, for God despised them.

verses.textZh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出；神给他子民带来复兴的时候 ， 雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出；神给他子民带来复兴的时候 ， 雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。神救回他被掳的子民那时， 雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back the captivity of His people, Let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad.
verses.textEnNlt: Who will come from Mount Zion to rescue Israel? When God restores his people, Jacob will shout with joy, and Israel will rejoice.
verses.textEnNasb: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores the fortunes of His people, Jacob shall rejoice, Israel shall be glad.
verses.textEn: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

verses.textZh: 大卫的训诲诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏，是在西弗人去对扫罗说："大卫不是在我们中间躲藏吗？"以后作的。神啊！求你因你的名拯救我， 求你以你的大能为我伸冤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的训诲诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏，是在西弗人去对扫罗说："大卫不是在我们中间躲藏吗？"以后作的。神啊！求你因你的名拯救我， 求你以你的大能为我伸冤。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你以你的名救我， 凭你的大能为我伸冤。
verses.textEnNiv: Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, save me by your name, and vindicate me by your might.
verses.textEnNkjv: Save me, O God, by Your name, And vindicate me by Your strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Come with great power, O God, and rescue me! Defend me with your might.
verses.textEnNasb: Save me, God, by Your name, And vindicate me by Your power.
verses.textEn: Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你垂听我的祷告， 留心听我口中的言语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你垂听我的祷告， 留心听我口中的言语。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你听我的祷告， 留心听我口中的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to my prayer, O God. Pay attention to my plea.
verses.textEnNasb: Hear my prayer, God; Listen to the words of my mouth.
verses.textEn: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.

verses.textZh: 因为傲慢的人 起来攻击我， 强横的人寻索我的性命； 他们不把神放在眼里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为傲慢的人 起来攻击我， 强横的人寻索我的性命； 他们不把神放在眼里。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，外人起来攻击我， 强暴人寻索我的命； 他们眼中没有神。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Arrogant foes are attacking me; ruthless people are trying to kill me— people without regard for God.
verses.textEnEsv: For strangers have risen against me; ruthless men seek my life; they do not set God before themselves. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: For strangers have risen up against me, And oppressors have sought after my life; They have not set God before them. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: For strangers are attacking me; violent people are trying to kill me. They care nothing for God. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: For strangers have risen against me And violent men have sought my life; They have not set God before them. Selah
verses.textEn: Arrogant foes are attacking me; ruthless people are trying to kill me— people without regard for God.

verses.textZh: 看哪！神是我的帮助； 主是扶持我性命的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！神是我的帮助； 主是扶持我性命的。
verses.textZhCuv: 神是帮助我的，是扶持我命的。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, God is my helper; the Lord is the upholder of my life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, God is my helper; The Lord is with those who uphold my life.
verses.textEnNlt: But God is my helper. The Lord keeps me alive!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, God is my helper; The Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
verses.textEn: Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.

verses.textZh: 愿灾祸报应在我仇敌的身上； 愿你因你的信实消灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿灾祸报应在我仇敌的身上； 愿你因你的信实消灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要报应我仇敌所行的恶； 求你凭你的诚实灭绝他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in your faithfulness destroy them.
verses.textEnEsv: He will return the evil to my enemies; in your faithfulness put an end to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will repay my enemies for their evil. Cut them off in Your truth.
verses.textEnNlt: May the evil plans of my enemies be turned against them. Do as you promised and put an end to them.
verses.textEnNasb: He will pay back the evil to my enemies; Destroy them in Your faithfulness.
verses.textEn: Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in your faithfulness destroy them.

verses.textZh: 我要甘心情愿献祭给你； 耶和华啊！我必称赞你的名， 因你的名是美好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要甘心情愿献祭给你； 耶和华啊！我必称赞你的名， 因你的名是美好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要把甘心祭献给你。 耶和华啊，我要称赞你的名；这名本为美好。
verses.textEnNiv: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you; I will praise your name, Lord , for it is good.
verses.textEnEsv: With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to you; I will give thanks to your name, O Lord , for it is good.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will freely sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O Lord, for itis good.
verses.textEnNlt: I will sacrifice a voluntary offering to you; I will praise your name, O Lord , for it is good.
verses.textEnNasb: Willingly I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, Lord, for it is good.
verses.textEn: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you; I will praise your name, Lord , for it is good.

verses.textZh: 他救我脱离了一切患难； 我亲眼看见了我的仇敌灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救我脱离了一切患难； 我亲眼看见了我的仇敌灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从一切的急难中把我救出来； 我的眼睛也看见了我仇敌遭报。
verses.textEnNiv: You have delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
verses.textEnEsv: For he has delivered me from every trouble, and my eye has looked in triumph on my enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He has delivered me out of all trouble; And my eye has seen itsdesire upon my enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: For you have rescued me from my troubles and helped me to triumph over my enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: For He has saved me from all trouble, And my eye has looked with satisfaction upon my enemies.
verses.textEn: You have delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.

verses.textZh: 大卫的训诲诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。神啊！求你倾听我的祷告， 不要隐藏起来不听我的恳求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的训诲诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。神啊！求你倾听我的祷告， 不要隐藏起来不听我的恳求。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你留心听我的祷告， 不要隐藏不听我的恳求！
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;
verses.textEnEsv: Give ear to my prayer, O God, and hide not yourself from my plea for mercy!
verses.textEnNkjv: Give ear to my prayer, O God, And do not hide Yourself from my supplication.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to my prayer, O God. Do not ignore my cry for help!
verses.textEnNasb: Listen to my prayer, God; And do not hide Yourself from my pleading.
verses.textEn: Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;
