verses.textZh: 求你留心听我，应允我； 我在苦恼中必不安宁，唉哼难过；
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你留心听我，应允我； 我在苦恼中必不安宁，唉哼难过；
verses.textZhCuv: 求你侧耳听我，应允我。 我哀叹不安，发声唉哼，
verses.textEnNiv: hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught
verses.textEnEsv: Attend to me, and answer me; I am restless in my complaint and I moan,
verses.textEnNkjv: Attend to me, and hear me; I am restless in my complaint, and moan noisily,
verses.textEnNlt: Please listen and answer me, for I am overwhelmed by my troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: Give Your attention to me and answer me; I am restless in my complaint and severely distracted,
verses.textEn: hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught

verses.textZh: 这都是由于仇敌的声音， 和恶人的欺压； 因为他们使祸患临到我的身上， 怒气冲冲地迫害我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这都是由于仇敌的声音， 和恶人的欺压； 因为他们使祸患临到我的身上， 怒气冲冲地迫害我。
verses.textZhCuv: 都因仇敌的声音，恶人的欺压； 因为他们将罪孽加在我身上，发怒气逼迫我。
verses.textEnNiv: because of what my enemy is saying, because of the threats of the wicked; for they bring down suffering on me and assail me in their anger.
verses.textEnEsv: because of the noise of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they drop trouble upon me, and in anger they bear a grudge against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked; For they bring down trouble upon me, And in wrath they hate me.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies shout at me, making loud and wicked threats. They bring trouble on me and angrily hunt me down.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the pressure of the wicked; For they bring down trouble upon me And in anger they hold a grudge against me.
verses.textEn: because of what my enemy is saying, because of the threats of the wicked; for they bring down suffering on me and assail me in their anger.

verses.textZh: 我的心在我里面绞痛， 死亡的恐怖落在我身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心在我里面绞痛， 死亡的恐怖落在我身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心在我里面甚是疼痛； 死的惊惶临到我身。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death have fallen on me.
verses.textEnEsv: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My heart is severely pained within me, And the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart pounds in my chest. The terror of death assaults me.
verses.textEnNasb: My heart is in anguish within me, And the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
verses.textEn: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death have fallen on me.

verses.textZh: 惧怕和战兢临到我， 惊恐笼罩着我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 惧怕和战兢临到我， 惊恐笼罩着我。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐惧战兢归到我身； 惊恐漫过了我。
verses.textEnNiv: Fear and trembling have beset me; horror has overwhelmed me.
verses.textEnEsv: Fear and trembling come upon me, and horror overwhelms me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fearfulness and trembling have come upon me, And horror has overwhelmed me.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear and trembling overwhelm me, and I can’t stop shaking.
verses.textEnNasb: Fear and trembling come upon me, And horror has overwhelmed me.
verses.textEn: Fear and trembling have beset me; horror has overwhelmed me.

verses.textZh: 我说："但愿我有鸽子一般的翅膀， 我就飞走，得以安居。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说："但愿我有鸽子一般的翅膀， 我就飞走，得以安居。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：但愿我有翅膀像鸽子， 我就飞去，得享安息。
verses.textEnNiv: I said, "Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.
verses.textEnEsv: And I say, "Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest;
verses.textEnNkjv: So I said, "Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that I had wings like a dove; then I would fly away and rest!
verses.textEnNasb: I said, "Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.
verses.textEn: I said, "Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我必逃往远处， 在旷野里住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我必逃往远处， 在旷野里住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必远游， 宿在旷野。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: I would flee far away and stay in the desert;
verses.textEnEsv: yes, I would wander far away; I would lodge in the wilderness; Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, I would wander far off, And remain in the wilderness. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: I would fly far away to the quiet of the wilderness. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I would flee far away, I would spend my nights in the wilderness. Selah
verses.textEn: I would flee far away and stay in the desert;

verses.textZh: 我要赶快到我避难的地方去， 逃避狂风暴雨。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要赶快到我避难的地方去， 逃避狂风暴雨。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必速速逃到避所， 脱离狂风暴雨。
verses.textEnNiv: I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm."
verses.textEnEsv: I would hurry to find a shelter from the raging wind and tempest."
verses.textEnNkjv: I would hasten my escape From the windy storm and tempest."
verses.textEnNlt: How quickly I would escape— far from this wild storm of hatred.
verses.textEnNasb: "I would hurry to my place of refuge From the stormy wind and heavy gale."
verses.textEn: I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm."

verses.textZh: 主啊！扰乱恶人的计谋， 使他们的意见 分歧， 因为我在城中看见了强暴和争竞的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！扰乱恶人的计谋， 使他们的意见 分歧， 因为我在城中看见了强暴和争竞的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，求你吞灭他们，变乱他们的舌头！ 因为我在城中见了强暴争竞的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord, confuse the wicked, confound their words, for I see violence and strife in the city.
verses.textEnEsv: Destroy, O Lord, divide their tongues; for I see violence and strife in the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues, For I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Confuse them, Lord, and frustrate their plans, for I see violence and conflict in the city.
verses.textEnNasb: Confuse them, Lord, divide their tongues, For I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.textEn: Lord, confuse the wicked, confound their words, for I see violence and strife in the city.

verses.textZh: 恶人日夜在城墙上绕行， 在城里尽是邪恶与祸害；
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人日夜在城墙上绕行， 在城里尽是邪恶与祸害；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在城墙上昼夜绕行； 在城内也有罪孽和奸恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.
verses.textEnEsv: Day and night they go around it on its walls, and iniquity and trouble are within it;
verses.textEnNkjv: Day and night they go around it on its walls; Iniquity and trouble are also in the midst of it.
verses.textEnNlt: Its walls are patrolled day and night against invaders, but the real danger is wickedness within the city.
verses.textEnNasb: Day and night they go around her upon her walls, And evil and harm are in her midst.
verses.textEn: Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.

verses.textZh: 城中也有毁灭人的事， 欺压和诡诈不离城里的街道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城中也有毁灭人的事， 欺压和诡诈不离城里的街道。
verses.textZhCuv: 邪恶在其中； 欺压和诡诈不离街市。
verses.textEnNiv: Destructive forces are at work in the city; threats and lies never leave its streets.
verses.textEnEsv: ruin is in its midst; oppression and fraud do not depart from its marketplace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Destruction is in its midst; Oppression and deceit do not depart from its streets.
verses.textEnNlt: Everything is falling apart; threats and cheating are rampant in the streets.
verses.textEnNasb: Destruction is in her midst; Oppression and deceit do not depart from her streets.
verses.textEn: Destructive forces are at work in the city; threats and lies never leave its streets.

verses.textZh: 原来不是仇敌辱骂我， 如果是仇敌，我还可以忍受； 也不是恨我的人向我狂妄自大， 如果是恨我的人，我还可以躲避他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来不是仇敌辱骂我， 如果是仇敌，我还可以忍受； 也不是恨我的人向我狂妄自大， 如果是恨我的人，我还可以躲避他。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来不是仇敌辱骂我， 若是仇敌，还可忍耐； 也不是恨我的人向我狂大， 若是恨我的人就必躲避他。
verses.textEnNiv: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were rising against me, I could hide.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is not an enemy who taunts me— then I could bear it; it is not an adversary who deals insolently with me— then I could hide from him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For itis not an enemy who reproaches me; Then I could bear it. Nor isit one who hates me who has exalted himself against me; Then I could hide from him.
verses.textEnNlt: It is not an enemy who taunts me— I could bear that. It is not my foes who so arrogantly insult me— I could have hidden from them.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is not an enemy who taunts me, Then I could endure it; Nor is it one who hates me who has exalted himself against me, Then I could hide myself from him.
verses.textEn: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were rising against me, I could hide.

verses.textZh: 但你是和我同等地位的人， 是我的良友，我的知己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你是和我同等地位的人， 是我的良友，我的知己。
verses.textZhCuv: 不料是你；你原与我平等， 是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！
verses.textEnNiv: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend,
verses.textEnEsv: But it is you, a man, my equal, my companion, my familiar friend.
verses.textEnNkjv: But itwas you, a man my equal, My companion and my acquaintance.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, it is you—my equal, my companion and close friend.
verses.textEnNasb: But it is you, a man my equal, My companion and my confidant;
verses.textEn: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend,

verses.textZh: 我们常在一起密谈， 我们在神的殿中与群众同行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们常在一起密谈， 我们在神的殿中与群众同行。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们素常彼此谈论，以为甘甜； 我们与群众在神的殿中同行。
verses.textEnNiv: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship at the house of God, as we walked about among the worshipers.
verses.textEnEsv: We used to take sweet counsel together; within God’s house we walked in the throng.
verses.textEnNkjv: We took sweet counsel together, And walked to the house of God in the throng.
verses.textEnNlt: What good fellowship we once enjoyed as we walked together to the house of God.
verses.textEnNasb: We who had sweet fellowship together, Walked in the house of God among the commotion.
verses.textEn: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship at the house of God, as we walked about among the worshipers.

verses.textZh: 愿死亡忽然临到他们身上， 愿他们活活下到阴间去， 因为在他们中间，就是在他们的住所里，尽是邪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿死亡忽然临到他们身上， 愿他们活活下到阴间去， 因为在他们中间，就是在他们的住所里，尽是邪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿死亡忽然临到他们！ 愿他们活活地下入阴间！ 因为他们的住处，他们的心中，都是邪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Let death take my enemies by surprise; let them go down alive to the realm of the dead, for evil finds lodging among them.
verses.textEnEsv: Let death steal over them; let them go down to Sheol alive; for evil is in their dwelling place and in their heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let death seize them; Let them go down alive into hell, For wickedness is in their dwellings and among them.
verses.textEnNlt: Let death stalk my enemies; let the grave swallow them alive, for evil makes its home within them.
verses.textEnNasb: May death come deceitfully upon them; May they go down alive to Sheol, For evil is in their dwelling, in their midst.
verses.textEn: Let death take my enemies by surprise; let them go down alive to the realm of the dead, for evil finds lodging among them.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我却要求告神， 耶和华就必拯救我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我却要求告神， 耶和华就必拯救我。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我要求告神； 耶和华必拯救我。
verses.textEnNiv: As for me, I call to God, and the Lord saves me.
verses.textEnEsv: But I call to God, and the Lord will save me.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for me, I will call upon God, And the Lord shall save me.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will call on God, and the Lord will rescue me.
verses.textEnNasb: As for me, I shall call upon God, And the Lord will save me.
verses.textEn: As for me, I call to God, and the Lord saves me.

verses.textZh: 无论在晚上、早晨或中午， 我都哀诉唉哼； 他必听我的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论在晚上、早晨或中午， 我都哀诉唉哼； 他必听我的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀声悲叹； 他也必听我的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.
verses.textEnEsv: Evening and morning and at noon I utter my complaint and moan, and he hears my voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Evening and morning and at noon I will pray, and cry aloud, And He shall hear my voice.
verses.textEnNlt: Morning, noon, and night I cry out in my distress, and the Lord hears my voice.
verses.textEnNasb: Evening and morning and at noon, I will complain and moan, And He will hear my voice.
verses.textEn: Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.

verses.textZh: 他救赎我的性命脱离攻击我的人， 使我得着平安， 尽管攻击我的人的确很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救赎我的性命脱离攻击我的人， 使我得着平安， 尽管攻击我的人的确很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 他救赎我命脱离攻击我的人， 使我得享平安， 因为与我相争的人甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: He rescues me unharmed from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
verses.textEnEsv: He redeems my soul in safety from the battle that I wage, for many are arrayed against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle thatwas against me, For there were many against me.
verses.textEnNlt: He ransoms me and keeps me safe from the battle waged against me, though many still oppose me.
verses.textEnNasb: He will redeem my soul in peace from the battle which is against me, For they are many who are aggressive toward me.
verses.textEn: He rescues me unharmed from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.

verses.textZh: 神必听见， 那从亘古坐着为王的必使他们受苦， 因他们不肯改变， 也不敬畏神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神必听见， 那从亘古坐着为王的必使他们受苦， 因他们不肯改变， 也不敬畏神。
verses.textZhCuv: 那没有更变、不敬畏神的人， 从太古常存的神必听见而苦待他。
verses.textEnNiv: God, who is enthroned from of old, who does not change— he will hear them and humble them, because they have no fear of God.
verses.textEnEsv: God will give ear and humble them, he who is enthroned from of old, Selah because they do not change and do not fear God.
verses.textEnNkjv: God will hear, and afflict them, Even He who abides from of old. Selah Because they do not change, Therefore they do not fear God.
verses.textEnNlt: God, who has ruled forever, will hear me and humble them. Interlude For my enemies refuse to change their ways; they do not fear God.
verses.textEnNasb: God will hear and humiliate them— Even the One who sits enthroned from ancient times— Selah With whom there is no change, And who do not fear God.
verses.textEn: God, who is enthroned from of old, who does not change— he will hear them and humble them, because they have no fear of God.

verses.textZh: 他违背了自己的约， 伸手攻击那些与他和好的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他违背了自己的约， 伸手攻击那些与他和好的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他背了约， 伸手攻击与他和好的人。
verses.textEnNiv: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: My companion stretched out his hand against his friends; he violated his covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has put forth his hands against those who were at peace with him; He has broken his covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: As for my companion, he betrayed his friends; he broke his promises.
verses.textEnNasb: He has put forth his hands against those who were at peace with him; He has violated his covenant.
verses.textEn: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.

verses.textZh: 他的口比奶油光滑， 他的心却怀着争战的意图； 他的话比油还柔和， 其实却是拔了出来的刀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的口比奶油光滑， 他的心却怀着争战的意图； 他的话比油还柔和， 其实却是拔了出来的刀。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的口如奶油光滑， 他的心却怀着争战； 他的话比油柔和， 其实是拔出来的刀。
verses.textEnNiv: His talk is smooth as butter, yet war is in his heart; his words are more soothing than oil, yet they are drawn swords.
verses.textEnEsv: His speech was smooth as butter, yet war was in his heart; his words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thewords of his mouth were smoother than butter, But war was in his heart; His words were softer than oil, Yet they were drawn swords.
verses.textEnNlt: His words are as smooth as butter, but in his heart is war. His words are as soothing as lotion, but underneath are daggers!
verses.textEnNasb: His speech was smoother than butter, But his heart was war; His words were softer than oil, Yet they were drawn swords.
verses.textEn: His talk is smooth as butter, yet war is in his heart; his words are more soothing than oil, yet they are drawn swords.

verses.textZh: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华， 他必扶持你； 他永远不会让义人动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华， 他必扶持你； 他永远不会让义人动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华， 他必抚养你； 他永不叫义人动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.
verses.textEnEsv: Cast your burden on the Lord , and he will sustain you; he will never permit the righteous to be moved.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cast your burden on the Lord, And He shall sustain you; He shall never permit the righteous to be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: Give your burdens to the Lord , and he will take care of you. He will not permit the godly to slip and fall.
verses.textEnNasb: Cast your burden upon the Lord and He will sustain you; He will never allow the righteous to be shaken.
verses.textEn: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你必使恶人堕入灭亡的深坑里； 流人血和行诡诈的人必活不到半世； 至于我，我必倚靠你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你必使恶人堕入灭亡的深坑里； 流人血和行诡诈的人必活不到半世； 至于我，我必倚靠你。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你必使恶人下入灭亡的坑； 流人血、行诡诈的人必活不到半世， 但我要倚靠你。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of decay; the bloodthirsty and deceitful will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O God, will cast them down into the pit of destruction; men of blood and treachery shall not live out half their days. But I will trust in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, O God, shall bring them down to the pit of destruction; Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; But I will trust in You.
verses.textEnNlt: But you, O God, will send the wicked down to the pit of destruction. Murderers and liars will die young, but I am trusting you to save me.
verses.textEnNasb: But You, God, will bring them down to the pit of destruction; Men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
verses.textEn: But you, God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of decay; the bloodthirsty and deceitful will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.

verses.textZh: 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"远方无声鸽"，是大卫在迦特被非利士人捉住时作的。神啊！求你恩待我，因为人要践踏我； 他们终日攻击我，迫害我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"远方无声鸽"，是大卫在迦特被非利士人捉住时作的。神啊！求你恩待我，因为人要践踏我； 他们终日攻击我，迫害我。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你怜悯我，因为人要把我吞了， 终日攻击欺压我。
verses.textEnNiv: Be merciful to me, my God, for my enemies are in hot pursuit; all day long they press their attack.
verses.textEnEsv: Be gracious to me, O God, for man tramples on me; all day long an attacker oppresses me;
verses.textEnNkjv: Be merciful to me, O God, for man would swallow me up; Fighting all day he oppresses me.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, have mercy on me, for people are hounding me. My foes attack me all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: Be gracious to me, God, for a man has trampled upon me; Fighting all day long he oppresses me.
verses.textEn: Be merciful to me, my God, for my enemies are in hot pursuit; all day long they press their attack.

verses.textZh: 我的仇敌终日践踏我， 攻击我的人很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的仇敌终日践踏我， 攻击我的人很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仇敌终日要把我吞了， 因逞骄傲攻击我的人甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: My adversaries pursue me all day long; in their pride many are attacking me.
verses.textEnEsv: my enemies trample on me all day long, for many attack me proudly.
verses.textEnNkjv: My enemies would hound me all day, For thereare many who fight against me, O Most High.
verses.textEnNlt: I am constantly hounded by those who slander me, and many are boldly attacking me.
verses.textEnNasb: My enemies have trampled upon me all day long, For they are many who fight proudly against me.
verses.textEn: My adversaries pursue me all day long; in their pride many are attacking me.

verses.textZh: 至高者 啊！我惧怕的时候， 就要倚靠你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至高者 啊！我惧怕的时候， 就要倚靠你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我惧怕的时候要倚靠你。
verses.textEnNiv: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.
verses.textEnEsv: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whenever I am afraid, I will trust in You.
verses.textEnNlt: But when I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
verses.textEnNasb: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in You.
verses.textEn: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

verses.textZh: 靠着神，我要赞美他的话； 我倚靠神，就必不惧怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 靠着神，我要赞美他的话； 我倚靠神，就必不惧怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我倚靠神，我要赞美他的话； 我倚靠神，必不惧怕。 血气之辈能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textEnNiv: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust and am not afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
verses.textEnEsv: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I shall not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
verses.textEnNkjv: In God (I will praise His word), In God I have put my trust; I will not fear. What can flesh do to me?
verses.textEnNlt: I praise God for what he has promised. I trust in God, so why should I be afraid? What can mere mortals do to me?
verses.textEnNasb: In God, whose word I praise, In God I have put my trust; I shall not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
verses.textEn: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust and am not afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?

verses.textZh: 他们终日歪曲我的话， 常常设计谋陷害我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们终日歪曲我的话， 常常设计谋陷害我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们终日颠倒我的话； 他们一切的心思都是要害我。
verses.textEnNiv: All day long they twist my words; all their schemes are for my ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: All day long they injure my cause; all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: All day they twist my words; All their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.textEnNlt: They are always twisting what I say; they spend their days plotting to harm me.
verses.textEnNasb: All day long they distort my words; All their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.textEn: All day long they twist my words; all their schemes are for my ruin.

verses.textZh: 他们聚集在一起，埋伏着， 窥探我的脚踪， 等候要害我的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们聚集在一起，埋伏着， 窥探我的脚踪， 等候要害我的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们聚集，埋伏窥探我的脚踪， 等候要害我的命。
verses.textEnNiv: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps, hoping to take my life.
verses.textEnEsv: They stir up strife, they lurk; they watch my steps, as they have waited for my life.
verses.textEnNkjv: They gather together, They hide, they mark my steps, When they lie in wait for my life.
verses.textEnNlt: They come together to spy on me— watching my every step, eager to kill me.
verses.textEnNasb: They attack, they lurk, They watch my steps, As they have waited to take my life.
verses.textEn: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps, hoping to take my life.

verses.textZh: 愿他们因罪孽的缘故不能逃脱；神啊！愿你在怒中使这些人败落。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们因罪孽的缘故不能逃脱；神啊！愿你在怒中使这些人败落。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们岂能因罪孽逃脱吗？神啊，求你在怒中使众民堕落！
verses.textEnNiv: Because of their wickedness do not let them escape; in your anger, God, bring the nations down.
verses.textEnEsv: For their crime will they escape? In wrath cast down the peoples, O God!
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God!
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let them get away with their wickedness; in your anger, O God, bring them down.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of their wickedness, will there be an escape for them? In anger make the peoples fall down, God!
verses.textEn: Because of their wickedness do not let them escape; in your anger, God, bring the nations down.

verses.textZh: 我多次流离，你都数算； 你把我的眼泪装在你的皮袋里。 这不都记在你的册子上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我多次流离，你都数算； 你把我的眼泪装在你的皮袋里。 这不都记在你的册子上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我几次流离，你都记数； 求你把我眼泪装在你的皮袋里。 这不都记在你册子上吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Record my misery; list my tears on your scroll — are they not in your record?
verses.textEnEsv: You have kept count of my tossings; put my tears in your bottle. Are they not in your book?
verses.textEnNkjv: You number my wanderings; Put my tears into Your bottle; Arethey not in Your book?
verses.textEnNlt: You keep track of all my sorrows. You have collected all my tears in your bottle. You have recorded each one in your book.
verses.textEnNasb: You have taken account of my miseries; Put my tears in Your bottle. Are they not in Your book?
verses.textEn: Record my misery; list my tears on your scroll — are they not in your record?

verses.textZh: 我呼求你的时候， 我的仇敌就都转身退后； 因此我知道神是帮助我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我呼求你的时候， 我的仇敌就都转身退后； 因此我知道神是帮助我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我呼求的日子，我的仇敌都要转身退后。神帮助我，这是我所知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then my enemies will turn back when I call for help. By this I will know that God is for me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then my enemies will turn back in the day when I call. This I know, that God is for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I cry out toYou, Then my enemies will turn back; This I know, because God is for me.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies will retreat when I call to you for help. This I know: God is on my side!
verses.textEnNasb: Then my enemies will turn back on the day when I call; This I know, that God is for me.
verses.textEn: Then my enemies will turn back when I call for help. By this I will know that God is for me.

verses.textZh: 靠着神，我要赞美他的话； 靠着耶和华，我要赞美他的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 靠着神，我要赞美他的话； 靠着耶和华，我要赞美他的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我倚靠神，我要赞美他的话； 我倚靠耶和华，我要赞美他的话。
verses.textEnNiv: In God, whose word I praise, in the Lord , whose word I praise—
verses.textEnEsv: In God, whose word I praise, in the Lord , whose word I praise,
verses.textEnNkjv: In God (I will praise His word), In the Lord (I will praise His word),
verses.textEnNlt: I praise God for what he has promised; yes, I praise the Lord for what he has promised.
verses.textEnNasb: In God, whose word I praise, In the Lord, whose word I praise,
verses.textEn: In God, whose word I praise, in the Lord , whose word I praise—

verses.textZh: 我倚靠神，就必不惧怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我倚靠神，就必不惧怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我倚靠神，必不惧怕。 人能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textEnNiv: in God I trust and am not afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.textEnEsv: in God I trust; I shall not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.textEnNkjv: In God I have put my trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.textEnNlt: I trust in God, so why should I be afraid? What can mere mortals do to me?
verses.textEnNasb: In God I have put my trust, I shall not be afraid. What can mankind do to me?
verses.textEn: in God I trust and am not afraid. What can man do to me?

verses.textZh: 神啊！我要偿还我向你所许的愿， 我要把感谢祭献给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！我要偿还我向你所许的愿， 我要把感谢祭献给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我向你所许的愿在我身上； 我要将感谢祭献给你。
verses.textEnNiv: I am under vows to you, my God; I will present my thank offerings to you.
verses.textEnEsv: I must perform my vows to you, O God; I will render thank offerings to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Vows made to You arebinding upon me, O God; I will render praises to You,
verses.textEnNlt: I will fulfill my vows to you, O God, and will offer a sacrifice of thanks for your help.
verses.textEnNasb: Your vows are binding upon me, God; I will render thanksgiving offerings to You.
verses.textEn: I am under vows to you, my God; I will present my thank offerings to you.

verses.textZh: 因为你救了我的性命脱离死亡； 你不是救了我的脚不跌倒， 使我在生命的光中，行在神你的面前吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你救了我的性命脱离死亡； 你不是救了我的脚不跌倒， 使我在生命的光中，行在神你的面前吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你救我的命脱离死亡。 你岂不是救护我的脚不跌倒、 使我在生命光中行在神面前吗？
verses.textEnNiv: For you have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have delivered my soul from death, yes, my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have delivered my soul from death. HaveYou not kept my feet from falling, That I may walk before God In the light of the living?
verses.textEnNlt: For you have rescued me from death; you have kept my feet from slipping. So now I can walk in your presence, O God, in your life-giving light.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have saved my soul from death, Indeed my feet from stumbling, So that I may walk before God In the light of the living.
verses.textEn: For you have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.

verses.textZh: 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"休要毁坏"，是大卫躲在山洞里逃避扫罗时作的。神啊，求你恩待我！求你恩待我！ 因为我投靠你； 我要投靠在你翅膀的荫下， 直到灾害过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"休要毁坏"，是大卫躲在山洞里逃避扫罗时作的。神啊，求你恩待我！求你恩待我！ 因为我投靠你； 我要投靠在你翅膀的荫下， 直到灾害过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你怜悯我，怜悯我！ 因为我的心投靠你。 我要投靠在你翅膀的荫下， 等到灾害过去。
verses.textEnNiv: Have mercy on me, my God, have mercy on me, for in you I take refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.
verses.textEnEsv: Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me, for in you my soul takes refuge; in the shadow of your wings I will take refuge, till the storms of destruction pass by.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me! For my soul trusts in You; And in the shadow of Your wings I will make my refuge, Until these calamities have passed by.
verses.textEnNlt: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy! I look to you for protection. I will hide beneath the shadow of your wings until the danger passes by.
verses.textEnNasb: Be gracious to me, God, be gracious to me, For my soul takes refuge in You; And in the shadow of Your wings I will take refuge Until destruction passes by.
verses.textEn: Have mercy on me, my God, have mercy on me, for in you I take refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.

verses.textZh: 我要向至高的神呼求， 就是向为我成就他旨意的神呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要向至高的神呼求， 就是向为我成就他旨意的神呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要求告至高的神， 就是为我成全诸事的神。
verses.textEnNiv: I cry out to God Most High, to God, who vindicates me.
verses.textEnEsv: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills his purpose for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will cry out to God Most High, To God who performs allthings for me.
verses.textEnNlt: I cry out to God Most High, to God who will fulfill his purpose for me.
verses.textEnNasb: I will cry to God Most High, To God who accomplishes all things for me.
verses.textEn: I cry out to God Most High, to God, who vindicates me.

verses.textZh: 神从天上施恩拯救我， 斥责那践踏我的人；神必向我发出他的慈爱和信实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神从天上施恩拯救我， 斥责那践踏我的人；神必向我发出他的慈爱和信实。
verses.textZhCuv: 那要吞我的人辱骂我的时候，神从天上必施恩救我， 也必向我发出慈爱和诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me— God sends forth his love and his faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: He will send from heaven and save me; he will put to shame him who tramples on me. Selah God will send out his steadfast love and his faithfulness!
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall send from heaven and save me; He reproaches the one who would swallow me up. Selah God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.
verses.textEnNlt: He will send help from heaven to rescue me, disgracing those who hound me. Interlude My God will send forth his unfailing love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: He will send from heaven and save me; He rebukes the one who tramples upon me. Selah God will send His favor and His truth.
verses.textEn: He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me— God sends forth his love and his faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 我躺卧在狮子中间， 就是在那些想吞灭人的世人中间； 他们的牙齿是枪和箭， 他们的舌头是快刀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我躺卧在狮子中间， 就是在那些想吞灭人的世人中间； 他们的牙齿是枪和箭， 他们的舌头是快刀。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的性命在狮子中间； 我躺卧在性如烈火的世人当中。 他们的牙齿是枪、箭； 他们的舌头是快刀。
verses.textEnNiv: I am in the midst of lions; I am forced to dwell among ravenous beasts— men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul is in the midst of lions; I lie down amid fiery beasts— the children of man, whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul is among lions; I lie among the sons of men Who are set on fire, Whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.textEnNlt: I am surrounded by fierce lions who greedily devour human prey— whose teeth pierce like spears and arrows, and whose tongues cut like swords.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul is among lions; I must lie among those who devour, Among sons of mankind whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue is a sharp sword.
verses.textEn: I am in the midst of lions; I am forced to dwell among ravenous beasts— men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

verses.textZh: 神啊！愿你被尊崇，过于诸天； 愿你的荣耀遍及全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！愿你被尊崇，过于诸天； 愿你的荣耀遍及全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！ 愿你的荣耀高过全地！
verses.textEnNiv: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; Let Your glory be above all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Be exalted, O God, above the highest heavens! May your glory shine over all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Be exalted above the heavens, God; May Your glory be above all the earth.
verses.textEn: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

verses.textZh: 他们为我的脚设下了网罗， 使我低头屈服； 他们在我面前挖了坑， 自己反掉进坑中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们为我的脚设下了网罗， 使我低头屈服； 他们在我面前挖了坑， 自己反掉进坑中。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们为我的脚设下网罗，压制我的心； 他们在我面前挖了坑，自己反掉在其中。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: They spread a net for my feet— I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path— but they have fallen into it themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: They set a net for my steps; my soul was bowed down. They dug a pit in my way, but they have fallen into it themselves. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: They have prepared a net for my steps; My soul is bowed down; They have dug a pit before me; Into the midst of it they themselves have fallen. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies have set a trap for me. I am weary from distress. They have dug a deep pit in my path, but they themselves have fallen into it. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: They have prepared a net for my steps; My soul is bowed down; They dug a pit before me; They themselves have fallen into the midst of it. Selah
verses.textEn: They spread a net for my feet— I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path— but they have fallen into it themselves.

verses.textZh: 神啊！我的心坚定，我的心坚定； 我要歌唱，我要颂赞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！我的心坚定，我的心坚定； 我要歌唱，我要颂赞。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我心坚定，我心坚定； 我要唱诗，我要歌颂！
verses.textEnNiv: My heart, O God, is steadfast, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.
verses.textEnEsv: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast! I will sing and make melody!
verses.textEnNkjv: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and give praise.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart is confident in you, O God; my heart is confident. No wonder I can sing your praises!
verses.textEnNasb: My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing, yes, I will sing praises!
verses.textEn: My heart, O God, is steadfast, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.

verses.textZh: 我的灵 啊！你要醒过来。 琴和瑟啊！你们都要醒过来。 我也要唤醒黎明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的灵 啊！你要醒过来。 琴和瑟啊！你们都要醒过来。 我也要唤醒黎明。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的灵 啊，你当醒起！ 琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！ 我自己要极早醒起！
verses.textEnNiv: Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
verses.textEnEsv: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awake the dawn!
verses.textEnNkjv: Awake, my glory! Awake, lute and harp! I will awaken the dawn.
verses.textEnNlt: Wake up, my heart! Wake up, O lyre and harp! I will wake the dawn with my song.
verses.textEnNasb: Awake, my glory! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
verses.textEn: Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

verses.textZh: 主啊！我要在万民中称谢你， 在万族中歌颂你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！我要在万民中称谢你， 在万族中歌颂你。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，我要在万民中称谢你， 在列邦中歌颂你！
verses.textEnNiv: I will praise you, Lord, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises to you among the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will praise You, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing to You among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: I will thank you, Lord, among all the people. I will sing your praises among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: I will praise You, Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises to You among the nations.
verses.textEn: I will praise you, Lord, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

verses.textZh: 因为你的慈爱伟大，高及诸天， 你的信实上达云霄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你的慈爱伟大，高及诸天， 你的信实上达云霄。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，你的慈爱高及诸天； 你的诚实达到穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: For great is your love, reaching to the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.textEnEsv: For your steadfast love is great to the heavens, your faithfulness to the clouds.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Your mercy reaches unto the heavens, And Your truth unto the clouds.
verses.textEnNlt: For your unfailing love is as high as the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
verses.textEnNasb: For Your goodness is great to the heavens And Your truth to the clouds.
verses.textEn: For great is your love, reaching to the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

verses.textZh: 神啊！愿你被尊崇，过于诸天； 愿你的荣耀遍及全地。 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"休要毁坏"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！愿你被尊崇，过于诸天； 愿你的荣耀遍及全地。 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"休要毁坏"。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！ 愿你的荣耀高过全地！
verses.textEnNiv: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; Let Your glory be above all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Be exalted, O God, above the highest heavens. May your glory shine over all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Be exalted above the heavens, God; May Your glory be above all the earth.
verses.textEn: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

verses.textZh: 掌权者啊！你们真的讲公义吗 ？ 你们真的按照正直审判世人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 掌权者啊！你们真的讲公义吗 ？ 你们真的按照正直审判世人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 世人哪，你们默然不语，真合公义吗？ 施行审判，岂按正直吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge people with equity?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you indeed decree what is right, you gods? Do you judge the children of man uprightly?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you indeed speak righteousness, you silent ones? Do you judge uprightly, you sons of men?
verses.textEnNlt: Justice—do you rulers know the meaning of the word? Do you judge the people fairly?
verses.textEnNasb: Do you indeed speak righteousness, you gods? Do you judge fairly, you sons of mankind?
verses.textEn: Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge people with equity?

verses.textZh: 不是的，你们心中策划奸恶； 你们的手在地上施行强暴 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不是的，你们心中策划奸恶； 你们的手在地上施行强暴 。
verses.textZhCuv: 不然！你们是心中作恶； 你们在地上秤出你们手所行的强暴。
verses.textEnNiv: No, in your heart you devise injustice, and your hands mete out violence on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: No, in your hearts you devise wrongs; your hands deal out violence on earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: No, in heart you work wickedness; You weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: No! You plot injustice in your hearts. You spread violence throughout the land.
verses.textEnNasb: No, in heart you practice injustice; On earth you clear a way for the violence of your hands.
verses.textEn: No, in your heart you devise injustice, and your hands mete out violence on the earth.

verses.textZh: 恶人一出母胎，就走上歧路； 他们一离母腹，就走偏了路，常说谎话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人一出母胎，就走上歧路； 他们一离母腹，就走偏了路，常说谎话。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人一出母胎就与神疏远， 一离母腹便走错路，说谎话。
verses.textEnNiv: Even from birth the wicked go astray; from the womb they are wayward, spreading lies.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked are estranged from the womb; they go astray from birth, speaking lies.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked are estranged from the womb; They go astray as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
verses.textEnNlt: These wicked people are born sinners; even from birth they have lied and gone their own way.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked have turned away from the womb; These who speak lies go astray from birth.
verses.textEn: Even from birth the wicked go astray; from the womb they are wayward, spreading lies.

verses.textZh: 他们的毒气好象蛇的毒气， 又像耳朵塞住的聋虺，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的毒气好象蛇的毒气， 又像耳朵塞住的聋虺，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的毒气好像蛇的毒气； 他们好像塞耳的聋虺，
verses.textEnNiv: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like that of a cobra that has stopped its ears,
verses.textEnEsv: They have venom like the venom of a serpent, like the deaf adder that stops its ear,
verses.textEnNkjv: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent; Theyare like the deaf cobra that stops its ear,
verses.textEnNlt: They spit venom like deadly snakes; they are like cobras that refuse to listen,
verses.textEnNasb: They have venom like the venom of a serpent; Like a deaf cobra that stops up its ear,
verses.textEn: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like that of a cobra that has stopped its ears,

verses.textZh: 不听行法术者的声音， 就是极灵的咒语，也是无效。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不听行法术者的声音， 就是极灵的咒语，也是无效。
verses.textZhCuv: 不听行法术的声音， 虽用极灵的咒语也是不听。
verses.textEnNiv: that will not heed the tune of the charmer, however skillful the enchanter may be.
verses.textEnEsv: so that it does not hear the voice of charmers or of the cunning enchanter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Which will not heed the voice of charmers, Charming ever so skillfully.
verses.textEnNlt: ignoring the tunes of the snake charmers, no matter how skillfully they play.
verses.textEnNasb: So that it does not hear the voice of charmers, Or a skillful caster of spells.
verses.textEn: that will not heed the tune of the charmer, however skillful the enchanter may be.

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你敲掉他们口中的牙齿； 耶和华啊！求你打断少壮狮子的颚骨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你敲掉他们口中的牙齿； 耶和华啊！求你打断少壮狮子的颚骨。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你敲碎他们口中的牙！ 耶和华啊，求你敲掉少壮狮子的大牙！
verses.textEnNiv: Break the teeth in their mouths, O God; Lord , tear out the fangs of those lions!
verses.textEnEsv: O God, break the teeth in their mouths; tear out the fangs of the young lions, O Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Break their teeth in their mouth, O God! Break out the fangs of the young lions, O Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Break off their fangs, O God! Smash the jaws of these lions, O Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: God, shatter their teeth in their mouth; Break out the fangs of the young lions, Lord.
verses.textEn: Break the teeth in their mouths, O God; Lord , tear out the fangs of those lions!

verses.textZh: 愿他们像流水般消逝； 愿他们射箭的时候，箭头折断 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们像流水般消逝； 愿他们射箭的时候，箭头折断 。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们消灭，如急流的水一般； 他们瞅准射箭的时候，愿箭头仿佛砍断。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them vanish like water that flows away; when they draw the bow, let their arrows fall short.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them vanish like water that runs away; when he aims his arrows, let them be blunted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them flow away as waters which run continually; When he bends hisbow, Let his arrows be as if cut in pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: May they disappear like water into thirsty ground. Make their weapons useless in their hands.
verses.textEnNasb: May they flow away like water that runs off; When he aims his arrows, may they be as headless shafts.
verses.textEn: Let them vanish like water that flows away; when they draw the bow, let their arrows fall short.

verses.textZh: 愿他们像蜗牛般蠕行消融， 如同妇人流产未见天日的胎儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们像蜗牛般蠕行消融， 如同妇人流产未见天日的胎儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们像蜗牛消化过去， 又像妇人坠落未见天日的胎。
verses.textEnNiv: May they be like a slug that melts away as it moves along, like a stillborn child that never sees the sun.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be like the snail that dissolves into slime, like the stillborn child who never sees the sun.
verses.textEnNkjv: Letthembe like a snail which melts away as it goes, Like a stillborn child of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
verses.textEnNlt: May they be like snails that dissolve into slime, like a stillborn child who will never see the sun.
verses.textEnNasb: May they be like a snail which goes along in slime, Like the miscarriage of a woman that never sees the sun.
verses.textEn: May they be like a slug that melts away as it moves along, like a stillborn child that never sees the sun.

verses.textZh: 你们用荆棘烧火，锅还未热， 他要用旋风把烧着的和未烧着的一起刮去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们用荆棘烧火，锅还未热， 他要用旋风把烧着的和未烧着的一起刮去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们用荆棘烧火，锅还未热， 他要用旋风把青的和烧着的一齐刮去。
verses.textEnNiv: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns— whether they be green or dry—the wicked will be swept away.
verses.textEnEsv: Sooner than your pots can feel the heat of thorns, whether green or ablaze, may he sweep them away!
verses.textEnNkjv: Before your pots can feel theburning thorns, He shall take them away as with a whirlwind, As in His living and burning wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: God will sweep them away, both young and old, faster than a pot heats over burning thorns.
verses.textEnNasb: Before your pots can feel the fire of thorns He will sweep them away with a whirlwind, the green and the burning alike.
verses.textEn: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns— whether they be green or dry—the wicked will be swept away.

verses.textZh: 义人看见仇敌遭报就欢喜； 他要在恶人的血中洗自己的脚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人看见仇敌遭报就欢喜； 他要在恶人的血中洗自己的脚。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人见仇敌遭报就欢喜， 要在恶人的血中洗脚。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous will be glad when they are avenged, when they dip their feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous will rejoice when he sees the vengeance; he will bathe his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance; He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
verses.textEnNlt: The godly will rejoice when they see injustice avenged. They will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous will rejoice when he sees vengeance; He will wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.textEn: The righteous will be glad when they are avenged, when they dip their feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 因此，人必说："义人果然有善报； 在世上确有一位施行审判的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，人必说："义人果然有善报； 在世上确有一位施行审判的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，人必说：义人诚然有善报； 在地上果有施行判断的神！
verses.textEnNiv: Then people will say, "Surely the righteous still are rewarded; surely there is a God who judges the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: Mankind will say, "Surely there is a reward for the righteous; surely there is a God who judges on earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: So that men will say, "Surely thereis a reward for the righteous; Surely He is God who judges in the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then at last everyone will say, "There truly is a reward for those who live for God; surely there is a God who judges justly here on earth."
verses.textEnNasb: And people will say, "There certainly is a reward for the righteous; There certainly is a God who judges on the earth!"
verses.textEn: Then people will say, "Surely the righteous still are rewarded; surely there is a God who judges the earth."

verses.textZh: 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"休要毁坏"，是在扫罗打发人去窥探大卫的家，要杀死他以后作的。 我的神啊！求你救我脱离我的仇敌， 求你把我安放在高处，脱离那些起来攻击我的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"休要毁坏"，是在扫罗打发人去窥探大卫的家，要杀死他以后作的。 我的神啊！求你救我脱离我的仇敌， 求你把我安放在高处，脱离那些起来攻击我的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，求你救我脱离仇敌， 把我安置在高处，得脱那些起来攻击我的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Deliver me from my enemies, O God; be my fortress against those who are attacking me.
verses.textEnEsv: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise up against me;
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; Defend me from those who rise up against me.
verses.textEnNlt: Rescue me from my enemies, O God. Protect me from those who have come to destroy me.
verses.textEnNasb: Rescue me from my enemies, my God; Set me securely on high away from those who rise up against me.
verses.textEn: Deliver me from my enemies, O God; be my fortress against those who are attacking me.

verses.textZh: 求你救我脱离作孽的人， 救我脱离流人血的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你救我脱离作孽的人， 救我脱离流人血的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你救我脱离作孽的人 和喜爱流人血的人！
verses.textEnNiv: Deliver me from evildoers and save me from those who are after my blood.
verses.textEnEsv: deliver me from those who work evil, and save me from bloodthirsty men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from bloodthirsty men.
verses.textEnNlt: Rescue me from these criminals; save me from these murderers.
verses.textEnNasb: Rescue me from those who practice injustice, And save me from men of bloodshed.
verses.textEn: Deliver me from evildoers and save me from those who are after my blood.

verses.textZh: 看哪！他们埋伏要害我的性命； 强盛的人聚集起来攻击我； 耶和华啊！这不是因我的过犯， 也不是因我的罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！他们埋伏要害我的性命； 强盛的人聚集起来攻击我； 耶和华啊！这不是因我的过犯， 也不是因我的罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，他们埋伏要害我的命； 有能力的人聚集来攻击我。 耶和华啊，这不是为我的过犯， 也不是为我的罪愆。
verses.textEnNiv: See how they lie in wait for me! Fierce men conspire against me for no offense or sin of mine, Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, they lie in wait for my life; fierce men stir up strife against me. For no transgression or sin of mine, O Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: For look, they lie in wait for my life; The mighty gather against me, Not for my transgression nor for my sin, O Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They have set an ambush for me. Fierce enemies are out there waiting, Lord , though I have not sinned or offended them.
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, they have set an ambush for my life; Fierce men attack me, Not for my wrongdoing nor for my sin, Lord,
verses.textEn: See how they lie in wait for me! Fierce men conspire against me for no offense or sin of mine, Lord .

verses.textZh: 我虽然没有过错， 他们还是跑来，预备好攻击我。 求你醒来，帮助我，鉴察我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然没有过错， 他们还是跑来，预备好攻击我。 求你醒来，帮助我，鉴察我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽然无过，他们预备整齐，跑来攻击我。 求你兴起鉴察，帮助我！
verses.textEnNiv: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Arise to help me; look on my plight!
verses.textEnEsv: for no fault of mine, they run and make ready. Awake, come to meet me, and see!
verses.textEnNkjv: They run and prepare themselves through no fault ofmine. Awake to help me, and behold!
verses.textEnNlt: I have done nothing wrong, yet they prepare to attack me. Wake up! See what is happening and help me!
verses.textEnNasb: For no guilt of mine, they run and take their stand against me. Stir Yourself to help me, and see!
verses.textEn: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Arise to help me; look on my plight!

verses.textZh: 万军的神耶和华啊！你是以色列的神， 求你醒来，惩罚万国； 求你不要恩待那些背信弃义的恶人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军的神耶和华啊！你是以色列的神， 求你醒来，惩罚万国； 求你不要恩待那些背信弃义的恶人。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之神－耶和华以色列的神啊！ 求你兴起，惩治万邦！ 不要怜悯行诡诈的恶人！ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord God Almighty, you who are the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to wicked traitors.
verses.textEnEsv: You, Lord God of hosts, are God of Israel. Rouse yourself to punish all the nations; spare none of those who treacherously plot evil. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: You therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, Awake to punish all the nations; Do not be merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, wake up and punish those hostile nations. Show no mercy to wicked traitors. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: You, Lord God of armies, the God of Israel, Awake to punish all the nations; Do not be gracious to any who deal treacherously in wrongdoing. Selah
verses.textEn: You, Lord God Almighty, you who are the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to wicked traitors.

verses.textZh: 他们每晚都回来， 好象狗一样狂吠， 环绕着城行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们每晚都回来， 好象狗一样狂吠， 环绕着城行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们晚上转回， 叫号如狗，围城绕行。
verses.textEnNiv: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.
verses.textEnEsv: Each evening they come back, howling like dogs and prowling about the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: At evening they return, They growl like a dog, And go all around the city.
verses.textEnNlt: They come out at night, snarling like vicious dogs as they prowl the streets.
verses.textEnNasb: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And prowl around the city.
verses.textEn: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

verses.textZh: 看哪！他们口中吐出恶言， 他们嘴里吐出利刀， 他们心里说："有谁听见呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！他们口中吐出恶言， 他们嘴里吐出利刀， 他们心里说："有谁听见呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们口中喷吐恶言，嘴里有刀； 他们说：有谁听见？
verses.textEnNiv: See what they spew from their mouths— the words from their lips are sharp as swords, and they think, "Who can hear us?"
verses.textEnEsv: There they are, bellowing with their mouths with swords in their lips— for "Who," they think, "will hear us?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, they belch with their mouth; Swords are in their lips; For theysay, "Who hears?"
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the filth that comes from their mouths; their words cut like swords. "After all, who can hear us?" they sneer.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, they gush forth with their mouths; Swords are in their lips, For, they say, "Who hears?"
verses.textEn: See what they spew from their mouths— the words from their lips are sharp as swords, and they think, "Who can hear us?"

verses.textZh: 但你耶和华必讥笑他们， 你必嗤笑万国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你耶和华必讥笑他们， 你必嗤笑万国。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你－耶和华必笑话他们； 你要嗤笑万邦。
verses.textEnNiv: But you laugh at them, Lord ; you scoff at all those nations.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O Lord , laugh at them; you hold all the nations in derision.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, O Lord, shall laugh at them; You shall have all the nations in derision.
verses.textEnNlt: But Lord , you laugh at them. You scoff at all the hostile nations.
verses.textEnNasb: But You, Lord, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.
verses.textEn: But you laugh at them, Lord ; you scoff at all those nations.

verses.textZh: 我的力量啊！我要仰望你，神啊！因为你是我的高台。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的力量啊！我要仰望你，神啊！因为你是我的高台。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你， 因为神是我的高台。
verses.textEnNiv: You are my strength, I watch for you; you, God, are my fortress,
verses.textEnEsv: O my Strength, I will watch for you, for you, O God, are my fortress.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will wait for You, O You his Strength; For God is my defense.
verses.textEnNlt: You are my strength; I wait for you to rescue me, for you, O God, are my fortress.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of his strength I will watch for You, For God is my refuge.
verses.textEn: You are my strength, I watch for you; you, God, are my fortress,

verses.textZh: 我的神必以慈爱迎接我；神必叫我看见我的仇敌遭报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神必以慈爱迎接我；神必叫我看见我的仇敌遭报。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神要以慈爱迎接我；神要叫我看见我仇敌遭报。
verses.textEnNiv: my God on whom I can rely. God will go before me and will let me gloat over those who slander me.
verses.textEnEsv: My God in his steadfast love will meet me; God will let me look in triumph on my enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: My God of mercy shall come to meet me; God shall let me see mydesire on my enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: In his unfailing love, my God will stand with me. He will let me look down in triumph on all my enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: My God in His faithfulness will meet me; God will let me look triumphantly upon my enemies.
verses.textEn: my God on whom I can rely. God will go before me and will let me gloat over those who slander me.

verses.textZh: 不要杀害他们，免得我的人民忘记了； 主啊！你是我们的盾牌， 求你用你的能力，使他们飘流无定， 并且降为卑微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要杀害他们，免得我的人民忘记了； 主啊！你是我们的盾牌， 求你用你的能力，使他们飘流无定， 并且降为卑微。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要杀他们，恐怕我的民忘记。 主啊，你是我们的盾牌； 求你用你的能力使他们四散， 且降为卑。
verses.textEnNiv: But do not kill them, Lord our shield, or my people will forget. In your might uproot them and bring them down.
verses.textEnEsv: Kill them not, lest my people forget; make them totter by your power and bring them down, O Lord, our shield!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not slay them, lest my people forget; Scatter them by Your power, And bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t kill them, for my people soon forget such lessons; stagger them with your power, and bring them to their knees, O Lord our shield.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not kill them, or my people will forget; Scatter them by Your power and bring them down, Lord, our shield.
verses.textEn: But do not kill them, Lord our shield, or my people will forget. In your might uproot them and bring them down.

verses.textZh: 因他们口中的罪， 因他们嘴里所说的话， 愿他们在自己的骄傲中被缠住。 因他们所说的是咒骂和欺骗的话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因他们口中的罪， 因他们嘴里所说的话， 愿他们在自己的骄傲中被缠住。 因他们所说的是咒骂和欺骗的话，
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们口中的罪和嘴里的言语， 并咒骂虚谎的话， 愿他们在骄傲之中被缠住了。
verses.textEnNiv: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride. For the curses and lies they utter,
verses.textEnEsv: For the sin of their mouths, the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride. For the cursing and lies that they utter,
verses.textEnNkjv: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips, Let them even be taken in their pride, And for the cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of the sinful things they say, because of the evil that is on their lips, let them be captured by their pride, their curses, and their lies.
verses.textEnNasb: On account of the sin of their mouths and the words of their lips, May they even be caught in their pride, And on account of curses and lies which they tell.
verses.textEn: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride. For the curses and lies they utter,

verses.textZh: 求你在怒中消灭他们， 消灭他们，以致无一幸免， 好使他们知道神在雅各中间掌权， 直到地极。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在怒中消灭他们， 消灭他们，以致无一幸免， 好使他们知道神在雅各中间掌权， 直到地极。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你发怒，使他们消灭， 以致归于无有， 叫他们知道神在雅各中间掌权， 直到地极。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: consume them in your wrath, consume them till they are no more. Then it will be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, that they may know that God rules over Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Consume them in wrath, consume them, That they may not be; And let them know that God rules in Jacob To the ends of the earth. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Destroy them in your anger! Wipe them out completely! Then the whole world will know that God reigns in Israel. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Destroy them in wrath, destroy them so that they will no longer exist; So that people may know that God rules in Jacob, To the ends of the earth. Selah
verses.textEn: consume them in your wrath, consume them till they are no more. Then it will be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob.

verses.textZh: 他们每晚都回来， 好象狗一样狂吠， 环绕着城行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们每晚都回来， 好象狗一样狂吠， 环绕着城行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晚上，任凭他们转回； 任凭他们叫号如狗，围城绕行。
verses.textEnNiv: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.
verses.textEnEsv: Each evening they come back, howling like dogs and prowling about the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at evening they return, They growl like a dog, And go all around the city.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies come out at night, snarling like vicious dogs as they prowl the streets.
verses.textEnNasb: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And prowl around the city.
verses.textEn: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

verses.textZh: 他们四处飘流，寻找食物； 如果得不到饱足，就不断咆哮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们四处飘流，寻找食物； 如果得不到饱足，就不断咆哮。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必走来走去，寻找食物， 若不得饱就终夜在外。
verses.textEnNiv: They wander about for food and howl if not satisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: They wander about for food and growl if they do not get their fill.
verses.textEnNkjv: They wander up and down for food, And howl if they are not satisfied.
verses.textEnNlt: They scavenge for food but go to sleep unsatisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: They wander about for food And murmur if they are not satisfied.
verses.textEn: They wander about for food and howl if not satisfied.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我要歌颂你的能力， 每天早晨我要向你的慈爱欢呼， 因为你作了我的高台， 在患难的日子，作了我的避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我要歌颂你的能力， 每天早晨我要向你的慈爱欢呼， 因为你作了我的高台， 在患难的日子，作了我的避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我要歌颂你的力量， 早晨要高唱你的慈爱； 因为你作过我的高台， 在我急难的日子作过我的避难所。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will sing of your strength, in the morning I will sing of your love; for you are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: But I will sing of your strength; I will sing aloud of your steadfast love in the morning. For you have been to me a fortress and a refuge in the day of my distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will sing of Your power; Yes, I will sing aloud of Your mercy in the morning; For You have been my defense And refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for me, I will sing about your power. Each morning I will sing with joy about your unfailing love. For you have been my refuge, a place of safety when I am in distress.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, I will sing of Your strength; Yes, I will joyfully sing of Your faithfulness in the morning, For You have been my refuge And a place of refuge on the day of my distress.
verses.textEn: But I will sing of your strength, in the morning I will sing of your love; for you are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.

verses.textZh: 我的力量啊！我要向你歌唱；神啊！你是我的高台， 是向我施慈爱的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的力量啊！我要向你歌唱；神啊！你是我的高台， 是向我施慈爱的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的力量啊，我要歌颂你； 因为神是我的高台， 是赐恩与我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: You are my strength, I sing praise to you; you, God, are my fortress, my God on whom I can rely.
verses.textEnEsv: O my Strength, I will sing praises to you, for you, O God, are my fortress, the God who shows me steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: To You, O my Strength, I will sing praises; For God is my defense, My God of mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: O my Strength, to you I sing praises, for you, O God, are my refuge, the God who shows me unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: My strength, I will sing praises to You; For God is my refuge, the God who shows me favor.
verses.textEn: You are my strength, I sing praise to you; you, God, are my fortress, my God on whom I can rely.

verses.textZh: 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"见证的百合花"，为教导用的，是在大卫与两河之间的亚兰，和琐巴的亚兰争战以后，并在约押归回，在盐谷中击杀了一万二千以东人以后作的。神啊！你丢弃了我们，击碎了我们； 你曾向我们发怒，现在求你复兴我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的金诗，交给诗班长，调用"见证的百合花"，为教导用的，是在大卫与两河之间的亚兰，和琐巴的亚兰争战以后，并在约押归回，在盐谷中击杀了一万二千以东人以后作的。神啊！你丢弃了我们，击碎了我们； 你曾向我们发怒，现在求你复兴我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你丢弃了我们，使我们破败； 你向我们发怒，求你使我们复兴！
verses.textEnNiv: You have rejected us, God, and burst upon us; you have been angry—now restore us!
verses.textEnEsv: O God, you have rejected us, broken our defenses; you have been angry; oh, restore us.
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, You have cast us off; You have broken us down; You have been displeased; Oh, restore us again!
verses.textEnNlt: You have rejected us, O God, and broken our defenses. You have been angry with us; now restore us to your favor.
verses.textEnNasb: God, You have rejected us. You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
verses.textEn: You have rejected us, God, and burst upon us; you have been angry—now restore us!

verses.textZh: 你使地震动、崩裂， 求你修补裂缝， 因为地正在摇动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使地震动、崩裂， 求你修补裂缝， 因为地正在摇动。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使地震动，而且崩裂； 求你将裂口医好，因为地摇动。
verses.textEnNiv: You have shaken the land and torn it open; mend its fractures, for it is quaking.
verses.textEnEsv: You have made the land to quake; you have torn it open; repair its breaches, for it totters.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have made the earth tremble; You have broken it; Heal its breaches, for it is shaking.
verses.textEnNlt: You have shaken our land and split it open. Seal the cracks, for the land trembles.
verses.textEnNasb: You have made the land quake, You have split it open; Heal its cracks, for it sways.
verses.textEn: You have shaken the land and torn it open; mend its fractures, for it is quaking.

verses.textZh: 你使你的子民遇见艰苦； 你使我们喝那令人东倒西歪的酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使你的子民遇见艰苦； 你使我们喝那令人东倒西歪的酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你叫你的民遇见艰难； 你叫我们喝那使人东倒西歪的酒。
verses.textEnNiv: You have shown your people desperate times; you have given us wine that makes us stagger.
verses.textEnEsv: You have made your people see hard things; you have given us wine to drink that made us stagger.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have shown Your people hard things; You have made us drink the wine of confusion.
verses.textEnNlt: You have been very hard on us, making us drink wine that sent us reeling.
verses.textEnNasb: You have made Your people experience hardship; You have given us wine to drink that makes us stagger.
verses.textEn: You have shown your people desperate times; you have given us wine that makes us stagger.

verses.textZh: 你为敬畏你的人，竖起旗帜， 使他们可以逃到那里，躲避敌人的弓箭。 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为敬畏你的人，竖起旗帜， 使他们可以逃到那里，躲避敌人的弓箭。 。
verses.textZhCuv: 你把旌旗赐给敬畏你的人， 可以为真理扬起来。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner to be unfurled against the bow.
verses.textEnEsv: You have set up a banner for those who fear you, that they may flee to it from the bow. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: You have given a banner to those who fear You, That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: But you have raised a banner for those who fear you— a rallying point in the face of attack. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: You have given a banner to those who fear You, That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah
verses.textEn: But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner to be unfurled against the bow.

verses.textZh: 求你用右手拯救我们，应允我们， 好使你所喜爱的人得拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你用右手拯救我们，应允我们， 好使你所喜爱的人得拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们， 好叫你所亲爱的人得救。
verses.textEnNiv: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.
verses.textEnEsv: That your beloved ones may be delivered, give salvation by your right hand and answer us!
verses.textEnNkjv: That Your beloved may be delivered, Save with Your right hand, and hear me.
verses.textEnNlt: Now rescue your beloved people. Answer and save us by your power.
verses.textEnNasb: That Your beloved may be rescued, Save us with Your right hand, and answer us!
verses.textEn: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

verses.textZh: 神在自己的圣所 说： "我必夸胜， 我必分开示剑， 我必量度疏割谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在自己的圣所 说： "我必夸胜， 我必分开示剑， 我必量度疏割谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 神已经指着他的圣洁说 ：我要欢乐； 我要分开示剑，丈量疏割谷。
verses.textEnNiv: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.
verses.textEnEsv: God has spoken in his holiness: "With exultation I will divide up Shechem and portion out the Vale of Succoth.
verses.textEnNkjv: God has spoken in His holiness: "I will rejoice; I will divide Shechem And measure out the Valley of Succoth.
verses.textEnNlt: God has promised this by his holiness : "I will divide up Shechem with joy. I will measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.textEnNasb: God has spoken in His holiness: "I will triumph, I will divide up Shechem, and measure out the Valley of Succoth.
verses.textEn: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.

verses.textZh: 基列是我的，玛拿西是我的； 以法莲是我的头盔； 犹大是我的权杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列是我的，玛拿西是我的； 以法莲是我的头盔； 犹大是我的权杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 基列是我的，玛拿西也是我的。 以法莲是护卫我头的； 犹大是我的杖。
verses.textEnNiv: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.
verses.textEnEsv: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet; Judah is my scepter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim also is the helmet for My head; Judah is My lawgiver.
verses.textEnNlt: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh, too. Ephraim, my helmet, will produce my warriors, and Judah, my scepter, will produce my kings.
verses.textEnNasb: "Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim also is the helmet of My head; Judah is My scepter.
verses.textEn: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.

verses.textZh: 摩押是我的洗脚盆； 我要向以东拋鞋； 我要因战胜非利士欢呼 。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押是我的洗脚盆； 我要向以东拋鞋； 我要因战胜非利士欢呼 。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押是我的沐浴盆； 我要向以东抛鞋。 非利士啊，你还能因我欢呼吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."
verses.textEnEsv: Moab is my washbasin; upon Edom I cast my shoe; over Philistia I shout in triumph."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moab is My washpot; Over Edom I will cast My shoe; Philistia, shout in triumph because of Me."
verses.textEnNlt: But Moab, my washbasin, will become my servant, and I will wipe my feet on Edom and shout in triumph over Philistia."
verses.textEnNasb: "Moab is My washbowl; I will throw My sandal over Edom; Shout loud, Philistia, because of Me!"
verses.textEn: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."

verses.textZh: 谁能带我进坚固城？ 谁能领我到以东地去呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能带我进坚固城？ 谁能领我到以东地去呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能领我进坚固城？ 谁能引我到以东地？
verses.textEnNiv: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
verses.textEnEsv: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who will bring me to the strong city? Who will lead me to Edom?
verses.textEnNlt: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will bring me victory over Edom?
verses.textEnNasb: Who will bring me into the besieged city? Who will lead me to Edom?
verses.textEn: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

verses.textZh: 神啊！你不是把我们丢弃了吗？神啊！你不和我们的军队一同出战吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你不是把我们丢弃了吗？神啊！你不和我们的军队一同出战吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你不是丢弃了我们吗？神啊，你不和我们的军兵同去吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is it not you, God, you who have now rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?
verses.textEnEsv: Have you not rejected us, O God? You do not go forth, O God, with our armies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Isit not You, O God, who cast us off? And You, O God, who did not go out with our armies?
verses.textEnNlt: Have you rejected us, O God? Will you no longer march with our armies?
verses.textEnNasb: Have You Yourself not rejected us, God? And will You not go out with our armies, God?
verses.textEn: Is it not you, God, you who have now rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

verses.textZh: 求你帮助我们抵挡敌人， 因为人的援助是没有用的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你帮助我们抵挡敌人， 因为人的援助是没有用的。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人， 因为人的帮助是枉然的。
verses.textEnNiv: Give us aid against the enemy, for human help is worthless.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, grant us help against the foe, for vain is the salvation of man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Give us help from trouble, For the help of man is useless.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, please help us against our enemies, for all human help is useless.
verses.textEnNasb: Oh give us help against the enemy, For rescue by man is worthless.
verses.textEn: Give us aid against the enemy, for human help is worthless.

verses.textZh: 我们靠着神奋勇作战， 因为他必践踏我们的敌人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们靠着神奋勇作战， 因为他必践踏我们的敌人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们倚靠神才得施展大能， 因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。
verses.textEnNiv: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: With God we shall do valiantly; it is he who will tread down our foes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Through God we will do valiantly, For itis He who shall tread down our enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: With God’s help we will do mighty things, for he will trample down our foes.
verses.textEnNasb: Through God we will do valiantly, And it is He who will trample down our enemies.
verses.textEn: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。神啊！求你听我的呼求， 留心听我的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。神啊！求你听我的呼求， 留心听我的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你听我的呼求， 侧耳听我的祷告！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear my cry, O God, listen to my prayer;
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear my cry, O God; Attend to my prayer.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, listen to my cry! Hear my prayer!
verses.textEnNasb: Hear my cry, God; Give Your attention to my prayer.
verses.textEn: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.

verses.textZh: 我内心沮丧的时候， 我从地极向你呼求； 求你领我到那比我更高的盘石上面去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我内心沮丧的时候， 我从地极向你呼求； 求你领我到那比我更高的盘石上面去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心里发昏的时候， 我要从地极求告你。 求你领我到那比我更高的磐石！
verses.textEnNiv: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.textEnEsv: from the end of the earth I call to you when my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I,
verses.textEnNkjv: From the end of the earth I will cry to You, When my heart is overwhelmed; Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.textEnNlt: From the ends of the earth, I cry to you for help when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the towering rock of safety,
verses.textEnNasb: From the end of the earth I call to You when my heart is faint; Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.textEn: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.textZh: 因为你作过我的避难所， 作过我逃避仇敌的坚固堡垒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你作过我的避难所， 作过我逃避仇敌的坚固堡垒。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你作过我的避难所， 作过我的坚固台，脱离仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.
verses.textEnEsv: for you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have been a shelter for me, A strong tower from the enemy.
verses.textEnNlt: for you are my safe refuge, a fortress where my enemies cannot reach me.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have been a refuge for me, A tower of strength against the enemy.
verses.textEn: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.

verses.textZh: 我要永远住在你的帐棚里， 投靠在你翅膀下的隐密处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要永远住在你的帐棚里， 投靠在你翅膀下的隐密处。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要永远住在你的帐幕里！ 我要投靠在你翅膀下的隐密处！ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings.
verses.textEnEsv: Let me dwell in your tent forever! Let me take refuge under the shelter of your wings! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: I will abide in Your tabernacle forever; I will trust in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Let me live forever in your sanctuary, safe beneath the shelter of your wings! Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Let me dwell in Your tent forever; Let me take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
verses.textEn: I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你听了我所许的愿； 你把产业赐给敬畏你名的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你听了我所许的愿； 你把产业赐给敬畏你名的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你原是听了我所许的愿； 你将产业赐给敬畏你名的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For you, God, have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
verses.textEnEsv: For you, O God, have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You, O God, have heard my vows; You have given me the heritage of those who fear Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: For you have heard my vows, O God. You have given me an inheritance reserved for those who fear your name.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have heard my vows, God; You have given me the inheritance of those who fear Your name.
verses.textEn: For you, God, have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

verses.textZh: 愿你增添王的寿数； 愿他的年日世世无穷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你增添王的寿数； 愿他的年日世世无穷。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要加添王的寿数； 他的年岁必存到世世。
verses.textEnNiv: Increase the days of the king’s life, his years for many generations.
verses.textEnEsv: Prolong the life of the king; may his years endure to all generations!
verses.textEnNkjv: You will prolong the king’s life, His years as many generations.
verses.textEnNlt: Add many years to the life of the king! May his years span the generations!
verses.textEnNasb: You will prolong the king’s life; His years will be like generations.
verses.textEn: Increase the days of the king’s life, his years for many generations.

verses.textZh: 愿他在神面前永远作王； 愿你指派慈爱和诚实保护他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他在神面前永远作王； 愿你指派慈爱和诚实保护他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必永远坐在神面前； 愿你预备慈爱和诚实保佑他！
verses.textEnNiv: May he be enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint your love and faithfulness to protect him.
verses.textEnEsv: May he be enthroned forever before God; appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to watch over him!
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall abide before God forever. Oh, prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him!
verses.textEnNlt: May he reign under God’s protection forever. May your unfailing love and faithfulness watch over him.
verses.textEnNasb: He will sit enthroned before God forever; Appoint faithfulness and truth that they may watch over him.
verses.textEn: May he be enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint your love and faithfulness to protect him.

verses.textZh: 这样，我要永远歌颂你的名， 并且天天还我向你所许的愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我要永远歌颂你的名， 并且天天还我向你所许的愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我要歌颂你的名，直到永远， 好天天还我所许的愿。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will ever sing in praise of your name and fulfill my vows day after day.
verses.textEnEsv: So will I ever sing praises to your name, as I perform my vows day after day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will sing praise to Your name forever, That I may daily perform my vows.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will sing praises to your name forever as I fulfill my vows each day.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will sing praise to Your name forever, That I may pay my vows day by day.
verses.textEn: Then I will ever sing in praise of your name and fulfill my vows day after day.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，照耶杜顿的做法。 唯独等候神，我的心才有安息； 我的拯救从他而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，照耶杜顿的做法。 唯独等候神，我的心才有安息； 我的拯救从他而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心默默无声，专等候神； 我的救恩是从他而来。
verses.textEnNiv: Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from him.
verses.textEnEsv: For God alone my soul waits in silence; from him comes my salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly my soul silently waits for God; From Him comes my salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: I wait quietly before God, for my victory comes from him.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul waits in silence for God alone; From Him comes my salvation.
verses.textEn: Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from him.

verses.textZh: 唯独他是我的盘石，我的拯救； 他是我的保障，我必不至动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独他是我的盘石，我的拯救； 他是我的保障，我必不至动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高台，我必不很动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.
verses.textEnEsv: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I shall not be greatly shaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: He only is my rock and my salvation; Heis my defense; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.textEnNlt: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress where I will never be shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: He alone is my rock and my salvation, My stronghold; I will not be greatly shaken.
verses.textEn: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.

verses.textZh: 你们大家攻击一个人，要把他杀害， 如同拆毁倾斜的墙，将倒的壁， 要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们大家攻击一个人，要把他杀害， 如同拆毁倾斜的墙，将倒的壁， 要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们大家攻击一人，把他毁坏， 如同毁坏歪斜的墙、将倒的壁，要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long will you assault me? Would all of you throw me down— this leaning wall, this tottering fence?
verses.textEnEsv: How long will all of you attack a man to batter him, like a leaning wall, a tottering fence?
verses.textEnNkjv: How long will you attack a man? You shall be slain, all of you, Like a leaning wall and a tottering fence.
verses.textEnNlt: So many enemies against one man— all of them trying to kill me. To them I’m just a broken-down wall or a tottering fence.
verses.textEnNasb: How long will you attack a man, That you may murder him, all of you, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
verses.textEn: How long will you assault me? Would all of you throw me down— this leaning wall, this tottering fence?

verses.textZh: 他们彼此商议， 务要把他从尊位上拉下来； 他们喜爱谎话； 他们口虽祝福，心却咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此商议， 务要把他从尊位上拉下来； 他们喜爱谎话； 他们口虽祝福，心却咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们彼此商议，专要从他的尊位上把他推下； 他们喜爱谎话，口虽祝福，心却咒诅。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Surely they intend to topple me from my lofty place; they take delight in lies. With their mouths they bless, but in their hearts they curse.
verses.textEnEsv: They only plan to thrust him down from his high position. They take pleasure in falsehood. They bless with their mouths, but inwardly they curse. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: They only consult to cast him down from his high position; They delight in lies; They bless with their mouth, But they curse inwardly. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: They plan to topple me from my high position. They delight in telling lies about me. They praise me to my face but curse me in their hearts. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: They have planned only to thrust him down from his high position; They delight in falsehood; They bless with their mouth, But inwardly they curse. Selah
verses.textEn: Surely they intend to topple me from my lofty place; they take delight in lies. With their mouths they bless, but in their hearts they curse.

verses.textZh: 唯独等候神，我的心才有安息； 因为我的盼望是从他而来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独等候神，我的心才有安息； 因为我的盼望是从他而来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心哪，你当默默无声，专等候神， 因为我的盼望是从他而来。
verses.textEnNiv: Yes, my soul, find rest in God; my hope comes from him.
verses.textEnEsv: For God alone, O my soul, wait in silence, for my hope is from him.
