verses.textEnNkjv: My soul, wait silently for God alone, For my expectation is from Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Let all that I am wait quietly before God, for my hope is in him.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, For my hope is from Him.
verses.textEn: Yes, my soul, find rest in God; my hope comes from him.

verses.textZh: 唯独他是我的盘石，我的拯救； 他是我的保障，我必不至动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独他是我的盘石，我的拯救； 他是我的保障，我必不至动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救； 他是我的高台，我必不动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will not be shaken.
verses.textEnEsv: He only is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I shall not be shaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: He only is my rock and my salvation; Heis my defense; I shall not be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress where I will not be shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: He alone is my rock and my salvation, My refuge; I will not be shaken.
verses.textEn: Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will not be shaken.

verses.textZh: 我的拯救，我的荣耀，都在于神； 我坚固的盘石，我的避难所，都在于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的拯救，我的荣耀，都在于神； 我坚固的盘石，我的避难所，都在于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的拯救、我的荣耀都在乎神； 我力量的磐石、我的避难所都在乎神。
verses.textEnNiv: My salvation and my honor depend on God ; he is my mighty rock, my refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: On God rests my salvation and my glory; my mighty rock, my refuge is God.
verses.textEnNkjv: In God is my salvation and my glory; The rock of my strength, And my refuge, is in God.
verses.textEnNlt: My victory and honor come from God alone. He is my refuge, a rock where no enemy can reach me.
verses.textEnNasb: My salvation and my glory rest on God; The rock of my strength, my refuge is in God.
verses.textEn: My salvation and my honor depend on God ; he is my mighty rock, my refuge.

verses.textZh: 众民哪！你们要常常倚靠他， 在他面前倾心吐意； 因为神是我们的避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民哪！你们要常常倚靠他， 在他面前倾心吐意； 因为神是我们的避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们众民当时时倚靠他， 在他面前倾心吐意；神是我们的避难所。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: Trust in him at all times, O people; pour out your heart before him; God is a refuge for us. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Trust in Him at all times, you people; Pour out your heart before Him; God is a refuge for us. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: O my people, trust in him at all times. Pour out your heart to him, for God is our refuge. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Trust in Him at all times, you people; Pour out your hearts before Him; God is a refuge for us. Selah
verses.textEn: Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge.

verses.textZh: 卑贱的人真是虚空， 高贵的人也是虚假， 放在天平上就必升起； 他们加在一起比空气还轻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 卑贱的人真是虚空， 高贵的人也是虚假， 放在天平上就必升起； 他们加在一起比空气还轻。
verses.textZhCuv: 下流人真是虚空； 上流人也是虚假； 放在天平里就必浮起； 他们一共比空气还轻。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely the lowborn are but a breath, the highborn are but a lie. If weighed on a balance, they are nothing; together they are only a breath.
verses.textEnEsv: Those of low estate are but a breath; those of high estate are a delusion; in the balances they go up; they are together lighter than a breath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely men of low degree are a vapor, Men of high degree are a lie; If they are weighed on the scales, They are altogether lighter than vapor.
verses.textEnNlt: Common people are as worthless as a puff of wind, and the powerful are not what they appear to be. If you weigh them on the scales, together they are lighter than a breath of air.
verses.textEnNasb: People of low standing are only breath, and people of rank are a lie; In the balances they go up. Together they are lighter than breath.
verses.textEn: Surely the lowborn are but a breath, the highborn are but a lie. If weighed on a balance, they are nothing; together they are only a breath.

verses.textZh: 不要倚靠藉强暴得来的财物， 也不要妄想倚靠抢夺回来的钱财； 如果财宝加增， 你的心也不要倚靠它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要倚靠藉强暴得来的财物， 也不要妄想倚靠抢夺回来的钱财； 如果财宝加增， 你的心也不要倚靠它。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要仗势欺人， 也不要因抢夺而骄傲； 若财宝加增，不要放在心上。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not trust in extortion or put vain hope in stolen goods; though your riches increase, do not set your heart on them.
verses.textEnEsv: Put no trust in extortion; set no vain hopes on robbery; if riches increase, set not your heart on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not trust in oppression, Nor vainly hope in robbery; If riches increase, Do not set your heart onthem.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t make your living by extortion or put your hope in stealing. And if your wealth increases, don’t make it the center of your life.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not trust in oppression, And do not vainly rely on robbery; If wealth increases, do not set your heart on it.
verses.textEn: Do not trust in extortion or put vain hope in stolen goods; though your riches increase, do not set your heart on them.

verses.textZh: 神说了一次， 我两次听过这事： 能力都属于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说了一次， 我两次听过这事： 能力都属于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说了一次、两次，我都听见： 就是能力都属乎神。
verses.textEnNiv: One thing God has spoken, two things I have heard: "Power belongs to you, God,
verses.textEnEsv: Once God has spoken; twice have I heard this: that power belongs to God,
verses.textEnNkjv: God has spoken once, Twice I have heard this: That power belongs to God.
verses.textEnNlt: God has spoken plainly, and I have heard it many times: Power, O God, belongs to you;
verses.textEnNasb: God has spoken once; Twice I have heard this: That power belongs to God;
verses.textEn: One thing God has spoken, two things I have heard: "Power belongs to you, God,

verses.textZh: 主啊！慈爱也属于你， 你必照各人所作的报应各人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！慈爱也属于你， 你必照各人所作的报应各人。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，慈爱也是属乎你， 因为你照着各人所行的报应他。
verses.textEnNiv: and with you, Lord, is unfailing love"; and, "You reward everyone according to what they have done."
verses.textEnEsv: and that to you, O Lord, belongs steadfast love. For you will render to a man according to his work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also to You, O Lord, belongs mercy; For You render to each one according to his work.
verses.textEnNlt: unfailing love, O Lord, is yours. Surely you repay all people according to what they have done.
verses.textEnNasb: And faithfulness is Yours, Lord, For You reward a person according to his work.
verses.textEn: and with you, Lord, is unfailing love"; and, "You reward everyone according to what they have done."

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，是他在犹大旷野时作的。神啊！你是我的神，我要切切寻求你； 在干旱、疲乏、无水之地， 我的心，我的身， 都渴想你，切慕你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，是他在犹大旷野时作的。神啊！你是我的神，我要切切寻求你； 在干旱、疲乏、无水之地， 我的心，我的身， 都渴想你，切慕你。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你是我的神， 我要切切地寻求你， 在干旱疲乏无水之地，我渴想你； 我的心切慕你。
verses.textEnNiv: You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek you; I thirst for you, my whole being longs for you, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, you are my God; earnestly I seek you; my soul thirsts for you; my flesh faints for you, as in a dry and weary land where there is no water.
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, You are my God; Early will I seek You; My soul thirsts for You; My flesh longs for You In a dry and thirsty land Where there is no water.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, you are my God; I earnestly search for you. My soul thirsts for you; my whole body longs for you in this parched and weary land where there is no water.
verses.textEnNasb: God, You are my God; I shall be watching for You; My soul thirsts for You, my flesh yearns for You, In a dry and exhausted land where there is no water.
verses.textEn: You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek you; I thirst for you, my whole being longs for you, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.

verses.textZh: 因此，我在圣所中瞻仰你， 为要见你的能力和荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我在圣所中瞻仰你， 为要见你的能力和荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在圣所中曾如此瞻仰你， 为要见你的能力和你的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: I have seen you in the sanctuary and beheld your power and your glory.
verses.textEnEsv: So I have looked upon you in the sanctuary, beholding your power and glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I have looked for You in the sanctuary, To see Your power and Your glory.
verses.textEnNlt: I have seen you in your sanctuary and gazed upon your power and glory.
verses.textEnNasb: So have I seen You in the sanctuary, To see Your power and glory.
verses.textEn: I have seen you in the sanctuary and beheld your power and your glory.

verses.textZh: 因你的慈爱比生命更好， 我的嘴唇要颂赞你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你的慈爱比生命更好， 我的嘴唇要颂赞你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你的慈爱比生命更好， 我的嘴唇要颂赞你。
verses.textEnNiv: Because your love is better than life, my lips will glorify you.
verses.textEnEsv: Because your steadfast love is better than life, my lips will praise you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because Your lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise You.
verses.textEnNlt: Your unfailing love is better than life itself; how I praise you!
verses.textEnNasb: Because Your favor is better than life, My lips will praise You.
verses.textEn: Because your love is better than life, my lips will glorify you.

verses.textZh: 我要一生称颂你， 我要奉你的名举手祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要一生称颂你， 我要奉你的名举手祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我还活的时候要这样称颂你； 我要奉你的名举手。
verses.textEnNiv: I will praise you as long as I live, and in your name I will lift up my hands.
verses.textEnEsv: So I will bless you as long as I live; in your name I will lift up my hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I will bless You while I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: I will praise you as long as I live, lifting up my hands to you in prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will bless You as long as I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.
verses.textEn: I will praise you as long as I live, and in your name I will lift up my hands.

verses.textZh: 我的心满足，就像饱享了骨髓肥油； 我要用欢乐的嘴唇赞美你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心满足，就像饱享了骨髓肥油； 我要用欢乐的嘴唇赞美你。
verses.textZhCuv: 在夜更的时候思想你； 我的心就像饱足了骨髓肥油， 我也要以欢乐的嘴唇赞美你。
verses.textEnNiv: I will be fully satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul will be satisfied as with fat and rich food, and my mouth will praise you with joyful lips,
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness, And my mouth shall praise You with joyful lips.
verses.textEnNlt: You satisfy me more than the richest feast. I will praise you with songs of joy.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul is satisfied as with fat and fatness, And my mouth offers praises with joyful lips.
verses.textEn: I will be fully satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.

verses.textZh: 我在床上记念你， 我整夜默想你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在床上记念你， 我整夜默想你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你曾帮助我， 我就在你翅膀的荫下欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night.
verses.textEnEsv: when I remember you upon my bed, and meditate on you in the watches of the night;
verses.textEnNkjv: When I remember You on my bed, I meditate on You in the night watches.
verses.textEnNlt: I lie awake thinking of you, meditating on you through the night.
verses.textEnNasb: When I remember You on my bed, I meditate on You in the night watches,
verses.textEn: On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night.

verses.textZh: 因为你帮助了我， 我要在你翅膀的荫下欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你帮助了我， 我要在你翅膀的荫下欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心紧紧地跟随你； 你的右手扶持我。
verses.textEnNiv: Because you are my help, I sing in the shadow of your wings.
verses.textEnEsv: for you have been my help, and in the shadow of your wings I will sing for joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because You have been my help, Therefore in the shadow of Your wings I will rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: Because you are my helper, I sing for joy in the shadow of your wings.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have been my help, And in the shadow of Your wings I sing for joy.
verses.textEn: Because you are my help, I sing in the shadow of your wings.

verses.textZh: 我心紧紧追随你； 你的右手扶持我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心紧紧追随你； 你的右手扶持我。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那些寻索要灭我命的人 必往地底下去；
verses.textEnNiv: I cling to you; your right hand upholds me.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul follows close behind You; Your right hand upholds me.
verses.textEnNlt: I cling to you; your strong right hand holds me securely.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul clings to You; Your right hand takes hold of me.
verses.textEn: I cling to you; your right hand upholds me.

verses.textZh: 但那些寻索我、要杀我的人， 必下到地的深处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那些寻索我、要杀我的人， 必下到地的深处。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必被刀剑所杀， 被野狗所吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who want to kill me will be destroyed; they will go down to the depths of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: But those who seek to destroy my life shall go down into the depths of the earth;
verses.textEnNkjv: But those who seek my life, to destroy it, Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: But those plotting to destroy me will come to ruin. They will go down into the depths of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: But those who seek my life to destroy it, Will go into the depths of the earth.
verses.textEn: Those who want to kill me will be destroyed; they will go down to the depths of the earth.

verses.textZh: 他们必交在刀剑之下， 成了野狗的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必交在刀剑之下， 成了野狗的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 但是王必因神欢喜。 凡指着他发誓的必要夸口， 因为说谎之人的口必被塞住。
verses.textEnNiv: They will be given over to the sword and become food for jackals.
verses.textEnEsv: they shall be given over to the power of the sword; they shall be a portion for jackals.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall fall by the sword; They shall be a portion for jackals.
verses.textEnNlt: They will die by the sword and become the food of jackals.
verses.textEnNasb: They will be turned over to the power of the sword; They will be a prey for foxes.
verses.textEn: They will be given over to the sword and become food for jackals.

verses.textZh: 但王必因神欢喜； 所有指着神起誓的，都必可以夸耀； 说谎的人的口却必被塞住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但王必因神欢喜； 所有指着神起誓的，都必可以夸耀； 说谎的人的口却必被塞住。
verses.textZhCuv: 但王必因神欢喜； 所有指着神起誓的，都必可以夸耀； 说谎的人的口却必被塞住。
verses.textEnNiv: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by God will glory in him, while the mouths of liars will be silenced.
verses.textEnEsv: But the king shall rejoice in God; all who swear by him shall exult, for the mouths of liars will be stopped.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the king shall rejoice in God; Everyone who swears by Him shall glory; But the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.textEnNlt: But the king will rejoice in God. All who swear to tell the truth will praise him, while liars will be silenced.
verses.textEnNasb: But the king will rejoice in God; Everyone who swears by Him will boast, For the mouths of those who speak lies will be stopped.
verses.textEn: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by God will glory in him, while the mouths of liars will be silenced.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。神啊！我哀诉的时候，求你垂听我的声音； 求你保护我的性命，脱离仇敌的恐吓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。神啊！我哀诉的时候，求你垂听我的声音； 求你保护我的性命，脱离仇敌的恐吓。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我哀叹的时候，求你听我的声音！ 求你保护我的性命，不受仇敌的惊恐！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear me, my God, as I voice my complaint; protect my life from the threat of the enemy.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear my voice, O God, in my meditation; Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, listen to my complaint. Protect my life from my enemies’ threats.
verses.textEnNasb: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint; Protect my life from dread of the enemy.
verses.textEn: Hear me, my God, as I voice my complaint; protect my life from the threat of the enemy.

verses.textZh: 求你把我隐藏，使我脱离恶人的阴谋， 脱离作孽的人的扰乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你把我隐藏，使我脱离恶人的阴谋， 脱离作孽的人的扰乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你把我隐藏， 使我脱离作恶之人的暗谋和作孽之人的扰乱。
verses.textEnNiv: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the plots of evildoers.
verses.textEnEsv: Hide me from the secret plots of the wicked, from the throng of evildoers,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hide me from the secret plots of the wicked, From the rebellion of the workers of iniquity,
verses.textEnNlt: Hide me from the plots of this evil mob, from this gang of wrongdoers.
verses.textEnNasb: Hide me from the secret discussion of evildoers, From the restlessness of the workers of injustice,
verses.textEn: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the plots of evildoers.

verses.textZh: 他们磨快自己的舌头，如同刀剑； 他们吐出恶毒的言语，好象利箭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们磨快自己的舌头，如同刀剑； 他们吐出恶毒的言语，好象利箭，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们磨舌如刀， 发出苦毒的言语，好像比准了的箭，
verses.textEnNiv: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim cruel words like deadly arrows.
verses.textEnEsv: who whet their tongues like swords, who aim bitter words like arrows,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who sharpen their tongue like a sword, And bend theirbowstoshoot their arrows—bitter words,
verses.textEnNlt: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows.
verses.textEnNasb: Who have sharpened their tongues like a sword. They aimed bitter speech as their arrows,
verses.textEn: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim cruel words like deadly arrows.

verses.textZh: 要在暗地里射杀完全的人； 他们忽然射杀他，毫不惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要在暗地里射杀完全的人； 他们忽然射杀他，毫不惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 要在暗地射完全人； 他们忽然射他，并不惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: They shoot from ambush at the innocent; they shoot suddenly, without fear.
verses.textEnEsv: shooting from ambush at the blameless, shooting at him suddenly and without fear.
verses.textEnNkjv: That they may shoot in secret at the blameless; Suddenly they shoot at him and do not fear.
verses.textEnNlt: They shoot from ambush at the innocent, attacking suddenly and fearlessly.
verses.textEnNasb: To shoot from concealment at the innocent; Suddenly they shoot at him, and do not fear.
verses.textEn: They shoot from ambush at the innocent; they shoot suddenly, without fear.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此鼓励，设下恶计， 商议暗设网罗，说： "谁能看见它们呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此鼓励，设下恶计， 商议暗设网罗，说： "谁能看见它们呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们彼此勉励设下恶计； 他们商量暗设网罗， 说：谁能看见？
verses.textEnNiv: They encourage each other in evil plans, they talk about hiding their snares; they say, "Who will see it ?"
verses.textEnEsv: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they talk of laying snares secretly, thinking, "Who can see them?"
verses.textEnNkjv: They encourage themselves in an evil matter; They talk of laying snares secretly; They say, "Who will see them?"
verses.textEnNlt: They encourage each other to do evil and plan how to set their traps in secret. "Who will ever notice?" they ask.
verses.textEnNasb: They make firm for themselves an evil purpose; They talk of setting snares secretly; They say, "Who can see them?"
verses.textEn: They encourage each other in evil plans, they talk about hiding their snares; they say, "Who will see it ?"

verses.textZh: 他们图谋奸恶，说： "我们设计了最精密的阴谋！" 人的意念和心思实在深不可测。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们图谋奸恶，说： "我们设计了最精密的阴谋！" 人的意念和心思实在深不可测。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们图谋奸恶， 说：我们是极力图谋的。 他们各人的意念心思是深的。
verses.textEnNiv: They plot injustice and say, "We have devised a perfect plan!" Surely the human mind and heart are cunning.
verses.textEnEsv: They search out injustice, saying, "We have accomplished a diligent search." For the inward mind and heart of a man are deep.
verses.textEnNkjv: They devise iniquities: "We have perfected a shrewd scheme." Both the inward thought and the heart of man are deep.
verses.textEnNlt: As they plot their crimes, they say, "We have devised the perfect plan!" Yes, the human heart and mind are cunning.
verses.textEnNasb: They devise injustices, saying, "We are ready with a well-conceived plot"; For the inward thought and the heart of a person are deep.
verses.textEn: They plot injustice and say, "We have devised a perfect plan!" Surely the human mind and heart are cunning.

verses.textZh: 但神要用箭射他们， 他们必忽然受伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但神要用箭射他们， 他们必忽然受伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 但神要射他们； 他们忽然被箭射伤。
verses.textEnNiv: But God will shoot them with his arrows; they will suddenly be struck down.
verses.textEnEsv: But God shoots his arrow at them; they are wounded suddenly.
verses.textEnNkjv: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; Suddenly they shall be wounded.
verses.textEnNlt: But God himself will shoot them with his arrows, suddenly striking them down.
verses.textEnNasb: But God will shoot an arrow at them; Suddenly they will be wounded.
verses.textEn: But God will shoot them with his arrows; they will suddenly be struck down.

verses.textZh: 他们各人反被自己的舌头所害，必然跌倒； 所有看见他们的，都必摇头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人反被自己的舌头所害，必然跌倒； 所有看见他们的，都必摇头。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必然绊跌，被自己的舌头所害； 凡看见他们的必都摇头。
verses.textEnNiv: He will turn their own tongues against them and bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.
verses.textEnEsv: They are brought to ruin, with their own tongues turned against them; all who see them will wag their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He will make them stumble over their own tongue; All who see them shall flee away.
verses.textEnNlt: Their own tongues will ruin them, and all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.
verses.textEnNasb: So they will make him stumble; Their own tongue is against them; All who see them will shake their heads.
verses.textEn: He will turn their own tongues against them and bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.

verses.textZh: 众人都要惧怕， 要传扬神的作为， 并且要思想他所作的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都要惧怕， 要传扬神的作为， 并且要思想他所作的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都要害怕， 要传扬神的工作， 并且明白他的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: All people will fear; they will proclaim the works of God and ponder what he has done.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all mankind fears; they tell what God has brought about and ponder what he has done.
verses.textEnNkjv: All men shall fear, And shall declare the work of God; For they shall wisely consider His doing.
verses.textEnNlt: Then everyone will be afraid; they will proclaim the mighty acts of God and realize all the amazing things he does.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all people will fear, And they will declare the work of God, And will consider what He has done.
verses.textEn: All people will fear; they will proclaim the works of God and ponder what he has done.

verses.textZh: 愿义人因耶和华欢喜，并且投靠他； 愿所有心里正直的人，都因他夸耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿义人因耶和华欢喜，并且投靠他； 愿所有心里正直的人，都因他夸耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人必因耶和华欢喜，并要投靠他； 凡心里正直的人都要夸口。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous will rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in him; all the upright in heart will glory in him!
verses.textEnEsv: Let the righteous one rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in him! Let all the upright in heart exult!
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and trust in Him. And all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly will rejoice in the Lord and find shelter in him. And those who do what is right will praise him.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous person will be glad in the Lord and take refuge in Him; And all the upright in heart will boast.
verses.textEn: The righteous will rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in him; all the upright in heart will glory in him!

verses.textZh: 歌一首，大卫的诗，交给诗班长。神啊！在锡安城里， 人们都在等候要颂赞你， 他们也要向你偿还所许的愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌一首，大卫的诗，交给诗班长。神啊！在锡安城里， 人们都在等候要颂赞你， 他们也要向你偿还所许的愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，锡安的人都等候赞美你； 所许的愿也要向你偿还。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise awaits you, our God, in Zion; to you our vows will be fulfilled.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise is due to you, O God, in Zion, and to you shall vows be performed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise is awaiting You, O God, in Zion; And to You the vow shall be performed.
verses.textEnNlt: What mighty praise, O God, belongs to you in Zion. We will fulfill our vows to you,
verses.textEnNasb: There will be silence before You, and praise in Zion, God, And the vow will be fulfilled for You.
verses.textEn: Praise awaits you, our God, in Zion; to you our vows will be fulfilled.

verses.textZh: 听祷告的主啊！ 所有的人都要到你面前来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听祷告的主啊！ 所有的人都要到你面前来。
verses.textZhCuv: 听祷告的主啊， 凡有血气的都要来就你。
verses.textEnNiv: You who answer prayer, to you all people will come.
verses.textEnEsv: O you who hear prayer, to you shall all flesh come.
verses.textEnNkjv: O You who hear prayer, To You all flesh will come.
verses.textEnNlt: for you answer our prayers. All of us must come to you.
verses.textEnNasb: You who hear prayer, To You all mankind comes.
verses.textEn: You who answer prayer, to you all people will come.

verses.textZh: 罪孽胜过了我， 但我们的过犯，你都必赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罪孽胜过了我， 但我们的过犯，你都必赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 罪孽胜了我； 至于我们的过犯，你都要赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: When we were overwhelmed by sins, you forgave our transgressions.
verses.textEnEsv: When iniquities prevail against me, you atone for our transgressions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Iniquities prevail against me; Asfor our transgressions, You will provide atonement for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Though we are overwhelmed by our sins, you forgive them all.
verses.textEnNasb: Wrongdoings prevail against me; As for our offenses, You forgive them.
verses.textEn: When we were overwhelmed by sins, you forgave our transgressions.

verses.textZh: 你所拣选，使他亲近你， 可以住在你院子中的人，是有福的！ 愿我们因你的居所，就是你圣殿的美福心满意足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所拣选，使他亲近你， 可以住在你院子中的人，是有福的！ 愿我们因你的居所，就是你圣殿的美福心满意足。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所拣选、使他亲近你、住在你院中的， 这人便为有福！ 我们必因你居所、你圣殿的美福知足了。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the one you choose and bring near, to dwell in your courts! We shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house, the holiness of your temple!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed istheman You choose, And cause to approach You, That he may dwell in Your courts. We shall be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, Of Your holy temple.
verses.textEnNlt: What joy for those you choose to bring near, those who live in your holy courts. What festivities await us inside your holy Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the one You choose and allow to approach You; He will dwell in Your courtyards. We will be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, Your holy temple.
verses.textEn: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.

verses.textZh: 拯救我们的神啊！ 你必充满威严，按公义应允我们； 你本是一切地极和海洋远处的人所倚靠的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拯救我们的神啊！ 你必充满威严，按公义应允我们； 你本是一切地极和海洋远处的人所倚靠的。
verses.textZhCuv: 拯救我们的神啊，你必以威严秉公义应允我们； 你本是一切地极和海上远处的人所倚靠的。
verses.textEnNiv: You answer us with awesome and righteous deeds, God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,
verses.textEnEsv: By awesome deeds you answer us with righteousness, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas;
verses.textEnNkjv: By awesome deeds in righteousness You will answer us, O God of our salvation, Youwhoare the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of the far-off seas;
verses.textEnNlt: You faithfully answer our prayers with awesome deeds, O God our savior. You are the hope of everyone on earth, even those who sail on distant seas.
verses.textEnNasb: By awesome deeds You answer us in righteousness, God of our salvation, You who are the trust of all the ends of the earth and the farthest sea;
verses.textEn: You answer us with awesome and righteous deeds, God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,

verses.textZh: 你以大能束腰， 用自己的力量坚立众山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你以大能束腰， 用自己的力量坚立众山。
verses.textZhCuv: 他既以大能束腰， 就用力量安定诸山，
verses.textEnNiv: who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,
verses.textEnEsv: the one who by his strength established the mountains, being girded with might;
verses.textEnNkjv: Who established the mountains by His strength, Being clothed with power;
verses.textEnNlt: You formed the mountains by your power and armed yourself with mighty strength.
verses.textEnNasb: Who establishes the mountains by His strength, Who is encircled with might;
verses.textEn: who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,

verses.textZh: 你平息了海洋的洪涛和澎湃的巨浪， 以及万民的喧哗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你平息了海洋的洪涛和澎湃的巨浪， 以及万民的喧哗。
verses.textZhCuv: 使诸海的响声和其中波浪的响声， 并万民的喧哗，都平静了。
verses.textEnNiv: who stilled the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, the tumult of the peoples,
verses.textEnNkjv: You who still the noise of the seas, The noise of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: You quieted the raging oceans with their pounding waves and silenced the shouting of the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: Who stills the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the turmoil of the nations.
verses.textEn: who stilled the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

verses.textZh: 因此，住在地极的人都因你的神迹起了敬畏的心； 你使日出和日落之地的人都欢呼歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，住在地极的人都因你的神迹起了敬畏的心； 你使日出和日落之地的人都欢呼歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在地极的人因你的神迹惧怕； 你使日出日落之地都欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole earth is filled with awe at your wonders; where morning dawns, where evening fades, you call forth songs of joy.
verses.textEnEsv: so that those who dwell at the ends of the earth are in awe at your signs. You make the going out of the morning and the evening to shout for joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also who dwell in the farthest parts are afraid of Your signs; You make the outgoings of the morning and evening rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who live at the ends of the earth stand in awe of your wonders. From where the sun rises to where it sets, you inspire shouts of joy.
verses.textEnNasb: They who dwell at the ends of the earth stand in awe of Your signs; You make the sunrise and the sunset shout for joy.
verses.textEn: The whole earth is filled with awe at your wonders; where morning dawns, where evening fades, you call forth songs of joy.

verses.textZh: 你眷顾大地，普降甘霖， 使地甚为肥沃；神的河满了水， 好为人预备五谷； 你就这样预备了大地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你眷顾大地，普降甘霖， 使地甚为肥沃；神的河满了水， 好为人预备五谷； 你就这样预备了大地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你眷顾地，降下透雨， 使地大得肥美。神的河满了水； 你这样浇灌了地， 好为人预备五谷。
verses.textEnNiv: You care for the land and water it; you enrich it abundantly. The streams of God are filled with water to provide the people with grain, for so you have ordained it.
verses.textEnEsv: You visit the earth and water it; you greatly enrich it; the river of God is full of water; you provide their grain, for so you have prepared it.
verses.textEnNkjv: You visit the earth and water it, You greatly enrich it; The river of God is full of water; You provide their grain, For so You have prepared it.
verses.textEnNlt: You take care of the earth and water it, making it rich and fertile. The river of God has plenty of water; it provides a bountiful harvest of grain, for you have ordered it so.
verses.textEnNasb: You visit the earth and cause it to overflow; You greatly enrich it; The stream of God is full of water; You prepare their grain, for so You prepare the earth.
verses.textEn: You care for the land and water it; you enrich it abundantly. The streams of God are filled with water to provide the people with grain, for so you have ordained it.

verses.textZh: 你灌溉地的犁沟，润平犁脊， 又降雨露使地松软， 并且赐福给地上所生长的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你灌溉地的犁沟，润平犁脊， 又降雨露使地松软， 并且赐福给地上所生长的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你浇透地的犁沟，润平犁脊， 降甘霖，使地软和； 其中发长的，蒙你赐福。
verses.textEnNiv: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.
verses.textEnEsv: You water its furrows abundantly, settling its ridges, softening it with showers, and blessing its growth.
verses.textEnNkjv: You water its ridges abundantly, You settle its furrows; You make it soft with showers, You bless its growth.
verses.textEnNlt: You drench the plowed ground with rain, melting the clods and leveling the ridges. You soften the earth with showers and bless its abundant crops.
verses.textEnNasb: You water its furrows abundantly, You settle its ridges, You soften it with showers, You bless its growth.
verses.textEn: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.

verses.textZh: 你以恩典为年岁的冠冕， 你的路径都滴下脂油，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你以恩典为年岁的冠冕， 你的路径都滴下脂油，
verses.textZhCuv: 你以恩典为年岁的冠冕； 你的路径都滴下脂油，
verses.textEnNiv: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.
verses.textEnEsv: You crown the year with your bounty; your wagon tracks overflow with abundance.
verses.textEnNkjv: You crown the year with Your goodness, And Your paths drip with abundance.
verses.textEnNlt: You crown the year with a bountiful harvest; even the hard pathways overflow with abundance.
verses.textEnNasb: You have crowned the year with Your goodness, And Your paths drip with fatness.
verses.textEn: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.

verses.textZh: 滴在旷野的草场上； 群山以欢乐束腰，
verses.textZhCnvs: 滴在旷野的草场上； 群山以欢乐束腰，
verses.textZhCuv: 滴在旷野的草场上。 小山以欢乐束腰；
verses.textEnNiv: The grasslands of the wilderness overflow; the hills are clothed with gladness.
verses.textEnEsv: The pastures of the wilderness overflow, the hills gird themselves with joy,
verses.textEnNkjv: They drop on the pastures of the wilderness, And the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.textEnNlt: The grasslands of the wilderness become a lush pasture, and the hillsides blossom with joy.
verses.textEnNasb: The pastures of the wilderness drip, And the hills encircle themselves with rejoicing.
verses.textEn: The grasslands of the wilderness overflow; the hills are clothed with gladness.

verses.textZh: 牧场以羊群为衣， 山谷都盖满了五谷； 这一切都欢呼歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牧场以羊群为衣， 山谷都盖满了五谷； 这一切都欢呼歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 草场以羊群为衣； 谷中也长满了五谷。 这一切都欢呼歌唱。
verses.textEnNiv: The meadows are covered with flocks and the valleys are mantled with grain; they shout for joy and sing.
verses.textEnEsv: the meadows clothe themselves with flocks, the valleys deck themselves with grain, they shout and sing together for joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: The pastures are clothed with flocks; The valleys also are covered with grain; They shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.textEnNlt: The meadows are clothed with flocks of sheep, and the valleys are carpeted with grain. They all shout and sing for joy!
verses.textEnNasb: The meadows are clothed with flocks And the valleys are covered with grain; They shout for joy, yes, they sing.
verses.textEn: The meadows are covered with flocks and the valleys are mantled with grain; they shout for joy and sing.

verses.textZh: 诗歌一首，交给诗班长。 全地的居民哪！ 你们应当向神欢呼 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诗歌一首，交给诗班长。 全地的居民哪！ 你们应当向神欢呼 。
verses.textZhCuv: 全地都当向神欢呼！
verses.textEnNiv: Shout for joy to God, all the earth!
verses.textEnEsv: Shout for joy to God, all the earth;
verses.textEnNkjv: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
verses.textEnNlt: Shout joyful praises to God, all the earth!
verses.textEnNasb: Shout joyfully to God, all the earth;
verses.textEn: Shout for joy to God, all the earth!

verses.textZh: 你们要歌颂他名的荣耀， 把荣耀和赞美都归给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要歌颂他名的荣耀， 把荣耀和赞美都归给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌颂他名的荣耀！ 用赞美的言语将他的荣耀发明！
verses.textEnNiv: Sing the glory of his name; make his praise glorious.
verses.textEnEsv: sing the glory of his name; give to him glorious praise!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing out the honor of His name; Make His praise glorious.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing about the glory of his name! Tell the world how glorious he is.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing the glory of His name; Make His praise glorious.
verses.textEn: Sing the glory of his name; make his praise glorious.

verses.textZh: 要对神说："你的作为多么可畏！ 因你伟大的能力，你的仇敌必向你假意归顺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要对神说："你的作为多么可畏！ 因你伟大的能力，你的仇敌必向你假意归顺。
verses.textZhCuv: 当对神说：你的作为何等可畏！ 因你的大能，仇敌要投降你。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies cringe before you.
verses.textEnEsv: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies come cringing to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to God, "How awesome are Your works! Through the greatness of Your power Your enemies shall submit themselves to You.
verses.textEnNlt: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! Your enemies cringe before your mighty power.
verses.textEnNasb: Say to God, "How awesome are Your works! Because of the greatness of Your power Your enemies will pretend to obey You.
verses.textEn: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies cringe before you.

verses.textZh: 全地的居民都必敬拜你， 向你歌颂， 歌颂你的名。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 全地的居民都必敬拜你， 向你歌颂， 歌颂你的名。"
verses.textZhCuv: 全地要敬拜你，歌颂你， 要歌颂你的名。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: All the earth bows down to you; they sing praise to you, they sing the praises of your name."
verses.textEnEsv: All the earth worships you and sings praises to you; they sing praises to your name." Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: All the earth shall worship You And sing praises to You; They shall sing praises to Your name." Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Everything on earth will worship you; they will sing your praises, shouting your name in glorious songs." Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: "All the earth will worship You, And will sing praises to You; They will sing praises to Your name." Selah
verses.textEn: All the earth bows down to you; they sing praise to you, they sing the praises of your name."

verses.textZh: 你们来看神的作为， 他向世人所作的事是可畏惧的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们来看神的作为， 他向世人所作的事是可畏惧的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们来看神所行的， 他向世人所做之事是可畏的。
verses.textEnNiv: Come and see what God has done, his awesome deeds for mankind!
verses.textEnEsv: Come and see what God has done: he is awesome in his deeds toward the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come and see the works of God; Heis awesome inHis doing toward the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: Come and see what our God has done, what awesome miracles he performs for people!
verses.textEnNasb: Come and see the works of God, Who is awesome in His deeds toward the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: Come and see what God has done, his awesome deeds for mankind!

verses.textZh: 他把海变为干地， 众人就步行过河， 我们要在那里因他欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把海变为干地， 众人就步行过河， 我们要在那里因他欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将海变成干地，众民步行过河； 我们在那里因他欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot— come, let us rejoice in him.
verses.textEnEsv: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the river on foot. There did we rejoice in him,
verses.textEnNkjv: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot. There we will rejoice in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He made a dry path through the Red Sea, and his people went across on foot. There we rejoiced in him.
verses.textEnNasb: He turned the sea into dry land; They passed through the river on foot; Let’s rejoice there, in Him!
verses.textEn: He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot— come, let us rejoice in him.

verses.textZh: 他以自己的权能永远统管万有， 他的眼睛鉴察万国， 悖逆的人不可自高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以自己的权能永远统管万有， 他的眼睛鉴察万国， 悖逆的人不可自高。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用权能治理万民，直到永远。 他的眼睛鉴察列邦； 悖逆的人不可自高。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: He rules forever by his power, his eyes watch the nations— let not the rebellious rise up against him.
verses.textEnEsv: who rules by his might forever, whose eyes keep watch on the nations— let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: He rules by His power forever; His eyes observe the nations; Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: For by his great power he rules forever. He watches every movement of the nations; let no rebel rise in defiance. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: He rules by His might forever; His eyes keep watch on the nations; The rebellious shall not exalt themselves! Selah
verses.textEn: He rules forever by his power, his eyes watch the nations— let not the rebellious rise up against him.

verses.textZh: 万民哪！你们要称颂我们的神， 宣扬赞美他的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万民哪！你们要称颂我们的神， 宣扬赞美他的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 万民哪，你们当称颂我们的神， 使人得听赞美他的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise our God, all peoples, let the sound of his praise be heard;
verses.textEnEsv: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of his praise be heard,
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, bless our God, you peoples! And make the voice of His praise to be heard,
verses.textEnNlt: Let the whole world bless our God and loudly sing his praises.
verses.textEnNasb: Bless our God, you peoples, And sound His praise abroad,
verses.textEn: Praise our God, all peoples, let the sound of his praise be heard;

verses.textZh: 他保全我们的性命， 不使我们的脚动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他保全我们的性命， 不使我们的脚动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我们的性命存活， 也不叫我们的脚摇动。
verses.textEnNiv: he has preserved our lives and kept our feet from slipping.
verses.textEnEsv: who has kept our soul among the living and has not let our feet slip.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who keeps our soul among the living, And does not allow our feet to be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: Our lives are in his hands, and he keeps our feet from stumbling.
verses.textEnNasb: Who keeps us in life, And does not allow our feet to slip.
verses.textEn: he has preserved our lives and kept our feet from slipping.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你试炼了我们， 熬炼了我们，如同熬炼银子一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你试炼了我们， 熬炼了我们，如同熬炼银子一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你曾试验我们， 熬炼我们，如熬炼银子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: For you, God, tested us; you refined us like silver.
verses.textEnEsv: For you, O God, have tested us; you have tried us as silver is tried.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us as silver is refined.
verses.textEnNlt: You have tested us, O God; you have purified us like silver.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have put us to the test, God; You have refined us as silver is refined.
verses.textEn: For you, God, tested us; you refined us like silver.

verses.textZh: 你使我们进入网罗， 把重担放在我们的背上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我们进入网罗， 把重担放在我们的背上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使我们进入网罗， 把重担放在我们的身上。
verses.textEnNiv: You brought us into prison and laid burdens on our backs.
verses.textEnEsv: You brought us into the net; you laid a crushing burden on our backs;
verses.textEnNkjv: You brought us into the net; You laid affliction on our backs.
verses.textEnNlt: You captured us in your net and laid the burden of slavery on our backs.
verses.textEnNasb: You brought us into the net; You laid an oppressive burden upon us.
verses.textEn: You brought us into prison and laid burdens on our backs.

verses.textZh: 你使人驾车轧我们的头， 我们经过水火， 你却把我们领到丰盛之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使人驾车轧我们的头， 我们经过水火， 你却把我们领到丰盛之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使人坐车轧我们的头； 我们经过水火， 你却使我们到丰富之地。
verses.textEnNiv: You let people ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.
verses.textEnEsv: you let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water; yet you have brought us out to a place of abundance.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have caused men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But You brought us out to rich fulfillment.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you put a leader over us. We went through fire and flood, but you brought us to a place of great abundance.
verses.textEnNasb: You made men ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water. Yet You brought us out into a place of abundance.
verses.textEn: You let people ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.

verses.textZh: 我要带着燔祭进你的殿， 我要向你还我的愿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要带着燔祭进你的殿， 我要向你还我的愿，
verses.textZhCuv: 我要用燔祭进你的殿， 向你还我的愿，
verses.textEnNiv: I will come to your temple with burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you—
verses.textEnEsv: I will come into your house with burnt offerings; I will perform my vows to you,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will go into Your house with burnt offerings; I will pay You my vows,
verses.textEnNlt: Now I come to your Temple with burnt offerings to fulfill the vows I made to you—
verses.textEnNasb: I shall come into Your house with burnt offerings; I shall pay You my vows,
verses.textEn: I will come to your temple with burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you—

verses.textZh: 就是在急难的时候， 我嘴唇所许的，我口里所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是在急难的时候， 我嘴唇所许的，我口里所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是在急难时我嘴唇所发的、 口中所许的。
verses.textEnNiv: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: that which my lips uttered and my mouth promised when I was in trouble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Which my lips have uttered And my mouth has spoken when I was in trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: yes, the sacred vows that I made when I was in deep trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: Which my lips uttered And my mouth spoke when I was in distress.
verses.textEn: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.

verses.textZh: 我要把肥美的牲畜作燔祭， 连同公绵羊的馨香祭献给你， 我并且要把公牛和公山羊献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把肥美的牲畜作燔祭， 连同公绵羊的馨香祭献给你， 我并且要把公牛和公山羊献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要把肥牛作燔祭， 将公羊的香祭献给你， 又把公牛和山羊献上。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats.
verses.textEnEsv: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fattened animals, with the smoke of the sacrifice of rams; I will make an offering of bulls and goats. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: I will offer You burnt sacrifices of fat animals, With the sweet aroma of rams; I will offer bulls with goats. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I am sacrificing burnt offerings to you— the best of my rams as a pleasing aroma, and a sacrifice of bulls and male goats. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: I shall offer to You burnt offerings of fat animals, With the smoke of rams; I shall make an offering of bulls with male goats. Selah
verses.textEn: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats.

verses.textZh: 所有敬畏神的人哪！ 你们都要来听， 我要述说他为我所行的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有敬畏神的人哪！ 你们都要来听， 我要述说他为我所行的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡敬畏神的人，你们都来听！ 我要述说他为我所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Come and hear, all you who fear God; let me tell you what he has done for me.
verses.textEnEsv: Come and hear, all you who fear God, and I will tell what he has done for my soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come and hear, all you who fear God, And I will declare what He has done for my soul.
verses.textEnNlt: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will tell you what he did for me.
verses.textEnNasb: Come and hear, all who fear God, And I will tell of what He has done for my soul.
verses.textEn: Come and hear, all you who fear God; let me tell you what he has done for me.

verses.textZh: 我曾用口向他呼求， 我曾用舌头颂赞他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾用口向他呼求， 我曾用舌头颂赞他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾用口求告他； 我的舌头也称他为高。
verses.textEnNiv: I cried out to him with my mouth; his praise was on my tongue.
verses.textEnEsv: I cried to him with my mouth, and high praise was on my tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: I cried to Him with my mouth, And He was extolled with my tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: For I cried out to him for help, praising him as I spoke.
verses.textEnNasb: I cried to Him with my mouth, And He was exalted with my tongue.
verses.textEn: I cried out to him with my mouth; his praise was on my tongue.

verses.textZh: 如果我心里偏向罪孽， 主必不听；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我心里偏向罪孽， 主必不听；
verses.textZhCuv: 我若心里注重罪孽， 主必不听。
verses.textEnNiv: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened;
verses.textEnEsv: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear.
verses.textEnNlt: If I had not confessed the sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
verses.textEnNasb: If I regard wickedness in my heart, The Lord will not hear;
verses.textEn: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened;

verses.textZh: 神却垂听了， 他留心听了我祷告的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神却垂听了， 他留心听了我祷告的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 但神实在听见了； 他侧耳听了我祷告的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: but God has surely listened and has heard my prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: But truly God has listened; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.textEnNkjv: But certainly God has heard me; He has attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.textEnNlt: But God did listen! He paid attention to my prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: But God has heard; He has given attention to the sound of my prayer.
verses.textEn: but God has surely listened and has heard my prayer.

verses.textZh: 神是应当称颂的， 他没有拒绝我的祷告， 也没有使他的慈爱离开我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神是应当称颂的， 他没有拒绝我的祷告， 也没有使他的慈爱离开我。
verses.textZhCuv: 神是应当称颂的！ 他并没有推却我的祷告， 也没有叫他的慈爱离开我。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld his love from me!
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be God, because he has not rejected my prayer or removed his steadfast love from me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be God, Who has not turned away my prayer, Nor His mercy from me!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise God, who did not ignore my prayer or withdraw his unfailing love from me.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be God, Who has not turned away my prayer Nor His favor from me.
verses.textEn: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld his love from me!

verses.textZh: 诗歌一首，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。 愿神恩待我们，赐福给我们， 愿他用脸光照我们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 诗歌一首，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。 愿神恩待我们，赐福给我们， 愿他用脸光照我们，
verses.textZhCuv: 愿神怜悯我们，赐福与我们， 用脸光照我们， （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face shine on us—
verses.textEnEsv: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face to shine upon us, Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: God be merciful to us and bless us, And cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
verses.textEnNlt: May God be merciful and bless us. May his face smile with favor on us. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: God be gracious to us and bless us, And cause His face to shine upon us— Selah
verses.textEn: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face shine on us—

verses.textZh: 好使全地得知你的道路， 万国得知你的救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使全地得知你的道路， 万国得知你的救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫世界得知你的道路， 万国得知你的救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: so that your ways may be known on earth, your salvation among all nations.
verses.textEnEsv: that your way may be known on earth, your saving power among all nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: That Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
verses.textEnNlt: May your ways be known throughout the earth, your saving power among people everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: That Your way may be known on the earth, Your salvation among all nations.
verses.textEn: so that your ways may be known on earth, your salvation among all nations.

verses.textZh: 神啊！愿众民都称谢你， 愿万民都称谢你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！愿众民都称谢你， 愿万民都称谢你。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，愿列邦称赞你！ 愿万民都称赞你！
verses.textEnNiv: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the peoples praise you, O God; let all the peoples praise you!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You.
verses.textEnNlt: May the nations praise you, O God. Yes, may all the nations praise you.
verses.textEnNasb: May the peoples praise You, God; May all the peoples praise You.
verses.textEn: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.

verses.textZh: 愿万族都快乐欢呼， 因为你按正直统管众民， 并引导地上的万族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿万族都快乐欢呼， 因为你按正直统管众民， 并引导地上的万族。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿万国都快乐欢呼； 因为你必按公正审判万民， 引导世上的万国。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you rule the peoples with equity and guide the nations of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you judge the peoples with equity and guide the nations upon earth. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, let the nations be glad and sing for joy! For You shall judge the people righteously, And govern the nations on earth. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Let the whole world sing for joy, because you govern the nations with justice and guide the people of the whole world. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: May the nations be glad and sing for joy; For You will judge the peoples with fairness And guide the nations on the earth. Selah
verses.textEn: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you rule the peoples with equity and guide the nations of the earth.

verses.textZh: 神啊！愿众民都称谢你， 愿万民都称谢你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！愿众民都称谢你， 愿万民都称谢你。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，愿列邦称赞你！ 愿万民都称赞你！
verses.textEnNiv: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the peoples praise you, O God; let all the peoples praise you!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You.
verses.textEnNlt: May the nations praise you, O God. Yes, may all the nations praise you.
verses.textEnNasb: May the peoples praise You, God; May all the peoples praise You.
verses.textEn: May the peoples praise you, God; may all the peoples praise you.

verses.textZh: 地生出土产；神，就是我们的神，要赐福给我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地生出土产；神，就是我们的神，要赐福给我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 地已经出了土产；神－就是我们的神要赐福与我们。
verses.textEnNiv: The land yields its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
verses.textEnEsv: The earth has yielded its increase; God, our God, shall bless us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the earth shall yield her increase; God, our own God, shall bless us.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the earth will yield its harvests, and God, our God, will richly bless us.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth has yielded its produce; God, our God, blesses us.
verses.textEn: The land yields its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.

verses.textZh: 神要赐福给我们， 全地都要敬畏他。 歌一首，大卫的诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神要赐福给我们， 全地都要敬畏他。 歌一首，大卫的诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCuv: 神要赐福与我们； 地的四极都要敬畏他！
verses.textEnNiv: May God bless us still, so that all the ends of the earth will fear him.
verses.textEnEsv: God shall bless us; let all the ends of the earth fear him!
verses.textEnNkjv: God shall bless us, And all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, God will bless us, and people all over the world will fear him.
verses.textEnNasb: God blesses us, So that all the ends of the earth may fear Him.
verses.textEn: May God bless us still, so that all the ends of the earth will fear him.

verses.textZh: 愿神兴起，愿他的仇敌四散； 愿恨恶他的人从他面前逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿神兴起，愿他的仇敌四散； 愿恨恶他的人从他面前逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿神兴起，使他的仇敌四散， 叫那恨他的人从他面前逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: May God arise, may his enemies be scattered; may his foes flee before him.
verses.textEnEsv: God shall arise, his enemies shall be scattered; and those who hate him shall flee before him!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let God arise, Let His enemies be scattered; Let those also who hate Him flee before Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Rise up, O God, and scatter your enemies. Let those who hate God run for their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: May God arise, may His enemies be scattered, And may those who hate Him flee from His presence.
verses.textEn: May God arise, may his enemies be scattered; may his foes flee before him.

verses.textZh: 愿你把他们赶散，如同烟被风吹散一样； 愿恶人在神面前灭亡， 好象蜡在火前熔化。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你把他们赶散，如同烟被风吹散一样； 愿恶人在神面前灭亡， 好象蜡在火前熔化。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们被驱逐，如烟被风吹散； 恶人见神之面而消灭，如蜡被火熔化。
verses.textEnNiv: May you blow them away like smoke— as wax melts before the fire, may the wicked perish before God.
verses.textEnEsv: As smoke is driven away, so you shall drive them away; as wax melts before fire, so the wicked shall perish before God!
verses.textEnNkjv: As smoke is driven away, So drive them away; As wax melts before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Blow them away like smoke. Melt them like wax in a fire. Let the wicked perish in the presence of God.
verses.textEnNasb: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away; As wax melts before a fire, So the wicked will perish before God.
verses.textEn: May you blow them away like smoke— as wax melts before the fire, may the wicked perish before God.

verses.textZh: 但愿义人在神面前欢喜快乐； 愿他们高兴快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿义人在神面前欢喜快乐； 愿他们高兴快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有义人必然欢喜， 在神面前高兴快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: But may the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; may they be happy and joyful.
verses.textEnEsv: But the righteous shall be glad; they shall exult before God; they shall be jubilant with joy!
verses.textEnNkjv: But let the righteous be glad; Let them rejoice before God; Yes, let them rejoice exceedingly.
verses.textEnNlt: But let the godly rejoice. Let them be glad in God’s presence. Let them be filled with joy.
verses.textEnNasb: But the righteous will be joyful; they will rejoice before God; Yes, they will rejoice with gladness.
verses.textEn: But may the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; may they be happy and joyful.

verses.textZh: 你们要向神歌唱，歌颂他的名； 为那乘车经过旷野的预备道路 ； 他的名是耶和华， 你们要在他面前欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要向神歌唱，歌颂他的名； 为那乘车经过旷野的预备道路 ； 他的名是耶和华， 你们要在他面前欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当向神唱诗，歌颂他的名； 为那坐车行过旷野的修平大路。 他的名是耶和华， 要在他面前欢乐！
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to God, sing in praise of his name, extol him who rides on the clouds ; rejoice before him—his name is the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Sing to God, sing praises to his name; lift up a song to him who rides through the deserts; his name is the Lord ; exult before him!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to God, sing praises to His name; Extol Him who rides on the clouds, By His name Yah, And rejoice before Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing praises to God and to his name! Sing loud praises to him who rides the clouds. His name is the Lord — rejoice in his presence!
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to God, sing praises to His name; Exalt Him who rides through the deserts, Whose name is the Lord, and be jubilant before Him.
verses.textEn: Sing to God, sing in praise of his name, extol him who rides on the clouds ; rejoice before him—his name is the Lord .

verses.textZh: 神在他的圣居所， 作孤儿的父亲，作寡妇的伸冤者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在他的圣居所， 作孤儿的父亲，作寡妇的伸冤者。
verses.textZhCuv: 神在他的圣所作孤儿的父， 作寡妇的伸冤者。
verses.textEnNiv: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling.
verses.textEnEsv: Father of the fatherless and protector of widows is God in his holy habitation.
verses.textEnNkjv: A father of the fatherless, a defender of widows, Is God in His holy habitation.
verses.textEnNlt: Father to the fatherless, defender of widows— this is God, whose dwelling is holy.
verses.textEnNasb: A father of the fatherless and a judge for the widows, Is God in His holy dwelling.
verses.textEn: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling.

verses.textZh: 神使孤独的有家可居住； 领被囚的出来，到丰盛之处； 唯有悖逆的住在干旱之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神使孤独的有家可居住； 领被囚的出来，到丰盛之处； 唯有悖逆的住在干旱之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 神叫孤独的有家， 使被囚的出来享福； 惟有悖逆的住在干燥之地。
verses.textEnNiv: God sets the lonely in families, he leads out the prisoners with singing; but the rebellious live in a sun-scorched land.
verses.textEnEsv: God settles the solitary in a home; he leads out the prisoners to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a parched land.
verses.textEnNkjv: God sets the solitary in families; He brings out those who are bound into prosperity; But the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verses.textEnNlt: God places the lonely in families; he sets the prisoners free and gives them joy. But he makes the rebellious live in a sun-scorched land.
verses.textEnNasb: God makes a home for the lonely; He leads out the prisoners into prosperity, Only the rebellious live in parched lands.
verses.textEn: God sets the lonely in families, he leads out the prisoners with singing; but the rebellious live in a sun-scorched land.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你领着你的子民出来， 走过旷野的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你领着你的子民出来， 走过旷野的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你曾在你百姓前头出来， 在旷野行走。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: When you, God, went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness,
verses.textEnEsv: O God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness, Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, when You went out before Your people, When You marched through the wilderness, Selah
verses.textEnNlt: O God, when you led your people out from Egypt, when you marched through the dry wasteland, Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: God, when You went forth before Your people, When You marched through the desert, Selah
verses.textEn: When you, God, went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness,

verses.textZh: 地就震动， 在你面前天也落下雨来； 这西奈山在神面前， 就是在以色列的神面前，也要震动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地就震动， 在你面前天也落下雨来； 这西奈山在神面前， 就是在以色列的神面前，也要震动。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，地见神的面而震动，天也落雨； 西奈山见以色列神的面也震动。
verses.textEnNiv: the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: the earth quaked, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth shook; The heavens also dropped rain at the presence of God; Sinai itself wasmoved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: the earth trembled, and the heavens poured down rain before you, the God of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth quaked; The heavens also dropped rain at the presence of God; Sinai itself quaked at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你降下大雨， 使你贫瘠的产业得到滋润。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你降下大雨， 使你贫瘠的产业得到滋润。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你降下大雨； 你产业以色列疲乏的时候，你使他坚固。
verses.textEnNiv: You gave abundant showers, O God; you refreshed your weary inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: Rain in abundance, O God, you shed abroad; you restored your inheritance as it languished;
verses.textEnNkjv: You, O God, sent a plentiful rain, Whereby You confirmed Your inheritance, When it was weary.
verses.textEnNlt: You sent abundant rain, O God, to refresh the weary land.
verses.textEnNasb: You made plentiful rain fall, God; You confirmed Your inheritance when it was parched.
verses.textEn: You gave abundant showers, O God; you refreshed your weary inheritance.

verses.textZh: 你的子民住在其中；神啊，你满有恩慈，为贫苦的人预备了一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的子民住在其中；神啊，你满有恩慈，为贫苦的人预备了一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的会众住在其中；神啊，你的恩惠是为困苦人预备的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your people settled in it, and from your bounty, God, you provided for the poor.
verses.textEnEsv: your flock found a dwelling in it; in your goodness, O God, you provided for the needy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your congregation dwelt in it; You, O God, provided from Your goodness for the poor.
verses.textEnNlt: There your people finally settled, and with a bountiful harvest, O God, you provided for your needy people.
verses.textEnNasb: Your creatures settled in it; In Your kindness You provided for the poor, God.
verses.textEn: Your people settled in it, and from your bounty, God, you provided for the poor.

verses.textZh: 主发出命令， 传扬好信息的妇女就成了一大群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主发出命令， 传扬好信息的妇女就成了一大群。
verses.textZhCuv: 主发命令， 传好信息的妇女成了大群。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord announces the word, and the women who proclaim it are a mighty throng:
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord gives the word; the women who announce the news are a great host:
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord gave the word; Great was the company of those who proclaimed it:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gives the word, and a great army brings the good news.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord gives the command; The women who proclaim good news are a great army:
verses.textEn: The Lord announces the word, and the women who proclaim it are a mighty throng:

verses.textZh: "带领大军的君王都逃跑了，逃跑了； 住在家中的妇女分得了战利品。
verses.textZhCnvs: "带领大军的君王都逃跑了，逃跑了； 住在家中的妇女分得了战利品。
verses.textZhCuv: 统兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了； 在家等候的妇女分受所夺的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Kings and armies flee in haste; the women at home divide the plunder.
verses.textEnEsv: "The kings of the armies—they flee, they flee!" The women at home divide the spoil—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Kings of armies flee, they flee, And she who remains at home divides the spoil.
verses.textEnNlt: Enemy kings and their armies flee, while the women of Israel divide the plunder.
verses.textEnNasb: "Kings of armies flee, they flee, And she who remains at home will divide the spoils!"
verses.textEn: "Kings and armies flee in haste; the women at home divide the plunder.

verses.textZh: 你们躺卧在羊圈中， 如同鸽子的翅膀镀上白银， 羽毛镀上黄金。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们躺卧在羊圈中， 如同鸽子的翅膀镀上白银， 羽毛镀上黄金。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们安卧在羊圈的时候， 好像鸽子的翅膀镀白银，翎毛镀黄金一般。
verses.textEnNiv: Even while you sleep among the sheep pens, the wings of my dove are sheathed with silver, its feathers with shining gold."
verses.textEnEsv: though you men lie among the sheepfolds— the wings of a dove covered with silver, its pinions with shimmering gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, Youwillbe like the wings of a dove covered with silver, And her feathers with yellow gold."
verses.textEnNlt: Even those who lived among the sheepfolds found treasures— doves with wings of silver and feathers of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: When you lie down among the sheepfolds, You are like the wings of a dove covered with silver, And its pinions with glistening gold.
verses.textEn: Even while you sleep among the sheep pens, the wings of my dove are sheathed with silver, its feathers with shining gold."

verses.textZh: 全能者赶散境内列王的时候， 就像撒们山上下大雪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全能者赶散境内列王的时候， 就像撒们山上下大雪。
verses.textZhCuv: 全能者在境内赶散列王的时候， 势如飘雪在撒们。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like snow fallen on Mount Zalmon.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Almighty scatters kings there, let snow fall on Zalmon.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, It was white as snow in Zalmon.
verses.textEnNlt: The Almighty scattered the enemy kings like a blowing snowstorm on Mount Zalmon.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Almighty scattered the kings there, It was snowing in Zalmon.
verses.textEn: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like snow fallen on Mount Zalmon.

verses.textZh: 巴珊山是神的山 ； 巴珊山是多峰多岭的山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴珊山是神的山 ； 巴珊山是多峰多岭的山。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴珊山是神的山； 巴珊山是多峰多岭的山。
verses.textEnNiv: Mount Bashan, majestic mountain, Mount Bashan, rugged mountain,
verses.textEnEsv: O mountain of God, mountain of Bashan; O many-peaked mountain, mountain of Bashan!
verses.textEnNkjv: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A mountain ofmany peaks is the mountain of Bashan.
verses.textEnNlt: The mountains of Bashan are majestic, with many peaks stretching high into the sky.
verses.textEnNasb: The mountain of Bashan is a mountain of God; The mountain of Bashan is a mountain of many peaks.
verses.textEn: Mount Bashan, majestic mountain, Mount Bashan, rugged mountain,

verses.textZh: 多峰多岭的山哪！ 你们为甚么敌视神所喜悦居住的山呢？ 耶和华必住在那里，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 多峰多岭的山哪！ 你们为甚么敌视神所喜悦居住的山呢？ 耶和华必住在那里，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们多峰多岭的山哪， 为何斜看神所愿居住的山？ 耶和华必住这山，直到永远！
verses.textEnNiv: why gaze in envy, you rugged mountain, at the mountain where God chooses to reign, where the Lord himself will dwell forever?
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you look with hatred, O many-peaked mountain, at the mount that God desired for his abode, yes, where the Lord will dwell forever?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do you fume with envy, you mountains of many peaks? Thisis the mountain which God desires to dwell in; Yes, the Lord will dwell init forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you look with envy, O rugged mountains, at Mount Zion, where God has chosen to live, where the Lord himself will live forever?
verses.textEnNasb: Why do you look with envy, you mountains of many peaks, At the mountain God has desired as His dwelling? Indeed, the Lord will dwell there forever.
verses.textEn: why gaze in envy, you rugged mountain, at the mountain where God chooses to reign, where the Lord himself will dwell forever?

verses.textZh: 神的车马千千万万； 主从西奈山来到他的圣所中 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的车马千千万万； 主从西奈山来到他的圣所中 。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的车辇累万盈千； 主在其中，好像在西奈圣山一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai into his sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: The chariots of God are twice ten thousand, thousands upon thousands; the Lord is among them; Sinai is now in the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, Even thousands of thousands; The Lord is among them asin Sinai, in the Holy Place.
verses.textEnNlt: Surrounded by unnumbered thousands of chariots, the Lord came from Mount Sinai into his sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: The chariots of God are myriads, thousands upon thousands; The Lord is among them as at Sinai, in holiness.
verses.textEn: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai into his sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 你升到高天的时候， 掳了许多俘虏； 你在人间，就是在悖逆的人当中， 接受了礼物， 使耶和华神可以与他们同住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你升到高天的时候， 掳了许多俘虏； 你在人间，就是在悖逆的人当中， 接受了礼物， 使耶和华神可以与他们同住。
verses.textZhCuv: 你已经升上高天，掳掠仇敌； 你在人间，就是在悖逆的人间，受了供献， 叫耶和华神可以与他们同住。
verses.textEnNiv: When you ascended on high, you took many captives; you received gifts from people, even from the rebellious— that you, Lord God, might dwell there.
verses.textEnEsv: You ascended on high, leading a host of captives in your train and receiving gifts among men, even among the rebellious, that the Lord God may dwell there.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have ascended on high, You have led captivity captive; You have received gifts among men, Even from the rebellious, That the Lord God might dwell there.
verses.textEnNlt: When you ascended to the heights, you led a crowd of captives. You received gifts from the people, even from those who rebelled against you. Now the Lord God will live among us there.
verses.textEnNasb: You have ascended on high, You have led captive Your captives; You have received gifts among people, Even among the rebellious as well, that the Lord God may dwell there.
verses.textEn: When you ascended on high, you took many captives; you received gifts from people, even from the rebellious— that you, Lord God, might dwell there.

verses.textZh: 主，拯救我们的神，是应当称颂的， 他天天背负我们的重担。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主，拯救我们的神，是应当称颂的， 他天天背负我们的重担。
verses.textZhCuv: 天天背负我们重担的主， 就是拯救我们的神， 是应当称颂的！ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears us up; God is our salvation. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord, Who daily loads us withbenefits, The God of our salvation! Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord; praise God our savior! For each day he carries us in his arms. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, The God who is our salvation. Selah
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens.

verses.textZh: 我们的神是施行拯救的神； 人能逃脱死亡，是在于主耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的神是施行拯救的神； 人能逃脱死亡，是在于主耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 神是为我们施行诸般救恩的神； 人能脱离死亡是在乎主耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Our God is a God who saves; from the Sovereign Lord comes escape from death.
verses.textEnEsv: Our God is a God of salvation, and to God , the Lord, belong deliverances from death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our God is the God of salvation; And to God the Lord belong escapes from death.
verses.textEnNlt: Our God is a God who saves! The Sovereign Lord rescues us from death.
verses.textEnNasb: God is to us a God of salvation; And to God the Lord belong ways of escape from death.
verses.textEn: Our God is a God who saves; from the Sovereign Lord comes escape from death.

verses.textZh: 神必打碎仇敌的头颅， 就是打碎那些常行在罪中的人的脑袋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神必打碎仇敌的头颅， 就是打碎那些常行在罪中的人的脑袋。
verses.textZhCuv: 但神要打破他仇敌的头， 就是那常犯罪之人的发顶。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely God will crush the heads of his enemies, the hairy crowns of those who go on in their sins.
verses.textEnEsv: But God will strike the heads of his enemies, the hairy crown of him who walks in his guilty ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: But God will wound the head of His enemies, The hairy scalp of the one who still goes on in his trespasses.
verses.textEnNlt: But God will smash the heads of his enemies, crushing the skulls of those who love their guilty ways.
verses.textEnNasb: God certainly will shatter the heads of His enemies, The hairy head of one who goes about in his guilt.
verses.textEn: Surely God will crush the heads of his enemies, the hairy crowns of those who go on in their sins.

verses.textZh: 主说："我必使他们从巴珊回来， 使他们从海的深处回来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 主说："我必使他们从巴珊回来， 使他们从海的深处回来；
verses.textZhCuv: 主说：我要使众民从巴珊而归， 使他们从深海而回，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord says, "I will bring them from Bashan; I will bring them from the depths of the sea,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said, "I will bring them back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord said, "I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "I will bring my enemies down from Bashan; I will bring them up from the depths of the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said, "I will bring them back from Bashan. I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,
verses.textEn: The Lord says, "I will bring them from Bashan; I will bring them from the depths of the sea,

verses.textZh: 好使你在他们的血中洗自己的脚 ，使你的狗的舌头也有分舔仇敌的血。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使你在他们的血中洗自己的脚 ，使你的狗的舌头也有分舔仇敌的血。"
verses.textZhCuv: 使你打碎仇敌，你的脚踹在血中， 使你狗的舌头从其中得分。
verses.textEnNiv: that your feet may wade in the blood of your foes, while the tongues of your dogs have their share."
verses.textEnEsv: that you may strike your feet in their blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from the foe."
verses.textEnNkjv: That your foot may crush them in blood, And the tongues of your dogs mayhave their portion from your enemies."
verses.textEnNlt: You, my people, will wash your feet in their blood, and even your dogs will get their share!"
verses.textEnNasb: So that your foot may shatter them in blood, And the tongue of your dogs may have its portion from your enemies."
verses.textEn: that your feet may wade in the blood of your foes, while the tongues of your dogs have their share."

verses.textZh: 神啊！人人都看见你的巡行队伍， 看见我的神、我的君王的巡行队伍，进入圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！人人都看见你的巡行队伍， 看见我的神、我的君王的巡行队伍，进入圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你是我的神，我的王； 人已经看见你行走，进入圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: Your procession, God, has come into view, the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: Your procession is seen, O God, the procession of my God, my King, into the sanctuary—
verses.textEnNkjv: They have seen Your procession, O God, The procession of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: Your procession has come into view, O God— the procession of my God and King as he goes into the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: They have seen Your procession, God, The procession of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: Your procession, God, has come into view, the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 歌唱的在前头行，作乐的走在后面， 中间还有击鼓的少女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌唱的在前头行，作乐的走在后面， 中间还有击鼓的少女。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌唱的行在前，作乐的随在后， 都在击鼓的童女中间。
verses.textEnNiv: In front are the singers, after them the musicians; with them are the young women playing the timbrels.
verses.textEnEsv: the singers in front, the musicians last, between them virgins playing tambourines:
verses.textEnNkjv: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; Among themwere the maidens playing timbrels.
verses.textEnNlt: Singers are in front, musicians behind; between them are young women playing tambourines.
verses.textEnNasb: The singers went on, the musicians after them, In the midst of the young women beating tambourines.
verses.textEn: In front are the singers, after them the musicians; with them are the young women playing the timbrels.

verses.textZh: 你们要在大会中称颂神， 以色列的子孙 啊！你们要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在大会中称颂神， 以色列的子孙 啊！你们要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 从以色列源头而来的， 当在各会中称颂主神！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise God in the great congregation; praise the Lord in the assembly of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "Bless God in the great congregation, the Lord , O you who are of Israel’s fountain!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless God in the congregations, The Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise God, all you people of Israel; praise the Lord , the source of Israel’s life.
verses.textEnNasb: Bless God in the congregations, Even the Lord, you who are of the fountain of Israel.
verses.textEn: Praise God in the great congregation; praise the Lord in the assembly of Israel.

verses.textZh: 在那里有微小的便雅悯领导他们； 随后的，有犹大的领袖，成群结队， 还有西布伦和拿弗他利的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里有微小的便雅悯领导他们； 随后的，有犹大的领袖，成群结队， 还有西布伦和拿弗他利的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里，有统管他们的小便雅悯， 有犹大的首领和他们的群众， 有西布伦的首领， 有拿弗他利的首领。
verses.textEnNiv: There is the little tribe of Benjamin, leading them, there the great throng of Judah’s princes, and there the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
verses.textEnEsv: There is Benjamin, the least of them, in the lead, the princes of Judah in their throng, the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is little Benjamin, their leader, The princes of Judah and their company, The princes of Zebulun and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNlt: Look, the little tribe of Benjamin leads the way. Then comes a great throng of rulers from Judah and all the rulers of Zebulun and Naphtali.
verses.textEnNasb: Benjamin, the youngest, is there, ruling them, The leaders of Judah in their company, The leaders of Zebulun, the leaders of Naphtali.
verses.textEn: There is the little tribe of Benjamin, leading them, there the great throng of Judah’s princes, and there the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.

verses.textZh: 神 啊！召唤你的能力吧。神啊！坚立你为我们作成的事吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神 啊！召唤你的能力吧。神啊！坚立你为我们作成的事吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的能力是神所赐的；神啊，求你坚固你为我们所成全的事！
verses.textEnNiv: Summon your power, God ; show us your strength, our God, as you have done before.
verses.textEnEsv: Summon your power, O God, the power, O God, by which you have worked for us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your God has commanded your strength; Strengthen, O God, what You have done for us.
verses.textEnNlt: Summon your might, O God. Display your power, O God, as you have in the past.
verses.textEnNasb: Your God has commanded your strength; Show Yourself strong, God, You who acted in our behalf.
verses.textEn: Summon your power, God ; show us your strength, our God, as you have done before.

verses.textZh: 因为你在耶路撒冷的圣殿， 众王都把礼物带来献给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你在耶路撒冷的圣殿， 众王都把礼物带来献给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你耶路撒冷的殿， 列王必带贡物献给你。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring you gifts.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of your temple at Jerusalem kings shall bear gifts to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem, Kings will bring presents to You.
verses.textEnNlt: The kings of the earth are bringing tribute to your Temple in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem Kings will bring gifts to You.
verses.textEn: Because of your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring you gifts.

verses.textZh: 求你斥责芦苇中的野兽、 成群的公牛和万民中的牛犊， 并且把贪爱银块的人践踏在脚下； 求你赶散那些喜爱战争的民族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你斥责芦苇中的野兽、 成群的公牛和万民中的牛犊， 并且把贪爱银块的人践踏在脚下； 求你赶散那些喜爱战争的民族。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你叱喝芦苇中的野兽和群公牛， 并列邦中的牛犊。 把银块踹在脚下；神已经赶散好争战的列邦。
verses.textEnNiv: Rebuke the beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations. Humbled, may the beast bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
verses.textEnEsv: Rebuke the beasts that dwell among the reeds, the herd of bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample underfoot those who lust after tribute; scatter the peoples who delight in war.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rebuke the beasts of the reeds, The herd of bulls with the calves of the peoples, Tilleveryone submits himself with pieces of silver. Scatter the peoples who delight in war.
verses.textEnNlt: Rebuke these enemy nations— these wild animals lurking in the reeds, this herd of bulls among the weaker calves. Make them bring bars of silver in humble tribute. Scatter the nations that delight in war.
verses.textEnNasb: Rebuke the animals in the reeds, The herd of bulls with the calves of the peoples, Trampling the pieces of silver; He has scattered the peoples who delight in war.
verses.textEn: Rebuke the beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations. Humbled, may the beast bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

verses.textZh: 有使节从埃及出来， 古实人赶快向神呈献礼物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有使节从埃及出来， 古实人赶快向神呈献礼物。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及的公侯要出来朝见神； 古实人要急忙举手祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will submit herself to God.
verses.textEnEsv: Nobles shall come from Egypt; Cush shall hasten to stretch out her hands to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Envoys will come out of Egypt; Ethiopia will quickly stretch out her hands to God.
verses.textEnNlt: Let Egypt come with gifts of precious metals ; let Ethiopia bring tribute to God.
