verses.textEnNasb: Messengers will come from Egypt; Cush will quickly stretch out her hands to God.
verses.textEn: Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will submit herself to God.

verses.textZh: 地上的万国啊！你们要歌颂神， 你们要颂扬主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上的万国啊！你们要歌颂神， 你们要颂扬主。
verses.textZhCuv: 世上的列国啊，你们要向神歌唱； 愿你们歌颂主！
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth, sing praise to the Lord,
verses.textEnEsv: O kingdoms of the earth, sing to God; sing praises to the Lord, Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth; Oh, sing praises to the Lord, Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth. Sing praises to the Lord. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth, Sing praises to the Lord, Selah
verses.textEn: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth, sing praise to the Lord,

verses.textZh: 歌颂那乘驾在自古就有的众天之上的主； 看哪！他发出了强而有力的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌颂那乘驾在自古就有的众天之上的主； 看哪！他发出了强而有力的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌颂那自古驾行在诸天以上的主！ 他发出声音，是极大的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: to him who rides across the highest heavens, the ancient heavens, who thunders with mighty voice.
verses.textEnEsv: to him who rides in the heavens, the ancient heavens; behold, he sends out his voice, his mighty voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him who rides on the heaven of heavens, whichwere of old! Indeed, He sends out His voice, a mighty voice.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing to the one who rides across the ancient heavens, his mighty voice thundering from the sky.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him who rides upon the highest heavens, which are from ancient times; Behold, He speaks with His voice, a mighty voice.
verses.textEn: to him who rides across the highest heavens, the ancient heavens, who thunders with mighty voice.

verses.textZh: 你们要承认能力是从神而来的， 他的威荣是在以色列之上， 他的能力显于穹苍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要承认能力是从神而来的， 他的威荣是在以色列之上， 他的能力显于穹苍。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要将能力归给神。 他的威荣在以色列之上； 他的能力是在穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: Proclaim the power of God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose power is in the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: Ascribe power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, and whose power is in the skies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ascribe strength to God; His excellence is over Israel, And His strength is in the clouds.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell everyone about God’s power. His majesty shines down on Israel; his strength is mighty in the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: Ascribe strength to God; His majesty is over Israel, And His strength is in the skies.
verses.textEn: Proclaim the power of God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose power is in the heavens.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你在你的圣所中显为可畏； 以色列的神把能力和权能赐给他的子民。神是应当称颂的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你在你的圣所中显为可畏； 以色列的神把能力和权能赐给他的子民。神是应当称颂的。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你从圣所显为可畏； 以色列的神是那将力量权能赐给他百姓的。神是应当称颂的！
verses.textEnNiv: You, God, are awesome in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!
verses.textEnEsv: Awesome is God from his sanctuary; the God of Israel—he is the one who gives power and strength to his people. Blessed be God!
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, Youare more awesome than Your holy places. The God of Israel is He who gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!
verses.textEnNlt: God is awesome in his sanctuary. The God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!
verses.textEnNasb: God, You are awesome from Your sanctuary. The God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to the people. Blessed be God!
verses.textEn: You, God, are awesome in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，调用"百合花"。神啊！求你拯救我， 因为大水淹没了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长，调用"百合花"。神啊！求你拯救我， 因为大水淹没了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你救我！ 因为众水要淹没我。
verses.textEnNiv: Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.
verses.textEnEsv: Save me, O God! For the waters have come up to my neck.
verses.textEnNkjv: Save me, O God! For the waters have come up to my neck.
verses.textEnNlt: Save me, O God, for the floodwaters are up to my neck.
verses.textEnNasb: Save me, God, For the waters have threatened my life.
verses.textEn: Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.

verses.textZh: 我深陷在淤泥中， 没有立足之地； 我到了水深之处， 波涛漫过我身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我深陷在淤泥中， 没有立足之地； 我到了水深之处， 波涛漫过我身。
verses.textZhCuv: 我陷在深淤泥中，没有立脚之地； 我到了深水中，大水漫过我身。
verses.textEnNiv: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.
verses.textEnEsv: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold; I have come into deep waters, and the flood sweeps over me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I sink in deep mire, Where thereis no standing; I have come into deep waters, Where the floods overflow me.
verses.textEnNlt: Deeper and deeper I sink into the mire; I can’t find a foothold. I am in deep water, and the floods overwhelm me.
verses.textEnNasb: I have sunk in deep mud, and there is no foothold; I have come into deep waters, and a flood overflows me.
verses.textEn: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.

verses.textZh: 我因不住呼求而疲倦，我的喉咙发干； 我因等候我的神，眼睛昏花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因不住呼求而疲倦，我的喉咙发干； 我因等候我的神，眼睛昏花。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因呼求困乏，喉咙发干； 我因等候神，眼睛失明。
verses.textEnNiv: I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
verses.textEnEsv: I am weary with my crying out; my throat is parched. My eyes grow dim with waiting for my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am weary with my crying; My throat is dry; My eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.textEnNlt: I am exhausted from crying for help; my throat is parched. My eyes are swollen with weeping, waiting for my God to help me.
verses.textEnNasb: I am weary with my crying; my throat is parched; My eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.textEn: I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

verses.textZh: 那些无故恨我的，比我的头发还多； 无理与我为敌，要把我灭绝的，人数众多。 我没有抢夺过的，竟要我偿还。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些无故恨我的，比我的头发还多； 无理与我为敌，要把我灭绝的，人数众多。 我没有抢夺过的，竟要我偿还。
verses.textZhCuv: 无故恨我的，比我头发还多； 无理与我为仇、要把我剪除的，甚为强盛。 我没有抢夺的，要叫我偿还。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.
verses.textEnEsv: More in number than the hairs of my head are those who hate me without cause; mighty are those who would destroy me, those who attack me with lies. What I did not steal must I now restore?
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who hate me without a cause Are more than the hairs of my head; They are mighty who would destroy me, Being my enemies wrongfully; Though I have stolen nothing, I still must restore it.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs on my head. Many enemies try to destroy me with lies, demanding that I give back what I didn’t steal.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; Those who would destroy me are powerful, those who oppose me with lies; What I did not steal, I then have to restore.
verses.textEn: Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.

verses.textZh: 神啊！我的愚昧你是知道的， 我的罪愆不能向你隐瞒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！我的愚昧你是知道的， 我的罪愆不能向你隐瞒。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我的愚昧，你原知道； 我的罪愆不能隐瞒。
verses.textEnNiv: You, God, know my folly; my guilt is not hidden from you.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, you know my folly; the wrongs I have done are not hidden from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, You know my foolishness; And my sins are not hidden from You.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, you know how foolish I am; my sins cannot be hidden from you.
verses.textEnNasb: God, You know my foolishness, And my guilt is not hidden from You.
verses.textEn: You, God, know my folly; my guilt is not hidden from you.

verses.textZh: 主万军之耶和华啊！ 愿那些等候你的，不要因我蒙羞； 以色列的神啊！ 愿那些寻求你的，不要因我受辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主万军之耶和华啊！ 愿那些等候你的，不要因我蒙羞； 以色列的神啊！ 愿那些寻求你的，不要因我受辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军的主－耶和华啊， 求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞！ 以色列的神啊， 求你叫那寻求你的，不要因我受辱！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord, the Lord Almighty, may those who hope in you not be disgraced because of me; God of Israel, may those who seek you not be put to shame because of me.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not those who hope in you be put to shame through me, O Lord God of hosts; let not those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, O God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let not those who wait for You, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed because of me; Let not those who seek You be confounded because of me, O God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let those who trust in you be ashamed because of me, O Sovereign Lord of Heaven’s Armies. Don’t let me cause them to be humiliated, O God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: May those who wait for You not be ashamed because of me, Lord God of armies; May those who seek You not be dishonored because of me, God of Israel,
verses.textEn: Lord, the Lord Almighty, may those who hope in you not be disgraced because of me; God of Israel, may those who seek you not be put to shame because of me.

verses.textZh: 然而，为了你的缘故，我忍受辱骂， 满面羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，为了你的缘故，我忍受辱骂， 满面羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我为你的缘故受了辱骂， 满面羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: For I endure scorn for your sake, and shame covers my face.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is for your sake that I have borne reproach, that dishonor has covered my face.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because for Your sake I have borne reproach; Shame has covered my face.
verses.textEnNlt: For I endure insults for your sake; humiliation is written all over my face.
verses.textEnNasb: Because for Your sake I have endured disgrace; Dishonor has covered my face.
verses.textEn: For I endure scorn for your sake, and shame covers my face.

verses.textZh: 我的兄弟都疏远我， 我同母的兄弟把我当作外人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的兄弟都疏远我， 我同母的兄弟把我当作外人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄看我为外路人； 我的同胞看我为外邦人。
verses.textEnNiv: I am a foreigner to my own family, a stranger to my own mother’s children;
verses.textEnEsv: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have become a stranger to my brothers, And an alien to my mother’s children;
verses.textEnNlt: Even my own brothers pretend they don’t know me; they treat me like a stranger.
verses.textEnNasb: I have become estranged from my brothers, And a stranger to my mother’s sons.
verses.textEn: I am a foreigner to my own family, a stranger to my own mother’s children;

verses.textZh: 因我为你的殿，心中迫切如同火烧； 辱骂你的人的辱骂，都落在我身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因我为你的殿，心中迫切如同火烧； 辱骂你的人的辱骂，都落在我身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧， 并且辱骂你人的辱骂都落在我身上。
verses.textEnNiv: for zeal for your house consumes me, and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.
verses.textEnEsv: For zeal for your house has consumed me, and the reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because zeal for Your house has eaten me up, And the reproaches of those who reproach You have fallen on me.
verses.textEnNlt: Passion for your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult you have fallen on me.
verses.textEnNasb: For zeal for Your house has consumed me, And the taunts of those who taunt You have fallen on me.
verses.textEn: for zeal for your house consumes me, and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.

verses.textZh: 我哭泣禁食， 这竟成了我的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我哭泣禁食， 这竟成了我的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 我哭泣，以禁食刻苦我心； 这倒算为我的羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: When I weep and fast, I must endure scorn;
verses.textEnEsv: When I wept and humbled my soul with fasting, it became my reproach.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I wept andchastened my soul with fasting, That became my reproach.
verses.textEnNlt: When I weep and fast, they scoff at me.
verses.textEnNasb: When I wept in my soul with fasting, It became my disgrace.
verses.textEn: When I weep and fast, I must endure scorn;

verses.textZh: 我披上麻衣， 就成了他们取笑的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我披上麻衣， 就成了他们取笑的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 我拿麻布当衣裳， 就成了他们的笑谈。
verses.textEnNiv: when I put on sackcloth, people make sport of me.
verses.textEnEsv: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also made sackcloth my garment; I became a byword to them.
verses.textEnNlt: When I dress in burlap to show sorrow, they make fun of me.
verses.textEnNasb: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a proverb to them.
verses.textEn: when I put on sackcloth, people make sport of me.

verses.textZh: 坐在城门口的人对我议论纷纷， 我成了酒徒之歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 坐在城门口的人对我议论纷纷， 我成了酒徒之歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 坐在城门口的谈论我； 酒徒也以我为歌曲。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of the drunkards.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the talk of those who sit in the gate, and the drunkards make songs about me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who sit in the gate speak against me, And I am the song of the drunkards.
verses.textEnNlt: I am the favorite topic of town gossip, and all the drunks sing about me.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who sit in the gate talk about me, And songs of mockery by those habitually drunk are about me.
verses.textEn: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of the drunkards.

verses.textZh: 但是，耶和华啊！ 在悦纳的时候，我向你祷告；神啊！求你按着你丰盛的慈爱， 凭着你信实的拯救应允我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，耶和华啊！ 在悦纳的时候，我向你祷告；神啊！求你按着你丰盛的慈爱， 凭着你信实的拯救应允我。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我在悦纳的时候向你－耶和华祈祷。神啊，求你按你丰盛的慈爱， 凭你拯救的诚实应允我！
verses.textEnNiv: But I pray to you, Lord , in the time of your favor; in your great love, O God, answer me with your sure salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for me, my prayer is to you, O Lord . At an acceptable time, O God, in the abundance of your steadfast love answer me in your saving faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for me, my prayer is to You, O Lord, in the acceptable time; O God, in the multitude of Your mercy, Hear me in the truth of Your salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: But I keep praying to you, Lord , hoping this time you will show me favor. In your unfailing love, O God, answer my prayer with your sure salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, my prayer is to You, Lord, at an acceptable time; God, in the greatness of Your mercy, Answer me with Your saving truth.
verses.textEn: But I pray to you, Lord , in the time of your favor; in your great love, O God, answer me with your sure salvation.

verses.textZh: 求你救我脱离淤泥， 不要容我沉下去； 求你救我脱离那些恨我的人， 救我脱离深水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你救我脱离淤泥， 不要容我沉下去； 求你救我脱离那些恨我的人， 救我脱离深水。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你搭救我出离淤泥， 不叫我陷在其中； 求你使我脱离那些恨我的人， 使我出离深水。
verses.textEnNiv: Rescue me from the mire, do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.
verses.textEnEsv: Deliver me from sinking in the mire; let me be delivered from my enemies and from the deep waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver me out of the mire, And let me not sink; Let me be delivered from those who hate me, And out of the deep waters.
verses.textEnNlt: Rescue me from the mud; don’t let me sink any deeper! Save me from those who hate me, and pull me from these deep waters.
verses.textEnNasb: Rescue me from the mud and do not let me sink; May I be rescued from those who hate me, and from the depths of water.
verses.textEn: Rescue me from the mire, do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.

verses.textZh: 求你不要让波涛淹没我， 不要让深水吞灭我， 也不要让深坑把我封闭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要让波涛淹没我， 不要让深水吞灭我， 也不要让深坑把我封闭。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你不容大水漫过我， 不容深渊吞灭我， 不容坑坎在我以上合口。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let the floodwaters engulf me or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not the flood sweep over me, or the deep swallow me up, or the pit close its mouth over me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let not the floodwater overflow me, Nor let the deep swallow me up; And let not the pit shut its mouth on me.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let the floods overwhelm me, or the deep waters swallow me, or the pit of death devour me.
verses.textEnNasb: May the flood of water not overflow me Nor the deep swallow me up, Nor the pit close its mouth on me.
verses.textEn: Do not let the floodwaters engulf me or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你应允我，因为你的慈爱美善； 求你照着你丰盛的怜悯转脸垂顾我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你应允我，因为你的慈爱美善； 求你照着你丰盛的怜悯转脸垂顾我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你应允我！ 因为你的慈爱本为美好； 求你按你丰盛的慈悲回转眷顾我！
verses.textEnNiv: Answer me, Lord , out of the goodness of your love; in your great mercy turn to me.
verses.textEnEsv: Answer me, O Lord , for your steadfast love is good; according to your abundant mercy, turn to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear me, O Lord, for Your lovingkindness is good; Turn to me according to the multitude of Your tender mercies.
verses.textEnNlt: Answer my prayers, O Lord , for your unfailing love is wonderful. Take care of me, for your mercy is so plentiful.
verses.textEnNasb: Answer me, Lord, for Your mercy is good; According to the greatness of Your compassion, turn to me,
verses.textEn: Answer me, Lord , out of the goodness of your love; in your great mercy turn to me.

verses.textZh: 求你不要向你的仆人掩面； 求你快快应允我，因为我在困境之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要向你的仆人掩面； 求你快快应允我，因为我在困境之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要掩面不顾你的仆人； 我是在急难之中，求你速速地应允我！
verses.textEnNiv: Do not hide your face from your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: Hide not your face from your servant, for I am in distress; make haste to answer me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not hide Your face from Your servant, For I am in trouble; Hear me speedily.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t hide from your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in deep trouble!
verses.textEnNasb: And do not hide Your face from Your servant, For I am in distress; answer me quickly.
verses.textEn: Do not hide your face from your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.

verses.textZh: 求你亲近我，拯救我， 因我仇敌的缘故救赎我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你亲近我，拯救我， 因我仇敌的缘故救赎我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你亲近我，救赎我！ 求你因我的仇敌把我赎回！
verses.textEnNiv: Come near and rescue me; deliver me because of my foes.
verses.textEnEsv: Draw near to my soul, redeem me; ransom me because of my enemies!
verses.textEnNkjv: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it; Deliver me because of my enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: Come and redeem me; free me from my enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: Come near to my soul and redeem it; Ransom me because of my enemies!
verses.textEn: Come near and rescue me; deliver me because of my foes.

verses.textZh: 我所受的辱骂、欺凌和侮辱，你都知道， 我所有的敌人都在你面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所受的辱骂、欺凌和侮辱，你都知道， 我所有的敌人都在你面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 你知道我受的辱骂、欺凌、羞辱； 我的敌人都在你面前。
verses.textEnNiv: You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed; all my enemies are before you.
verses.textEnEsv: You know my reproach, and my shame and my dishonor; my foes are all known to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor; My adversaries are all before You.
verses.textEnNlt: You know of my shame, scorn, and disgrace. You see all that my enemies are doing.
verses.textEnNasb: You know my disgrace, my shame, and my dishonor; All my enemies are known to You.
verses.textEn: You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed; all my enemies are before you.

verses.textZh: 辱骂伤了我的心， 我忧愁难过； 我希望有人同情，却一个也没有； 我希望有人安慰，还是找不到一个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 辱骂伤了我的心， 我忧愁难过； 我希望有人同情，却一个也没有； 我希望有人安慰，还是找不到一个。
verses.textZhCuv: 辱骂伤破了我的心， 我又满了忧愁。 我指望有人体恤，却没有一个； 我指望有人安慰，却找不着一个。
verses.textEnNiv: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.
verses.textEnEsv: Reproaches have broken my heart, so that I am in despair. I looked for pity, but there was none, and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.textEnNkjv: Reproach has broken my heart, And I am full of heaviness; I looked forsomeone to take pity, but therewas none; And for comforters, but I found none.
verses.textEnNlt: Their insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. If only one person would show some pity; if only one would turn and comfort me.
verses.textEnNasb: Disgrace has broken my heart, and I am so sick. And I waited for sympathy, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.
verses.textEn: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.

verses.textZh: 他们在我的食物中加上苦胆， 我渴了，他们把醋给我喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在我的食物中加上苦胆， 我渴了，他们把醋给我喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们拿苦胆给我当食物； 我渴了，他们拿醋给我喝。
verses.textEnNiv: They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst.
verses.textEnEsv: They gave me poison for food, and for my thirst they gave me sour wine to drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also gave me gall for my food, And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.textEnNlt: But instead, they give me poison for food; they offer me sour wine for my thirst.
verses.textEnNasb: They also gave me a bitter herb in my food, And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.textEn: They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst.

verses.textZh: 愿他们的筵席在他们面前变为网罗、 报应和陷阱 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们的筵席在他们面前变为网罗、 报应和陷阱 。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们的筵席在他们面前变为网罗， 在他们平安的时候变为机槛。
verses.textEnNiv: May the table set before them become a snare; may it become retribution and a trap.
verses.textEnEsv: Let their own table before them become a snare; and when they are at peace, let it become a trap.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let their table become a snare before them, And their well-being a trap.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the bountiful table set before them become a snare and their prosperity become a trap.
verses.textEnNasb: May their table before them become a snare; And when they are at peace, may it become a trap.
verses.textEn: May the table set before them become a snare; may it become retribution and a trap.

verses.textZh: 愿他们的眼睛昏花，不能看见； 愿他们的腰不停地战抖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们的眼睛昏花，不能看见； 愿他们的腰不停地战抖。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不得看见； 愿你使他们的腰常常战抖。
verses.textEnNiv: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see, and make their loins tremble continually.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they do not see; And make their loins shake continually.
verses.textEnNlt: Let their eyes go blind so they cannot see, and make their bodies shake continually.
verses.textEnNasb: May their eyes grow dim so that they cannot see, And make their hips shake continually.
verses.textEn: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.

verses.textZh: 求你把你的恼怒倾倒在他们身上， 使你的烈怒追上他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你把你的恼怒倾倒在他们身上， 使你的烈怒追上他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你将你的恼恨倒在他们身上， 叫你的烈怒追上他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Pour out your wrath on them; let your fierce anger overtake them.
verses.textEnEsv: Pour out your indignation upon them, and let your burning anger overtake them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pour out Your indignation upon them, And let Your wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.textEnNlt: Pour out your fury on them; consume them with your burning anger.
verses.textEnNasb: Pour out Your indignation on them, And may Your burning anger overtake them.
verses.textEn: Pour out your wrath on them; let your fierce anger overtake them.

verses.textZh: 愿他们的住处变为荒场； 愿他们的帐幕无人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们的住处变为荒场； 愿他们的帐幕无人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们的住处变为荒场； 愿他们的帐棚无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
verses.textEnEsv: May their camp be a desolation; let no one dwell in their tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let their dwelling place be desolate; Let no one live in their tents.
verses.textEnNlt: Let their homes become desolate and their tents be deserted.
verses.textEnNasb: May their camp be desolated; May there be none living in their tents.
verses.textEn: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.

verses.textZh: 因为他们迫害你所击打的人， 嘲笑你所击伤的人的痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们迫害你所击打的人， 嘲笑你所击伤的人的痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，你所击打的，他们就逼迫； 你所击伤的，他们戏说他的愁苦。
verses.textEnNiv: For they persecute those you wound and talk about the pain of those you hurt.
verses.textEnEsv: For they persecute him whom you have struck down, and they recount the pain of those you have wounded.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they persecute the ones You have struck, And talk of the grief of those You have wounded.
verses.textEnNlt: To the one you have punished, they add insult to injury; they add to the pain of those you have hurt.
verses.textEnNasb: For they have persecuted him whom You Yourself struck, And they tell of the pain of those whom You have wounded.
verses.textEn: For they persecute those you wound and talk about the pain of those you hurt.

verses.textZh: 愿你在他们的惩罚上加上惩罚， 不容他们在你面前得称为义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你在他们的惩罚上加上惩罚， 不容他们在你面前得称为义。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你在他们的罪上加罪， 不容他们在你面前称义。
verses.textEnNiv: Charge them with crime upon crime; do not let them share in your salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: Add to them punishment upon punishment; may they have no acquittal from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Add iniquity to their iniquity, And let them not come into Your righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Pile their sins up high, and don’t let them go free.
verses.textEnNasb: Add guilt to their guilt, And may they not come into Your righteousness.
verses.textEn: Charge them with crime upon crime; do not let them share in your salvation.

verses.textZh: 愿他们的名字从生命册上被涂抹， 不要让他们和义人一同被记录。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们的名字从生命册上被涂抹， 不要让他们和义人一同被记录。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们从生命册上被涂抹， 不得记录在义人之中。
verses.textEnNiv: May they be blotted out of the book of life and not be listed with the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living; let them not be enrolled among the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, And not be written with the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: Erase their names from the Book of Life; don’t let them be counted among the righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: May they be wiped out of the book of life, And may they not be recorded with the righteous.
verses.textEn: May they be blotted out of the book of life and not be listed with the righteous.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我是忧伤痛苦的人；神啊！愿你的救恩保护我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我是忧伤痛苦的人；神啊！愿你的救恩保护我。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我是困苦忧伤的；神啊，愿你的救恩将我安置在高处。
verses.textEnNiv: But as for me, afflicted and in pain— may your salvation, God, protect me.
verses.textEnEsv: But I am afflicted and in pain; let your salvation, O God, set me on high!
verses.textEnNkjv: But I am poor and sorrowful; Let Your salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.textEnNlt: I am suffering and in pain. Rescue me, O God, by your saving power.
verses.textEnNasb: But I am afflicted and in pain; May Your salvation, God, set me safely on high.
verses.textEn: But as for me, afflicted and in pain— may your salvation, God, protect me.

verses.textZh: 我要用诗歌赞美神的名， 以感谢尊他为大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要用诗歌赞美神的名， 以感谢尊他为大。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要以诗歌赞美神的名， 以感谢称他为大！
verses.textEnNiv: I will praise God’s name in song and glorify him with thanksgiving.
verses.textEnEsv: I will praise the name of God with a song; I will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify Him with thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will praise God’s name with singing, and I will honor him with thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNasb: I will praise the name of God with song, And exalt Him with thanksgiving.
verses.textEn: I will praise God’s name in song and glorify him with thanksgiving.

verses.textZh: 这就使耶和华喜悦，胜过献牛， 或是献有角有蹄的公牛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就使耶和华喜悦，胜过献牛， 或是献有角有蹄的公牛。
verses.textZhCuv: 这便叫耶和华喜悦，胜似献牛， 或是献有角有蹄的公牛。
verses.textEnNiv: This will please the Lord more than an ox, more than a bull with its horns and hooves.
verses.textEnEsv: This will please the Lord more than an ox or a bull with horns and hoofs.
verses.textEnNkjv: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bull, Which has horns and hooves.
verses.textEnNlt: For this will please the Lord more than sacrificing cattle, more than presenting a bull with its horns and hooves.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will please the Lord better than an ox Or bull with horns and hoofs.
verses.textEn: This will please the Lord more than an ox, more than a bull with its horns and hooves.

verses.textZh: 困苦的人看见了就喜乐； 寻求神的人哪！愿你们的心苏醒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 困苦的人看见了就喜乐； 寻求神的人哪！愿你们的心苏醒。
verses.textZhCuv: 谦卑的人看见了就喜乐； 寻求神的人，愿你们的心苏醒。
verses.textEnNiv: The poor will see and be glad— you who seek God, may your hearts live!
verses.textEnEsv: When the humble see it they will be glad; you who seek God, let your hearts revive.
verses.textEnNkjv: The humble shall see thisand be glad; And you who seek God, your hearts shall live.
verses.textEnNlt: The humble will see their God at work and be glad. Let all who seek God’s help be encouraged.
verses.textEnNasb: The humble have seen it and are glad; You who seek God, let your heart revive.
verses.textEn: The poor will see and be glad— you who seek God, may your hearts live!

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华垂听了贫穷人的祷告， 也不藐视属他自己、正被囚禁的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华垂听了贫穷人的祷告， 也不藐视属他自己、正被囚禁的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华听了穷乏人， 不藐视被囚的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord hears the needy and does not despise his captive people.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord hears the needy and does not despise his own people who are prisoners.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord hears the poor, And does not despise His prisoners.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord hears the cries of the needy; he does not despise his imprisoned people.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord hears the needy, And does not despise those of His who are prisoners.
verses.textEn: The Lord hears the needy and does not despise his captive people.

verses.textZh: 愿天和地都赞美他， 愿海洋和海中一切生物都赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿天和地都赞美他， 愿海洋和海中一切生物都赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿天和地、 洋海和其中一切的动物都赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and all that move in them,
verses.textEnEsv: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let heaven and earth praise Him, The seas and everything that moves in them.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise him, O heaven and earth, the seas and all that move in them.
verses.textEnNasb: Heaven and earth shall praise Him, The seas and everything that moves in them.
verses.textEn: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and all that move in them,

verses.textZh: 因为神要拯救锡安， 要建造犹大的众城； 他的子民必在那里居住，并且拥有那地为业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神要拯救锡安， 要建造犹大的众城； 他的子民必在那里居住，并且拥有那地为业。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神要拯救锡安，建造犹大的城邑； 他的民要在那里居住，得以为业。
verses.textEnNiv: for God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;
verses.textEnEsv: For God will save Zion and build up the cities of Judah, and people shall dwell there and possess it;
verses.textEnNkjv: For God will save Zion And build the cities of Judah, That they may dwell there and possess it.
verses.textEnNlt: For God will save Jerusalem and rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there and settle in their own land.
verses.textEnNasb: For God will save Zion and build the cities of Judah, So that they may live there and possess it.
verses.textEn: for God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;

verses.textZh: 他众仆人的后裔都必承受那地为业， 喜爱他名的人要住在其中。 大卫的记念诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他众仆人的后裔都必承受那地为业， 喜爱他名的人要住在其中。 大卫的记念诗，交给诗班长。
verses.textZhCuv: 他仆人的后裔要承受为业； 爱他名的人也要住在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: the children of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell there.
verses.textEnEsv: the offspring of his servants shall inherit it, and those who love his name shall dwell in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, the descendants of His servants shall inherit it, And those who love His name shall dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of those who obey him will inherit the land, and those who love him will live there in safety.
verses.textEnNasb: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, And those who love His name will live in it.
verses.textEn: the children of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell there.

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你搭救我； 耶和华啊！求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你搭救我； 耶和华啊！求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你快快搭救我！ 耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！
verses.textEnNiv: Hasten, O God, to save me; come quickly, Lord , to help me.
verses.textEnEsv: Make haste, O God, to deliver me! O Lord , make haste to help me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Makehaste, O God, to deliver me! Make haste to help me, O Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Please, God, rescue me! Come quickly, Lord , and help me.
verses.textEnNasb: God, hurry to save me; Lord, hurry to help me!
verses.textEn: Hasten, O God, to save me; come quickly, Lord , to help me.

verses.textZh: 愿那些寻索我性命的，抱愧蒙羞； 愿那些喜悦我遭害的，退后受辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那些寻索我性命的，抱愧蒙羞； 愿那些喜悦我遭害的，退后受辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那些寻索我命的，抱愧蒙羞； 愿那些喜悦我遭害的，退后受辱。
verses.textEnNiv: May those who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be put to shame and confusion who seek my life! Let them be turned back and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded Who seek my life; Let them be turned back and confused Who desire my hurt.
verses.textEnNlt: May those who try to kill me be humiliated and put to shame. May those who take delight in my trouble be turned back in disgrace.
verses.textEnNasb: May those who seek my life Be put to shame and humiliated; May those who delight in my harm Be turned back and dishonored.
verses.textEn: May those who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

verses.textZh: 愿那些对我说："啊哈！啊哈！"的， 都因羞愧退后。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那些对我说："啊哈！啊哈！"的， 都因羞愧退后。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的， 因羞愧退后。
verses.textEnNiv: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" turn back because of their shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them turn back because of their shame who say, "Aha, Aha!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be turned back because of their shame, Who say, "Aha, aha!"
verses.textEnNlt: Let them be horrified by their shame, for they said, "Aha! We’ve got him now!"
verses.textEnNasb: May those who say, "Aha, aha!" be turned back Because of their shame.
verses.textEn: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" turn back because of their shame.

verses.textZh: 愿所有寻求你的， 都因你欢喜快乐； 愿那些喜爱你救恩的， 常说："要尊神为大。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿所有寻求你的， 都因你欢喜快乐； 愿那些喜爱你救恩的， 常说："要尊神为大。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜； 愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊神为大！
verses.textEnNiv: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who long for your saving help always say, "The Lord is great!"
verses.textEnEsv: May all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you! May those who love your salvation say evermore, "God is great!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; And let those who love Your salvation say continually, "Let God be magnified!"
verses.textEnNlt: But may all who search for you be filled with joy and gladness in you. May those who love your salvation repeatedly shout, "God is great!"
verses.textEnNasb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; And may those who love Your salvation say continually, "May God be exalted!"
verses.textEn: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who long for your saving help always say, "The Lord is great!"

verses.textZh: 至于我，我是困苦贫穷的；神啊！求你快快到我这里来； 你是我的帮助，我的拯救； 耶和华啊！求你不要耽延。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我是困苦贫穷的；神啊！求你快快到我这里来； 你是我的帮助，我的拯救； 耶和华啊！求你不要耽延。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我是困苦穷乏的；神啊，求你速速到我这里来！ 你是帮助我的，搭救我的。 耶和华啊，求你不要耽延！
verses.textEnNiv: But as for me, I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; Lord , do not delay.
verses.textEnEsv: But I am poor and needy; hasten to me, O God! You are my help and my deliverer; O Lord , do not delay!
verses.textEnNkjv: But I am poor and needy; Make haste to me, O God! You are my help and my deliverer; O Lord, do not delay.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for me, I am poor and needy; please hurry to my aid, O God. You are my helper and my savior; O Lord , do not delay.
verses.textEnNasb: But I am afflicted and needy; Hurry to me, God! You are my help and my savior; Lord, do not delay.
verses.textEn: But as for me, I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; Lord , do not delay.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我投靠你， 求你使我永不羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我投靠你， 求你使我永不羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我投靠你； 求你叫我永不羞愧！
verses.textEnNiv: In you, Lord , I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: In you, O Lord , do I take refuge; let me never be put to shame!
verses.textEnNkjv: In You, O Lord, I put my trust; Let me never be put to shame.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , I have come to you for protection; don’t let me be disgraced.
verses.textEnNasb: In You, Lord, I have taken refuge; Let me never be put to shame.
verses.textEn: In you, Lord , I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

verses.textZh: 求你按着你的公义搭救我，救赎我； 求你留心听我，拯救我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你按着你的公义搭救我，救赎我； 求你留心听我，拯救我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你凭你的公义搭救我，救拔我； 侧耳听我，拯救我！
verses.textEnNiv: In your righteousness, rescue me and deliver me; turn your ear to me and save me.
verses.textEnEsv: In your righteousness deliver me and rescue me; incline your ear to me, and save me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver me in Your righteousness, and cause me to escape; Incline Your ear to me, and save me.
verses.textEnNlt: Save me and rescue me, for you do what is right. Turn your ear to listen to me, and set me free.
verses.textEnNasb: In Your righteousness rescue me and save me; Extend Your ear to me and help me.
verses.textEn: In your righteousness, rescue me and deliver me; turn your ear to me and save me.

verses.textZh: 求你作我避难的盘石，使我可以常来投靠； 你已经下令救我， 因为你是我的岩石、我的坚垒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你作我避难的盘石，使我可以常来投靠； 你已经下令救我， 因为你是我的岩石、我的坚垒。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你作我常住的磐石； 你已经命定要救我， 因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨。
verses.textEnNiv: Be my rock of refuge, to which I can always go; give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
verses.textEnEsv: Be to me a rock of refuge, to which I may continually come; you have given the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be my strong refuge, To which I may resort continually; You have given the commandment to save me, For You are my rock and my fortress.
verses.textEnNlt: Be my rock of safety where I can always hide. Give the order to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
verses.textEnNasb: Be to me a rock of dwelling to which I may continually come; You have given the commandment to save me, For You are my rock and my fortress.
verses.textEn: Be my rock of refuge, to which I can always go; give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

verses.textZh: 我的神啊！求你救我脱离恶人的手， 脱离邪恶和残暴的人的掌握，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神啊！求你救我脱离恶人的手， 脱离邪恶和残暴的人的掌握，
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，求你救我脱离恶人的手， 脱离不义和残暴之人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Deliver me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of those who are evil and cruel.
verses.textEnEsv: Rescue me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and cruel man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.textEnNlt: My God, rescue me from the power of the wicked, from the clutches of cruel oppressors.
verses.textEnNasb: Save me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, From the grasp of the wrongdoer and the ruthless,
verses.textEn: Deliver me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of those who are evil and cruel.

verses.textZh: 因为你是我的盼望； 主耶和华啊！你是我自幼以来所倚靠的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你是我的盼望； 主耶和华啊！你是我自幼以来所倚靠的。
verses.textZhCuv: 主－耶和华啊，你是我所盼望的； 从我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。
verses.textEnNiv: For you have been my hope, Sovereign Lord , my confidence since my youth.
verses.textEnEsv: For you, O Lord, are my hope, my trust, O Lord , from my youth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You are my hope, O Lord God; Youare my trust from my youth.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord, you alone are my hope. I’ve trusted you, O Lord , from childhood.
verses.textEnNasb: For You are my hope; Lord God, You are my confidence from my youth.
verses.textEn: For you have been my hope, Sovereign Lord , my confidence since my youth.

verses.textZh: 我自出母胎就倚赖你， 把我从母腹中领出来的就是你， 我要常常赞美你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我自出母胎就倚赖你， 把我从母腹中领出来的就是你， 我要常常赞美你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从出母胎被你扶持； 使我出母腹的是你。 我必常常赞美你！
verses.textEnNiv: From birth I have relied on you; you brought me forth from my mother’s womb. I will ever praise you.
verses.textEnEsv: Upon you I have leaned from before my birth; you are he who took me from my mother’s womb. My praise is continually of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: By You I have been upheld from birth; You are He who took me out of my mother’s womb. My praise shallbe continually of You.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you have been with me from birth; from my mother’s womb you have cared for me. No wonder I am always praising you!
verses.textEnNasb: I have leaned on You since my birth; You are He who took me from my mother’s womb; My praise is continually of You.
verses.textEn: From birth I have relied on you; you brought me forth from my mother’s womb. I will ever praise you.

verses.textZh: 众人都以我为怪， 但你是我坚固的避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都以我为怪， 但你是我坚固的避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 许多人以我为怪， 但你是我坚固的避难所。
verses.textEnNiv: I have become a sign to many; you are my strong refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: I have been as a portent to many, but you are my strong refuge.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have become as a wonder to many, But You are my strong refuge.
verses.textEnNlt: My life is an example to many, because you have been my strength and protection.
verses.textEnNasb: I have become a marvel to many, For You are my strong refuge.
verses.textEn: I have become a sign to many; you are my strong refuge.

verses.textZh: 我要满口赞美你， 我终日颂扬你的荣美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要满口赞美你， 我终日颂扬你的荣美。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的赞美，你的荣耀 终日必满了我的口。
verses.textEnNiv: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: My mouth is filled with your praise, and with your glory all the day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let my mouth be filled with Your praise Andwith Your glory all the day.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I can never stop praising you; I declare your glory all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: My mouth is filled with Your praise And with Your glory all day long.
verses.textEn: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.

verses.textZh: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我； 我气力衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我； 我气力衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我！ 我力气衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我！
verses.textEnNiv: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not cast me off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength is spent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not cast me off in the time of old age; Do not forsake me when my strength fails.
verses.textEnNlt: And now, in my old age, don’t set me aside. Don’t abandon me when my strength is failing.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not cast me away at the time of my old age; Do not abandon me when my strength fails.
verses.textEn: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.

verses.textZh: 因为我的仇敌议论我； 那些窥探着要害我性命的，一同商议，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我的仇敌议论我； 那些窥探着要害我性命的，一同商议，
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仇敌议论我； 那些窥探要害我命的彼此商议，
verses.textEnNiv: For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.
verses.textEnEsv: For my enemies speak concerning me; those who watch for my life consult together
verses.textEnNkjv: For my enemies speak against me; And those who lie in wait for my life take counsel together,
verses.textEnNlt: For my enemies are whispering against me. They are plotting together to kill me.
verses.textEnNasb: For my enemies have spoken against me; And those who watch for my life have consulted together,
verses.textEn: For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.

verses.textZh: 说："神已经离弃了他， 你们追赶他，拿住他吧！ 因为没有人搭救他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："神已经离弃了他， 你们追赶他，拿住他吧！ 因为没有人搭救他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：神已经离弃他； 我们追赶他，捉拿他吧！ 因为没有人搭救。
verses.textEnNiv: They say, "God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for no one will rescue him."
verses.textEnEsv: and say, "God has forsaken him; pursue and seize him, for there is none to deliver him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Saying, "God has forsaken him; Pursue and take him, for thereis none to deliver him."
verses.textEnNlt: They say, "God has abandoned him. Let’s go and get him, for no one will help him now."
verses.textEnNasb: Saying, "God has abandoned him; Pursue and seize him, for there is no one to save him."
verses.textEn: They say, "God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for no one will rescue him."

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你不要远离我； 我的神啊！求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你不要远离我； 我的神啊！求你快来帮助我。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你不要远离我！ 我的神啊，求你速速帮助我！
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be far from me, my God; come quickly, God, to help me.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me!
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, do not be far from me; O my God, make haste to help me!
verses.textEnNlt: O God, don’t stay away. My God, please hurry to help me.
verses.textEnNasb: God, do not be far from me; My God, hurry to my aid!
verses.textEn: Do not be far from me, my God; come quickly, God, to help me.

verses.textZh: 愿那些控告我的， 都羞愧灭亡； 愿那些谋求害我的， 都蒙羞受辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那些控告我的， 都羞愧灭亡； 愿那些谋求害我的， 都蒙羞受辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿那与我性命为敌的，羞愧被灭； 愿那谋害我的，受辱蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: May my accusers perish in shame; may those who want to harm me be covered with scorn and disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: May my accusers be put to shame and consumed; with scorn and disgrace may they be covered who seek my hurt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be confounded and consumed Who are adversaries of my life; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonor Who seek my hurt.
verses.textEnNlt: Bring disgrace and destruction on my accusers. Humiliate and shame those who want to harm me.
verses.textEnNasb: May those who are enemies of my soul be put to shame and consumed; May they be covered with disgrace and dishonor, who seek to injure me.
verses.textEn: May my accusers perish in shame; may those who want to harm me be covered with scorn and disgrace.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我要常常仰望你， 要多多赞美你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我要常常仰望你， 要多多赞美你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却要常常盼望， 并要越发赞美你。
verses.textEnNiv: As for me, I will always have hope; I will praise you more and more.
verses.textEnEsv: But I will hope continually and will praise you yet more and more.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will hope continually, And will praise You yet more and more.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will keep on hoping for your help; I will praise you more and more.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, I will wait continually, And will praise You yet more and more.
verses.textEn: As for me, I will always have hope; I will praise you more and more.

verses.textZh: 我的口要述说你的公义， 终日讲述你的救恩， 尽管我不知道它们的数量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的口要述说你的公义， 终日讲述你的救恩， 尽管我不知道它们的数量。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的口终日要述说你的公义和你的救恩， 因我不计其数。
verses.textEnNiv: My mouth will tell of your righteous deeds, of your saving acts all day long— though I know not how to relate them all.
verses.textEnEsv: My mouth will tell of your righteous acts, of your deeds of salvation all the day, for their number is past my knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: My mouth shall tell of Your righteousness And Your salvation all the day, For I do not know their limits.
verses.textEnNlt: I will tell everyone about your righteousness. All day long I will proclaim your saving power, though I am not skilled with words.
verses.textEnNasb: My mouth shall tell of Your righteousness And of Your salvation all day long; For I do not know the art of writing.
verses.textEn: My mouth will tell of your righteous deeds, of your saving acts all day long— though I know not how to relate them all.

verses.textZh: 我要来述说主耶和华大能的事； 我要提说你独有的公义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要来述说主耶和华大能的事； 我要提说你独有的公义。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要来说主－耶和华大能的事； 我单要提说你的公义。
verses.textEnNiv: I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, Sovereign Lord ; I will proclaim your righteous deeds, yours alone.
verses.textEnEsv: With the mighty deeds of the Lord God I will come; I will remind them of your righteousness, yours alone.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord God; I will make mention of Your righteousness, of Yours only.
verses.textEnNlt: I will praise your mighty deeds, O Sovereign Lord . I will tell everyone that you alone are just.
verses.textEnNasb: I will come with the mighty deeds of the Lord God; I will make mention of Your righteousness, Yours alone.
verses.textEn: I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, Sovereign Lord ; I will proclaim your righteous deeds, yours alone.

verses.textZh: 神啊！我自幼以来，你就教导我； 直到现在，我还是宣扬你奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！我自幼以来，你就教导我； 直到现在，我还是宣扬你奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，自我年幼时，你就教训我； 直到如今，我传扬你奇妙的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: Since my youth, God, you have taught me, and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, from my youth you have taught me, and I still proclaim your wondrous deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, You have taught me from my youth; And to this day I declare Your wondrous works.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, you have taught me from my earliest childhood, and I constantly tell others about the wonderful things you do.
verses.textEnNasb: God, You have taught me from my youth, And I still declare Your wondrous deeds.
verses.textEn: Since my youth, God, you have taught me, and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.

verses.textZh: 神啊！到我年老发白的时候， 求你仍不要离弃我， 等我把你的能力向下一代传扬， 把你的大能向后世所有的人传扬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！到我年老发白的时候， 求你仍不要离弃我， 等我把你的能力向下一代传扬， 把你的大能向后世所有的人传扬。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我到年老发白的时候， 求你不要离弃我！ 等我将你的能力指示下代， 将你的大能指示后世的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, my God, till I declare your power to the next generation, your mighty acts to all who are to come.
verses.textEnEsv: So even to old age and gray hairs, O God, do not forsake me, until I proclaim your might to another generation, your power to all those to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now also when Iam old and grayheaded, O God, do not forsake me, Until I declare Your strength to this generation, Your power to everyone who is to come.
verses.textEnNlt: Now that I am old and gray, do not abandon me, O God. Let me proclaim your power to this new generation, your mighty miracles to all who come after me.
verses.textEnNasb: And even when I am old and gray, God, do not abandon me, Until I declare Your strength to this generation, Your power to all who are to come.
verses.textEn: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, my God, till I declare your power to the next generation, your mighty acts to all who are to come.

verses.textZh: 神啊！你的公义达到高天， 你曾经行过大事，神啊！有谁像你呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你的公义达到高天， 你曾经行过大事，神啊！有谁像你呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你的公义甚高； 行过大事的神啊，谁能像你！
verses.textEnNiv: Your righteousness, God, reaches to the heavens, you who have done great things. Who is like you, God?
verses.textEnEsv: Your righteousness, O God, reaches the high heavens. You who have done great things, O God, who is like you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Your righteousness, O God, is very high, You who have done great things; O God, who is like You?
verses.textEnNlt: Your righteousness, O God, reaches to the highest heavens. You have done such wonderful things. Who can compare with you, O God?
verses.textEnNasb: For Your righteousness, God, reaches to the heavens, You who have done great things; God, who is like You?
verses.textEn: Your righteousness, God, reaches to the heavens, you who have done great things. Who is like you, God?

verses.textZh: 你使我们经历了很多苦难， 你必使我们再活过来， 你必把我们从地的深处救上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我们经历了很多苦难， 你必使我们再活过来， 你必把我们从地的深处救上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是叫我们多经历重大急难的， 必使我们复活， 从地的深处救上来。
verses.textEnNiv: Though you have made me see troubles, many and bitter, you will restore my life again; from the depths of the earth you will again bring me up.
verses.textEnEsv: You who have made me see many troubles and calamities will revive me again; from the depths of the earth you will bring me up again.
verses.textEnNkjv: You, who have shown me great and severe troubles, Shall revive me again, And bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: You have allowed me to suffer much hardship, but you will restore me to life again and lift me up from the depths of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: You who have shown me many troubles and distresses Will revive me again, And will bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.textEn: Though you have made me see troubles, many and bitter, you will restore my life again; from the depths of the earth you will again bring me up.

verses.textZh: 你必增加我的尊荣， 并转过来安慰我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必增加我的尊荣， 并转过来安慰我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使我越发昌大， 又转来安慰我。
verses.textEnNiv: You will increase my honor and comfort me once more.
verses.textEnEsv: You will increase my greatness and comfort me again.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall increase my greatness, And comfort me on every side.
verses.textEnNlt: You will restore me to even greater honor and comfort me once again.
verses.textEnNasb: May You increase my greatness And turn to comfort me.
verses.textEn: You will increase my honor and comfort me once more.

verses.textZh: 我的神啊！ 我要弹琴称赞你，称赞你的信实； 以色列的圣者啊！ 我要鼓瑟歌颂你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神啊！ 我要弹琴称赞你，称赞你的信实； 以色列的圣者啊！ 我要鼓瑟歌颂你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，我要鼓瑟称赞你， 称赞你的诚实！ 以色列的圣者啊，我要弹琴歌颂你！
verses.textEnNiv: I will praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God; I will sing praise to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praises to you with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also with the lute I will praise You— And Your faithfulness, O my God! To You I will sing with the harp, O Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will praise you with music on the harp, because you are faithful to your promises, O my God. I will sing praises to you with a lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also praise You with a harp, And Your truth, my God; I will sing praises to You with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: I will praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God; I will sing praise to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 我歌颂你的时候，我的嘴唇要欢呼； 我的灵魂，就是你所救赎的，也要欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我歌颂你的时候，我的嘴唇要欢呼； 我的灵魂，就是你所救赎的，也要欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 我歌颂你的时候， 我的嘴唇和你所赎我的灵魂都必欢呼；
verses.textEnNiv: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praise to you— I whom you have delivered.
verses.textEnEsv: My lips will shout for joy, when I sing praises to you; my soul also, which you have redeemed.
verses.textEnNkjv: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing to You, And my soul, which You have redeemed.
verses.textEnNlt: I will shout for joy and sing your praises, for you have ransomed me.
verses.textEnNasb: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praises to You; And my soul, which You have redeemed.
verses.textEn: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praise to you— I whom you have delivered.

verses.textZh: 我的舌头也要终日讲述你的公义， 因为那些谋求害我的人已经蒙羞受辱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的舌头也要终日讲述你的公义， 因为那些谋求害我的人已经蒙羞受辱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我的舌头必终日讲论你的公义， 因为那些谋害我的人已经蒙羞受辱了。
verses.textEnNiv: My tongue will tell of your righteous acts all day long, for those who wanted to harm me have been put to shame and confusion.
verses.textEnEsv: And my tongue will talk of your righteous help all the day long, for they have been put to shame and disappointed who sought to do me hurt.
verses.textEnNkjv: My tongue also shall talk of Your righteousness all the day long; For they are confounded, For they are brought to shame Who seek my hurt.
verses.textEnNlt: I will tell about your righteous deeds all day long, for everyone who tried to hurt me has been shamed and humiliated.
verses.textEnNasb: My tongue also will tell of Your righteousness all day long; For they are put to shame, for they are humiliated who seek my harm.
verses.textEn: My tongue will tell of your righteous acts all day long, for those who wanted to harm me have been put to shame and confusion.

verses.textZh: 所罗门的诗。神啊！求你把你的公正赐给王， 把你的公义赐给王子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门的诗。神啊！求你把你的公正赐给王， 把你的公义赐给王子。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你将判断的权柄赐给王， 将公义赐给王的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with your righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: Give the king your justice, O God, and your righteousness to the royal son!
verses.textEnNkjv: Give the king Your judgments, O God, And Your righteousness to the king’s Son.
verses.textEnNlt: Give your love of justice to the king, O God, and righteousness to the king’s son.
verses.textEnNasb: Give the king Your judgments, God, And Your righteousness to the king’s son.
verses.textEn: Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with your righteousness.

verses.textZh: 他要按着公义审判你的子民， 凭着公正审判你的困苦人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要按着公义审判你的子民， 凭着公正审判你的困苦人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要按公义审判你的民， 按公平审判你的困苦人。
verses.textEnNiv: May he judge your people in righteousness, your afflicted ones with justice.
verses.textEnEsv: May he judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice!
verses.textEnNkjv: He will judge Your people with righteousness, And Your poor with justice.
verses.textEnNlt: Help him judge your people in the right way; let the poor always be treated fairly.
verses.textEnNasb: May he judge Your people with righteousness And Your afflicted with justice.
verses.textEn: May he judge your people in righteousness, your afflicted ones with justice.

verses.textZh: 因着公义， 愿大山和小山都给人民带来和平。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着公义， 愿大山和小山都给人民带来和平。
verses.textZhCuv: 大山小山都要因公义使民得享平安。
verses.textEnNiv: May the mountains bring prosperity to the people, the hills the fruit of righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the mountains bear prosperity for the people, and the hills, in righteousness!
verses.textEnNkjv: The mountains will bring peace to the people, And the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: May the mountains yield prosperity for all, and may the hills be fruitful.
verses.textEnNasb: May the mountains bring peace to the people, And the hills, in righteousness.
verses.textEn: May the mountains bring prosperity to the people, the hills the fruit of righteousness.

verses.textZh: 他必为民间的困苦人伸冤， 拯救贫穷人， 粉碎那欺压人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必为民间的困苦人伸冤， 拯救贫穷人， 粉碎那欺压人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必为民中的困苦人伸冤， 拯救穷乏之辈， 压碎那欺压人的。
verses.textEnNiv: May he defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; may he crush the oppressor.
verses.textEnEsv: May he defend the cause of the poor of the people, give deliverance to the children of the needy, and crush the oppressor!
verses.textEnNkjv: He will bring justice to the poor of the people; He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.textEnNlt: Help him to defend the poor, to rescue the children of the needy, and to crush their oppressors.
verses.textEnNasb: May he vindicate the afflicted of the people, Save the children of the needy, And crush the oppressor.
verses.textEn: May he defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; may he crush the oppressor.

verses.textZh: 他必像日月一般长久， 直到万代 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必像日月一般长久， 直到万代 。
verses.textZhCuv: 太阳还存，月亮还在， 人要敬畏你，直到万代！
verses.textEnNiv: May he endure as long as the sun, as long as the moon, through all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: May they fear you while the sun endures, and as long as the moon, throughout all generations!
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall fear You As long as the sun and moon endure, Throughout all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: May they fear you as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains in the sky. Yes, forever!
verses.textEnNasb: May they fear You while the sun shines, And as long as the moon shines, throughout all generations.
verses.textEn: May he endure as long as the sun, as long as the moon, through all generations.

verses.textZh: 他必像雨降在已割的草地上， 像甘霖滋润大地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必像雨降在已割的草地上， 像甘霖滋润大地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必降临，像雨降在已割的草地上， 如甘霖滋润田地。
verses.textEnNiv: May he be like rain falling on a mown field, like showers watering the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: May he be like rain that falls on the mown grass, like showers that water the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall come down like rain upon the grass before mowing, Like showers that water the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: May the king’s rule be refreshing like spring rain on freshly cut grass, like the showers that water the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: May he come down like rain upon the mown grass, Like showers that water the earth.
verses.textEn: May he be like rain falling on a mown field, like showers watering the earth.

verses.textZh: 他在世的日子，义人必兴旺， 四境太平，直到月亮不再重现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在世的日子，义人必兴旺， 四境太平，直到月亮不再重现。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他的日子，义人要发旺， 大有平安，好像月亮长存。
verses.textEnNiv: In his days may the righteous flourish and prosperity abound till the moon is no more.
verses.textEnEsv: In his days may the righteous flourish, and peace abound, till the moon be no more!
verses.textEnNkjv: In His days the righteous shall flourish, And abundance of peace, Until the moon is no more.
verses.textEnNlt: May all the godly flourish during his reign. May there be abundant prosperity until the moon is no more.
verses.textEnNasb: May the righteous flourish in his days, As well as an abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
verses.textEn: In his days may the righteous flourish and prosperity abound till the moon is no more.

verses.textZh: 他要执掌权柄，从这海到那海， 从大河直到地极。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要执掌权柄，从这海到那海， 从大河直到地极。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要执掌权柄，从这海直到那海， 从大河直到地极。
verses.textEnNiv: May he rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: May he have dominion from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: May he reign from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates River to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: May he also rule from sea to sea, And from the Euphrates River to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEn: May he rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

verses.textZh: 住在旷野的人必向他屈身， 他的仇敌必舔尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在旷野的人必向他屈身， 他的仇敌必舔尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在旷野的，必在他面前下拜； 他的仇敌必要舔土。
verses.textEnNiv: May the desert tribes bow before him and his enemies lick the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: May desert tribes bow down before him, and his enemies lick the dust!
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who dwell in the wilderness will bow before Him, And His enemies will lick the dust.
verses.textEnNlt: Desert nomads will bow before him; his enemies will fall before him in the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: May the nomads of the desert bow before him, And his enemies lick the dust.
verses.textEn: May the desert tribes bow before him and his enemies lick the dust.

verses.textZh: 他施和海岛的列王都必带来礼物， 示巴和西巴的列王都必献上贡物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他施和海岛的列王都必带来礼物， 示巴和西巴的列王都必献上贡物。
verses.textZhCuv: 他施和海岛的王要进贡； 示巴和西巴的王要献礼物。
verses.textEnNiv: May the kings of Tarshish and of distant shores bring tribute to him. May the kings of Sheba and Seba present him gifts.
verses.textEnEsv: May the kings of Tarshish and of the coastlands render him tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba bring gifts!
verses.textEnNkjv: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles Will bring presents; The kings of Sheba and Seba Will offer gifts.
verses.textEnNlt: The western kings of Tarshish and other distant lands will bring him tribute. The eastern kings of Sheba and Seba will bring him gifts.
verses.textEnNasb: May the kings of Tarshish and of the islands bring gifts; May the kings of Sheba and Seba offer tributes.
verses.textEn: May the kings of Tarshish and of distant shores bring tribute to him. May the kings of Sheba and Seba present him gifts.

verses.textZh: 众王都必向他俯伏， 万国都必服事他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众王都必向他俯伏， 万国都必服事他。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸王都要叩拜他； 万国都要事奉他。
verses.textEnNiv: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
verses.textEnEsv: May all kings fall down before him, all nations serve him!
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, all kings shall fall down before Him; All nations shall serve Him.
verses.textEnNlt: All kings will bow before him, and all nations will serve him.
verses.textEnNasb: And may all kings bow down before him, All nations serve him.
verses.textEn: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.

verses.textZh: 因为贫穷人呼求的时候，他就搭救； 没有人帮助的困苦人，他也搭救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为贫穷人呼求的时候，他就搭救； 没有人帮助的困苦人，他也搭救。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，穷乏人呼求的时候，他要搭救； 没有人帮助的困苦人，他也要搭救。
verses.textEnNiv: For he will deliver the needy who cry out, the afflicted who have no one to help.
verses.textEnEsv: For he delivers the needy when he calls, the poor and him who has no helper.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He will deliver the needy when he cries, The poor also, and him who has no helper.
verses.textEnNlt: He will rescue the poor when they cry to him; he will help the oppressed, who have no one to defend them.
verses.textEnNasb: For he will save the needy when he cries for help, The afflicted also, and him who has no helper.
verses.textEn: For he will deliver the needy who cry out, the afflicted who have no one to help.

verses.textZh: 他必怜恤软弱和贫穷的人， 拯救贫穷人的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必怜恤软弱和贫穷的人， 拯救贫穷人的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要怜恤贫寒和穷乏的人， 拯救穷苦人的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: He will take pity on the weak and the needy and save the needy from death.
verses.textEnEsv: He has pity on the weak and the needy, and saves the lives of the needy.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will spare the poor and needy, And will save the souls of the needy.
verses.textEnNlt: He feels pity for the weak and the needy, and he will rescue them.
verses.textEnNasb: He will have compassion on the poor and needy, And he will save the lives of the needy.
verses.textEn: He will take pity on the weak and the needy and save the needy from death.

verses.textZh: 他要救他们脱离欺凌和强暴， 他们的血在他眼中看为宝贵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要救他们脱离欺凌和强暴， 他们的血在他眼中看为宝贵。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要救赎他们脱离欺压和强暴； 他们的血在他眼中看为宝贵。
verses.textEnNiv: He will rescue them from oppression and violence, for precious is their blood in his sight.
verses.textEnEsv: From oppression and violence he redeems their life, and precious is their blood in his sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will redeem their life from oppression and violence; And precious shall be their blood in His sight.
verses.textEnNlt: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their lives are precious to him.
verses.textEnNasb: He will rescue their life from oppression and violence, And their blood will be precious in his sight;
verses.textEn: He will rescue them from oppression and violence, for precious is their blood in his sight.

verses.textZh: 愿他长久活着， 愿人把示巴的金子奉给他， 愿人为他不住祷告， 终日给他祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他长久活着， 愿人把示巴的金子奉给他， 愿人为他不住祷告， 终日给他祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要存活。 示巴的金子要奉给他； 人要常常为他祷告，终日称颂他。
verses.textEnNiv: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him and bless him all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: Long may he live; may gold of Sheba be given to him! May prayer be made for him continually, and blessings invoked for him all the day!
verses.textEnNkjv: And He shall live; And the gold of Sheba will be given to Him; Prayer also will be made for Him continually, And daily He shall be praised.
verses.textEnNlt: Long live the king! May the gold of Sheba be given to him. May the people always pray for him and bless him all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: So may he live, and may the gold of Sheba be given to him; And they are to pray for him continually; They are to bless him all day long.
verses.textEn: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him and bless him all day long.

verses.textZh: 愿地上五谷丰登， 山顶上也都丰收； 愿地上的果实茂盛，像黎巴嫩山的树林， 愿城里的人繁衍，好象地上的青草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿地上五谷丰登， 山顶上也都丰收； 愿地上的果实茂盛，像黎巴嫩山的树林， 愿城里的人繁衍，好象地上的青草。
verses.textZhCuv: 在地的山顶上，五谷必然茂盛 ； 所结的谷实要响动，如黎巴嫩的树林； 城里的人要发旺，如地上的草。
verses.textEnNiv: May grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. May the crops flourish like Lebanon and thrive like the grass of the field.
verses.textEnEsv: May there be abundance of grain in the land; on the tops of the mountains may it wave; may its fruit be like Lebanon; and may people blossom in the cities like the grass of the field!
verses.textEnNkjv: There will be an abundance of grain in the earth, On the top of the mountains; Its fruit shall wave like Lebanon; And those of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: May there be abundant grain throughout the land, flourishing even on the hilltops. May the fruit trees flourish like the trees of Lebanon, and may the people thrive like grass in a field.
verses.textEnNasb: May there be abundance of grain on the earth on top of the mountains; Its fruit will wave like the cedars of Lebanon; And may those from the city flourish like the vegetation of the earth.
verses.textEn: May grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. May the crops flourish like Lebanon and thrive like the grass of the field.

verses.textZh: 愿他的名永远常存， 愿他的名延续像太阳的恒久； 愿万人都因他蒙福， 愿万国都称他为有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他的名永远常存， 愿他的名延续像太阳的恒久； 愿万人都因他蒙福， 愿万国都称他为有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的名要存到永远， 要留传如日之久。 人要因他蒙福； 万国要称他有福。
verses.textEnNiv: May his name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun. Then all nations will be blessed through him, and they will call him blessed.
verses.textEnEsv: May his name endure forever, his fame continue as long as the sun! May people be blessed in him, all nations call him blessed!
verses.textEnNkjv: His name shall endure forever; His name shall continue as long as the sun. And men shall be blessed in Him; All nations shall call Him blessed.
verses.textEnNlt: May the king’s name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun shines. May all nations be blessed through him and bring him praise.
verses.textEnNasb: May his name endure forever; May his name produce descendants as long as the sun shines; And may people wish blessings on themselves by him; May all nations call him blessed.
verses.textEn: May his name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun. Then all nations will be blessed through him, and they will call him blessed.

verses.textZh: 独行奇事的以色列的神， 就是耶和华神，是应当称颂的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 独行奇事的以色列的神， 就是耶和华神，是应当称颂的。
verses.textZhCuv: 独行奇事的耶和华－以色列的神 是应当称颂的！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, who alone does wondrous things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, Who only does wondrous things!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does such wonderful things.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, Who alone works wonders.
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

verses.textZh: 他荣耀的名也是应当永远称颂的； 愿他的荣耀充满全地。 阿们，阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他荣耀的名也是应当永远称颂的； 愿他的荣耀充满全地。 阿们，阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他荣耀的名也当称颂，直到永远。 愿他的荣耀充满全地！ 阿们！阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and Amen!
verses.textEnNkjv: And blessed be His glorious name forever! And let the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen and Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and amen!
verses.textEnNasb: And blessed be His glorious name forever; And may the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen and Amen.
verses.textEn: Praise be to his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen.

verses.textZh: 耶西的儿子大卫的祷告完毕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶西的儿子大卫的祷告完毕。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶西的儿子－大卫的祈祷完毕。
verses.textEnNiv: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.
verses.textEnEsv: The prayers of David, the son of Jesse, are ended.
verses.textEnNkjv: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.textEnNlt: (This ends the prayers of David son of Jesse.)
verses.textEnNasb: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.textEn: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.

verses.textZh: 亚萨的诗。神实在善待以色列， 善待那些内心清洁的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的诗。神实在善待以色列， 善待那些内心清洁的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 神实在恩待以色列那些清心的人！
verses.textEnNiv: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Truly God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly God is good to Israel, To such as are pure in heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Truly God is good to Israel, to those whose hearts are pure.
verses.textEnNasb: God certainly is good to Israel, To those who are pure in heart!
verses.textEn: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我的脚几乎滑跌， 我 险些跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我的脚几乎滑跌， 我 险些跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我的脚几乎失闪； 我的脚险些滑跌。
verses.textEnNiv: But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled, my steps had nearly slipped.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; My steps had nearly slipped.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for me, I almost lost my footing. My feet were slipping, and I was almost gone.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, my feet came close to stumbling, My steps had almost slipped.
verses.textEn: But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.

verses.textZh: 我看见恶人兴隆， 我就嫉妒狂傲的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见恶人兴隆， 我就嫉妒狂傲的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见恶人和狂傲人享平安就心怀不平。
verses.textEnNiv: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: For I was envious of the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I was envious of the boastful, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: For I envied the proud when I saw them prosper despite their wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: For I was envious of the arrogant As I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.textEn: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 他们没有痛苦， 他们的身体又健康又肥壮 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们没有痛苦， 他们的身体又健康又肥壮 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们死的时候没有疼痛； 他们的力气却也壮实。
verses.textEnNiv: They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.
verses.textEnEsv: For they have no pangs until death; their bodies are fat and sleek.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thereare no pangs in their death, But their strength is firm.
verses.textEnNlt: They seem to live such painless lives; their bodies are so healthy and strong.
verses.textEnNasb: For there are no pains in their death, And their belly is fat.
verses.textEn: They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.

verses.textZh: 他们没有一般人所受的苦难， 也不像普通人一样遭遇灾害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们没有一般人所受的苦难， 也不像普通人一样遭遇灾害。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不像别人受苦， 也不像别人遭灾。
verses.textEnNiv: They are free from common human burdens; they are not plagued by human ills.
verses.textEnEsv: They are not in trouble as others are; they are not stricken like the rest of mankind.
verses.textEnNkjv: They are not in trouble asother men, Nor are they plagued like other men.
verses.textEnNlt: They don’t have troubles like other people; they’re not plagued with problems like everyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: They are not in trouble like other people, Nor are they tormented together with the rest of mankind.
verses.textEn: They are free from common human burdens; they are not plagued by human ills.

verses.textZh: 所以，骄傲像链子戴在他们的颈项上， 强暴好象衣裳穿在他们的身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，骄傲像链子戴在他们的颈项上， 强暴好象衣裳穿在他们的身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，骄傲如链子戴在他们的项上； 强暴像衣裳遮住他们的身体。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore pride is their necklace; violence covers them as a garment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore pride serves as their necklace; Violence covers them like a garment.
verses.textEnNlt: They wear pride like a jeweled necklace and clothe themselves with cruelty.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore arrogance is their necklace; The garment of violence covers them.
verses.textEn: Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.

verses.textZh: 他们的罪孽是出于麻木的心 ， 他们心里的恶念泛滥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的罪孽是出于麻木的心 ， 他们心里的恶念泛滥。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的眼睛因体胖而凸出； 他们所得的，过于心里所想的。
verses.textEnNiv: From their callous hearts comes iniquity ; their evil imaginations have no limits.
verses.textEnEsv: Their eyes swell out through fatness; their hearts overflow with follies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their eyes bulge with abundance; They have more than heart could wish.
verses.textEnNlt: These fat cats have everything their hearts could ever wish for!
verses.textEnNasb: Their eye bulges from fatness; The imaginations of their heart overflow.
verses.textEn: From their callous hearts comes iniquity ; their evil imaginations have no limits.

verses.textZh: 他们讥笑人，怀着恶意说欺压人的话，他们说话自高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们讥笑人，怀着恶意说欺压人的话，他们说话自高。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们讥笑人，凭恶意说欺压人的话； 他们说话自高。
verses.textEnNiv: They scoff, and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
verses.textEnEsv: They scoff and speak with malice; loftily they threaten oppression.
verses.textEnNkjv: They scoff and speak wickedly concerning oppression; They speak loftily.
verses.textEnNlt: They scoff and speak only evil; in their pride they seek to crush others.
verses.textEnNasb: They mock and wickedly speak of oppression; They speak from on high.
verses.textEn: They scoff, and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.

verses.textZh: 他们用口亵渎上天， 他们用舌头毁谤全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用口亵渎上天， 他们用舌头毁谤全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的口亵渎上天； 他们的舌毁谤全地。
verses.textEnNiv: Their mouths lay claim to heaven, and their tongues take possession of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongue struts through the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: They set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walks through the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: They boast against the very heavens, and their words strut throughout the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: They have set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue parades through the earth.
verses.textEn: Their mouths lay claim to heaven, and their tongues take possession of the earth.

verses.textZh: 因此他的人民归回那里去， 并且喝光了大量的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此他的人民归回那里去， 并且喝光了大量的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以神的民归到这里， 喝尽了满杯的苦水。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore his people turn back to them, and find no fault in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore his people return here, And waters of a full cup are drained by them.
verses.textEnNlt: And so the people are dismayed and confused, drinking in all their words.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore his people return here, And abundant waters are drunk by them.
verses.textEn: Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.

verses.textZh: 他们说："神怎会晓得？ 至高者有知识吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："神怎会晓得？ 至高者有知识吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：神怎能晓得？ 至高者岂有知识呢？
verses.textEnNiv: They say, "How would God know? Does the Most High know anything?"
verses.textEnEsv: And they say, "How can God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they say, "How does God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What does God know?" they ask. "Does the Most High even know what’s happening?"
verses.textEnNasb: They say, "How does God know? And is there knowledge with the Most High?"
verses.textEn: They say, "How would God know? Does the Most High know anything?"

verses.textZh: 看这些恶人， 他们常享安逸，财富却增加。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看这些恶人， 他们常享安逸，财富却增加。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，这就是恶人； 他们既是常享安逸，财宝便加增。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the wicked are like— always free of care, they go on amassing wealth.
