verses.textEnEsv: Behold, these are the wicked; always at ease, they increase in riches.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, these are the ungodly, Who are always at ease; They increase in riches.
verses.textEnNlt: Look at these wicked people— enjoying a life of ease while their riches multiply.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, these are the wicked; And always at ease, they have increased in wealth.
verses.textEn: This is what the wicked are like— always free of care, they go on amassing wealth.

verses.textZh: 我谨守我心纯洁实在徒然； 我洗手表明清白也是枉然。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我谨守我心纯洁实在徒然； 我洗手表明清白也是枉然。
verses.textZhCuv: 我实在徒然洁净了我的心， 徒然洗手表明无辜。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure and have washed my hands in innocence.
verses.textEnEsv: All in vain have I kept my heart clean and washed my hands in innocence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, And washed my hands in innocence.
verses.textEnNlt: Did I keep my heart pure for nothing? Did I keep myself innocent for no reason?
verses.textEnNasb: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure And washed my hands in innocence;
verses.textEn: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure and have washed my hands in innocence.

verses.textZh: 因为我终日受伤害， 每天早晨受惩罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我终日受伤害， 每天早晨受惩罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，我终日遭灾难； 每早晨受惩治。
verses.textEnNiv: All day long I have been afflicted, and every morning brings new punishments.
verses.textEnEsv: For all the day long I have been stricken and rebuked every morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all day long I have been plagued, And chastened every morning.
verses.textEnNlt: I get nothing but trouble all day long; every morning brings me pain.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have been stricken all day long, And punished every morning.
verses.textEn: All day long I have been afflicted, and every morning brings new punishments.

verses.textZh: 如果我心里说："我要说这样的话"， 我就是对你这一代的众儿女不忠了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我心里说："我要说这样的话"， 我就是对你这一代的众儿女不忠了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若说，我要这样讲， 这就是以奸诈待你的众子。
verses.textEnNiv: If I had spoken out like that, I would have betrayed your children.
verses.textEnEsv: If I had said, "I will speak thus," I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I had said, "I will speak thus," Behold, I would have been untrue to the generation of Your children.
verses.textEnNlt: If I had really spoken this way to others, I would have been a traitor to your people.
verses.textEnNasb: If I had said, "I will speak this way," Behold, I would have betrayed the generation of Your children.
verses.textEn: If I had spoken out like that, I would have betrayed your children.

verses.textZh: 我思想要明白这事， 我就看为烦恼；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我思想要明白这事， 我就看为烦恼；
verses.textZhCuv: 我思索怎能明白这事， 眼看实系为难，
verses.textEnNiv: When I tried to understand all this, it troubled me deeply
verses.textEnEsv: But when I thought how to understand this, it seemed to me a wearisome task,
verses.textEnNkjv: When I thought how to understand this, It was too painful for me—
verses.textEnNlt: So I tried to understand why the wicked prosper. But what a difficult task it is!
verses.textEnNasb: When I thought of understanding this, It was troublesome in my sight
verses.textEn: When I tried to understand all this, it troubled me deeply

verses.textZh: 直到我进了神的圣所， 才明白他们的结局。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到我进了神的圣所， 才明白他们的结局。
verses.textZhCuv: 等我进了神的圣所， 思想他们的结局。
verses.textEnNiv: till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their final destiny.
verses.textEnEsv: until I went into the sanctuary of God; then I discerned their end.
verses.textEnNkjv: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; Then I understood their end.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I went into your sanctuary, O God, and I finally understood the destiny of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: Until I entered the sanctuary of God; Then I perceived their end.
verses.textEn: till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their final destiny.

verses.textZh: 你实在把他们安放在滑地， 使他们倒下、灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你实在把他们安放在滑地， 使他们倒下、灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 你实在把他们安在滑地， 使他们掉在沉沦之中。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely you place them on slippery ground; you cast them down to ruin.
verses.textEnEsv: Truly you set them in slippery places; you make them fall to ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely You set them in slippery places; You cast them down to destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: Truly, you put them on a slippery path and send them sliding over the cliff to destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: You indeed put them on slippery ground; You dropped them into ruin.
verses.textEn: Surely you place them on slippery ground; you cast them down to ruin.

verses.textZh: 他们忽然间成了多么荒凉， 被突然的惊恐完全消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们忽然间成了多么荒凉， 被突然的惊恐完全消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们转眼之间成了何等的荒凉！ 他们被惊恐灭尽了。
verses.textEnNiv: How suddenly are they destroyed, completely swept away by terrors!
verses.textEnEsv: How they are destroyed in a moment, swept away utterly by terrors!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, how they are brought to desolation, as in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.textEnNlt: In an instant they are destroyed, completely swept away by terrors.
verses.textEnNasb: How they are destroyed in a moment! They are utterly swept away by sudden terrors!
verses.textEn: How suddenly are they destroyed, completely swept away by terrors!

verses.textZh: 人睡醒了怎样看梦， 主啊！你睡醒了，也要照样轻看他们 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人睡醒了怎样看梦， 主啊！你睡醒了，也要照样轻看他们 。
verses.textZhCuv: 人睡醒了，怎样看梦； 主啊，你醒了也必照样轻看他们的影像。
verses.textEnNiv: They are like a dream when one awakes; when you arise, Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.
verses.textEnEsv: Like a dream when one awakes, O Lord, when you rouse yourself, you despise them as phantoms.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a dream when one awakes, So, Lord, when You awake, You shall despise their image.
verses.textEnNlt: When you arise, O Lord, you will laugh at their silly ideas as a person laughs at dreams in the morning.
verses.textEnNasb: Like a dream when one awakes, Lord, when stirred, You will despise their image.
verses.textEn: They are like a dream when one awakes; when you arise, Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.

verses.textZh: 我心中酸苦， 我肺腑刺痛的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心中酸苦， 我肺腑刺痛的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 因而，我心里发酸， 肺腑被刺。
verses.textEnNiv: When my heart was grieved and my spirit embittered,
verses.textEnEsv: When my soul was embittered, when I was pricked in heart,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus my heart was grieved, And I was vexed in my mind.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I realized that my heart was bitter, and I was all torn up inside.
verses.textEnNasb: When my heart was embittered And I was pierced within,
verses.textEn: When my heart was grieved and my spirit embittered,

verses.textZh: 我是愚昧无知的； 我在你面前就像畜类一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是愚昧无知的； 我在你面前就像畜类一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 我这样愚昧无知， 在你面前如畜类一般。
verses.textEnNiv: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before you.
verses.textEnEsv: I was brutish and ignorant; I was like a beast toward you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was so foolish and ignorant; I was like a beast before You.
verses.textEnNlt: I was so foolish and ignorant— I must have seemed like a senseless animal to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I was stupid and ignorant; I was like an animal before You.
verses.textEn: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before you.

verses.textZh: 但是，我仍常与你同在； 你紧握着我的右手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，我仍常与你同在； 你紧握着我的右手。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我常与你同在； 你搀着我的右手。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, I am continually with you; you hold my right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless I am continually with You; You hold me by my right hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I still belong to you; you hold my right hand.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless I am continually with You; You have taken hold of my right hand.
verses.textEn: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.

verses.textZh: 你要以你的训言引领我， 以后还要接我到荣耀里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要以你的训言引领我， 以后还要接我到荣耀里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要以你的训言引导我， 以后必接我到荣耀里。
verses.textEnNiv: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.
verses.textEnEsv: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will receive me to glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will guide me with Your counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.
verses.textEnNlt: You guide me with your counsel, leading me to a glorious destiny.
verses.textEnNasb: You will guide me with Your plan, And afterward receive me to glory.
verses.textEn: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.

verses.textZh: 除你以外，在天上，我还有谁呢？ 除你以外，在地上，我也无所爱慕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除你以外，在天上，我还有谁呢？ 除你以外，在地上，我也无所爱慕。
verses.textZhCuv: 除你以外，在天上我有谁呢？ 除你以外，在地上我也没有所爱慕的。
verses.textEnNiv: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.
verses.textEnEsv: Whom have I in heaven but you? And there is nothing on earth that I desire besides you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whom have I in heaven butYou? And thereis none upon earth that I desire besides You.
verses.textEnNlt: Whom have I in heaven but you? I desire you more than anything on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Whom do I have in heaven but You? And with You, I desire nothing on earth.
verses.textEn: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.

verses.textZh: 我的肉身和我的内心虽然渐渐衰弱，神却永远是我心里的盘石，是我的业分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的肉身和我的内心虽然渐渐衰弱，神却永远是我心里的盘石，是我的业分。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的肉体和我的心肠衰残； 但神是我心里的力量， 又是我的福分，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.textEnEsv: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: My flesh and my heart fail; But God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.textEnNlt: My health may fail, and my spirit may grow weak, but God remains the strength of my heart; he is mine forever.
verses.textEnNasb: My flesh and my heart may fail, But God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.textEn: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

verses.textZh: 看哪！远离你的，必定灭亡； 凡是对你不贞的，你都要灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！远离你的，必定灭亡； 凡是对你不贞的，你都要灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 远离你的，必要死亡； 凡离弃你行邪淫的，你都灭绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are far from you will perish; you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, those who are far from you shall perish; you put an end to everyone who is unfaithful to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed, those who are far from You shall perish; You have destroyed all those who desert You for harlotry.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who desert him will perish, for you destroy those who abandon you.
verses.textEnNasb: For, behold, those who are far from You will perish; You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to You.
verses.textEn: Those who are far from you will perish; you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.

verses.textZh: 对我来说，亲近神是美好的， 我以主耶和华为我的避难所； 我要述说你的一切作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对我来说，亲近神是美好的， 我以主耶和华为我的避难所； 我要述说你的一切作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我亲近神是与我有益； 我以主耶和华为我的避难所， 好叫我述说你一切的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: But as for me, it is good to be near God. I have made the Sovereign Lord my refuge; I will tell of all your deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: But for me it is good to be near God; I have made the Lord God my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
verses.textEnNkjv: But itis good for me to draw near to God; I have put my trust in the Lord God, That I may declare all Your works.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for me, how good it is to be near God! I have made the Sovereign Lord my shelter, and I will tell everyone about the wonderful things you do.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, the nearness of God is good for me; I have made the Lord God my refuge, So that I may tell of all Your works.
verses.textEn: But as for me, it is good to be near God. I have made the Sovereign Lord my refuge; I will tell of all your deeds.

verses.textZh: 亚萨的训诲诗。神啊！你为甚么永远丢弃我们呢？ 为甚么你的怒气向你草场上的羊群好象烟冒出呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的训诲诗。神啊！你为甚么永远丢弃我们呢？ 为甚么你的怒气向你草场上的羊群好象烟冒出呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你为何永远丢弃我们呢？ 你为何向你草场的羊发怒，如烟冒出呢？
verses.textEnNiv: O God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
verses.textEnEsv: O God, why do you cast us off forever? Why does your anger smoke against the sheep of your pasture?
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, why have You cast us off forever? Why does Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your pasture?
verses.textEnNlt: O God, why have you rejected us so long? Why is your anger so intense against the sheep of your own pasture?
verses.textEnNasb: God, why have You rejected us forever? Why does Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your pasture?
verses.textEn: O God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

verses.textZh: 求你记念你在古时买赎的会众， 就是你赎回作你产业的民族； 求你记念你所居住的锡安山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你记念你在古时买赎的会众， 就是你赎回作你产业的民族； 求你记念你所居住的锡安山。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你记念你古时所得来的会众， 就是你所赎、作你产业支派的， 并记念你向来所居住的锡安山。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember the nation you purchased long ago, the people of your inheritance, whom you redeemed— Mount Zion, where you dwelt.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember your congregation, which you have purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your heritage! Remember Mount Zion, where you have dwelt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember Your congregation, which You have purchased of old, The tribe of Your inheritance, which You have redeemed— This Mount Zion where You have dwelt.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that we are the people you chose long ago, the tribe you redeemed as your own special possession! And remember Jerusalem, your home here on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased of old, Which You have redeemed to be the tribe of Your inheritance; And this Mount Zion, where You have dwelt.
verses.textEn: Remember the nation you purchased long ago, the people of your inheritance, whom you redeemed— Mount Zion, where you dwelt.

verses.textZh: 求你举步去看那些长久荒凉的地方， 去看仇敌在圣所里所行的一切恶事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你举步去看那些长久荒凉的地方， 去看仇敌在圣所里所行的一切恶事。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你举步去看那日久荒凉之地， 仇敌在圣所中所行的一切恶事。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: Direct your steps to the perpetual ruins; the enemy has destroyed everything in the sanctuary!
verses.textEnNkjv: Lift up Your feet to the perpetual desolations. The enemy has damaged everything in the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: Walk through the awful ruins of the city; see how the enemy has destroyed your sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: Step toward the irreparable ruins; The enemy has damaged everything in the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 你的敌人在敬拜你的聚会中吼叫， 他们竖起了自己的旗帜为记号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的敌人在敬拜你的聚会中吼叫， 他们竖起了自己的旗帜为记号。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的敌人在你会中吼叫； 他们竖了自己的旗为记号。
verses.textEnNiv: Your foes roared in the place where you met with us; they set up their standards as signs.
verses.textEnEsv: Your foes have roared in the midst of your meeting place; they set up their own signs for signs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your enemies roar in the midst of Your meeting place; They set up their banners for signs.
verses.textEnNlt: There your enemies shouted their victorious battle cries; there they set up their battle standards.
verses.textEnNasb: Your adversaries have roared in the midst of Your meeting place; They have set up their own signs as signs.
verses.textEn: Your foes roared in the place where you met with us; they set up their standards as signs.

verses.textZh: 他们好象那些举起斧子， 在树林中砍伐树木的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们好象那些举起斧子， 在树林中砍伐树木的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们好像人扬起斧子， 砍伐林中的树。
verses.textEnNiv: They behaved like men wielding axes to cut through a thicket of trees.
verses.textEnEsv: They were like those who swing axes in a forest of trees.
verses.textEnNkjv: They seem like men who lift up Axes among the thick trees.
verses.textEnNlt: They swung their axes like woodcutters in a forest.
verses.textEnNasb: It seems like one bringing up His axe into a forest of trees.
verses.textEn: They behaved like men wielding axes to cut through a thicket of trees.

verses.textZh: 圣殿中的一切雕刻， 他们都用斧子和铳子打碎了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣殿中的一切雕刻， 他们都用斧子和铳子打碎了。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣所中一切雕刻的， 他们现在用斧子锤子打坏了。
verses.textEnNiv: They smashed all the carved paneling with their axes and hatchets.
verses.textEnEsv: And all its carved wood they broke down with hatchets and hammers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now they break down its carved work, all at once, With axes and hammers.
verses.textEnNlt: With axes and picks, they smashed the carved paneling.
verses.textEnNasb: And now they break down all its carved work With axe and hammers.
verses.textEn: They smashed all the carved paneling with their axes and hatchets.

verses.textZh: 他们用火把你的圣所烧成焦土， 他们亵渎你名的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用火把你的圣所烧成焦土， 他们亵渎你名的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们用火焚烧你的圣所， 亵渎你名的居所，拆毁到地。
verses.textEnNiv: They burned your sanctuary to the ground; they defiled the dwelling place of your Name.
verses.textEnEsv: They set your sanctuary on fire; they profaned the dwelling place of your name, bringing it down to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have set fire to Your sanctuary; They have defiled the dwelling place of Your name to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: They burned your sanctuary to the ground. They defiled the place that bears your name.
verses.textEnNasb: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; They have defiled the dwelling place of Your name.
verses.textEn: They burned your sanctuary to the ground; they defiled the dwelling place of your Name.

verses.textZh: 他们心里说："我们要把它们完全毁灭！" 他们烧毁了地上一切敬拜神的聚会地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们心里说："我们要把它们完全毁灭！" 他们烧毁了地上一切敬拜神的聚会地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们心里说：我们要尽行毁灭； 他们就在遍地把神的会所都烧毁了。
verses.textEnNiv: They said in their hearts, "We will crush them completely!" They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to themselves, "We will utterly subdue them"; they burned all the meeting places of God in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: They said in their hearts, "Let us destroy them altogether." They have burned up all the meeting places of God in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they thought, "Let’s destroy everything!" So they burned down all the places where God was worshiped.
verses.textEnNasb: They said in their heart, "Let’s completely subdue them." They have burned all the meeting places of God in the land.
verses.textEn: They said in their hearts, "We will crush them completely!" They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.

verses.textZh: 我们看不见我们的记号， 也不再有先知； 我们中间也没有人知道这灾祸要到几时。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们看不见我们的记号， 也不再有先知； 我们中间也没有人知道这灾祸要到几时。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不见我们的标帜，不再有先知； 我们内中也没有人知道这灾祸要到几时呢！
verses.textEnNiv: We are given no signs from God; no prophets are left, and none of us knows how long this will be.
verses.textEnEsv: We do not see our signs; there is no longer any prophet, and there is none among us who knows how long.
verses.textEnNkjv: We do not see our signs; Thereis no longer any prophet; Nor isthere any among us who knows how long.
verses.textEnNlt: We no longer see your miraculous signs. All the prophets are gone, and no one can tell us when it will end.
verses.textEnNasb: We do not see our signs; There is no longer any prophet, Nor is there anyone among us who knows how long.
verses.textEn: We are given no signs from God; no prophets are left, and none of us knows how long this will be.

verses.textZh: 神啊！敌人辱骂你要到几时呢？ 仇敌亵慢你的名要到永远吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！敌人辱骂你要到几时呢？ 仇敌亵慢你的名要到永远吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，敌人辱骂要到几时呢？ 仇敌亵渎你的名要到永远吗？
verses.textEnNiv: How long will the enemy mock you, God? Will the foe revile your name forever?
verses.textEnEsv: How long, O God, is the foe to scoff? Is the enemy to revile your name forever?
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, how long will the adversary reproach? Will the enemy blaspheme Your name forever?
verses.textEnNlt: How long, O God, will you allow our enemies to insult you? Will you let them dishonor your name forever?
verses.textEnNasb: How long, God, will the enemy taunt You? Shall the enemy treat Your name disrespectfully forever?
verses.textEn: How long will the enemy mock you, God? Will the foe revile your name forever?

verses.textZh: 你为甚么把你的手，就是你的右手收回呢？ 求你从怀中抽出来毁灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么把你的手，就是你的右手收回呢？ 求你从怀中抽出来毁灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你为什么缩回你的右手？ 求你从怀中伸出来，毁灭他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take it from the folds of your garment and destroy them!
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take it from the fold of your garment and destroy them!
verses.textEnNkjv: Why do You withdraw Your hand, even Your right hand? Takeit out of Your bosom and destroy them.
verses.textEnNlt: Why do you hold back your strong right hand? Unleash your powerful fist and destroy them.
verses.textEnNasb: Why do You withdraw Your hand, even Your right hand? Extend it from Your chest and destroy them!
verses.textEn: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take it from the folds of your garment and destroy them!

verses.textZh: 神自古以来就是我的君王， 在地上施行拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神自古以来就是我的君王， 在地上施行拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 神自古以来为我的王， 在地上施行拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: But God is my King from long ago; he brings salvation on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet God my King is from of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God is my King from of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: You, O God, are my king from ages past, bringing salvation to the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet God is my King from long ago, Who performs acts of salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.textEn: But God is my King from long ago; he brings salvation on the earth.

verses.textZh: 你曾用你的大能分开大海， 把海中怪兽的头都打碎了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾用你的大能分开大海， 把海中怪兽的头都打碎了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾用能力将海分开， 将水中大鱼的头打破。
verses.textEnNiv: It was you who split open the sea by your power; you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.
verses.textEnEsv: You divided the sea by your might; you broke the heads of the sea monsters on the waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: You divided the sea by Your strength; You broke the heads of the sea serpents in the waters.
verses.textEnNlt: You split the sea by your strength and smashed the heads of the sea monsters.
verses.textEnNasb: You divided the sea by Your strength; You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
verses.textEn: It was you who split open the sea by your power; you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.

verses.textZh: 你砸碎了利未亚坦 的头， 把牠给住在旷野的人作食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你砸碎了利未亚坦 的头， 把牠给住在旷野的人作食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾砸碎鳄鱼的头， 把它给旷野的禽兽 为食物。
verses.textEnNiv: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave it as food to the creatures of the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; you gave him as food for the creatures of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces, And gave him as food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: You crushed the heads of Leviathan and let the desert animals eat him.
verses.textEnNasb: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You gave him as food for the creatures of the wilderness.
verses.textEn: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave it as food to the creatures of the desert.

verses.textZh: 你曾开辟泉源和溪流， 又使长流不息的江河干涸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾开辟泉源和溪流， 又使长流不息的江河干涸。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾分裂磐石，水便成了溪河； 你使长流的江河干了。
verses.textEnNiv: It was you who opened up springs and streams; you dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
verses.textEnEsv: You split open springs and brooks; you dried up ever-flowing streams.
verses.textEnNkjv: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up mighty rivers.
verses.textEnNlt: You caused the springs and streams to gush forth, and you dried up rivers that never run dry.
verses.textEnNasb: You broke open springs and torrents; You dried up ever-flowing streams.
verses.textEn: It was you who opened up springs and streams; you dried up the ever-flowing rivers.

verses.textZh: 白昼是你的，黑夜也是你的， 月亮和太阳，都是你设立的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 白昼是你的，黑夜也是你的， 月亮和太阳，都是你设立的。
verses.textZhCuv: 白昼属你，黑夜也属你； 亮光和日头是你所预备的。
verses.textEnNiv: The day is yours, and yours also the night; you established the sun and moon.
verses.textEnEsv: Yours is the day, yours also the night; you have established the heavenly lights and the sun.
verses.textEnNkjv: The day is Yours, the night also is Yours; You have prepared the light and the sun.
verses.textEnNlt: Both day and night belong to you; you made the starlight and the sun.
verses.textEnNasb: Yours is the day, Yours also is the night; You have prepared the light and the sun.
verses.textEn: The day is yours, and yours also the night; you established the sun and moon.

verses.textZh: 地上的一切疆界都是你立定的， 夏天和冬天都是你制定的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上的一切疆界都是你立定的， 夏天和冬天都是你制定的。
verses.textZhCuv: 地的一切疆界是你所立的； 夏天和冬天是你所定的。
verses.textEnNiv: It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth; you made both summer and winter.
verses.textEnEsv: You have fixed all the boundaries of the earth; you have made summer and winter.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have set all the borders of the earth; You have made summer and winter.
verses.textEnNlt: You set the boundaries of the earth, and you made both summer and winter.
verses.textEnNasb: You have established all the boundaries of the earth; You have created summer and winter.
verses.textEn: It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth; you made both summer and winter.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！仇敌辱骂你， 愚顽人亵渎你的名， 求你记念这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！仇敌辱骂你， 愚顽人亵渎你的名， 求你记念这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，仇敌辱骂， 愚顽民亵渎了你的名，求你记念这事。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember how the enemy has mocked you, Lord , how foolish people have reviled your name.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember this, O Lord , how the enemy scoffs, and a foolish people reviles your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember this, that the enemy has reproached, O Lord, And that a foolish people has blasphemed Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: See how these enemies insult you, Lord . A foolish nation has dishonored your name.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember this, Lord, that the enemy has taunted You, And a foolish people has treated Your name disrespectfully.
verses.textEn: Remember how the enemy has mocked you, Lord , how foolish people have reviled your name.

verses.textZh: 求你不要把你斑鸠的性命交给野兽， 不要永远忘记你困苦人的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要把你斑鸠的性命交给野兽， 不要永远忘记你困苦人的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要将你斑鸠的性命交给野兽； 不要永远忘记你困苦人的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts; do not forget the lives of your afflicted people forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not deliver the soul of your dove to the wild beasts; do not forget the life of your poor forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, do not deliver the life of Your turtledove to the wild beast! Do not forget the life of Your poor forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let these wild beasts destroy your turtledoves. Don’t forget your suffering people forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not give the soul of Your turtledove to the wild animal; Do not forget the life of Your afflicted forever.
verses.textEn: Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts; do not forget the lives of your afflicted people forever.

verses.textZh: 求你顾念所立的约， 因为地上黑暗的地方充满了强暴的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你顾念所立的约， 因为地上黑暗的地方充满了强暴的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你顾念所立的约， 因为地上黑暗之处都满了强暴的居所。
verses.textEnNiv: Have regard for your covenant, because haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Have regard for the covenant, for the dark places of the land are full of the habitations of violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have respect to the covenant; For the dark places of the earth are full of the haunts of cruelty.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember your covenant promises, for the land is full of darkness and violence!
verses.textEnNasb: Consider the covenant; For the dark places of the land are full of the places of violence.
verses.textEn: Have regard for your covenant, because haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

verses.textZh: 不要使受欺压的人蒙羞回去， 要使困苦、贫穷的人赞美你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要使受欺压的人蒙羞回去， 要使困苦、贫穷的人赞美你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要叫受欺压的人蒙羞回去； 要叫困苦穷乏的人赞美你的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace; may the poor and needy praise your name.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not the downtrodden turn back in shame; let the poor and needy praise your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, do not let the oppressed return ashamed! Let the poor and needy praise Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let the downtrodden be humiliated again. Instead, let the poor and needy praise your name.
verses.textEnNasb: May the oppressed person not return dishonored; May the afflicted and the needy praise Your name.
verses.textEn: Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace; may the poor and needy praise your name.

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你起来，为你的案件辩护， 要记得愚顽人终日对你的辱骂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你起来，为你的案件辩护， 要记得愚顽人终日对你的辱骂。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你起来为自己伸诉！ 要记念愚顽人怎样终日辱骂你。
verses.textEnNiv: Rise up, O God, and defend your cause; remember how fools mock you all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, O God, defend your cause; remember how the foolish scoff at you all the day!
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, O God, plead Your own cause; Remember how the foolish man reproaches You daily.
verses.textEnNlt: Arise, O God, and defend your cause. Remember how these fools insult you all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, God, and plead Your own cause; Remember how the foolish person taunts You all day long.
verses.textEn: Rise up, O God, and defend your cause; remember how fools mock you all day long.

verses.textZh: 求你不要忘记你敌人的声音， 不要忘记那些起来与你为敌的人不住加剧地喧闹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要忘记你敌人的声音， 不要忘记那些起来与你为敌的人不住加剧地喧闹。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要忘记你敌人的声音； 那起来敌你之人的喧哗时常上升。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not ignore the clamor of your adversaries, the uproar of your enemies, which rises continually.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not forget the clamor of your foes, the uproar of those who rise against you, which goes up continually!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not forget the voice of Your enemies; The tumult of those who rise up against You increases continually.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t overlook what your enemies have said or their growing uproar.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not forget the voice of Your adversaries, The uproar of those who rise against You, which ascends continually.
verses.textEn: Do not ignore the clamor of your adversaries, the uproar of your enemies, which rises continually.

verses.textZh: 歌一首，亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，调用"休要毁坏"。神啊！我们称谢你，我们称谢你， 因为你 接近人， 人都述说你奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌一首，亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，调用"休要毁坏"。神啊！我们称谢你，我们称谢你， 因为你 接近人， 人都述说你奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我们称谢你，我们称谢你！ 因为你的名相近，人都述说你奇妙的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: We praise you, God, we praise you, for your Name is near; people tell of your wonderful deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: We give thanks to you, O God; we give thanks, for your name is near. We recount your wondrous deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: We give thanks to You, O God, we give thanks! For Your wondrous works declare that Your name is near.
verses.textEnNlt: We thank you, O God! We give thanks because you are near. People everywhere tell of your wonderful deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: We give thanks to You, God, we give thanks, For Your name is near; People declare Your wondrous works.
verses.textEn: We praise you, God, we praise you, for your Name is near; people tell of your wonderful deeds.

verses.textZh: 你说："我选定了日期， 我要按公正施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你说："我选定了日期， 我要按公正施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 我到了所定的日期， 必按正直施行审判。
verses.textEnNiv: You say, "I choose the appointed time; it is I who judge with equity.
verses.textEnEsv: "At the set time that I appoint I will judge with equity.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When I choose the proper time, I will judge uprightly.
verses.textEnNlt: God says, "At the time I have planned, I will bring justice against the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: "When I select an appointed time, It is I who judge fairly.
verses.textEn: You say, "I choose the appointed time; it is I who judge with equity.

verses.textZh: 地和地上的居民都因惧怕而融化， 我却使大地的柱子坚立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地和地上的居民都因惧怕而融化， 我却使大地的柱子坚立。
verses.textZhCuv: 地和其上的居民都消化了； 我曾立了地的柱子。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: When the earth and all its people quake, it is I who hold its pillars firm.
verses.textEnEsv: When the earth totters, and all its inhabitants, it is I who keep steady its pillars. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth and all its inhabitants are dissolved; I set up its pillars firmly. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: When the earth quakes and its people live in turmoil, I am the one who keeps its foundations firm. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: "The earth and all who inhabit it are unsteady; It is I who have firmly set its pillars. Selah
verses.textEn: When the earth and all its people quake, it is I who hold its pillars firm.

verses.textZh: 我对狂傲的人说：‘不要行事狂傲’； 对邪恶的人说：‘不要举角，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对狂傲的人说：‘不要行事狂傲’； 对邪恶的人说：‘不要举角，
verses.textZhCuv: 我对狂傲人说：不要行事狂傲！ 对凶恶人说：不要举角！
verses.textEnNiv: To the arrogant I say, ‘Boast no more,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horns.
verses.textEnEsv: I say to the boastful, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn;
verses.textEnNkjv: "I said to the boastful, ‘Do not deal boastfully,’ And to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up the horn.
verses.textEnNlt: "I warned the proud, ‘Stop your boasting!’ I told the wicked, ‘Don’t raise your fists!
verses.textEnNasb: "I said to the boastful, ‘Do not boast,’ And to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up the horn;
verses.textEn: To the arrogant I say, ‘Boast no more,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horns.

verses.textZh: 不要高举你们的角， 不要挺着傲慢的颈项说话。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要高举你们的角， 不要挺着傲慢的颈项说话。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 不要把你们的角高举； 不要挺着颈项说话。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not lift your horns against heaven; do not speak so defiantly.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: do not lift up your horn on high, or speak with haughty neck.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not lift up your horn on high; Do not speak with a stiff neck.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t raise your fists in defiance at the heavens or speak with such arrogance.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Do not lift up your horn on high, Do not speak with insolent pride.’ "
verses.textEn: Do not lift your horns against heaven; do not speak so defiantly.’ "

verses.textZh: 高升不是从东面来，不是从西面来， 也不是旷野来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 高升不是从东面来，不是从西面来， 也不是旷野来，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为高举非从东，非从西， 也非从南而来。
verses.textEnNiv: No one from the east or the west or from the desert can exalt themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: For not from the east or from the west and not from the wilderness comes lifting up,
verses.textEnNkjv: For exaltation comes neither from the east Nor from the west nor from the south.
verses.textEnNlt: For no one on earth—from east or west, or even from the wilderness— should raise a defiant fist.
verses.textEnNasb: For not from the east, nor from the west, Nor from the desert comes exaltation;
verses.textEn: No one from the east or the west or from the desert can exalt themselves.

verses.textZh: 而是由神来决定； 他使这人降卑，使那人升高。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而是由神来决定； 他使这人降卑，使那人升高。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有神断定； 他使这人降卑，使那人升高。
verses.textEnNiv: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verses.textEnEsv: but it is God who executes judgment, putting down one and lifting up another.
verses.textEnNkjv: But God is the Judge: He puts down one, And exalts another.
verses.textEnNlt: It is God alone who judges; he decides who will rise and who will fall.
verses.textEnNasb: But God is the Judge; He puts down one and exalts another.
verses.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.

verses.textZh: 原来耶和华的手里有杯， 装满了起沫和混杂各种香料的酒； 他把酒从杯里倒出来，地上所有的恶人都必定要喝， 甚至连酒的渣滓都要喝尽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来耶和华的手里有杯， 装满了起沫和混杂各种香料的酒； 他把酒从杯里倒出来，地上所有的恶人都必定要喝， 甚至连酒的渣滓都要喝尽。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华手里有杯， 其中的酒起沫，杯内满了搀杂的酒； 他倒出来， 地上的恶人必都喝这酒的渣滓，而且喝尽。
verses.textEnNiv: In the hand of the Lord is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs.
verses.textEnEsv: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup with foaming wine, well mixed, and he pours out from it, and all the wicked of the earth shall drain it down to the dregs.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in the hand of the Lordthereis a cup, And the wine is red; It is fully mixed, and He pours it out; Surely its dregs shall all the wicked of the earth Drain and drink down.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord holds a cup in his hand that is full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours out the wine in judgment, and all the wicked must drink it, draining it to the dregs.
verses.textEnNasb: For a cup is in the hand of the Lord, and the wine foams; It is well mixed, and He pours out of this; Certainly all the wicked of the earth must drain and drink its dregs.
verses.textEn: In the hand of the Lord is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我要永远传扬， 我要向雅各的神歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我要永远传扬， 我要向雅各的神歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我要宣扬，直到永远！ 我要歌颂雅各的神！
verses.textEnNiv: As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob,
verses.textEnEsv: But I will declare it forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will declare forever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for me, I will always proclaim what God has done; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, I will declare it forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.textEn: As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob,

verses.textZh: 所有恶人的角，我都要砍断， 只有义人的角必被高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有恶人的角，我都要砍断， 只有义人的角必被高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人一切的角，我要砍断； 惟有义人的角必被高举。
verses.textEnNiv: who says, "I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up."
verses.textEnEsv: All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
verses.textEnNkjv: "All the horns of the wicked I will also cut off, But the horns of the righteous shall be exalted."
verses.textEnNlt: For God says, "I will break the strength of the wicked, but I will increase the power of the godly."
verses.textEnNasb: And He will cut off all the horns of the wicked, But the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.
verses.textEn: who says, "I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up."

verses.textZh: 歌一首，亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。 在犹大，神是人人所认识的， 在以色列，他的名被尊为大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌一首，亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，用丝弦的乐器伴奏。 在犹大，神是人人所认识的， 在以色列，他的名被尊为大。
verses.textZhCuv: 在犹大，神为人所认识； 在以色列，他的名为大。
verses.textEnNiv: God is renowned in Judah; in Israel his name is great.
verses.textEnEsv: In Judah God is known; his name is great in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: In Judah God is known; His name is great in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: God is honored in Judah; his name is great in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
verses.textEn: God is renowned in Judah; in Israel his name is great.

verses.textZh: 他的帐棚是在撒冷， 他的居所是在锡安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的帐棚是在撒冷， 他的居所是在锡安。
verses.textZhCuv: 在撒冷有他的帐幕； 在锡安有他的居所。
verses.textEnNiv: His tent is in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: His abode has been established in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: In Salem also is His tabernacle, And His dwelling place in Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem is where he lives; Mount Zion is his home.
verses.textEnNasb: His tabernacle is in Salem; His dwelling place also is in Zion.
verses.textEn: His tent is in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.

verses.textZh: 在那里他折断了弓上的火箭， 拆毁了盾牌、刀剑和争战的兵器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里他折断了弓上的火箭， 拆毁了盾牌、刀剑和争战的兵器。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在那里折断弓上的火箭， 并盾牌、刀剑，和争战的兵器。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shields and the swords, the weapons of war.
verses.textEnEsv: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shield, the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: There He broke the arrows of the bow, The shield and sword of battle. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: There he has broken the fiery arrows of the enemy, the shields and swords and weapons of war. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: There He broke the flaming arrows, The shield, the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah
verses.textEn: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shields and the swords, the weapons of war.

verses.textZh: 你满有光华和荣美， 胜过猎物丰富的群山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你满有光华和荣美， 胜过猎物丰富的群山。
verses.textZhCuv: 你从有野食之山而来， 有光华和荣美。
verses.textEnNiv: You are radiant with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.
verses.textEnEsv: Glorious are you, more majestic than the mountains full of prey.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are more glorious and excellent Than the mountains of prey.
verses.textEnNlt: You are glorious and more majestic than the everlasting mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: You are resplendent, More majestic than the mountains of prey.
verses.textEn: You are radiant with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.

verses.textZh: 心里勇敢的人都被抢掠， 他们长睡不起； 所有大能的勇士都无力举手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心里勇敢的人都被抢掠， 他们长睡不起； 所有大能的勇士都无力举手。
verses.textZhCuv: 心中勇敢的人都被抢夺； 他们睡了长觉，没有一个英雄能措手。
verses.textEnNiv: The valiant lie plundered, they sleep their last sleep; not one of the warriors can lift his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: The stouthearted were stripped of their spoil; they sank into sleep; all the men of war were unable to use their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: The stouthearted were plundered; They have sunk into their sleep; And none of the mighty men have found the use of their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Our boldest enemies have been plundered. They lie before us in the sleep of death. No warrior could lift a hand against us.
verses.textEnNasb: The stouthearted were plundered, They sank into sleep; And none of the warriors could use his hands.
verses.textEn: The valiant lie plundered, they sleep their last sleep; not one of the warriors can lift his hands.

verses.textZh: 雅各的神啊！因你的斥责，坐车的和骑马的都沉睡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各的神啊！因你的斥责，坐车的和骑马的都沉睡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的神啊，你的斥责一发， 坐车的、骑马的都沉睡了。
verses.textEnNiv: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still.
verses.textEnEsv: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both rider and horse lay stunned.
verses.textEnNkjv: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both the chariot and horse were cast into a dead sleep.
verses.textEnNlt: At the blast of your breath, O God of Jacob, their horses and chariots lay still.
verses.textEnNasb: At Your rebuke, God of Jacob, Both rider and horse were cast into a dead sleep.
verses.textEn: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still.

verses.textZh: 唯有你是可畏的， 你的烈怒一发出，谁能在你面前站立得住呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有你是可畏的， 你的烈怒一发出，谁能在你面前站立得住呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独你是可畏的！ 你怒气一发，谁能在你面前站得住呢？
verses.textEnNiv: It is you alone who are to be feared. Who can stand before you when you are angry?
verses.textEnEsv: But you, you are to be feared! Who can stand before you when once your anger is roused?
verses.textEnNkjv: You, Yourself, are to be feared; And who may stand in Your presence When once You are angry?
verses.textEnNlt: No wonder you are greatly feared! Who can stand before you when your anger explodes?
verses.textEnNasb: You, You indeed are to be feared, And who may stand in Your presence, once You are angry?
verses.textEn: It is you alone who are to be feared. Who can stand before you when you are angry?

verses.textZh: 要拯救地上所有困苦的人。 那时，你从天上宣告审判， 地上的人就惧怕，并且静默无声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要拯救地上所有困苦的人。 那时，你从天上宣告审判， 地上的人就惧怕，并且静默无声。
verses.textZhCuv: 神起来施行审判， 要救地上一切谦卑的人； 那时地就惧怕而静默。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: From heaven you pronounced judgment, and the land feared and was quiet—
verses.textEnEsv: From the heavens you uttered judgment; the earth feared and was still,
verses.textEnNkjv: You caused judgment to be heard from heaven; The earth feared and was still,
verses.textEnNlt: From heaven you sentenced your enemies; the earth trembled and stood silent before you.
verses.textEnNasb: You caused judgment to be heard from heaven; The earth feared and was still
verses.textEn: From heaven you pronounced judgment, and the land feared and was quiet—

verses.textZh: 人的忿怒必使你得称赞， 人的余怒必成为你的装饰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的忿怒必使你得称赞， 人的余怒必成为你的装饰。
verses.textZhCuv: 人的忿怒要成全你的荣美； 人的余怒，你要禁止。
verses.textEnNiv: when you, God, rose up to judge, to save all the afflicted of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: when God arose to establish judgment, to save all the humble of the earth. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: When God arose to judgment, To deliver all the oppressed of the earth. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: You stand up to judge those who do evil, O God, and to rescue the oppressed of the earth. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: When God arose to judgment, To save all the humble of the earth. Selah
verses.textEn: when you, God, rose up to judge, to save all the afflicted of the land.

verses.textZh: 你们许愿，总要向耶和华你们的神偿还； 所有在他周围的人，都要把贡物带来献给那可敬畏的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们许愿，总要向耶和华你们的神偿还； 所有在他周围的人，都要把贡物带来献给那可敬畏的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们许愿，当向耶和华－你们的神还愿； 在他四面的人都当拿贡物献给那可畏的主。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely your wrath against mankind brings you praise, and the survivors of your wrath are restrained.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely the wrath of man shall praise you; the remnant of wrath you will put on like a belt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely the wrath of man shall praise You; With the remainder of wrath You shall gird Yourself.
verses.textEnNlt: Human defiance only enhances your glory, for you use it as a weapon.
verses.textEnNasb: For the wrath of mankind shall praise You; You will encircle Yourself with a remnant of wrath.
verses.textEn: Surely your wrath against mankind brings you praise, and the survivors of your wrath are restrained.

verses.textZh: 他必挫折众领袖的傲气， 他必使地上的君王畏惧他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必挫折众领袖的傲气， 他必使地上的君王畏惧他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要挫折王子的骄气； 他向地上的君王显威可畏。
verses.textEnNiv: Make vows to the Lord your God and fulfill them; let all the neighboring lands bring gifts to the One to be feared.
verses.textEnEsv: Make your vows to the Lord your God and perform them; let all around him bring gifts to him who is to be feared,
verses.textEnNkjv: Make vows to the Lord your God, and pay them; Let all who are around Him bring presents to Him who ought to be feared.
verses.textEnNlt: Make vows to the Lord your God, and keep them. Let everyone bring tribute to the Awesome One.
verses.textEnNasb: Make vows to the Lord your God and fulfill them; All who are around Him are to bring gifts to Him who is to be feared.
verses.textEn: Make vows to the Lord your God and fulfill them; let all the neighboring lands bring gifts to the One to be feared.

verses.textZh: 他要挫折君王的骄气，他向地上的君王显为可畏。
verses.textEnNiv: He breaks the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: who cuts off the spirit of princes, who is to be feared by the kings of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes; Heis awesome to the kings of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: For he breaks the pride of princes, and the kings of the earth fear him.
verses.textEnNasb: He will cut off the spirit of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
verses.textEn: He breaks the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.
verses.textZhCn: 他要挫折君王的骄气，他向地上的君王显为可畏。

verses.textZh: 亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，照耶杜顿的做法。 我要向神发声呼求， 我向神发声，他必留心听我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，照耶杜顿的做法。 我要向神发声呼求， 我向神发声，他必留心听我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要向神发声呼求； 我向神发声，他必留心听我。
verses.textEnNiv: I cried out to God for help; I cried out to God to hear me.
verses.textEnEsv: I cry aloud to God, aloud to God, and he will hear me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I cried out to God with my voice— To God with my voice; And He gave ear to me.
verses.textEnNlt: I cry out to God; yes, I shout. Oh, that God would listen to me!
verses.textEnNasb: My voice rises to God, and I will cry aloud; My voice rises to God, and He will listen to me.
verses.textEn: I cried out to God for help; I cried out to God to hear me.

verses.textZh: 我在患难的日子寻求主， 我整夜举手祷告，总不倦怠， 我的心不肯受安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在患难的日子寻求主， 我整夜举手祷告，总不倦怠， 我的心不肯受安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在患难之日寻求主； 我在夜间不住地举手祷告； 我的心不肯受安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: When I was in distress, I sought the Lord; at night I stretched out untiring hands, and I would not be comforted.
verses.textEnEsv: In the day of my trouble I seek the Lord; in the night my hand is stretched out without wearying; my soul refuses to be comforted.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord; My hand was stretched out in the night without ceasing; My soul refused to be comforted.
verses.textEnNlt: When I was in deep trouble, I searched for the Lord. All night long I prayed, with hands lifted toward heaven, but my soul was not comforted.
verses.textEnNasb: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord; In the night my hand was stretched out and did not grow weary; My soul refused to be comforted.
verses.textEn: When I was in distress, I sought the Lord; at night I stretched out untiring hands, and I would not be comforted.

verses.textZh: 我想到神，就哀怨唉哼； 我沉思默想，心灵就烦乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我想到神，就哀怨唉哼； 我沉思默想，心灵就烦乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 我想念神，就烦燥不安； 我沉吟悲伤，心便发昏。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: I remembered you, God, and I groaned; I meditated, and my spirit grew faint.
verses.textEnEsv: When I remember God, I moan; when I meditate, my spirit faints. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: I remembered God, and was troubled; I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: I think of God, and I moan, overwhelmed with longing for his help. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: When I remember God, then I am restless; When I sigh, then my spirit feels weak. Selah
verses.textEn: I remembered you, God, and I groaned; I meditated, and my spirit grew faint.

verses.textZh: 你使我不能合眼， 我烦躁不安，连话也说不出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我不能合眼， 我烦躁不安，连话也说不出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你叫我不能闭眼； 我烦乱不安，甚至不能说话。
verses.textEnNiv: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.
verses.textEnEsv: You hold my eyelids open; I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.textEnNkjv: You hold my eyelids open; I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.textEnNlt: You don’t let me sleep. I am too distressed even to pray!
verses.textEnNasb: You have held my eyelids open; I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.textEn: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.

verses.textZh: 我回想过往的日子， 上古的年代；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我回想过往的日子， 上古的年代；
verses.textZhCuv: 我追想古时之日， 上古之年。
verses.textEnNiv: I thought about the former days, the years of long ago;
verses.textEnEsv: I consider the days of old, the years long ago.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have considered the days of old, The years of ancient times.
verses.textEnNlt: I think of the good old days, long since ended,
verses.textEnNasb: I have considered the days of old, The years of long ago.
verses.textEn: I thought about the former days, the years of long ago;

verses.textZh: 我想起我夜间的诗歌。 我的心沉思默想，我的灵仔细探究。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我想起我夜间的诗歌。 我的心沉思默想，我的灵仔细探究。
verses.textZhCuv: 我想起我夜间的歌曲，扪心自问； 我心里也仔细省察。
verses.textEnNiv: I remembered my songs in the night. My heart meditated and my spirit asked:
verses.textEnEsv: I said, "Let me remember my song in the night; let me meditate in my heart." Then my spirit made a diligent search:
verses.textEnNkjv: I call to remembrance my song in the night; I meditate within my heart, And my spirit makes diligent search.
verses.textEnNlt: when my nights were filled with joyful songs. I search my soul and ponder the difference now.
verses.textEnNasb: I will remember my song in the night; I will meditate with my heart, And my spirit ponders:
verses.textEn: I remembered my songs in the night. My heart meditated and my spirit asked:

verses.textZh: 主要永远丢弃我， 不再施恩吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 主要永远丢弃我， 不再施恩吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 难道主要永远丢弃我， 不再施恩吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Will the Lord reject forever? Will he never show his favor again?
verses.textEnEsv: "Will the Lord spurn forever, and never again be favorable?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will the Lord cast off forever? And will He be favorable no more?
verses.textEnNlt: Has the Lord rejected me forever? Will he never again be kind to me?
verses.textEnNasb: Will the Lord reject forever? And will He never be favorable again?
verses.textEn: "Will the Lord reject forever? Will he never show his favor again?

verses.textZh: 他的慈爱永远消失， 他的应许永久废去吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的慈爱永远消失， 他的应许永久废去吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 难道他的慈爱永远穷尽， 他的应许世世废弃吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Has his unfailing love vanished forever? Has his promise failed for all time?
verses.textEnEsv: Has his steadfast love forever ceased? Are his promises at an end for all time?
verses.textEnNkjv: Has His mercy ceased forever? Has His promise failed forevermore?
verses.textEnNlt: Is his unfailing love gone forever? Have his promises permanently failed?
verses.textEnNasb: Has His favor ceased forever? Has His promise come to an end forever?
verses.textEn: Has his unfailing love vanished forever? Has his promise failed for all time?

verses.textZh: 神忘记施恩， 因忿怒而止住他的怜悯吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神忘记施恩， 因忿怒而止住他的怜悯吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 难道神忘记开恩， 因发怒就止住他的慈悲吗？ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has he in anger withheld his compassion?"
verses.textEnEsv: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he in anger shut up his compassion?" Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has He in anger shut up His tender mercies? Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he slammed the door on his compassion? Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Has God forgotten to be gracious, Or has He in anger withdrawn His compassion? Selah
verses.textEn: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has he in anger withheld his compassion?"

verses.textZh: 因此我说："这是我的忧伤： 至高者的右手已经改变了 ！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我说："这是我的忧伤： 至高者的右手已经改变了 ！"
verses.textZhCuv: 我便说：这是我的懦弱， 但我要追念至高者显出右手之年代。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I thought, "To this I will appeal: the years when the Most High stretched out his right hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, "I will appeal to this, to the years of the right hand of the Most High."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said, "This is my anguish; ButIwillremember the years of the right hand of the Most High."
verses.textEnNlt: And I said, "This is my fate; the Most High has turned his hand against me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "It is my grief, That the right hand of the Most High has changed."
verses.textEn: Then I thought, "To this I will appeal: the years when the Most High stretched out his right hand.

verses.textZh: 我要述说耶和华的作为， 我要记念你古时所行的奇事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要述说耶和华的作为， 我要记念你古时所行的奇事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要提说耶和华所行的； 我要记念你古时的奇事。
verses.textEnNiv: I will remember the deeds of the Lord ; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.
verses.textEnEsv: I will remember the deeds of the Lord ; yes, I will remember your wonders of old.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will remember the works of the Lord; Surely I will remember Your wonders of old.
verses.textEnNlt: But then I recall all you have done, O Lord ; I remember your wonderful deeds of long ago.
verses.textEnNasb: I shall remember the deeds of the Lord; I will certainly remember Your wonders of old.
verses.textEn: I will remember the deeds of the Lord ; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

verses.textZh: 我要默想你一切所行的， 思想你的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要默想你一切所行的， 思想你的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要思想你的经营， 默念你的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: I will consider all your works and meditate on all your mighty deeds."
verses.textEnEsv: I will ponder all your work, and meditate on your mighty deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also meditate on all Your work, And talk of Your deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: They are constantly in my thoughts. I cannot stop thinking about your mighty works.
verses.textEnNasb: I will meditate on all Your work, And on Your deeds with thanksgiving.
verses.textEn: I will consider all your works and meditate on all your mighty deeds."

verses.textZh: 神啊！你的道路是圣洁的， 有哪一位神好象我们的神这样伟大呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你的道路是圣洁的， 有哪一位神好象我们的神这样伟大呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你的作为是洁净的； 有何神大如神呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Your ways, God, are holy. What god is as great as our God?
verses.textEnEsv: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is great like our God?
verses.textEnNkjv: Your way, O God, is in the sanctuary; Who is so great a God as our God?
verses.textEnNlt: O God, your ways are holy. Is there any god as mighty as you?
verses.textEnNasb: Your way, God, is holy; What god is great like our God?
verses.textEn: Your ways, God, are holy. What god is as great as our God?

verses.textZh: 你是行奇事的神， 你在万民中显明你的能力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是行奇事的神， 你在万民中显明你的能力。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是行奇事的神； 你曾在列邦中彰显你的能力。
verses.textEnNiv: You are the God who performs miracles; you display your power among the peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: You are the God who works wonders; you have made known your might among the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are the God who does wonders; You have declared Your strength among the peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: You are the God of great wonders! You demonstrate your awesome power among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: You are the God who works wonders; You have made known Your strength among the peoples.
verses.textEn: You are the God who performs miracles; you display your power among the peoples.

verses.textZh: 你曾用你的膀臂救赎你的子民， 就是雅各和约瑟的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾用你的膀臂救赎你的子民， 就是雅各和约瑟的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾用你的膀臂赎了你的民， 就是雅各和约瑟的子孙。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
verses.textEnEsv: You with your arm redeemed your people, the children of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: You have with Your arm redeemed Your people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: By your strong arm, you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: By Your power You have redeemed Your people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
verses.textEn: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.

verses.textZh: 神啊！众水看见你， 众水看见你就惧怕， 深渊也都战抖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！众水看见你， 众水看见你就惧怕， 深渊也都战抖。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，诸水见你， 一见就都惊惶； 深渊也都战抖。
verses.textEnNiv: The waters saw you, God, the waters saw you and writhed; the very depths were convulsed.
verses.textEnEsv: When the waters saw you, O God, when the waters saw you, they were afraid; indeed, the deep trembled.
verses.textEnNkjv: The waters saw You, O God; The waters saw You, they were afraid; The depths also trembled.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Red Sea saw you, O God, its waters looked and trembled! The sea quaked to its very depths.
verses.textEnNasb: The waters saw You, God; The waters saw You, they were in anguish; The ocean depths also trembled.
verses.textEn: The waters saw you, God, the waters saw you and writhed; the very depths were convulsed.

verses.textZh: 密云倾降雨水， 天空发出响声， 你的箭闪射四方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 密云倾降雨水， 天空发出响声， 你的箭闪射四方。
verses.textZhCuv: 云中倒出水来； 天空发出响声； 你的箭也飞行四方。
verses.textEnNiv: The clouds poured down water, the heavens resounded with thunder; your arrows flashed back and forth.
verses.textEnEsv: The clouds poured out water; the skies gave forth thunder; your arrows flashed on every side.
verses.textEnNkjv: The clouds poured out water; The skies sent out a sound; Your arrows also flashed about.
verses.textEnNlt: The clouds poured down rain; the thunder rumbled in the sky. Your arrows of lightning flashed.
verses.textEnNasb: The clouds poured out water; The skies sounded out; Your arrows flashed here and there.
verses.textEn: The clouds poured down water, the heavens resounded with thunder; your arrows flashed back and forth.

verses.textZh: 你的雷声在旋风中响起来， 闪电照亮了世界， 大地战抖震动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的雷声在旋风中响起来， 闪电照亮了世界， 大地战抖震动。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的雷声在旋风中； 电光照亮世界； 大地战抖震动。
verses.textEnNiv: Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
verses.textEnEsv: The crash of your thunder was in the whirlwind; your lightnings lighted up the world; the earth trembled and shook.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of Your thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lit up the world; The earth trembled and shook.
verses.textEnNlt: Your thunder roared from the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world! The earth trembled and shook.
verses.textEnNasb: The sound of Your thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightning lit up the world; The earth trembled and shook.
verses.textEn: Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

verses.textZh: 你的道路经过海洋， 你的路径穿过大水， 但你的脚踪无人知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的道路经过海洋， 你的路径穿过大水， 但你的脚踪无人知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的道在海中； 你的路在大水中； 你的脚踪无人知道。
verses.textEnNiv: Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.
verses.textEnEsv: Your way was through the sea, your path through the great waters; yet your footprints were unseen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your way was in the sea, Your path in the great waters, And Your footsteps were not known.
verses.textEnNlt: Your road led through the sea, your pathway through the mighty waters— a pathway no one knew was there!
verses.textEnNasb: Your way was in the sea And Your paths in the mighty waters, And Your footprints were not known.
verses.textEn: Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.

verses.textZh: 你曾借着摩西和亚伦的手， 带领你的子民如同带领羊群一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾借着摩西和亚伦的手， 带领你的子民如同带领羊群一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾藉摩西和亚伦的手引导你的百姓， 好像羊群一般。
verses.textEnNiv: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnEsv: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNkjv: You led Your people like a flock By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: You led your people along that road like a flock of sheep, with Moses and Aaron as their shepherds.
verses.textEnNasb: You led Your people like a flock By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textEn: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.textZh: 亚萨的训诲诗。 我的民哪！你们要留心听我的教训， 侧耳听我口中的言语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的训诲诗。 我的民哪！你们要留心听我的教训， 侧耳听我口中的言语。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的民哪，你们要留心听我的训诲， 侧耳听我口中的话。
verses.textEnNiv: My people, hear my teaching; listen to the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; incline your ears to the words of my mouth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Give ear, O my people, to my law; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: O my people, listen to my instructions. Open your ears to what I am saying,
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, my people, to my instruction; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.textEn: My people, hear my teaching; listen to the words of my mouth.

verses.textZh: 我要开口用比喻， 把古时隐秘的事说出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要开口用比喻， 把古时隐秘的事说出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 我要开口说比喻； 我要说出古时的谜语，
verses.textEnNiv: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter hidden things, things from of old—
verses.textEnEsv: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings from of old,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings of old,
verses.textEnNlt: for I will speak to you in a parable. I will teach you hidden lessons from our past—
verses.textEnNasb: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will tell riddles of old,
verses.textEn: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter hidden things, things from of old—

verses.textZh: 就是我们所听过所知道的， 也是我们的列祖告诉我们的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是我们所听过所知道的， 也是我们的列祖告诉我们的，
verses.textZhCuv: 是我们所听见、所知道的， 也是我们的祖宗告诉我们的。
verses.textEnNiv: things we have heard and known, things our ancestors have told us.
verses.textEnEsv: things that we have heard and known, that our fathers have told us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.
verses.textEnNlt: stories we have heard and known, stories our ancestors handed down to us.
verses.textEnNasb: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.
verses.textEn: things we have heard and known, things our ancestors have told us.

verses.textZh: 我们不把这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒， 却要把耶和华应得的赞美、他的能力， 和他所行的奇事， 都向后代的人述说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不把这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒， 却要把耶和华应得的赞美、他的能力， 和他所行的奇事， 都向后代的人述说。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不将这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒， 要将耶和华的美德和他的能力， 并他奇妙的作为，述说给后代听。
verses.textEnNiv: We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the Lord , his power, and the wonders he has done.
verses.textEnEsv: We will not hide them from their children, but tell to the coming generation the glorious deeds of the Lord , and his might, and the wonders that he has done.
verses.textEnNkjv: We will not hide them from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, And His strength and His wonderful works that He has done.
verses.textEnNlt: We will not hide these truths from our children; we will tell the next generation about the glorious deeds of the Lord , about his power and his mighty wonders.
verses.textEnNasb: We will not conceal them from their children, But we will tell the generation to come the praises of the Lord, And His power and His wondrous works that He has done.
verses.textEn: We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the Lord , his power, and the wonders he has done.

verses.textZh: 他在雅各设立法度， 在以色列中制订律法， 就是他吩咐我们的列祖， 去教训他们的子孙的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在雅各设立法度， 在以色列中制订律法， 就是他吩咐我们的列祖， 去教训他们的子孙的，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，他在雅各中立法度， 在以色列中设律法； 是他吩咐我们祖宗要传给子孙的，
verses.textEnNiv: He decreed statutes for Jacob and established the law in Israel, which he commanded our ancestors to teach their children,
verses.textEnEsv: He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers to teach to their children,
verses.textEnNkjv: For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;
verses.textEnNlt: For he issued his laws to Jacob; he gave his instructions to Israel. He commanded our ancestors to teach them to their children,
verses.textEnNasb: For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers That they were to teach them to their children,
verses.textEn: He decreed statutes for Jacob and established the law in Israel, which he commanded our ancestors to teach their children,

verses.textZh: 好使后代的人，包括将要出生的儿女，都可以知道； 他们也要起来，告诉他们的子孙，
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使后代的人，包括将要出生的儿女，都可以知道； 他们也要起来，告诉他们的子孙，
verses.textZhCuv: 使将要生的后代子孙可以晓得； 他们也要起来告诉他们的子孙，
verses.textEnNiv: so the next generation would know them, even the children yet to be born, and they in turn would tell their children.
verses.textEnEsv: that the next generation might know them, the children yet unborn, and arise and tell them to their children,
verses.textEnNkjv: That the generation to come might know them, The children who would be born, That they may arise and declare them to their children,
verses.textEnNlt: so the next generation might know them— even the children not yet born— and they in turn will teach their own children.
verses.textEnNasb: So that the generation to come would know, the children yet to be born, That they would arise and tell them to their children,
verses.textEn: so the next generation would know them, even the children yet to be born, and they in turn would tell their children.

verses.textZh: 使他们信靠神， 不忘记神的作为， 谨守他的诫命；
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他们信靠神， 不忘记神的作为， 谨守他的诫命；
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫他们仰望神， 不忘记神的作为， 惟要守他的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget his deeds but would keep his commands.
verses.textEnEsv: so that they should set their hope in God and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments;
verses.textEnNkjv: That they may set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep His commandments;
verses.textEnNlt: So each generation should set its hope anew on God, not forgetting his glorious miracles and obeying his commands.
verses.textEnNasb: So that they would put their confidence in God And not forget the works of God, But comply with His commandments,
verses.textEn: Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget his deeds but would keep his commands.

verses.textZh: 免得他们像他们的列祖， 成了顽梗悖逆的一代， 心不坚定的一代， 他们的心对神不忠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得他们像他们的列祖， 成了顽梗悖逆的一代， 心不坚定的一代， 他们的心对神不忠。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要像他们的祖宗， 是顽梗悖逆、居心不正之辈， 向着神，心不诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: They would not be like their ancestors— a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose hearts were not loyal to God, whose spirits were not faithful to him.
verses.textEnEsv: and that they should not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation whose heart was not steadfast, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And may not be like their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation that did not set its heart aright, And whose spirit was not faithful to God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will not be like their ancestors— stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful, refusing to give their hearts to God.
verses.textEnNasb: And not be like their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation that did not prepare its heart And whose spirit was not faithful to God.
verses.textEn: They would not be like their ancestors— a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose hearts were not loyal to God, whose spirits were not faithful to him.

verses.textZh: 以法莲的子孙，虽然备有弓箭， 在争战的日子，却转身逃走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以法莲的子孙，虽然备有弓箭， 在争战的日子，却转身逃走。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲的子孙带着兵器，拿着弓， 临阵之日转身退后。
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned back on the day of battle;
verses.textEnEsv: The Ephraimites, armed with the bow, turned back on the day of battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.
verses.textEnNlt: The warriors of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned their backs and fled on the day of battle.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ephraim were archers equipped with bows, Yet they turned back on the day of battle.
verses.textEn: The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned back on the day of battle;

verses.textZh: 他们不谨守神的约， 不肯遵行他的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不谨守神的约， 不肯遵行他的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不遵守神的约， 不肯照他的律法行；
verses.textEnNiv: they did not keep God’s covenant and refused to live by his law.
verses.textEnEsv: They did not keep God’s covenant, but refused to walk according to his law.
verses.textEnNkjv: They did not keep the covenant of God; They refused to walk in His law,
verses.textEnNlt: They did not keep God’s covenant and refused to live by his instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: They did not keep the covenant of God And refused to walk in His Law;
verses.textEn: they did not keep God’s covenant and refused to live by his law.

verses.textZh: 他们忘记了神的作为， 和他显给他们看的奇事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们忘记了神的作为， 和他显给他们看的奇事。
verses.textZhCuv: 又忘记他所行的 和他显给他们奇妙的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: They forgot what he had done, the wonders he had shown them.
verses.textEnEsv: They forgot his works and the wonders that he had shown them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And forgot His works And His wonders that He had shown them.
verses.textEnNlt: They forgot what he had done— the great wonders he had shown them,
verses.textEnNasb: They forgot His deeds And His miracles that He had shown them.
verses.textEn: They forgot what he had done, the wonders he had shown them.

verses.textZh: 他在埃及地，在琐安的田野， 在他们列祖的眼前，行了奇事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在埃及地，在琐安的田野， 在他们列祖的眼前，行了奇事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在埃及地，在琐安田， 在他们祖宗的眼前施行奇事。
verses.textEnNiv: He did miracles in the sight of their ancestors in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
verses.textEnEsv: In the sight of their fathers he performed wonders in the land of Egypt, in the fields of Zoan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Marvelous things He did in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.textEnNlt: the miracles he did for their ancestors on the plain of Zoan in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: He performed wonders before their fathers In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.textEn: He did miracles in the sight of their ancestors in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.

verses.textZh: 他把海分开，领他们走过去， 又使海水直立像一道堤坝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把海分开，领他们走过去， 又使海水直立像一道堤坝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将海分裂，使他们过去， 又叫水立起如垒。
verses.textEnNiv: He divided the sea and led them through; he made the water stand up like a wall.
verses.textEnEsv: He divided the sea and let them pass through it, and made the waters stand like a heap.
verses.textEnNkjv: He divided the sea and caused them to pass through; And He made the waters stand up like a heap.
verses.textEnNlt: For he divided the sea and led them through, making the water stand up like walls!
verses.textEnNasb: He divided the sea and caused them to pass through, And He made the waters stand up like a heap.
verses.textEn: He divided the sea and led them through; he made the water stand up like a wall.

verses.textZh: 白日他用云彩， 夜间他用火光引导他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 白日他用云彩， 夜间他用火光引导他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他白日用云彩， 终夜用火光引导他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He guided them with the cloud by day and with light from the fire all night.
verses.textEnEsv: In the daytime he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a fiery light.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the daytime also He led them with the cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.
verses.textEnNlt: In the daytime he led them by a cloud, and all night by a pillar of fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He led them with the cloud by day And all the night with a light of fire.
verses.textEn: He guided them with the cloud by day and with light from the fire all night.

verses.textZh: 他在旷野使盘石裂开， 给他们水喝，多如深渊的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在旷野使盘石裂开， 给他们水喝，多如深渊的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在旷野分裂磐石， 多多地给他们水喝，如从深渊而出。
verses.textEnNiv: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them water as abundant as the seas;
verses.textEnEsv: He split rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink abundantly as from the deep.
verses.textEnNkjv: He split the rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink in abundance like the depths.
verses.textEnNlt: He split open the rocks in the wilderness to give them water, as from a gushing spring.
verses.textEnNasb: He split the rocks in the wilderness And gave them plenty to drink like the ocean depths.
verses.textEn: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them water as abundant as the seas;

verses.textZh: 他使水从盘石中涌出来， 使水好象江河一般流下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使水从盘石中涌出来， 使水好象江河一般流下。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使水从磐石涌出， 叫水如江河下流。
verses.textEnNiv: he brought streams out of a rocky crag and made water flow down like rivers.
verses.textEnEsv: He made streams come out of the rock and caused waters to flow down like rivers.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also brought streams out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.textEnNlt: He made streams pour from the rock, making the waters flow down like a river!
verses.textEnNasb: He brought forth streams from the rock And made waters run down like rivers.
verses.textEn: he brought streams out of a rocky crag and made water flow down like rivers.

verses.textZh: 但他们仍然犯罪顶撞他， 在干旱之地仍然悖逆至高者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们仍然犯罪顶撞他， 在干旱之地仍然悖逆至高者。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却仍旧得罪他， 在干燥之地悖逆至高者。
verses.textEnNiv: But they continued to sin against him, rebelling in the wilderness against the Most High.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet they sinned still more against him, rebelling against the Most High in the desert.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they sinned even more against Him By rebelling against the Most High in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet they kept on sinning against him, rebelling against the Most High in the desert.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they still continued to sin against Him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.
verses.textEn: But they continued to sin against him, rebelling in the wilderness against the Most High.

verses.textZh: 他们心里试探神， 随着自己的欲望要求食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们心里试探神， 随着自己的欲望要求食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们心中试探神， 随自己所欲的求食物，
verses.textEnNiv: They willfully put God to the test by demanding the food they craved.
verses.textEnEsv: They tested God in their heart by demanding the food they craved.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they tested God in their heart By asking for the food of their fancy.
verses.textEnNlt: They stubbornly tested God in their hearts, demanding the foods they craved.
verses.textEnNasb: And in their heart they put God to the test By asking for food that suited their taste.
verses.textEn: They willfully put God to the test by demanding the food they craved.

verses.textZh: 他们妄论神，说： "神可以在旷野摆设筵席吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们妄论神，说： "神可以在旷野摆设筵席吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 并且妄论神说：神在旷野岂能摆设筵席吗？
verses.textEnNiv: They spoke against God; they said, "Can God really spread a table in the wilderness?
verses.textEnEsv: They spoke against God, saying, "Can God spread a table in the wilderness?
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, they spoke against God: They said, "Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.textEnNlt: They even spoke against God himself, saying, "God can’t give us food in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they spoke against God; They said, "Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
verses.textEn: They spoke against God; they said, "Can God really spread a table in the wilderness?

verses.textZh: 他虽曾击打盘石，使水涌出来， 好象江河泛滥， 他还能赐粮食吗？ 他还能为自己的子民预备肉食吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他虽曾击打盘石，使水涌出来， 好象江河泛滥， 他还能赐粮食吗？ 他还能为自己的子民预备肉食吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他曾击打磐石，使水涌出，成了江河； 他还能赐粮食吗？ 还能为他的百姓预备肉吗？
verses.textEnNiv: True, he struck the rock, and water gushed out, streams flowed abundantly, but can he also give us bread? Can he supply meat for his people?"
verses.textEnEsv: He struck the rock so that water gushed out and streams overflowed. Can he also give bread or provide meat for his people?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, He struck the rock, So that the waters gushed out, And the streams overflowed. Can He give bread also? Can He provide meat for His people?"
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, he can strike a rock so water gushes out, but he can’t give his people bread and meat."
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, He struck the rock so that waters gushed out, And streams were overflowing; Can He also provide bread? Will He prepare meat for His people?"
verses.textEn: True, he struck the rock, and water gushed out, streams flowed abundantly, but can he also give us bread? Can he supply meat for his people?"

verses.textZh: 因此耶和华听见了，就大怒； 有烈火在雅各烧起， 有怒气向以色列发作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此耶和华听见了，就大怒； 有烈火在雅各烧起， 有怒气向以色列发作。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华听见就发怒； 有烈火向雅各烧起； 有怒气向以色列上腾；
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord heard them, he was furious; his fire broke out against Jacob, and his wrath rose against Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, when the Lord heard, he was full of wrath; a fire was kindled against Jacob; his anger rose against Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord heard this and was furious; So a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also came up against Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord heard them, he was furious. The fire of his wrath burned against Jacob. Yes, his anger rose against Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord heard and was full of wrath; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also mounted against Israel,
verses.textEn: When the Lord heard them, he was furious; his fire broke out against Jacob, and his wrath rose against Israel,

verses.textZh: 因为他们不相信神， 不倚靠他的拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们不相信神， 不倚靠他的拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们不信服神， 不倚赖他的救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: for they did not believe in God or trust in his deliverance.
verses.textEnEsv: because they did not believe in God and did not trust his saving power.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because they did not believe in God, And did not trust in His salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: for they did not believe God or trust him to care for them.
verses.textEnNasb: Because they did not believe in God And did not trust in His salvation.
