verses.textEn: for they did not believe in God or trust in his deliverance.

verses.textZh: 然而，他吩咐天上的云彩， 打开天上的门户。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，他吩咐天上的云彩， 打开天上的门户。
verses.textZhCuv: 他却吩咐天空， 又敞开天上的门，
verses.textEnNiv: Yet he gave a command to the skies above and opened the doors of the heavens;
verses.textEnEsv: Yet he commanded the skies above and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet He had commanded the clouds above, And opened the doors of heaven,
verses.textEnNlt: But he commanded the skies to open; he opened the doors of heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet He commanded the clouds above And opened the doors of heaven;
verses.textEn: Yet he gave a command to the skies above and opened the doors of the heavens;

verses.textZh: 他降吗哪给他们吃， 把天上的食物赐给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他降吗哪给他们吃， 把天上的食物赐给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 降吗哪，像雨给他们吃， 将天上的粮食赐给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: he rained down manna for the people to eat, he gave them the grain of heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: and he rained down on them manna to eat and gave them the grain of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Had rained down manna on them to eat, And given them of the bread of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: He rained down manna for them to eat; he gave them bread from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: He rained down manna upon them to eat, And gave them food from heaven.
verses.textEn: he rained down manna for the people to eat, he gave them the grain of heaven.

verses.textZh: 于是人吃了天使的食物， 是神赐下的食粮，使他们饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是人吃了天使的食物， 是神赐下的食粮，使他们饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人 吃大能者的食物； 他赐下粮食，使他们饱足。
verses.textEnNiv: Human beings ate the bread of angels; he sent them all the food they could eat.
verses.textEnEsv: Man ate of the bread of the angels; he sent them food in abundance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Men ate angels’ food; He sent them food to the full.
verses.textEnNlt: They ate the food of angels! God gave them all they could hold.
verses.textEnNasb: Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them food in abundance.
verses.textEn: Human beings ate the bread of angels; he sent them all the food they could eat.

verses.textZh: 他从天空刮起东风， 施能力领出南风。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从天空刮起东风， 施能力领出南风。
verses.textZhCuv: 他领东风起在天空， 又用能力引了南风来。
verses.textEnNiv: He let loose the east wind from the heavens and by his power made the south wind blow.
verses.textEnEsv: He caused the east wind to blow in the heavens, and by his power he led out the south wind;
verses.textEnNkjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heavens; And by His power He brought in the south wind.
verses.textEnNlt: He released the east wind in the heavens and guided the south wind by his mighty power.
verses.textEnNasb: He made the east wind blow in the sky And by His power He directed the south wind.
verses.textEn: He let loose the east wind from the heavens and by his power made the south wind blow.

verses.textZh: 他降肉食给他们，多如尘土； 又降飞鸟给他们，多如海沙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他降肉食给他们，多如尘土； 又降飞鸟给他们，多如海沙。
verses.textZhCuv: 他降肉，像雨在他们当中，多如尘土， 又降飞鸟，多如海沙，
verses.textEnNiv: He rained meat down on them like dust, birds like sand on the seashore.
verses.textEnEsv: he rained meat on them like dust, winged birds like the sand of the seas;
verses.textEnNkjv: He also rained meat on them like the dust, Feathered fowl like the sand of the seas;
verses.textEnNlt: He rained down meat as thick as dust— birds as plentiful as the sand on the seashore!
verses.textEnNasb: When He rained meat upon them like the dust, Even winged fowl like the sand of the seas,
verses.textEn: He rained meat down on them like dust, birds like sand on the seashore.

verses.textZh: 他使飞鸟落在他们的营中， 在他们住处的四围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使飞鸟落在他们的营中， 在他们住处的四围。
verses.textZhCuv: 落在他们的营中， 在他们住处的四面。
verses.textEnNiv: He made them come down inside their camp, all around their tents.
verses.textEnEsv: he let them fall in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He let them fall in the midst of their camp, All around their dwellings.
verses.textEnNlt: He caused the birds to fall within their camp and all around their tents.
verses.textEnNasb: He let them fall in the midst of their camp, All around their dwellings.
verses.textEn: He made them come down inside their camp, all around their tents.

verses.textZh: 他们吃了，而且吃得很饱， 这样，神把他们所愿的都赐给他们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们吃了，而且吃得很饱， 这样，神把他们所愿的都赐给他们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吃了，而且饱足； 这样就随了他们所欲的。
verses.textEnNiv: They ate till they were gorged— he had given them what they craved.
verses.textEnEsv: And they ate and were well filled, for he gave them what they craved.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they ate and were well filled, For He gave them their own desire.
verses.textEnNlt: The people ate their fill. He gave them what they craved.
verses.textEnNasb: So they ate and were well filled, And He satisfied their longing.
verses.textEn: They ate till they were gorged— he had given them what they craved.

verses.textZh: 他们还没有因所愿的满足， 食物仍在他们口中的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们还没有因所愿的满足， 食物仍在他们口中的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们贪而无厌， 食物还在他们口中的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: But before they turned from what they craved, even while the food was still in their mouths,
verses.textEnEsv: But before they had satisfied their craving, while the food was still in their mouths,
verses.textEnNkjv: They were not deprived of their craving; But while their food was still in their mouths,
verses.textEnNlt: But before they satisfied their craving, while the meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.textEnNasb: Yet before they had abandoned their longing, While their food was in their mouths,
verses.textEn: But before they turned from what they craved, even while the food was still in their mouths,

verses.textZh: 神的怒气就向他们发作， 杀了他们中间最肥壮的人， 击倒了以色列的年轻人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的怒气就向他们发作， 杀了他们中间最肥壮的人， 击倒了以色列的年轻人。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的怒气就向他们上腾， 杀了他们内中的肥壮人， 打倒以色列的少年人。
verses.textEnNiv: God’s anger rose against them; he put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: the anger of God rose against them, and he killed the strongest of them and laid low the young men of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wrath of God came against them, And slew the stoutest of them, And struck down the choice men of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: the anger of God rose against them, and he killed their strongest men. He struck down the finest of Israel’s young men.
verses.textEnNasb: The anger of God rose against them And killed some of their strongest ones, And subdued the choice men of Israel.
verses.textEn: God’s anger rose against them; he put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.

verses.textZh: 虽然经历了这一切，他们仍然犯罪； 尽管看见这些奇事，他们仍不相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然经历了这一切，他们仍然犯罪； 尽管看见这些奇事，他们仍不相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽是这样，他们仍旧犯罪， 不信他奇妙的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; in spite of his wonders, they did not believe.
verses.textEnEsv: In spite of all this, they still sinned; despite his wonders, they did not believe.
verses.textEnNkjv: In spite of this they still sinned, And did not believe in His wondrous works.
verses.textEnNlt: But in spite of this, the people kept sinning. Despite his wonders, they refused to trust him.
verses.textEnNasb: In spite of all this they still sinned And did not believe in His wonderful works.
verses.textEn: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; in spite of his wonders, they did not believe.

verses.textZh: 所以神使他们的日子在虚空中消逝， 使他们的岁月在惊恐中完结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以神使他们的日子在虚空中消逝， 使他们的岁月在惊恐中完结。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，他叫他们的日子全归虚空， 叫他们的年岁尽属惊恐。
verses.textEnNiv: So he ended their days in futility and their years in terror.
verses.textEnEsv: So he made their days vanish like a breath, and their years in terror.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore their days He consumed in futility, And their years in fear.
verses.textEnNlt: So he ended their lives in failure, their years in terror.
verses.textEnNasb: So He brought their days to an end in futility, And their years to an end in sudden terror.
verses.textEn: So he ended their days in futility and their years in terror.

verses.textZh: 神击杀他们的时候，他们就寻求他； 他们回转过来，切切求问神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神击杀他们的时候，他们就寻求他； 他们回转过来，切切求问神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他杀他们的时候，他们才求问他， 回心转意，切切地寻求神。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever God slew them, they would seek him; they eagerly turned to him again.
verses.textEnEsv: When he killed them, they sought him; they repented and sought God earnestly.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He slew them, then they sought Him; And they returned and sought earnestly for God.
verses.textEnNlt: When God began killing them, they finally sought him. They repented and took God seriously.
verses.textEnNasb: When He killed them, then they sought Him, And they returned and searched diligently for God;
verses.textEn: Whenever God slew them, they would seek him; they eagerly turned to him again.

verses.textZh: 他们也想起神是他们的盘石， 至高的神是他们的救赎主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们也想起神是他们的盘石， 至高的神是他们的救赎主。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们也追念神是他们的磐石， 至高的神是他们的救赎主。
verses.textEnNiv: They remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
verses.textEnEsv: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God their redeemer.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they remembered that God was their rock, And the Most High God their Redeemer.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they remembered that God was their rock, that God Most High was their redeemer.
verses.textEnNasb: And they remembered that God was their rock, And the Most High God their Redeemer.
verses.textEn: They remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.

verses.textZh: 但他们仍然用口欺骗他， 用舌头向他说谎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们仍然用口欺骗他， 用舌头向他说谎。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却用口谄媚他， 用舌向他说谎。
verses.textEnNiv: But then they would flatter him with their mouths, lying to him with their tongues;
verses.textEnEsv: But they flattered him with their mouths; they lied to him with their tongues.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless they flattered Him with their mouth, And they lied to Him with their tongue;
verses.textEnNlt: But all they gave him was lip service; they lied to him with their tongues.
verses.textEnNasb: But they flattered Him with their mouth And lied to Him with their tongue.
verses.textEn: But then they would flatter him with their mouths, lying to him with their tongues;

verses.textZh: 他们的心对他不坚定， 也不忠于和他所立的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的心对他不坚定， 也不忠于和他所立的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们的心向他不正， 在他的约上也不忠心。
verses.textEnNiv: their hearts were not loyal to him, they were not faithful to his covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: Their heart was not steadfast toward him; they were not faithful to his covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: For their heart was not steadfast with Him, Nor were they faithful in His covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: Their hearts were not loyal to him. They did not keep his covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: For their heart was not steadfast toward Him, Nor were they faithful with His covenant.
verses.textEn: their hearts were not loyal to him, they were not faithful to his covenant.

verses.textZh: 他却有怜悯，赦免罪孽，没有把他们灭绝， 并且多次抑制自己的怒气， 没有完全宣泄他的烈怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却有怜悯，赦免罪孽，没有把他们灭绝， 并且多次抑制自己的怒气， 没有完全宣泄他的烈怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他有怜悯， 赦免他们的罪孽， 不灭绝他们， 而且屡次消他的怒气， 不发尽他的忿怒。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet he was merciful; he forgave their iniquities and did not destroy them. Time after time he restrained his anger and did not stir up his full wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet he, being compassionate, atoned for their iniquity and did not destroy them; he restrained his anger often and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, And did not destroy them. Yes, many a time He turned His anger away, And did not stir up all His wrath;
verses.textEnNlt: Yet he was merciful and forgave their sins and did not destroy them all. Many times he held back his anger and did not unleash his fury!
verses.textEnNasb: But He, being compassionate, forgave their wrongdoing and did not destroy them; And often He restrained His anger And did not stir up all His wrath.
verses.textEn: Yet he was merciful; he forgave their iniquities and did not destroy them. Time after time he restrained his anger and did not stir up his full wrath.

verses.textZh: 他顾念他们不过是人， 是一阵吹去不再返回的风。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他顾念他们不过是人， 是一阵吹去不再返回的风。
verses.textZhCuv: 他想到他们不过是血气， 是一阵去而不返的风。
verses.textEnNiv: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.
verses.textEnEsv: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes and comes not again.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He remembered that they werebut flesh, A breath that passes away and does not come again.
verses.textEnNlt: For he remembered that they were merely mortal, gone like a breath of wind that never returns.
verses.textEnNasb: So He remembered that they were only flesh, A wind that passes and does not return.
verses.textEn: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

verses.textZh: 他们多少次在旷野悖逆他， 在沙漠使他担忧；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们多少次在旷野悖逆他， 在沙漠使他担忧；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在旷野悖逆他， 在荒地叫他担忧，何其多呢！
verses.textEnNiv: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved him in the wasteland!
verses.textEnEsv: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved him in the desert!
verses.textEnNkjv: How often they provoked Him in the wilderness, And grieved Him in the desert!
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, how often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved his heart in that dry wasteland.
verses.textEnNasb: How often they rebelled against Him in the wilderness And grieved Him in the desert!
verses.textEn: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved him in the wasteland!

verses.textZh: 他们再三试探神， 使以色列的圣者忧伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们再三试探神， 使以色列的圣者忧伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们再三试探神， 惹动以色列的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: Again and again they put God to the test; they vexed the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: They tested God again and again and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, again and again they tempted God, And limited the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Again and again they tested God’s patience and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Again and again they tempted God, And pained the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: Again and again they put God to the test; they vexed the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他们忘记了他的能力 ， 就是他救赎他们脱离敌人的日子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们忘记了他的能力 ， 就是他救赎他们脱离敌人的日子，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不追念他的能力 和赎他们脱离敌人的日子；
verses.textEnNiv: They did not remember his power— the day he redeemed them from the oppressor,
verses.textEnEsv: They did not remember his power or the day when he redeemed them from the foe,
verses.textEnNkjv: They did not remember His power: The day when He redeemed them from the enemy,
verses.textEnNlt: They did not remember his power and how he rescued them from their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: They did not remember His power, The day when He redeemed them from the enemy,
verses.textEn: They did not remember his power— the day he redeemed them from the oppressor,

verses.textZh: 他怎样在埃及显神迹， 在琐安的田野行奇事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他怎样在埃及显神迹， 在琐安的田野行奇事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他怎样在埃及地显神迹， 在琐安田显奇事，
verses.textEnNiv: the day he displayed his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the region of Zoan.
verses.textEnEsv: when he performed his signs in Egypt and his marvels in the fields of Zoan.
verses.textEnNkjv: When He worked His signs in Egypt, And His wonders in the field of Zoan;
verses.textEnNlt: They did not remember his miraculous signs in Egypt, his wonders on the plain of Zoan.
verses.textEnNasb: When He performed His signs in Egypt And His marvels in the field of Zoan,
verses.textEn: the day he displayed his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the region of Zoan.

verses.textZh: 他把他们的江河都变为血， 使他们不能喝河流的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把他们的江河都变为血， 使他们不能喝河流的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 把他们的江河并河汊的水都变为血， 使他们不能喝。
verses.textEnNiv: He turned their river into blood; they could not drink from their streams.
verses.textEnEsv: He turned their rivers to blood, so that they could not drink of their streams.
verses.textEnNkjv: Turned their rivers into blood, And their streams, that they could not drink.
verses.textEnNlt: For he turned their rivers into blood, so no one could drink from the streams.
verses.textEnNasb: And turned their rivers to blood, And their streams, so that they could not drink.
verses.textEn: He turned their river into blood; they could not drink from their streams.

verses.textZh: 他使成群的苍蝇到他们中间来，吞吃他们； 又使青蛙来毁灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使成群的苍蝇到他们中间来，吞吃他们； 又使青蛙来毁灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他叫苍蝇成群落在他们当中，嘬尽他们， 又叫青蛙灭了他们，
verses.textEnNiv: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
verses.textEnEsv: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them, and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent swarms of flies among them, which devoured them, And frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.textEnNlt: He sent vast swarms of flies to consume them and hordes of frogs to ruin them.
verses.textEnNasb: He sent swarms of flies among them that devoured them, And frogs that destroyed them.
verses.textEn: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.

verses.textZh: 他把他们的农产交给蚱蜢， 把他们辛劳的收获交给蝗虫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把他们的农产交给蚱蜢， 把他们辛劳的收获交给蝗虫。
verses.textZhCuv: 把他们的土产交给蚂蚱， 把他们辛苦得来的交给蝗虫。
verses.textEnNiv: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, their produce to the locust.
verses.textEnEsv: He gave their crops to the destroying locust and the fruit of their labor to the locust.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also gave their crops to the caterpillar, And their labor to the locust.
verses.textEnNlt: He gave their crops to caterpillars; their harvest was consumed by locusts.
verses.textEnNasb: He also gave their crops to the grasshopper And the product of their labor to the locust.
verses.textEn: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, their produce to the locust.

verses.textZh: 他用冰雹摧毁他们的葡萄树， 用严霜冻坏他们的桑树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用冰雹摧毁他们的葡萄树， 用严霜冻坏他们的桑树。
verses.textZhCuv: 他降冰雹打坏他们的葡萄树， 下严霜打坏他们的桑树，
verses.textEnNiv: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
verses.textEnEsv: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamores with frost.
verses.textEnNkjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycamore trees with frost.
verses.textEnNlt: He destroyed their grapevines with hail and shattered their sycamore-figs with sleet.
verses.textEnNasb: He destroyed their vines with hailstones And their sycamore trees with frost.
verses.textEn: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamore-figs with sleet.

verses.textZh: 又把他们的牲畜交给冰雹， 把他们的群畜交给闪电。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把他们的牲畜交给冰雹， 把他们的群畜交给闪电。
verses.textZhCuv: 又把他们的牲畜交给冰雹， 把他们的群畜交给闪电。
verses.textEnNiv: He gave over their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.
verses.textEnEsv: He gave over their cattle to the hail and their flocks to thunderbolts.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also gave up their cattle to the hail, And their flocks to fiery lightning.
verses.textEnNlt: He abandoned their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.
verses.textEnNasb: He also turned their cattle over to the hailstones, And their herds to bolts of lightning.
verses.textEn: He gave over their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.

verses.textZh: 他使猛烈的怒气、忿怒、愤恨、患难， 好象一群降灾的使者，临到他们中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使猛烈的怒气、忿怒、愤恨、患难， 好象一群降灾的使者，临到他们中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使猛烈的怒气和忿怒、恼恨、苦难 成了一群降灾的使者，临到他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He unleashed against them his hot anger, his wrath, indignation and hostility— a band of destroying angels.
verses.textEnEsv: He let loose on them his burning anger, wrath, indignation, and distress, a company of destroying angels.
verses.textEnNkjv: He cast on them the fierceness of His anger, Wrath, indignation, and trouble, By sending angels of destruction amongthem.
verses.textEnNlt: He loosed on them his fierce anger— all his fury, rage, and hostility. He dispatched against them a band of destroying angels.
verses.textEnNasb: He sent His burning anger upon them, Fury and indignation and trouble, A band of destroying angels.
verses.textEn: He unleashed against them his hot anger, his wrath, indignation and hostility— a band of destroying angels.

verses.textZh: 他为自己的怒气修平了路， 不惜使他们死亡， 把他们的性命交给瘟疫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为自己的怒气修平了路， 不惜使他们死亡， 把他们的性命交给瘟疫。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为自己的怒气修平了路， 将他们交给瘟疫， 使他们死亡，
verses.textEnNiv: He prepared a path for his anger; he did not spare them from death but gave them over to the plague.
verses.textEnEsv: He made a path for his anger; he did not spare them from death, but gave their lives over to the plague.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made a path for His anger; He did not spare their soul from death, But gave their life over to the plague,
verses.textEnNlt: He turned his anger against them; he did not spare the Egyptians’ lives but ravaged them with the plague.
verses.textEnNasb: He leveled a path for His anger; He did not spare their souls from death, But turned their lives over to the plague,
verses.textEn: He prepared a path for his anger; he did not spare them from death but gave them over to the plague.

verses.textZh: 他在埃及击杀了所有的长子， 在含的帐棚中击杀了他们强壮时生的头胎子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在埃及击杀了所有的长子， 在含的帐棚中击杀了他们强壮时生的头胎子。
verses.textZhCuv: 在埃及击杀一切长子， 在含的帐棚中击杀他们强壮时头生的。
verses.textEnNiv: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.
verses.textEnEsv: He struck down every firstborn in Egypt, the firstfruits of their strength in the tents of Ham.
verses.textEnNkjv: And destroyed all the firstborn in Egypt, The first of their strength in the tents of Ham.
verses.textEnNlt: He killed the oldest son in each Egyptian family, the flower of youth throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: And struck all the firstborn in Egypt, The first and best of their vigor in the tents of Ham.
verses.textEn: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.

verses.textZh: 他却把自己的子民领出来好象领羊群， 在旷野引导他们像引导群畜一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却把自己的子民领出来好象领羊群， 在旷野引导他们像引导群畜一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他却领出自己的民如羊， 在旷野引他们如羊群。
verses.textEnNiv: But he brought his people out like a flock; he led them like sheep through the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he led out his people like sheep and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: But He made His own people go forth like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock;
verses.textEnNlt: But he led his own people like a flock of sheep, guiding them safely through the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: But He led His own people out like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock;
verses.textEn: But he brought his people out like a flock; he led them like sheep through the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 他带领他们平平安安地走过去，所以他们不惧怕； 海却淹没了他们的仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他带领他们平平安安地走过去，所以他们不惧怕； 海却淹没了他们的仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 他领他们稳稳妥妥地，使他们不致害怕； 海却淹没他们的仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: He guided them safely, so they were unafraid; but the sea engulfed their enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: He led them in safety, so that they were not afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He led them on safely, so that they did not fear; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: He kept them safe so they were not afraid; but the sea covered their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: He led them safely, so that they did not fear; But the sea engulfed their enemies.
verses.textEn: He guided them safely, so they were unafraid; but the sea engulfed their enemies.

verses.textZh: 他领他们进入自己圣地的境界， 到他右手所得的这山地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领他们进入自己圣地的境界， 到他右手所得的这山地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带他们到自己圣地的边界， 到他右手所得的这山地。
verses.textEnNiv: And so he brought them to the border of his holy land, to the hill country his right hand had taken.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought them to his holy land, to the mountain which his right hand had won.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He brought them to His holy border, This mountain which His right hand had acquired.
verses.textEnNlt: He brought them to the border of his holy land, to this land of hills he had won for them.
verses.textEnNasb: So He brought them to His holy land, To this hill country which His right hand had gained.
verses.textEn: And so he brought them to the border of his holy land, to the hill country his right hand had taken.

verses.textZh: 他在他们面前把外族人赶出去， 用绳子量地，分给他们作为产业， 又使以色列众支派的人居住在自己的帐棚里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在他们面前把外族人赶出去， 用绳子量地，分给他们作为产业， 又使以色列众支派的人居住在自己的帐棚里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在他们面前赶出外邦人， 用绳子将外邦的地量给他们为业， 叫以色列支派的人住在他们的帐棚里。
verses.textEnNiv: He drove out nations before them and allotted their lands to them as an inheritance; he settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.
verses.textEnEsv: He drove out nations before them; he apportioned them for a possession and settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also drove out the nations before them, Allotted them an inheritance by survey, And made the tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.
verses.textEnNlt: He drove out the nations before them; he gave them their inheritance by lot. He settled the tribes of Israel into their homes.
verses.textEnNasb: He also drove out the nations from them And apportioned them as an inheritance by measurement, And had the tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.
verses.textEn: He drove out nations before them and allotted their lands to them as an inheritance; he settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.

verses.textZh: 但他们仍然试探和悖逆至高的神， 不谨守他的法则。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们仍然试探和悖逆至高的神， 不谨守他的法则。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们仍旧试探、悖逆至高的神， 不守他的法度，
verses.textEnNiv: But they put God to the test and rebelled against the Most High; they did not keep his statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet they tested and rebelled against the Most High God and did not keep his testimonies,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they tested and provoked the Most High God, And did not keep His testimonies,
verses.textEnNlt: But they kept testing and rebelling against God Most High. They did not obey his laws.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God And did not keep His testimonies,
verses.textEn: But they put God to the test and rebelled against the Most High; they did not keep his statutes.

verses.textZh: 他们背信不忠，像他们的列祖一样； 他们改变了，如同不可靠的弓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们背信不忠，像他们的列祖一样； 他们改变了，如同不可靠的弓。
verses.textZhCuv: 反倒退后，行诡诈，像他们的祖宗一样； 他们改变，如同翻背的弓。
verses.textEnNiv: Like their ancestors they were disloyal and faithless, as unreliable as a faulty bow.
verses.textEnEsv: but turned away and acted treacherously like their fathers; they twisted like a deceitful bow.
verses.textEnNkjv: But turned back and acted unfaithfully like their fathers; They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.textEnNlt: They turned back and were as faithless as their parents. They were as undependable as a crooked bow.
verses.textEnNasb: But turned back and acted treacherously like their fathers; They turned aside like a treacherous bow.
verses.textEn: Like their ancestors they were disloyal and faithless, as unreliable as a faulty bow.

verses.textZh: 因他们的邱坛，惹起他的怒气， 因他们雕刻的偶像，激起他的愤恨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因他们的邱坛，惹起他的怒气， 因他们雕刻的偶像，激起他的愤恨。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们的邱坛惹了他的怒气； 因他们雕刻的偶像触动他的愤恨。
verses.textEnNiv: They angered him with their high places; they aroused his jealousy with their idols.
verses.textEnEsv: For they provoked him to anger with their high places; they moved him to jealousy with their idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they provoked Him to anger with their high places, And moved Him to jealousy with their carved images.
verses.textEnNlt: They angered God by building shrines to other gods; they made him jealous with their idols.
verses.textEnNasb: For they provoked Him with their high places And moved Him to jealousy with their carved images.
verses.textEn: They angered him with their high places; they aroused his jealousy with their idols.

verses.textZh: 神听见就大怒， 完全弃绝了以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神听见就大怒， 完全弃绝了以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 神听见就发怒， 极其憎恶以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: When God heard them, he was furious; he rejected Israel completely.
verses.textEnEsv: When God heard, he was full of wrath, and he utterly rejected Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: When God heard this, He was furious, And greatly abhorred Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: When God heard them, he was very angry, and he completely rejected Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: When God heard them, He was filled with wrath And He utterly rejected Israel;
verses.textEn: When God heard them, he was furious; he rejected Israel completely.

verses.textZh: 他丢弃了在示罗的居所， 就是他在世人中间居住的帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他丢弃了在示罗的居所， 就是他在世人中间居住的帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至他离弃示罗的帐幕， 就是他在人间所搭的帐棚；
verses.textEnNiv: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent he had set up among humans.
verses.textEnEsv: He forsook his dwelling at Shiloh, the tent where he dwelt among mankind,
verses.textEnNkjv: So that He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent He had placed among men,
verses.textEnNlt: Then he abandoned his dwelling at Shiloh, the Tabernacle where he had lived among the people.
verses.textEnNasb: So that He abandoned the dwelling place at Shiloh, The tent which He had pitched among people,
verses.textEn: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent he had set up among humans.

verses.textZh: 他又把象征他权能的约柜交给人掳去， 把他的荣美交在敌人的手里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把象征他权能的约柜交给人掳去， 把他的荣美交在敌人的手里，
verses.textZhCuv: 又将他的约柜 交与人掳去， 将他的荣耀交在敌人手中；
verses.textEnNiv: He sent the ark of his might into captivity, his splendor into the hands of the enemy.
verses.textEnEsv: and delivered his power to captivity, his glory to the hand of the foe.
verses.textEnNkjv: And delivered His strength into captivity, And His glory into the enemy’s hand.
verses.textEnNlt: He allowed the Ark of his might to be captured; he surrendered his glory into enemy hands.
verses.textEnNasb: And He gave up His strength to captivity And His glory into the hand of the enemy.
verses.textEn: He sent the ark of his might into captivity, his splendor into the hands of the enemy.

verses.textZh: 并且把自己的子民交给刀剑， 向自己的产业大发烈怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且把自己的子民交给刀剑， 向自己的产业大发烈怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 并将他的百姓交与刀剑， 向他的产业发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: He gave his people over to the sword; he was furious with his inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: He gave his people over to the sword and vented his wrath on his heritage.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also gave His people over to the sword, And was furious with His inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: He gave his people over to be butchered by the sword, because he was so angry with his own people—his special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: He also turned His people over to the sword, And was filled with wrath at His inheritance.
verses.textEn: He gave his people over to the sword; he was furious with his inheritance.

verses.textZh: 他们的青年被火吞灭， 他们的少女也听不见结婚的喜歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的青年被火吞灭， 他们的少女也听不见结婚的喜歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 少年人被火烧灭； 处女也无喜歌。
verses.textEnNiv: Fire consumed their young men, and their young women had no wedding songs;
verses.textEnEsv: Fire devoured their young men, and their young women had no marriage song.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fire consumed their young men, And their maidens were not given in marriage.
verses.textEnNlt: Their young men were killed by fire; their young women died before singing their wedding songs.
verses.textEnNasb: Fire devoured His young men, And His virgins had no wedding songs.
verses.textEn: Fire consumed their young men, and their young women had no wedding songs;

verses.textZh: 他们的祭司倒在刀下， 他们的寡妇却不能哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的祭司倒在刀下， 他们的寡妇却不能哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司倒在刀下， 寡妇却不哀哭。
verses.textEnNiv: their priests were put to the sword, and their widows could not weep.
verses.textEnEsv: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their priests fell by the sword, And their widows made no lamentation.
verses.textEnNlt: Their priests were slaughtered, and their widows could not mourn their deaths.
verses.textEnNasb: His priests fell by the sword, And His widows could not weep.
verses.textEn: their priests were put to the sword, and their widows could not weep.

verses.textZh: 那时主好象从睡眠中醒过来， 如同勇士酒后清醒一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时主好象从睡眠中醒过来， 如同勇士酒后清醒一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，主像世人睡醒， 像勇士饮酒呼喊。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, as a warrior wakes from the stupor of wine.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a strong man shouting because of wine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, Like a mighty man who shouts because of wine.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord rose up as though waking from sleep, like a warrior aroused from a drunken stupor.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord awoke as if from sleep, Like a warrior overcome by wine.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, as a warrior wakes from the stupor of wine.

verses.textZh: 他击退了他的敌人， 使他们永远蒙羞受辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他击退了他的敌人， 使他们永远蒙羞受辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就打退了他的敌人， 叫他们永蒙羞辱；
verses.textEnNiv: He beat back his enemies; he put them to everlasting shame.
verses.textEnEsv: And he put his adversaries to rout; he put them to everlasting shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He beat back His enemies; He put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.textEnNlt: He routed his enemies and sent them to eternal shame.
verses.textEnNasb: He drove His adversaries backward; He put on them an everlasting disgrace.
verses.textEn: He beat back his enemies; he put them to everlasting shame.

verses.textZh: 他弃绝约瑟的帐棚， 不拣选以法莲支派，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他弃绝约瑟的帐棚， 不拣选以法莲支派，
verses.textZhCuv: 并且他弃掉约瑟的帐棚， 不拣选以法莲支派，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he rejected the tents of Joseph, he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;
verses.textEnEsv: He rejected the tent of Joseph; he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover He rejected the tent of Joseph, And did not choose the tribe of Ephraim,
verses.textEnNlt: But he rejected Joseph’s descendants; he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: He also rejected the tent of Joseph, And did not choose the tribe of Ephraim,
verses.textEn: Then he rejected the tents of Joseph, he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;

verses.textZh: 却拣选了犹大支派， 他所爱的锡安山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却拣选了犹大支派， 他所爱的锡安山。
verses.textZhCuv: 却拣选犹大支派－他所喜爱的锡安山；
verses.textEnNiv: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.
verses.textEnEsv: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loves.
verses.textEnNkjv: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which He loved.
verses.textEnNlt: He chose instead the tribe of Judah, and Mount Zion, which he loved.
verses.textEnNasb: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
verses.textEn: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.

verses.textZh: 他建造了自己的圣所好象在高天之上， 又像他所建立永存的大地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他建造了自己的圣所好象在高天之上， 又像他所建立永存的大地。
verses.textZhCuv: 盖造他的圣所，好像高峰， 又像他建立永存之地；
verses.textEnNiv: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he established forever.
verses.textEnEsv: He built his sanctuary like the high heavens, like the earth, which he has founded forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which He has established forever.
verses.textEnNlt: There he built his sanctuary as high as the heavens, as solid and enduring as the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which He has established forever.
verses.textEn: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he established forever.

verses.textZh: 他拣选了自己的仆人大卫， 把他从羊圈中召出来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拣选了自己的仆人大卫， 把他从羊圈中召出来；
verses.textZhCuv: 又拣选他的仆人大卫， 从羊圈中将他召来，
verses.textEnNiv: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheep pens;
verses.textEnEsv: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheepfolds;
verses.textEnNkjv: He also chose David His servant, And took him from the sheepfolds;
verses.textEnNlt: He chose his servant David, calling him from the sheep pens.
verses.textEnNasb: He also chose His servant David And took him from the sheepfolds;
verses.textEn: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheep pens;

verses.textZh: 他领他出来，使他不再跟着那些母羊， 却要牧养他的子民雅各， 和他的产业以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领他出来，使他不再跟着那些母羊， 却要牧养他的子民雅各， 和他的产业以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫他不再跟从那些带奶的母羊， 为要牧养自己的百姓雅各 和自己的产业以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: from tending the sheep he brought him to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, of Israel his inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: from following the nursing ewes he brought him to shepherd Jacob his people, Israel his inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: From following the ewes that had young He brought him, To shepherd Jacob His people, And Israel His inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: He took David from tending the ewes and lambs and made him the shepherd of Jacob’s descendants— God’s own people, Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: From the care of the ewes with nursing lambs He brought him To shepherd Jacob His people, And Israel His inheritance.
verses.textEn: from tending the sheep he brought him to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, of Israel his inheritance.

verses.textZh: 于是大卫以正直的心牧养他们， 灵巧地引导他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大卫以正直的心牧养他们， 灵巧地引导他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，他按心中的纯正牧养他们， 用手中的巧妙引导他们。
verses.textEnNiv: And David shepherded them with integrity of heart; with skillful hands he led them.
verses.textEnEsv: With upright heart he shepherded them and guided them with his skillful hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
verses.textEnNlt: He cared for them with a true heart and led them with skillful hands.
verses.textEnNasb: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them with his skillful hands.
verses.textEn: And David shepherded them with integrity of heart; with skillful hands he led them.

verses.textZh: 亚萨的诗。神啊！外族人侵入你的产业， 污秽了你的圣殿， 使耶路撒冷成为废墟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的诗。神啊！外族人侵入你的产业， 污秽了你的圣殿， 使耶路撒冷成为废墟。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，外邦人进入你的产业， 污秽你的圣殿，使耶路撒冷变成荒堆，
verses.textEnNiv: O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple, they have reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, the nations have come into your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple; they have laid Jerusalem in ruins.
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, the nations have come into Your inheritance; Your holy temple they have defiled; They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, pagan nations have conquered your land, your special possession. They have defiled your holy Temple and made Jerusalem a heap of ruins.
verses.textEnNasb: God, the nations have invaded Your inheritance; They have defiled Your holy temple; They have laid Jerusalem in ruins.
verses.textEn: O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple, they have reduced Jerusalem to rubble.

verses.textZh: 他们把你仆人的尸首， 给空中的飞鸟啄食； 把你圣民的肉， 给地上的野兽吞噬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把你仆人的尸首， 给空中的飞鸟啄食； 把你圣民的肉， 给地上的野兽吞噬。
verses.textZhCuv: 把你仆人的尸首交与天空的飞鸟为食， 把你圣民的肉交与地上的野兽，
verses.textEnNiv: They have left the dead bodies of your servants as food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your own people for the animals of the wild.
verses.textEnEsv: They have given the bodies of your servants to the birds of the heavens for food, the flesh of your faithful to the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The dead bodies of Your servants They have given as food for the birds of the heavens, The flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: They have left the bodies of your servants as food for the birds of heaven. The flesh of your godly ones has become food for the wild animals.
verses.textEnNasb: They have given the dead bodies of Your servants to the birds of the sky as food, The flesh of Your godly ones to the animals of the earth.
verses.textEn: They have left the dead bodies of your servants as food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your own people for the animals of the wild.

verses.textZh: 他们在耶路撒冷的周围把圣民的血像水一般倒出， 没有人埋葬他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在耶路撒冷的周围把圣民的血像水一般倒出， 没有人埋葬他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶路撒冷周围流他们的血如水， 无人葬埋。
verses.textEnNiv: They have poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there was no one to bury them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their blood they have shed like water all around Jerusalem, And therewas no one to bury them.
verses.textEnNlt: Blood has flowed like water all around Jerusalem; no one is left to bury the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem; And there was no one to bury them.
verses.textEn: They have poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.

verses.textZh: 我们成为邻国羞辱的对象， 成为四周的人嗤笑和讥刺的目标。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们成为邻国羞辱的对象， 成为四周的人嗤笑和讥刺的目标。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们成为邻国的羞辱， 成为我们四围人的嗤笑讥刺。
verses.textEnNiv: We are objects of contempt to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.
verses.textEnEsv: We have become a taunt to our neighbors, mocked and derided by those around us.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, A scorn and derision to those who are around us.
verses.textEnNlt: We are mocked by our neighbors, an object of scorn and derision to those around us.
verses.textEnNasb: We have become a disgrace before our neighbors, An object of derision and ridicule to those around us.
verses.textEn: We are objects of contempt to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！要到几时呢？ 你要永远怀怒吗？ 你的愤恨要像火焚烧吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！要到几时呢？ 你要永远怀怒吗？ 你的愤恨要像火焚烧吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，这到几时呢？ 你要动怒到永远吗？ 你的愤恨要如火焚烧吗？
verses.textEnNiv: How long, Lord ? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?
verses.textEnEsv: How long, O Lord ? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
verses.textEnNkjv: How long, Lord? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , how long will you be angry with us? Forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?
verses.textEnNasb: How long, Lord? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
verses.textEn: How long, Lord ? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?

verses.textZh: 愿你把你的烈怒，倾倒在不认识你的外族人， 和不求告你名的列国身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你把你的烈怒，倾倒在不认识你的外族人， 和不求告你名的列国身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你将你的忿怒倒在那不认识你的外邦 和那不求告你名的国度。
verses.textEnNiv: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;
verses.textEnEsv: Pour out your anger on the nations that do not know you, and on the kingdoms that do not call upon your name!
verses.textEnNkjv: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not know You, And on the kingdoms that do not call on Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: Pour out your wrath on the nations that refuse to acknowledge you— on kingdoms that do not call upon your name.
verses.textEnNasb: Pour out Your wrath upon the nations which do not know You, And upon the kingdoms which do not call upon Your name.
verses.textEn: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;

verses.textZh: 因为他们吞吃了雅各， 使他的住处荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们吞吃了雅各， 使他的住处荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们吞了雅各， 把他的住处变为荒场。
verses.textEnNiv: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
verses.textEnEsv: For they have devoured Jacob and laid waste his habitation.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.textEnNlt: For they have devoured your people Israel, making the land a desolate wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: For they have devoured Jacob And laid waste his settlement.
verses.textEn: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.

verses.textZh: 求你不要记住我们祖先的罪孽； 愿你的怜悯快快临到我们， 因为我们落到极卑微的地步。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你不要记住我们祖先的罪孽； 愿你的怜悯快快临到我们， 因为我们落到极卑微的地步。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你不要记念我们先祖的罪孽，向我们追讨； 愿你的慈悲快迎着我们， 因为我们落到极卑微的地步。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not hold against us the sins of past generations; may your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are in desperate need.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not remember against us our former iniquities; let your compassion come speedily to meet us, for we are brought very low.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, do not remember former iniquities against us! Let Your tender mercies come speedily to meet us, For we have been brought very low.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not hold us guilty for the sins of our ancestors! Let your compassion quickly meet our needs, for we are on the brink of despair.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not hold us responsible for the guilty deeds of our forefathers; Let Your compassion come quickly to meet us, For we have become very low.
verses.textEn: Do not hold against us the sins of past generations; may your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are in desperate need.

verses.textZh: 拯救我们的神啊！ 求你因你名的荣耀帮助我们； 为你名的缘故， 搭救我们，赦免我们的罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拯救我们的神啊！ 求你因你名的荣耀帮助我们； 为你名的缘故， 搭救我们，赦免我们的罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 拯救我们的神啊，求你因你名的荣耀帮助我们！ 为你名的缘故搭救我们，赦免我们的罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name’s sake.
verses.textEnEsv: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your name; deliver us, and atone for our sins, for your name’s sake!
verses.textEnNkjv: Help us, O God of our salvation, For the glory of Your name; And deliver us, and provide atonement for our sins, For Your name’s sake!
verses.textEnNlt: Help us, O God of our salvation! Help us for the glory of your name. Save us and forgive our sins for the honor of your name.
verses.textEnNasb: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; And save us and forgive our sins for the sake of Your name.
verses.textEn: Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name’s sake.

verses.textZh: 为甚么容外族人说： "他们的神在哪里呢？" 愿我们亲眼看见你在列邦中， 使人知道你要为你仆人所流的血伸冤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么容外族人说： "他们的神在哪里呢？" 愿我们亲眼看见你在列邦中， 使人知道你要为你仆人所流的血伸冤。
verses.textZhCuv: 为何容外邦人说「他们的神在哪里」呢？ 愿你使外邦人知道你在我们眼前 伸你仆人流血的冤。
verses.textEnNiv: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.
verses.textEnEsv: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let the avenging of the outpoured blood of your servants be known among the nations before our eyes!
verses.textEnNkjv: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let there be known among the nations in our sight The avenging of the blood of Your servants whichhasbeen shed.
verses.textEnNlt: Why should pagan nations be allowed to scoff, asking, "Where is their God?" Show us your vengeance against the nations, for they have spilled the blood of your servants.
verses.textEnNasb: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let vengeance for the blood of Your servants which has been shed Be known among the nations in our sight.
verses.textEn: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.

verses.textZh: 愿被囚的人的唉哼，达到你面前； 愿你用你的大能，使那些已定死罪的人可以存留。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿被囚的人的唉哼，达到你面前； 愿你用你的大能，使那些已定死罪的人可以存留。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿被囚之人的叹息达到你面前； 愿你按你的大能力存留那些将要死的人。
verses.textEnNiv: May the groans of the prisoners come before you; with your strong arm preserve those condemned to die.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the groans of the prisoners come before you; according to your great power, preserve those doomed to die!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You; According to the greatness of Your power Preserve those who are appointed to die;
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to the moaning of the prisoners. Demonstrate your great power by saving those condemned to die.
verses.textEnNasb: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You; According to the greatness of Your power, let those who are doomed to die remain.
verses.textEn: May the groans of the prisoners come before you; with your strong arm preserve those condemned to die.

verses.textZh: 主啊！愿你把我们邻国羞辱你的羞辱， 七倍归还在他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！愿你把我们邻国羞辱你的羞辱， 七倍归还在他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，愿你将我们邻邦所羞辱你的羞辱 加七倍归到他们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Return sevenfold into the lap of our neighbors the taunts with which they have taunted you, O Lord!
verses.textEnNkjv: And return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach with which they have reproached You, O Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord, pay back our neighbors seven times for the scorn they have hurled at you.
verses.textEnNasb: And return to our neighbors seven times as much into their lap Their taunts with which they have taunted You, Lord.
verses.textEn: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord.

verses.textZh: 这样，我们作你的子民，作你牧场上的羊的， 要永远称谢你； 我们要世世代代述说你可称颂的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我们作你的子民，作你牧场上的羊的， 要永远称谢你； 我们要世世代代述说你可称颂的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你的民，你草场的羊， 要称谢你，直到永远； 要述说赞美你的话，直到万代。
verses.textEnNiv: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will proclaim your praise.
verses.textEnEsv: But we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will give thanks to you forever; from generation to generation we will recount your praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: So we, Your people and sheep of Your pasture, Will give You thanks forever; We will show forth Your praise to all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will thank you forever and ever, praising your greatness from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNasb: So we Your people and the sheep of Your pasture Will give thanks to You forever; To all generations we will tell of Your praise.
verses.textEn: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will proclaim your praise.

verses.textZh: 亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，调用"见证的花"。 以色列的牧者啊！带领约瑟好象带领羊群的啊！ 求你留心听； 坐在基路伯上面的啊！ 求你显出荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，调用"见证的花"。 以色列的牧者啊！带领约瑟好象带领羊群的啊！ 求你留心听； 坐在基路伯上面的啊！ 求你显出荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 领约瑟如领羊群之以色列的牧者啊，求你留心听！ 坐在二基路伯上的啊，求你发出光来！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock. You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
verses.textEnEsv: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock. You who are enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, You who lead Joseph like a flock; You who dwell between the cherubim, shine forth!
verses.textEnNlt: Please listen, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph’s descendants like a flock. O God, enthroned above the cherubim, display your radiant glory
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, Shepherd of Israel, Who leads Joseph like a flock; You who are enthroned above the cherubim, shine forth!
verses.textEn: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock. You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth

verses.textZh: 在以法莲、便雅悯和玛拿西面前， 求你施展你的大能， 前来拯救我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以法莲、便雅悯和玛拿西面前， 求你施展你的大能， 前来拯救我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在以法莲、便雅悯、玛拿西前面 施展你的大能，来救我们。
verses.textEnNiv: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.
verses.textEnEsv: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might and come to save us!
verses.textEnNkjv: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, Stir up Your strength, And come and save us!
verses.textEnNlt: to Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Show us your mighty power. Come to rescue us!
verses.textEnNasb: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, awaken Your power, And come to save us!
verses.textEn: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.

verses.textZh: 神啊，求你使我们复兴！ 愿你的脸光照我们，我们就可以得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊，求你使我们复兴！ 愿你的脸光照我们，我们就可以得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你使我们回转 ， 使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！
verses.textEnNiv: Restore us, O God; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: Restore us, O God; let your face shine, that we may be saved!
verses.textEnNkjv: Restore us, O God; Cause Your face to shine, And we shall be saved!
verses.textEnNlt: Turn us again to yourself, O God. Make your face shine down upon us. Only then will we be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: God, restore us And make Your face shine upon us, and we will be saved.
verses.textEn: Restore us, O God; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.

verses.textZh: 耶和华万军之神啊！ 你因你子民的祷告发怒，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华万军之神啊！ 你因你子民的祷告发怒，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－万军之神啊， 你向你百姓的祷告发怒，要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long, Lord God Almighty, will your anger smolder against the prayers of your people?
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord God of hosts, how long will you be angry with your people’s prayers?
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord God of hosts, How long will You be angry Against the prayer of Your people?
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, how long will you be angry with our prayers?
verses.textEnNasb: Lord God of armies, How long will You be angry with the prayer of Your people?
verses.textEn: How long, Lord God Almighty, will your anger smolder against the prayers of your people?

verses.textZh: 你使他们以眼泪当饼吃， 使他们喝满杯的泪水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使他们以眼泪当饼吃， 使他们喝满杯的泪水。
verses.textZhCuv: 你以眼泪当食物给他们吃， 又多量出眼泪给他们喝。
verses.textEnNiv: You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.
verses.textEnEsv: You have fed them with the bread of tears and given them tears to drink in full measure.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.textEnNlt: You have fed us with sorrow and made us drink tears by the bucketful.
verses.textEnNasb: You have fed them with the bread of tears, And You have made them drink tears in large measure.
verses.textEn: You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.

verses.textZh: 你使我们的邻国因我们纷争， 我们的仇敌也讥笑我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我们的邻国因我们纷争， 我们的仇敌也讥笑我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使邻邦因我们纷争； 我们的仇敌彼此戏笑。
verses.textEnNiv: You have made us an object of derision to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.
verses.textEnEsv: You make us an object of contention for our neighbors, and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have made us a strife to our neighbors, And our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: You have made us the scorn of neighboring nations. Our enemies treat us as a joke.
verses.textEnNasb: You make us an object of contention to our neighbors, And our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.textEn: You have made us an object of derision to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.

verses.textZh: 万军的神啊！求你使我们复兴； 愿你的脸光照我们，我们就可以得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军的神啊！求你使我们复兴； 愿你的脸光照我们，我们就可以得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之神啊，求你使我们回转， 使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！
verses.textEnNiv: Restore us, God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: Restore us, O God of hosts; let your face shine, that we may be saved!
verses.textEnNkjv: Restore us, O God of hosts; Cause Your face to shine, And we shall be saved!
verses.textEnNlt: Turn us again to yourself, O God of Heaven’s Armies. Make your face shine down upon us. Only then will we be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: God of armies, restore us And make Your face shine upon us, and we will be saved.
verses.textEn: Restore us, God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.

verses.textZh: 你从埃及带走一棵葡萄树， 你赶出外族人，把这树栽上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你从埃及带走一棵葡萄树， 你赶出外族人，把这树栽上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你从埃及挪出一棵葡萄树， 赶出外邦人，把这树栽上。
verses.textEnNiv: You transplanted a vine from Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.
verses.textEnEsv: You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have brought a vine out of Egypt; You have cast out the nations, and planted it.
verses.textEnNlt: You brought us from Egypt like a grapevine; you drove away the pagan nations and transplanted us into your land.
verses.textEnNasb: You removed a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and planted it.
verses.textEn: You transplanted a vine from Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.

verses.textZh: 你为它预备了地土， 它就深深扎根，充满全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为它预备了地土， 它就深深扎根，充满全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在这树根前预备了地方， 它就深深扎根，爬满了地。
verses.textEnNiv: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
verses.textEnEsv: You cleared the ground for it; it took deep root and filled the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: You prepared room for it, And caused it to take deep root, And it filled the land.
verses.textEnNlt: You cleared the ground for us, and we took root and filled the land.
verses.textEnNasb: You cleared the ground before it, And it took deep root and filled the land.
verses.textEn: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.

verses.textZh: 它的荫影遮盖了群山， 它的枝条遮盖了高大的香柏树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的荫影遮盖了群山， 它的枝条遮盖了高大的香柏树。
verses.textZhCuv: 它的影子遮满了山， 枝子好像佳美的香柏树。
verses.textEnNiv: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.
verses.textEnEsv: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hills were covered with its shadow, And the mighty cedars with its boughs.
verses.textEnNlt: Our shade covered the mountains; our branches covered the mighty cedars.
verses.textEnNasb: The mountains were covered with its shadow, And the cedars of God with its branches.
verses.textEn: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.

verses.textZh: 它的枝条伸展，直到大海； 它的幼苗，直到大河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的枝条伸展，直到大海； 它的幼苗，直到大河。
verses.textZhCuv: 它发出枝子，长到大海， 发出蔓子，延到大河。
verses.textEnNiv: Its branches reached as far as the Sea, its shoots as far as the River.
verses.textEnEsv: It sent out its branches to the sea and its shoots to the River.
verses.textEnNkjv: She sent out her boughs to the Sea, And her branches to the River.
verses.textEnNlt: We spread our branches west to the Mediterranean Sea; our shoots spread east to the Euphrates River.
verses.textEnNasb: It was sending out its branches to the sea And its shoots to the Euphrates River.
verses.textEn: Its branches reached as far as the Sea, its shoots as far as the River.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么拆毁它的篱笆， 任由所有过路的人采摘呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么拆毁它的篱笆， 任由所有过路的人采摘呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你为何拆毁这树的篱笆， 任凭一切过路的人摘取？
verses.textEnNiv: Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?
verses.textEnEsv: Why then have you broken down its walls, so that all who pass along the way pluck its fruit?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why have You broken down her hedges, So that all who pass by the way pluck her fruit?
verses.textEnNlt: But now, why have you broken down our walls so that all who pass by may steal our fruit?
verses.textEnNasb: Why have You broken down its hedges, So that all who pass that way pick its fruit?
verses.textEn: Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?

verses.textZh: 从树林中出来的野猪践踏它， 田野的走兽把它吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从树林中出来的野猪践踏它， 田野的走兽把它吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 林中出来的野猪把它糟踏； 野地的走兽拿它当食物。
verses.textEnNiv: Boars from the forest ravage it, and insects from the fields feed on it.
verses.textEnEsv: The boar from the forest ravages it, and all that move in the field feed on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The boar out of the woods uproots it, And the wild beast of the field devours it.
verses.textEnNlt: The wild boar from the forest devours it, and the wild animals feed on it.
verses.textEnNasb: A boar from the forest eats it away, And whatever moves in the field feeds on it.
verses.textEn: Boars from the forest ravage it, and insects from the fields feed on it.

verses.textZh: 万军的神啊！求你回心转意， 从天上垂看鉴察， 眷顾这葡萄树，
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军的神啊！求你回心转意， 从天上垂看鉴察， 眷顾这葡萄树，
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之神啊，求你回转！ 从天上垂看，眷顾这葡萄树，
verses.textEnNiv: Return to us, God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Watch over this vine,
verses.textEnEsv: Turn again, O God of hosts! Look down from heaven, and see; have regard for this vine,
verses.textEnNkjv: Return, we beseech You, O God of hosts; Look down from heaven and see, And visit this vine
verses.textEnNlt: Come back, we beg you, O God of Heaven’s Armies. Look down from heaven and see our plight. Take care of this grapevine
verses.textEnNasb: God of armies, do turn back; Look down from heaven and see, and take care of this vine,
verses.textEn: Return to us, God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Watch over this vine,

verses.textZh: 眷顾你右手栽种的根， 和你为自己培育的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 眷顾你右手栽种的根， 和你为自己培育的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 保护你右手所栽的 和你为自己所坚固的枝子。
verses.textEnNiv: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.
verses.textEnEsv: the stock that your right hand planted, and for the son whom you made strong for yourself.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the vineyard which Your right hand has planted, And the branch that You made strong for Yourself.
verses.textEnNlt: that you yourself have planted, this son you have raised for yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: The shoot which Your right hand has planted, And of the son whom You have strengthened for Yourself.
verses.textEn: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.

verses.textZh: 这树已被火烧，被砍下； 他们因你脸上的怒容灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这树已被火烧，被砍下； 他们因你脸上的怒容灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 这树已经被火焚烧，被刀砍伐； 他们因你脸上的怒容就灭亡了。
verses.textEnNiv: Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish.
verses.textEnEsv: They have burned it with fire; they have cut it down; may they perish at the rebuke of your face!
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis burned with fire, itis cut down; They perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
verses.textEnNlt: For we are chopped up and burned by our enemies. May they perish at the sight of your frown.
verses.textEnNasb: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; They perish from the rebuke of Your face.
verses.textEn: Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish.

verses.textZh: 愿你的手护庇你右边的人， 就是你为自己培育的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你的手护庇你右边的人， 就是你为自己培育的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你的手扶持你右边的人， 就是你为自己所坚固的人子。
verses.textEnNiv: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.
verses.textEnEsv: But let your hand be on the man of your right hand, the son of man whom you have made strong for yourself!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, Upon the son of man whom You made strong for Yourself.
verses.textEnNlt: Strengthen the man you love, the son of your choice.
verses.textEnNasb: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, Upon the son of man whom You made strong for Yourself.
verses.textEn: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.

verses.textZh: 这样，我们就不退后离开你； 求你救活我们，我们就要求告你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我们就不退后离开你； 求你救活我们，我们就要求告你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我们便不退后离开你； 求你救活我们，我们就要求告你的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name.
verses.textEnEsv: Then we shall not turn back from you; give us life, and we will call upon your name!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then we will not turn back from You; Revive us, and we will call upon Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: Then we will never abandon you again. Revive us so we can call on your name once more.
verses.textEnNasb: Then we will not turn back from You; Revive us, and we will call upon Your name.
verses.textEn: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name.

verses.textZh: 耶和华万军的神啊！求你使我们复兴； 愿你的脸光照我们，我们就可以得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华万军的神啊！求你使我们复兴； 愿你的脸光照我们，我们就可以得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－万军之神啊，求你使我们回转， 使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！
verses.textEnNiv: Restore us, Lord God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: Restore us, O Lord God of hosts! Let your face shine, that we may be saved!
verses.textEnNkjv: Restore us, O Lord God of hosts; Cause Your face to shine, And we shall be saved!
verses.textEnNlt: Turn us again to yourself, O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies. Make your face shine down upon us. Only then will we be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord God of armies, restore us; Make Your face shine upon us, and we will be saved.
verses.textEn: Restore us, Lord God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.

verses.textZh: 亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，用"迦特"的乐器。 要向神我们的力量欢呼， 要向雅各的神大声呼叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的诗，交给诗班长，用"迦特"的乐器。 要向神我们的力量欢呼， 要向雅各的神大声呼叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当向神－我们的力量大声欢呼， 向雅各的神发声欢乐！
verses.textEnNiv: Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob!
verses.textEnEsv: Sing aloud to God our strength; shout for joy to the God of Jacob!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing aloud to God our strength; Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing praises to God, our strength. Sing to the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing for joy to God our strength; Shout joyfully to the God of Jacob.
verses.textEn: Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob!

verses.textZh: 要唱诗歌，打手鼓， 弹奏美好的琴瑟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要唱诗歌，打手鼓， 弹奏美好的琴瑟。
verses.textZhCuv: 唱起诗歌，打手鼓， 弹美琴与瑟。
verses.textEnNiv: Begin the music, strike the timbrel, play the melodious harp and lyre.
verses.textEnEsv: Raise a song; sound the tambourine, the sweet lyre with the harp.
verses.textEnNkjv: Raise a song and strike the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the lute.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing! Beat the tambourine. Play the sweet lyre and the harp.
verses.textEnNasb: Raise a song, strike the tambourine, The sweet sounding lyre with the harp.
verses.textEn: Begin the music, strike the timbrel, play the melodious harp and lyre.

verses.textZh: 要在月朔，在月望， 在我们守节的日子吹角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要在月朔，在月望， 在我们守节的日子吹角。
verses.textZhCuv: 当在月朔并月望－ 我们过节的日期吹角，
verses.textEnNiv: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our festival;
verses.textEnEsv: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blow the trumpet at the time of the New Moon, At the full moon, on our solemn feast day.
verses.textEnNlt: Blow the ram’s horn at new moon, and again at full moon to call a festival!
verses.textEnNasb: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast day.
verses.textEn: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our festival;

verses.textZh: 因为这是给以色列的律例， 是雅各的神的典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这是给以色列的律例， 是雅各的神的典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 因这是为以色列定的律例， 是雅各神的典章。
verses.textEnNiv: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is a statute for Israel, a rule of the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is a statute for Israel, A law of the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: For this is required by the decrees of Israel; it is a regulation of the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is a statute for Israel, An ordinance of the God of Jacob.
verses.textEn: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 约瑟从埃及地出来 的时候，神为约瑟立了这法规。 我听见了我不晓得的言语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟从埃及地出来 的时候，神为约瑟立了这法规。 我听见了我不晓得的言语。
verses.textZhCuv: 他去攻击埃及地的时候， 在约瑟中间立此为证。 我在那里听见我所不明白的言语：
verses.textEnNiv: When God went out against Egypt, he established it as a statute for Joseph. I heard an unknown voice say:
verses.textEnEsv: He made it a decree in Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt. I hear a language I had not known:
verses.textEnNkjv: This He established in Joseph as a testimony, When He went throughout the land of Egypt, Where I heard a language I did not understand.
verses.textEnNlt: He made it a law for Israel when he attacked Egypt to set us free. I heard an unknown voice say,
verses.textEnNasb: He established it as a testimony in Joseph When he went throughout the land of Egypt. I heard a language I did not know:
verses.textEn: When God went out against Egypt, he established it as a statute for Joseph. I heard an unknown voice say:

verses.textZh: 神说："我要除去你 肩头的重担， 使你 的手放下筐子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："我要除去你 肩头的重担， 使你 的手放下筐子。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：我使你的肩得脱重担， 你的手放下筐子。
verses.textEnNiv: "I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket.
verses.textEnEsv: "I relieved your shoulder of the burden; your hands were freed from the basket.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I removed his shoulder from the burden; His hands were freed from the baskets.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now I will take the load from your shoulders; I will free your hands from their heavy tasks.
verses.textEnNasb: "I relieved his shoulder of the burden, His hands were freed from the basket.
verses.textEn: "I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket.

verses.textZh: 你在患难中呼求， 我就搭救你； 我在打雷的密云中回答你， 在米利巴的水边试验你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在患难中呼求， 我就搭救你； 我在打雷的密云中回答你， 在米利巴的水边试验你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你在急难中呼求，我就搭救你； 我在雷的隐密处应允你， 在米利巴水那里试验你。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: In your distress you called and I rescued you, I answered you out of a thundercloud; I tested you at the waters of Meribah.
verses.textEnEsv: In distress you called, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: You called in trouble, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: You cried to me in trouble, and I saved you; I answered out of the thundercloud and tested your faith when there was no water at Meribah. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: "You called in trouble and I rescued you; I answered you in the hiding place of thunder; I put you to the test at the waters of Meribah. Selah
verses.textEn: In your distress you called and I rescued you, I answered you out of a thundercloud; I tested you at the waters of Meribah.

verses.textZh: "我的子民哪！你要听，我要劝戒你； 以色列啊！但愿你肯听从我。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的子民哪！你要听，我要劝戒你； 以色列啊！但愿你肯听从我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的民哪，你当听，我要劝戒你； 以色列啊，甚愿你肯听从我。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear me, my people, and I will warn you— if you would only listen to me, Israel!
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, O my people, while I admonish you! O Israel, if you would but listen to me!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear, O My people, and I will admonish you! O Israel, if you will listen to Me!
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to me, O my people, while I give you stern warnings. O Israel, if you would only listen to me!
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear, My people, and I will admonish you; Israel, if you would listen to Me!
verses.textEn: Hear me, my people, and I will warn you— if you would only listen to me, Israel!

verses.textZh: 在你中间不可有别的神， 外族人的神你也不可敬拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你中间不可有别的神， 外族人的神你也不可敬拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你当中，不可有别的神； 外邦的神，你也不可下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: You shall have no foreign god among you; you shall not worship any god other than me.
verses.textEnEsv: There shall be no strange god among you; you shall not bow down to a foreign god.
verses.textEnNkjv: There shall be no foreign god among you; Nor shall you worship any foreign god.
verses.textEnNlt: You must never have a foreign god; you must not bow down before a false god.
verses.textEnNasb: "There shall be no strange god among you; Nor shall you worship a foreign god.
verses.textEn: You shall have no foreign god among you; you shall not worship any god other than me.

verses.textZh: 我是耶和华你的神， 曾把你从埃及地领出来。 你要大大张口，我就要给它充满。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是耶和华你的神， 曾把你从埃及地领出来。 你要大大张口，我就要给它充满。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华－你的神， 曾把你从埃及地领上来； 你要大大张口，我就给你充满。
verses.textEnNiv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the Lord your God, Who brought you out of the land of Egypt; Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.textEnNlt: For it was I, the Lord your God, who rescued you from the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it with good things.
verses.textEnNasb: "I, the Lord, am your God, Who brought you up from the land of Egypt; Open your mouth wide and I will fill it.
verses.textEn: I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.

verses.textZh: 我的子民却不听我的话， 以色列不肯服从我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民却不听我的话， 以色列不肯服从我。
verses.textZhCuv: 无奈，我的民不听我的声音； 以色列全不理我。
verses.textEnNiv: "But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me.
verses.textEnEsv: "But my people did not listen to my voice; Israel would not submit to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But My people would not heed My voice, And Israel would have none of Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "But no, my people wouldn’t listen. Israel did not want me around.
verses.textEnNasb: "But My people did not listen to My voice, And Israel did not obey Me.
verses.textEn: "But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me.

verses.textZh: 因此，我就任凭他们心里刚硬， 随着自己的计谋行事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我就任凭他们心里刚硬， 随着自己的计谋行事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我便任凭他们心里刚硬， 随自己的计谋而行。
verses.textEnNiv: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
verses.textEnEsv: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts, to follow their own counsels.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I gave them over to their own stubborn heart, To walk in their own counsels.
verses.textEnNlt: So I let them follow their own stubborn desires, living according to their own ideas.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I gave them over to the stubbornness of their heart, To walk by their own plans.
verses.textEn: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.

verses.textZh: 只要我的子民听从我， 以色列肯遵行我的道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 只要我的子民听从我， 以色列肯遵行我的道，
verses.textZhCuv: 甚愿我的民肯听从我， 以色列肯行我的道，
verses.textEnNiv: "If my people would only listen to me, if Israel would only follow my ways,
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
verses.textEnNkjv: "Oh, that My people would listen to Me, That Israel would walk in My ways!
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that my people would listen to me! Oh, that Israel would follow me, walking in my paths!
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh that My people would listen to Me, That Israel would walk in My ways!
verses.textEn: "If my people would only listen to me, if Israel would only follow my ways,

verses.textZh: 我就迅速制伏他们的仇敌， 把手转回来攻击他们的敌人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就迅速制伏他们的仇敌， 把手转回来攻击他们的敌人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我便速速治服他们的仇敌， 反手攻击他们的敌人。
verses.textEnNiv: how quickly I would subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes!
verses.textEnEsv: I would soon subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes.
verses.textEnNkjv: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn My hand against their adversaries.
verses.textEnNlt: How quickly I would then subdue their enemies! How soon my hands would be upon their foes!
verses.textEnNasb: "I would quickly subdue their enemies And turn My hand against their adversaries.
verses.textEn: how quickly I would subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes!

verses.textZh: 憎恨耶和华的人必向他假意归顺， 他们的刑期必永无止境。
verses.textZhCnvs: 憎恨耶和华的人必向他假意归顺， 他们的刑期必永无止境。
verses.textZhCuv: 恨耶和华的人必来投降， 但他的百姓必永久长存。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who hate the Lord would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who hate the Lord would cringe toward him, and their fate would last forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: The haters of the Lord would pretend submission to Him, But their fate would endure forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who hate the Lord would cringe before him; they would be doomed forever.
verses.textEnNasb: "Those who hate the Lord would pretend to obey Him, And their time of punishment would be forever.
verses.textEn: Those who hate the Lord would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

verses.textZh: 但我 必把上好的麦子给你们 吃， 又用盘石里的蜂蜜使你们饱足。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我 必把上好的麦子给你们 吃， 又用盘石里的蜂蜜使你们饱足。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他也必拿上好的麦子给他们吃， 又拿从磐石出的蜂蜜叫他们饱足。
verses.textEnNiv: But you would be fed with the finest of wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you."
verses.textEnEsv: But he would feed you with the finest of the wheat, and with honey from the rock I would satisfy you."
verses.textEnNkjv: He would have fed them also with the finest of wheat; And with honey from the rock I would have satisfied you."
verses.textEnNlt: But I would feed you with the finest wheat. I would satisfy you with wild honey from the rock."
verses.textEnNasb: " But I would feed you with the finest of the wheat, And with honey from the rock I would satisfy you."
verses.textEn: But you would be fed with the finest of wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you."

verses.textZh: 亚萨的诗。神站在大能者的会中， 在众神之中施行审判，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚萨的诗。神站在大能者的会中， 在众神之中施行审判，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 神站在有权力者的会中， 在诸神中行审判，
verses.textEnNiv: God presides in the great assembly; he renders judgment among the "gods":
verses.textEnEsv: God has taken his place in the divine council; in the midst of the gods he holds judgment:
verses.textEnNkjv: God stands in the congregation of the mighty; He judges among the gods.
verses.textEnNlt: God presides over heaven’s court; he pronounces judgment on the heavenly beings:
verses.textEnNasb: God takes His position in His assembly; He judges in the midst of the gods.
verses.textEn: God presides in the great assembly; he renders judgment among the "gods":

verses.textZh: "你们不按公义审判， 偏袒恶人，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们不按公义审判， 偏袒恶人，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 说：你们审判不秉公义， 徇恶人的情面，要到几时呢？ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: "How long will you defend the unjust and show partiality to the wicked?
verses.textEnEsv: "How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: How long will you judge unjustly, And show partiality to the wicked? Selah
verses.textEnNlt: "How long will you hand down unjust decisions by favoring the wicked? Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: How long will you judge unjustly And show partiality to the wicked? Selah
verses.textEn: "How long will you defend the unjust and show partiality to the wicked?

verses.textZh: 你们要为贫寒的人和孤儿伸冤， 为困苦和穷乏的人伸张正义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要为贫寒的人和孤儿伸冤， 为困苦和穷乏的人伸张正义。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当为贫寒的人和孤儿伸冤； 当为困苦和穷乏的人施行公义。
verses.textEnNiv: Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.
verses.textEnEsv: Give justice to the weak and the fatherless; maintain the right of the afflicted and the destitute.
verses.textEnNkjv: Defend the poor and fatherless; Do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.textEnNlt: "Give justice to the poor and the orphan; uphold the rights of the oppressed and the destitute.
verses.textEnNasb: Vindicate the weak and fatherless; Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
verses.textEn: Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.

verses.textZh: 要搭救贫寒和穷困的人， 救他们脱离恶人的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 要搭救贫寒和穷困的人， 救他们脱离恶人的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当保护贫寒和穷乏的人， 救他们脱离恶人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked."
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver the poor and needy; Free them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: Rescue the poor and helpless; deliver them from the grasp of evil people.
verses.textEnNasb: Rescue the weak and needy; Save them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.textEn: Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 他们没有知识，也不明白， 在黑暗中走来走去； 大地的一切根基都摇动了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们没有知识，也不明白， 在黑暗中走来走去； 大地的一切根基都摇动了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们仍不知道，也不明白， 在黑暗中走来走去； 地的根基都摇动了。
verses.textEnNiv: "The ‘gods’ know nothing, they understand nothing. They walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.textEnEsv: They have neither knowledge nor understanding, they walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.textEnNkjv: They do not know, nor do they understand; They walk about in darkness; All the foundations of the earth are unstable.
