verses.textEnNlt: But these oppressors know nothing; they are so ignorant! They wander about in darkness, while the whole world is shaken to the core.
verses.textEnNasb: They do not know nor do they understand; They walk around in darkness; All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.textEn: "The ‘gods’ know nothing, they understand nothing. They walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

verses.textZh: 我曾说过："你们都是神， 是至高者的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾说过："你们都是神， 是至高者的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾说：你们是神， 都是至高者的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: "I said, ‘You are "gods"; you are all sons of the Most High.’
verses.textEnEsv: I said, "You are gods, sons of the Most High, all of you;
verses.textEnNkjv: I said, "You are gods, And all of you are children of the Most High.
verses.textEnNlt: I say, ‘You are gods; you are all children of the Most High.
verses.textEnNasb: I said, "You are gods, And all of you are sons of the Most High.
verses.textEn: "I said, ‘You are "gods"; you are all sons of the Most High.’

verses.textZh: 然而，你们要像世人一样死亡， 像世上任何一位领袖一样倒毙。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，你们要像世人一样死亡， 像世上任何一位领袖一样倒毙。"
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，你们要死，与世人一样， 要仆倒，像王子中的一位。
verses.textEnNiv: But you will die like mere mortals; you will fall like every other ruler."
verses.textEnEsv: nevertheless, like men you shall die, and fall like any prince."
verses.textEnNkjv: But you shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes."
verses.textEnNlt: But you will die like mere mortals and fall like every other ruler.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Nevertheless you will die like men, And fall like one of the princes."
verses.textEn: But you will die like mere mortals; you will fall like every other ruler."

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你起来，审判大地， 因为万国都是你的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你起来，审判大地， 因为万国都是你的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你起来审判世界， 因为你要得万邦为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for you shall inherit all the nations!
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For You shall inherit all nations.
verses.textEnNlt: Rise up, O God, and judge the earth, for all the nations belong to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, God, judge the earth! For You possess all the nations.
verses.textEn: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.

verses.textZh: 歌一首，亚萨的诗。神啊！求你不要静默；神啊！求你不要闭口，也不要一言不发。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌一首，亚萨的诗。神啊！求你不要静默；神啊！求你不要闭口，也不要一言不发。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，求你不要静默！神啊，求你不要闭口，也不要不作声！
verses.textEnNiv: O God, do not remain silent; do not turn a deaf ear, do not stand aloof, O God.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, do not keep silence; do not hold your peace or be still, O God!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not keep silent, O God! Do not hold Your peace, And do not be still, O God!
verses.textEnNlt: O God, do not be silent! Do not be deaf. Do not be quiet, O God.
verses.textEnNasb: God, do not remain quiet; Do not be silent and, God, do not be still.
verses.textEn: O God, do not remain silent; do not turn a deaf ear, do not stand aloof, O God.

verses.textZh: 看哪！你的仇敌喧哗， 恨你的人都抬起头来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！你的仇敌喧哗， 恨你的人都抬起头来。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你的仇敌喧嚷， 恨你的抬起头来。
verses.textEnNiv: See how your enemies growl, how your foes rear their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, your enemies make an uproar; those who hate you have raised their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, Your enemies make a tumult; And those who hate You have lifted up their head.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you hear the uproar of your enemies? Don’t you see that your arrogant enemies are rising up?
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, Your enemies make an uproar, And those who hate You have exalted themselves.
verses.textEn: See how your enemies growl, how your foes rear their heads.

verses.textZh: 他们密谋奸诈，陷害你的子民； 他们彼此商议，攻击你所宝贵的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们密谋奸诈，陷害你的子民； 他们彼此商议，攻击你所宝贵的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们同谋奸诈要害你的百姓， 彼此商议要害你所隐藏的人。
verses.textEnNiv: With cunning they conspire against your people; they plot against those you cherish.
verses.textEnEsv: They lay crafty plans against your people; they consult together against your treasured ones.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have taken crafty counsel against Your people, And consulted together against Your sheltered ones.
verses.textEnNlt: They devise crafty schemes against your people; they conspire against your precious ones.
verses.textEnNasb: They make shrewd plans against Your people, And conspire together against Your treasured ones.
verses.textEn: With cunning they conspire against your people; they plot against those you cherish.

verses.textZh: 他们说："来吧！我们来把他们除灭，使他们不再成国， 使以色列的名不再被人记念。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："来吧！我们来把他们除灭，使他们不再成国， 使以色列的名不再被人记念。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：来吧，我们将他们剪灭， 使他们不再成国！ 使以色列的名不再被人记念！
verses.textEnNiv: "Come," they say, "let us destroy them as a nation, so that Israel’s name is remembered no more."
verses.textEnEsv: They say, "Come, let us wipe them out as a nation; let the name of Israel be remembered no more!"
verses.textEnNkjv: They have said, "Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation, That the name of Israel may be remembered no more."
verses.textEnNlt: "Come," they say, "let us wipe out Israel as a nation. We will destroy the very memory of its existence."
verses.textEnNasb: They have said, "Come, and let’s wipe them out as a nation, So that the name of Israel will no longer be remembered."
verses.textEn: "Come," they say, "let us destroy them as a nation, so that Israel’s name is remembered no more."

verses.textZh: 他们同心商议， 彼此结盟，要和你对抗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们同心商议， 彼此结盟，要和你对抗。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们同心商议， 彼此结盟，要抵挡你，
verses.textEnNiv: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against you—
verses.textEnEsv: For they conspire with one accord; against you they make a covenant—
verses.textEnNkjv: For they have consulted together with one consent; They form a confederacy against You:
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, this was their unanimous decision. They signed a treaty as allies against you—
verses.textEnNasb: For they have conspired together with one mind; They make a covenant against You:
verses.textEn: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against you—

verses.textZh: 他们就是住帐棚的以东人和以实玛利人， 摩押人和夏甲人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就是住帐棚的以东人和以实玛利人， 摩押人和夏甲人，
verses.textZhCuv: 就是住帐棚的以东人和以实玛利人， 摩押和夏甲人，
verses.textEnNiv: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
verses.textEnEsv: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
verses.textEnNkjv: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
verses.textEnNlt: these Edomites and Ishmaelites; Moabites and Hagrites;
verses.textEnNasb: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites;
verses.textEn: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

verses.textZh: 迦巴勒、亚扪、亚玛力、 非利士和推罗的居民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦巴勒、亚扪、亚玛力、 非利士和推罗的居民。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦巴勒、亚扪， 和亚玛力、非利士并泰尔的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: Byblos, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.
verses.textEnEsv: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.textEnNkjv: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.textEnNlt: Gebalites, Ammonites, and Amalekites; and people from Philistia and Tyre.
verses.textEnNasb: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.textEn: Byblos, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.

verses.textZh: 亚述也和他们联合起来， 作了罗得子孙的帮手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚述也和他们联合起来， 作了罗得子孙的帮手。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述也与他们连合； 他们作罗得子孙的帮手。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Even Assyria has joined them to reinforce Lot’s descendants.
verses.textEnEsv: Asshur also has joined them; they are the strong arm of the children of Lot. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Assyria also has joined with them; They have helped the children of Lot. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Assyria has joined them, too, and is allied with the descendants of Lot. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Assyria also has joined them; They have become a help to the children of Lot. Selah
verses.textEn: Even Assyria has joined them to reinforce Lot’s descendants.

verses.textZh: 求你待他们好象待米甸人， 像在基顺河待西西拉和耶宾一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你待他们好象待米甸人， 像在基顺河待西西拉和耶宾一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 求你待他们，如待米甸， 如在基顺河待西西拉和耶宾一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Do to them as you did to Midian, as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,
verses.textEnEsv: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,
verses.textEnNkjv: Deal with them as with Midian, As with Sisera, As with Jabin at the Brook Kishon,
verses.textEnNlt: Do to them as you did to the Midianites and as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the Kishon River.
verses.textEnNasb: Deal with them as with Midian, As with Sisera and Jabin at the river of Kishon,
verses.textEn: Do to them as you did to Midian, as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,

verses.textZh: 他们都在隐．多珥被消灭， 成了地上的粪土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们都在隐．多珥被消灭， 成了地上的粪土。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在隐‧多珥灭亡， 成了地上的粪土。
verses.textEnNiv: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: who were destroyed at En-dor, who became dung for the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who perished at En Dor, Who became as refuse on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: They were destroyed at Endor, and their decaying corpses fertilized the soil.
verses.textEnNasb: Who were destroyed at En-dor, Who became like dung for the ground.
verses.textEn: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.

verses.textZh: 求你使他们的贵族像俄立和西伊伯， 使他们的王子像西巴和撒慕拿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使他们的贵族像俄立和西伊伯， 使他们的王子像西巴和撒慕拿。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你叫他们的首领像俄立和西伊伯， 叫他们的王子都像西巴和撒慕拿。
verses.textEnNiv: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
verses.textEnEsv: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
verses.textEnNkjv: Make their nobles like Oreb and like Zeeb, Yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
verses.textEnNlt: Let their mighty nobles die as Oreb and Zeeb did. Let all their princes die like Zebah and Zalmunna,
verses.textEnNasb: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, And all their leaders like Zebah and Zalmunna,
verses.textEn: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

verses.textZh: 他们曾说： "我们要得着神的牧场作自己的产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们曾说： "我们要得着神的牧场作自己的产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：我们要得神的住处， 作为自己的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: who said, "Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God."
verses.textEnEsv: who said, "Let us take possession for ourselves of the pastures of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Who said, "Let us take for ourselves The pastures of God for a possession."
verses.textEnNlt: for they said, "Let us seize for our own use these pasturelands of God!"
verses.textEnNasb: Who said, "Let’s possess for ourselves The pastures of God."
verses.textEn: who said, "Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God."

verses.textZh: 我的神啊！求你使他们像旋风卷起的草， 像风前的碎秸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神啊！求你使他们像旋风卷起的草， 像风前的碎秸。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，求你叫他们像旋风的尘土， 像风前的碎秸。
verses.textEnNiv: Make them like tumbleweed, my God, like chaff before the wind.
verses.textEnEsv: O my God, make them like whirling dust, like chaff before the wind.
verses.textEnNkjv: O my God, make them like the whirling dust, Like the chaff before the wind!
verses.textEnNlt: O my God, scatter them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind!
verses.textEnNasb: My God, make them like the whirling dust, Like chaff before the wind.
verses.textEn: Make them like tumbleweed, my God, like chaff before the wind.

verses.textZh: 火怎样焚烧树林， 火焰怎样燃烧群山，
verses.textZhCnvs: 火怎样焚烧树林， 火焰怎样燃烧群山，
verses.textZhCuv: 火怎样焚烧树林， 火焰怎样烧着山岭，
verses.textEnNiv: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
verses.textEnEsv: As fire consumes the forest, as the flame sets the mountains ablaze,
verses.textEnNkjv: As the fire burns the woods, And as the flame sets the mountains on fire,
verses.textEnNlt: As a fire burns a forest and as a flame sets mountains ablaze,
verses.textEnNasb: Like fire that burns the forest, And like a flame that sets the mountains on fire,
verses.textEn: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

verses.textZh: 求你也照样用狂风追赶他们， 藉暴风雨惊吓他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你也照样用狂风追赶他们， 藉暴风雨惊吓他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你也照样用狂风追赶他们， 用暴雨恐吓他们。
verses.textEnNiv: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.
verses.textEnEsv: so may you pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your hurricane!
verses.textEnNkjv: So pursue them with Your tempest, And frighten them with Your storm.
verses.textEnNlt: chase them with your fierce storm; terrify them with your tempest.
verses.textEnNasb: So pursue them with Your heavy gale, And terrify them with Your storm.
verses.textEn: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你使他们满面羞愧， 好使他们寻求你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你使他们满面羞愧， 好使他们寻求你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你使他们满面羞耻， 好叫他们寻求你－耶和华的名！
verses.textEnNiv: Cover their faces with shame, Lord , so that they will seek your name.
verses.textEnEsv: Fill their faces with shame, that they may seek your name, O Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Fill their faces with shame, That they may seek Your name, O Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Utterly disgrace them until they submit to your name, O Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Fill their faces with dishonor, So that they will seek Your name, Lord.
verses.textEn: Cover their faces with shame, Lord , so that they will seek your name.

verses.textZh: 愿他们永远受辱惊惶， 愿他们抱愧灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们永远受辱惊惶， 愿他们抱愧灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们永远羞愧惊惶！ 愿他们惭愧灭亡！
verses.textEnNiv: May they ever be ashamed and dismayed; may they perish in disgrace.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be put to shame and dismayed forever; let them perish in disgrace,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be confounded and dismayed forever; Yes, let them be put to shame and perish,
verses.textEnNlt: Let them be ashamed and terrified forever. Let them die in disgrace.
verses.textEnNasb: May they be ashamed and dismayed forever, And may they be humiliated and perish,
verses.textEn: May they ever be ashamed and dismayed; may they perish in disgrace.

verses.textZh: 使他们知道只有你的名是耶和华， 唯有你是掌管全地的至高者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他们知道只有你的名是耶和华， 唯有你是掌管全地的至高者。
verses.textZhCuv: 使他们知道：惟独你－ 名为耶和华的－是全地以上的至高者！
verses.textEnNiv: Let them know that you, whose name is the Lord — that you alone are the Most High over all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the Lord , are the Most High over all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: That they may know that You, whose name alone is the Lord, Are the Most High over all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will learn that you alone are called the Lord , that you alone are the Most High, supreme over all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: So that they will know that You alone, whose name is the Lord, Are the Most High over all the earth.
verses.textEn: Let them know that you, whose name is the Lord — that you alone are the Most High over all the earth.

verses.textZh: 可拉子孙的诗，交给诗班长，用"迦特"的乐器。 万军之耶和华啊！ 你的居所多么可爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉子孙的诗，交给诗班长，用"迦特"的乐器。 万军之耶和华啊！ 你的居所多么可爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华啊， 你的居所何等可爱！
verses.textEnNiv: How lovely is your dwelling place, Lord Almighty!
verses.textEnEsv: How lovely is your dwelling place, O Lord of hosts!
verses.textEnNkjv: How lovely is Your tabernacle, O Lord of hosts!
verses.textEnNlt: How lovely is your dwelling place, O Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: How lovely are Your dwelling places, Lord of armies!
verses.textEn: How lovely is your dwelling place, Lord Almighty!

verses.textZh: 我的灵渴想切慕耶和华的院子， 我的心身向永活的神欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的灵渴想切慕耶和华的院子， 我的心身向永活的神欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 我羡慕渴想耶和华的院宇； 我的心肠，我的肉体向永生神呼吁 。
verses.textEnNiv: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the Lord ; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul longs, yes, faints for the courts of the Lord ; my heart and flesh sing for joy to the living God.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul longs, yes, even faints For the courts of the Lord; My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
verses.textEnNlt: I long, yes, I faint with longing to enter the courts of the Lord . With my whole being, body and soul, I will shout joyfully to the living God.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul longed and even yearned for the courtyards of the Lord; My heart and my flesh sing for joy to the living God.
verses.textEn: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the Lord ; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华，我的王我的神啊！ 在你的祭坛那里， 麻雀找到了住处， 燕子也为自己找到了安置幼雏的巢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华，我的王我的神啊！ 在你的祭坛那里， 麻雀找到了住处， 燕子也为自己找到了安置幼雏的巢。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－我的王，我的神啊， 在你祭坛那里，麻雀为自己找着房屋， 燕子为自己找着抱雏之窝。
verses.textEnNiv: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young— a place near your altar, Lord Almighty, my King and my God.
verses.textEnEsv: Even the sparrow finds a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, at your altars, O Lord of hosts, my King and my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even the sparrow has found a home, And the swallow a nest for herself, Where she may lay her young— Even Your altars, O Lord of hosts, My King and my God.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the sparrow finds a home, and the swallow builds her nest and raises her young at a place near your altar, O Lord of Heaven’s Armies, my King and my God!
verses.textEnNasb: The bird also has found a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may put her young: Your altars, Lord of armies, My King and my God.
verses.textEn: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young— a place near your altar, Lord Almighty, my King and my God.

verses.textZh: 住在你殿中的，都是有福的， 他们还要不断赞美你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在你殿中的，都是有福的， 他们还要不断赞美你。
verses.textZhCuv: 如此住在你殿中的便为有福！ 他们仍要赞美你。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those who dwell in your house; they are ever praising you.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed are those who dwell in your house, ever singing your praise! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are those who dwell in Your house; They will still be praising You. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: What joy for those who can live in your house, always singing your praises. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
verses.textEn: Blessed are those who dwell in your house; they are ever praising you.

verses.textZh: 靠你有力量，心中向往通到圣殿大道的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 靠你有力量，心中向往通到圣殿大道的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 靠你有力量、心中想往锡安大道的， 这人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, in whose heart are the highways to Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is the man whose strength is in You, Whose heart is set on pilgrimage.
verses.textEnNlt: What joy for those whose strength comes from the Lord , who have set their minds on a pilgrimage to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the person whose strength is in You, In whose heart are the roads to Zion!
verses.textEn: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

verses.textZh: 他们经过干旱的山谷， 使这谷变为泉源之地， 更有秋雨使这谷到处都是水池。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们经过干旱的山谷， 使这谷变为泉源之地， 更有秋雨使这谷到处都是水池。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们经过「流泪谷」，叫这谷变为泉源之地； 并有秋雨之福盖满了全谷。
verses.textEnNiv: As they pass through the Valley of Baka, they make it a place of springs; the autumn rains also cover it with pools.
verses.textEnEsv: As they go through the Valley of Baca they make it a place of springs; the early rain also covers it with pools.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asthey pass through the Valley of Baca, They make it a spring; The rain also covers it with pools.
verses.textEnNlt: When they walk through the Valley of Weeping, it will become a place of refreshing springs. The autumn rains will clothe it with blessings.
verses.textEnNasb: Passing through the Valley of Baca they make it a spring; The early rain also covers it with blessings.
verses.textEn: As they pass through the Valley of Baka, they make it a place of springs; the autumn rains also cover it with pools.

verses.textZh: 他们行走，力上加力， 直到各人在锡安朝见神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们行走，力上加力， 直到各人在锡安朝见神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们行走，力上加力， 各人到锡安朝见神。
verses.textEnNiv: They go from strength to strength, till each appears before God in Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: They go from strength to strength; each one appears before God in Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: They go from strength to strength; Eachone appears before God in Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: They will continue to grow stronger, and each of them will appear before God in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: They go from strength to strength, Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
verses.textEn: They go from strength to strength, till each appears before God in Zion.

verses.textZh: 耶和华万军的神啊！ 求你听我的祷告； 雅各的神啊！ 求你留心听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华万军的神啊！ 求你听我的祷告； 雅各的神啊！ 求你留心听。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－万军之神啊，求你听我的祷告！ 雅各的神啊，求你留心听！ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Hear my prayer, Lord God Almighty; listen to me, God of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob! Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob! Selah
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, O God of Jacob. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Lord God of armies, hear my prayer; Listen, God of Jacob! Selah
verses.textEn: Hear my prayer, Lord God Almighty; listen to me, God of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 神啊！求你垂顾我们的盾牌， 求你看顾你的受膏者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！求你垂顾我们的盾牌， 求你看顾你的受膏者。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你是我们的盾牌； 求你垂顾观看你受膏者的面！
verses.textEnNiv: Look on our shield, O God; look with favor on your anointed one.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold our shield, O God; look on the face of your anointed!
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, behold our shield, And look upon the face of Your anointed.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, look with favor upon the king, our shield! Show favor to the one you have anointed.
verses.textEnNasb: See our shield, God, And look at the face of Your anointed.
verses.textEn: Look on our shield, O God; look with favor on your anointed one.

verses.textZh: 在你院子里住一日， 胜过在别处住千日； 宁愿站在我神殿中的门槛上， 也不愿住在恶人的帐棚里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你院子里住一日， 胜过在别处住千日； 宁愿站在我神殿中的门槛上， 也不愿住在恶人的帐棚里。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你的院宇住一日， 胜似在别处住千日； 宁可在我神殿中看门， 不愿住在恶人的帐棚里。
verses.textEnNiv: Better is one day in your courts than a thousand elsewhere; I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a day in Your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God Than dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: A single day in your courts is better than a thousand anywhere else! I would rather be a gatekeeper in the house of my God than live the good life in the homes of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: For a day in Your courtyards is better than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God Than live in the tents of wickedness.
verses.textEn: Better is one day in your courts than a thousand elsewhere; I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华神是太阳，是盾牌， 耶和华赐下恩惠和光荣； 他没有留下一样好处， 不给那些行为正直的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华神是太阳，是盾牌， 耶和华赐下恩惠和光荣； 他没有留下一样好处， 不给那些行为正直的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－神是日头，是盾牌， 要赐下恩惠和荣耀。 他未尝留下一样好处不给那些行动正直的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor. No good thing does he withhold from those who walk uprightly.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; The Lord will give grace and glory; No good thing will He withhold From those who walk uprightly.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord God is our sun and our shield. He gives us grace and glory. The Lord will withhold no good thing from those who do what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; The Lord gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
verses.textEn: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

verses.textZh: 万军之耶和华啊！ 倚靠你的人是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万军之耶和华啊！ 倚靠你的人是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华啊， 倚靠你的人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord Almighty, blessed is the one who trusts in you.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the one who trusts in you!
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord of hosts, Blessed is the man who trusts in You!
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord of Heaven’s Armies, what joy for those who trust in you.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord of armies, Blessed is the person who trusts in You!
verses.textEn: Lord Almighty, blessed is the one who trusts in you.

verses.textZh: 可拉子孙的诗，交给诗班长。 耶和华啊！你恩待了你的地， 恢复了雅各的产业 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉子孙的诗，交给诗班长。 耶和华啊！你恩待了你的地， 恢复了雅各的产业 。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你已经向你的地施恩， 救回被掳的雅各。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord , showed favor to your land; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: Lord , you were favorable to your land; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, You have been favorable to Your land; You have brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you poured out blessings on your land! You restored the fortunes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, You showed favor to Your land; You restored the fortunes of Jacob.
verses.textEn: You, Lord , showed favor to your land; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 你赦免了你子民的罪孽， 遮盖了他们的一切罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你赦免了你子民的罪孽， 遮盖了他们的一切罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 你赦免了你百姓的罪孽， 遮盖了他们一切的过犯。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: You forgave the iniquity of your people and covered all their sins.
verses.textEnEsv: You forgave the iniquity of your people; you covered all their sin. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sin. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: You forgave the guilt of your people— yes, you covered all their sins. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: You forgave the guilt of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
verses.textEn: You forgave the iniquity of your people and covered all their sins.

verses.textZh: 你收回了你的一切忿怒， 使你猛烈的怒气转消。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你收回了你的一切忿怒， 使你猛烈的怒气转消。
verses.textZhCuv: 你收转了所发的忿怒 和你猛烈的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: You set aside all your wrath and turned from your fierce anger.
verses.textEnEsv: You withdrew all your wrath; you turned from your hot anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have taken away all Your wrath; You have turned from the fierceness of Your anger.
verses.textEnNlt: You held back your fury. You kept back your blazing anger.
verses.textEnNasb: You withdrew all Your fury; You turned away from Your burning anger.
verses.textEn: You set aside all your wrath and turned from your fierce anger.

verses.textZh: 拯救我们的神啊！求你复兴我们， 求你止住你向我们所发的忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拯救我们的神啊！求你复兴我们， 求你止住你向我们所发的忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 拯救我们的神啊，求你使我们回转， 叫你的恼恨向我们止息。
verses.textEnNiv: Restore us again, God our Savior, and put away your displeasure toward us.
verses.textEnEsv: Restore us again, O God of our salvation, and put away your indignation toward us!
verses.textEnNkjv: Restore us, O God of our salvation, And cause Your anger toward us to cease.
verses.textEnNlt: Now restore us again, O God of our salvation. Put aside your anger against us once more.
verses.textEnNasb: Restore us, God of our salvation, And cause Your indignation toward us to cease.
verses.textEn: Restore us again, God our Savior, and put away your displeasure toward us.

verses.textZh: 你要永远向我们发怒吗？ 你要延长你的怒气到万代吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要永远向我们发怒吗？ 你要延长你的怒气到万代吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你要向我们发怒到永远吗？ 你要将你的怒气延留到万代吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger through all generations?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger to all generations?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You prolong Your anger to all generations?
verses.textEnNlt: Will you be angry with us always? Will you prolong your wrath to all generations?
verses.textEnNasb: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You prolong Your anger to all generations?
verses.textEn: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger through all generations?

verses.textZh: 你不使我们再活过来， 以致你的子民可以因你欢喜吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不使我们再活过来， 以致你的子民可以因你欢喜吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你不再将我们救活， 使你的百姓靠你欢喜吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
verses.textEnEsv: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Will You not revive us again, That Your people may rejoice in You?
verses.textEnNlt: Won’t you revive us again, so your people can rejoice in you?
verses.textEnNasb: Will You not revive us again, So that Your people may rejoice in You?
verses.textEn: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你使我们得见你的慈爱， 又把你的救恩赐给我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你使我们得见你的慈爱， 又把你的救恩赐给我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你使我们得见你的慈爱， 又将你的救恩赐给我们。
verses.textEnNiv: Show us your unfailing love, Lord , and grant us your salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: Show us your steadfast love, O Lord , and grant us your salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Show us Your mercy, Lord, And grant us Your salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: Show us your unfailing love, O Lord , and grant us your salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: Show us Your mercy, Lord, And grant us Your salvation.
verses.textEn: Show us your unfailing love, Lord , and grant us your salvation.

verses.textZh: 我要听神耶和华所要说的话； 因为他应许赐平安给他的子民，给他的圣民； 但愿他们不要转向愚妄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要听神耶和华所要说的话； 因为他应许赐平安给他的子民，给他的圣民； 但愿他们不要转向愚妄。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要听神－耶和华所说的话； 因为他必应许将平安赐给他的百姓－他的圣民； 他们却不可再转去妄行。
verses.textEnNiv: I will listen to what God the Lord says; he promises peace to his people, his faithful servants— but let them not turn to folly.
verses.textEnEsv: Let me hear what God the Lord will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, to his saints; but let them not turn back to folly.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will hear what God the Lord will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly.
verses.textEnNlt: I listen carefully to what God the Lord is saying, for he speaks peace to his faithful people. But let them not return to their foolish ways.
verses.textEnNasb: I will hear what God the Lord will say; For He will speak peace to His people, to His godly ones; And may they not turn back to foolishness.
verses.textEn: I will listen to what God the Lord says; he promises peace to his people, his faithful servants— but let them not turn to folly.

verses.textZh: 他的救恩的确临近敬畏他的人， 使他的荣耀住在我们的地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的救恩的确临近敬畏他的人， 使他的荣耀住在我们的地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的救恩诚然与敬畏他的人相近， 叫荣耀住在我们的地上。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.
verses.textEnEsv: Surely his salvation is near to those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, That glory may dwell in our land.
verses.textEnNlt: Surely his salvation is near to those who fear him, so our land will be filled with his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: Certainly His salvation is near to those who fear Him, That glory may dwell in our land.
verses.textEn: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.

verses.textZh: 慈爱和信实彼此相遇， 公义和平安互相亲吻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 慈爱和信实彼此相遇， 公义和平安互相亲吻。
verses.textZhCuv: 慈爱和诚实彼此相遇； 公义和平安彼此相亲。
verses.textEnNiv: Love and faithfulness meet together; righteousness and peace kiss each other.
verses.textEnEsv: Steadfast love and faithfulness meet; righteousness and peace kiss each other.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mercy and truth have met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed.
verses.textEnNlt: Unfailing love and truth have met together. Righteousness and peace have kissed!
verses.textEnNasb: Graciousness and truth have met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.textEn: Love and faithfulness meet together; righteousness and peace kiss each other.

verses.textZh: 信实从地上生出， 公义从天上俯视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 信实从地上生出， 公义从天上俯视。
verses.textZhCuv: 诚实从地而生； 公义从天而现。
verses.textEnNiv: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: Faithfulness springs up from the ground, and righteousness looks down from the sky.
verses.textEnNkjv: Truth shall spring out of the earth, And righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Truth springs up from the earth, and righteousness smiles down from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Truth sprouts from the earth, And righteousness looks down from heaven.
verses.textEn: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

verses.textZh: 耶和华也必赐下好处， 我们的地要多出土产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华也必赐下好处， 我们的地要多出土产。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必将好处赐给我们； 我们的地也要多出土产。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.
verses.textEnEsv: Yes, the Lord will give what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, the Lord will give whatis good; And our land will yield its increase.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the Lord pours down his blessings. Our land will yield its bountiful harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, the Lord will give what is good, And our land will yield its produce.
verses.textEn: The Lord will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.

verses.textZh: 公义必行在他面前， 为他的脚步预备道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公义必行在他面前， 为他的脚步预备道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 公义要行在他面前， 叫他的脚踪成为可走的路。
verses.textEnNiv: Righteousness goes before him and prepares the way for his steps.
verses.textEnEsv: Righteousness will go before him and make his footsteps a way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Righteousness will go before Him, And shall make His footsteps our pathway.
verses.textEnNlt: Righteousness goes as a herald before him, preparing the way for his steps.
verses.textEnNasb: Righteousness will go before Him And will make His footsteps into a way.
verses.textEn: Righteousness goes before him and prepares the way for his steps.

verses.textZh: 大卫的祷告。 耶和华啊！求你留心听我、应允我， 因为我是困苦贫穷的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的祷告。 耶和华啊！求你留心听我、应允我， 因为我是困苦贫穷的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳应允我， 因我是困苦穷乏的。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear me, Lord , and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
verses.textEnEsv: Incline your ear, O Lord , and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bow down Your ear, O Lord, hear me; For I am poor and needy.
verses.textEnNlt: Bend down, O Lord , and hear my prayer; answer me, for I need your help.
verses.textEnNasb: Incline Your ear, Lord, and answer me; For I am afflicted and needy.
verses.textEn: Hear me, Lord , and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

verses.textZh: 求你保护我的性命，因为我是虔诚的人； 我的神啊！求你拯救这倚靠你的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你保护我的性命，因为我是虔诚的人； 我的神啊！求你拯救这倚靠你的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔诚人。 我的神啊，求你拯救这倚靠你的仆人！
verses.textEnNiv: Guard my life, for I am faithful to you; save your servant who trusts in you. You are my God;
verses.textEnEsv: Preserve my life, for I am godly; save your servant, who trusts in you—you are my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Preserve my life, for I am holy; You are my God; Save Your servant who trusts in You!
verses.textEnNlt: Protect me, for I am devoted to you. Save me, for I serve you and trust you. You are my God.
verses.textEnNasb: Protect my soul, for I am godly; You my God, save Your servant who trusts in You.
verses.textEn: Guard my life, for I am faithful to you; save your servant who trusts in you. You are my God;

verses.textZh: 主啊！求你恩待我， 因为我终日向你呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！求你恩待我， 因为我终日向你呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，求你怜悯我， 因我终日求告你。
verses.textEnNiv: have mercy on me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: Be gracious to me, O Lord, for to you do I cry all the day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be merciful to me, O Lord, For I cry to You all day long.
verses.textEnNlt: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I am calling on you constantly.
verses.textEnNasb: Be gracious to me, Lord, For I call upon You all day long.
verses.textEn: have mercy on me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

verses.textZh: 主啊！求你使你的仆人心里欢喜， 因为我的心仰望你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！求你使你的仆人心里欢喜， 因为我的心仰望你。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，求你使仆人心里欢喜， 因为我的心仰望你。
verses.textEnNiv: Bring joy to your servant, Lord, for I put my trust in you.
verses.textEnEsv: Gladden the soul of your servant, for to you, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rejoice the soul of Your servant, For to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
verses.textEnNlt: Give me happiness, O Lord, for I give myself to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Make the soul of Your servant joyful, For to You, Lord, I lift up my soul.
verses.textEn: Bring joy to your servant, Lord, for I put my trust in you.

verses.textZh: 主啊！你是良善，又乐意饶恕人的， 向你呼求的，你都以丰盛的慈爱待他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！你是良善，又乐意饶恕人的， 向你呼求的，你都以丰盛的慈爱待他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，你本为良善，乐意饶恕人， 有丰盛的慈爱赐给凡求告你的人。
verses.textEnNiv: You, Lord, are forgiving and good, abounding in love to all who call to you.
verses.textEnEsv: For you, O Lord, are good and forgiving, abounding in steadfast love to all who call upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in mercy to all those who call upon You.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord, you are so good, so ready to forgive, so full of unfailing love for all who ask for your help.
verses.textEnNasb: For You, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in mercy to all who call upon You.
verses.textEn: You, Lord, are forgiving and good, abounding in love to all who call to you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你侧耳听我的祷告， 留心听我的恳求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你侧耳听我的祷告， 留心听我的恳求。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的祷告， 垂听我恳求的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear my prayer, Lord ; listen to my cry for mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: Give ear, O Lord , to my prayer; listen to my plea for grace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer; And attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen closely to my prayer, O Lord ; hear my urgent cry.
verses.textEnNasb: Listen, Lord, to my prayer; And give Your attention to the sound of my pleading!
verses.textEn: Hear my prayer, Lord ; listen to my cry for mercy.

verses.textZh: 在我遭难的日子，我要求告你， 因为你必应允我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我遭难的日子，我要求告你， 因为你必应允我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在患难之日要求告你， 因为你必应允我。
verses.textEnNiv: When I am in distress, I call to you, because you answer me.
verses.textEnEsv: In the day of my trouble I call upon you, for you answer me.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the day of my trouble I will call upon You, For You will answer me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will call to you whenever I’m in trouble, and you will answer me.
verses.textEnNasb: On the day of my trouble I will call upon You, For You will answer me.
verses.textEn: When I am in distress, I call to you, because you answer me.

verses.textZh: 主啊！在众神之中，没有能和你相比的， 你的作为也是无可比拟的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！在众神之中，没有能和你相比的， 你的作为也是无可比拟的。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，诸神之中没有可比你的； 你的作为也无可比。
verses.textEnNiv: Among the gods there is none like you, Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.
verses.textEnEsv: There is none like you among the gods, O Lord, nor are there any works like yours.
verses.textEnNkjv: Among the gods thereis none like You, O Lord; Nor arethereanyworks like Your works.
verses.textEnNlt: No pagan god is like you, O Lord. None can do what you do!
verses.textEnNasb: There is no one like You among the gods, Lord, Nor are there any works like Yours.
verses.textEn: Among the gods there is none like you, Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.

verses.textZh: 主啊！你所造的万国都要来，在你面前下拜， 他们必荣耀你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！你所造的万国都要来，在你面前下拜， 他们必荣耀你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，你所造的万民都要来敬拜你； 他们也要荣耀你的名。
verses.textEnNiv: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord; they will bring glory to your name.
verses.textEnEsv: All the nations you have made shall come and worship before you, O Lord, and shall glorify your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: All nations whom You have made Shall come and worship before You, O Lord, And shall glorify Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: All the nations you made will come and bow before you, Lord; they will praise your holy name.
verses.textEnNasb: All nations whom You have made will come and worship before You, Lord, And they will glorify Your name.
verses.textEn: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord; they will bring glory to your name.

verses.textZh: 因为你是伟大的，并且行奇妙的事， 只有你是神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你是伟大的，并且行奇妙的事， 只有你是神。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你为大，且行奇妙的事； 惟独你是神。
verses.textEnNiv: For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.
verses.textEnEsv: For you are great and do wondrous things; you alone are God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You are great, and do wondrous things; You alone are God.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are great and perform wonderful deeds. You alone are God.
verses.textEnNasb: For You are great, and You do wondrous deeds; You alone are God.
verses.textEn: For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你把你的道路指教我， 使我行在你的真理中， 专心敬畏你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你把你的道路指教我， 使我行在你的真理中， 专心敬畏你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我； 我要照你的真理行； 求你使我专心敬畏你的名！
verses.textEnNiv: Teach me your way, Lord , that I may rely on your faithfulness; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name.
verses.textEnEsv: Teach me your way, O Lord , that I may walk in your truth; unite my heart to fear your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Teach me Your way, O Lord; I will walk in Your truth; Unite my heart to fear Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach me your ways, O Lord , that I may live according to your truth! Grant me purity of heart, so that I may honor you.
verses.textEnNasb: Teach me Your way, Lord; I will walk in Your truth; Unite my heart to fear Your name.
verses.textEn: Teach me your way, Lord , that I may rely on your faithfulness; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name.

verses.textZh: 主我的神啊！我要满心称赞你， 我要永远荣耀你的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主我的神啊！我要满心称赞你， 我要永远荣耀你的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 主－我的神啊，我要一心称赞你； 我要荣耀你的名，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: I will praise you, Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify your name forever.
verses.textEnEsv: I give thanks to you, O Lord my God, with my whole heart, and I will glorify your name forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, And I will glorify Your name forevermore.
verses.textEnNlt: With all my heart I will praise you, O Lord my God. I will give glory to your name forever,
verses.textEnNasb: I will give thanks to You, Lord my God, with all my heart, And I will glorify Your name forever.
verses.textEn: I will praise you, Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify your name forever.

verses.textZh: 因为你向我大施慈爱， 你救了我的命，免入阴间的深处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你向我大施慈爱， 你救了我的命，免入阴间的深处。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，你向我发的慈爱是大的； 你救了我的灵魂免入极深的阴间。
verses.textEnNiv: For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths, from the realm of the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: For great is your steadfast love toward me; you have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.
verses.textEnNkjv: For great is Your mercy toward me, And You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.
verses.textEnNlt: for your love for me is very great. You have rescued me from the depths of death.
verses.textEnNasb: For Your graciousness toward me is great, And You have saved my soul from the depths of Sheol.
verses.textEn: For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths, from the realm of the dead.

verses.textZh: 神啊！骄傲的人起来攻击我， 一群强暴的人寻索我的性命， 他们不把你放在眼内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！骄傲的人起来攻击我， 一群强暴的人寻索我的性命， 他们不把你放在眼内。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，骄傲的人起来攻击我， 又有一党强横的人寻索我的命； 他们没有将你放在眼中。
verses.textEnNiv: Arrogant foes are attacking me, O God; ruthless people are trying to kill me— they have no regard for you.
verses.textEnEsv: O God, insolent men have risen up against me; a band of ruthless men seeks my life, and they do not set you before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, the proud have risen against me, And a mob of violent men have sought my life, And have not set You before them.
verses.textEnNlt: O God, insolent people rise up against me; a violent gang is trying to kill me. You mean nothing to them.
verses.textEnNasb: God, arrogant men have risen up against me, And a gang of violent men have sought my life, And they have not set You before them.
verses.textEn: Arrogant foes are attacking me, O God; ruthless people are trying to kill me— they have no regard for you.

verses.textZh: 但是，主啊！你是有怜悯有恩典的神， 你不轻易发怒，并且有极大的慈爱和信实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，主啊！你是有怜悯有恩典的神， 你不轻易发怒，并且有极大的慈爱和信实。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，你是有怜悯有恩典的神， 不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O Lord, are a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, O Lord, are a God full of compassion, and gracious, Longsuffering and abundant in mercy and truth.
verses.textEnNlt: But you, O Lord, are a God of compassion and mercy, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: But You, Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, Slow to anger and abundant in mercy and truth.
verses.textEn: But you, Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 求你转向我，恩待我； 把你的能力赐给你的仆人， 拯救你婢女的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你转向我，恩待我； 把你的能力赐给你的仆人， 拯救你婢女的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你向我转脸，怜恤我， 将你的力量赐给仆人，救你婢女的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn to me and have mercy on me; show your strength in behalf of your servant; save me, because I serve you just as my mother did.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn to me and be gracious to me; give your strength to your servant, and save the son of your maidservant.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give Your strength to Your servant, And save the son of Your maidservant.
verses.textEnNlt: Look down and have mercy on me. Give your strength to your servant; save me, the son of your servant.
verses.textEnNasb: Turn to me, and be gracious to me; Grant Your strength to Your servant, And save the son of Your maidservant.
verses.textEn: Turn to me and have mercy on me; show your strength in behalf of your servant; save me, because I serve you just as my mother did.

verses.textZh: 求你向我显出恩待我的记号， 好使恨我的人看见了，就觉得羞愧； 因为你耶和华帮助了我，安慰了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你向我显出恩待我的记号， 好使恨我的人看见了，就觉得羞愧； 因为你耶和华帮助了我，安慰了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你向我显出恩待我的凭据， 叫恨我的人看见便羞愧， 因为你－耶和华帮助我，安慰我。
verses.textEnNiv: Give me a sign of your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, Lord , have helped me and comforted me.
verses.textEnEsv: Show me a sign of your favor, that those who hate me may see and be put to shame because you, Lord , have helped me and comforted me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Show me a sign for good, That those who hate me may see it and be ashamed, Because You, Lord, have helped me and comforted me.
verses.textEnNlt: Send me a sign of your favor. Then those who hate me will be put to shame, for you, O Lord , help and comfort me.
verses.textEnNasb: Show me a sign of good, That those who hate me may see it and be ashamed, Because You, Lord, have helped me and comforted me.
verses.textEn: Give me a sign of your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, Lord , have helped me and comforted me.

verses.textZh: 歌一首，可拉子孙的诗。 耶和华所立的根基在圣山上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌一首，可拉子孙的诗。 耶和华所立的根基在圣山上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华所立的根基在圣山上。
verses.textEnNiv: He has founded his city on the holy mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: On the holy mount stands the city he founded;
verses.textEnNkjv: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: On the holy mountain stands the city founded by the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.textEn: He has founded his city on the holy mountain.

verses.textZh: 耶和华爱锡安的城门， 胜过雅各的一切居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华爱锡安的城门， 胜过雅各的一切居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 他爱锡安的门， 胜于爱雅各一切的住处。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the other dwellings of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling places of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord loves the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: He loves the city of Jerusalem more than any other city in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord loves the gates of Zion More than all the other dwelling places of Jacob.
verses.textEn: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the other dwellings of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 神的城啊！ 有很多荣耀的事，都是指着你说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的城啊！ 有很多荣耀的事，都是指着你说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的城啊， 有荣耀的事乃指着你说的。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Glorious things are said of you, city of God:
verses.textEnEsv: Glorious things of you are spoken, O city of God. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God! Selah
verses.textEnNlt: O city of God, what glorious things are said of you! Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Glorious things are spoken of you, City of God. Selah
verses.textEn: Glorious things are said of you, city of God:

verses.textZh: "在认识我的人中，我提到拉哈伯和巴比伦， 看哪！还有非利士、推罗和古实，我说： ‘这一个是生在那里的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "在认识我的人中，我提到拉哈伯和巴比伦， 看哪！还有非利士、推罗和古实，我说： ‘这一个是生在那里的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要提起拉哈伯和巴比伦人， 是在认识我之中的； 看哪，非利士和泰尔并古实人， 个个生在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me— Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush — and will say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Among those who know me I mention Rahab and Babylon; behold, Philistia and Tyre, with Cush — "This one was born there," they say.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to those who know Me; Behold, O Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia: ‘This one was born there.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will count Egypt and Babylon among those who know me— also Philistia and Tyre, and even distant Ethiopia. They have all become citizens of Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNasb: "I shall mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me; Behold, Philistia and Tyre with Cush: ‘This one was born there.’ "
verses.textEn: "I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me— Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush — and will say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’ "

verses.textZh: 论到锡安，必有话说： "这一个、那一个都是生在锡安的。" 至高者必亲自坚立这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到锡安，必有话说： "这一个、那一个都是生在锡安的。" 至高者必亲自坚立这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到锡安，必说： 这一个、那一个都生在其中， 而且至高者必亲自坚立这城。
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her."
verses.textEnEsv: And of Zion it shall be said, "This one and that one were born in her"; for the Most High himself will establish her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one were born in her; And the Most High Himself shall establish her."
verses.textEnNlt: Regarding Jerusalem it will be said, "Everyone enjoys the rights of citizenship there." And the Most High will personally bless this city.
verses.textEnNasb: But of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one were born in her"; And the Most High Himself will establish her.
verses.textEn: Indeed, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her."

verses.textZh: 耶和华登记万民的时候，必记着： "这一个是生在那里的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华登记万民的时候，必记着： "这一个是生在那里的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华记录万民的时候， 他要点出这一个生在那里。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will write in the register of the peoples: "This one was born in Zion."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord records as he registers the peoples, "This one was born there." Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord will record, When He registers the peoples: "This one was born there." Selah
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord registers the nations, he will say, "They have all become citizens of Jerusalem." Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will count when He registers the peoples, "This one was born there." Selah
verses.textEn: The Lord will write in the register of the peoples: "This one was born in Zion."

verses.textZh: 他们跳舞歌唱的时候，要说： "我的泉源都在你里面。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们跳舞歌唱的时候，要说： "我的泉源都在你里面。"
verses.textZhCuv: 歌唱的，跳舞的，都要说： 我的泉源都在你里面。
verses.textEnNiv: As they make music they will sing, "All my fountains are in you."
verses.textEnEsv: Singers and dancers alike say, "All my springs are in you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Both the singers and the players on instruments say, "All my springs are in you."
verses.textEnNlt: The people will play flutes and sing, "The source of my life springs from Jerusalem!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then those who sing as well as those who play the flutes will say, "All my springs of joy are in you."
verses.textEn: As they make music they will sing, "All my fountains are in you."

verses.textZh: 歌一首，可拉子孙的诗，就是以斯拉人希幔的训诲诗，交给诗班长，调用"麻哈拉利暗俄"。 耶和华、拯救我的神啊！ 我昼夜都在你面前哀求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌一首，可拉子孙的诗，就是以斯拉人希幔的训诲诗，交给诗班长，调用"麻哈拉利暗俄"。 耶和华、拯救我的神啊！ 我昼夜都在你面前哀求。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－拯救我的神啊， 我昼夜在你面前呼吁。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , you are the God who saves me; day and night I cry out to you.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , God of my salvation, I cry out day and night before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, God of my salvation, I have cried out day and night before You.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , God of my salvation, I cry out to you by day. I come to you at night.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, the God of my salvation, I have cried out by day and in the night before You.
verses.textEn: Lord , you are the God who saves me; day and night I cry out to you.

verses.textZh: 愿我的祷告达到你面前， 求你留心听我的呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我的祷告达到你面前， 求你留心听我的呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我的祷告达到你面前； 求你侧耳听我的呼求！
verses.textEnNiv: May my prayer come before you; turn your ear to my cry.
verses.textEnEsv: Let my prayer come before you; incline your ear to my cry!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let my prayer come before You; Incline Your ear to my cry.
verses.textEnNlt: Now hear my prayer; listen to my cry.
verses.textEnNasb: Let my prayer come before You; Incline Your ear to my cry!
verses.textEn: May my prayer come before you; turn your ear to my cry.

verses.textZh: 因为我饱经忧患， 我的性命临近阴间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我饱经忧患， 我的性命临近阴间。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我心里满了患难； 我的性命临近阴间。
verses.textEnNiv: I am overwhelmed with troubles and my life draws near to death.
verses.textEnEsv: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
verses.textEnNkjv: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draws near to the grave.
verses.textEnNlt: For my life is full of troubles, and death draws near.
verses.textEnNasb: For my soul has had enough troubles, And my life has approached Sheol.
verses.textEn: I am overwhelmed with troubles and my life draws near to death.

verses.textZh: 我被列在下坑的人中， 就像一个没有气力的人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我被列在下坑的人中， 就像一个没有气力的人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我算和下坑的人同列， 如同无力 的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like one without strength.
verses.textEnEsv: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am a man who has no strength,
verses.textEnNkjv: I am counted with those who go down to the pit; I am like a man whohas no strength,
verses.textEnNlt: I am as good as dead, like a strong man with no strength left.
verses.textEnNasb: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I have become like a man without strength,
verses.textEn: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like one without strength.

verses.textZh: 我被弃在死人之中， 好象被杀的人躺在坟墓里； 你不再记念他们， 他们也和你 隔绝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我被弃在死人之中， 好象被杀的人躺在坟墓里； 你不再记念他们， 他们也和你 隔绝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我被丢在死人中， 好像被杀的人躺在坟墓里。 他们是你不再记念的， 与你隔绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: I am set apart with the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, who are cut off from your care.
verses.textEnEsv: like one set loose among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, like those whom you remember no more, for they are cut off from your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Adrift among the dead, Like the slain who lie in the grave, Whom You remember no more, And who are cut off from Your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: They have left me among the dead, and I lie like a corpse in a grave. I am forgotten, cut off from your care.
verses.textEnNasb: Abandoned among the dead, Like the slain who lie in the grave, Whom You no longer remember, And they are cut off from Your hand.
verses.textEn: I am set apart with the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, who are cut off from your care.

verses.textZh: 你把我放在最深的坑里， 把我放在黑暗的地方和深渊里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把我放在最深的坑里， 把我放在黑暗的地方和深渊里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你把我放在极深的坑里， 在黑暗地方，在深处。
verses.textEnNiv: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
verses.textEnEsv: You have put me in the depths of the pit, in the regions dark and deep.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have laid me in the lowest pit, In darkness, in the depths.
verses.textEnNlt: You have thrown me into the lowest pit, into the darkest depths.
verses.textEnNasb: You have put me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the depths.
verses.textEn: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

verses.textZh: 你的烈怒重重地压着我， 你的波浪从四方八面把我淹盖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的烈怒重重地压着我， 你的波浪从四方八面把我淹盖。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的忿怒重压我身； 你用一切的波浪困住我。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Your wrath lies heavily on me; you have overwhelmed me with all your waves.
verses.textEnEsv: Your wrath lies heavy upon me, and you overwhelm me with all your waves. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Your wrath lies heavy upon me, And You have afflicted me with all Your waves. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Your anger weighs me down; with wave after wave you have engulfed me. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Your wrath has rested upon me, And You have afflicted me with all Your waves. Selah
verses.textEn: Your wrath lies heavily on me; you have overwhelmed me with all your waves.

verses.textZh: 你使我的知己都远离我， 使我成为他们所厌恶的。 我被囚禁，不能外出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我的知己都远离我， 使我成为他们所厌恶的。 我被囚禁，不能外出。
verses.textZhCuv: 你把我所认识的隔在远处， 使我为他们所憎恶； 我被拘困，不得出来。
verses.textEnNiv: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;
verses.textEnEsv: You have caused my companions to shun me; you have made me a horror to them. I am shut in so that I cannot escape;
verses.textEnNkjv: You have put away my acquaintances far from me; You have made me an abomination to them; Iam shut up, and I cannot get out;
verses.textEnNlt: You have driven my friends away by making me repulsive to them. I am in a trap with no way of escape.
verses.textEnNasb: You have removed my acquaintances far from me; You have made me an object of loathing to them; I am shut up and cannot go out.
verses.textEn: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;

verses.textZh: 我的眼睛因困苦而昏花； 耶和华啊，我天天向你呼求， 向你举手祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼睛因困苦而昏花； 耶和华啊，我天天向你呼求， 向你举手祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的眼睛因困苦而干瘪。 耶和华啊，我天天求告你，向你举手。
verses.textEnNiv: my eyes are dim with grief. I call to you, Lord , every day; I spread out my hands to you.
verses.textEnEsv: my eye grows dim through sorrow. Every day I call upon you, O Lord ; I spread out my hands to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eye wastes away because of affliction. Lord, I have called daily upon You; I have stretched out my hands to You.
verses.textEnNlt: My eyes are blinded by my tears. Each day I beg for your help, O Lord ; I lift my hands to you for mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: My eye grows dim from misery; I have called upon You every day, Lord; I have spread out my hands to You.
verses.textEn: my eyes are dim with grief. I call to you, Lord , every day; I spread out my hands to you.

verses.textZh: 你要为死人行奇事吗？ 阴魂会起来称谢你吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要为死人行奇事吗？ 阴魂会起来称谢你吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你岂要行奇事给死人看吗？ 难道阴魂还能起来称赞你吗？ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do their spirits rise up and praise you?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you work wonders for the dead? Do the departed rise up to praise you? Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: Will You work wonders for the dead? Shall the dead arise and praise You? Selah
verses.textEnNlt: Are your wonderful deeds of any use to the dead? Do the dead rise up and praise you? Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: Will You perform wonders for the dead? Or will the departed spirits rise and praise You? Selah
verses.textEn: Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do their spirits rise up and praise you?

verses.textZh: 在坟墓里有人述说你的慈爱吗？ 在灭亡之地 有人述说你的信实吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 在坟墓里有人述说你的慈爱吗？ 在灭亡之地 有人述说你的信实吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂能在坟墓里述说你的慈爱吗？ 岂能在灭亡中述说你的信实吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is your love declared in the grave, your faithfulness in Destruction ?
verses.textEnEsv: Is your steadfast love declared in the grave, or your faithfulness in Abaddon?
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall Your lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or Your faithfulness in the place of destruction?
verses.textEnNlt: Can those in the grave declare your unfailing love? Can they proclaim your faithfulness in the place of destruction?
verses.textEnNasb: Will Your graciousness be declared in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
verses.textEn: Is your love declared in the grave, your faithfulness in Destruction ?

verses.textZh: 你的奇事在黑暗里有人知道吗？ 你的公义在那遗忘之地有人知道吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的奇事在黑暗里有人知道吗？ 你的公义在那遗忘之地有人知道吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你的奇事岂能在幽暗里被知道吗？ 你的公义岂能在忘记之地被知道吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Are your wonders known in the place of darkness, or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?
verses.textEnEsv: Are your wonders known in the darkness, or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall Your wonders be known in the dark? And Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.textEnNlt: Can the darkness speak of your wonderful deeds? Can anyone in the land of forgetfulness talk about your righteousness?
verses.textEnNasb: Will Your wonders be made known in the darkness? And Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.textEn: Are your wonders known in the place of darkness, or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我却向你呼求， 我的祷告在早晨达到你面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我却向你呼求， 我的祷告在早晨达到你面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我呼求你； 我早晨的祷告要达到你面前。
verses.textEnNiv: But I cry to you for help, Lord ; in the morning my prayer comes before you.
verses.textEnEsv: But I, O Lord , cry to you; in the morning my prayer comes before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But to You I have cried out, O Lord, And in the morning my prayer comes before You.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , I cry out to you. I will keep on pleading day by day.
verses.textEnNasb: But I, Lord, have cried out to You for help, And in the morning my prayer comes before You.
verses.textEn: But I cry to you for help, Lord ; in the morning my prayer comes before you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你为甚么丢弃我？ 为甚么掩面不顾我？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你为甚么丢弃我？ 为甚么掩面不顾我？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你为何丢弃我？ 为何掩面不顾我？
verses.textEnNiv: Why, Lord , do you reject me and hide your face from me?
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , why do you cast my soul away? Why do you hide your face from me?
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, why do You cast off my soul? Why do You hide Your face from me?
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , why do you reject me? Why do you turn your face from me?
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, why do You reject my soul? Why do You hide Your face from me?
verses.textEn: Why, Lord , do you reject me and hide your face from me?

verses.textZh: 我自幼受苦，几乎死亡； 我受了你的惊吓，以致困惑不安 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我自幼受苦，几乎死亡； 我受了你的惊吓，以致困惑不安 。
verses.textZhCuv: 我自幼受苦，几乎死亡； 我受你的惊恐，甚至慌张。
verses.textEnNiv: From my youth I have suffered and been close to death; I have borne your terrors and am in despair.
verses.textEnEsv: Afflicted and close to death from my youth up, I suffer your terrors; I am helpless.
verses.textEnNkjv: I havebeen afflicted and ready to die from my youth; I suffer Your terrors; I am distraught.
verses.textEnNlt: I have been sick and close to death since my youth. I stand helpless and desperate before your terrors.
verses.textEnNasb: I was miserable and about to die from my youth on; I suffer Your terrors; I grow weary.
verses.textEn: From my youth I have suffered and been close to death; I have borne your terrors and am in despair.

verses.textZh: 你的烈怒把我淹没， 你的惊吓把我除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的烈怒把我淹没， 你的惊吓把我除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的烈怒漫过我身； 你的惊吓把我剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: Your wrath has swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.
verses.textEnEsv: Your wrath has swept over me; your dreadful assaults destroy me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your fierce wrath has gone over me; Your terrors have cut me off.
verses.textEnNlt: Your fierce anger has overwhelmed me. Your terrors have paralyzed me.
verses.textEnNasb: Your burning anger has passed over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
verses.textEn: Your wrath has swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.

verses.textZh: 这些终日像水一样环绕我， 一起把我围困。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些终日像水一样环绕我， 一起把我围困。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些终日如水环绕我， 一齐都来围困我。
verses.textEnNiv: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.
verses.textEnEsv: They surround me like a flood all day long; they close in on me together.
verses.textEnNkjv: They came around me all day long like water; They engulfed me altogether.
verses.textEnNlt: They swirl around me like floodwaters all day long. They have engulfed me completely.
verses.textEnNasb: They have surrounded me like water all day long; They have encircled me altogether.
verses.textEn: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.

verses.textZh: 你使我挚爱的和同伴都远离我， 黑暗成了我的知己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我挚爱的和同伴都远离我， 黑暗成了我的知己。
verses.textZhCuv: 你把我的良朋密友隔在远处， 使我所认识的人进入黑暗里。
verses.textEnNiv: You have taken from me friend and neighbor— darkness is my closest friend.
verses.textEnEsv: You have caused my beloved and my friend to shun me; my companions have become darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Loved one and friend You have put far from me, And my acquaintances into darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: You have taken away my companions and loved ones. Darkness is my closest friend.
verses.textEnNasb: You have removed lover and friend far from me; My acquaintances are in a hiding place.
verses.textEn: You have taken from me friend and neighbor— darkness is my closest friend.

verses.textZh: 以斯拉人以探的训诲诗。 我要永远歌唱耶和华的慈爱， 世世代代用口传扬你的信实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯拉人以探的训诲诗。 我要永远歌唱耶和华的慈爱， 世世代代用口传扬你的信实。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要歌唱耶和华的慈爱，直到永远； 我要用口将你的信实传与万代。
verses.textEnNiv: I will sing of the Lord ’s great love forever; with my mouth I will make your faithfulness known through all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: I will sing of the steadfast love of the Lord forever; with my mouth I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord forever; With my mouth will I make known Your faithfulness to all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: I will sing of the Lord ’s unfailing love forever! Young and old will hear of your faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: I will sing of the graciousness of the Lord forever; To all generations I will make Your faithfulness known with my mouth.
verses.textEn: I will sing of the Lord ’s great love forever; with my mouth I will make your faithfulness known through all generations.

verses.textZh: 我要说："你的慈爱必永远建立； 你的信实，你必坚立在天上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要说："你的慈爱必永远建立； 你的信实，你必坚立在天上。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我曾说：你的慈悲必建立到永远； 你的信实必坚立在天上。
verses.textEnNiv: I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you have established your faithfulness in heaven itself.
verses.textEnEsv: For I said, "Steadfast love will be built up forever; in the heavens you will establish your faithfulness."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have said, "Mercy shall be built up forever; Your faithfulness You shall establish in the very heavens."
verses.textEnNlt: Your unfailing love will last forever. Your faithfulness is as enduring as the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have said, "Graciousness will be built up forever; In the heavens You will establish Your faithfulness."
verses.textEn: I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you have established your faithfulness in heaven itself.

verses.textZh: 你曾说：‘我和我所拣选的人立了约， 向我的仆人大卫起了誓，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾说：‘我和我所拣选的人立了约， 向我的仆人大卫起了誓，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 我与我所拣选的人立了约， 向我的仆人大卫起了誓：
verses.textEnNiv: You said, "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David my servant,
verses.textEnEsv: You have said, "I have made a covenant with my chosen one; I have sworn to David my servant:
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have made a covenant with My chosen, I have sworn to My servant David:
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said, "I have made a covenant with David, my chosen servant. I have sworn this oath to him:
verses.textEnNasb: "I have made a covenant with My chosen; I have sworn to My servant David,
verses.textEn: You said, "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David my servant,

verses.textZh: 我必永远坚立你的后裔， 也必世世代代建立你的王位。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必永远坚立你的后裔， 也必世世代代建立你的王位。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要建立你的后裔，直到永远； 要建立你的宝座，直到万代。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: ‘I will establish your line forever and make your throne firm through all generations.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build your throne for all generations.’" Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Your seed I will establish forever, And build up your throne to all generations.’ " Selah
verses.textEnNlt: ‘I will establish your descendants as kings forever; they will sit on your throne from now until eternity.’" Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: I will establish your descendants forever And build up your throne to all generations." Selah
verses.textEn: ‘I will establish your line forever and make your throne firm through all generations.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！诸天要称颂你的奇事； 在圣者的会中，你的信实也要被称颂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！诸天要称颂你的奇事； 在圣者的会中，你的信实也要被称颂。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，诸天要称赞你的奇事； 在圣者的会中，要称赞你的信实。
verses.textEnNiv: The heavens praise your wonders, Lord , your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the heavens praise your wonders, O Lord , your faithfulness in the assembly of the holy ones!
verses.textEnNkjv: And the heavens will praise Your wonders, O Lord; Your faithfulness also in the assembly of the saints.
verses.textEnNlt: All heaven will praise your great wonders, Lord ; myriads of angels will praise you for your faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: The heavens will praise Your wonders, Lord; Your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.textEn: The heavens praise your wonders, Lord , your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.

verses.textZh: 在天上，谁能和耶和华相比呢？ 在全能者的众子中，谁能像耶和华呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 在天上，谁能和耶和华相比呢？ 在全能者的众子中，谁能像耶和华呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 在天空谁能比耶和华呢？神的众子中，谁能像耶和华呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For who in the skies above can compare with the Lord ? Who is like the Lord among the heavenly beings?
verses.textEnEsv: For who in the skies can be compared to the Lord ? Who among the heavenly beings is like the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: For who in the heavens can be compared to the Lord? Who among the sons of the mighty can be likened to the Lord?
verses.textEnNlt: For who in all of heaven can compare with the Lord ? What mightiest angel is anything like the Lord ?
verses.textEnNasb: For who in the skies is comparable to the Lord? Who among the sons of the mighty is like the Lord,
verses.textEn: For who in the skies above can compare with the Lord ? Who is like the Lord among the heavenly beings?

verses.textZh: 在圣者的议会中，神是令人惊惧的， 比一切在他周围的都更为可畏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在圣者的议会中，神是令人惊惧的， 比一切在他周围的都更为可畏。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在圣者的会中，是大有威严的神， 比一切在他四围的更可畏惧。
verses.textEnNiv: In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared; he is more awesome than all who surround him.
verses.textEnEsv: a God greatly to be feared in the council of the holy ones, and awesome above all who are around him?
verses.textEnNkjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, And to be held in reverence by all those around Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The highest angelic powers stand in awe of God. He is far more awesome than all who surround his throne.
verses.textEnNasb: A God greatly feared in the council of the holy ones, And awesome above all those who are around Him?
verses.textEn: In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared; he is more awesome than all who surround him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华万军之神啊！有谁像你？ 耶和华啊！你是大能的，你的信实在你的周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华万军之神啊！有谁像你？ 耶和华啊！你是大能的，你的信实在你的周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－万军之神啊， 哪一个大能者像你耶和华？ 你的信实是在你的四围。
verses.textEnNiv: Who is like you, Lord God Almighty? You, Lord , are mighty, and your faithfulness surrounds you.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord God of hosts, who is mighty as you are, O Lord , with your faithfulness all around you?
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord God of hosts, Who is mighty like You, O Lord? Your faithfulness also surrounds You.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord God of Heaven’s Armies! Where is there anyone as mighty as you, O Lord ? You are entirely faithful.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord God of armies, who is like You, mighty Lord? Your faithfulness also surrounds You.
verses.textEn: Who is like you, Lord God Almighty? You, Lord , are mighty, and your faithfulness surrounds you.

verses.textZh: 你管辖海洋的狂涛， 波浪翻腾的时候，你使它们平息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你管辖海洋的狂涛， 波浪翻腾的时候，你使它们平息。
verses.textZhCuv: 你管辖海的狂傲； 波浪翻腾，你就使它平静了。
verses.textEnNiv: You rule over the surging sea; when its waves mount up, you still them.
verses.textEnEsv: You rule the raging of the sea; when its waves rise, you still them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You rule the raging of the sea; When its waves rise, You still them.
verses.textEnNlt: You rule the oceans. You subdue their storm-tossed waves.
verses.textEnNasb: You rule the surging of the sea; When its waves rise, You calm them.
verses.textEn: You rule over the surging sea; when its waves mount up, you still them.

verses.textZh: 你打碎了拉哈伯，好象已遭刺杀的人； 你用有力的膀臂，赶散了你的仇敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你打碎了拉哈伯，好象已遭刺杀的人； 你用有力的膀臂，赶散了你的仇敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 你打碎了拉哈伯，似乎是已杀的人； 你用有能的膀臂打散了你的仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: You crushed Rahab like one of the slain; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; you scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have broken Rahab in pieces, as one who is slain; You have scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
verses.textEnNlt: You crushed the great sea monster. You scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
verses.textEnNasb: You Yourself crushed Rahab like one who is slain; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
verses.textEn: You crushed Rahab like one of the slain; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.

verses.textZh: 天是你的，地也是你的； 世界和世界充满的，都是你建立的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天是你的，地也是你的； 世界和世界充满的，都是你建立的。
verses.textZhCuv: 天属你，地也属你； 世界和其中所充满的都为你所建立。
verses.textEnNiv: The heavens are yours, and yours also the earth; you founded the world and all that is in it.
verses.textEnEsv: The heavens are yours; the earth also is yours; the world and all that is in it, you have founded them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heavens are Yours, the earth also is Yours; The world and all its fullness, You have founded them.
verses.textEnNlt: The heavens are yours, and the earth is yours; everything in the world is yours—you created it all.
verses.textEnNasb: The heavens are Yours, the earth also is Yours; The world and all it contains, You have established them.
verses.textEn: The heavens are yours, and yours also the earth; you founded the world and all that is in it.

verses.textZh: 南北都是你创造的， 他泊和黑门都因你的名欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 南北都是你创造的， 他泊和黑门都因你的名欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 南北为你所创造； 他泊和黑门都因你的名欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: You created the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.
verses.textEnEsv: The north and the south, you have created them; Tabor and Hermon joyously praise your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: The north and the south, You have created them; Tabor and Hermon rejoice in Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: You created north and south. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon praise your name.
verses.textEnNasb: The north and the south, You have created them; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
verses.textEn: You created the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.

verses.textZh: 你有大能的膀臂， 你的手强而有力，你的右手高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你有大能的膀臂， 你的手强而有力，你的右手高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 你有大能的膀臂； 你的手有力，你的右手也高举。
verses.textEnNiv: Your arm is endowed with power; your hand is strong, your right hand exalted.
verses.textEnEsv: You have a mighty arm; strong is your hand, high your right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have a mighty arm; Strong is Your hand, and high is Your right hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Powerful is your arm! Strong is your hand! Your right hand is lifted high in glorious strength.
verses.textEnNasb: You have a strong arm; Your hand is mighty, Your right hand is exalted.
verses.textEn: Your arm is endowed with power; your hand is strong, your right hand exalted.

verses.textZh: 公义和公正是你宝座的基础， 慈爱和信实行在你前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公义和公正是你宝座的基础， 慈爱和信实行在你前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 公义和公平是你宝座的根基； 慈爱和诚实行在你前面。
verses.textEnNiv: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; love and faithfulness go before you.
verses.textEnEsv: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; steadfast love and faithfulness go before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; Mercy and truth go before Your face.
verses.textEnNlt: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Unfailing love and truth walk before you as attendants.
verses.textEnNasb: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; Mercy and truth go before You.
verses.textEn: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; love and faithfulness go before you.

verses.textZh: 晓得向你欢呼的人民是有福的， 耶和华啊！他们在你的脸光中行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 晓得向你欢呼的人民是有福的， 耶和华啊！他们在你的脸光中行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 知道向你欢呼的，那民是有福的！ 耶和华啊，他们在你脸上的光里行走。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed are the people who know the festal shout, who walk, O Lord , in the light of your face,
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are the people who know the joyful sound! They walk, O Lord, in the light of Your countenance.
verses.textEnNlt: Happy are those who hear the joyful call to worship, for they will walk in the light of your presence, Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are the people who know the joyful sound! Lord, they walk in the light of Your face.
verses.textEn: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们因你的名终日欢呼， 因你的公义被高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们因你的名终日欢呼， 因你的公义被高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们因你的名终日欢乐， 因你的公义得以高举。
verses.textEnNiv: They rejoice in your name all day long; they celebrate your righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: who exult in your name all the day and in your righteousness are exalted.
verses.textEnNkjv: In Your name they rejoice all day long, And in Your righteousness they are exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: They rejoice all day long in your wonderful reputation. They exult in your righteousness.
verses.textEnNasb: In Your name they rejoice all the day, And by Your righteousness they are exalted.
verses.textEn: They rejoice in your name all day long; they celebrate your righteousness.

verses.textZh: 因为你是他们的荣耀和力量； 因你的恩惠，我们的角得以高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你是他们的荣耀和力量； 因你的恩惠，我们的角得以高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是他们力量的荣耀； 因为你喜悦我们，我们的角必被高举。
verses.textEnNiv: For you are their glory and strength, and by your favor you exalt our horn.
