verses.textEnEsv: For you are the glory of their strength; by your favor our horn is exalted.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You are the glory of their strength, And in Your favor our horn is exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: You are their glorious strength. It pleases you to make us strong.
verses.textEnNasb: For You are the glory of their strength, And by Your favor our horn is exalted.
verses.textEn: For you are their glory and strength, and by your favor you exalt our horn.

verses.textZh: 因为我们的盾牌是耶和华， 我们的君王是以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们的盾牌是耶和华， 我们的君王是以色列的圣者。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的盾牌属耶和华； 我们的王属以色列的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, our shield belongs to the Lord , our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For our shield belongs to the Lord , our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For our shield belongs to the Lord, And our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, our protection comes from the Lord , and he, the Holy One of Israel, has given us our king.
verses.textEnNasb: For our shield belongs to the Lord, And our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEn: Indeed, our shield belongs to the Lord , our king to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textZh: 那时，你在异象中告诉你的圣民说： "我帮助了一位勇士， 我从民中兴起了一位青年 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你在异象中告诉你的圣民说： "我帮助了一位勇士， 我从民中兴起了一位青年 。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，你在异象中晓谕你的圣民，说： 我已把救助之力加在那有能者的身上； 我高举那从民中所拣选的。
verses.textEnNiv: Once you spoke in a vision, to your faithful people you said: "I have bestowed strength on a warrior; I have raised up a young man from among the people.
verses.textEnEsv: Of old you spoke in a vision to your godly one, and said: "I have granted help to one who is mighty; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then You spoke in a vision to Your holy one, And said: "I have given help to onewhois mighty; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Long ago you spoke in a vision to your faithful people. You said, "I have raised up a warrior. I have selected him from the common people to be king.
verses.textEnNasb: Once You spoke in vision to Your godly ones, And said, "I have given help to one who is mighty; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
verses.textEn: Once you spoke in a vision, to your faithful people you said: "I have bestowed strength on a warrior; I have raised up a young man from among the people.

verses.textZh: 我找到我的仆人大卫， 用我的圣膏油膏他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我找到我的仆人大卫， 用我的圣膏油膏他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我寻得我的仆人大卫， 用我的圣膏膏他。
verses.textEnNiv: I have found David my servant; with my sacred oil I have anointed him.
verses.textEnEsv: I have found David, my servant; with my holy oil I have anointed him,
verses.textEnNkjv: I have found My servant David; With My holy oil I have anointed him,
verses.textEnNlt: I have found my servant David. I have anointed him with my holy oil.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have found My servant David; With My holy oil I have anointed him,
verses.textEn: I have found David my servant; with my sacred oil I have anointed him.

verses.textZh: 我的手必坚立他， 我的膀臂必坚固他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的手必坚立他， 我的膀臂必坚固他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的手必使他坚立； 我的膀臂也必坚固他。
verses.textEnNiv: My hand will sustain him; surely my arm will strengthen him.
verses.textEnEsv: so that my hand shall be established with him; my arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.textEnNkjv: With whom My hand shall be established; Also My arm shall strengthen him.
verses.textEnNlt: I will steady him with my hand; with my powerful arm I will make him strong.
verses.textEnNasb: With whom My hand will be established; My arm also will strengthen him.
verses.textEn: My hand will sustain him; surely my arm will strengthen him.

verses.textZh: 仇敌必不能欺骗他， 凶恶的人必不能压迫他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 仇敌必不能欺骗他， 凶恶的人必不能压迫他。
verses.textZhCuv: 仇敌必不勒索他； 凶恶之子也不苦害他。
verses.textEnNiv: The enemy will not get the better of him; the wicked will not oppress him.
verses.textEnEsv: The enemy shall not outwit him; the wicked shall not humble him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The enemy shall not outwit him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.textEnNlt: His enemies will not defeat him, nor will the wicked overpower him.
verses.textEnNasb: "The enemy will not deceive him, Nor will the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.textEn: The enemy will not get the better of him; the wicked will not oppress him.

verses.textZh: 我要在他的面前击碎他的敌人， 击杀那些恨他的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在他的面前击碎他的敌人， 击杀那些恨他的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在他面前打碎他的敌人， 击杀那恨他的人。
verses.textEnNiv: I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.
verses.textEnEsv: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will beat down his foes before his face, And plague those who hate him.
verses.textEnNlt: I will beat down his adversaries before him and destroy those who hate him.
verses.textEnNasb: "But I will crush his adversaries before him, And strike those who hate him.
verses.textEn: I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.

verses.textZh: 我的信实和慈爱必与他同在， 他的角必因我的名被高举。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的信实和慈爱必与他同在， 他的角必因我的名被高举。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是我的信实和我的慈爱要与他同在； 因我的名，他的角必被高举。
verses.textEnNiv: My faithful love will be with him, and through my name his horn will be exalted.
verses.textEnEsv: My faithfulness and my steadfast love shall be with him, and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But My faithfulness and My mercy shallbe with him, And in My name his horn shall be exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: My faithfulness and unfailing love will be with him, and by my authority he will grow in power.
verses.textEnNasb: "My faithfulness and My favor will be with him, And in My name his horn will be exalted.
verses.textEn: My faithful love will be with him, and through my name his horn will be exalted.

verses.textZh: 我必使他的左手伸到大海， 使他的右手伸到大河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使他的左手伸到大海， 使他的右手伸到大河。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使他的左手伸到海上， 右手伸到河上。
verses.textEnNiv: I will set his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.
verses.textEnEsv: I will set his hand on the sea and his right hand on the rivers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I will set his hand over the sea, And his right hand over the rivers.
verses.textEnNlt: I will extend his rule over the sea, his dominion over the rivers.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also place his hand on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.
verses.textEn: I will set his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.

verses.textZh: 他必呼叫我，说：‘你是我的父、我的神、拯救我的盘石。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必呼叫我，说：‘你是我的父、我的神、拯救我的盘石。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他要称呼我说：你是我的父， 是我的神，是拯救我的磐石。
verses.textEnNiv: He will call out to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior.’
verses.textEnEsv: He shall cry to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation.’
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall cry to Me, ‘You are my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.’
verses.textEnNlt: And he will call out to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation.’
verses.textEnNasb: "He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.’
verses.textEn: He will call out to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior.’

verses.textZh: 我也要立他为长子， 为世上最高的君王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也要立他为长子， 为世上最高的君王。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要立他为长子， 为世上最高的君王。
verses.textEnNiv: And I will appoint him to be my firstborn, the most exalted of the kings of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make him the firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I will make him My firstborn, The highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make him my firstborn son, the mightiest king on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also make him My firstborn, The highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.textEn: And I will appoint him to be my firstborn, the most exalted of the kings of the earth.

verses.textZh: 我要永远保持我对他的慈爱， 我和他所立的约必坚立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要永远保持我对他的慈爱， 我和他所立的约必坚立。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要为他存留我的慈爱，直到永远； 我与他立的约必要坚定。
verses.textEnNiv: I will maintain my love to him forever, and my covenant with him will never fail.
verses.textEnEsv: My steadfast love I will keep for him forever, and my covenant will stand firm for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: My mercy I will keep for him forever, And My covenant shall stand firm with him.
verses.textEnNlt: I will love him and be kind to him forever; my covenant with him will never end.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will maintain My favor for him forever, And My covenant shall be confirmed to him.
verses.textEn: I will maintain my love to him forever, and my covenant with him will never fail.

verses.textZh: 我要使他的后裔存到永远， 使他的王位好象天一样长久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使他的后裔存到永远， 使他的王位好象天一样长久。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要使他的后裔存到永远， 使他的宝座如天之久。
verses.textEnNiv: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
verses.textEnEsv: I will establish his offspring forever and his throne as the days of the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: His seed also I will make toendure forever, And his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: I will preserve an heir for him; his throne will be as endless as the days of heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I will establish his descendants forever, And his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.textEn: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

verses.textZh: 如果他的子孙离弃我的律法， 不照着我的典章而行；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他的子孙离弃我的律法， 不照着我的典章而行；
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若他的子孙离弃我的律法， 不照我的典章行，
verses.textEnNiv: "If his sons forsake my law and do not follow my statutes,
verses.textEnEsv: If his children forsake my law and do not walk according to my rules,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If his sons forsake My law And do not walk in My judgments,
verses.textEnNlt: But if his descendants forsake my instructions and fail to obey my regulations,
verses.textEnNasb: "If his sons abandon My Law And do not walk in My judgments,
verses.textEn: "If his sons forsake my law and do not follow my statutes,

verses.textZh: 如果他们违背我的律例， 不遵守我的诫命，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们违背我的律例， 不遵守我的诫命，
verses.textZhCuv: 背弃我的律例， 不遵守我的诫命，
verses.textEnNiv: if they violate my decrees and fail to keep my commands,
verses.textEnEsv: if they violate my statutes and do not keep my commandments,
verses.textEnNkjv: If they break My statutes And do not keep My commandments,
verses.textEnNlt: if they do not obey my decrees and fail to keep my commands,
verses.textEnNasb: If they violate My statutes And do not keep My commandments,
verses.textEn: if they violate my decrees and fail to keep my commands,

verses.textZh: 我就用杖责罚他们的过犯， 用鞭责罚他们的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就用杖责罚他们的过犯， 用鞭责罚他们的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就要用杖责罚他们的过犯， 用鞭责罚他们的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: I will punish their sin with the rod, their iniquity with flogging;
verses.textEnEsv: then I will punish their transgression with the rod and their iniquity with stripes,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will punish their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.
verses.textEnNlt: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their disobedience with beating.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will punish their wrongdoing with the rod, And their guilt with afflictions.
verses.textEn: I will punish their sin with the rod, their iniquity with flogging;

verses.textZh: 但我必不把我的慈爱从他身上收回， 也必不背弃我的信实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我必不把我的慈爱从他身上收回， 也必不背弃我的信实。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是我必不将我的慈爱全然收回， 也必不叫我的信实废弃。
verses.textEnNiv: but I will not take my love from him, nor will I ever betray my faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: but I will not remove from him my steadfast love or be false to my faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless My lovingkindness I will not utterly take from him, Nor allow My faithfulness to fail.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will never stop loving him nor fail to keep my promise to him.
verses.textEnNasb: "But I will not withhold My favor from him, Nor deal falsely in My faithfulness.
verses.textEn: but I will not take my love from him, nor will I ever betray my faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 我必不违背我的约， 也不改变我口中所出的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必不违背我的约， 也不改变我口中所出的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必不背弃我的约， 也不改变我口中所出的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will not violate my covenant or alter what my lips have uttered.
verses.textEnEsv: I will not violate my covenant or alter the word that went forth from my lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: My covenant I will not break, Nor alter the word that has gone out of My lips.
verses.textEnNlt: No, I will not break my covenant; I will not take back a single word I said.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will not violate My covenant, Nor will I alter the utterance of My lips.
verses.textEn: I will not violate my covenant or alter what my lips have uttered.

verses.textZh: 我断然指着自己的圣洁起誓，说： ‘我决不向大卫说谎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我断然指着自己的圣洁起誓，说： ‘我决不向大卫说谎。
verses.textZhCuv: 我一次指着自己的圣洁起誓： 我决不向大卫说谎！
verses.textEnNiv: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness— and I will not lie to David—
verses.textEnEsv: Once for all I have sworn by my holiness; I will not lie to David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Once I have sworn by My holiness; I will not lie to David:
verses.textEnNlt: I have sworn an oath to David, and in my holiness I cannot lie:
verses.textEnNasb: " Once I have sworn by My holiness; I will not lie to David.
verses.textEn: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness— and I will not lie to David—

verses.textZh: 他的后裔必存到永远， 他的王位在我面前必像太阳长存，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的后裔必存到永远， 他的王位在我面前必像太阳长存，
verses.textZhCuv: 他的后裔要存到永远； 他的宝座在我面前如日之恒一般，
verses.textEnNiv: that his line will continue forever and his throne endure before me like the sun;
verses.textEnEsv: His offspring shall endure forever, his throne as long as the sun before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: His seed shall endure forever, And his throne as the sun before Me;
verses.textEnNlt: His dynasty will go on forever; his kingdom will endure as the sun.
verses.textEnNasb: "His descendants shall endure forever, And his throne as the sun before Me.
verses.textEn: that his line will continue forever and his throne endure before me like the sun;

verses.textZh: 又像月亮永远坚立， 作天上确实的见证。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又像月亮永远坚立， 作天上确实的见证。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 又如月亮永远坚立， 如天上确实的见证。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky."
verses.textEnEsv: Like the moon it shall be established forever, a faithful witness in the skies." Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be established forever like the moon, Even like the faithful witness in the sky." Selah
verses.textEnNlt: It will be as eternal as the moon, my faithful witness in the sky!" Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: "It shall be established forever like the moon, And a witness in the sky is faithful." Selah
verses.textEn: it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky."

verses.textZh: 你却恼怒你的受膏者， 丢掉弃绝他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你却恼怒你的受膏者， 丢掉弃绝他。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你恼怒你的受膏者， 就丢掉弃绝他。
verses.textEnNiv: But you have rejected, you have spurned, you have been very angry with your anointed one.
verses.textEnEsv: But now you have cast off and rejected; you are full of wrath against your anointed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You have cast off and abhorred, You have been furious with Your anointed.
verses.textEnNlt: But now you have rejected him and cast him off. You are angry with your anointed king.
verses.textEnNasb: But You have rejected and refused, You have been full of wrath against Your anointed.
verses.textEn: But you have rejected, you have spurned, you have been very angry with your anointed one.

verses.textZh: 你舍弃了和你仆人所立的约， 把他的冠冕玷污在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你舍弃了和你仆人所立的约， 把他的冠冕玷污在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你厌恶了与仆人所立的约， 将他的冠冕践踏于地。
verses.textEnNiv: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: You have renounced the covenant with your servant; you have defiled his crown in the dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have renounced the covenant of Your servant; You have profaned his crown bycastingit to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: You have renounced your covenant with him; you have thrown his crown in the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: You have repudiated the covenant of Your servant; You have profaned his crown in the dust.
verses.textEn: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.

verses.textZh: 你拆毁了他的一切城墙， 使他的堡垒成废堆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你拆毁了他的一切城墙， 使他的堡垒成废堆。
verses.textZhCuv: 你拆毁了他一切的篱笆， 使他的保障变为荒场。
verses.textEnNiv: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.
verses.textEnEsv: You have breached all his walls; you have laid his strongholds in ruins.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have broken down all his hedges; You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
verses.textEnNlt: You have broken down the walls protecting him and ruined every fort defending him.
verses.textEnNasb: You have broken down all his walls; You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
verses.textEn: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.

verses.textZh: 过路的都抢掠他， 他成了邻国的人羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过路的都抢掠他， 他成了邻国的人羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡过路的人都抢夺他； 他成为邻邦的羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: All who pass by have plundered him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.
verses.textEnEsv: All who pass by plunder him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.
verses.textEnNkjv: All who pass by the way plunder him; He is a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who comes along has robbed him, and he has become a joke to his neighbors.
verses.textEnNasb: All who pass along the way plunder him; He has become a disgrace to his neighbors.
verses.textEn: All who pass by have plundered him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.

verses.textZh: 你高举了他敌人的右手， 使他所有的仇敌欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你高举了他敌人的右手， 使他所有的仇敌欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你高举了他敌人的右手； 你叫他一切的仇敌欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.
verses.textEnEsv: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: You have strengthened his enemies and made them all rejoice.
verses.textEnNasb: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
verses.textEn: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.

verses.textZh: 你使他的刀剑卷刃， 使他在战场上站立不住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使他的刀剑卷刃， 使他在战场上站立不住。
verses.textZhCuv: 你叫他的刀剑卷刃， 叫他在争战之中站立不住。
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, you have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: You have also turned back the edge of his sword, and you have not made him stand in battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have also turned back the edge of his sword, And have not sustained him in the battle.
verses.textEnNlt: You have made his sword useless and refused to help him in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: You also turn back the edge of his sword, And have not made him stand in battle.
verses.textEn: Indeed, you have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.

verses.textZh: 你使他的光辉消失， 把他的王位推翻 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使他的光辉消失， 把他的王位推翻 。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使他的光辉止息， 将他的宝座推倒于地。
verses.textEnNiv: You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: You have made his splendor to cease and cast his throne to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have made his glory cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: You have ended his splendor and overturned his throne.
verses.textEnNasb: You have put an end to his splendor And cast his throne to the ground.
verses.textEn: You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.

verses.textZh: 你减少了他青春的日子， 使他披上耻辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你减少了他青春的日子， 使他披上耻辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你减少他青年的日子， 又使他蒙羞。 （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame.
verses.textEnEsv: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with shame. Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: The days of his youth You have shortened; You have covered him with shame. Selah
verses.textEnNlt: You have made him old before his time and publicly disgraced him. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: You have shortened the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
verses.textEn: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！这要到几时呢？ 你要永远隐藏自己吗？ 你的烈怒像火一般焚烧，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！这要到几时呢？ 你要永远隐藏自己吗？ 你的烈怒像火一般焚烧，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，这要到几时呢？ 你要将自己隐藏到永远吗？ 你的忿怒如火焚烧要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long, Lord ? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?
verses.textEnEsv: How long, O Lord ? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?
verses.textEnNkjv: How long, Lord? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath burn like fire?
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , how long will this go on? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your anger burn like fire?
verses.textEnNasb: How long, Lord? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath burn like fire?
verses.textEn: How long, Lord ? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?

verses.textZh: 求你记念我的一生多么短暂， 你创造的世人是多么虚幻呢！
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你记念我的一生多么短暂， 你创造的世人是多么虚幻呢！
verses.textZhCuv: 求你想念我的时候是何等的短少； 你创造世人，要使他们归何等的虚空呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Remember how fleeting is my life. For what futility you have created all humanity!
verses.textEnEsv: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity you have created all the children of man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember how short my time is; For what futility have You created all the children of men?
verses.textEnNlt: Remember how short my life is, how empty and futile this human existence!
verses.textEnNasb: Remember what my lifespan is; For what futility You have created all the sons of mankind!
verses.textEn: Remember how fleeting is my life. For what futility you have created all humanity!

verses.textZh: 有哪一个人能长活不死， 能救自己的性命脱离阴间的权势呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有哪一个人能长活不死， 能救自己的性命脱离阴间的权势呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能常活免死、 救他的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄呢？ （细拉）
verses.textEnNiv: Who can live and not see death, or who can escape the power of the grave?
verses.textEnEsv: What man can live and never see death? Who can deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
verses.textEnNkjv: What man can live and not see death? Can he deliver his life from the power of the grave? Selah
verses.textEnNlt: No one can live forever; all will die. No one can escape the power of the grave. Interlude
verses.textEnNasb: What man can live and not see death? Can he save his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
verses.textEn: Who can live and not see death, or who can escape the power of the grave?

verses.textZh: 主啊！你从前指着你的信实向大卫起誓要施的慈爱， 现今在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！你从前指着你的信实向大卫起誓要施的慈爱， 现今在哪里呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，你从前凭你的信实 向大卫立誓要施行的慈爱在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Lord, where is your former great love, which in your faithfulness you swore to David?
verses.textEnEsv: Lord, where is your steadfast love of old, which by your faithfulness you swore to David?
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, where are Your former lovingkindnesses, Which You swore to David in Your truth?
verses.textEnNlt: Lord, where is your unfailing love? You promised it to David with a faithful pledge.
verses.textEnNasb: Where are Your former acts of favor, Lord, Which You swore to David in Your faithfulness?
verses.textEn: Lord, where is your former great love, which in your faithfulness you swore to David?

verses.textZh: 主啊！求你记念你仆人所受的羞辱， 记念我心里 承担着万民的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！求你记念你仆人所受的羞辱， 记念我心里 承担着万民的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，求你记念仆人们所受的羞辱， 记念我怎样将一切强盛民的羞辱存在我怀里。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember, Lord, how your servant has been mocked, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the nations,
verses.textEnEsv: Remember, O Lord, how your servants are mocked, and how I bear in my heart the insults of all the many nations,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of Your servants— How I bear in my bosom thereproachof all the many peoples,
verses.textEnNlt: Consider, Lord, how your servants are disgraced! I carry in my heart the insults of so many people.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember, Lord, the taunt against Your servants; How I carry in my heart the taunts of all the many peoples,
verses.textEn: Remember, Lord, how your servant has been mocked, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the nations,

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的仇敌用这羞辱羞辱了你的仆人， 羞辱了你受膏者的脚踪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的仇敌用这羞辱羞辱了你的仆人， 羞辱了你受膏者的脚踪。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌用这羞辱羞辱了你的仆人， 羞辱了你受膏者的脚踪。
verses.textEnNiv: the taunts with which your enemies, Lord , have mocked, with which they have mocked every step of your anointed one.
verses.textEnEsv: with which your enemies mock, O Lord , with which they mock the footsteps of your anointed.
verses.textEnNkjv: With which Your enemies have reproached, O Lord, With which they have reproached the footsteps of Your anointed.
verses.textEnNlt: Your enemies have mocked me, O Lord ; they mock your anointed king wherever he goes.
verses.textEnNasb: With which Your enemies have taunted, Lord, With which they have taunted the footsteps of Your anointed.
verses.textEn: the taunts with which your enemies, Lord , have mocked, with which they have mocked every step of your anointed one.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，直到永远！ 阿们，阿们！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是应当称颂的，直到永远！ 阿们，阿们！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是应当称颂的，直到永远。 阿们！阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord forever! Amen and Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord forever! Amen and Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord forevermore! Amen and Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord forever! Amen and amen!
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord forever! Amen and Amen.
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord forever! Amen and Amen.

verses.textZh: 神人摩西的祈祷。 主啊！你世世代代作我们的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人摩西的祈祷。 主啊！你世世代代作我们的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，你世世代代作我们的居所。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: Lord, you have been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, You have been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord, through all the generations you have been our home!
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, You have been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.textEn: Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.

verses.textZh: 群山尚未生出， 大地和世界你未曾造成， 从永远到永远，你是神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群山尚未生出， 大地和世界你未曾造成， 从永远到永远，你是神。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸山未曾生出， 地与世界你未曾造成， 从亘古到永远，你是神。
verses.textEnNiv: Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the whole world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.
verses.textEnEsv: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever you had formed the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever You had formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, You are God.
verses.textEnNlt: Before the mountains were born, before you gave birth to the earth and the world, from beginning to end, you are God.
verses.textEnNasb: Before the mountains were born Or You gave birth to the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, You are God.
verses.textEn: Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the whole world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.

verses.textZh: 你使人归回尘土， 说："世人哪！你们要归回尘土。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使人归回尘土， 说："世人哪！你们要归回尘土。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你使人归于尘土，说： 你们世人要归回。
verses.textEnNiv: You turn people back to dust, saying, "Return to dust, you mortals."
verses.textEnEsv: You return man to dust and say, "Return, O children of man!"
verses.textEnNkjv: You turn man to destruction, And say, "Return, O children of men."
verses.textEnNlt: You turn people back to dust, saying, "Return to dust, you mortals!"
verses.textEnNasb: You turn mortals back into dust And say, "Return, you sons of mankind."
verses.textEn: You turn people back to dust, saying, "Return to dust, you mortals."

verses.textZh: 在你看来， 千年好象刚过去了的昨天， 又像夜里的一更。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你看来， 千年好象刚过去了的昨天， 又像夜里的一更。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你看来，千年如已过的昨日， 又如夜间的一更。
verses.textEnNiv: A thousand years in your sight are like a day that has just gone by, or like a watch in the night.
verses.textEnEsv: For a thousand years in your sight are but as yesterday when it is past, or as a watch in the night.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a thousand years in Your sight Are like yesterday when it is past, And like a watch in the night.
verses.textEnNlt: For you, a thousand years are as a passing day, as brief as a few night hours.
verses.textEnNasb: For a thousand years in Your sight Are like yesterday when it passes by, Or like a watch in the night.
verses.textEn: A thousand years in your sight are like a day that has just gone by, or like a watch in the night.

verses.textZh: 你使世人消逝，像被洪水冲去； 他们好象睡了一觉； 他们又像在早晨生长的草，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使世人消逝，像被洪水冲去； 他们好象睡了一觉； 他们又像在早晨生长的草，
verses.textZhCuv: 你叫他们如水冲去； 他们如睡一觉。 早晨，他们如生长的草，
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you sweep people away in the sleep of death— they are like the new grass of the morning:
verses.textEnEsv: You sweep them away as with a flood; they are like a dream, like grass that is renewed in the morning:
verses.textEnNkjv: You carry them away like a flood; Theyare like a sleep. In the morning they are like grass which grows up:
verses.textEnNlt: You sweep people away like dreams that disappear. They are like grass that springs up in the morning.
verses.textEnNasb: You have swept them away like a flood, they fall asleep; In the morning they are like grass that sprouts anew.
verses.textEn: Yet you sweep people away in the sleep of death— they are like the new grass of the morning:

verses.textZh: 早晨发芽生长， 晚上就凋萎枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 早晨发芽生长， 晚上就凋萎枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 早晨发芽生长， 晚上割下枯干。
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning it springs up new, but by evening it is dry and withered.
verses.textEnEsv: in the morning it flourishes and is renewed; in the evening it fades and withers.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the morning it flourishes and grows up; In the evening it is cut down and withers.
verses.textEnNlt: In the morning it blooms and flourishes, but by evening it is dry and withered.
verses.textEnNasb: In the morning it flourishes and sprouts anew; Toward evening it wilts and withers away.
verses.textEn: In the morning it springs up new, but by evening it is dry and withered.

verses.textZh: 我们因你的怒气而消灭， 因你的烈怒而惊恐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们因你的怒气而消灭， 因你的烈怒而惊恐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们因你的怒气而消灭， 因你的忿怒而惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: We are consumed by your anger and terrified by your indignation.
verses.textEnEsv: For we are brought to an end by your anger; by your wrath we are dismayed.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we have been consumed by Your anger, And by Your wrath we are terrified.
verses.textEnNlt: We wither beneath your anger; we are overwhelmed by your fury.
verses.textEnNasb: For we have been consumed by Your anger, And we have been terrified by Your wrath.
verses.textEn: We are consumed by your anger and terrified by your indignation.

verses.textZh: 你把我们的罪孽摆在你面前， 把我们的隐恶摆在你脸光之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把我们的罪孽摆在你面前， 把我们的隐恶摆在你脸光之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 你将我们的罪孽摆在你面前， 将我们的隐恶摆在你面光之中。
verses.textEnNiv: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
verses.textEnEsv: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have set our iniquities before You, Our secret sins in the light of Your countenance.
verses.textEnNlt: You spread out our sins before you— our secret sins—and you see them all.
verses.textEnNasb: You have placed our guilty deeds before You, Our hidden sins in the light of Your presence.
verses.textEn: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

verses.textZh: 我们一生的日子都在你的震怒中消逝， 我们度尽的年岁好象一声叹息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们一生的日子都在你的震怒中消逝， 我们度尽的年岁好象一声叹息。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们经过的日子都在你震怒之下； 我们度尽的年岁好像一声叹息。
verses.textEnNiv: All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.
verses.textEnEsv: For all our days pass away under your wrath; we bring our years to an end like a sigh.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all our days have passed away in Your wrath; We finish our years like a sigh.
verses.textEnNlt: We live our lives beneath your wrath, ending our years with a groan.
verses.textEnNasb: For all our days have dwindled away in Your fury; We have finished our years like a sigh.
verses.textEn: All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.

verses.textZh: 我们一生的年日是七十岁， 如果强壮，可到八十岁， 但其中可夸耀的，不过是劳苦愁烦； 我们的年日转眼即逝， 我们也如飞而去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们一生的年日是七十岁， 如果强壮，可到八十岁， 但其中可夸耀的，不过是劳苦愁烦； 我们的年日转眼即逝， 我们也如飞而去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们一生的年日是七十岁， 若是强壮可到八十岁； 但其中所矜夸的不过是劳苦愁烦， 转眼成空，我们便如飞而去。
verses.textEnNiv: Our days may come to seventy years, or eighty, if our strength endures; yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
verses.textEnEsv: The years of our life are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty; yet their span is but toil and trouble; they are soon gone, and we fly away.
verses.textEnNkjv: The days of our lives are seventy years; And if by reason of strength theyare eighty years, Yet their boast is only labor and sorrow; For it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.textEnNlt: Seventy years are given to us! Some even live to eighty. But even the best years are filled with pain and trouble; soon they disappear, and we fly away.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the days of our life, they contain seventy years, Or if due to strength, eighty years, Yet their pride is only trouble and tragedy; For it quickly passes, and we disappear.
verses.textEn: Our days may come to seventy years, or eighty, if our strength endures; yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

verses.textZh: 谁晓得你怒气的威力， 谁按着你该受的敬畏晓得你的忿怒呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁晓得你怒气的威力， 谁按着你该受的敬畏晓得你的忿怒呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁晓得你怒气的权势？ 谁按着你该受的敬畏晓得你的忿怒呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If only we knew the power of your anger! Your wrath is as great as the fear that is your due.
verses.textEnEsv: Who considers the power of your anger, and your wrath according to the fear of you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who knows the power of Your anger? For as the fear of You, sois Your wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: Who can comprehend the power of your anger? Your wrath is as awesome as the fear you deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: Who understands the power of Your anger And Your fury, according to the fear that is due You?
verses.textEn: If only we knew the power of your anger! Your wrath is as great as the fear that is your due.

verses.textZh: 求你教导我们怎样数算自己的日子， 好使我们得着智慧的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你教导我们怎样数算自己的日子， 好使我们得着智慧的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子， 好叫我们得着智慧的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verses.textEnEsv: So teach us to number our days that we may get a heart of wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: So teach us to number our days, That we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach us to realize the brevity of life, so that we may grow in wisdom.
verses.textEnNasb: So teach us to number our days, That we may present to You a heart of wisdom.
verses.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！要到几时呢？求你回心转意， 求你怜恤你的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！要到几时呢？求你回心转意， 求你怜恤你的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我们要等到几时呢？ 求你转回，为你的仆人后悔。
verses.textEnNiv: Relent, Lord ! How long will it be? Have compassion on your servants.
verses.textEnEsv: Return, O Lord ! How long? Have pity on your servants!
verses.textEnNkjv: Return, O Lord! How long? And have compassion on Your servants.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , come back to us! How long will you delay? Take pity on your servants!
verses.textEnNasb: Do return, Lord; how long will it be? And be sorry for Your servants.
verses.textEn: Relent, Lord ! How long will it be? Have compassion on your servants.

verses.textZh: 求你使我们早晨饱尝你的慈爱， 好使我们一生一世欢呼喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使我们早晨饱尝你的慈爱， 好使我们一生一世欢呼喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使我们早早饱得你的慈爱， 好叫我们一生一世欢呼喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
verses.textEnEsv: Satisfy us in the morning with your steadfast love, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, satisfy us early with Your mercy, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days!
verses.textEnNlt: Satisfy us each morning with your unfailing love, so we may sing for joy to the end of our lives.
verses.textEnNasb: Satisfy us in the morning with Your graciousness, That we may sing for joy and rejoice all our days.
verses.textEn: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

verses.textZh: 你使我们受苦和遭难的年日有多久， 求你使我们喜乐的日子也有多久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使我们受苦和遭难的年日有多久， 求你使我们喜乐的日子也有多久。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你照着你使我们受苦的日子， 和我们遭难的年岁，叫我们喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, and for as many years as we have seen evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make us glad according to the days inwhich You have afflicted us, The years inwhich we have seen evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Give us gladness in proportion to our former misery! Replace the evil years with good.
verses.textEnNasb: Make us glad according to the days You have afflicted us, And the years we have seen evil.
verses.textEn: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen trouble.

verses.textZh: 愿你的作为向你的仆人彰显， 愿你的威严向他们的子孙显明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你的作为向你的仆人彰显， 愿你的威严向他们的子孙显明。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你的作为向你仆人显现； 愿你的荣耀向他们子孙显明。
verses.textEnNiv: May your deeds be shown to your servants, your splendor to their children.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your work be shown to your servants, and your glorious power to their children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Your work appear to Your servants, And Your glory to their children.
verses.textEnNlt: Let us, your servants, see you work again; let our children see your glory.
verses.textEnNasb: Let Your work appear to Your servants And Your majesty to their children.
verses.textEn: May your deeds be shown to your servants, your splendor to their children.

verses.textZh: 愿主我们的神的恩慈临到我们身上； 愿你为我们的缘故，坚立我们手所作的工； 我们手所作的工，愿你坚立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿主我们的神的恩慈临到我们身上； 愿你为我们的缘故，坚立我们手所作的工； 我们手所作的工，愿你坚立。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿主－我们神的荣美归于我们身上。 愿你坚立我们手所做的工； 我们手所做的工，愿你坚立。
verses.textEnNiv: May the favor of the Lord our God rest on us; establish the work of our hands for us— yes, establish the work of our hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us, and establish the work of our hands upon us; yes, establish the work of our hands!
verses.textEnNkjv: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us, And establish the work of our hands for us; Yes, establish the work of our hands.
verses.textEnNlt: And may the Lord our God show us his approval and make our efforts successful. Yes, make our efforts successful!
verses.textEnNasb: May the kindness of the Lord our God be upon us; And confirm for us the work of our hands; Yes, confirm the work of our hands.
verses.textEn: May the favor of the Lord our God rest on us; establish the work of our hands for us— yes, establish the work of our hands.

verses.textZh: 住在至高者的隐密处的， 必在全能者的荫庇下安居。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在至高者的隐密处的， 必在全能者的荫庇下安居。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在至高者隐密处的， 必住在全能者的荫下。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who live in the shelter of the Most High will find rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.textEnNasb: One who dwells in the shelter of the Most High Will lodge in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.textEn: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.textZh: 我要对耶和华说： "你是我的避难所，我的保障， 你是我的神，我所倚靠的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要对耶和华说： "你是我的避难所，我的保障， 你是我的神，我所倚靠的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要论到耶和华说： 他是我的避难所，是我的山寨， 是我的神，是我所倚靠的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will say of the Lord , "He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust."
verses.textEnEsv: I will say to the Lord , "My refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will say of the Lord, "He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in Him I will trust."
verses.textEnNlt: This I declare about the Lord : He alone is my refuge, my place of safety; he is my God, and I trust him.
verses.textEnNasb: I will say to the Lord, "My refuge and my fortress, My God, in whom I trust!"
verses.textEn: I will say of the Lord , "He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust."

verses.textZh: 他必救你脱离捕鸟的人的网罗， 脱离致命的瘟疫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必救你脱离捕鸟的人的网罗， 脱离致命的瘟疫。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必救你脱离捕鸟人的网罗 和毒害的瘟疫。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely he will save you from the fowler’s snare and from the deadly pestilence.
verses.textEnEsv: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler and from the deadly pestilence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely He shall deliver you from the snare of the fowler And from the perilous pestilence.
verses.textEnNlt: For he will rescue you from every trap and protect you from deadly disease.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is He who rescues you from the net of the trapper And from the deadly plague.
verses.textEn: Surely he will save you from the fowler’s snare and from the deadly pestilence.

verses.textZh: 他必用自己的羽毛遮盖你， 你要投靠在他的翅膀底下； 他的信实象盾牌，像坚垒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必用自己的羽毛遮盖你， 你要投靠在他的翅膀底下； 他的信实象盾牌，像坚垒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你； 你要投靠在他的翅膀底下； 他的诚实是大小的盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.
verses.textEnEsv: He will cover you with his pinions, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness is a shield and buckler.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall cover you with His feathers, And under His wings you shall take refuge; His truth shallbeyour shield and buckler.
verses.textEnNlt: He will cover you with his feathers. He will shelter you with his wings. His faithful promises are your armor and protection.
verses.textEnNasb: He will cover you with His pinions, And under His wings you may take refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and wall.
verses.textEn: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

verses.textZh: 你不必害怕黑夜的惊恐， 或是白日的飞箭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不必害怕黑夜的惊恐， 或是白日的飞箭；
verses.textZhCuv: 你必不怕黑夜的惊骇， 或是白日飞的箭，
verses.textEnNiv: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
verses.textEnEsv: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, Nor of the arrow that flies by day,
verses.textEnNlt: Do not be afraid of the terrors of the night, nor the arrow that flies in the day.
verses.textEnNasb: You will not be afraid of the terror by night, Or of the arrow that flies by day;
verses.textEn: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,

verses.textZh: 也不必害怕黑暗中流行的瘟疫， 或是在正午把人毁灭的毒病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不必害怕黑暗中流行的瘟疫， 或是在正午把人毁灭的毒病。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫， 或是午间灭人的毒病。
verses.textEnNiv: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the plague that destroys at midday.
verses.textEnEsv: nor the pestilence that stalks in darkness, nor the destruction that wastes at noonday.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, Nor of the destruction that lays waste at noonday.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not dread the disease that stalks in darkness, nor the disaster that strikes at midday.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the plague that stalks in darkness, Or of the destruction that devastates at noon.
verses.textEn: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the plague that destroys at midday.

verses.textZh: 虽有千人仆倒在你的左边， 万人仆倒在你的右边， 但灾害必不临近你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽有千人仆倒在你的左边， 万人仆倒在你的右边， 但灾害必不临近你。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有千人仆倒在你旁边， 万人仆倒在你右边， 这灾却不得临近你。
verses.textEnNiv: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
verses.textEnEsv: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
verses.textEnNkjv: A thousand may fall at your side, And ten thousand at your right hand; But it shall not come near you.
verses.textEnNlt: Though a thousand fall at your side, though ten thousand are dying around you, these evils will not touch you.
verses.textEnNasb: A thousand may fall at your side And ten thousand at your right hand, But it shall not approach you.
verses.textEn: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.

verses.textZh: 不过你要亲眼观看， 看见恶人遭报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过你要亲眼观看， 看见恶人遭报。
verses.textZhCuv: 你惟亲眼观看， 见恶人遭报。
verses.textEnNiv: You will only observe with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: You will only look with your eyes and see the recompense of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only with your eyes shall you look, And see the reward of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: Just open your eyes, and see how the wicked are punished.
verses.textEnNasb: You will only look on with your eyes And see the retaliation against the wicked.
verses.textEn: You will only observe with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 你既然把耶和华当作自己的避难所， 把至高者当作自己的居所，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你既然把耶和华当作自己的避难所， 把至高者当作自己的居所，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是我的避难所； 你已将至高者当你的居所，
verses.textEnNiv: If you say, "The Lord is my refuge," and you make the Most High your dwelling,
verses.textEnEsv: Because you have made the Lord your dwelling place— the Most High, who is my refuge —
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you have made the Lord, whois my refuge, Even the Most High, your dwelling place,
verses.textEnNlt: If you make the Lord your refuge, if you make the Most High your shelter,
verses.textEnNasb: For you have made the Lord, my refuge, The Most High, your dwelling place.
verses.textEn: If you say, "The Lord is my refuge," and you make the Most High your dwelling,

verses.textZh: 祸患必不临到你， 灾害必不临近你的帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祸患必不临到你， 灾害必不临近你的帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 祸患必不临到你， 灾害也不挨近你的帐棚。
verses.textEnNiv: no harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.
verses.textEnEsv: no evil shall be allowed to befall you, no plague come near your tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: No evil shall befall you, Nor shall any plague come near your dwelling;
verses.textEnNlt: no evil will conquer you; no plague will come near your home.
verses.textEnNasb: No evil will happen to you, Nor will any plague come near your tent.
verses.textEn: no harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.

verses.textZh: 因为他为了你，会吩咐自己的使者， 在你所行的一切路上保护你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他为了你，会吩咐自己的使者， 在你所行的一切路上保护你。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他要为你吩咐他的使者， 在你行的一切道路上保护你。
verses.textEnNiv: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;
verses.textEnEsv: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He shall give His angels charge over you, To keep you in all your ways.
verses.textEnNlt: For he will order his angels to protect you wherever you go.
verses.textEnNasb: For He will give His angels orders concerning you, To protect you in all your ways.
verses.textEn: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;

verses.textZh: 他们必用手托住你， 免得你的脚碰到石头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必用手托住你， 免得你的脚碰到石头。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要用手托着你， 免得你的脚碰在石头上。
verses.textEnNiv: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
verses.textEnEsv: On their hands they will bear you up, lest you strike your foot against a stone.
verses.textEnNkjv: In their hands they shall bear you up, Lest you dash your foot against a stone.
verses.textEnNlt: They will hold you up with their hands so you won’t even hurt your foot on a stone.
verses.textEnNasb: On their hands they will lift you up, So that you do not strike your foot against a stone.
verses.textEn: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

verses.textZh: 你必践踏狮子和虺蛇。 你必踏碎少壮狮子和大蛇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必践踏狮子和虺蛇。 你必踏碎少壮狮子和大蛇。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要踹在狮子和虺蛇的身上， 践踏少壮狮子和大蛇。
verses.textEnNiv: You will tread on the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.
verses.textEnEsv: You will tread on the lion and the adder; the young lion and the serpent you will trample underfoot.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall tread upon the lion and the cobra, The young lion and the serpent you shall trample underfoot.
verses.textEnNlt: You will trample upon lions and cobras; you will crush fierce lions and serpents under your feet!
verses.textEnNasb: You will walk upon the lion and cobra, You will trample the young lion and the serpent.
verses.textEn: You will tread on the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："因为他恋慕我，我必搭救他； 因为他认识我的名，我必保护他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："因为他恋慕我，我必搭救他； 因为他认识我的名，我必保护他。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：因为他专心爱我，我就要搭救他； 因为他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高处。
verses.textEnNiv: "Because he loves me," says the Lord , "I will rescue him; I will protect him, for he acknowledges my name.
verses.textEnEsv: "Because he holds fast to me in love, I will deliver him; I will protect him, because he knows my name.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because he has set his love upon Me, therefore I will deliver him; I will set him on high, because he has known My name.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "I will rescue those who love me. I will protect those who trust in my name.
verses.textEnNasb: "Because he has loved Me, I will save him; I will set him securely on high, because he has known My name.
verses.textEn: "Because he loves me," says the Lord , "I will rescue him; I will protect him, for he acknowledges my name.

verses.textZh: 他求告我，我必应允他； 他在患难中，我必与他同在； 我必拯救他，使他得尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他求告我，我必应允他； 他在患难中，我必与他同在； 我必拯救他，使他得尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若求告我，我就应允他； 他在急难中，我要与他同在； 我要搭救他，使他尊贵。
verses.textEnNiv: He will call on me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.
verses.textEnEsv: When he calls to me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him and honor him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I willbe with him in trouble; I will deliver him and honor him.
verses.textEnNlt: When they call on me, I will answer; I will be with them in trouble. I will rescue and honor them.
verses.textEnNasb: "He will call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him and honor him.
verses.textEn: He will call on me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.

verses.textZh: 我必使他得享长寿， 又向他显明我的救恩。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使他得享长寿， 又向他显明我的救恩。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使他足享长寿， 将我的救恩显明给他。
verses.textEnNiv: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation."
verses.textEnEsv: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation."
verses.textEnNkjv: With long life I will satisfy him, And show him My salvation."
verses.textEnNlt: I will reward them with a long life and give them my salvation."
verses.textEnNasb: "I will satisfy him with a long life, And show him My salvation."
verses.textEn: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation."

verses.textZh: 诗一首，安息日的歌。 称谢耶和华， 歌颂你至高者的名；
verses.textZhCnvs: 诗一首，安息日的歌。 称谢耶和华， 歌颂你至高者的名；
verses.textZhCuv: 称谢耶和华！ 歌颂你至高者的名！
verses.textEnNiv: It is good to praise the Lord and make music to your name, O Most High,
verses.textEnEsv: It is good to give thanks to the Lord , to sing praises to your name, O Most High;
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis good to give thanks to the Lord, And to sing praises to Your name, O Most High;
verses.textEnNlt: It is good to give thanks to the Lord , to sing praises to the Most High.
verses.textEnNasb: It is good to give thanks to the Lord And to sing praises to Your name, Most High;
verses.textEn: It is good to praise the Lord and make music to your name, O Most High,

verses.textZh: 早晨传扬你的慈爱， 夜间传讲你的信实；
verses.textZhCnvs: 早晨传扬你的慈爱， 夜间传讲你的信实；
verses.textZhCuv: 用琴弹幽雅的声音， 早晨传扬你的慈爱； 每夜传扬你的信实。 这本为美事。
verses.textEnNiv: proclaiming your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night,
verses.textEnEsv: to declare your steadfast love in the morning, and your faithfulness by night,
verses.textEnNkjv: To declare Your lovingkindness in the morning, And Your faithfulness every night,
verses.textEnNlt: It is good to proclaim your unfailing love in the morning, your faithfulness in the evening,
verses.textEnNasb: To declare Your goodness in the morning And Your faithfulness by night,
verses.textEn: proclaiming your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night,

verses.textZh: 弹奏十弦的乐器和瑟， 又用琴弹出美妙的声音， 这是多么美的事 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弹奏十弦的乐器和瑟， 又用琴弹出美妙的声音， 这是多么美的事 。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你－耶和华藉着你的作为叫我高兴， 我要因你手的工作欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.
verses.textEnEsv: to the music of the lute and the harp, to the melody of the lyre.
verses.textEnNkjv: On an instrument of ten strings, On the lute, And on the harp, With harmonious sound.
verses.textEnNlt: accompanied by a ten-stringed instrument, a harp, and the melody of a lyre.
verses.textEnNasb: With the ten-stringed lute and with the harp, With resounding music on the lyre.
verses.textEn: to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你借着你的作为使我欢喜， 我要因你手的工作欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你借着你的作为使我欢喜， 我要因你手的工作欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的工作何其大！ 你的心思极其深！
verses.textEnNiv: For you make me glad by your deeds, Lord ; I sing for joy at what your hands have done.
verses.textEnEsv: For you, O Lord , have made me glad by your work; at the works of your hands I sing for joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You, Lord, have made me glad through Your work; I will triumph in the works of Your hands.
verses.textEnNlt: You thrill me, Lord , with all you have done for me! I sing for joy because of what you have done.
verses.textEnNasb: For You, Lord, have made me joyful by what You have done, I will sing for joy over the works of Your hands.
verses.textEn: For you make me glad by your deeds, Lord ; I sing for joy at what your hands have done.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的工作多么伟大， 你的心思极为深奥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的工作多么伟大， 你的心思极为深奥。
verses.textZhCuv: 畜类人不晓得； 愚顽人也不明白。
verses.textEnNiv: How great are your works, Lord , how profound your thoughts!
verses.textEnEsv: How great are your works, O Lord ! Your thoughts are very deep!
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, how great are Your works! Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , what great works you do! And how deep are your thoughts.
verses.textEnNasb: How great are Your works, Lord! Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.textEn: How great are your works, Lord , how profound your thoughts!

verses.textZh: 无理性的人不晓得， 愚昧的人不明白这事：
verses.textZhCnvs: 无理性的人不晓得， 愚昧的人不明白这事：
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人茂盛如草， 一切作孽之人发旺的时候， 正是他们要灭亡， 直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: Senseless people do not know, fools do not understand,
verses.textEnEsv: The stupid man cannot know; the fool cannot understand this:
verses.textEnNkjv: A senseless man does not know, Nor does a fool understand this.
verses.textEnNlt: Only a simpleton would not know, and only a fool would not understand this:
verses.textEnNasb: A stupid person has no knowledge, Nor does a foolish person understand this:
verses.textEn: Senseless people do not know, fools do not understand,

verses.textZh: 恶人虽好象草一样繁茂， 所有作孽的人虽然兴旺， 他们都要永远灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人虽好象草一样繁茂， 所有作孽的人虽然兴旺， 他们都要永远灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟你－耶和华是至高， 直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
verses.textEnEsv: that though the wicked sprout like grass and all evildoers flourish, they are doomed to destruction forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: When the wicked spring up like grass, And when all the workers of iniquity flourish, Itis that they may be destroyed forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Though the wicked sprout like weeds and evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
verses.textEnNasb: When the wicked sprouted up like grass And all who did injustice flourished, It was only that they might be destroyed forevermore.
verses.textEn: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

verses.textZh: 但你耶和华永远是至高的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你耶和华永远是至高的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌都要灭亡； 一切作孽的也要离散。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, Lord , are forever exalted.
verses.textEnEsv: but you, O Lord , are on high forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, Lord, are on high forevermore.
verses.textEnNlt: But you, O Lord , will be exalted forever.
verses.textEnNasb: But You, Lord, are on high forever.
verses.textEn: But you, Lord , are forever exalted.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的仇敌必灭亡， 你的仇敌必定灭亡； 所有作孽的都必被分散。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的仇敌必灭亡， 你的仇敌必定灭亡； 所有作孽的都必被分散。
verses.textZhCuv: 你却高举了我的角，如野牛的角； 我是被新油膏了的。
verses.textEnNiv: For surely your enemies, Lord , surely your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, your enemies, O Lord , for behold, your enemies shall perish; all evildoers shall be scattered.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, Your enemies, O Lord, For behold, Your enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.textEnNlt: Your enemies, Lord , will surely perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: For, behold, Your enemies, Lord, For, behold, Your enemies will perish; All who do injustice will be scattered.
verses.textEn: For surely your enemies, Lord , surely your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

verses.textZh: 你却高举了我的角，像野牛的角； 你用新油膏抹我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你却高举了我的角，像野牛的角； 你用新油膏抹我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我眼睛看见仇敌遭报； 我耳朵听见那些起来攻击我的恶人受罚。
verses.textEnNiv: You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; fine oils have been poured on me.
verses.textEnEsv: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox; you have poured over me fresh oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: But my horn You have exalted like a wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.
verses.textEnNlt: But you have made me as strong as a wild ox. You have anointed me with the finest oil.
verses.textEnNasb: But You have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.
verses.textEn: You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; fine oils have been poured on me.

verses.textZh: 我亲眼看见那些窥伺我的人遭报， 我亲耳听见那些起来攻击我的恶人受罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我亲眼看见那些窥伺我的人遭报， 我亲耳听见那些起来攻击我的恶人受罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人要发旺如棕树， 生长如黎巴嫩的香柏树。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes have seen the defeat of my adversaries; my ears have heard the rout of my wicked foes.
verses.textEnEsv: My eyes have seen the downfall of my enemies; my ears have heard the doom of my evil assailants.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eye also has seen mydesire on my enemies; My ears hear mydesire on the wicked Who rise up against me.
verses.textEnNlt: My eyes have seen the downfall of my enemies; my ears have heard the defeat of my wicked opponents.
verses.textEnNasb: And my eye has looked at my enemies, My ears hear of the evildoers who rise up against me.
verses.textEn: My eyes have seen the defeat of my adversaries; my ears have heard the rout of my wicked foes.

verses.textZh: 义人必像棕树一样繁茂， 像黎巴嫩的香柏树一样高耸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人必像棕树一样繁茂， 像黎巴嫩的香柏树一样高耸。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们栽于耶和华的殿中， 发旺在我们神的院里。
verses.textEnNiv: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;
verses.textEnEsv: The righteous flourish like the palm tree and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree, He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.textEnNlt: But the godly will flourish like palm trees and grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: The righteous person will flourish like the palm tree, He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.textEn: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;

verses.textZh: 他们栽在耶和华的殿中， 在我们神的院子里繁茂生长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们栽在耶和华的殿中， 在我们神的院子里繁茂生长。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们年老的时候仍要结果子， 要满了汁浆而常发青，
verses.textEnNiv: planted in the house of the Lord , they will flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: They are planted in the house of the Lord ; they flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who are planted in the house of the Lord Shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.textEnNlt: For they are transplanted to the Lord ’s own house. They flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: Planted in the house of the Lord, They will flourish in the courtyards of our God.
verses.textEn: planted in the house of the Lord , they will flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.textZh: 他们年老的时候仍要结果子， 经常保持茂盛青翠，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们年老的时候仍要结果子， 经常保持茂盛青翠，
verses.textZhCuv: 好显明耶和华是正直的。 他是我的磐石，在他毫无不义。
verses.textEnNiv: They will still bear fruit in old age, they will stay fresh and green,
verses.textEnEsv: They still bear fruit in old age; they are ever full of sap and green,
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall still bear fruit in old age; They shall be fresh and flourishing,
verses.textEnNlt: Even in old age they will still produce fruit; they will remain vital and green.
verses.textEnNasb: They will still yield fruit in advanced age; They will be full of sap and very green,
verses.textEn: They will still bear fruit in old age, they will stay fresh and green,

verses.textZh: 好显明耶和华是正直的； 他是我的盘石，在他里面没有不义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好显明耶和华是正直的； 他是我的盘石，在他里面没有不义。
verses.textZhCuv: 好显明耶和华是正直的； 他是我的盘石，在他里面没有不义。
verses.textEnNiv: proclaiming, "The Lord is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in him."
verses.textEnEsv: to declare that the Lord is upright; he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: To declare that the Lord is upright; Heis my rock, and thereis no unrighteousness in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: They will declare, "The Lord is just! He is my rock! There is no evil in him!"
verses.textEnNasb: To declare that the Lord is just; He is my rock, and there is no malice in Him.
verses.textEn: proclaiming, "The Lord is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in him."

verses.textZh: 耶和华作王，他以威严为衣； 耶和华以威严为衣，以能力束腰， 世界就得以坚立，永不动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华作王，他以威严为衣； 耶和华以威严为衣，以能力束腰， 世界就得以坚立，永不动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华作王！ 他以威严为衣穿上； 耶和华以能力为衣，以能力束腰， 世界就坚定，不得动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord reigns, he is robed in majesty; the Lord is robed in majesty and armed with strength; indeed, the world is established, firm and secure.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord reigns; he is robed in majesty; the Lord is robed; he has put on strength as his belt. Yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord reigns, He is clothed with majesty; The Lord is clothed, He has girded Himself with strength. Surely the world is established, so that it cannot be moved.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is king! He is robed in majesty. Indeed, the Lord is robed in majesty and armed with strength. The world stands firm and cannot be shaken.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord reigns, He is clothed with majesty; The Lord has clothed and encircled Himself with strength. Indeed, the world is firmly established; it will not be moved.
verses.textEn: The Lord reigns, he is robed in majesty; the Lord is robed in majesty and armed with strength; indeed, the world is established, firm and secure.

verses.textZh: 你的宝座自古就立定， 你从亘古就存在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的宝座自古就立定， 你从亘古就存在。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的宝座从太初立定； 你从亘古就有。
verses.textEnNiv: Your throne was established long ago; you are from all eternity.
verses.textEnEsv: Your throne is established from of old; you are from everlasting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your throne is established from of old; You are from everlasting.
verses.textEnNlt: Your throne, O Lord , has stood from time immemorial. You yourself are from the everlasting past.
verses.textEnNasb: Your throne is established from of old; You are from eternity.
verses.textEn: Your throne was established long ago; you are from all eternity.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！大水扬起了， 大水扬起了声音， 大水扬起了澎湃的波浪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！大水扬起了， 大水扬起了声音， 大水扬起了澎湃的波浪。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，大水扬起， 大水发声，波浪澎湃。
verses.textEnNiv: The seas have lifted up, Lord , the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.
verses.textEnEsv: The floods have lifted up, O Lord , the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring.
verses.textEnNkjv: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.
verses.textEnNlt: The floods have risen up, O Lord . The floods have roared like thunder; the floods have lifted their pounding waves.
verses.textEnNasb: The floods have lifted up, Lord, The floods have lifted up their voice, The floods lift up their pounding waves.
verses.textEn: The seas have lifted up, Lord , the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在高处大有能力， 胜过大水的响声， 胜过海中的巨浪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在高处大有能力， 胜过大水的响声， 胜过海中的巨浪。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在高处大有能力， 胜过诸水的响声，洋海的大浪。
verses.textEnNiv: Mightier than the thunder of the great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea— the Lord on high is mighty.
verses.textEnEsv: Mightier than the thunders of many waters, mightier than the waves of the sea, the Lord on high is mighty!
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord on high is mightier Than the noise of many waters, Than the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: But mightier than the violent raging of the seas, mightier than the breakers on the shore— the Lord above is mightier than these!
verses.textEnNasb: More than the sounds of many waters, Than the mighty breakers of the sea, The Lord on high is mighty.
verses.textEn: Mightier than the thunder of the great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea— the Lord on high is mighty.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的法度极为确定； 你的殿永远被称为圣是合宜的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的法度极为确定； 你的殿永远被称为圣是合宜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的法度最的确； 你的殿永称为圣，是合宜的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your statutes, Lord , stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days.
verses.textEnEsv: Your decrees are very trustworthy; holiness befits your house, O Lord , forevermore.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your testimonies are very sure; Holiness adorns Your house, O Lord, forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Your royal laws cannot be changed. Your reign, O Lord , is holy forever and ever.
verses.textEnNasb: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; Holiness is pleasing to Your house, Lord, forevermore.
verses.textEn: Your statutes, Lord , stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你是伸冤的神； 伸冤的神啊！求你显出荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你是伸冤的神； 伸冤的神啊！求你显出荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你是伸冤的神； 伸冤的神啊，求你发出光来！
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is a God who avenges. O God who avenges, shine forth.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth!
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongs— O God, to whom vengeance belongs, shine forth!
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , the God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, let your glorious justice shine forth!
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, God of vengeance, God of vengeance, shine forth!
verses.textEn: The Lord is a God who avenges. O God who avenges, shine forth.

verses.textZh: 审判大地的主啊！求你起来， 使骄傲的人得到应得的报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 审判大地的主啊！求你起来， 使骄傲的人得到应得的报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 审判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立， 使骄傲人受应得的报应！
verses.textEnNiv: Rise up, Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.
verses.textEnEsv: Rise up, O judge of the earth; repay to the proud what they deserve!
verses.textEnNkjv: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; Render punishment to the proud.
verses.textEnNlt: Arise, O Judge of the earth. Give the proud what they deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: Rise up, Judge of the earth, Pay back retribution to the proud.
verses.textEn: Rise up, Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！恶人得意要到几时呢？ 恶人欢乐要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！恶人得意要到几时呢？ 恶人欢乐要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，恶人夸胜要到几时呢？ 要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long, Lord , will the wicked, how long will the wicked be jubilant?
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked exult?
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, how long will the wicked, How long will the wicked triumph?
verses.textEnNlt: How long, O Lord ? How long will the wicked be allowed to gloat?
verses.textEnNasb: How long, Lord, shall the wicked— How long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.textEn: How long, Lord , will the wicked, how long will the wicked be jubilant?

verses.textZh: 他们不住地说骄傲的话， 所有作孽的人都夸耀自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不住地说骄傲的话， 所有作孽的人都夸耀自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们絮絮叨叨说傲慢的话； 一切作孽的人都自己夸张。
verses.textEnNiv: They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.
verses.textEnEsv: They pour out their arrogant words; all the evildoers boast.
verses.textEnNkjv: They utter speech, and speak insolent things; All the workers of iniquity boast in themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: How long will they speak with arrogance? How long will these evil people boast?
verses.textEnNasb: They pour out words, they speak arrogantly; All who do injustice boast.
verses.textEn: They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！他们欺压你的子民， 苦害你的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！他们欺压你的子民， 苦害你的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，他们强压你的百姓， 苦害你的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: They crush your people, Lord ; they oppress your inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: They crush your people, O Lord , and afflict your heritage.
verses.textEnNkjv: They break in pieces Your people, O Lord, And afflict Your heritage.
verses.textEnNlt: They crush your people, Lord , hurting those you claim as your own.
verses.textEnNasb: They crush Your people, Lord, And afflict Your inheritance.
verses.textEn: They crush your people, Lord ; they oppress your inheritance.

verses.textZh: 他们杀死寡妇和寄居的， 又杀害孤儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们杀死寡妇和寄居的， 又杀害孤儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们杀死寡妇和寄居的， 又杀害孤儿。
verses.textEnNiv: They slay the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
verses.textEnEsv: They kill the widow and the sojourner, and murder the fatherless;
verses.textEnNkjv: They slay the widow and the stranger, And murder the fatherless.
verses.textEnNlt: They kill widows and foreigners and murder orphans.
verses.textEnNasb: They kill the widow and the stranger And murder the orphans.
verses.textEn: They slay the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.

verses.textZh: 他们还说："耶和华必看不见， 雅各的神并不留意。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们还说："耶和华必看不见， 雅各的神并不留意。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：耶和华必不看见； 雅各的神必不思念。
verses.textEnNiv: They say, "The Lord does not see; the God of Jacob takes no notice."
verses.textEnEsv: and they say, "The Lord does not see; the God of Jacob does not perceive."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they say, "The Lord does not see, Nor does the God of Jacob understand."
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord isn’t looking," they say, "and besides, the God of Israel doesn’t care."
verses.textEnNasb: They have said, " The Lord does not see, Nor does the God of Jacob perceive."
verses.textEn: They say, "The Lord does not see; the God of Jacob takes no notice."

verses.textZh: 民间的愚昧人哪！你们要留心； 愚顽人哪！你们要到几时才能明白呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 民间的愚昧人哪！你们要留心； 愚顽人哪！你们要到几时才能明白呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们民间的畜类人当思想； 你们愚顽人到几时才有智慧呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Take notice, you senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?
verses.textEnEsv: Understand, O dullest of the people! Fools, when will you be wise?
verses.textEnNkjv: Understand, you senseless among the people; And you fools, when will you be wise?
verses.textEnNlt: Think again, you fools! When will you finally catch on?
verses.textEnNasb: Pay attention, you stupid ones among the people; And when will you understand, foolish ones?
verses.textEn: Take notice, you senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?

verses.textZh: 那造耳朵的，自己不能听见吗？ 那造眼睛的，自己不能看见吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那造耳朵的，自己不能听见吗？ 那造眼睛的，自己不能看见吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 造耳朵的，难道自己不听见吗？ 造眼睛的，难道自己不看见吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Does he who fashioned the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?
verses.textEnEsv: He who planted the ear, does he not hear? He who formed the eye, does he not see?
verses.textEnNkjv: He who planted the ear, shall He not hear? He who formed the eye, shall He not see?
verses.textEnNlt: Is he deaf—the one who made your ears? Is he blind—the one who formed your eyes?
verses.textEnNasb: He who planted the ear, does He not hear? Or He who formed the eye, does He not see?
verses.textEn: Does he who fashioned the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?

verses.textZh: 那管教万国的，不施行审判吗？ 那教导人的，自己没有知识吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那管教万国的，不施行审判吗？ 那教导人的，自己没有知识吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知识的， 难道自己不惩治人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Does he who disciplines nations not punish? Does he who teaches mankind lack knowledge?
verses.textEnEsv: He who disciplines the nations, does he not rebuke? He who teaches man knowledge—
verses.textEnNkjv: He who instructs the nations, shall He not correct, He who teaches man knowledge?
verses.textEnNlt: He punishes the nations—won’t he also punish you? He knows everything—doesn’t he also know what you are doing?
verses.textEnNasb: He who disciplines the nations, will He not rebuke, He who teaches mankind knowledge?
verses.textEn: Does he who disciplines nations not punish? Does he who teaches mankind lack knowledge?

verses.textZh: 耶和华知道人的意念是虚妄的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华知道人的意念是虚妄的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华知道人的意念是虚妄的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord knows all human plans; he knows that they are futile.
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord —knows the thoughts of man, that they are but a breath.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord knows the thoughts of man, That they are futile.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord knows people’s thoughts; he knows they are worthless!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord knows human thoughts, That they are mere breath.
verses.textEn: The Lord knows all human plans; he knows that they are futile.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你所管教， 用律法教导的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你所管教， 用律法教导的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你所管教、 用律法所教训的人是有福的！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one you discipline, Lord , the one you teach from your law;
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, O Lord , and whom you teach out of your law,
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is the man whom You instruct, O Lord, And teach out of Your law,
verses.textEnNlt: Joyful are those you discipline, Lord , those you teach with your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the man whom You discipline, Lord, And whom You teach from Your Law,
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one you discipline, Lord , the one you teach from your law;

verses.textZh: 在患难的日子，你使他得享平安， 直到为恶人所预备的坑挖好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在患难的日子，你使他得享平安， 直到为恶人所预备的坑挖好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你使他在遭难的日子得享平安； 惟有恶人陷在所挖的坑中。
verses.textEnNiv: you grant them relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: to give him rest from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: That You may give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: You give them relief from troubled times until a pit is dug to capture the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: So that You may grant him relief from the days of adversity, Until a pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.textEn: you grant them relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug for the wicked.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华必不丢弃他的子民， 必不离弃他的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华必不丢弃他的子民， 必不离弃他的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华必不丢弃他的百姓， 也不离弃他的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord will not forsake his people; he will not abandon his heritage;
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will not cast off His people, Nor will He forsake His inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will not reject his people; he will not abandon his special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord will not abandon His people, Nor will He abandon His inheritance.
verses.textEn: For the Lord will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance.

verses.textZh: 因为审判必再转向公义， 所有心里正直的都必顺从。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为审判必再转向公义， 所有心里正直的都必顺从。
verses.textZhCuv: 审判要转向公义； 心里正直的，必都随从。
verses.textEnNiv: Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
verses.textEnEsv: for justice will return to the righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
verses.textEnNkjv: But judgment will return to righteousness, And all the upright in heart will follow it.
verses.textEnNlt: Judgment will again be founded on justice, and those with virtuous hearts will pursue it.
verses.textEnNasb: For judgment will again be righteous, And all the upright in heart will follow it.
verses.textEn: Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.

verses.textZh: 谁肯为我起来攻击作恶的人呢？ 谁肯为我挺身而起对抗作孽的人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁肯为我起来攻击作恶的人呢？ 谁肯为我挺身而起对抗作孽的人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁肯为我起来攻击作恶的？ 谁肯为我站起抵挡作孽的？
verses.textEnNiv: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?
verses.textEnEsv: Who rises up for me against the wicked? Who stands up for me against evildoers?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.textEnNlt: Who will protect me from the wicked? Who will stand up for me against evildoers?
verses.textEnNasb: Who will stand up for me against evildoers? Who will take his stand for me against those who do injustice?
verses.textEn: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?

verses.textZh: 如果不是耶和华帮助我， 我早就不在人世了 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果不是耶和华帮助我， 我早就不在人世了 。
verses.textZhCuv: 若不是耶和华帮助我， 我就住在寂静之中了。
verses.textEnNiv: Unless the Lord had given me help, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.
verses.textEnEsv: If the Lord had not been my help, my soul would soon have lived in the land of silence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Unless the Lordhadbeen my help, My soul would soon have settled in silence.
verses.textEnNlt: Unless the Lord had helped me, I would soon have settled in the silence of the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: If the Lord had not been my help, My soul would soon have dwelt in the land of silence.
verses.textEn: Unless the Lord had given me help, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.

verses.textZh: 我说："我失了脚"， 耶和华啊！那时你的慈爱就扶持我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说："我失了脚"， 耶和华啊！那时你的慈爱就扶持我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我正说我失了脚， 耶和华啊，那时你的慈爱扶助我。
verses.textEnNiv: When I said, "My foot is slipping," your unfailing love, Lord , supported me.
verses.textEnEsv: When I thought, "My foot slips," your steadfast love, O Lord , held me up.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I say, "My foot slips," Your mercy, O Lord, will hold me up.
verses.textEnNlt: I cried out, "I am slipping!" but your unfailing love, O Lord , supported me.
verses.textEnNasb: If I should say, "My foot has slipped," Your faithfulness, Lord, will support me.
verses.textEn: When I said, "My foot is slipping," your unfailing love, Lord , supported me.

verses.textZh: 我心里充满忧虑的时候， 你就安慰我，使我的心欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心里充满忧虑的时候， 你就安慰我，使我的心欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心里多忧多疑， 你安慰我，就使我欢乐。
verses.textEnNiv: When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought me joy.
verses.textEnEsv: When the cares of my heart are many, your consolations cheer my soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the multitude of my anxieties within me, Your comforts delight my soul.
