verses.textEnNlt: When doubts filled my mind, your comfort gave me renewed hope and cheer.
verses.textEnNasb: When my anxious thoughts multiply within me, Your comfort delights my soul.
verses.textEn: When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought me joy.

verses.textZh: 凭着律例制造奸恶， 借着权位行毁灭的，怎能和你相交呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 凭着律例制造奸恶， 借着权位行毁灭的，怎能和你相交呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 那藉着律例架弄残害、 在位上行奸恶的，岂能与你相交吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Can a corrupt throne be allied with you— a throne that brings on misery by its decrees?
verses.textEnEsv: Can wicked rulers be allied with you, those who frame injustice by statute?
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall the throne of iniquity, which devises evil by law, Have fellowship with You?
verses.textEnNlt: Can unjust leaders claim that God is on their side— leaders whose decrees permit injustice?
verses.textEnNasb: Can a throne of destruction be allied with You, One which devises mischief by decree?
verses.textEn: Can a corrupt throne be allied with you— a throne that brings on misery by its decrees?

verses.textZh: 他们集结起来攻击义人， 把无辜的人定了死罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们集结起来攻击义人， 把无辜的人定了死罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们大家聚集攻击义人， 将无辜的人定为死罪。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
verses.textEnEsv: They band together against the life of the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: They gather together against the life of the righteous, And condemn innocent blood.
verses.textEnNlt: They gang up against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
verses.textEnNasb: They band themselves together against the life of the righteous And condemn the innocent to death.
verses.textEn: The wicked band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华作了我的高台， 我的神作了我避难的盘石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华作了我的高台， 我的神作了我避难的盘石。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华向来作了我的高台； 我的神作了我投靠的磐石。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord has become my stronghold, and my God the rock of my refuge.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord has been my defense, And my God the rock of my refuge.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord is my fortress; my God is the mighty rock where I hide.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord has been my refuge, And my God the rock of my refuge.
verses.textEn: But the Lord has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.

verses.textZh: 他必使他们的罪孽归到他们身上， 他必因他们的罪恶灭绝他们； 耶和华我们的神必把他们灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必使他们的罪孽归到他们身上， 他必因他们的罪恶灭绝他们； 耶和华我们的神必把他们灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他叫他们的罪孽归到他们身上。 他们正在行恶之中，他要剪除他们； 耶和华－我们的神要把他们剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them for their wickedness; the Lord our God will destroy them.
verses.textEnEsv: He will bring back on them their iniquity and wipe them out for their wickedness; the Lord our God will wipe them out.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has brought on them their own iniquity, And shall cut them off in their own wickedness; The Lord our God shall cut them off.
verses.textEnNlt: God will turn the sins of evil people back on them. He will destroy them for their sins. The Lord our God will destroy them.
verses.textEnNasb: He has brought back their injustice upon them, And He will destroy them in their evil; The Lord our God will destroy them.
verses.textEn: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them for their wickedness; the Lord our God will destroy them.

verses.textZh: 来吧，我们来向耶和华歌唱， 向拯救我们的盘石欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 来吧，我们来向耶和华歌唱， 向拯救我们的盘石欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 来啊，我们要向耶和华歌唱， 向拯救我们的磐石欢呼！
verses.textEnNiv: Come, let us sing for joy to the Lord ; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh come, let us sing to the Lord ; let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh come, let us sing to the Lord! Let us shout joyfully to the Rock of our salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, let us sing to the Lord ! Let us shout joyfully to the Rock of our salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: Come, let’s sing for joy to the Lord, Let’s shout joyfully to the rock of our salvation.
verses.textEn: Come, let us sing for joy to the Lord ; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.

verses.textZh: 我们要来到他面前称谢他， 用诗歌向他欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要来到他面前称谢他， 用诗歌向他欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要来感谢他， 用诗歌向他欢呼！
verses.textEnNiv: Let us come before him with thanksgiving and extol him with music and song.
verses.textEnEsv: Let us come into his presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to him with songs of praise!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving; Let us shout joyfully to Him with psalms.
verses.textEnNlt: Let us come to him with thanksgiving. Let us sing psalms of praise to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Let’s come before His presence with a song of thanksgiving, Let’s shout joyfully to Him in songs with instruments.
verses.textEn: Let us come before him with thanksgiving and extol him with music and song.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华是伟大的神， 是超越众神的大君王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华是伟大的神， 是超越众神的大君王。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华为大神， 为大王，超乎万神之上。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord is the great God, the great King above all gods.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lordis the great God, And the great King above all gods.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is a great God, a great King above all gods.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord is a great God And a great King above all gods,
verses.textEn: For the Lord is the great God, the great King above all gods.

verses.textZh: 地的深处在他手中， 山的高峰也都属他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地的深处在他手中， 山的高峰也都属他。
verses.textZhCuv: 地的深处在他手中； 山的高峰也属他。
verses.textEnNiv: In his hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to him.
verses.textEnEsv: In his hand are the depths of the earth; the heights of the mountains are his also.
verses.textEnNkjv: In His hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the hills are His also.
verses.textEnNlt: He holds in his hands the depths of the earth and the mightiest mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: In whose hand are the depths of the earth, The peaks of the mountains are also His.
verses.textEn: In his hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to him.

verses.textZh: 海洋属他，因为是他创造的， 陆地也是他的手造成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 海洋属他，因为是他创造的， 陆地也是他的手造成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 海洋属他，是他造的； 旱地也是他手造成的。
verses.textEnNiv: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.textEnEsv: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sea is His, for He made it; And His hands formed the dry land.
verses.textEnNlt: The sea belongs to him, for he made it. His hands formed the dry land, too.
verses.textEnNasb: The sea is His, for it was He who made it, And His hands formed the dry land.
verses.textEn: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.

verses.textZh: 来吧，我们来俯伏敬拜， 在造我们的耶和华面前跪下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 来吧，我们来俯伏敬拜， 在造我们的耶和华面前跪下。
verses.textZhCuv: 来啊，我们要屈身敬拜， 在造我们的耶和华面前跪下。
verses.textEnNiv: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the Lord our Maker;
verses.textEnEsv: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the Lord , our Maker!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before the Lord our Maker.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, let us worship and bow down. Let us kneel before the Lord our maker,
verses.textEnNasb: Come, let’s worship and bow down, Let’s kneel before the Lord our Maker.
verses.textEn: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the Lord our Maker;

verses.textZh: 因为他是我们的神， 我们是他草场上的子民， 是他手下的羊群。 如果你们今天听从他的声音，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他是我们的神， 我们是他草场上的子民， 是他手下的羊群。 如果你们今天听从他的声音，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他是我们的神； 我们是他草场的羊，是他手下的民。 惟愿你们今天听他的话：
verses.textEnNiv: for he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if only you would hear his voice,
verses.textEnEsv: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. Today, if you hear his voice,
verses.textEnNkjv: For He is our God, And we are the people of His pasture, And the sheep of His hand. Today, if you will hear His voice:
verses.textEnNlt: for he is our God. We are the people he watches over, the flock under his care. If only you would listen to his voice today!
verses.textEnNasb: For He is our God, And we are the people of His pasture and the sheep of His hand. Today, if you will hear His voice,
verses.textEn: for he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if only you would hear his voice,

verses.textZh: 就不要硬着心，好象在米利巴， 就是在旷野的玛撒的日子一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就不要硬着心，好象在米利巴， 就是在旷野的玛撒的日子一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不可硬着心，像当日在米利巴， 就是在旷野的玛撒。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the wilderness,
verses.textEnEsv: do not harden your hearts, as at Meribah, as on the day at Massah in the wilderness,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, As in the day of trial in the wilderness,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord says, "Don’t harden your hearts as Israel did at Meribah, as they did at Massah in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not harden your hearts as at Meribah, As on the day of Massah in the wilderness,
verses.textEn: "Do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the wilderness,

verses.textZh: 在那里你们的祖先虽曾见过我的作为， 还是试探我，考验我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里你们的祖先虽曾见过我的作为， 还是试探我，考验我。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，你们的祖宗试我探我， 并且观看我的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: where your ancestors tested me; they tried me, though they had seen what I did.
verses.textEnEsv: when your fathers put me to the test and put me to the proof, though they had seen my work.
verses.textEnNkjv: When your fathers tested Me; They tried Me, though they saw My work.
verses.textEnNlt: For there your ancestors tested and tried my patience, even though they saw everything I did.
verses.textEnNasb: "When your fathers put Me to the test, They tested Me, though they had seen My work.
verses.textEn: where your ancestors tested me; they tried me, though they had seen what I did.

verses.textZh: 四十年之久，我厌恶那个世代的人； 我曾说："他们是心里迷误的人民， 不认识我的道路。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 四十年之久，我厌恶那个世代的人； 我曾说："他们是心里迷误的人民， 不认识我的道路。"
verses.textZhCuv: 四十年之久，我厌烦那世代，说： 这是心里迷糊的百姓， 竟不晓得我的作为！
verses.textEnNiv: For forty years I was angry with that generation; I said, ‘They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known my ways.’
verses.textEnEsv: For forty years I loathed that generation and said, "They are a people who go astray in their heart, and they have not known my ways."
verses.textEnNkjv: For forty years I was grieved with that generation, And said, ‘It is a people who go astray in their hearts, And they do not know My ways.’
verses.textEnNlt: For forty years I was angry with them, and I said, ‘They are a people whose hearts turn away from me. They refuse to do what I tell them.’
verses.textEnNasb: "For forty years I was disgusted with that generation, And said they are a people who err in their heart, And they do not know My ways.
verses.textEn: For forty years I was angry with that generation; I said, ‘They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known my ways.’

verses.textZh: 所以我在忿怒中起誓，说： "他们绝不可进入我的安息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我在忿怒中起誓，说： "他们绝不可进入我的安息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我在怒中起誓，说： 他们断不可进入我的安息！
verses.textEnNiv: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I swore in my wrath, "They shall not enter my rest."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I swore in My wrath, ‘They shall not enter My rest.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: So in my anger I took an oath: ‘They will never enter my place of rest.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I swore in My anger, They certainly shall not enter My rest."
verses.textEn: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ "

verses.textZh: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌， 全地都要向耶和华歌唱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌， 全地都要向耶和华歌唱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！ 全地都要向耶和华歌唱！
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord , all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord , all the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, sing to the Lord a new song! Sing to the Lord, all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing a new song to the Lord ! Let the whole earth sing to the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to the Lord a new song; Sing to the Lord, all the earth.
verses.textEn: Sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord , all the earth.

verses.textZh: 要向耶和华歌唱，称颂他的名， 天天传扬他的救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要向耶和华歌唱，称颂他的名， 天天传扬他的救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 要向耶和华歌唱，称颂他的名！ 天天传扬他的救恩！
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to the Lord , praise his name; proclaim his salvation day after day.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing to the Lord , bless his name; tell of his salvation from day to day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to the Lord, bless His name; Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing to the Lord ; praise his name. Each day proclaim the good news that he saves.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to the Lord, bless His name; Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.
verses.textEn: Sing to the Lord , praise his name; proclaim his salvation day after day.

verses.textZh: 要在列国中述说他的荣耀。 在万民中述说他奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要在列国中述说他的荣耀。 在万民中述说他奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀！ 在万民中述说他的奇事！
verses.textEnNiv: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples!
verses.textEnNkjv: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: Publish his glorious deeds among the nations. Tell everyone about the amazing things he does.
verses.textEnNasb: Tell of His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all the peoples.
verses.textEn: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华是伟大的，该受极大的赞美， 他当受敬畏，过于众神之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华是伟大的，该受极大的赞美， 他当受敬畏，过于众神之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美； 他在万神之上，当受敬畏。
verses.textEnNiv: For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEnEsv: For great is the Lord , and greatly to be praised; he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lordis great and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEnNlt: Great is the Lord ! He is most worthy of praise! He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEnNasb: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.textEn: For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

verses.textZh: 因为万民的神都是虚空的偶像， 但耶和华创造了诸天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万民的神都是虚空的偶像， 但耶和华创造了诸天。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦的神都属虚无； 惟独耶和华创造诸天。
verses.textEnNiv: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: For all the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, But the Lord made the heavens.
verses.textEnNlt: The gods of other nations are mere idols, but the Lord made the heavens!
verses.textEnNasb: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, But the Lord made the heavens.
verses.textEn: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.

verses.textZh: 尊荣和威严在他面前， 能力和华美在他圣所之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尊荣和威严在他面前， 能力和华美在他圣所之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 有尊荣和威严在他面前； 有能力与华美在他圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and glory are in his sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: Honor and majesty are before Him; Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: Honor and majesty surround him; strength and beauty fill his sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: Splendor and majesty are before Him, Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.
verses.textEn: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and glory are in his sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 列国的万族啊！你们要归给耶和华， 要把荣耀和能力归给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国的万族啊！你们要归给耶和华， 要把荣耀和能力归给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 民中的万族啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华， 都归给耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Ascribe to the Lord , all you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEnEsv: Ascribe to the Lord , O families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength!
verses.textEnNkjv: Give to the Lord, O families of the peoples, Give to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEnNlt: O nations of the world, recognize the Lord ; recognize that the Lord is glorious and strong.
verses.textEnNasb: Ascribe to the Lord, you families of the peoples, Ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
verses.textEn: Ascribe to the Lord , all you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

verses.textZh: 要把耶和华的名当得的荣耀归给他， 带着礼物进入他的院子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把耶和华的名当得的荣耀归给他， 带着礼物进入他的院子。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 拿供物来进入他的院宇。
verses.textEnNiv: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.
verses.textEnEsv: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering, and come into his courts!
verses.textEnNkjv: Give to the Lord the glory due His name; Bring an offering, and come into His courts.
verses.textEnNlt: Give to the Lord the glory he deserves! Bring your offering and come into his courts.
verses.textEnNasb: Ascribe to the Lord the glory of His name; Bring an offering and come into His courtyards.
verses.textEn: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.

verses.textZh: 要以圣洁的装束敬拜耶和华 ， 全地都要在他面前战栗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要以圣洁的装束敬拜耶和华 ， 全地都要在他面前战栗。
verses.textZhCuv: 当以圣洁的 妆饰敬拜耶和华； 全地要在他面前战抖！
verses.textEnNiv: Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Worship the Lord in the splendor of holiness; tremble before him, all the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness! Tremble before Him, all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Worship the Lord in all his holy splendor. Let all the earth tremble before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Worship the Lord in holy attire; Tremble before Him, all the earth.
verses.textEn: Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.

verses.textZh: 你们要在万国中宣告："耶和华作王！" 世界就坚定，必不动摇； 他必按着公正审判万民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要在万国中宣告："耶和华作王！" 世界就坚定，必不动摇； 他必按着公正审判万民。
verses.textZhCuv: 人在列邦中要说：耶和华作王！ 世界就坚定，不得动摇； 他要按公正审判众民。
verses.textEnNiv: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns." The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity.
verses.textEnEsv: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns! Yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity."
verses.textEnNkjv: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns; The world also is firmly established, It shall not be moved; He shall judge the peoples righteously."
verses.textEnNlt: Tell all the nations, "The Lord reigns!" The world stands firm and cannot be shaken. He will judge all peoples fairly.
verses.textEnNasb: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns; Indeed, the world is firmly established, it will not be moved; He will judge the peoples fairly."
verses.textEn: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns." The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity.

verses.textZh: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐； 愿海和海中充满的，都翻腾响闹；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐； 愿海和海中充满的，都翻腾响闹；
verses.textZhCuv: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐！ 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃！
verses.textEnNiv: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; let the sea roar, and all that fills it;
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; Let the sea roar, and all its fullness;
verses.textEnNlt: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice! Let the sea and everything in it shout his praise!
verses.textEnNasb: May the heavens be joyful, and may the earth rejoice; May the sea roar, and all it contains;
verses.textEn: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it.

verses.textZh: 愿田野和其中的一切都欢乐， 那时林中的一切树木都必欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿田野和其中的一切都欢乐， 那时林中的一切树木都必欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿田和其中所有的都欢乐！ 那时，林中的树木都要在耶和华面前欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.
verses.textEnEsv: let the field exult, and everything in it! Then shall all the trees of the forest sing for joy
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the field be joyful, and all that is in it. Then all the trees of the woods will rejoice before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the fields and their crops burst out with joy! Let the trees of the forest sing for joy
verses.textEnNasb: May the field be jubilant, and all that is in it. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
verses.textEn: Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.

verses.textZh: 它们都要在耶和华面前欢呼，因为他来了； 他来要审判全地。 他要按着公义审判世界， 凭着他的信实审判万民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们都要在耶和华面前欢呼，因为他来了； 他来要审判全地。 他要按着公义审判世界， 凭着他的信实审判万民。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他来了，他来要审判全地。 他要按公义审判世界， 按他的信实审判万民。
verses.textEnNiv: Let all creation rejoice before the Lord , for he comes, he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in his faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: before the Lord , for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples in his faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth. He shall judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with His truth.
verses.textEnNlt: before the Lord , for he is coming! He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with justice, and the nations with his truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Before the Lord, for He is coming, For He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness, And the peoples in His faithfulness.
verses.textEn: Let all creation rejoice before the Lord , for he comes, he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in his faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 耶和华作王，愿地快乐， 愿众海岛都欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华作王，愿地快乐， 愿众海岛都欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华作王！愿地快乐！ 愿众海岛欢喜！
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad!
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord reigns; Let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad!
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is king! Let the earth rejoice! Let the farthest coastlands be glad.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord reigns, may the earth rejoice; May the many islands be joyful.
verses.textEn: The Lord reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.

verses.textZh: 密云和幽暗在他的四围， 公义和公正是他宝座的根基。
verses.textZhCnvs: 密云和幽暗在他的四围， 公义和公正是他宝座的根基。
verses.textZhCuv: 密云和幽暗在他的四围； 公义和公平是他宝座的根基。
verses.textEnNiv: Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.textEnEsv: Clouds and thick darkness are all around him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.textEnNkjv: Clouds and darkness surround Him; Righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.
verses.textEnNlt: Dark clouds surround him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.textEnNasb: Clouds and thick darkness surround Him; Righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.
verses.textEn: Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

verses.textZh: 有火走在他的前面， 烧尽他四围的敌人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有火走在他的前面， 烧尽他四围的敌人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有烈火在他前头行， 烧灭他四围的敌人。
verses.textEnNiv: Fire goes before him and consumes his foes on every side.
verses.textEnEsv: Fire goes before him and burns up his adversaries all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fire goes before Him, And burns up His enemies round about.
verses.textEnNlt: Fire spreads ahead of him and burns up all his foes.
verses.textEnNasb: Fire goes before Him And burns up His enemies all around.
verses.textEn: Fire goes before him and consumes his foes on every side.

verses.textZh: 他的闪电照亮世界， 大地看见了就战栗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的闪电照亮世界， 大地看见了就战栗。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的闪电光照世界， 大地看见便震动。
verses.textEnNiv: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.
verses.textEnEsv: His lightnings light up the world; the earth sees and trembles.
verses.textEnNkjv: His lightnings light the world; The earth sees and trembles.
verses.textEnNlt: His lightning flashes out across the world. The earth sees and trembles.
verses.textEnNasb: His lightning lit up the world; The earth saw it and trembled.
verses.textEn: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华面前，就是在全地的主面前， 群山都像蜡一般融化。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华面前，就是在全地的主面前， 群山都像蜡一般融化。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸山见耶和华的面， 就是全地之主的面，便消化如蜡。
verses.textEnNiv: The mountains melt like wax before the Lord , before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: The mountains melt like wax before the Lord , before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.textEnNlt: The mountains melt like wax before the Lord , before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.textEn: The mountains melt like wax before the Lord , before the Lord of all the earth.

verses.textZh: 诸天传扬他的公义， 万民得见他的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诸天传扬他的公义， 万民得见他的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸天表明他的公义； 万民看见他的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all peoples see his glory.
verses.textEnEsv: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heavens declare His righteousness, And all the peoples see His glory.
verses.textEnNlt: The heavens proclaim his righteousness; every nation sees his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: The heavens declare His righteousness, And all the peoples have seen His glory.
verses.textEn: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all peoples see his glory.

verses.textZh: 愿所有事奉雕刻的偶像的， 以虚无的偶像为夸口的，都蒙羞； 众神哪！你们都要拜他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿所有事奉雕刻的偶像的， 以虚无的偶像为夸口的，都蒙羞； 众神哪！你们都要拜他。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿一切事奉雕刻的偶像、 靠虚无之神自夸的，都蒙羞愧。 万神哪，你们都当拜他。
verses.textEnNiv: All who worship images are put to shame, those who boast in idols— worship him, all you gods!
verses.textEnEsv: All worshipers of images are put to shame, who make their boast in worthless idols; worship him, all you gods!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all be put to shame who serve carved images, Who boast of idols. Worship Him, all you gods.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who worship idols are disgraced— all who brag about their worthless gods— for every god must bow to him.
verses.textEnNasb: May all those be ashamed who serve carved images, Who boast in idols; Worship Him, all you gods.
verses.textEn: All who worship images are put to shame, those who boast in idols— worship him, all you gods!

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！锡安听见你的判断就欢喜， 犹大的各城 也都快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！锡安听见你的判断就欢喜， 犹大的各城 也都快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，锡安听见你的判断就欢喜； 犹大的城邑 也都快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Zion hears and is glad, and the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of your judgments, O Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Zion hears and is glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoice Because of Your judgments, O Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem has heard and rejoiced, and all the towns of Judah are glad because of your justice, O Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Zion heard this and was joyful, And the daughters of Judah have rejoiced Because of Your judgments, Lord.
verses.textEn: Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！因为你是全地的至高者； 你被尊崇，远超过众神之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！因为你是全地的至高者； 你被尊崇，远超过众神之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你－耶和华至高，超乎全地； 你被尊崇，远超万神之上。
verses.textEnNiv: For you, Lord , are the Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.
verses.textEnEsv: For you, O Lord , are most high over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You, Lord, are most high above all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
verses.textEnNlt: For you, O Lord , are supreme over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.
verses.textEnNasb: For You are the Lord Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
verses.textEn: For you, Lord , are the Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.

verses.textZh: 你们爱耶和华的，都要恨恶罪恶； 耶和华保护圣民的性命， 救他们脱离恶人的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们爱耶和华的，都要恨恶罪恶； 耶和华保护圣民的性命， 救他们脱离恶人的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们爱耶和华的，都当恨恶罪恶； 他保护圣民的性命， 搭救他们脱离恶人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Let those who love the Lord hate evil, for he guards the lives of his faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: O you who love the Lord , hate evil! He preserves the lives of his saints; he delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: You who love the Lord, hate evil! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: You who love the Lord , hate evil! He protects the lives of his godly people and rescues them from the power of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: Hate evil, you who love the Lord, Who watches over the souls of His godly ones; He saves them from the hand of the wicked.
verses.textEn: Let those who love the Lord hate evil, for he guards the lives of his faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 有亮光照耀 义人， 心里正直的人得享喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有亮光照耀 义人， 心里正直的人得享喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 散布亮光是为义人； 预备喜乐是为正直人。
verses.textEnNiv: Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Light shines on the godly, and joy on those whose hearts are right.
verses.textEnNasb: Light is sown like seed for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.textEn: Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart.

verses.textZh: 义人哪！你们要靠耶和华欢喜， 要称赞他的圣名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人哪！你们要靠耶和华欢喜， 要称赞他的圣名。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们义人当靠耶和华欢喜， 称谢他可记念的圣名。
verses.textEnNiv: Rejoice in the Lord , you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice in the Lord , O you righteous, and give thanks to his holy name!
verses.textEnNkjv: Rejoice in the Lord, you righteous, And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.
verses.textEnNlt: May all who are godly rejoice in the Lord and praise his holy name!
verses.textEnNasb: Be joyful in the Lord, you righteous ones, And praise the mention of His holy name.
verses.textEn: Rejoice in the Lord , you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.

verses.textZh: 诗一首。 你们要向耶和华唱新歌， 因为他行了奇妙的事； 他的右手和他的圣臂，为他施行拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 诗一首。 你们要向耶和华唱新歌， 因为他行了奇妙的事； 他的右手和他的圣臂，为他施行拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！ 因为他行过奇妙的事； 他的右手和圣臂施行救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvelous things; his right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, sing to the Lord a new song! For He has done marvelous things; His right hand and His holy arm have gained Him the victory.
verses.textEnNlt: Sing a new song to the Lord , for he has done wonderful deeds. His right hand has won a mighty victory; his holy arm has shown his saving power!
verses.textEnNasb: Sing a new song to the Lord, For He has done wonderful things, His right hand and His holy arm have gained the victory for Him.
verses.textEn: Sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvelous things; his right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华显明了他的救恩， 在列国眼前显示了他的公义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华显明了他的救恩， 在列国眼前显示了他的公义。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华发明了他的救恩， 在列邦人眼前显出公义；
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has made his salvation known and revealed his righteousness to the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has made known his salvation; he has revealed his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has made known His salvation; His righteousness He has revealed in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has announced his victory and has revealed his righteousness to every nation!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has made His salvation known; He has revealed His righteousness in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEn: The Lord has made his salvation known and revealed his righteousness to the nations.

verses.textZh: 他记念他向以色列家所应许的慈爱和信实， 地的四极都看见我们神的救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他记念他向以色列家所应许的慈爱和信实， 地的四极都看见我们神的救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 记念他向以色列家所发的慈爱，所凭的信实。 地的四极都看见我们神的救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: He has remembered his love and his faithfulness to Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: He has remembered his steadfast love and faithfulness to the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has remembered His mercy and His faithfulness to the house of Israel; All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.textEnNlt: He has remembered his promise to love and be faithful to Israel. The ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: He has remembered His graciousness and His faithfulness to the house of Israel; All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.textEn: He has remembered his love and his faithfulness to Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.textZh: 全地都要向耶和华欢呼， 要发声欢唱，要歌颂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全地都要向耶和华欢呼， 要发声欢唱，要歌颂。
verses.textZhCuv: 全地都要向耶和华欢乐； 要发起大声，欢呼歌颂！
verses.textEnNiv: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;
verses.textEnEsv: Make a joyful noise to the Lord , all the earth; break forth into joyous song and sing praises!
verses.textEnNkjv: Shout joyfully to the Lord, all the earth; Break forth in song, rejoice, and sing praises.
verses.textEnNlt: Shout to the Lord , all the earth; break out in praise and sing for joy!
verses.textEnNasb: Shout joyfully to the Lord, all the earth; Be cheerful and sing for joy and sing praises.
verses.textEn: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;

verses.textZh: 要弹琴歌颂耶和华， 要用琴和歌声歌颂他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 要弹琴歌颂耶和华， 要用琴和歌声歌颂他；
verses.textZhCuv: 要用琴歌颂耶和华， 用琴和诗歌的声音歌颂他！
verses.textEnNiv: make music to the Lord with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,
verses.textEnEsv: Sing praises to the Lord with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of melody!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to the Lord with the harp, With the harp and the sound of a psalm,
verses.textEnNlt: Sing your praise to the Lord with the harp, with the harp and melodious song,
verses.textEnNasb: Sing praises to the Lord with the lyre, With the lyre and the sound of melody.
verses.textEn: make music to the Lord with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,

verses.textZh: 要用号筒和号角的声音， 在大君王耶和华面前欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要用号筒和号角的声音， 在大君王耶和华面前欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 用号和角声， 在大君王耶和华面前欢呼！
verses.textEnNiv: with trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn— shout for joy before the Lord , the King.
verses.textEnEsv: With trumpets and the sound of the horn make a joyful noise before the King, the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: With trumpets and the sound of a horn; Shout joyfully before the Lord, the King.
verses.textEnNlt: with trumpets and the sound of the ram’s horn. Make a joyful symphony before the Lord , the King!
verses.textEnNasb: With trumpets and the sound of the horn Shout joyfully before the King, the Lord.
verses.textEn: with trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn— shout for joy before the Lord , the King.

verses.textZh: 愿海和海中充满的，都翻腾响闹， 愿世界和住在世上的也都发声；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿海和海中充满的，都翻腾响闹， 愿世界和住在世上的也都发声；
verses.textZhCuv: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃； 世界和住在其间的也要发声。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the sea resound, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the sea roar, and all that fills it; the world and those who dwell in it!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the sea roar, and all its fullness, The world and those who dwell in it;
verses.textEnNlt: Let the sea and everything in it shout his praise! Let the earth and all living things join in.
verses.textEnNasb: May the sea roar and all it contains, The world and those who dwell in it.
verses.textEn: Let the sea resound, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.

verses.textZh: 愿江河拍手， 愿群山一起欢呼；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿江河拍手， 愿群山一起欢呼；
verses.textZhCuv: 愿大水拍手； 愿诸山在耶和华面前一同欢呼；
verses.textEnNiv: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy;
verses.textEnEsv: Let the rivers clap their hands; let the hills sing for joy together
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the rivers clap their hands; Let the hills be joyful together before the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: Let the rivers clap their hands in glee! Let the hills sing out their songs of joy
verses.textEnNasb: May the rivers clap their hands, May the mountains sing together for joy
verses.textEn: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy;

verses.textZh: 它们都要在耶和华面前欢呼， 因为他来是要审判全地， 他要按着公义审判世界， 凭着公正审判万民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们都要在耶和华面前欢呼， 因为他来是要审判全地， 他要按着公义审判世界， 凭着公正审判万民。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他来要审判遍地。 他要按公义审判世界， 按公正审判万民。
verses.textEnNiv: let them sing before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples with equity.
verses.textEnEsv: before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He is coming to judge the earth. With righteousness He shall judge the world, And the peoples with equity.
verses.textEnNlt: before the Lord , for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with justice, and the nations with fairness.
verses.textEnNasb: Before the Lord, for He is coming to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness And the peoples with fairness.
verses.textEn: let them sing before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples with equity.

verses.textZh: 耶和华作王，万民都要战栗； 他坐在两个基路伯之上，大地也要震动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华作王，万民都要战栗； 他坐在两个基路伯之上，大地也要震动。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华作王；万民当战抖！ 他坐在二基路伯上，地当动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord reigns; let the peoples tremble! He sits enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake!
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord reigns; Let the peoples tremble! He dwells between the cherubim; Let the earth be moved!
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is king! Let the nations tremble! He sits on his throne between the cherubim. Let the whole earth quake!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord reigns, the peoples tremble! He sits enthroned above the cherubim, the earth quakes!
verses.textEn: The Lord reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在锡安是至大的， 他崇高，超过万民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在锡安是至大的， 他崇高，超过万民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在锡安为大； 他超乎万民之上。
verses.textEnNiv: Great is the Lord in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is great in Zion; he is exalted over all the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis great in Zion, And He is high above all the peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord sits in majesty in Jerusalem, exalted above all the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is great in Zion, And He is exalted above all the peoples.
verses.textEn: Great is the Lord in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.

verses.textZh: 愿他们称赞你伟大可畏的名。 他是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们称赞你伟大可畏的名。 他是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们当称赞他大而可畏的名； 他本为圣！
verses.textEnNiv: Let them praise your great and awesome name— he is holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them praise your great and awesome name! Holy is he!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them praise your great and awesome name. Your name is holy!
verses.textEnNasb: May they praise Your great and awesome name; Holy is He.
verses.textEn: Let them praise your great and awesome name— he is holy.

verses.textZh: 王有能力 ， 喜爱公正； 你坚立正义； 你在雅各家施行公正和公义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王有能力 ， 喜爱公正； 你坚立正义； 你在雅各家施行公正和公义。
verses.textZhCuv: 王有能力，喜爱公平，坚立公正， 在雅各中施行公平和公义。
verses.textEnNiv: The King is mighty, he loves justice— you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.
verses.textEnEsv: The King in his might loves justice. You have established equity; you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: The King’s strength also loves justice; You have established equity; You have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: Mighty King, lover of justice, you have established fairness. You have acted with justice and righteousness throughout Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The strength of the King loves justice; You have established order; You have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.textEn: The King is mighty, he loves justice— you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.

verses.textZh: 你们要尊崇耶和华我们的神， 在他的脚凳前敬拜； 他是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要尊崇耶和华我们的神， 在他的脚凳前敬拜； 他是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当尊崇耶和华－我们的神， 在他脚凳前下拜。 他本为圣！
verses.textEnNiv: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his footstool; he is holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Exalt the Lord our God; worship at his footstool! Holy is he!
verses.textEnNkjv: Exalt the Lord our God, And worship at His footstool— He is holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Exalt the Lord our God! Bow low before his feet, for he is holy!
verses.textEnNasb: Exalt the Lord our God And worship at His footstool; Holy is He.
verses.textEn: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his footstool; he is holy.

verses.textZh: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亚伦， 在求告他名的人中有撒母耳； 他们求告耶和华， 他就应允他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亚伦， 在求告他名的人中有撒母耳； 他们求告耶和华， 他就应允他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亚伦； 在求告他名的人中有撒母耳。 他们求告耶和华，他就应允他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the Lord and he answered them.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel also was among those who called upon his name. They called to the Lord , and he answered them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moses and Aaron were among His priests, And Samuel was among those who called upon His name; They called upon the Lord, and He answered them.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses and Aaron were among his priests; Samuel also called on his name. They cried to the Lord for help, and he answered them.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses and Aaron were among His priests, And Samuel was among those who called on His name; They called upon the Lord and He answered them.
verses.textEn: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the Lord and he answered them.

verses.textZh: 他从云柱中对他们说话； 他们谨守耶和华赐给他们的法度和律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从云柱中对他们说话； 他们谨守耶和华赐给他们的法度和律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在云柱中对他们说话； 他们遵守他的法度和他所赐给他们的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.
verses.textEnEsv: In the pillar of the cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and the statute that he gave them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar; They kept His testimonies and the ordinance He gave them.
verses.textEnNlt: He spoke to Israel from the pillar of cloud, and they followed the laws and decrees he gave them.
verses.textEnNasb: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud; They kept His testimonies And the statute that He gave them.
verses.textEn: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我们的神啊！你应允了他们； 你虽然按照他们所行的报应他们， 但对他们来说，你是一位赦免人的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我们的神啊！你应允了他们； 你虽然按照他们所行的报应他们， 但对他们来说，你是一位赦免人的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的神啊，你应允他们； 你是赦免他们的神， 却按他们所行的报应他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord our God, you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord our God, you answered them; you were a forgiving God to them, but an avenger of their wrongdoings.
verses.textEnNkjv: You answered them, O Lord our God; You were to them God-Who-Forgives, Though You took vengeance on their deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord our God, you answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, but you punished them when they went wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord our God, You answered them; You were a forgiving God to them, And yet an avenger of their evil deeds.
verses.textEn: Lord our God, you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.

verses.textZh: 你们要尊崇耶和华我们的神， 在他的圣山上敬拜， 因为耶和华我们的神是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要尊崇耶和华我们的神， 在他的圣山上敬拜， 因为耶和华我们的神是圣洁的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要尊崇耶和华－我们的神， 在他的圣山下拜， 因为耶和华－我们的神本为圣！
verses.textEnNiv: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his holy mountain, for the Lord our God is holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy mountain; for the Lord our God is holy!
verses.textEnNkjv: Exalt the Lord our God, And worship at His holy hill; For the Lord our God is holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy mountain in Jerusalem, for the Lord our God is holy!
verses.textEnNasb: Exalt the Lord our God And worship at His holy hill, For the Lord our God is holy.
verses.textEn: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his holy mountain, for the Lord our God is holy.

verses.textZh: 感恩诗。 全地应当向耶和华欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 感恩诗。 全地应当向耶和华欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 普天下当向耶和华欢呼！
verses.textEnNiv: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Make a joyful noise to the Lord , all the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Make a joyful shout to the Lord, all you lands!
verses.textEnNlt: Shout with joy to the Lord , all the earth!
verses.textEnNasb: Shout joyfully to the Lord, all the earth.
verses.textEn: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth.

verses.textZh: 应当欢欢喜喜事奉耶和华， 欢唱着到他的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 应当欢欢喜喜事奉耶和华， 欢唱着到他的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当乐意事奉耶和华， 当来向他歌唱！
verses.textEnNiv: Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.
verses.textEnEsv: Serve the Lord with gladness! Come into his presence with singing!
verses.textEnNkjv: Serve the Lord with gladness; Come before His presence with singing.
verses.textEnNlt: Worship the Lord with gladness. Come before him, singing with joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Serve the Lord with jubilation; Come before Him with rejoicing.
verses.textEn: Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.

verses.textZh: 要知道耶和华是神； 他创造了我们，我们是属他的 ； 我们是他的子民，也是他草场上的羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要知道耶和华是神； 他创造了我们，我们是属他的 ； 我们是他的子民，也是他草场上的羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当晓得耶和华是神！ 我们是他造的，也是属他的； 我们是他的民，也是他草场的羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Know that the Lord is God. It is he who made us, and we are his ; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.
verses.textEnEsv: Know that the Lord , he is God! It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.textEnNkjv: Know that the Lord, He is God; Itis He who has made us, and not we ourselves; Weare His people and the sheep of His pasture.
verses.textEnNlt: Acknowledge that the Lord is God! He made us, and we are his. We are his people, the sheep of his pasture.
verses.textEnNasb: Know that the Lord Himself is God; It is He who has made us, and not we ourselves; We are His people and the sheep of His pasture.
verses.textEn: Know that the Lord is God. It is he who made us, and we are his ; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.

verses.textZh: 应当充满感恩进入他的殿门， 满口赞美进入他的院子； 要感谢他，称颂他的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 应当充满感恩进入他的殿门， 满口赞美进入他的院子； 要感谢他，称颂他的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 当称谢进入他的门； 当赞美进入他的院。 当感谢他，称颂他的名！
verses.textEnNiv: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.
verses.textEnEsv: Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise! Give thanks to him; bless his name!
verses.textEnNkjv: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, And into His courts with praise. Be thankful to Him, and bless His name.
verses.textEnNlt: Enter his gates with thanksgiving; go into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him and praise his name.
verses.textEnNasb: Enter His gates with thanksgiving, And His courtyards with praise. Give thanks to Him, bless His name.
verses.textEn: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华本是美善的， 他的慈爱存到永远， 他的信实直到万代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华本是美善的， 他的慈爱存到永远， 他的信实直到万代。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华本为善。 他的慈爱存到永远； 他的信实直到万代。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord is good; his steadfast love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lordis good; His mercy is everlasting, And His truth endures to all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is good. His unfailing love continues forever, and his faithfulness continues to each generation.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord is good; His mercy is everlasting And His faithfulness is to all generations.
verses.textEn: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 我要歌唱慈爱和公正； 耶和华啊！我要向你歌颂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 我要歌唱慈爱和公正； 耶和华啊！我要向你歌颂。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要歌唱慈爱和公平； 耶和华啊，我要向你歌颂！
verses.textEnNiv: I will sing of your love and justice; to you, Lord , I will sing praise.
verses.textEnEsv: I will sing of steadfast love and justice; to you, O Lord , I will make music.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will sing of mercy and justice; To You, O Lord, I will sing praises.
verses.textEnNlt: I will sing of your love and justice, Lord . I will praise you with songs.
verses.textEnNasb: I will sing of mercy and justice; To You, Lord, I will sing praises.
verses.textEn: I will sing of your love and justice; to you, Lord , I will sing praise.

verses.textZh: 我要小心谨慎行正直的路； 你甚么时候才到我这里来呢？ 我要在我的家中，以正直的心行事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要小心谨慎行正直的路； 你甚么时候才到我这里来呢？ 我要在我的家中，以正直的心行事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要用智慧行完全的道。 你几时到我这里来呢？ 我要存完全的心行在我家中。
verses.textEnNiv: I will be careful to lead a blameless life— when will you come to me? I will conduct the affairs of my house with a blameless heart.
verses.textEnEsv: I will ponder the way that is blameless. Oh when will you come to me? I will walk with integrity of heart within my house;
verses.textEnNkjv: I will behave wisely in a perfect way. Oh, when will You come to me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be careful to live a blameless life— when will you come to help me? I will lead a life of integrity in my own home.
verses.textEnNasb: I will carefully attend to the blameless way. When will You come to me? I will walk within my house in the integrity of my heart.
verses.textEn: I will be careful to lead a blameless life— when will you come to me? I will conduct the affairs of my house with a blameless heart.

verses.textZh: 邪恶的事，我都不摆在眼前； 离开正路的人所作的事，我都恨恶， 决不容这些沾染我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 邪恶的事，我都不摆在眼前； 离开正路的人所作的事，我都恨恶， 决不容这些沾染我。
verses.textZhCuv: 邪僻的事，我都不摆在我眼前； 悖逆人所做的事，我甚恨恶， 不容沾在我身上。
verses.textEnNiv: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile. I hate what faithless people do; I will have no part in it.
verses.textEnEsv: I will not set before my eyes anything that is worthless. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will set nothing wicked before my eyes; I hate the work of those who fall away; It shall not cling to me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will refuse to look at anything vile and vulgar. I hate all who deal crookedly; I will have nothing to do with them.
verses.textEnNasb: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes; I hate the work of those who fall away; It shall not cling to me.
verses.textEn: I will not look with approval on anything that is vile. I hate what faithless people do; I will have no part in it.

verses.textZh: 狡诈的心思，我要远离； 邪恶的事，我不参与。
verses.textZhCnvs: 狡诈的心思，我要远离； 邪恶的事，我不参与。
verses.textZhCuv: 弯曲的心思，我必远离； 一切的恶人 ，我不认识。
verses.textEnNiv: The perverse of heart shall be far from me; I will have nothing to do with what is evil.
verses.textEnEsv: A perverse heart shall be far from me; I will know nothing of evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will not know wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: I will reject perverse ideas and stay away from every evil.
verses.textEnNasb: A perverse heart shall leave me; I will know no evil.
verses.textEn: The perverse of heart shall be far from me; I will have nothing to do with what is evil.

verses.textZh: 暗中诽谤邻舍的，我必把他灭绝； 眼目高傲，心里骄横的， 我必不容忍他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗中诽谤邻舍的，我必把他灭绝； 眼目高傲，心里骄横的， 我必不容忍他。
verses.textZhCuv: 在暗中谗谤他邻居的，我必将他灭绝； 眼目高傲、心里骄纵的，我必不容他。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever slanders their neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not tolerate.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever slanders his neighbor secretly I will destroy. Whoever has a haughty look and an arrogant heart I will not endure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever secretly slanders his neighbor, Him I will destroy; The one who has a haughty look and a proud heart, Him I will not endure.
verses.textEnNlt: I will not tolerate people who slander their neighbors. I will not endure conceit and pride.
verses.textEnNasb: Whoever secretly slanders his neighbor, him I will destroy; I will not endure one who has a haughty look and an arrogant heart.
verses.textEn: Whoever slanders their neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not tolerate.

verses.textZh: 我的眼目必看顾国中的诚实人， 使他们与我同住； 行为正直的， 必要侍候我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼目必看顾国中的诚实人， 使他们与我同住； 行为正直的， 必要侍候我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我眼要看国中的诚实人，叫他们与我同住； 行为完全的，他要伺候我。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; the one whose walk is blameless will minister to me.
verses.textEnEsv: I will look with favor on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way that is blameless shall minister to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eyes shallbe on the faithful of the land, That they may dwell with me; He who walks in a perfect way, He shall serve me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will search for faithful people to be my companions. Only those who are above reproach will be allowed to serve me.
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; One who walks in a blameless way is one who will serve me.
verses.textEn: My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; the one whose walk is blameless will minister to me.

verses.textZh: 行诡诈的，必不得住在我的家里； 说谎话的，必不能在我眼前坚立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行诡诈的，必不得住在我的家里； 说谎话的，必不能在我眼前坚立。
verses.textZhCuv: 行诡诈的，必不得住在我家里； 说谎话的，必不得立在我眼前。
verses.textEnNiv: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.
verses.textEnEsv: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who utters lies shall continue before my eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who works deceit shall not dwell within my house; He who tells lies shall not continue in my presence.
verses.textEnNlt: I will not allow deceivers to serve in my house, and liars will not stay in my presence.
verses.textEnNasb: One who practices deceit shall not dwell within my house; One who speaks lies shall not maintain his position before me.
verses.textEn: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.

verses.textZh: 我每日早晨必灭绝国中所有的恶人， 好把所有作孽的人都从耶和华的城里剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我每日早晨必灭绝国中所有的恶人， 好把所有作孽的人都从耶和华的城里剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 我每日早晨要灭绝国中所有的恶人， 好把一切作孽的从耶和华的城里剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: Every morning I will put to silence all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Morning by morning I will destroy all the wicked in the land, cutting off all the evildoers from the city of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Early I will destroy all the wicked of the land, That I may cut off all the evildoers from the city of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: My daily task will be to ferret out the wicked and free the city of the Lord from their grip.
verses.textEnNasb: Every morning I will destroy all the wicked of the land, So as to eliminate from the city of the Lord all those who do injustice.
verses.textEn: Every morning I will put to silence all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 困苦人沮丧的时候，在耶和华面前倾吐苦情的祷告。 耶和华啊！求你听我的祷告； 愿我的呼求达到你那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 困苦人沮丧的时候，在耶和华面前倾吐苦情的祷告。 耶和华啊！求你听我的祷告； 愿我的呼求达到你那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告， 容我的呼求达到你面前！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear my prayer, Lord ; let my cry for help come to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear my prayer, O Lord ; let my cry come to you!
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear my prayer, O Lord, And let my cry come to You.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , hear my prayer! Listen to my plea!
verses.textEnNasb: Hear my prayer, Lord! And let my cry for help come to You.
verses.textEn: Hear my prayer, Lord ; let my cry for help come to you.

verses.textZh: 我在患难的日子， 求你不要向我掩面； 我呼求的时候， 求你留心听我，并且迅速应允我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在患难的日子， 求你不要向我掩面； 我呼求的时候， 求你留心听我，并且迅速应允我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在急难的日子，求你向我侧耳； 不要向我掩面！ 我呼求的日子，求你快快应允我！
verses.textEnNiv: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress! Incline your ear to me; answer me speedily in the day when I call!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not hide Your face from me in the day of my trouble; Incline Your ear to me; In the day that I call, answer me speedily.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t turn away from me in my time of distress. Bend down to listen, and answer me quickly when I call to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not hide Your face from me on the day of my distress; Incline Your ear to me; On the day when I call answer me quickly.
verses.textEn: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.

verses.textZh: 因为我的年日好象烟一般消散； 我的骨头烧焦像炉中的炭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我的年日好象烟一般消散； 我的骨头烧焦像炉中的炭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，我的年日如烟云消灭； 我的骨头如火把烧着。
verses.textEnNiv: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.
verses.textEnEsv: For my days pass away like smoke, and my bones burn like a furnace.
verses.textEnNkjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, And my bones are burned like a hearth.
verses.textEnNlt: For my days disappear like smoke, and my bones burn like red-hot coals.
verses.textEnNasb: For my days have ended in smoke, And my bones have been scorched like a hearth.
verses.textEn: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.

verses.textZh: 我的心受创伤， 好象草一般枯干， 以致我连饭也忘了吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心受创伤， 好象草一般枯干， 以致我连饭也忘了吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心被伤，如草枯干， 甚至我忘记吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.
verses.textEnEsv: My heart is struck down like grass and has withered; I forget to eat my bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: My heart is stricken and withered like grass, So that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart is sick, withered like grass, and I have lost my appetite.
verses.textEnNasb: My heart has been struck like grass and has withered, Indeed, I forget to eat my bread.
verses.textEn: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.

verses.textZh: 因我唉哼的声音， 我就渐渐消瘦 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因我唉哼的声音， 我就渐渐消瘦 。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我唉哼的声音， 我的肉紧贴骨头。
verses.textEnNiv: In my distress I groan aloud and am reduced to skin and bones.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of my loud groaning my bones cling to my flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the sound of my groaning My bones cling to my skin.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of my groaning, I am reduced to skin and bones.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of the loudness of my groaning My bones cling to my flesh.
verses.textEn: In my distress I groan aloud and am reduced to skin and bones.

verses.textZh: 我像旷野的鹈鹕， 又像废墟里的猫头鹰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我像旷野的鹈鹕， 又像废墟里的猫头鹰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我如同旷野的鹈鹕； 我好像荒场的鸮鸟。
verses.textEnNiv: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
verses.textEnEsv: I am like a desert owl of the wilderness, like an owl of the waste places;
verses.textEnNkjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.textEnNlt: I am like an owl in the desert, like a little owl in a far-off wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: I resemble a pelican of the wilderness; I have become like an owl of the ruins.
verses.textEn: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.

verses.textZh: 我躺在床上警醒着， 就像屋顶上孤单的麻雀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我躺在床上警醒着， 就像屋顶上孤单的麻雀。
verses.textZhCuv: 我警醒不睡； 我像房顶上孤单的麻雀。
verses.textEnNiv: I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a roof.
verses.textEnEsv: I lie awake; I am like a lonely sparrow on the housetop.
verses.textEnNkjv: I lie awake, And am like a sparrow alone on the housetop.
verses.textEnNlt: I lie awake, lonely as a solitary bird on the roof.
verses.textEnNasb: I lie awake, I have become like a solitary bird on a housetop.
verses.textEn: I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a roof.

verses.textZh: 我的仇敌终日辱骂我； 嘲弄我的指着我赌咒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的仇敌终日辱骂我； 嘲弄我的指着我赌咒。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仇敌终日辱骂我； 向我猖狂的人指着我赌咒。
verses.textEnNiv: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.
verses.textEnEsv: All the day my enemies taunt me; those who deride me use my name for a curse.
verses.textEnNkjv: My enemies reproach me all day long; Those who deride me swear an oath against me.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies taunt me day after day. They mock and curse me.
verses.textEnNasb: My enemies have taunted me all day long; Those who deride me have used my name as a curse.
verses.textEn: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.

verses.textZh: 我吃炉灰像吃饭一样； 我所喝的与眼泪混和。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我吃炉灰像吃饭一样； 我所喝的与眼泪混和。
verses.textZhCuv: 我吃过炉灰，如同吃饭； 我所喝的与眼泪搀杂。
verses.textEnNiv: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears
verses.textEnEsv: For I eat ashes like bread and mingle tears with my drink,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.textEnNlt: I eat ashes for food. My tears run down into my drink
verses.textEnNasb: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mixed my drink with weeping
verses.textEn: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears

verses.textZh: 这都是因为你的愤恨和烈怒； 你把我举起来，又把我摔下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这都是因为你的愤恨和烈怒； 你把我举起来，又把我摔下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都因你的恼恨和忿怒； 你把我拾起来，又把我摔下去。
verses.textEnNiv: because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.
verses.textEnEsv: because of your indignation and anger; for you have taken me up and thrown me down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of Your indignation and Your wrath; For You have lifted me up and cast me away.
verses.textEnNlt: because of your anger and wrath. For you have picked me up and thrown me out.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of Your indignation and Your wrath; For You have lifted me up and thrown me away.
verses.textEn: because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.

verses.textZh: 我的年日好象日影偏斜， 我也好象草一般枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的年日好象日影偏斜， 我也好象草一般枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的年日如日影偏斜； 我也如草枯干。
verses.textEnNiv: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.
verses.textEnEsv: My days are like an evening shadow; I wither away like grass.
verses.textEnNkjv: My days are like a shadow that lengthens, And I wither away like grass.
verses.textEnNlt: My life passes as swiftly as the evening shadows. I am withering away like grass.
verses.textEnNasb: My days are like a lengthened shadow, And I wither away like grass.
verses.textEn: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你却永远坐着为王， 你可记念的名也必存到万代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你却永远坐着为王， 你可记念的名也必存到万代。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟你－耶和华必存到永远； 你可记念的名也存到万代。
verses.textEnNiv: But you, Lord , sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O Lord , are enthroned forever; you are remembered throughout all generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, O Lord, shall endure forever, And the remembrance of Your name to all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: But you, O Lord , will sit on your throne forever. Your fame will endure to every generation.
verses.textEnNasb: But You, Lord, remain forever, And Your name remains to all generations.
verses.textEn: But you, Lord , sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.

verses.textZh: 你要起来，怜悯锡安， 因为现在是恩待锡安的时候； 所定的日期已经到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要起来，怜悯锡安， 因为现在是恩待锡安的时候； 所定的日期已经到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必起来怜恤锡安， 因现在是可怜她的时候， 日期已经到了。
verses.textEnNiv: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.
verses.textEnEsv: You will arise and have pity on Zion; it is the time to favor her; the appointed time has come.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; For the time to favor her, Yes, the set time, has come.
verses.textEnNlt: You will arise and have mercy on Jerusalem — and now is the time to pity her, now is the time you promised to help.
verses.textEnNasb: You will arise and have compassion on Zion; For it is time to be gracious to her, For the appointed time has come.
verses.textEn: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.

verses.textZh: 因为你的众仆人喜爱它的石头， 爱惜它的尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你的众仆人喜爱它的石头， 爱惜它的尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的仆人原来喜悦她的石头， 可怜她的尘土。
verses.textEnNiv: For her stones are dear to your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.
verses.textEnEsv: For your servants hold her stones dear and have pity on her dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Your servants take pleasure in her stones, And show favor to her dust.
verses.textEnNlt: For your people love every stone in her walls and cherish even the dust in her streets.
verses.textEnNasb: Surely Your servants take pleasure in her stones, And feel pity for her dust.
verses.textEn: For her stones are dear to your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.

verses.textZh: 万国都必敬畏耶和华的名； 世上列王都敬畏你的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万国都必敬畏耶和华的名； 世上列王都敬畏你的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 列国要敬畏耶和华的名； 世上诸王都敬畏你的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: The nations will fear the name of the Lord , all the kings of the earth will revere your glory.
verses.textEnEsv: Nations will fear the name of the Lord , and all the kings of the earth will fear your glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the nations shall fear the name of the Lord, And all the kings of the earth Your glory.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the nations will tremble before the Lord . The kings of the earth will tremble before his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: So the nations will fear the name of the Lord, And all the kings of the earth, Your glory.
verses.textEn: The nations will fear the name of the Lord , all the kings of the earth will revere your glory.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华必建造锡安， 在他自己的荣耀里显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华必建造锡安， 在他自己的荣耀里显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华建造了锡安， 在他荣耀里显现。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord builds up Zion; he appears in his glory;
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord shall build up Zion; He shall appear in His glory.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord will rebuild Jerusalem. He will appear in his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord has built up Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
verses.textEn: For the Lord will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.

verses.textZh: 他要垂顾困苦人的祷告， 必不藐视他们的祈求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要垂顾困苦人的祷告， 必不藐视他们的祈求。
verses.textZhCuv: 他垂听穷人的祷告， 并不藐视他们的祈求。
verses.textEnNiv: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their plea.
verses.textEnEsv: he regards the prayer of the destitute and does not despise their prayer.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall regard the prayer of the destitute, And shall not despise their prayer.
verses.textEnNlt: He will listen to the prayers of the destitute. He will not reject their pleas.
verses.textEnNasb: He has turned His attention to the prayer of the destitute And has not despised their prayer.
verses.textEn: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their plea.

verses.textZh: 这些事要记下来，传给后代， 好使将来出生的人民可以赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事要记下来，传给后代， 好使将来出生的人民可以赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 这必为后代的人记下， 将来受造的民要赞美耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Let this be written for a future generation, that a people not yet created may praise the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: Let this be recorded for a generation to come, so that a people yet to be created may praise the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: This will be written for the generation to come, That a people yet to be created may praise the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Let this be recorded for future generations, so that a people not yet born will praise the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: This will be written for the generation to come, That a people yet to be created may praise the Lord:
verses.textEn: Let this be written for a future generation, that a people not yet created may praise the Lord :

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华从他至高的圣所里垂看， 从天上观看大地，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华从他至高的圣所里垂看， 从天上观看大地，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，他从至高的圣所垂看； 耶和华从天向地观察，
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord looked down from his sanctuary on high, from heaven he viewed the earth,
verses.textEnEsv: that he looked down from his holy height; from heaven the Lord looked at the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: For He looked down from the height of His sanctuary; From heaven the Lord viewed the earth,
verses.textEnNlt: Tell them the Lord looked down from his heavenly sanctuary. He looked down to earth from heaven
verses.textEnNasb: For He looked down from His holy height; From heaven the Lord looked upon the earth,
verses.textEn: "The Lord looked down from his sanctuary on high, from heaven he viewed the earth,

verses.textZh: 为要垂听被囚的人的叹息， 解救定了死罪的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要垂听被囚的人的叹息， 解救定了死罪的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 要垂听被囚之人的叹息， 要释放将要死的人，
verses.textEnNiv: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death."
verses.textEnEsv: to hear the groans of the prisoners, to set free those who were doomed to die,
verses.textEnNkjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner, To release those appointed to death,
verses.textEnNlt: to hear the groans of the prisoners, to release those condemned to die.
verses.textEnNasb: To hear the groaning of the prisoner, To set free those who were doomed to death,
verses.textEn: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death."

verses.textZh: 使人在锡安传扬耶和华的名， 在耶路撒冷传扬赞美他的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使人在锡安传扬耶和华的名， 在耶路撒冷传扬赞美他的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 使人在锡安传扬耶和华的名， 在耶路撒冷传扬赞美他的话，
verses.textEnNiv: So the name of the Lord will be declared in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem
verses.textEnEsv: that they may declare in Zion the name of the Lord , and in Jerusalem his praise,
verses.textEnNkjv: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNlt: And so the Lord ’s fame will be celebrated in Zion, his praises in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNasb: So that people may tell of the name of the Lord in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem,
verses.textEn: So the name of the Lord will be declared in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem

verses.textZh: 那时，万民和万国必一同聚集， 要事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，万民和万国必一同聚集， 要事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是在万民和列国 聚会事奉耶和华的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to worship the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: when multitudes gather together and kingdoms come to worship the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
verses.textEn: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华在我壮年的时候，使我的力量衰弱， 缩短我的年日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在我壮年的时候，使我的力量衰弱， 缩短我的年日。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我的力量中道衰弱， 使我的年日短少。
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of my life he broke my strength; he cut short my days.
verses.textEnEsv: He has broken my strength in midcourse; he has shortened my days.
verses.textEnNkjv: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.
verses.textEnNlt: He broke my strength in midlife, cutting short my days.
verses.textEnNasb: He has broken my strength in the way; He has shortened my days.
verses.textEn: In the course of my life he broke my strength; he cut short my days.

verses.textZh: 所以我说："我的神啊！ 求你不要使我中年去世， 你的年数万代无疆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我说："我的神啊！ 求你不要使我中年去世， 你的年数万代无疆。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：我的神啊， 不要使我中年去世。 你的年数世世无穷！
verses.textEnNiv: So I said: "Do not take me away, my God, in the midst of my days; your years go on through all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: "O my God," I say, "take me not away in the midst of my days— you whose years endure throughout all generations!"
verses.textEnNkjv: I said, "O my God, Do not take me away in the midst of my days; Your years are throughout all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: But I cried to him, "O my God, who lives forever, don’t take my life while I am so young!
verses.textEnNasb: I say, "My God, do not take me away in the middle of my days, Your years are throughout all generations.
verses.textEn: So I said: "Do not take me away, my God, in the midst of my days; your years go on through all generations.

verses.textZh: 你起初立了地的根基； 天也是你手的工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你起初立了地的根基； 天也是你手的工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 你起初立了地的根基； 天也是你手所造的。
verses.textEnNiv: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Of old you laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of old You laid the foundation of the earth, And the heavens are the work of Your hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Long ago you laid the foundation of the earth and made the heavens with your hands.
verses.textEnNasb: "In time of old You founded the earth, And the heavens are the work of Your hands.
verses.textEn: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

verses.textZh: 天地都要毁灭，你却长存； 天地都要像衣服一样渐渐残旧； 你要更换天地如同更换衣物一样， 天地就被更换。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天地都要毁灭，你却长存； 天地都要像衣服一样渐渐残旧； 你要更换天地如同更换衣物一样， 天地就被更换。
verses.textZhCuv: 天地都要灭没，你却要长存； 天地都要如外衣渐渐旧了。 你要将天地如里衣更换， 天地就都改变了。
verses.textEnNiv: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them and they will be discarded.
verses.textEnEsv: They will perish, but you will remain; they will all wear out like a garment. You will change them like a robe, and they will pass away,
verses.textEnNkjv: They will perish, but You will endure; Yes, they will all grow old like a garment; Like a cloak You will change them, And they will be changed.
verses.textEnNlt: They will perish, but you remain forever; they will wear out like old clothing. You will change them like a garment and discard them.
verses.textEnNasb: " Even they will perish, but You endure; All of them will wear out like a garment; Like clothing You will change them and they will pass away.
verses.textEn: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them and they will be discarded.

verses.textZh: 只有你永不改变， 你的年数也没有穷尽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有你永不改变， 你的年数也没有穷尽。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有你永不改变； 你的年数没有穷尽。
verses.textEnNiv: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.
verses.textEnEsv: but you are the same, and your years have no end.
verses.textEnNkjv: But You are the same, And Your years will have no end.
verses.textEnNlt: But you are always the same; you will live forever.
verses.textEnNasb: "But You are the same, And Your years will not come to an end.
verses.textEn: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.

verses.textZh: 你仆人的子孙必安然居住； 他们的后裔必在你面前坚立。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你仆人的子孙必安然居住； 他们的后裔必在你面前坚立。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你仆人的子孙要长存； 他们的后裔要坚立在你面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The children of your servants will live in your presence; their descendants will be established before you."
verses.textEnEsv: The children of your servants shall dwell secure; their offspring shall be established before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of Your servants will continue, And their descendants will be established before You."
verses.textEnNlt: The children of your people will live in security. Their children’s children will thrive in your presence."
verses.textEnNasb: "The children of Your servants will continue, And their descendants will be established before You."
verses.textEn: The children of your servants will live in your presence; their descendants will be established before you."

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 我的心哪！你要称颂耶和华； 在我里面的一切，都要称颂他的圣名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 我的心哪！你要称颂耶和华； 在我里面的一切，都要称颂他的圣名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 凡在我里面的，也要称颂他的圣名！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord , my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.
verses.textEnEsv: Bless the Lord , O my soul, and all that is within me, bless his holy name!
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name!
verses.textEnNlt: Let all that I am praise the Lord ; with my whole heart, I will praise his holy name.
verses.textEnNasb: Bless the Lord, my soul, And all that is within me, bless His holy name.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord , my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

verses.textZh: 我的心哪！你要称颂耶和华； 不可忘记他的一切恩惠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心哪！你要称颂耶和华； 不可忘记他的一切恩惠。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 不可忘记他的一切恩惠！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord , my soul, and forget not all his benefits—
verses.textEnEsv: Bless the Lord , O my soul, and forget not all his benefits,
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits:
verses.textEnNlt: Let all that I am praise the Lord ; may I never forget the good things he does for me.
verses.textEnNasb: Bless the Lord, my soul, And do not forget any of His benefits;
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord , my soul, and forget not all his benefits—

verses.textZh: 他赦免你的一切罪孽， 医治你的一切疾病；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他赦免你的一切罪孽， 医治你的一切疾病；
verses.textZhCuv: 他赦免你的一切罪孽， 医治你的一切疾病。
verses.textEnNiv: who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases,
verses.textEnEsv: who forgives all your iniquity, who heals all your diseases,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who forgives all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases,
verses.textEnNlt: He forgives all my sins and heals all my diseases.
verses.textEnNasb: Who pardons all your guilt, Who heals all your diseases;
verses.textEn: who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases,

verses.textZh: 他救赎你的性命脱离死亡， 以慈爱和怜悯作你的冠冕；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救赎你的性命脱离死亡， 以慈爱和怜悯作你的冠冕；
verses.textZhCuv: 他救赎你的命脱离死亡， 以仁爱和慈悲为你的冠冕。
verses.textEnNiv: who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion,
verses.textEnEsv: who redeems your life from the pit, who crowns you with steadfast love and mercy,
