verses.textEnNkjv: Who redeems your life from destruction, Who crowns you with lovingkindness and tender mercies,
verses.textEnNlt: He redeems me from death and crowns me with love and tender mercies.
verses.textEnNasb: Who redeems your life from the pit, Who crowns you with favor and compassion;
verses.textEn: who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion,

verses.textZh: 他以福乐使你的心愿满足， 以致你好象鹰一般恢复青春的活力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以福乐使你的心愿满足， 以致你好象鹰一般恢复青春的活力。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用美物使你所愿的得以知足， 以致你如鹰返老还童。
verses.textEnNiv: who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.textEnEsv: who satisfies you with good so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who satisfies your mouth with good things, Sothat your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.textEnNlt: He fills my life with good things. My youth is renewed like the eagle’s!
verses.textEnNasb: Who satisfies your years with good things, So that your youth is renewed like the eagle.
verses.textEn: who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

verses.textZh: 耶和华施行公义， 为所有受欺压的人主持公道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华施行公义， 为所有受欺压的人主持公道。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华施行公义， 为一切受屈的人伸冤。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord works righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord works righteousness and justice for all who are oppressed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord executes righteousness And justice for all who are oppressed.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gives righteousness and justice to all who are treated unfairly.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord performs righteous deeds And judgments for all who are oppressed.
verses.textEn: The Lord works righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.

verses.textZh: 他向摩西指示自己的道路， 向以色列人显明自己的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向摩西指示自己的道路， 向以色列人显明自己的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使摩西知道他的法则， 叫以色列人晓得他的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel:
verses.textEnEsv: He made known his ways to Moses, his acts to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made known His ways to Moses, His acts to the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He revealed his character to Moses and his deeds to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel:

verses.textZh: 耶和华有怜悯，有恩典， 不轻易发怒，并且有丰盛的慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华有怜悯，有恩典， 不轻易发怒，并且有丰盛的慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华有怜悯，有恩典， 不轻易发怒，且有丰盛的慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abounding in mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is compassionate and merciful, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is compassionate and gracious, Slow to anger and abounding in mercy.
verses.textEn: The Lord is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.

verses.textZh: 他不长久责备， 也不永远怀怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不长久责备， 也不永远怀怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不长久责备， 也不永远怀怒。
verses.textEnNiv: He will not always accuse, nor will he harbor his anger forever;
verses.textEnEsv: He will not always chide, nor will he keep his anger forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not always strive withus, Nor will He keep Hisanger forever.
verses.textEnNlt: He will not constantly accuse us, nor remain angry forever.
verses.textEnNasb: He will not always contend with us, Nor will He keep His anger forever.
verses.textEn: He will not always accuse, nor will he harbor his anger forever;

verses.textZh: 他没有按着我们的罪过待我们， 也没有照着我们的罪孽报应我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他没有按着我们的罪过待我们， 也没有照着我们的罪孽报应我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他没有按我们的罪过待我们， 也没有照我们的罪孽报应我们。
verses.textEnNiv: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.
verses.textEnEsv: He does not deal with us according to our sins, nor repay us according to our iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, Nor punished us according to our iniquities.
verses.textEnNlt: He does not punish us for all our sins; he does not deal harshly with us, as we deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, Nor rewarded us according to our guilty deeds.
verses.textEn: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.

verses.textZh: 天离地有多高， 他的慈爱向敬畏他的人也有多大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天离地有多高， 他的慈爱向敬畏他的人也有多大。
verses.textZhCuv: 天离地何等的高， 他的慈爱向敬畏他的人也是何等的大！
verses.textEnNiv: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him;
verses.textEnEsv: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his steadfast love toward those who fear him;
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is His mercy toward those who fear Him;
verses.textEnNlt: For his unfailing love toward those who fear him is as great as the height of the heavens above the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, So great is His mercy toward those who fear Him.
verses.textEn: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him;

verses.textZh: 东离西有多远， 他使我们的过犯离我们也有多远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东离西有多远， 他使我们的过犯离我们也有多远。
verses.textZhCuv: 东离西有多远， 他叫我们的过犯离我们也有多远！
verses.textEnNiv: as far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.textEnEsv: as far as the east is from the west, so far does he remove our transgressions from us.
verses.textEnNkjv: As far as the east is from the west, So far has He removed our transgressions from us.
verses.textEnNlt: He has removed our sins as far from us as the east is from the west.
verses.textEnNasb: As far as the east is from the west, So far has He removed our wrongdoings from us.
verses.textEn: as far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.textZh: 父亲怎样怜恤儿子， 耶和华也照样怜恤敬畏他的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 父亲怎样怜恤儿子， 耶和华也照样怜恤敬畏他的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 父亲怎样怜恤他的儿女， 耶和华也怎样怜恤敬畏他的人！
verses.textEnNiv: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him;
verses.textEnEsv: As a father shows compassion to his children, so the Lord shows compassion to those who fear him.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a father pities his children, So the Lord pities those who fear Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is like a father to his children, tender and compassionate to those who fear him.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as a father has compassion on his children, So the Lord has compassion on those who fear Him.
verses.textEn: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him;

verses.textZh: 因为他知道我们的本体， 记得我们不过是尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他知道我们的本体， 记得我们不过是尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他知道我们的本体， 思念我们不过是尘土。
verses.textEnNiv: for he knows how we are formed, he remembers that we are dust.
verses.textEnEsv: For he knows our frame; he remembers that we are dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He knows our frame; He remembers that we are dust.
verses.textEnNlt: For he knows how weak we are; he remembers we are only dust.
verses.textEnNasb: For He Himself knows our form; He is mindful that we are nothing but dust.
verses.textEn: for he knows how we are formed, he remembers that we are dust.

verses.textZh: 至于世人，他的年日好象草一般； 他又像野地繁茂的花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于世人，他的年日好象草一般； 他又像野地繁茂的花。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于世人，他的年日如草一样。 他发旺如野地的花，
verses.textEnNiv: The life of mortals is like grass, they flourish like a flower of the field;
verses.textEnEsv: As for man, his days are like grass; he flourishes like a flower of the field;
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor man, his days are like grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
verses.textEnNlt: Our days on earth are like grass; like wildflowers, we bloom and die.
verses.textEnNasb: As for man, his days are like grass; Like a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
verses.textEn: The life of mortals is like grass, they flourish like a flower of the field;

verses.textZh: 经风一吹，就归无有； 他原来的地方再不认识他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经风一吹，就归无有； 他原来的地方再不认识他。
verses.textZhCuv: 经风一吹，便归无有； 它的原处也不再认识它。
verses.textEnNiv: the wind blows over it and it is gone, and its place remembers it no more.
verses.textEnEsv: for the wind passes over it, and it is gone, and its place knows it no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone, And its place remembers it no more.
verses.textEnNlt: The wind blows, and we are gone— as though we had never been here.
verses.textEnNasb: When the wind has passed over it, it is no more, And its place no longer knows about it.
verses.textEn: the wind blows over it and it is gone, and its place remembers it no more.

verses.textZh: 但从亘古到永远，耶和华的慈爱临到敬畏他的人； 他的公义也归于他们的子子孙孙，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但从亘古到永远，耶和华的慈爱临到敬畏他的人； 他的公义也归于他们的子子孙孙，
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华的慈爱归于敬畏他的人， 从亘古到永远； 他的公义也归于子子孙孙－
verses.textEnNiv: But from everlasting to everlasting the Lord ’s love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children’s children—
verses.textEnEsv: But the steadfast love of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear him, and his righteousness to children’s children,
verses.textEnNkjv: But the mercy of the Lordis from everlasting to everlasting On those who fear Him, And His righteousness to children’s children,
verses.textEnNlt: But the love of the Lord remains forever with those who fear him. His salvation extends to the children’s children
verses.textEnNasb: But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting for those who fear Him, And His justice to the children’s children,
verses.textEn: But from everlasting to everlasting the Lord ’s love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children’s children—

verses.textZh: 就是那些谨守他的约， 记住他的训词，并且遵行的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是那些谨守他的约， 记住他的训词，并且遵行的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是那些遵守他的约、 记念他的训词而遵行的人。
verses.textEnNiv: with those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: to those who keep his covenant and remember to do his commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: To such as keep His covenant, And to those who remember His commandments to do them.
verses.textEnNlt: of those who are faithful to his covenant, of those who obey his commandments!
verses.textEnNasb: To those who keep His covenant And remember His precepts, so as to do them.
verses.textEn: with those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his precepts.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在天上立定宝座， 他的王权统管万有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在天上立定宝座， 他的王权统管万有。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在天上立定宝座； 他的权柄 统管万有。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has established his throne in the heavens, and his kingdom rules over all.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has established His throne in heaven, And His kingdom rules over all.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has made the heavens his throne; from there he rules over everything.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has established His throne in the heavens, And His sovereignty rules over all.
verses.textEn: The Lord has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.

verses.textZh: 你们作他天使的， 就是那些大有能力，行他所吩咐， 以及听从他命令的，都要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作他天使的， 就是那些大有能力，行他所吩咐， 以及听从他命令的，都要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 听从他命令、成全他旨意、 有大能的天使，都要称颂耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord , you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, who obey his word.
verses.textEnEsv: Bless the Lord , O you his angels, you mighty ones who do his word, obeying the voice of his word!
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless the Lord, you His angels, Who excel in strength, who do His word, Heeding the voice of His word.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , you angels, you mighty ones who carry out his plans, listening for each of his commands.
verses.textEnNasb: Bless the Lord, you His angels, Mighty in strength, who perform His word, Obeying the voice of His word!
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord , you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, who obey his word.

verses.textZh: 你们作他的众军， 作他的仆役，遵行他旨意的， 都要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作他的众军， 作他的仆役，遵行他旨意的， 都要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作他的诸军，作他的仆役， 行他所喜悦的，都要称颂耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord , all his heavenly hosts, you his servants who do his will.
verses.textEnEsv: Bless the Lord , all his hosts, his ministers, who do his will!
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless the Lord, all you His hosts, You ministers of His, who do His pleasure.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, praise the Lord , you armies of angels who serve him and do his will!
verses.textEnNasb: Bless the Lord, all you His angels, You who serve Him, doing His will.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord , all his heavenly hosts, you his servants who do his will.

verses.textZh: 你们一切被他所造的， 在他统治的各处，都要称颂耶和华。 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们一切被他所造的， 在他统治的各处，都要称颂耶和华。 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们一切被他造的， 在他所治理的各处， 都要称颂耶和华！ 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord , all his works everywhere in his dominion. Praise the Lord , my soul.
verses.textEnEsv: Bless the Lord , all his works, in all places of his dominion. Bless the Lord , O my soul!
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless the Lord, all His works, In all places of His dominion. Bless the Lord, O my soul!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , everything he has created, everything in all his kingdom. Let all that I am praise the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Bless the Lord, all you works of His, In all places of His dominion; Bless the Lord, my soul!
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord , all his works everywhere in his dominion. Praise the Lord , my soul.

verses.textZh: 我的心哪！你要称颂耶和华； 耶和华我的神啊！你真伟大； 你以尊荣和威严为衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心哪！你要称颂耶和华； 耶和华我的神啊！你真伟大； 你以尊荣和威严为衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！ 耶和华－我的神啊，你为至大！ 你以尊荣威严为衣服，
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord , my soul. Lord my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.
verses.textEnEsv: Bless the Lord , O my soul! O Lord my God, you are very great! You are clothed with splendor and majesty,
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul! O Lord my God, You are very great: You are clothed with honor and majesty,
verses.textEnNlt: Let all that I am praise the Lord . O Lord my God, how great you are! You are robed with honor and majesty.
verses.textEnNasb: Bless the Lord, my soul! Lord my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty,
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord , my soul. Lord my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.

verses.textZh: 你披上亮光好象披上外袍； 展开诸天好象铺张帐幔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你披上亮光好象披上外袍； 展开诸天好象铺张帐幔。
verses.textZhCuv: 披上亮光，如披外袍， 铺张穹苍，如铺幔子，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord wraps himself in light as with a garment; he stretches out the heavens like a tent
verses.textEnEsv: covering yourself with light as with a garment, stretching out the heavens like a tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who cover Yourself with light as with a garment, Who stretch out the heavens like a curtain.
verses.textEnNlt: You are dressed in a robe of light. You stretch out the starry curtain of the heavens;
verses.textEnNasb: Covering Yourself with light as with a cloak, Stretching out heaven like a tent curtain.
verses.textEn: The Lord wraps himself in light as with a garment; he stretches out the heavens like a tent

verses.textZh: 你在水上立起你楼阁的栋梁； 你以云彩为战车； 乘驾风的翅膀而行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在水上立起你楼阁的栋梁； 你以云彩为战车； 乘驾风的翅膀而行。
verses.textZhCuv: 在水中立楼阁的栋梁， 用云彩为车辇， 藉着风的翅膀而行，
verses.textEnNiv: and lays the beams of his upper chambers on their waters. He makes the clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnEsv: He lays the beams of his chambers on the waters; he makes the clouds his chariot; he rides on the wings of the wind;
verses.textEnNkjv: He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters, Who makes the clouds His chariot, Who walks on the wings of the wind,
verses.textEnNlt: you lay out the rafters of your home in the rain clouds. You make the clouds your chariot; you ride upon the wings of the wind.
verses.textEnNasb: He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters; He makes the clouds His chariot; He walks on the wings of the wind;
verses.textEn: and lays the beams of his upper chambers on their waters. He makes the clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.

verses.textZh: 你用风作你的使者， 用火焰作你的仆役。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你用风作你的使者， 用火焰作你的仆役。
verses.textZhCuv: 以风为使者， 以火焰为仆役，
verses.textEnNiv: He makes winds his messengers, flames of fire his servants.
verses.textEnEsv: he makes his messengers winds, his ministers a flaming fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who makes His angels spirits, His ministers a flame of fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The winds are your messengers; flames of fire are your servants.
verses.textEnNasb: He makes the winds His messengers, Flaming fire His ministers.
verses.textEn: He makes winds his messengers, flames of fire his servants.

verses.textZh: 你把大地坚立在根基上， 使地永永远远不动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把大地坚立在根基上， 使地永永远远不动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 将地立在根基上， 使地永不动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.
verses.textEnEsv: He set the earth on its foundations, so that it should never be moved.
verses.textEnNkjv: Youwho laid the foundations of the earth, So that it should not be moved forever,
verses.textEnNlt: You placed the world on its foundation so it would never be moved.
verses.textEnNasb: He established the earth upon its foundations, So that it will not totter forever and ever.
verses.textEn: He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.

verses.textZh: 你用深水像衣服一般覆盖大地， 使众水高过群山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你用深水像衣服一般覆盖大地， 使众水高过群山。
verses.textZhCuv: 你用深水遮盖地面，犹如衣裳； 诸水高过山岭。
verses.textEnNiv: You covered it with the watery depths as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.textEnEsv: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.textEnNkjv: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; The waters stood above the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: You clothed the earth with floods of water, water that covered even the mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: You covered it with the deep sea as with a garment; The waters were standing above the mountains.
verses.textEn: You covered it with the watery depths as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.textZh: 因你的斥责，水就退去； 因你的雷声，水就奔逃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你的斥责，水就退去； 因你的雷声，水就奔逃。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的斥责一发，水便奔逃； 你的雷声一发，水便奔流。
verses.textEnNiv: But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;
verses.textEnEsv: At your rebuke they fled; at the sound of your thunder they took to flight.
verses.textEnNkjv: At Your rebuke they fled; At the voice of Your thunder they hastened away.
verses.textEnNlt: At your command, the water fled; at the sound of your thunder, it hurried away.
verses.textEnNasb: They fled from Your rebuke, At the sound of Your thunder they hurried away.
verses.textEn: But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;

verses.textZh: 众水流经群山，向下流往众谷， 流到你为它们指定的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众水流经群山，向下流往众谷， 流到你为它们指定的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸山升上，诸谷沉下 ， 归你为它所安定之地。
verses.textEnNiv: they flowed over the mountains, they went down into the valleys, to the place you assigned for them.
verses.textEnEsv: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down to the place that you appointed for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They went up over the mountains; They went down into the valleys, To the place which You founded for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Mountains rose and valleys sank to the levels you decreed.
verses.textEnNasb: The mountains rose; the valleys sank down To the place which You established for them.
verses.textEn: they flowed over the mountains, they went down into the valleys, to the place you assigned for them.

verses.textZh: 你定了界限，使众水不能越过； 它们不再转回掩盖大地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你定了界限，使众水不能越过； 它们不再转回掩盖大地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你定了界限，使水不能过去， 不再转回遮盖地面。
verses.textEnNiv: You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: You set a boundary that they may not pass, so that they might not again cover the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, That they may not return to cover the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you set a firm boundary for the seas, so they would never again cover the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: You set a boundary so that they will not pass over, So that they will not return to cover the earth.
verses.textEn: You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.

verses.textZh: 你使泉源在山谷中涌流， 流经群山中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你使泉源在山谷中涌流， 流经群山中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使泉源涌在山谷， 流在山间，
verses.textEnNiv: He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.
verses.textEnEsv: You make springs gush forth in the valleys; they flow between the hills;
verses.textEnNkjv: He sends the springs into the valleys; They flow among the hills.
verses.textEnNlt: You make springs pour water into the ravines, so streams gush down from the mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: He sends forth springs in the valleys; They flow between the mountains;
verses.textEn: He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.

verses.textZh: 使野地所有的走兽有水喝， 野驴得以解渴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使野地所有的走兽有水喝， 野驴得以解渴。
verses.textZhCuv: 使野地的走兽有水喝， 野驴得解其渴。
verses.textEnNiv: They give water to all the beasts of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.textEnEsv: they give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.textEnNkjv: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.textEnNlt: They provide water for all the animals, and the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.textEnNasb: They give drink to every animal of the field; The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.textEn: They give water to all the beasts of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

verses.textZh: 天上的飞鸟在水边住宿， 在树枝上鸣叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天上的飞鸟在水边住宿， 在树枝上鸣叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 天上的飞鸟在水旁住宿， 在树枝上啼叫。
verses.textEnNiv: The birds of the sky nest by the waters; they sing among the branches.
verses.textEnEsv: Beside them the birds of the heavens dwell; they sing among the branches.
verses.textEnNkjv: By them the birds of the heavens have their home; They sing among the branches.
verses.textEnNlt: The birds nest beside the streams and sing among the branches of the trees.
verses.textEnNasb: The birds of the sky dwell beside them; They lift up their voices from among the branches.
verses.textEn: The birds of the sky nest by the waters; they sing among the branches.

verses.textZh: 你从自己的楼阁中浇灌群山， 因你所作的事的果效，大地就丰足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你从自己的楼阁中浇灌群山， 因你所作的事的果效，大地就丰足。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从楼阁中浇灌山岭； 因他作为的功效，地就丰足。
verses.textEnNiv: He waters the mountains from his upper chambers; the land is satisfied by the fruit of his work.
verses.textEnEsv: From your lofty abode you water the mountains; the earth is satisfied with the fruit of your work.
verses.textEnNkjv: He waters the hills from His upper chambers; The earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.
verses.textEnNlt: You send rain on the mountains from your heavenly home, and you fill the earth with the fruit of your labor.
verses.textEnNasb: He waters the mountains from His upper chambers; The earth is satisfied with the fruit of His works.
verses.textEn: He waters the mountains from his upper chambers; the land is satisfied by the fruit of his work.

verses.textZh: 你为了牲畜使青草滋生， 为了人的需用使蔬菜生长， 使粮食从地里生出；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为了牲畜使青草滋生， 为了人的需用使蔬菜生长， 使粮食从地里生出；
verses.textZhCuv: 他使草生长，给六畜吃， 使菜蔬发长，供给人用， 使人从地里能得食物，
verses.textEnNiv: He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for people to cultivate— bringing forth food from the earth:
verses.textEnEsv: You cause the grass to grow for the livestock and plants for man to cultivate, that he may bring forth food from the earth
verses.textEnNkjv: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, And vegetation for the service of man, That he may bring forth food from the earth,
verses.textEnNlt: You cause grass to grow for the livestock and plants for people to use. You allow them to produce food from the earth—
verses.textEnNasb: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, And vegetation for the labor of mankind, So that they may produce food from the earth,
verses.textEn: He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for people to cultivate— bringing forth food from the earth:

verses.textZh: 又有酒使人心欢喜， 有油使人容光焕发， 有粮加添人的心力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有酒使人心欢喜， 有油使人容光焕发， 有粮加添人的心力。
verses.textZhCuv: 又得酒能悦人心， 得油能润人面， 得粮能养人心。
verses.textEnNiv: wine that gladdens human hearts, oil to make their faces shine, and bread that sustains their hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: and wine to gladden the heart of man, oil to make his face shine and bread to strengthen man’s heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And wine that makes glad the heart of man, Oil to make his face shine, And bread which strengthens man’s heart.
verses.textEnNlt: wine to make them glad, olive oil to soothe their skin, and bread to give them strength.
verses.textEnNasb: And wine, which makes a human heart cheerful, So that he makes his face gleam with oil, And food, which sustains a human heart.
verses.textEn: wine that gladdens human hearts, oil to make their faces shine, and bread that sustains their hearts.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的树，就是他所栽种的黎巴嫩香柏树， 都得到了充分的灌溉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的树，就是他所栽种的黎巴嫩香柏树， 都得到了充分的灌溉。
verses.textZhCuv: 佳美的树木，就是黎巴嫩的香柏树， 是耶和华所栽种的，都满了汁浆。
verses.textEnNiv: The trees of the Lord are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
verses.textEnEsv: The trees of the Lord are watered abundantly, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
verses.textEnNkjv: The trees of the Lord are full ofsap, The cedars of Lebanon which He planted,
verses.textEnNlt: The trees of the Lord are well cared for— the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
verses.textEnNasb: The trees of the Lord drink their fill, The cedars of Lebanon which He planted,
verses.textEn: The trees of the Lord are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.

verses.textZh: 雀鸟在上面筑巢； 至于鹤，松树是牠的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雀鸟在上面筑巢； 至于鹤，松树是牠的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 雀鸟在其上搭窝； 至于鹤，松树是它的房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: There the birds make their nests; the stork has its home in the junipers.
verses.textEnEsv: In them the birds build their nests; the stork has her home in the fir trees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Where the birds make their nests; The stork has her home in the fir trees.
verses.textEnNlt: There the birds make their nests, and the storks make their homes in the cypresses.
verses.textEnNasb: Where the birds build their nests, And the stork, whose home is the juniper trees.
verses.textEn: There the birds make their nests; the stork has its home in the junipers.

verses.textZh: 高山是野山羊的住所； 岩石是石貛藏身的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 高山是野山羊的住所； 岩石是石貛藏身的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 高山为野山羊的住所； 岩石为沙番的藏处。
verses.textEnNiv: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the hyrax.
verses.textEnEsv: The high mountains are for the wild goats; the rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.textEnNkjv: The high hills are for the wild goats; The cliffs are a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.textEnNlt: High in the mountains live the wild goats, and the rocks form a refuge for the hyraxes.
verses.textEnNasb: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The cliffs are a refuge for the rock hyrax.
verses.textEn: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the hyrax.

verses.textZh: 你造月亮为定节令； 太阳知道何时沉落。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你造月亮为定节令； 太阳知道何时沉落。
verses.textZhCuv: 你安置月亮为定节令； 日头自知沉落。
verses.textEnNiv: He made the moon to mark the seasons, and the sun knows when to go down.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows its time for setting.
verses.textEnNkjv: He appointed the moon for seasons; The sun knows its going down.
verses.textEnNlt: You made the moon to mark the seasons, and the sun knows when to set.
verses.textEnNasb: He made the moon for the seasons; The sun knows the place of its setting.
verses.textEn: He made the moon to mark the seasons, and the sun knows when to go down.

verses.textZh: 你安设黑暗，有了晚上， 林中的百兽就都爬出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你安设黑暗，有了晚上， 林中的百兽就都爬出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你造黑暗为夜， 林中的百兽就都爬出来。
verses.textEnNiv: You bring darkness, it becomes night, and all the beasts of the forest prowl.
verses.textEnEsv: You make darkness, and it is night, when all the beasts of the forest creep about.
verses.textEnNkjv: You make darkness, and it is night, In which all the beasts of the forest creep about.
verses.textEnNlt: You send the darkness, and it becomes night, when all the forest animals prowl about.
verses.textEnNasb: You appoint darkness and it becomes night, In which all the animals of the forest prowl about.
verses.textEn: You bring darkness, it becomes night, and all the beasts of the forest prowl.

verses.textZh: 少壮狮子吼叫觅食， 要寻求从神而来的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 少壮狮子吼叫觅食， 要寻求从神而来的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 少壮狮子吼叫，要抓食， 向神寻求食物。
verses.textEnNiv: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
verses.textEnEsv: The young lions roar for their prey, seeking their food from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the young lions roar for their prey, stalking the food provided by God.
verses.textEnNasb: The young lions roar for their prey And seek their food from God.
verses.textEn: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

verses.textZh: 太阳升起的时候， 牠们就躲避， 回到自己的洞穴躺卧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 太阳升起的时候， 牠们就躲避， 回到自己的洞穴躺卧。
verses.textZhCuv: 日头一出，兽便躲避， 卧在洞里。
verses.textEnNiv: The sun rises, and they steal away; they return and lie down in their dens.
verses.textEnEsv: When the sun rises, they steal away and lie down in their dens.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the sun rises, they gather together And lie down in their dens.
verses.textEnNlt: At dawn they slink back into their dens to rest.
verses.textEnNasb: When the sun rises they withdraw, And they lie down in their dens.
verses.textEn: The sun rises, and they steal away; they return and lie down in their dens.

verses.textZh: 人出去作工， 劳碌直到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人出去作工， 劳碌直到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 人出去做工， 劳碌直到晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then people go out to their work, to their labor until evening.
verses.textEnEsv: Man goes out to his work and to his labor until the evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: Man goes out to his work And to his labor until the evening.
verses.textEnNlt: Then people go off to their work, where they labor until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: A person goes out to his work And to his labor until evening.
verses.textEn: Then people go out to their work, to their labor until evening.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你所造的真是众多。 它们都是你用智慧造成的； 全地充满你所造的东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你所造的真是众多。 它们都是你用智慧造成的； 全地充满你所造的东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你所造的何其多！ 都是你用智慧造成的； 遍地满了你的丰富。
verses.textEnNiv: How many are your works, Lord ! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , how manifold are your works! In wisdom have you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, how manifold are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all. The earth is full of Your possessions—
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , what a variety of things you have made! In wisdom you have made them all. The earth is full of your creatures.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, how many are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all; The earth is full of Your possessions.
verses.textEn: How many are your works, Lord ! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

verses.textZh: 那里有海，又大又广； 海里有无数的活物， 大小活物都有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里有海，又大又广； 海里有无数的活物， 大小活物都有。
verses.textZhCuv: 那里有海，又大又广； 其中有无数的动物， 大小活物都有。
verses.textEnNiv: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number— living things both large and small.
verses.textEnEsv: Here is the sea, great and wide, which teems with creatures innumerable, living things both small and great.
verses.textEnNkjv: This great and wide sea, In which are innumerable teeming things, Living things both small and great.
verses.textEnNlt: Here is the ocean, vast and wide, teeming with life of every kind, both large and small.
verses.textEnNasb: There is the sea, great and broad, In which are swarms without number, Animals both small and great.
verses.textEn: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number— living things both large and small.

verses.textZh: 那里有船只往来航行， 有你所造的大鱼， 在海里嬉戏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里有船只往来航行， 有你所造的大鱼， 在海里嬉戏。
verses.textZhCuv: 那里有船行走， 有你所造的鳄鱼游泳在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: There the ships go to and fro, and Leviathan, which you formed to frolic there.
verses.textEnEsv: There go the ships, and Leviathan, which you formed to play in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: There the ships sail about; Thereis that Leviathan Which You have made to play there.
verses.textEnNlt: See the ships sailing along, and Leviathan, which you made to play in the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: The ships move along there, And Leviathan, which You have formed to have fun in it.
verses.textEn: There the ships go to and fro, and Leviathan, which you formed to frolic there.

verses.textZh: 这些活物都仰望你， 仰望你按时赐给牠们食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些活物都仰望你， 仰望你按时赐给牠们食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都仰望你按时给它食物。
verses.textEnNiv: All creatures look to you to give them their food at the proper time.
verses.textEnEsv: These all look to you, to give them their food in due season.
verses.textEnNkjv: These all wait for You, That You may give them their food in due season.
verses.textEnNlt: They all depend on you to give them food as they need it.
verses.textEnNasb: They all wait for You To give them their food in due season.
verses.textEn: All creatures look to you to give them their food at the proper time.

verses.textZh: 你赐给牠们，牠们就拾取； 你张开你的手，牠们就饱享美物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你赐给牠们，牠们就拾取； 你张开你的手，牠们就饱享美物。
verses.textZhCuv: 你给它们，它们便拾起来； 你张手，它们饱得美食。
verses.textEnNiv: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
verses.textEnEsv: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are filled with good things.
verses.textEnNkjv: What You give them they gather in; You open Your hand, they are filled with good.
verses.textEnNlt: When you supply it, they gather it. You open your hand to feed them, and they are richly satisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: You give to them, they gather it up; You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good.
verses.textEn: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

verses.textZh: 你向牠们掩面，牠们就惊慌； 你收回牠们的气息，牠们就死亡，归回尘土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你向牠们掩面，牠们就惊慌； 你收回牠们的气息，牠们就死亡，归回尘土。
verses.textZhCuv: 你掩面，它们便惊惶； 你收回它们的气，它们就死亡，归于尘土。
verses.textEnNiv: When you hide your face, they are terrified; when you take away their breath, they die and return to the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: When you hide your face, they are dismayed; when you take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: You hide Your face, they are troubled; You take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you turn away from them, they panic. When you take away their breath, they die and turn again to dust.
verses.textEnNasb: You hide Your face, they are terrified; You take away their breath, they perish And return to their dust.
verses.textEn: When you hide your face, they are terrified; when you take away their breath, they die and return to the dust.

verses.textZh: 你发出你的灵，万物就被造成； 你也使地面更换一新。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你发出你的灵，万物就被造成； 你也使地面更换一新。
verses.textZhCuv: 你发出你的灵，它们便受造； 你使地面更换为新。
verses.textEnNiv: When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: When you send forth your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; And You renew the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: When you give them your breath, life is created, and you renew the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; And You renew the face of the ground.
verses.textEn: When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the ground.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华的荣耀存到永远； 愿耶和华喜悦他自己所作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华的荣耀存到永远； 愿耶和华喜悦他自己所作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华的荣耀存到永远！ 愿耶和华喜悦自己所造的！
verses.textEnNiv: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; may the Lord rejoice in his works—
verses.textEnEsv: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; may the Lord rejoice in his works,
verses.textEnNkjv: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; May the Lord rejoice in His works.
verses.textEnNlt: May the glory of the Lord continue forever! The Lord takes pleasure in all he has made!
verses.textEnNasb: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; May the Lord rejoice in His works;
verses.textEn: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; may the Lord rejoice in his works—

verses.textZh: 他注视大地，地就震动； 他触摸群山，山就冒烟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他注视大地，地就震动； 他触摸群山，山就冒烟。
verses.textZhCuv: 他看地，地便震动； 他摸山，山就冒烟。
verses.textEnNiv: he who looks at the earth, and it trembles, who touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.textEnEsv: who looks on the earth and it trembles, who touches the mountains and they smoke!
verses.textEnNkjv: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the hills, and they smoke.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth trembles at his glance; the mountains smoke at his touch.
verses.textEnNasb: He looks at the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
verses.textEn: he who looks at the earth, and it trembles, who touches the mountains, and they smoke.

verses.textZh: 我一生要向耶和华歌唱； 我还在世的时候，我要向我的神歌颂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我一生要向耶和华歌唱； 我还在世的时候，我要向我的神歌颂。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要一生向耶和华唱诗！ 我还活的时候，要向我神歌颂！
verses.textEnNiv: I will sing to the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.
verses.textEnEsv: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have being.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.textEnNlt: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live. I will praise my God to my last breath!
verses.textEnNasb: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.textEn: I will sing to the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

verses.textZh: 愿我的默想蒙他喜悦； 我要因耶和华欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我的默想蒙他喜悦； 我要因耶和华欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他以我的默念为甘甜！ 我要因耶和华欢喜！
verses.textEnNiv: May my meditation be pleasing to him, as I rejoice in the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: May my meditation be pleasing to him, for I rejoice in the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: May my meditation be sweet to Him; I will be glad in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: May all my thoughts be pleasing to him, for I rejoice in the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: May my praise be pleasing to Him; As for me, I shall rejoice in the Lord.
verses.textEn: May my meditation be pleasing to him, as I rejoice in the Lord .

verses.textZh: 愿罪人从世上灭绝， 也不再有恶人存在。 我的心哪！你要称颂耶和华。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿罪人从世上灭绝， 也不再有恶人存在。 我的心哪！你要称颂耶和华。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿罪人从世上消灭！ 愿恶人归于无有！ 我的心哪，要称颂耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华 ！
verses.textEnNiv: But may sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Praise the Lord , my soul. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Let sinners be consumed from the earth, and let the wicked be no more! Bless the Lord , O my soul! Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: May sinners be consumed from the earth, And the wicked be no more. Bless the Lord, O my soul! Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Let all sinners vanish from the face of the earth; let the wicked disappear forever. Let all that I am praise the Lord . Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: May sinners be removed from the earth And may the wicked be no more. Bless the Lord, my soul. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: But may sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Praise the Lord , my soul. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名； 在万民中传扬他的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名； 在万民中传扬他的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名， 在万民中传扬他的作为！
verses.textEnNiv: Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh give thanks to the Lord ; call upon his name; make known his deeds among the peoples!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord! Call upon His name; Make known His deeds among the peoples!
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the Lord and proclaim his greatness. Let the whole world know what he has done.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the Lord, call upon His name; Make His deeds known among the peoples.
verses.textEn: Give praise to the Lord , proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

verses.textZh: 你们要向他歌唱，歌颂他， 讲论他一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要向他歌唱，歌颂他， 讲论他一切奇妙的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 要向他唱诗歌颂， 谈论他一切奇妙的作为！
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing to him, sing praises to him; tell of all his wondrous works!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to Him, sing psalms to Him; Talk of all His wondrous works!
verses.textEnNlt: Sing to him; yes, sing his praises. Tell everyone about his wonderful deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; Tell of all His wonders.
verses.textEn: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

verses.textZh: 你们要以他的圣名夸耀； 愿寻求耶和华的人都心里欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要以他的圣名夸耀； 愿寻求耶和华的人都心里欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 要以他的圣名夸耀！ 寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜！
verses.textEnNiv: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
verses.textEnEsv: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice!
verses.textEnNkjv: Glory in His holy name; Let the hearts of those rejoice who seek the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Exult in his holy name; rejoice, you who worship the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Boast in His holy name; May the heart of those who seek the Lord be joyful.
verses.textEn: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

verses.textZh: 你们要追求耶和华与他的能力， 常常寻求他的面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要追求耶和华与他的能力， 常常寻求他的面。
verses.textZhCuv: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力， 时常寻求他的面。
verses.textEnNiv: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.
verses.textEnEsv: Seek the Lord and his strength; seek his presence continually!
verses.textEnNkjv: Seek the Lord and His strength; Seek His face evermore!
verses.textEnNlt: Search for the Lord and for his strength; continually seek him.
verses.textEnNasb: Seek the Lord and His strength; Seek His face continually.
verses.textEn: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.

verses.textZh: 记念他所作的奇事、 他的神迹， 和他口里的判词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 记念他所作的奇事、 他的神迹， 和他口里的判词。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所拣选雅各的子孙哪， 你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事， 并他口中的判语。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,
verses.textEnEsv: Remember the wondrous works that he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he uttered,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.textEnNlt: Remember the wonders he has performed, his miracles, and the rulings he has given,
verses.textEnNasb: Remember His wonders which He has done, His marvels and the judgments spoken by His mouth,
verses.textEn: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

verses.textZh: 他仆人亚伯拉罕的后裔啊！ 他所拣选的人，雅各的子孙哪！
verses.textZhCnvs: 他仆人亚伯拉罕的后裔啊！ 他所拣选的人，雅各的子孙哪！
verses.textZhCuv: 他是耶和华－我们的神； 全地都有他的判断。
verses.textEnNiv: you his servants, the descendants of Abraham, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: O offspring of Abraham, his servant, children of Jacob, his chosen ones!
verses.textEnNkjv: O seed of Abraham His servant, You children of Jacob, His chosen ones!
verses.textEnNlt: you children of his servant Abraham, you descendants of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.textEnNasb: You descendants of Abraham, His servant, You sons of Jacob, His chosen ones!
verses.textEn: you his servants, the descendants of Abraham, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 他是耶和华我们的神， 他的判词充满全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是耶和华我们的神， 他的判词充满全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他记念他的约，直到永远； 他所吩咐的话，直到千代－
verses.textEnNiv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: He is the Lord our God. His justice is seen throughout the land.
verses.textEnNasb: He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textEn: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.textZh: 他永远记念他的约， 他记念他所吩咐的话，直到千代，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他永远记念他的约， 他记念他所吩咐的话，直到千代，
verses.textZhCuv: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约， 向以撒所起的誓。
verses.textEnNiv: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,
verses.textEnEsv: He remembers his covenant forever, the word that he commanded, for a thousand generations,
verses.textEnNkjv: He remembers His covenant forever, The word which He commanded, for a thousand generations,
verses.textEnNlt: He always stands by his covenant— the commitment he made to a thousand generations.
verses.textEnNasb: He has remembered His covenant forever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.textEn: He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,

verses.textZh: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约， 向以撒所起的誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约， 向以撒所起的誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列定为永远的约，
verses.textEnNiv: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.
verses.textEnEsv: the covenant that he made with Abraham, his sworn promise to Isaac,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thecovenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,
verses.textEnNlt: This is the covenant he made with Abraham and the oath he swore to Isaac.
verses.textEnNasb: The covenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac.
verses.textEn: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.

verses.textZh: 他把这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列坚立为永远的约，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列坚立为永远的约，
verses.textZhCuv: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你， 作你产业的分。
verses.textEnNiv: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
verses.textEnEsv: which he confirmed to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.textEnNkjv: And confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.textEnNlt: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, and to the people of Israel as a never-ending covenant:
verses.textEnNasb: Then He confirmed it to Jacob as a statute, To Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.textEn: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

verses.textZh: 说："我必把迦南地赐给你们， 作你们产业的分。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："我必把迦南地赐给你们， 作你们产业的分。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，他们人丁有限，数目稀少， 并且在那地为寄居的。
verses.textEnNiv: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan as your portion for an inheritance."
verses.textEnNkjv: Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan As the allotment of your inheritance,"
verses.textEnNlt: "I will give you the land of Canaan as your special possession."
verses.textEnNasb: Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan As the portion of your inheritance,"
verses.textEn: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."

verses.textZh: 那时，他们人数不多， 实在很少，而且是在那地寄居的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，他们人数不多， 实在很少，而且是在那地寄居的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从这邦游到那邦， 从这国行到那国。
verses.textEnNiv: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,
verses.textEnEsv: When they were few in number, of little account, and sojourners in it,
verses.textEnNkjv: When they were few in number, Indeed very few, and strangers in it.
verses.textEnNlt: He said this when they were few in number, a tiny group of strangers in Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: When they were only a few people in number, Very few, and strangers in it.
verses.textEn: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,

verses.textZh: 他们从这邦飘流到那邦， 从这国飘流到另一国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从这邦飘流到那邦， 从这国飘流到另一国。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不容什么人欺负他们， 为他们的缘故责备君王，
verses.textEnNiv: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
verses.textEnEsv: wandering from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,
verses.textEnNkjv: When they went from one nation to another, From one kingdom to another people,
verses.textEnNlt: They wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
verses.textEnNasb: And they wandered from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people,
verses.textEn: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

verses.textZh: 他不容任何人欺压他们， 为了他们的缘故，他曾指责君王，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不容任何人欺压他们， 为了他们的缘故，他曾指责君王，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 说：不可难为我受膏的人， 也不可恶待我的先知。
verses.textEnNiv: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:
verses.textEnEsv: he allowed no one to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their account,
verses.textEnNkjv: He permitted no one to do them wrong; Yes, He rebuked kings for their sakes,
verses.textEnNlt: Yet he did not let anyone oppress them. He warned kings on their behalf:
verses.textEnNasb: He allowed no one to oppress them, And He rebuked kings for their sakes, saying,
verses.textEn: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

verses.textZh: "不可伤害我的受膏者， 也不可恶待我的先知。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "不可伤害我的受膏者， 也不可恶待我的先知。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他命饥荒降在那地上， 将所倚靠的粮食全行断绝，
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Touch not my anointed ones, do my prophets no harm!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Saying, "Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not touch my chosen people, and do not hurt my prophets."
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not touch My anointed ones, And do not harm My prophets."
verses.textEn: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."

verses.textZh: 他命令饥荒临到那地， 断绝了一切粮食的供应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他命令饥荒临到那地， 断绝了一切粮食的供应。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他们以先打发一个人去 －约瑟被卖为奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: He called down famine on the land and destroyed all their supplies of food;
verses.textEnEsv: When he summoned a famine on the land and broke all supply of bread,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover He called for a famine in the land; He destroyed all the provision of bread.
verses.textEnNlt: He called for a famine on the land of Canaan, cutting off its food supply.
verses.textEnNasb: And He called for a famine upon the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.
verses.textEn: He called down famine on the land and destroyed all their supplies of food;

verses.textZh: 在他们之前，他差遣一个人去， 就是被卖为奴的约瑟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们之前，他差遣一个人去， 就是被卖为奴的约瑟。
verses.textZhCuv: 人用脚镣伤他的脚； 他被铁链捆拘。
verses.textEnNiv: and he sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
verses.textEnEsv: he had sent a man ahead of them, Joseph, who was sold as a slave.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent a man before them— Joseph—who was sold as a slave.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he sent someone to Egypt ahead of them— Joseph, who was sold as a slave.
verses.textEnNasb: He sent a man before them, Joseph, who was sold as a slave.
verses.textEn: and he sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.

verses.textZh: 人用脚镣弄伤他的脚， 他的颈项被铁链锁着，
verses.textZhCnvs: 人用脚镣弄伤他的脚， 他的颈项被铁链锁着，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话试炼他， 直等到他所说的应验了。
verses.textEnNiv: They bruised his feet with shackles, his neck was put in irons,
verses.textEnEsv: His feet were hurt with fetters; his neck was put in a collar of iron;
verses.textEnNkjv: They hurt his feet with fetters, He was laid in irons.
verses.textEnNlt: They bruised his feet with fetters and placed his neck in an iron collar.
verses.textEnNasb: They forced his feet into shackles, He was put in irons;
verses.textEn: They bruised his feet with shackles, his neck was put in irons,

verses.textZh: 直到他的话应验， 耶和华的话为他证实的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到他的话应验， 耶和华的话为他证实的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 王打发人把他解开， 就是治理众民的，把他释放，
verses.textEnNiv: till what he foretold came to pass, till the word of the Lord proved him true.
verses.textEnEsv: until what he had said came to pass, the word of the Lord tested him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the Lord tested him.
verses.textEnNlt: Until the time came to fulfill his dreams, the Lord tested Joseph’s character.
verses.textEnNasb: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the Lord refined him.
verses.textEn: till what he foretold came to pass, till the word of the Lord proved him true.

verses.textZh: 王就派人去释放他， 统治众民的把他释放了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王就派人去释放他， 统治众民的把他释放了。
verses.textZhCuv: 立他作王家之主， 掌管他一切所有的，
verses.textEnNiv: The king sent and released him, the ruler of peoples set him free.
verses.textEnEsv: The king sent and released him; the ruler of the peoples set him free;
verses.textEnNkjv: The king sent and released him, The ruler of the people let him go free.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh sent for him and set him free; the ruler of the nation opened his prison door.
verses.textEnNasb: The king sent and released him, The ruler of peoples, and set him free.
verses.textEn: The king sent and released him, the ruler of peoples set him free.

verses.textZh: 王立他执掌朝政， 管理王一切所有的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 王立他执掌朝政， 管理王一切所有的，
verses.textZhCuv: 使他随意捆绑他的臣宰， 将智慧教导他的长老。
verses.textEnNiv: He made him master of his household, ruler over all he possessed,
verses.textEnEsv: he made him lord of his house and ruler of all his possessions,
verses.textEnNkjv: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his possessions,
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph was put in charge of all the king’s household; he became ruler over all the king’s possessions.
verses.textEnNasb: He made him lord of his house, And ruler over all his possessions,
verses.textEn: He made him master of his household, ruler over all he possessed,

verses.textZh: 使他可以随意捆绑王的群臣， 把智慧教导王的长老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他可以随意捆绑王的群臣， 把智慧教导王的长老。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列也到了埃及； 雅各在含地寄居。
verses.textEnNiv: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
verses.textEnEsv: to bind his princes at his pleasure and to teach his elders wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: He could instruct the king’s aides as he pleased and teach the king’s advisers.
verses.textEnNasb: To imprison his high officials at will, That he might teach his elders wisdom.
verses.textEn: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.

verses.textZh: 后来以色列到了埃及， 雅各在含地寄居。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来以色列到了埃及， 雅各在含地寄居。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使他的百姓生养众多， 使他们比敌人强盛，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob resided as a foreigner in the land of Ham.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Israel came to Egypt; Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.textEnNkjv: Israel also came into Egypt, And Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Israel arrived in Egypt; Jacob lived as a foreigner in the land of Ham.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel also came into Egypt; So Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
verses.textEn: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob resided as a foreigner in the land of Ham.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使他的子民生育众多， 使他们比他们的敌人更强盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使他的子民生育众多， 使他们比他们的敌人更强盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 使敌人的心转去恨他的百姓， 并用诡计待他的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord made his people very fruitful; he made them too numerous for their foes,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord made his people very fruitful and made them stronger than their foes.
verses.textEnNkjv: He increased His people greatly, And made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord multiplied the people of Israel until they became too mighty for their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: And He made His people very fruitful, And made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.textEn: The Lord made his people very fruitful; he made them too numerous for their foes,

verses.textZh: 他改变敌人的心去憎恨他的子民， 用诡诈待他的众仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他改变敌人的心去憎恨他的子民， 用诡诈待他的众仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他打发他的仆人摩西 和他所拣选的亚伦，
verses.textEnNiv: whose hearts he turned to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
verses.textEnEsv: He turned their hearts to hate his people, to deal craftily with his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he turned the Egyptians against the Israelites, and they plotted against the Lord ’s servants.
verses.textEnNasb: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal cunningly with His servants.
verses.textEn: whose hearts he turned to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

verses.textZh: 他差派了他的仆人摩西， 和他拣选的亚伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他差派了他的仆人摩西， 和他拣选的亚伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 在敌人中间显他的神迹， 在含地显他的奇事。
verses.textEnNiv: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
verses.textEnEsv: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent Moses His servant, And Aaron whom He had chosen.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord sent his servant Moses, along with Aaron, whom he had chosen.
verses.textEnNasb: He sent His servant Moses, And Aaron, whom He had chosen.
verses.textEn: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

verses.textZh: 他们在敌人中间施行他的神迹， 在含地显明他的奇事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在敌人中间施行他的神迹， 在含地显明他的奇事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗； 没有违背他话的。
verses.textEnNiv: They performed his signs among them, his wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.textEnEsv: They performed his signs among them and miracles in the land of Ham.
verses.textEnNkjv: They performed His signs among them, And wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.textEnNlt: They performed miraculous signs among the Egyptians, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.textEnNasb: They performed His wondrous acts among them, And miracles in the land of Ham.
verses.textEn: They performed his signs among them, his wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.textZh: 他命黑暗降下，使那地黑暗； 他的话是不能违背的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他命黑暗降下，使那地黑暗； 他的话是不能违背的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他叫埃及的水变为血， 叫他们的鱼死了。
verses.textEnNiv: He sent darkness and made the land dark— for had they not rebelled against his words?
verses.textEnEsv: He sent darkness, and made the land dark; they did not rebel against his words.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they did not rebel against His word.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord blanketed Egypt in darkness, for they had defied his commands to let his people go.
verses.textEnNasb: He sent darkness and made it dark; And they did not rebel against His words.
verses.textEn: He sent darkness and made the land dark— for had they not rebelled against his words?

verses.textZh: 他使埃及的水都变成血， 使他们的鱼都死掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使埃及的水都变成血， 使他们的鱼都死掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他们的地上以及王宫的内室， 青蛙多多滋生。
verses.textEnNiv: He turned their waters into blood, causing their fish to die.
verses.textEnEsv: He turned their waters into blood and caused their fish to die.
verses.textEnNkjv: He turned their waters into blood, And killed their fish.
verses.textEnNlt: He turned their water into blood, poisoning all the fish.
verses.textEnNasb: He turned their waters into blood, And caused their fish to die.
verses.textEn: He turned their waters into blood, causing their fish to die.

verses.textZh: 在他们的地上，以及君王的内室， 青蛙多多滋生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们的地上，以及君王的内室， 青蛙多多滋生。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说一声，苍蝇就成群而来， 并有虱子进入他们四境。
verses.textEnNiv: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.
verses.textEnEsv: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the chambers of their kings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their land abounded with frogs, Even in the chambers of their kings.
verses.textEnNlt: Then frogs overran the land and even invaded the king’s bedrooms.
verses.textEnNasb: Their land swarmed with frogs Even in the chambers of their kings.
verses.textEn: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.

verses.textZh: 他一发命令，苍蝇就成群而来， 并且虱子进入他们的四境。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一发命令，苍蝇就成群而来， 并且虱子进入他们的四境。
verses.textZhCuv: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨， 在他们的地上降下火焰。
verses.textEnNiv: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.
verses.textEnEsv: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.
verses.textEnNkjv: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their territory.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord spoke, flies descended on the Egyptians, and gnats swarmed across Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: He spoke, and a swarm of flies And gnats invaded all their territory.
verses.textEn: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.

verses.textZh: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨， 又在他们的地上降下火焰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨， 又在他们的地上降下火焰。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树， 毁坏他们境内的树木。
verses.textEnNiv: He turned their rain into hail, with lightning throughout their land;
verses.textEnEsv: He gave them hail for rain, and fiery lightning bolts through their land.
verses.textEnNkjv: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.
verses.textEnNlt: He sent them hail instead of rain, and lightning flashed over the land.
verses.textEnNasb: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.
verses.textEn: He turned their rain into hail, with lightning throughout their land;

verses.textZh: 他击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树， 又毁坏他们境内的树木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树， 又毁坏他们境内的树木。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说一声，就有蝗虫蚂蚱上来， 不计其数，
verses.textEnNiv: he struck down their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
verses.textEnEsv: He struck down their vines and fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
verses.textEnNkjv: He struck their vines also, and their fig trees, And splintered the trees of their territory.
verses.textEnNlt: He ruined their grapevines and fig trees and shattered all the trees.
verses.textEnNasb: He also struck their vines and their fig trees, And smashed the trees of their territory.
verses.textEn: he struck down their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.

verses.textZh: 他一发命令，蝗虫就来， 蚱蜢也来，多得无法数算，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一发命令，蝗虫就来， 蚱蜢也来，多得无法数算，
verses.textZhCuv: 吃尽了他们地上各样的菜蔬 和田地的出产。
verses.textEnNiv: He spoke, and the locusts came, grasshoppers without number;
verses.textEnEsv: He spoke, and the locusts came, young locusts without number,
verses.textEnNkjv: He spoke, and locusts came, Young locusts without number,
verses.textEnNlt: He spoke, and hordes of locusts came— young locusts beyond number.
verses.textEnNasb: He spoke, and locusts came, And creeping locusts, beyond number,
verses.textEn: He spoke, and the locusts came, grasshoppers without number;

verses.textZh: 吃尽了他们地上的一切植物， 吃光了他们土地的出产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃尽了他们地上的一切植物， 吃光了他们土地的出产。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又击杀他们国内一切的长子， 就是他们强壮时头生的。
verses.textEnNiv: they ate up every green thing in their land, ate up the produce of their soil.
verses.textEnEsv: which devoured all the vegetation in their land and ate up the fruit of their ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: And ate up all the vegetation in their land, And devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.textEnNlt: They ate up everything green in the land, destroying all the crops in their fields.
verses.textEnNasb: And they ate all the vegetation in their land, And ate the fruit of their ground.
verses.textEn: they ate up every green thing in their land, ate up the produce of their soil.

verses.textZh: 他击杀了他们境内所有的长子， 就是他们强壮的时候所生的头生子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他击杀了他们境内所有的长子， 就是他们强壮的时候所生的头生子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他领自己的百姓带银子金子出来； 他支派中没有一个软弱的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their manhood.
verses.textEnEsv: He struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also destroyed all the firstborn in their land, The first of all their strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he killed the oldest son in each Egyptian home, the pride and joy of each family.
verses.textEnNasb: He also fatally struck all the firstborn in their land, The first fruits of all their vigor.
verses.textEn: Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their manhood.

verses.textZh: 他领自己的子民带着金银出来； 他们众支派中没有一个畏缩的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领自己的子民带着金银出来； 他们众支派中没有一个畏缩的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们出来的时候，埃及人便欢喜； 原来埃及人惧怕他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought out Israel with silver and gold, and there was none among his tribes who stumbled.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also brought them out with silver and gold, And therewas none feeble among His tribes.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord brought his people out of Egypt, loaded with silver and gold; and not one among the tribes of Israel even stumbled.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He brought the Israelites out with silver and gold, And among His tribes there was not one who stumbled.
verses.textEn: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.

verses.textZh: 他们出来的时候，埃及人很欢喜， 因为埃及人都惧怕他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们出来的时候，埃及人很欢喜， 因为埃及人都惧怕他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他铺张云彩当遮盖， 夜间使火光照。
verses.textEnNiv: Egypt was glad when they left, because dread of Israel had fallen on them.
verses.textEnEsv: Egypt was glad when they departed, for dread of them had fallen upon it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Egypt was glad when they departed, For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: Egypt was glad when they were gone, for they feared them greatly.
verses.textEnNasb: Egypt was glad when they departed, For the dread of them had fallen upon the Egyptians.
verses.textEn: Egypt was glad when they left, because dread of Israel had fallen on them.

verses.textZh: 他展开云彩作遮盖， 夜间有火光照。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他展开云彩作遮盖， 夜间有火光照。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来， 并用天上的粮食叫他们饱足。
verses.textEnNiv: He spread out a cloud as a covering, and a fire to give light at night.
verses.textEnEsv: He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord spread a cloud above them as a covering and gave them a great fire to light the darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: He spread out a cloud as a covering, And fire to illumine by night.
verses.textEn: He spread out a cloud as a covering, and a fire to give light at night.

verses.textZh: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来， 并且用天上的粮食使他们饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来， 并且用天上的粮食使他们饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 他打开磐石，水就涌出； 在干旱之处，水流成河。
verses.textEnNiv: They asked, and he brought them quail; he fed them well with the bread of heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: They asked, and he brought quail, and gave them bread from heaven in abundance.
verses.textEnNkjv: The people asked, and He brought quail, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: They asked for meat, and he sent them quail; he satisfied their hunger with manna—bread from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: They asked, and He brought quail, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.textEn: They asked, and he brought them quail; he fed them well with the bread of heaven.

verses.textZh: 他裂开盘石，水就涌流出来； 在干旱之处水流成河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他裂开盘石，水就涌流出来； 在干旱之处水流成河。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都因他记念他的圣言 和他的仆人亚伯拉罕。
verses.textEnNiv: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed through the desert like a river.
verses.textEnNkjv: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; It ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.textEnNlt: He split open a rock, and water gushed out to form a river through the dry wasteland.
verses.textEnNasb: He opened the rock and water flowed out; It ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.textEn: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.

verses.textZh: 因为他记念他向自己的仆人亚伯拉罕应许的圣言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他记念他向自己的仆人亚伯拉罕应许的圣言。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带领百姓欢乐而出， 带领选民欢呼前往。
verses.textEnNiv: For he remembered his holy promise given to his servant Abraham.
verses.textEnEsv: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham, his servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He remembered His holy promise, And Abraham His servant.
verses.textEnNlt: For he remembered his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: For He remembered His holy word With His servant Abraham;
verses.textEn: For he remembered his holy promise given to his servant Abraham.

verses.textZh: 他带领自己的子民欢欢乐乐出来， 带领自己的选民欢呼着出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他带领自己的子民欢欢乐乐出来， 带领自己的选民欢呼着出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将列国的地赐给他们， 他们便承受众民劳碌得来的，
verses.textEnNiv: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;
verses.textEnEsv: So he brought his people out with joy, his chosen ones with singing.
verses.textEnNkjv: He brought out His people with joy, His chosen ones with gladness.
verses.textEnNlt: So he brought his people out of Egypt with joy, his chosen ones with rejoicing.
verses.textEnNasb: And He led out His people with joy, His chosen ones with a joyful shout.
verses.textEn: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;

verses.textZh: 他把多国的地土赐给他们， 他们就承受众民劳碌的成果，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把多国的地土赐给他们， 他们就承受众民劳碌的成果，
verses.textZhCuv: 好使他们遵他的律例， 守他的律法。 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they fell heir to what others had toiled for—
verses.textEnEsv: And he gave them the lands of the nations, and they took possession of the fruit of the peoples’ toil,
verses.textEnNkjv: He gave them the lands of the Gentiles, And they inherited the labor of the nations,
verses.textEnNlt: He gave his people the lands of pagan nations, and they harvested crops that others had planted.
verses.textEnNasb: He also gave them the lands of the nations, So that they might take possession of the fruit of the peoples’ labor,
verses.textEn: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they fell heir to what others had toiled for—

verses.textZh: 为要使他们谨守他的律例， 遵守他的律法。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要使他们谨守他的律例， 遵守他的律法。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 为要使他们谨守他的律例， 遵守他的律法。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: that they might keep his precepts and observe his laws. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: that they might keep his statutes and observe his laws. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: That they might observe His statutes And keep His laws. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: All this happened so they would follow his decrees and obey his instructions. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: And that they might keep His statutes And comply with His laws; Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: that they might keep his precepts and observe his laws. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华。 你们要称谢耶和华，因为他是美善的； 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华。 你们要称谢耶和华，因为他是美善的； 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! Oh give thanks to the Lord , for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good! His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! Oh give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; For His mercy is everlasting.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 谁能述说耶和华大能的作为， 谁能说尽赞美他的话？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能述说耶和华大能的作为， 谁能说尽赞美他的话？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能传说耶和华的大能？ 谁能表明他一切的美德？
verses.textEnNiv: Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the Lord or fully declare his praise?
verses.textEnEsv: Who can utter the mighty deeds of the Lord , or declare all his praise?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? Who can declare all His praise?
verses.textEnNlt: Who can list the glorious miracles of the Lord ? Who can ever praise him enough?
verses.textEnNasb: Who can speak of the mighty deeds of the Lord, Or can proclaim all His praise?
verses.textEn: Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the Lord or fully declare his praise?

verses.textZh: 谨守公正，常行公义的人， 都是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谨守公正，常行公义的人， 都是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡遵守公平、常行公义的， 这人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those who act justly, who always do what is right.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed are they who observe justice, who do righteousness at all times!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are those who keep justice, And he who does righteousness at all times!
verses.textEnNlt: There is joy for those who deal justly with others and always do what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: How blessed are those who maintain justice, Who practice righteousness at all times!
verses.textEn: Blessed are those who act justly, who always do what is right.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你恩待你子民的时候， 求你记念我； 你拯救他们的时候，求你眷念我；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你恩待你子民的时候， 求你记念我； 你拯救他们的时候，求你眷念我；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓； 求你也用这恩惠记念我，开你的救恩眷顾我，
verses.textEnNiv: Remember me, Lord , when you show favor to your people, come to my aid when you save them,
verses.textEnEsv: Remember me, O Lord , when you show favor to your people; help me when you save them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember me, O Lord, with the favor Youhavetoward Your people. Oh, visit me with Your salvation,
verses.textEnNlt: Remember me, Lord , when you show favor to your people; come near and rescue me.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember me, Lord, in Your favor toward Your people. Visit me with Your salvation,
verses.textEn: Remember me, Lord , when you show favor to your people, come to my aid when you save them,

verses.textZh: 使我得见你选民的福乐， 因你国民的欢乐而欢乐， 与你的产业一同夸耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使我得见你选民的福乐， 因你国民的欢乐而欢乐， 与你的产业一同夸耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 使我见你选民的福， 乐你国民的乐， 与你的产业一同夸耀。
verses.textEnNiv: that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of your nation and join your inheritance in giving praise.
verses.textEnEsv: that I may look upon the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: That I may see the benefit of Your chosen ones, That I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, That I may glory with Your inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: Let me share in the prosperity of your chosen ones. Let me rejoice in the joy of your people; let me praise you with those who are your heritage.
verses.textEnNasb: So that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, That I may rejoice in the joy of Your nation, That I may boast with Your inheritance.
verses.textEn: that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of your nation and join your inheritance in giving praise.

verses.textZh: 我们和我们的列祖都犯了罪， 我们作了孽，也行了恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们和我们的列祖都犯了罪， 我们作了孽，也行了恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们与我们的祖宗一同犯罪； 我们作了孽，行了恶。
verses.textEnNiv: We have sinned, even as our ancestors did; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
verses.textEnEsv: Both we and our fathers have sinned; we have committed iniquity; we have done wickedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, We have done wickedly.
verses.textEnNlt: Like our ancestors, we have sinned. We have done wrong! We have acted wickedly!
verses.textEnNasb: We have sinned like our fathers, We have gone astray, we have behaved wickedly.
verses.textEn: We have sinned, even as our ancestors did; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

verses.textZh: 我们的列祖在埃及的时候， 不明白你的奇事， 也不记念你丰盛的慈爱， 反倒在红海的海边悖逆了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的列祖在埃及的时候， 不明白你的奇事， 也不记念你丰盛的慈爱， 反倒在红海的海边悖逆了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事， 不记念你丰盛的慈爱， 反倒在红海行了悖逆。
verses.textEnNiv: When our ancestors were in Egypt, they gave no thought to your miracles; they did not remember your many kindnesses, and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Our fathers, when they were in Egypt, did not consider your wondrous works; they did not remember the abundance of your steadfast love, but rebelled by the sea, at the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders; They did not remember the multitude of Your mercies, But rebelled by the sea—the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Our ancestors in Egypt were not impressed by the Lord ’s miraculous deeds. They soon forgot his many acts of kindness to them. Instead, they rebelled against him at the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders; They did not remember Your abundant kindnesses, But rebelled by the sea, at the Red Sea.
verses.textEn: When our ancestors were in Egypt, they gave no thought to your miracles; they did not remember your many kindnesses, and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.

verses.textZh: 但他因自己的名的缘故拯救他们， 为要彰显他的大能。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他因自己的名的缘故拯救他们， 为要彰显他的大能。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他们， 为要彰显他的大能，
verses.textEnNiv: Yet he saved them for his name’s sake, to make his mighty power known.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make known his mighty power.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless He saved them for His name’s sake, That He might make His mighty power known.
verses.textEnNlt: Even so, he saved them— to defend the honor of his name and to demonstrate his mighty power.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless He saved them for the sake of His name, So that He might make His power known.
verses.textEn: Yet he saved them for his name’s sake, to make his mighty power known.

verses.textZh: 他斥责红海，海就干了； 他领他们走过海底，像经过旷野一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他斥责红海，海就干了； 他领他们走过海底，像经过旷野一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且斥责红海，海便干了； 他带领他们经过深处，如同经过旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led them through the depths as through a desert.
verses.textEnEsv: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it became dry, and he led them through the deep as through a desert.
verses.textEnNkjv: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it dried up; So He led them through the depths, As through the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: He commanded the Red Sea to dry up. He led Israel across the sea as if it were a desert.
verses.textEnNasb: So He rebuked the Red Sea and it dried up, And He led them through the mighty waters, as through the wilderness.
verses.textEn: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led them through the depths as through a desert.

verses.textZh: 他拯救他们脱离憎恨他们的人的手， 从仇敌的手中救赎了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拯救他们脱离憎恨他们的人的手， 从仇敌的手中救赎了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他拯救他们脱离恨他们人的手， 从仇敌手中救赎他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.
verses.textEnEsv: So he saved them from the hand of the foe and redeemed them from the power of the enemy.
verses.textEnNkjv: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.textEnNlt: So he rescued them from their enemies and redeemed them from their foes.
verses.textEnNasb: So He saved them from the hand of one who hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.textEn: He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.

verses.textZh: 海水淹没了他们的敌人， 连一个也没有留下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 海水淹没了他们的敌人， 连一个也没有留下。
verses.textZhCuv: 水淹没他们的敌人， 没有一个存留。
verses.textEnNiv: The waters covered their adversaries; not one of them survived.
verses.textEnEsv: And the waters covered their adversaries; not one of them was left.
verses.textEnNkjv: The waters covered their enemies; There was not one of them left.
