verses.textEnNlt: Then the water returned and covered their enemies; not one of them survived.
verses.textEnNasb: The waters covered their adversaries; Not one of them was left.
verses.textEn: The waters covered their adversaries; not one of them survived.

verses.textZh: 那时他们才相信他的话， 唱歌赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时他们才相信他的话， 唱歌赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，他们才信了他的话， 歌唱赞美他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they believed his promises and sang his praise.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they believed his words; they sang his praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they believed His words; They sang His praise.
verses.textEnNlt: Then his people believed his promises. Then they sang his praise.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they believed His words; They sang His praise.
verses.textEn: Then they believed his promises and sang his praise.

verses.textZh: 可是他们很快就忘记了他的作为， 不仰望他的意旨，
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他们很快就忘记了他的作为， 不仰望他的意旨，
verses.textZhCuv: 等不多时，他们就忘了他的作为， 不仰望他的指教，
verses.textEnNiv: But they soon forgot what he had done and did not wait for his plan to unfold.
verses.textEnEsv: But they soon forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel.
verses.textEnNkjv: They soon forgot His works; They did not wait for His counsel,
verses.textEnNlt: Yet how quickly they forgot what he had done! They wouldn’t wait for his counsel!
verses.textEnNasb: They quickly forgot His works; They did not wait for His plan,
verses.textEn: But they soon forgot what he had done and did not wait for his plan to unfold.

verses.textZh: 反而在旷野大起贪欲， 在沙漠试探神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 反而在旷野大起贪欲， 在沙漠试探神。
verses.textZhCuv: 反倒在旷野大起欲心， 在荒地试探神。
verses.textEnNiv: In the desert they gave in to their craving; in the wilderness they put God to the test.
verses.textEnEsv: But they had a wanton craving in the wilderness, and put God to the test in the desert;
verses.textEnNkjv: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tested God in the desert.
verses.textEnNlt: In the wilderness their desires ran wild, testing God’s patience in that dry wasteland.
verses.textEnNasb: But became lustfully greedy in the wilderness, And put God to the test in the desert.
verses.textEn: In the desert they gave in to their craving; in the wilderness they put God to the test.

verses.textZh: 神把他们所求的赐给他们， 却使灾病临到他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神把他们所求的赐给他们， 却使灾病临到他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将他们所求的赐给他们， 却使他们的心灵软弱。
verses.textEnNiv: So he gave them what they asked for, but sent a wasting disease among them.
verses.textEnEsv: he gave them what they asked, but sent a wasting disease among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.
verses.textEnNlt: So he gave them what they asked for, but he sent a plague along with it.
verses.textEnNasb: So He gave them their request, But sent a wasting disease among them.
verses.textEn: So he gave them what they asked for, but sent a wasting disease among them.

verses.textZh: 他们在营中嫉妒摩西， 以及归耶和华为圣的亚伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在营中嫉妒摩西， 以及归耶和华为圣的亚伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又在营中嫉妒摩西 和耶和华的圣者亚伦。
verses.textEnNiv: In the camp they grew envious of Moses and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: When men in the camp were jealous of Moses and Aaron, the holy one of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: When they envied Moses in the camp, And Aaron the saint of the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: The people in the camp were jealous of Moses and envious of Aaron, the Lord ’s holy priest.
verses.textEnNasb: When they became envious of Moses in the camp, And of Aaron, the holy one of the Lord,
verses.textEn: In the camp they grew envious of Moses and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 于是地裂开，吞下了大坍， 把亚比兰一伙的人也掩埋了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是地裂开，吞下了大坍， 把亚比兰一伙的人也掩埋了。
verses.textZhCuv: 地裂开，吞下大坍， 掩盖亚比兰一党的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it buried the company of Abiram.
verses.textEnEsv: the earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, And covered the faction of Abiram.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of this, the earth opened up; it swallowed Dathan and buried Abiram and the other rebels.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And engulfed the company of Abiram.
verses.textEn: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it buried the company of Abiram.

verses.textZh: 有火在他们的党羽中燃烧起来， 烈焰焚毁了恶人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有火在他们的党羽中燃烧起来， 烈焰焚毁了恶人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有火在他们的党中发起； 有火焰烧毁了恶人。
verses.textEnNiv: Fire blazed among their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: Fire also broke out in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: Fire fell upon their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: And a fire blazed up in their company; The flame consumed the wicked.
verses.textEn: Fire blazed among their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.

verses.textZh: 他们在何烈山做了牛犊， 敬拜铸成的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在何烈山做了牛犊， 敬拜铸成的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊， 叩拜铸成的像。
verses.textEnNiv: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped an idol cast from metal.
verses.textEnEsv: They made a calf in Horeb and worshiped a metal image.
verses.textEnNkjv: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshiped the molded image.
verses.textEnNlt: The people made a calf at Mount Sinai ; they bowed before an image made of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshiped a cast metal image.
verses.textEn: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped an idol cast from metal.

verses.textZh: 这样，他们用吃草的牛的像， 代替了他们的荣耀的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，他们用吃草的牛的像， 代替了他们的荣耀的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 如此将他们荣耀的主 换为吃草之牛的像，
verses.textEnNiv: They exchanged their glorious God for an image of a bull, which eats grass.
verses.textEnEsv: They exchanged the glory of God for the image of an ox that eats grass.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus they changed their glory Into the image of an ox that eats grass.
verses.textEnNlt: They traded their glorious God for a statue of a grass-eating bull.
verses.textEnNasb: So they exchanged their glory For the image of an ox that eats grass.
verses.textEn: They exchanged their glorious God for an image of a bull, which eats grass.

verses.textZh: 他们竟忘记了拯救他们的神； 他曾在埃及行了大事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们竟忘记了拯救他们的神； 他曾在埃及行了大事，
verses.textZhCuv: 忘了神－他们的救主； 他曾在埃及行大事，
verses.textEnNiv: They forgot the God who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: They forgot God their Savior, Who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: They forgot God, their savior, who had done such great things in Egypt—
verses.textEnNasb: They forgot God their Savior, Who had done great things in Egypt,
verses.textEn: They forgot the God who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt,

verses.textZh: 在含地行了奇事，在红海边行了可畏可惧的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在含地行了奇事，在红海边行了可畏可惧的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 在含地行奇事， 在红海行可畏的事。
verses.textEnNiv: miracles in the land of Ham and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Awesome things by the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNlt: such wonderful things in the land of Ham, such awesome deeds at the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Wonders in the land of Ham, And awesome things by the Red Sea.
verses.textEn: miracles in the land of Ham and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

verses.textZh: 所以他说要灭绝他们， 不是有他拣选的摩西， 在他面前站在破口上， 使他的怒气转消，恐怕他早已毁灭他们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以他说要灭绝他们， 不是有他拣选的摩西， 在他面前站在破口上， 使他的怒气转消，恐怕他早已毁灭他们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，他说要灭绝他们； 若非有他所拣选的摩西站在当中 ， 使他的忿怒转消， 恐怕他就灭绝他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So he said he would destroy them— had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him to keep his wrath from destroying them.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he said he would destroy them— had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him, to turn away his wrath from destroying them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach, To turn away His wrath, lest He destroy them.
verses.textEnNlt: So he declared he would destroy them. But Moses, his chosen one, stepped between the Lord and the people. He begged him to turn from his anger and not destroy them.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, If Moses, His chosen one, had not stood in the gap before Him, To turn away His wrath from destroying them.
verses.textEn: So he said he would destroy them— had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him to keep his wrath from destroying them.

verses.textZh: 他们又轻视那美地， 不信他的应许。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又轻视那美地， 不信他的应许。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又藐视那美地， 不信他的话，
verses.textEnNiv: Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe his promise.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they despised the pleasant land, having no faith in his promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they despised the pleasant land; They did not believe His word,
verses.textEnNlt: The people refused to enter the pleasant land, for they wouldn’t believe his promise to care for them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they rejected the pleasant land; They did not believe His word,
verses.textEn: Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe his promise.

verses.textZh: 他们在自己的帐棚里发怨言， 不听从耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在自己的帐棚里发怨言， 不听从耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 在自己帐棚内发怨言， 不听耶和华的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: They grumbled in their tents and did not obey the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: They murmured in their tents, and did not obey the voice of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But complained in their tents, And did not heed the voice of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, they grumbled in their tents and refused to obey the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But grumbled in their tents; They did not listen to the voice of the Lord.
verses.textEn: They grumbled in their tents and did not obey the Lord .

verses.textZh: 所以他对他们起誓， 必使他们倒在旷野，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以他对他们起誓， 必使他们倒在旷野，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，他对他们起誓： 必叫他们倒在旷野，
verses.textEnNiv: So he swore to them with uplifted hand that he would make them fall in the wilderness,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he raised his hand and swore to them that he would make them fall in the wilderness,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He raised His hand inanoath against them, To overthrow them in the wilderness,
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, he solemnly swore that he would kill them in the wilderness,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore He swore to them That He would have them fall in the wilderness,
verses.textEn: So he swore to them with uplifted hand that he would make them fall in the wilderness,

verses.textZh: 使他们的后裔四散在万国中， 使他们分散在各地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他们的后裔四散在万国中， 使他们分散在各地。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫他们的后裔倒在列国之中， 分散在各地。
verses.textEnNiv: make their descendants fall among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
verses.textEnEsv: and would make their offspring fall among the nations, scattering them among the lands.
verses.textEnNkjv: To overthrow their descendants among the nations, And to scatter them in the lands.
verses.textEnNlt: that he would scatter their descendants among the nations, exiling them to distant lands.
verses.textEnNasb: And that He would bring down their descendants among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.
verses.textEn: make their descendants fall among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.

verses.textZh: 他们又归附巴力．毘珥， 吃了祭过死神的祭物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又归附巴力．毘珥， 吃了祭过死神的祭物。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又与巴力‧毗珥连合， 且吃了祭死神 的物。
verses.textEnNiv: They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;
verses.textEnEsv: Then they yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor, and ate sacrifices offered to the dead;
verses.textEnNkjv: They joined themselves also to Baal of Peor, And ate sacrifices made to the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: Then our ancestors joined in the worship of Baal at Peor; they even ate sacrifices offered to the dead!
verses.textEnNasb: They also followed Baal-peor, And ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
verses.textEn: They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;

verses.textZh: 他们的行为触怒了耶和华， 于是有瘟疫在他们中间发生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的行为触怒了耶和华， 于是有瘟疫在他们中间发生。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们这样行，惹耶和华发怒， 便有瘟疫流行在他们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: they aroused the Lord ’s anger by their wicked deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
verses.textEnEsv: they provoked the Lord to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus they provoked Him to anger with their deeds, And the plague broke out among them.
verses.textEnNlt: They angered the Lord with all these things, so a plague broke out among them.
verses.textEnNasb: So they provoked Him to anger with their deeds, And a plague broke out among them.
verses.textEn: they aroused the Lord ’s anger by their wicked deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

verses.textZh: 那时非尼哈站起来，执行刑罚， 瘟疫才止息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时非尼哈站起来，执行刑罚， 瘟疫才止息。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，非尼哈站起，刑罚恶人， 瘟疫这才止息。
verses.textEnNiv: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was stayed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Phinehas stood up and intervened, And the plague was stopped.
verses.textEnNlt: But Phinehas had the courage to intervene, and the plague was stopped.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Phinehas stood up and intervened, And so the plague was brought to a halt.
verses.textEn: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.

verses.textZh: 这就算为他的义， 世世代代直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就算为他的义， 世世代代直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 那就算为他的义， 世世代代，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: This was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: And that was counted to him as righteousness from generation to generation forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: And that was accounted to him for righteousness To all generations forevermore.
verses.textEnNlt: So he has been regarded as a righteous man ever since that time.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was credited to him as righteousness, To all generations forever.
verses.textEn: This was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.

verses.textZh: 他们在米利巴水边惹耶和华发怒， 以致摩西因他们的缘故也受了惩罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在米利巴水边惹耶和华发怒， 以致摩西因他们的缘故也受了惩罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在米利巴水又叫耶和华发怒， 甚至摩西也受了亏损，
verses.textEnNiv: By the waters of Meribah they angered the Lord , and trouble came to Moses because of them;
verses.textEnEsv: They angered him at the waters of Meribah, and it went ill with Moses on their account,
verses.textEnNkjv: They angered Him also at the waters of strife, So that it went ill with Moses on account of them;
verses.textEnNlt: At Meribah, too, they angered the Lord , causing Moses serious trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: They also provoked Him to wrath at the waters of Meribah, So that it went badly for Moses on their account.
verses.textEn: By the waters of Meribah they angered the Lord , and trouble came to Moses because of them;

verses.textZh: 因为他们抗拒神的灵 ， 摩西用嘴说出冒失的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们抗拒神的灵 ， 摩西用嘴说出冒失的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 是因他们惹动他的灵， 摩西 用嘴说了急躁的话。
verses.textEnNiv: for they rebelled against the Spirit of God, and rash words came from Moses’ lips.
verses.textEnEsv: for they made his spirit bitter, and he spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because they rebelled against His Spirit, So that he spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.textEnNlt: They made Moses angry, and he spoke foolishly.
verses.textEnNasb: Because they were rebellious against His Spirit, He spoke rashly with his lips.
verses.textEn: for they rebelled against the Spirit of God, and rash words came from Moses’ lips.

verses.textZh: 他们没有照着耶和华吩咐他们的， 灭绝外族的人民，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们没有照着耶和华吩咐他们的， 灭绝外族的人民，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不照耶和华所吩咐的 灭绝外邦人，
verses.textEnNiv: They did not destroy the peoples as the Lord had commanded them,
verses.textEnEsv: They did not destroy the peoples, as the Lord commanded them,
verses.textEnNkjv: They did not destroy the peoples, Concerning whom the Lord had commanded them,
verses.textEnNlt: Israel failed to destroy the nations in the land, as the Lord had commanded them.
verses.textEnNasb: They did not destroy the peoples, As the Lord had commanded them,
verses.textEn: They did not destroy the peoples as the Lord had commanded them,

verses.textZh: 反而和外族人混居杂处， 学习他们的风俗习惯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 反而和外族人混居杂处， 学习他们的风俗习惯。
verses.textZhCuv: 反与他们混杂相合， 学习他们的行为，
verses.textEnNiv: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
verses.textEnEsv: but they mixed with the nations and learned to do as they did.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they mingled with the Gentiles And learned their works;
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, they mingled among the pagans and adopted their evil customs.
verses.textEnNasb: But they got involved with the nations And learned their practices,
verses.textEn: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

verses.textZh: 他们又事奉外族人的偶像， 这就成了他们的网罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又事奉外族人的偶像， 这就成了他们的网罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 事奉他们的偶像， 这就成了自己的网罗，
verses.textEnNiv: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
verses.textEnEsv: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: They served their idols, Which became a snare to them.
verses.textEnNlt: They worshiped their idols, which led to their downfall.
verses.textEnNasb: And served their idols, Which became a snare to them.
verses.textEn: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

verses.textZh: 他们把自己的儿女祭祀鬼魔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把自己的儿女祭祀鬼魔。
verses.textZhCuv: 把自己的儿女祭祀鬼魔，
verses.textEnNiv: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to false gods.
verses.textEnEsv: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons;
verses.textEnNkjv: They even sacrificed their sons And their daughters to demons,
verses.textEnNlt: They even sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons.
verses.textEnNasb: They even sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons,
verses.textEn: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to false gods.

verses.textZh: 他们流了无辜人的血， 就是他们自己儿女的血， 把他们祭祀迦南的偶像； 那地就被血污秽了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们流了无辜人的血， 就是他们自己儿女的血， 把他们祭祀迦南的偶像； 那地就被血污秽了。
verses.textZhCuv: 流无辜人的血， 就是自己儿女的血， 把他们祭祀迦南的偶像， 那地就被血污秽了。
verses.textEnNiv: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was desecrated by their blood.
verses.textEnEsv: they poured out innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: And shed innocent blood, The blood of their sons and daughters, Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.
verses.textEnNlt: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters. By sacrificing them to the idols of Canaan, they polluted the land with murder.
verses.textEnNasb: And shed innocent blood, The blood of their sons and their daughters Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; And the land was defiled with the blood.
verses.textEn: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was desecrated by their blood.

verses.textZh: 这样，他们因自己所作的成了不洁， 他们的行为使他们犯了邪淫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，他们因自己所作的成了不洁， 他们的行为使他们犯了邪淫。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，他们被自己所做的污秽了， 在行为上犯了邪淫。
verses.textEnNiv: They defiled themselves by what they did; by their deeds they prostituted themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus they became unclean by their acts, and played the whore in their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus they were defiled by their own works, And played the harlot by their own deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: They defiled themselves by their evil deeds, and their love of idols was adultery in the Lord ’s sight.
verses.textEnNasb: So they became unclean in their practices, And were unfaithful in their deeds.
verses.textEn: They defiled themselves by what they did; by their deeds they prostituted themselves.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华的怒气向他的子民发作； 他厌恶自己的产业，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华的怒气向他的子民发作； 他厌恶自己的产业，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作， 憎恶他的产业，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore the Lord was angry with his people and abhorred his inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the anger of the Lord was kindled against his people, and he abhorred his heritage;
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the wrath of the Lord was kindled against His people, So that He abhorred His own inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Lord ’s anger burned against his people, and he abhorred his own special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the anger of the Lord was kindled against His people, And He loathed His inheritance.
verses.textEn: Therefore the Lord was angry with his people and abhorred his inheritance.

verses.textZh: 把他们交在外族人的手里， 恨恶他们的人就管辖他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把他们交在外族人的手里， 恨恶他们的人就管辖他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 将他们交在外邦人的手里； 恨他们的人就辖制他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He gave them into the hands of the nations, and their foes ruled over them.
verses.textEnEsv: he gave them into the hand of the nations, so that those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He gave them into the hand of the Gentiles, And those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.textEnNlt: He handed them over to pagan nations, and they were ruled by those who hated them.
verses.textEnNasb: So He handed them over to the nations, And those who hated them ruled over them.
verses.textEn: He gave them into the hands of the nations, and their foes ruled over them.

verses.textZh: 他们的仇敌压迫他们， 他们就屈服在仇敌的手下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的仇敌压迫他们， 他们就屈服在仇敌的手下。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的仇敌也欺压他们， 他们就伏在敌人手下。
verses.textEnNiv: Their enemies oppressed them and subjected them to their power.
verses.textEnEsv: Their enemies oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their power.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Their enemies crushed them and brought them under their cruel power.
verses.textEnNasb: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were subdued under their power.
verses.textEn: Their enemies oppressed them and subjected them to their power.

verses.textZh: 神曾多次搭救他们， 他们却故意悖逆， 以致因自己的罪孽降为卑微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神曾多次搭救他们， 他们却故意悖逆， 以致因自己的罪孽降为卑微。
verses.textZhCuv: 他屡次搭救他们， 他们却设谋悖逆， 因自己的罪孽降为卑下。
verses.textEnNiv: Many times he delivered them, but they were bent on rebellion and they wasted away in their sin.
verses.textEnEsv: Many times he delivered them, but they were rebellious in their purposes and were brought low through their iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Many times He delivered them; But they rebelled in their counsel, And were brought low for their iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: Again and again he rescued them, but they chose to rebel against him, and they were finally destroyed by their sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Many times He would rescue them; They, however, were rebellious in their plan, And they sank down into their guilt.
verses.textEn: Many times he delivered them, but they were bent on rebellion and they wasted away in their sin.

verses.textZh: 可是他听到了他们哀叫的时候， 就垂顾他们的苦难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他听到了他们哀叫的时候， 就垂顾他们的苦难。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，他听见他们哀告的时候， 就眷顾他们的急难，
verses.textEnNiv: Yet he took note of their distress when he heard their cry;
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, he looked upon their distress, when he heard their cry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless He regarded their affliction, When He heard their cry;
verses.textEnNlt: Even so, he pitied them in their distress and listened to their cries.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless He looked at their distress When He heard their cry;
verses.textEn: Yet he took note of their distress when he heard their cry;

verses.textZh: 他为他们的缘故记念他自己的约， 照着他丰盛的慈爱回心转意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为他们的缘故记念他自己的约， 照着他丰盛的慈爱回心转意。
verses.textZhCuv: 为他们记念他的约， 照他丰盛的慈爱后悔。
verses.textEnNiv: for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.
verses.textEnEsv: For their sake he remembered his covenant, and relented according to the abundance of his steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: And for their sake He remembered His covenant, And relented according to the multitude of His mercies.
verses.textEnNlt: He remembered his covenant with them and relented because of his unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: And He remembered His covenant for their sake, And relented according to the greatness of His mercy.
verses.textEn: for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.

verses.textZh: 他又使他们在所有掳掠他们的人面前， 得蒙怜恤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又使他们在所有掳掠他们的人面前， 得蒙怜恤。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也使他们在凡掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤。
verses.textEnNiv: He caused all who held them captive to show them mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: He caused them to be pitied by all those who held them captive.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made them to be pitied By all those who carried them away captive.
verses.textEnNlt: He even caused their captors to treat them with kindness.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made them objects of compassion In the presence of all their captors.
verses.textEn: He caused all who held them captive to show them mercy.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我们的神啊！求你拯救我们， 把我们从万国中招聚回来， 我们好称谢你的圣名， 以赞美你为夸耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我们的神啊！求你拯救我们， 把我们从万国中招聚回来， 我们好称谢你的圣名， 以赞美你为夸耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我们的神啊，求你拯救我们， 从外邦中招聚我们， 我们好称赞你的圣名， 以赞美你为夸胜。
verses.textEnNiv: Save us, Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
verses.textEnEsv: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Save us, O Lord our God, And gather us from among the Gentiles, To give thanks to Your holy name, To triumph in Your praise.
verses.textEnNlt: Save us, O Lord our God! Gather us back from among the nations, so we can thank your holy name and rejoice and praise you.
verses.textEnNasb: Save us, Lord our God, And gather us from the nations, To give thanks to Your holy name And glory in Your praise.
verses.textEn: Save us, Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的， 从永远到永远。 愿众民都说："阿们。" 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的， 从永远到永远。 愿众民都说："阿们。" 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神是应当称颂的， 从亘古直到永远。 愿众民都说：阿们！ 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! And let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! And let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who lives from everlasting to everlasting! Let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, From everlasting to everlasting. And all the people shall say, "Amen." Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本是良善的； 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本是良善的； 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！
verses.textEnNiv: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh give thanks to the Lord , for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good! His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, For His mercy is everlasting.
verses.textEn: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华救赎的子民这样称谢他； 这民就是他从敌人的手里救赎出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华救赎的子民这样称谢他； 这民就是他从敌人的手里救赎出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华的赎民说这话， 就是他从敌人手中所救赎的，
verses.textEnNiv: Let the redeemed of the Lord tell their story— those he redeemed from the hand of the foe,
verses.textEnEsv: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he has redeemed from trouble
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, Whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy,
verses.textEnNlt: Has the Lord redeemed you? Then speak out! Tell others he has redeemed you from your enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: The redeemed of the Lord shall say so, Those whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
verses.textEn: Let the redeemed of the Lord tell their story— those he redeemed from the hand of the foe,

verses.textZh: 把他们从各地， 就是从东从西、从南 从北，招聚回来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把他们从各地， 就是从东从西、从南 从北，招聚回来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 从各地，从东从西， 从南从北，所招聚来的。
verses.textEnNiv: those he gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
verses.textEnEsv: and gathered in from the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
verses.textEnNkjv: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.
verses.textEnNlt: For he has gathered the exiles from many lands, from east and west, from north and south.
verses.textEnNasb: And gathered from the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.
verses.textEn: those he gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.

verses.textZh: 他们有些人在旷野、在荒漠飘流， 寻不见路往可居住的城巿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们有些人在旷野、在荒漠飘流， 寻不见路往可居住的城巿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在旷野荒地漂流， 寻不见可住的城邑，
verses.textEnNiv: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no way to a city where they could settle.
verses.textEnEsv: Some wandered in desert wastes, finding no way to a city to dwell in;
verses.textEnNkjv: They wandered in the wilderness in a desolate way; They found no city to dwell in.
verses.textEnNlt: Some wandered in the wilderness, lost and homeless.
verses.textEnNasb: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert region; They did not find a way to an inhabited city.
verses.textEn: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no way to a city where they could settle.

verses.textZh: 他们又饥又渴， 心灵疲弱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又饥又渴， 心灵疲弱。
verses.textZhCuv: 又饥又渴， 心里发昏。
verses.textEnNiv: They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives ebbed away.
verses.textEnEsv: hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted within them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.
verses.textEnNlt: Hungry and thirsty, they nearly died.
verses.textEnNasb: They were hungry and thirsty; Their souls felt weak within them.
verses.textEn: They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives ebbed away.

verses.textZh: 他们在急难中呼求耶和华， 耶和华就救他们脱离困苦；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在急难中呼求耶和华， 耶和华就救他们脱离困苦；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华； 他从他们的祸患中搭救他们，
verses.textEnNiv: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, And He delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.textEnNlt: " Lord , help!" they cried in their trouble, and he rescued them from their distress.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble; He saved them from their distresses.
verses.textEn: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.

verses.textZh: 领他们走正直的路， 使他们去到可居住的城巿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 领他们走正直的路， 使他们去到可居住的城巿。
verses.textZhCuv: 又领他们行走直路， 使他们往可居住的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: He led them by a straight way to a city where they could settle.
verses.textEnEsv: He led them by a straight way till they reached a city to dwell in.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He led them forth by the right way, That they might go to a city for a dwelling place.
verses.textEnNlt: He led them straight to safety, to a city where they could live.
verses.textEnNasb: He also had them walk on a straight way, To go to an inhabited city.
verses.textEn: He led them by a straight way to a city where they could settle.

verses.textZh: 愿人因耶和华的慈爱， 和他向世人所行的奇事称谢他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿人因耶和华的慈爱， 和他向世人所行的奇事称谢他。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；
verses.textEnNiv: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind,
verses.textEnEsv: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love, for his wondrous works to the children of man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that men would give thanks to the Lordfor His goodness, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.textEnNlt: Let them praise the Lord for his great love and for the wonderful things he has done for them.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall give thanks to the Lord for His mercy, And for His wonders to the sons of mankind!
verses.textEn: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind,

verses.textZh: 因为他使干渴的人得到满足， 又使饥饿的人饱享美物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他使干渴的人得到满足， 又使饥饿的人饱享美物。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他使心里渴慕的人得以知足， 使心里饥饿的人得饱美物。
verses.textEnNiv: for he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
verses.textEnEsv: For he satisfies the longing soul, and the hungry soul he fills with good things.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He satisfies the longing soul, And fills the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.textEnNlt: For he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
verses.textEnNasb: For He has satisfied the thirsty soul, And He has filled the hungry soul with what is good.
verses.textEn: for he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

verses.textZh: 他们有些人坐在黑暗和死荫里， 被困苦和铁链捆锁着；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们有些人坐在黑暗和死荫里， 被困苦和铁链捆锁着；
verses.textZhCuv: 那些坐在黑暗中、死荫里的人 被困苦和铁链捆锁，
verses.textEnNiv: Some sat in darkness, in utter darkness, prisoners suffering in iron chains,
verses.textEnEsv: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and in irons,
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Bound in affliction and irons—
verses.textEnNlt: Some sat in darkness and deepest gloom, imprisoned in iron chains of misery.
verses.textEnNasb: There were those who lived in darkness and in the shadow of death, Prisoners in misery and chains,
verses.textEn: Some sat in darkness, in utter darkness, prisoners suffering in iron chains,

verses.textZh: 因为他们违背了神的话， 藐视了至高者的旨意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们违背了神的话， 藐视了至高者的旨意。
verses.textZhCuv: 是因他们违背神的话语， 藐视至高者的旨意。
verses.textEnNiv: because they rebelled against God’s commands and despised the plans of the Most High.
verses.textEnEsv: for they had rebelled against the words of God, and spurned the counsel of the Most High.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And despised the counsel of the Most High,
verses.textEnNlt: They rebelled against the words of God, scorning the counsel of the Most High.
verses.textEnNasb: Because they had rebelled against the words of God And rejected the plan of the Most High.
verses.textEn: because they rebelled against God’s commands and despised the plans of the Most High.

verses.textZh: 所以神用苦难治服他们的心； 他们跌倒，也没有人帮助。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以神用苦难治服他们的心； 他们跌倒，也没有人帮助。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，他用劳苦治服他们的心； 他们仆倒，无人扶助。
verses.textEnNiv: So he subjected them to bitter labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
verses.textEnEsv: So he bowed their hearts down with hard labor; they fell down, with none to help.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and therewas none to help.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why he broke them with hard labor; they fell, and no one was there to help them.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore He humbled their heart with labor; They stumbled and there was no one to help.
verses.textEn: So he subjected them to bitter labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

verses.textZh: 他们在急难中呼求耶和华， 耶和华就拯救他们脱离困苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在急难中呼求耶和华， 耶和华就拯救他们脱离困苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华； 他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses.
verses.textEnNlt: " Lord , help!" they cried in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble; He saved them from their distresses.
verses.textEn: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.

verses.textZh: 他从黑暗里和死荫中把他们领出来， 弄断他们的锁炼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从黑暗里和死荫中把他们领出来， 弄断他们的锁炼。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从黑暗中和死荫里领他们出来， 折断他们的绑索。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought them out of darkness, the utter darkness, and broke away their chains.
verses.textEnEsv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and burst their bonds apart.
verses.textEnNkjv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And broke their chains in pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: He led them from the darkness and deepest gloom; he snapped their chains.
verses.textEnNasb: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death And broke their bands apart.
verses.textEn: He brought them out of darkness, the utter darkness, and broke away their chains.

verses.textZh: 愿人因耶和华的慈爱， 和他向世人所行的奇事称谢他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿人因耶和华的慈爱， 和他向世人所行的奇事称谢他。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；
verses.textEnNiv: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind,
verses.textEnEsv: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love, for his wondrous works to the children of man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that men would give thanks to the Lordfor His goodness, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.textEnNlt: Let them praise the Lord for his great love and for the wonderful things he has done for them.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall give thanks to the Lord for His mercy, And for His wonders to the sons of mankind!
verses.textEn: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind,

verses.textZh: 因为他打破了铜门， 砍断了铁闩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他打破了铜门， 砍断了铁闩。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他打破了铜门， 砍断了铁闩。
verses.textEnNiv: for he breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.
verses.textEnEsv: For he shatters the doors of bronze and cuts in two the bars of iron.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He has broken the gates of bronze, And cut the bars of iron in two.
verses.textEnNlt: For he broke down their prison gates of bronze; he cut apart their bars of iron.
verses.textEnNasb: For He has shattered gates of bronze And cut off bars of iron.
verses.textEn: for he breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.

verses.textZh: 他们有些人因自己的过犯成了愚妄人， 有人受苦是因为自己的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们有些人因自己的过犯成了愚妄人， 有人受苦是因为自己的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 愚妄人因自己的过犯 和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。
verses.textEnNiv: Some became fools through their rebellious ways and suffered affliction because of their iniquities.
verses.textEnEsv: Some were fools through their sinful ways, and because of their iniquities suffered affliction;
verses.textEnNkjv: Fools, because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, were afflicted.
verses.textEnNlt: Some were fools; they rebelled and suffered for their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Fools, because of their rebellious way, And because of their guilty deeds, were afflicted.
verses.textEn: Some became fools through their rebellious ways and suffered affliction because of their iniquities.

verses.textZh: 他们厌恶各样食物， 就临近死门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们厌恶各样食物， 就临近死门。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们心里厌恶各样的食物， 就临近死门。
verses.textEnNiv: They loathed all food and drew near the gates of death.
verses.textEnEsv: they loathed any kind of food, and they drew near to the gates of death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their soul abhorred all manner of food, And they drew near to the gates of death.
verses.textEnNlt: They couldn’t stand the thought of food, and they were knocking on death’s door.
verses.textEnNasb: Their souls loathed all kinds of food, And they came close to the gates of death.
verses.textEn: They loathed all food and drew near the gates of death.

verses.textZh: 于是他们在急难中呼求耶和华， 他就拯救他们脱离困苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们在急难中呼求耶和华， 他就拯救他们脱离困苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华； 他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses.
verses.textEnNlt: " Lord , help!" they cried in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble; He saved them from their distresses.
verses.textEn: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.

verses.textZh: 他发出话语医治他们， 搭救他们脱离死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他发出话语医治他们， 搭救他们脱离死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 他发命医治他们， 救他们脱离死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: He sent out his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.
verses.textEnEsv: He sent out his word and healed them, and delivered them from their destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent His word and healed them, And delivered them from their destructions.
verses.textEnNlt: He sent out his word and healed them, snatching them from the door of death.
verses.textEnNasb: He sent His word and healed them, And saved them from their destruction.
verses.textEn: He sent out his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.

verses.textZh: 愿人因耶和华的慈爱， 因他向世人所行的奇事称谢他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿人因耶和华的慈爱， 因他向世人所行的奇事称谢他。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love, for his wondrous works to the children of man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that men would give thanks to the Lordfor His goodness, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.textEnNlt: Let them praise the Lord for his great love and for the wonderful things he has done for them.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall give thanks to the Lord for His mercy, And for His wonders to the sons of mankind!
verses.textEn: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.

verses.textZh: 愿他们以感谢为祭献给他， 欢欣地述说他的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们以感谢为祭献给他， 欢欣地述说他的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们以感谢为祭献给他， 欢呼述说他的作为！
verses.textEnNiv: Let them sacrifice thank offerings and tell of his works with songs of joy.
verses.textEnEsv: And let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving, and tell of his deeds in songs of joy!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare His works with rejoicing.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and sing joyfully about his glorious acts.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall also offer sacrifices of thanksgiving, And tell of His works with joyful singing.
verses.textEn: Let them sacrifice thank offerings and tell of his works with songs of joy.

verses.textZh: 他们有些人坐船出海， 在大海上往来经商。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们有些人坐船出海， 在大海上往来经商。
verses.textZhCuv: 在海上坐船， 在大水中经理事务的，
verses.textEnNiv: Some went out on the sea in ships; they were merchants on the mighty waters.
verses.textEnEsv: Some went down to the sea in ships, doing business on the great waters;
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who go down to the sea in ships, Who do business on great waters,
verses.textEnNlt: Some went off to sea in ships, plying the trade routes of the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who go down to the sea in ships, Who do business on great waters;
verses.textEn: Some went out on the sea in ships; they were merchants on the mighty waters.

verses.textZh: 他们见过耶和华的作为， 和他在深海中所行的奇事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们见过耶和华的作为， 和他在深海中所行的奇事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们看见耶和华的作为， 并他在深水中的奇事。
verses.textEnNiv: They saw the works of the Lord , his wonderful deeds in the deep.
verses.textEnEsv: they saw the deeds of the Lord , his wondrous works in the deep.
verses.textEnNkjv: They see the works of the Lord, And His wonders in the deep.
verses.textEnNlt: They, too, observed the Lord ’s power in action, his impressive works on the deepest seas.
verses.textEnNasb: They have seen the works of the Lord, And His wonders in the deep.
verses.textEn: They saw the works of the Lord , his wonderful deeds in the deep.

verses.textZh: 他一吩咐，狂风就刮起， 海中的波浪也高扬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一吩咐，狂风就刮起， 海中的波浪也高扬。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他一吩咐，狂风就起来， 海中的波浪也扬起。
verses.textEnNiv: For he spoke and stirred up a tempest that lifted high the waves.
verses.textEnEsv: For he commanded and raised the stormy wind, which lifted up the waves of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He commands and raises the stormy wind, Which lifts up the waves of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: He spoke, and the winds rose, stirring up the waves.
verses.textEnNasb: For He spoke and raised a stormy wind, Which lifted the waves of the sea.
verses.textEn: For he spoke and stirred up a tempest that lifted high the waves.

verses.textZh: 他们上到天上，下到深渊， 他们的心因危难而惊慌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们上到天上，下到深渊， 他们的心因危难而惊慌。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们上到天空，下到海底； 他们的心因患难便消化。
verses.textEnNiv: They mounted up to the heavens and went down to the depths; in their peril their courage melted away.
verses.textEnEsv: They mounted up to heaven; they went down to the depths; their courage melted away in their evil plight;
verses.textEnNkjv: They mount up to the heavens, They go down again to the depths; Their soul melts because of trouble.
verses.textEnNlt: Their ships were tossed to the heavens and plunged again to the depths; the sailors cringed in terror.
verses.textEnNasb: They rose up to the heavens, they went down to the depths; Their soul melted away in their misery.
verses.textEn: They mounted up to the heavens and went down to the depths; in their peril their courage melted away.

verses.textZh: 他们摇摇晃晃，东倒西歪，好象醉酒的人； 他们的一切智慧都没有用了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们摇摇晃晃，东倒西歪，好象醉酒的人； 他们的一切智慧都没有用了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们摇摇晃晃，东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人； 他们的智慧无法可施。
verses.textEnNiv: They reeled and staggered like drunkards; they were at their wits’ end.
verses.textEnEsv: they reeled and staggered like drunken men and were at their wits’ end.
verses.textEnNkjv: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits’ end.
verses.textEnNlt: They reeled and staggered like drunkards and were at their wits’ end.
verses.textEnNasb: They reeled and staggered like a drunken person, And were at their wits’ end.
verses.textEn: They reeled and staggered like drunkards; they were at their wits’ end.

verses.textZh: 于是他们在急难中呼求耶和华， 他就拯救他们脱离困苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们在急难中呼求耶和华， 他就拯救他们脱离困苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华， 他从他们的祸患中领出他们来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they cry out to the Lord in their trouble, And He brings them out of their distresses.
verses.textEnNlt: " Lord , help!" they cried in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, And He brought them out of their distresses.
verses.textEn: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.

verses.textZh: 他使狂风止息， 海浪就平静无声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使狂风止息， 海浪就平静无声。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使狂风止息， 波浪就平静。
verses.textEnNiv: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.
verses.textEnEsv: He made the storm be still, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
verses.textEnNkjv: He calms the storm, So that its waves are still.
verses.textEnNlt: He calmed the storm to a whisper and stilled the waves.
verses.textEnNasb: He caused the storm to be still, So that the waves of the sea were hushed.
verses.textEn: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.

verses.textZh: 风平浪静了，他们就欢喜； 他引领他们到他们所愿去的港口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 风平浪静了，他们就欢喜； 他引领他们到他们所愿去的港口。
verses.textZhCuv: 风息浪静，他们便欢喜； 他就引他们到所愿去的海口。
verses.textEnNiv: They were glad when it grew calm, and he guided them to their desired haven.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they were glad that the waters were quiet, and he brought them to their desired haven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they are glad because they are quiet; So He guides them to their desired haven.
verses.textEnNlt: What a blessing was that stillness as he brought them safely into harbor!
verses.textEnNasb: Then they were glad because they were quiet, So He guided them to their desired harbor.
verses.textEn: They were glad when it grew calm, and he guided them to their desired haven.

verses.textZh: 愿人因耶和华的慈爱， 和他向世人所行的奇事称谢他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿人因耶和华的慈爱， 和他向世人所行的奇事称谢他。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱 和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love, for his wondrous works to the children of man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that men would give thanks to the Lordfor His goodness, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.textEnNlt: Let them praise the Lord for his great love and for the wonderful things he has done for them.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall give thanks to the Lord for His mercy, And for His wonders to the sons of mankind!
verses.textEn: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind.

verses.textZh: 愿他们在众民的会中尊崇他， 在长老的集会中赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们在众民的会中尊崇他， 在长老的集会中赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们在民的会中尊崇他， 在长老的位上赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Let them exalt him in the assembly of the people and praise him in the council of the elders.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them extol him in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them exalt Him also in the assembly of the people, And praise Him in the company of the elders.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them exalt him publicly before the congregation and before the leaders of the nation.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall also exalt Him in the congregation of the people, And praise Him at the seat of the elders.
verses.textEn: Let them exalt him in the assembly of the people and praise him in the council of the elders.

verses.textZh: 他使江河变为旷野， 使水泉变为干旱无水之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使江河变为旷野， 使水泉变为干旱无水之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使江河变为旷野， 叫水泉变为干渴之地，
verses.textEnNiv: He turned rivers into a desert, flowing springs into thirsty ground,
verses.textEnEsv: He turns rivers into a desert, springs of water into thirsty ground,
verses.textEnNkjv: He turns rivers into a wilderness, And the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.textEnNlt: He changes rivers into deserts, and springs of water into dry, thirsty land.
verses.textEnNasb: He turns rivers into a wilderness, And springs of water into a thirsty ground;
verses.textEn: He turned rivers into a desert, flowing springs into thirsty ground,

verses.textZh: 他使肥沃的土地变为咸田， 都因住在那里的居民的邪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使肥沃的土地变为咸田， 都因住在那里的居民的邪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 使肥地变为硷地； 这都因其间居民的罪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: and fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who lived there.
verses.textEnEsv: a fruitful land into a salty waste, because of the evil of its inhabitants.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fruitful land into barrenness, For the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: He turns the fruitful land into salty wastelands, because of the wickedness of those who live there.
verses.textEnNasb: And a fruitful land into a salt waste, Because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
verses.textEn: and fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who lived there.

verses.textZh: 他使旷野变为池塘， 使旱地变为水泉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使旷野变为池塘， 使旱地变为水泉。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使旷野变为水潭， 叫旱地变为水泉。
verses.textEnNiv: He turned the desert into pools of water and the parched ground into flowing springs;
verses.textEnEsv: He turns a desert into pools of water, a parched land into springs of water.
verses.textEnNkjv: He turns a wilderness into pools of water, And dry land into watersprings.
verses.textEnNlt: But he also turns deserts into pools of water, the dry land into springs of water.
verses.textEnNasb: He turns a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into springs of water;
verses.textEn: He turned the desert into pools of water and the parched ground into flowing springs;

verses.textZh: 他使饥饿的人住在那里， 好让他们建造可以居住的城巿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使饥饿的人住在那里， 好让他们建造可以居住的城巿。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使饥饿的人住在那里， 好建造可住的城邑，
verses.textEnNiv: there he brought the hungry to live, and they founded a city where they could settle.
verses.textEnEsv: And there he lets the hungry dwell, and they establish a city to live in;
verses.textEnNkjv: There He makes the hungry dwell, That they may establish a city for a dwelling place,
verses.textEnNlt: He brings the hungry to settle there and to build their cities.
verses.textEnNasb: And He has the hungry live there, So that they may establish an inhabited city,
verses.textEn: there he brought the hungry to live, and they founded a city where they could settle.

verses.textZh: 他们耕种田地，栽种葡萄园， 得到丰盛的收成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们耕种田地，栽种葡萄园， 得到丰盛的收成。
verses.textZhCuv: 又种田地，栽葡萄园， 得享所出的土产。
verses.textEnNiv: They sowed fields and planted vineyards that yielded a fruitful harvest;
verses.textEnEsv: they sow fields and plant vineyards and get a fruitful yield.
verses.textEnNkjv: And sow fields and plant vineyards, That they may yield a fruitful harvest.
verses.textEnNlt: They sow their fields, plant their vineyards, and harvest their bumper crops.
verses.textEnNasb: And sow fields and plant vineyards, And gather a fruitful harvest.
verses.textEn: They sowed fields and planted vineyards that yielded a fruitful harvest;

verses.textZh: 他又赐福给他们， 使他们人口众多， 也没有使他们的牲畜减少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又赐福给他们， 使他们人口众多， 也没有使他们的牲畜减少。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又赐福给他们，叫他们生养众多， 也不叫他们的牲畜减少。
verses.textEnNiv: he blessed them, and their numbers greatly increased, and he did not let their herds diminish.
verses.textEnEsv: By his blessing they multiply greatly, and he does not let their livestock diminish.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also blesses them, and they multiply greatly; And He does not let their cattle decrease.
verses.textEnNlt: How he blesses them! They raise large families there, and their herds of livestock increase.
verses.textEnNasb: He also blesses them and they multiply greatly, And He does not let their cattle decrease.
verses.textEn: he blessed them, and their numbers greatly increased, and he did not let their herds diminish.

verses.textZh: 以后他们因为压迫、患难、愁苦， 就人数减少，降为卑微。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后他们因为压迫、患难、愁苦， 就人数减少，降为卑微。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又因暴虐、患难、愁苦， 就减少且卑下。
verses.textEnNiv: Then their numbers decreased, and they were humbled by oppression, calamity and sorrow;
verses.textEnEsv: When they are diminished and brought low through oppression, evil, and sorrow,
verses.textEnNkjv: When they are diminished and brought low Through oppression, affliction, and sorrow,
verses.textEnNlt: When they decrease in number and become impoverished through oppression, trouble, and sorrow,
verses.textEnNasb: When they become few and lowly Because of oppression, misery, and sorrow,
verses.textEn: Then their numbers decreased, and they were humbled by oppression, calamity and sorrow;

verses.textZh: 他使权贵受羞辱， 使他们在荒废无路的地方飘流。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使权贵受羞辱， 使他们在荒废无路的地方飘流。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使君王蒙羞被辱， 使他们在荒废无路之地漂流。
verses.textEnNiv: he who pours contempt on nobles made them wander in a trackless waste.
verses.textEnEsv: he pours contempt on princes and makes them wander in trackless wastes;
verses.textEnNkjv: He pours contempt on princes, And causes them to wander in the wilderness wherethereis no way;
verses.textEnNlt: the Lord pours contempt on their princes, causing them to wander in trackless wastelands.
verses.textEnNasb: He pours contempt upon noblemen And makes them wander in a pathless wasteland.
verses.textEn: he who pours contempt on nobles made them wander in a trackless waste.

verses.textZh: 他却把贫穷的人安置在高处，免受苦难， 使他的家族繁衍，好象羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却把贫穷的人安置在高处，免受苦难， 使他的家族繁衍，好象羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 他却将穷乏人安置在高处，脱离苦难， 使他的家属多如羊群。
verses.textEnNiv: But he lifted the needy out of their affliction and increased their families like flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: but he raises up the needy out of affliction and makes their families like flocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet He sets the poor on high, far from affliction, And makes their families like a flock.
verses.textEnNlt: But he rescues the poor from trouble and increases their families like flocks of sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: But He sets the needy securely on high, away from affliction, And makes his families like a flock.
verses.textEn: But he lifted the needy out of their affliction and increased their families like flocks.

verses.textZh: 正直的人看见了，就欢喜； 但所有邪恶的人都必闭口无言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正直的人看见了，就欢喜； 但所有邪恶的人都必闭口无言。
verses.textZhCuv: 正直人看见就欢喜； 罪孽之辈必塞口无言。
verses.textEnNiv: The upright see and rejoice, but all the wicked shut their mouths.
verses.textEnEsv: The upright see it and are glad, and all wickedness shuts its mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteous see it and rejoice, And all iniquity stops its mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly will see these things and be glad, while the wicked are struck silent.
verses.textEnNasb: The upright see it and are glad; But all injustice shuts its mouth.
verses.textEn: The upright see and rejoice, but all the wicked shut their mouths.

verses.textZh: 凡有智慧的，愿他留意这些事； 愿他思想耶和华的慈爱。 歌一首，大卫的诗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡有智慧的，愿他留意这些事； 愿他思想耶和华的慈爱。 歌一首，大卫的诗。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有智慧的，必在这些事上留心， 也必思想耶和华的慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the one who is wise heed these things and ponder the loving deeds of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever is wise, let him attend to these things; let them consider the steadfast love of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever is wise will observe these things, And they will understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are wise will take all this to heart; they will see in our history the faithful love of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Who is wise? He is to pay attention to these things, And consider the mercy of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Let the one who is wise heed these things and ponder the loving deeds of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 神啊！我的心坚定； 我要用我的灵 歌唱和颂赞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！我的心坚定； 我要用我的灵 歌唱和颂赞。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我心坚定； 我口 要唱诗歌颂！
verses.textEnNiv: My heart, O God, is steadfast; I will sing and make music with all my soul.
verses.textEnEsv: My heart is steadfast, O God! I will sing and make melody with all my being!
verses.textEnNkjv: O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart is confident in you, O God; no wonder I can sing your praises with all my heart!
verses.textEnNasb: My heart is steadfast, God; I will sing, I will sing praises also with my soul.
verses.textEn: My heart, O God, is steadfast; I will sing and make music with all my soul.

verses.textZh: 琴和瑟啊！你们都要醒过来； 我也要唤醒黎明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 琴和瑟啊！你们都要醒过来； 我也要唤醒黎明。
verses.textZhCuv: 琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！ 我自己要极早醒起！
verses.textEnNiv: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
verses.textEnEsv: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awake the dawn!
verses.textEnNkjv: Awake, lute and harp! I will awaken the dawn.
verses.textEnNlt: Wake up, lyre and harp! I will wake the dawn with my song.
verses.textEnNasb: Awake, harp and lyre; I will awaken the dawn!
verses.textEn: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我要在万民中称谢你， 在万族中歌颂你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我要在万民中称谢你， 在万族中歌颂你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我要在万民中称谢你， 在列邦中歌颂你！
verses.textEnNiv: I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: I will give thanks to you, O Lord , among the peoples; I will sing praises to you among the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will praise You, O Lord, among the peoples, And I will sing praises to You among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: I will thank you, Lord , among all the people. I will sing your praises among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: I will give thanks to You, Lord, among the peoples, And I will sing praises to You among the nations.
verses.textEn: I will praise you, Lord , among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

verses.textZh: 因为你的慈爱伟大，高及诸天； 你的信实上达云霄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你的慈爱伟大，高及诸天； 你的信实上达云霄。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，你的慈爱大过诸天； 你的诚实达到穹苍。
verses.textEnNiv: For great is your love, higher than the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
verses.textEnEsv: For your steadfast love is great above the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Your mercy is great above the heavens, And Your truth reaches to the clouds.
verses.textEnNlt: For your unfailing love is higher than the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
verses.textEnNasb: For Your mercy is great above the heavens, And Your truth reaches to the skies.
verses.textEn: For great is your love, higher than the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

verses.textZh: 神啊！愿你被尊崇，过于诸天； 愿你的荣耀遍及全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！愿你被尊崇，过于诸天； 愿你的荣耀遍及全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！ 愿你的荣耀高过全地！
verses.textEnNiv: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, And Your glory above all the earth;
verses.textEnNlt: Be exalted, O God, above the highest heavens. May your glory shine over all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Be exalted above the heavens, God, And may Your glory be above all the earth.
verses.textEn: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

verses.textZh: 求你用右手拯救我们，应允我们， 使你喜爱的人得拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你用右手拯救我们，应允我们， 使你喜爱的人得拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们， 好叫你所亲爱的人得救。
verses.textEnNiv: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.
verses.textEnEsv: That your beloved ones may be delivered, give salvation by your right hand and answer me!
verses.textEnNkjv: That Your beloved may be delivered, Save with Your right hand, and hear me.
verses.textEnNlt: Now rescue your beloved people. Answer and save us by your power.
verses.textEnNasb: So that Your beloved may be rescued, Save with Your right hand, and answer me!
verses.textEn: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

verses.textZh: 神在自己的圣所 说： "我必夸胜， 我必分开示剑， 我必量度疏割谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在自己的圣所 说： "我必夸胜， 我必分开示剑， 我必量度疏割谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 神已经指着他的圣洁说 ： 我要欢乐；我要分开示剑， 丈量疏割谷。
verses.textEnNiv: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.
verses.textEnEsv: God has promised in his holiness: "With exultation I will divide up Shechem and portion out the Valley of Succoth.
verses.textEnNkjv: God has spoken in His holiness: "I will rejoice; I will divide Shechem And measure out the Valley of Succoth.
verses.textEnNlt: God has promised this by his holiness : "I will divide up Shechem with joy. I will measure out the valley of Succoth.
verses.textEnNasb: God has spoken in His holiness: "I will triumph, I will divide up Shechem, And measure out the Valley of Succoth.
verses.textEn: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.

verses.textZh: 基列是我的，玛拿西是我的； 以法莲是我的头盔； 犹大是我的权杖，
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列是我的，玛拿西是我的； 以法莲是我的头盔； 犹大是我的权杖，
verses.textZhCuv: 基列是我的； 玛拿西是我的； 以法莲是护卫我头的； 犹大是我的杖；
verses.textEnNiv: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.
verses.textEnEsv: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my scepter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gilead is Mine; Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim also is the helmet for My head; Judah is My lawgiver.
verses.textEnNlt: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh, too. Ephraim, my helmet, will produce my warriors, and Judah, my scepter, will produce my kings.
verses.textEnNasb: "Gilead is Mine, Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim also is the helmet of My head; Judah is My scepter.
verses.textEn: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah is my scepter.

verses.textZh: 摩押是我的洗脚盆； 我要向以东拋鞋， 我要因战胜非利士欢呼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩押是我的洗脚盆； 我要向以东拋鞋， 我要因战胜非利士欢呼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩押是我的沐浴盆； 我要向以东抛鞋； 我必因胜非利士呼喊。
verses.textEnNiv: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."
verses.textEnEsv: Moab is my washbasin; upon Edom I cast my shoe; over Philistia I shout in triumph."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moab is My washpot; Over Edom I will cast My shoe; Over Philistia I will triumph."
verses.textEnNlt: But Moab, my washbasin, will become my servant, and I will wipe my feet on Edom and shout in triumph over Philistia."
verses.textEnNasb: "Moab is My washbowl; I will throw My sandal over Edom; I will shout aloud over Philistia."
verses.textEn: Moab is my washbasin, on Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."

verses.textZh: 谁能带我进坚固城？ 谁能领我到以东地去呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能带我进坚固城？ 谁能领我到以东地去呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能领我进坚固城？ 谁能引我到以东地？
verses.textEnNiv: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
verses.textEnEsv: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me to Edom?
verses.textEnNlt: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will bring me victory over Edom?
verses.textEnNasb: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
verses.textEn: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

verses.textZh: 神啊！你不是把我们丢弃了吗？神啊！你不和我们的军队一同出战吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 神啊！你不是把我们丢弃了吗？神啊！你不和我们的军队一同出战吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，你不是丢弃了我们吗？神啊，你不和我们的军兵同去吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is it not you, God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?
verses.textEnEsv: Have you not rejected us, O God? You do not go out, O God, with our armies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Isit not You, O God, who cast us off? And You, O God, who did not go out with our armies?
verses.textEnNlt: Have you rejected us, O God? Will you no longer march with our armies?
verses.textEnNasb: God, have You Yourself not rejected us? And will You not go forth with our armies, God?
verses.textEn: Is it not you, God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

verses.textZh: 求你帮助我们抵挡敌人， 因为人的援助是没有用的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你帮助我们抵挡敌人， 因为人的援助是没有用的。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人， 因为人的帮助是枉然的。
verses.textEnNiv: Give us aid against the enemy, for human help is worthless.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh grant us help against the foe, for vain is the salvation of man!
verses.textEnNkjv: Give us help from trouble, For the help of man is useless.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, please help us against our enemies, for all human help is useless.
verses.textEnNasb: Give us help against the enemy, For deliverance by man is worthless.
verses.textEn: Give us aid against the enemy, for human help is worthless.

verses.textZh: 我们靠着神奋勇作战， 因为他必践踏我们的敌人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们靠着神奋勇作战， 因为他必践踏我们的敌人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们倚靠神才得施展大能， 因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。
verses.textEnNiv: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: With God we shall do valiantly; it is he who will tread down our foes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Through God we will do valiantly, For itis He who shall tread down our enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: With God’s help we will do mighty things, for he will trample down our foes.
verses.textEnNasb: Through God we will do valiantly, And it is He who will trample down our enemies.
verses.textEn: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 我所赞美的神啊！ 求你不要缄默无声，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗，交给诗班长。 我所赞美的神啊！ 求你不要缄默无声，
verses.textZhCuv: 我所赞美的神啊， 求你不要闭口不言。
verses.textEnNiv: My God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,
verses.textEnEsv: Be not silent, O God of my praise!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not keep silent, O God of my praise!
verses.textEnNlt: O God, whom I praise, don’t stand silent and aloof
verses.textEnNasb: God of my praise, Do not be silent!
verses.textEn: My God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,

verses.textZh: 因为邪恶的人的嘴和诡诈的人的口，已经张开攻击我； 他们用虚谎的舌头对我说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为邪恶的人的嘴和诡诈的人的口，已经张开攻击我； 他们用虚谎的舌头对我说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为恶人的嘴和诡诈人的口已经张开攻击我； 他们用撒谎的舌头对我说话。
verses.textEnNiv: for people who are wicked and deceitful have opened their mouths against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.
verses.textEnEsv: For wicked and deceitful mouths are opened against me, speaking against me with lying tongues.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful Have opened against me; They have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: while the wicked slander me and tell lies about me.
verses.textEnNasb: For they have opened a wicked and deceitful mouth against me; They have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.textEn: for people who are wicked and deceitful have opened their mouths against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.

verses.textZh: 他们说毒恨的话围攻我， 无缘无故攻击我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说毒恨的话围攻我， 无缘无故攻击我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们围绕我，说怨恨的话， 又无故地攻打我。
verses.textEnNiv: With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.
verses.textEnEsv: They encircle me with words of hate, and attack me without cause.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.
verses.textEnNlt: They surround me with hateful words and fight against me for no reason.
verses.textEnNasb: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, And have fought against me without cause.
verses.textEn: With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.

verses.textZh: 他们以敌对的态度来回报我的爱； 至于我，我只有祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们以敌对的态度来回报我的爱； 至于我，我只有祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们与我为敌以报我爱， 但我专心祈祷。
verses.textEnNiv: In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: In return for my love they accuse me, but I give myself to prayer.
verses.textEnNkjv: In return for my love they are my accusers, But I givemyselfto prayer.
verses.textEnNlt: I love them, but they try to destroy me with accusations even as I am praying for them!
verses.textEnNasb: In return for my love they act as my accusers; But I am in prayer.
verses.textEn: In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

verses.textZh: 他们对我以恶报善， 以憎恨回报我的爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对我以恶报善， 以憎恨回报我的爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们向我以恶报善， 以恨报爱。
verses.textEnNiv: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my friendship.
verses.textEnEsv: So they reward me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.
verses.textEnNlt: They repay evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.textEnNasb: So they have repaid me evil for good, And hatred for my love.
verses.textEn: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my friendship.

verses.textZh: 求你派一个恶人对付他； 派一个对头站在他的右边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你派一个恶人对付他； 派一个对头站在他的右边。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你派一个恶人辖制他， 派一个对头站在他右边！
verses.textEnNiv: Appoint someone evil to oppose my enemy; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Appoint a wicked man against him; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Set a wicked man over him, And let an accuser stand at his right hand.
verses.textEnNlt: They say, "Get an evil person to turn against him. Send an accuser to bring him to trial.
verses.textEnNasb: Appoint a wicked person over him, And may an accuser stand at his right hand.
verses.textEn: Appoint someone evil to oppose my enemy; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

verses.textZh: 他受审判的时候，愿他被判为有罪； 愿他的祷告成为罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他受审判的时候，愿他被判为有罪； 愿他的祷告成为罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他受审判的时候， 愿他出来担当罪名！ 愿他的祈祷反成为罪！
verses.textEnNiv: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayers condemn him.
verses.textEnEsv: When he is tried, let him come forth guilty; let his prayer be counted as sin!
verses.textEnNkjv: When he is judged, let him be found guilty, And let his prayer become sin.
verses.textEnNlt: When his case comes up for judgment, let him be pronounced guilty. Count his prayers as sins.
verses.textEnNasb: When he is judged, may he come out guilty, And may his prayer become sin.
verses.textEn: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayers condemn him.

verses.textZh: 愿他的年日短少， 愿别人取代他的职分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他的年日短少， 愿别人取代他的职分。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他的年日短少！ 愿别人得他的职分！
verses.textEnNiv: May his days be few; may another take his place of leadership.
verses.textEnEsv: May his days be few; may another take his office!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let his days be few, And let another take his office.
verses.textEnNlt: Let his years be few; let someone else take his position.
verses.textEnNasb: May his days be few; May another take his office.
verses.textEn: May his days be few; may another take his place of leadership.

verses.textZh: 愿他的儿女成为孤儿； 愿他的妻子成为寡妇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他的儿女成为孤儿； 愿他的妻子成为寡妇。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他的儿女为孤儿， 他的妻子为寡妇！
verses.textEnNiv: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
verses.textEnEsv: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.
verses.textEnNlt: May his children become fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.textEnNasb: May his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.
verses.textEn: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

verses.textZh: 愿他的儿女流离失所，到处求乞； 愿他们从他们破毁的家中被赶逐出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他的儿女流离失所，到处求乞； 愿他们从他们破毁的家中被赶逐出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他的儿女漂流讨饭， 从他们荒凉之处出来求食！
verses.textEnNiv: May his children be wandering beggars; may they be driven from their ruined homes.
verses.textEnEsv: May his children wander about and beg, seeking food far from the ruins they inhabit!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let his children continually be vagabonds, and beg; Let them seek theirbread also from their desolate places.
verses.textEnNlt: May his children wander as beggars and be driven from their ruined homes.
verses.textEnNasb: May his children wander about and beg; And may they seek sustenance far from their ruined homes.
verses.textEn: May his children be wandering beggars; may they be driven from their ruined homes.

verses.textZh: 愿债主夺去他一切所有的； 愿外人都劫掠他劳碌得来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿债主夺去他一切所有的； 愿外人都劫掠他劳碌得来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿强暴的债主牢笼他一切所有的！ 愿外人抢他劳碌得来的！
verses.textEnNiv: May a creditor seize all he has; may strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
verses.textEnEsv: May the creditor seize all that he has; may strangers plunder the fruits of his toil!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the creditor seize all that he has, And let strangers plunder his labor.
verses.textEnNlt: May creditors seize his entire estate, and strangers take all he has earned.
verses.textEnNasb: May the creditor seize everything that he has, And may strangers plunder the product of his labor.
verses.textEn: May a creditor seize all he has; may strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.

verses.textZh: 愿无人对他施仁慈； 愿无人恩待他的孤儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿无人对他施仁慈； 愿无人恩待他的孤儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿无人向他延绵施恩！ 愿无人可怜他的孤儿！
verses.textEnNiv: May no one extend kindness to him or take pity on his fatherless children.
verses.textEnEsv: Let there be none to extend kindness to him, nor any to pity his fatherless children!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let there be none to extend mercy to him, Nor let there be any to favor his fatherless children.
verses.textEnNlt: Let no one be kind to him; let no one pity his fatherless children.
verses.textEnNasb: May there be none to extend kindness to him, Nor any to be gracious to his fatherless children.
verses.textEn: May no one extend kindness to him or take pity on his fatherless children.

verses.textZh: 愿他的后人被除灭， 愿他们的名字在下一代被涂抹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他的后人被除灭， 愿他们的名字在下一代被涂抹。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他的后人断绝， 名字被涂抹，不传于下代！
verses.textEnNiv: May his descendants be cut off, their names blotted out from the next generation.
verses.textEnEsv: May his posterity be cut off; may his name be blotted out in the second generation!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let his posterity be cut off, And in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.textEnNlt: May all his offspring die. May his family name be blotted out in the next generation.
verses.textEnNasb: May his descendants be eliminated; May their name be wiped out in a following generation.
verses.textEn: May his descendants be cut off, their names blotted out from the next generation.

verses.textZh: 愿他列祖的罪孽被耶和华谨记； 愿他母亲的罪恶不被涂抹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他列祖的罪孽被耶和华谨记； 愿他母亲的罪恶不被涂抹。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他祖宗的罪孽被耶和华记念！ 愿他母亲的罪过不被涂抹！
verses.textEnNiv: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord ; may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
verses.textEnEsv: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord , and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord, And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord never forget the sins of his fathers; may his mother’s sins never be erased from the record.
verses.textEnNasb: May the guilt of his fathers be remembered before the Lord, And do not let the sin of his mother be wiped out.
verses.textEn: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord ; may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

verses.textZh: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前， 好使他们的名号从地上被除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前， 好使他们的名号从地上被除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前， 使他的名号断绝于世！
verses.textEnNiv: May their sins always remain before the Lord , that he may blot out their name from the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be continually before the Lord, That He may cut off the memory of them from the earth;
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord always remember these sins, and may his name disappear from human memory.
verses.textEnNasb: May they be before the Lord continually, So that He may eliminate their memory from the earth;
verses.textEn: May their sins always remain before the Lord , that he may blot out their name from the earth.

verses.textZh: 因为他从没有想起要施慈爱， 只知道迫害困苦、贫穷和伤心的人， 要把他们置于死地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他从没有想起要施慈爱， 只知道迫害困苦、贫穷和伤心的人， 要把他们置于死地。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他不想施恩， 却逼迫困苦穷乏的和伤心的人， 要把他们治死。
verses.textEnNiv: For he never thought of doing a kindness, but hounded to death the poor and the needy and the brokenhearted.
verses.textEnEsv: For he did not remember to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and the brokenhearted, to put them to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because he did not remember to show mercy, But persecuted the poor and needy man, That he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.textEnNlt: For he refused all kindness to others; he persecuted the poor and needy, and he hounded the brokenhearted to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Because he did not remember to show mercy, But persecuted the afflicted and needy person, And the despondent in heart, to put them to death.
verses.textEn: For he never thought of doing a kindness, but hounded to death the poor and the needy and the brokenhearted.

verses.textZh: 他爱咒诅，愿咒诅临到他； 他不喜爱祝福，愿福乐远离他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他爱咒诅，愿咒诅临到他； 他不喜爱祝福，愿福乐远离他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他爱咒骂，咒骂就临到他； 他不喜爱福乐，福乐就与他远离！
verses.textEnNiv: He loved to pronounce a curse— may it come back on him. He found no pleasure in blessing— may it be far from him.
