verses.textEnEsv: He loved to curse; let curses come upon him! He did not delight in blessing; may it be far from him!
verses.textEnNkjv: As he loved cursing, so let it come to him; As he did not delight in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.textEnNlt: He loved to curse others; now you curse him. He never blessed others; now don’t you bless him.
verses.textEnNasb: He also loved cursing, so it came to him; And he did not delight in blessing, so it was far from him.
verses.textEn: He loved to pronounce a curse— may it come back on him. He found no pleasure in blessing— may it be far from him.

verses.textZh: 他以咒诅当作衣服穿上， 咒诅就像水一般进入他的内脏， 像油一样进入他的骨头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以咒诅当作衣服穿上， 咒诅就像水一般进入他的内脏， 像油一样进入他的骨头。
verses.textZhCuv: 他拿咒骂当衣服穿上； 这咒骂就如水进他里面， 像油入他的骨头。
verses.textEnNiv: He wore cursing as his garment; it entered into his body like water, into his bones like oil.
verses.textEnEsv: He clothed himself with cursing as his coat; may it soak into his body like water, like oil into his bones!
verses.textEnNkjv: As he clothed himself with cursing as with his garment, So let it enter his body like water, And like oil into his bones.
verses.textEnNlt: Cursing is as natural to him as his clothing, or the water he drinks, or the rich food he eats.
verses.textEnNasb: But he clothed himself with cursing as with his garment, And it entered his body like water, And like oil into his bones.
verses.textEn: He wore cursing as his garment; it entered into his body like water, into his bones like oil.

verses.textZh: 愿这咒诅像衣服一般给他披上， 并当作他常常束上的腰带。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿这咒诅像衣服一般给他披上， 并当作他常常束上的腰带。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿这咒骂当他遮身的衣服， 当他常束的腰带！
verses.textEnNiv: May it be like a cloak wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
verses.textEnEsv: May it be like a garment that he wraps around him, like a belt that he puts on every day!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let it be to him like the garment which covers him, And for a belt with which he girds himself continually.
verses.textEnNlt: Now may his curses return and cling to him like clothing; may they be tied around him like a belt."
verses.textEnNasb: May it be to him as a garment with which he covers himself, And as a belt which he constantly wears around himself.
verses.textEn: May it be like a cloak wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.

verses.textZh: 愿敌对我和用恶言攻击我的， 都从耶和华那里得到这报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿敌对我和用恶言攻击我的， 都从耶和华那里得到这报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是我对头和用恶言议论我的人 从耶和华那里所受的报应。
verses.textEnNiv: May this be the Lord ’s payment to my accusers, to those who speak evil of me.
verses.textEnEsv: May this be the reward of my accusers from the Lord , of those who speak evil against my life!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let this be the Lord’s reward to my accusers, And to those who speak evil against my person.
verses.textEnNlt: May those curses become the Lord ’s punishment for my accusers who speak evil of me.
verses.textEnNasb: May this be the reward of my accusers from the Lord, And of those who speak evil against my soul.
verses.textEn: May this be the Lord ’s payment to my accusers, to those who speak evil of me.

verses.textZh: 至于你，主耶和华啊！求你为你名的缘故恩待我； 按着你美好的慈爱拯救我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，主耶和华啊！求你为你名的缘故恩待我； 按着你美好的慈爱拯救我。
verses.textZhCuv: 主－耶和华啊，求你为你的名恩待我； 因你的慈爱美好，求你搭救我！
verses.textEnNiv: But you, Sovereign Lord , help me for your name’s sake; out of the goodness of your love, deliver me.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O God my Lord, deal on my behalf for your name’s sake; because your steadfast love is good, deliver me!
verses.textEnNkjv: But You, O God the Lord, Deal with me for Your name’s sake; Because Your mercy is good, deliver me.
verses.textEnNlt: But deal well with me, O Sovereign Lord , for the sake of your own reputation! Rescue me because you are so faithful and good.
verses.textEnNasb: But You, God, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; Because Your mercy is good, rescue me;
verses.textEn: But you, Sovereign Lord , help me for your name’s sake; out of the goodness of your love, deliver me.

verses.textZh: 因为我困苦贫穷， 我的内心伤痛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我困苦贫穷， 我的内心伤痛。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我困苦穷乏， 内心受伤。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.textEnEsv: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is stricken within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is full of pain.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am afflicted and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.
verses.textEn: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.textZh: 我像日影倾斜，渐渐消逝， 又像蝗虫被抖掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我像日影倾斜，渐渐消逝， 又像蝗虫被抖掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 我如日影渐渐偏斜而去； 我如蝗虫被抖出来。
verses.textEnNiv: I fade away like an evening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.textEnEsv: I am gone like a shadow at evening; I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am gone like a shadow when it lengthens; I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.textEnNlt: I am fading like a shadow at dusk; I am brushed off like a locust.
verses.textEnNasb: I am passing like a shadow when it lengthens; I am shaken off like the locust.
verses.textEn: I fade away like an evening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.

verses.textZh: 我因禁食，双膝软弱无力； 我的身体消瘦枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因禁食，双膝软弱无力； 我的身体消瘦枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因禁食，膝骨软弱； 我身上的肉也渐渐瘦了。
verses.textEnNiv: My knees give way from fasting; my body is thin and gaunt.
verses.textEnEsv: My knees are weak through fasting; my body has become gaunt, with no fat.
verses.textEnNkjv: My knees are weak through fasting, And my flesh is feeble from lack of fatness.
verses.textEnNlt: My knees are weak from fasting, and I am skin and bones.
verses.textEnNasb: My knees are weak from fasting, And my flesh has grown lean, without fatness.
verses.textEn: My knees give way from fasting; my body is thin and gaunt.

verses.textZh: 我成了他们羞辱的对象； 他们一看见我，就摇头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我成了他们羞辱的对象； 他们一看见我，就摇头。
verses.textZhCuv: 我受他们的羞辱， 他们看见我便摇头。
verses.textEnNiv: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they wag their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also have become a reproach to them; When they look at me, they shake their heads.
verses.textEnNlt: I am a joke to people everywhere; when they see me, they shake their heads in scorn.
verses.textEnNasb: I also have become a disgrace to them; When they see me, they shake their head.
verses.textEn: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神啊！求你帮助我； 求你按着你的慈爱拯救我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神啊！求你帮助我； 求你按着你的慈爱拯救我，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神啊，求你帮助我， 照你的慈爱拯救我，
verses.textEnNiv: Help me, Lord my God; save me according to your unfailing love.
verses.textEnEsv: Help me, O Lord my God! Save me according to your steadfast love!
verses.textEnNkjv: Help me, O Lord my God! Oh, save me according to Your mercy,
verses.textEnNlt: Help me, O Lord my God! Save me because of your unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: Help me, Lord my God; Save me according to Your mercy.
verses.textEn: Help me, Lord my God; save me according to your unfailing love.

verses.textZh: 好让人知道这是出于你的手， 是你耶和华所作的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好让人知道这是出于你的手， 是你耶和华所作的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 使他们知道这是你的手， 是你－耶和华所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them know that it is your hand, that you, Lord , have done it.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them know that this is your hand; you, O Lord , have done it!
verses.textEnNkjv: That they may know that this is Your hand— That You, Lord, have done it!
verses.textEnNlt: Let them see that this is your doing, that you yourself have done it, Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And may they know that this is Your hand; You, Lord, have done it.
verses.textEn: Let them know that it is your hand, that you, Lord , have done it.

verses.textZh: 任凭他们咒诅，只愿你赐福； 愿起来攻击我的都蒙羞， 你的仆人却要欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 任凭他们咒诅，只愿你赐福； 愿起来攻击我的都蒙羞， 你的仆人却要欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 任凭他们咒骂，惟愿你赐福； 他们几时起来就必蒙羞， 你的仆人却要欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: While they curse, may you bless; may those who attack me be put to shame, but may your servant rejoice.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them curse, but you will bless! They arise and are put to shame, but your servant will be glad!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them curse, but You bless; When they arise, let them be ashamed, But let Your servant rejoice.
verses.textEnNlt: Then let them curse me if they like, but you will bless me! When they attack me, they will be disgraced! But I, your servant, will go right on rejoicing!
verses.textEnNasb: They will curse, but You bless; When they arise, they will be ashamed, But Your servant will be glad.
verses.textEn: While they curse, may you bless; may those who attack me be put to shame, but may your servant rejoice.

verses.textZh: 愿敌对我的披戴羞辱； 愿他们以自己的耻辱为外袍披在身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿敌对我的披戴羞辱； 愿他们以自己的耻辱为外袍披在身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我的对头披戴羞辱！ 愿他们以自己的羞愧为外袍遮身！
verses.textEnNiv: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.
verses.textEnEsv: May my accusers be clothed with dishonor; may they be wrapped in their own shame as in a cloak!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let my accusers be clothed with shame, And let them cover themselves with their own disgrace as with a mantle.
verses.textEnNlt: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may their humiliation cover them like a cloak.
verses.textEnNasb: May my accusers be clothed with dishonor, And may they cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
verses.textEn: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.

verses.textZh: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华； 我要在众人中间赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华； 我要在众人中间赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华； 我要在众人中间赞美他；
verses.textEnNiv: With my mouth I will greatly extol the Lord ; in the great throng of worshipers I will praise him.
verses.textEnEsv: With my mouth I will give great thanks to the Lord ; I will praise him in the midst of the throng.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; Yes, I will praise Him among the multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will give repeated thanks to the Lord , praising him to everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: With my mouth I will give thanks abundantly to the Lord; And I will praise Him in the midst of many.
verses.textEn: With my mouth I will greatly extol the Lord ; in the great throng of worshipers I will praise him.

verses.textZh: 因为他必站在贫穷人的右边， 拯救他脱离定他死罪的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他必站在贫穷人的右边， 拯救他脱离定他死罪的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他必站在穷乏人的右边， 要救他脱离审判他灵魂的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For he stands at the right hand of the needy, to save their lives from those who would condemn them.
verses.textEnEsv: For he stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from those who condemn his soul to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He shall stand at the right hand of the poor, To save him from those who condemn him.
verses.textEnNlt: For he stands beside the needy, ready to save them from those who condemn them.
verses.textEnNasb: For He stands at the right hand of the needy, To save him from those who judge his soul.
verses.textEn: For he stands at the right hand of the needy, to save their lives from those who would condemn them.

verses.textZh: 大卫的诗。 耶和华对我主说： "你坐在我的右边， 等我使你的仇敌作你的脚凳。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫的诗。 耶和华对我主说： "你坐在我的右边， 等我使你的仇敌作你的脚凳。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我主说： 你坐在我的右边， 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord says to my lord: "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord says to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit in the place of honor at my right hand until I humble your enemies, making them a footstool under your feet."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord says to my Lord: "Sit at My right hand Until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet."
verses.textEn: The Lord says to my lord: "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet."

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使你从锡安伸出能力的权杖， 你要在你的仇敌中掌权。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使你从锡安伸出能力的权杖， 你要在你的仇敌中掌权。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必使你从锡安伸出能力的杖来； 你要在你仇敌中掌权。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will extend your mighty scepter from Zion, saying, "Rule in the midst of your enemies!"
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord sends forth from Zion your mighty scepter. Rule in the midst of your enemies!
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord shall send the rod of Your strength out of Zion. Rule in the midst of Your enemies!
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will extend your powerful kingdom from Jerusalem ; you will rule over your enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will stretch out Your strong scepter from Zion, saying, "Rule in the midst of Your enemies."
verses.textEn: The Lord will extend your mighty scepter from Zion, saying, "Rule in the midst of your enemies!"

verses.textZh: 在你征战的日子，你的人民都乐意投身； 你的少年人以圣洁为装饰， 好象清晨的甘露，到你那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你征战的日子，你的人民都乐意投身； 你的少年人以圣洁为装饰， 好象清晨的甘露，到你那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 当你掌权的日子 ， 你的民要以圣洁的妆饰为衣 ， 甘心牺牲自己； 你的民多如清晨的甘露 。
verses.textEnNiv: Your troops will be willing on your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, your young men will come to you like dew from the morning’s womb.
verses.textEnEsv: Your people will offer themselves freely on the day of your power, in holy garments; from the womb of the morning, the dew of your youth will be yours.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your people shallbe volunteers In the day of Your power; In the beauties of holiness, from the womb of the morning, You have the dew of Your youth.
verses.textEnNlt: When you go to war, your people will serve you willingly. You are arrayed in holy garments, and your strength will be renewed each day like the morning dew.
verses.textEnNasb: Your people will volunteer freely on the day of Your power; In holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, Your youth are to You as the dew.
verses.textEn: Your troops will be willing on your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, your young men will come to you like dew from the morning’s womb.

verses.textZh: 耶和华起了誓，就决不反悔； 他说："你永远作祭司， 是照着麦基洗德的体系。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华起了誓，就决不反悔； 他说："你永远作祭司， 是照着麦基洗德的体系。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华起了誓，决不后悔，说： 你是照着麦基洗德的等次永远为祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind, "You are a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has sworn And will not relent, "You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has taken an oath and will not break his vow: "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has sworn and will not change His mind, "You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek."
verses.textEn: The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

verses.textZh: 主在你右边， 在他发怒的日子，必剿灭列王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主在你右边， 在他发怒的日子，必剿灭列王。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你右边的主， 当他发怒的日子，必打伤列王。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is at your right hand ; he will crush kings on the day of his wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is at your right hand; he will shatter kings on the day of his wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord is at Your right hand; He shall execute kings in the day of His wrath.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord stands at your right hand to protect you. He will strike down many kings when his anger erupts.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will shatter kings in the day of His wrath.
verses.textEn: The Lord is at your right hand ; he will crush kings on the day of his wrath.

verses.textZh: 他必在列国中施行审判， 尸首就遍满各处； 他要剿灭地上各处的首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必在列国中施行审判， 尸首就遍满各处； 他要剿灭地上各处的首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要在列邦中刑罚恶人， 尸首就遍满各处； 他要在许多国中打破仇敌的头。
verses.textEnNiv: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.
verses.textEnEsv: He will execute judgment among the nations, filling them with corpses; he will shatter chiefs over the wide earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall judge among the nations, He shall fill theplaces with dead bodies, He shall execute the heads of many countries.
verses.textEnNlt: He will punish the nations and fill their lands with corpses; he will shatter heads over the whole earth.
verses.textEnNasb: He will judge among the nations, He will fill them with corpses, He will shatter the chief men over a broad country.
verses.textEn: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.

verses.textZh: 王要喝路旁的河水， 因此他必挺胸昂首。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王要喝路旁的河水， 因此他必挺胸昂首。
verses.textZhCuv: 他要喝路旁的河水， 因此必抬起头来。
verses.textEnNiv: He will drink from a brook along the way, and so he will lift his head high.
verses.textEnEsv: He will drink from the brook by the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall drink of the brook by the wayside; Therefore He shall lift up the head.
verses.textEnNlt: But he himself will be refreshed from brooks along the way. He will be victorious.
verses.textEnNasb: He will drink from the brook by the wayside; Therefore He will lift up His head.
verses.textEn: He will drink from a brook along the way, and so he will lift his head high.

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华。 在正直人的议会中和大会里， 我要全心称谢耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华。 在正直人的议会中和大会里， 我要全心称谢耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 我要在正直人的大会中，并公会中， 一心称谢耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . I will extol the Lord with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart, in the company of the upright, in the congregation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, In the assembly of the upright and in the congregation.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! I will thank the Lord with all my heart as I meet with his godly people.
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! I will give thanks to the Lord with all my heart, In the company of the upright and in the assembly.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . I will extol the Lord with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的作为伟大， 喜爱他作为的人都努力查究。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的作为伟大， 喜爱他作为的人都努力查究。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的作为本为大； 凡喜爱的都必考察。
verses.textEnNiv: Great are the works of the Lord ; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Great are the works of the Lord , studied by all who delight in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The works of the Lordare great, Studied by all who have pleasure in them.
verses.textEnNlt: How amazing are the deeds of the Lord ! All who delight in him should ponder them.
verses.textEnNasb: Great are the works of the Lord; They are studied by all who delight in them.
verses.textEn: Great are the works of the Lord ; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

verses.textZh: 他的作为满有尊荣和威严， 他的公义永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的作为满有尊荣和威严， 他的公义永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所行的是尊荣和威严； 他的公义存到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: Glorious and majestic are his deeds, and his righteousness endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Full of splendor and majesty is his work, and his righteousness endures forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: His work is honorable and glorious, And His righteousness endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Everything he does reveals his glory and majesty. His righteousness never fails.
verses.textEnNasb: Splendid and majestic is His work, And His righteousness endures forever.
verses.textEn: Glorious and majestic are his deeds, and his righteousness endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他使人记念他所行的奇事； 耶和华有恩典，有怜悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使人记念他所行的奇事； 耶和华有恩典，有怜悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行了奇事，使人记念； 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯。
verses.textEnNiv: He has caused his wonders to be remembered; the Lord is gracious and compassionate.
verses.textEnEsv: He has caused his wondrous works to be remembered; the Lord is gracious and merciful.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has made His wonderful works to be remembered; The Lordis gracious and full of compassion.
verses.textEnNlt: He causes us to remember his wonderful works. How gracious and merciful is our Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; The Lord is gracious and compassionate.
verses.textEn: He has caused his wonders to be remembered; the Lord is gracious and compassionate.

verses.textZh: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人； 他永远记念自己的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人； 他永远记念自己的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人； 他必永远记念他的约。
verses.textEnNiv: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.
verses.textEnEsv: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has given food to those who fear Him; He will ever be mindful of His covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: He gives food to those who fear him; he always remembers his covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: He has given food to those who fear Him; He will remember His covenant forever.
verses.textEn: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.

verses.textZh: 他向自己的子民彰显大能的作为， 把列国赐给他们为业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向自己的子民彰显大能的作为， 把列国赐给他们为业。
verses.textZhCuv: 他向百姓显出大能的作为， 把外邦的地赐给他们为业。
verses.textEnNiv: He has shown his people the power of his works, giving them the lands of other nations.
verses.textEnEsv: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the inheritance of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has declared to His people the power of His works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: He has shown his great power to his people by giving them the lands of other nations.
verses.textEnNasb: He has made known to His people the power of His works, In giving them the inheritance of the nations.
verses.textEn: He has shown his people the power of his works, giving them the lands of other nations.

verses.textZh: 他手所作的都是诚实和公正； 他的训词都是可信靠的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他手所作的都是诚实和公正； 他的训词都是可信靠的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他手所行的是诚实公平； 他的训词都是确实的，
verses.textEnNiv: The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are trustworthy.
verses.textEnEsv: The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are trustworthy;
verses.textEnNkjv: The works of His hands are verity and justice; All His precepts are sure.
verses.textEnNlt: All he does is just and good, and all his commandments are trustworthy.
verses.textEnNasb: The works of His hands are truth and justice; All His precepts are trustworthy.
verses.textEn: The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are trustworthy.

verses.textZh: 他的训词是永远确定的， 是按着信实和正直制订的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的训词是永远确定的， 是按着信实和正直制订的。
verses.textZhCuv: 是永永远远坚定的， 是按诚实正直设立的。
verses.textEnNiv: They are established for ever and ever, enacted in faithfulness and uprightness.
verses.textEnEsv: they are established forever and ever, to be performed with faithfulness and uprightness.
verses.textEnNkjv: They stand fast forever and ever, Andare done in truth and uprightness.
verses.textEnNlt: They are forever true, to be obeyed faithfully and with integrity.
verses.textEnNasb: They are upheld forever and ever; They are performed in truth and uprightness.
verses.textEn: They are established for ever and ever, enacted in faithfulness and uprightness.

verses.textZh: 他向自己的子民施行救赎； 他命定自己的约，直到永远； 他的名神圣可畏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向自己的子民施行救赎； 他命定自己的约，直到永远； 他的名神圣可畏。
verses.textZhCuv: 他向百姓施行救赎， 命定他的约，直到永远； 他的名圣而可畏。
verses.textEnNiv: He provided redemption for his people; he ordained his covenant forever— holy and awesome is his name.
verses.textEnEsv: He sent redemption to his people; he has commanded his covenant forever. Holy and awesome is his name!
verses.textEnNkjv: He has sent redemption to His people; He has commanded His covenant forever: Holy and awesome is His name.
verses.textEnNlt: He has paid a full ransom for his people. He has guaranteed his covenant with them forever. What a holy, awe-inspiring name he has!
verses.textEnNasb: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; Holy and awesome is His name.
verses.textEn: He provided redemption for his people; he ordained his covenant forever— holy and awesome is his name.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 凡是这样行的都是明智的。 耶和华该受赞美，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 凡是这样行的都是明智的。 耶和华该受赞美，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 凡遵行他命令的是聪明人。 耶和华是永远当赞美的！
verses.textEnNiv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow his precepts have good understanding. To him belongs eternal praise.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; all those who practice it have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: The fear of the Lordis the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all those who do Hiscommandments. His praise endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Fear of the Lord is the foundation of true wisdom. All who obey his commandments will grow in wisdom. Praise him forever!
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; All those who follow His commandments have a good understanding; His praise endures forever.
verses.textEn: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow his precepts have good understanding. To him belongs eternal praise.

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华。 敬畏耶和华、热爱他的诫命的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华。 敬畏耶和华、热爱他的诫命的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 敬畏耶和华，甚喜爱他命令的， 这人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . Blessed are those who fear the Lord , who find great delight in his commands.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! Blessed is the man who fears the Lord , who greatly delights in his commandments!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! Blessed is the man who fears the Lord, Who delights greatly in His commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! How joyful are those who fear the Lord and delight in obeying his commands.
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! Blessed is a person who fears the Lord, Who greatly delights in His commandments.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . Blessed are those who fear the Lord , who find great delight in his commands.

verses.textZh: 他的后裔在地上必强盛， 正直人的后代必蒙福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的后裔在地上必强盛， 正直人的后代必蒙福。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的后裔在世必强盛； 正直人的后代必要蒙福。
verses.textEnNiv: Their children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.textEnEsv: His offspring will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.textEnNkjv: His descendants will be mighty on earth; The generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.textEnNlt: Their children will be successful everywhere; an entire generation of godly people will be blessed.
verses.textEnNasb: His descendants will be mighty on the earth; The generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.textEn: Their children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

verses.textZh: 他家中有财富，有金钱， 他的仁义存到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他家中有财富，有金钱， 他的仁义存到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 他家中有货物，有钱财； 他的公义存到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wealth and riches willbe in his house, And his righteousness endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: They themselves will be wealthy, and their good deeds will last forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Wealth and riches are in his house, And his righteousness endures forever.
verses.textEn: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.

verses.textZh: 正直人在黑暗中有光照亮他， 他满有恩慈，好怜恤，行公义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正直人在黑暗中有光照亮他， 他满有恩慈，好怜恤，行公义。
verses.textZhCuv: 正直人在黑暗中，有光向他发现； 他有恩惠，有怜悯，有公义。
verses.textEnNiv: Even in darkness light dawns for the upright, for those who are gracious and compassionate and righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright; he is gracious, merciful, and righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: Unto the upright there arises light in the darkness; Heis gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: Light shines in the darkness for the godly. They are generous, compassionate, and righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: Light shines in the darkness for the upright; He is gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
verses.textEn: Even in darkness light dawns for the upright, for those who are gracious and compassionate and righteous.

verses.textZh: 恩待人，借贷给别人，按公正处理自己事务的， 这人必享福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恩待人，借贷给别人，按公正处理自己事务的， 这人必享福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 施恩与人、借贷与人的，这人事情顺利； 他被审判的时候要诉明自己的冤。
verses.textEnNiv: Good will come to those who are generous and lend freely, who conduct their affairs with justice.
verses.textEnEsv: It is well with the man who deals generously and lends; who conducts his affairs with justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: A good man deals graciously and lends; He will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.textEnNlt: Good comes to those who lend money generously and conduct their business fairly.
verses.textEnNasb: It goes well for a person who is gracious and lends; He will maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.textEn: Good will come to those who are generous and lend freely, who conduct their affairs with justice.

verses.textZh: 因为他永远不会动摇， 义人必永远被记念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他永远不会动摇， 义人必永远被记念。
verses.textZhCuv: 他永不动摇； 义人被记念，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: Surely the righteous will never be shaken; they will be remembered forever.
verses.textEnEsv: For the righteous will never be moved; he will be remembered forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely he will never be shaken; The righteous will be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.textEnNlt: Such people will not be overcome by evil. Those who are righteous will be long remembered.
verses.textEnNasb: For he will never be shaken; The righteous will be remembered forever.
verses.textEn: Surely the righteous will never be shaken; they will be remembered forever.

verses.textZh: 他必不因坏消息惧怕； 他的心坚定，倚靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必不因坏消息惧怕； 他的心坚定，倚靠耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必不怕凶恶的信息； 他心坚定，倚靠耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: They will have no fear of bad news; their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He is not afraid of bad news; his heart is firm, trusting in the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not be afraid of evil tidings; His heart is steadfast, trusting in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They do not fear bad news; they confidently trust the Lord to care for them.
verses.textEnNasb: He will not fear bad news; His heart is steadfast, trusting in the Lord.
verses.textEn: They will have no fear of bad news; their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他的心坚决，毫不惧怕， 直到他看见他的敌人遭报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的心坚决，毫不惧怕， 直到他看见他的敌人遭报。
verses.textZhCuv: 他心确定，总不惧怕， 直到他看见敌人遭报。
verses.textEnNiv: Their hearts are secure, they will have no fear; in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.
verses.textEnEsv: His heart is steady; he will not be afraid, until he looks in triumph on his adversaries.
verses.textEnNkjv: His heart is established; He will not be afraid, Until he sees hisdesire upon his enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: They are confident and fearless and can face their foes triumphantly.
verses.textEnNasb: His heart is firm, he will not fear, But will look with satisfaction on his enemies.
verses.textEn: Their hearts are secure, they will have no fear; in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.

verses.textZh: 他广施钱财，赒济穷人； 他的仁义存到永远； 他的角必被高举，大有荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他广施钱财，赒济穷人； 他的仁义存到永远； 他的角必被高举，大有荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 他施舍钱财，周济贫穷； 他的仁义存到永远。 他的角必被高举，大有荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor, their righteousness endures forever; their horn will be lifted high in honor.
verses.textEnEsv: He has distributed freely; he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn is exalted in honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: He has dispersed abroad, He has given to the poor; His righteousness endures forever; His horn will be exalted with honor.
verses.textEnNlt: They share freely and give generously to those in need. Their good deeds will be remembered forever. They will have influence and honor.
verses.textEnNasb: He has given freely to the poor, His righteousness endures forever; His horn will be exalted in honor.
verses.textEn: They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor, their righteousness endures forever; their horn will be lifted high in honor.

verses.textZh: 恶人看见就恼怒， 他必咬牙切齿，身心耗损； 恶人的心愿必幻灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人看见就恼怒， 他必咬牙切齿，身心耗损； 恶人的心愿必幻灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人看见便恼恨，必咬牙而消化； 恶人的心愿要归灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked will see and be vexed, they will gnash their teeth and waste away; the longings of the wicked will come to nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked man sees it and is angry; he gnashes his teeth and melts away; the desire of the wicked will perish!
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked will see it and be grieved; He will gnash his teeth and melt away; The desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked will see this and be infuriated. They will grind their teeth in anger; they will slink away, their hopes thwarted.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked will see it and be vexed, He will gnash his teeth and melt away; The desire of the wicked will perish.
verses.textEn: The wicked will see and be vexed, they will gnash their teeth and waste away; the longings of the wicked will come to nothing.

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华。 耶和华的仆人哪！你们要赞美， 要赞美耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华。 耶和华的仆人哪！你们要赞美， 要赞美耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 耶和华的仆人哪，你们要赞美， 赞美耶和华的名！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord , you his servants; praise the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! Praise, O servants of the Lord , praise the name of the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! Praise, O servants of the Lord, Praise the name of the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! Yes, give praise, O servants of the Lord . Praise the name of the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! Praise Him, you servants of the Lord, Praise the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord , you his servants; praise the name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华的名是应当称颂的， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的名是应当称颂的， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的名是应当称颂的， 从今时直到永远！
verses.textEnNiv: Let the name of the Lord be praised, both now and forevermore.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and forevermore!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the name of the Lord From this time forth and forevermore!
verses.textEnNlt: Blessed be the name of the Lord now and forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the name of the Lord From this time on and forever.
verses.textEn: Let the name of the Lord be praised, both now and forevermore.

verses.textZh: 从日出之地到日落之处， 耶和华的名都该受赞美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从日出之地到日落之处， 耶和华的名都该受赞美。
verses.textZhCuv: 从日出之地到日落之处， 耶和华的名是应当赞美的！
verses.textEnNiv: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the Lord is to be praised.
verses.textEnEsv: From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the Lord is to be praised!
verses.textEnNkjv: From the rising of the sun to its going down The Lord’s name is to be praised.
verses.textEnNlt: Everywhere—from east to west— praise the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: From the rising of the sun to its setting, The name of the Lord is to be praised.
verses.textEn: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the Lord is to be praised.

verses.textZh: 耶和华高过万国， 他的荣耀超越诸天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华高过万国， 他的荣耀超越诸天。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华超乎万民之上； 他的荣耀高过诸天。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is exalted over all the nations, his glory above the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens!
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis high above all nations, His glory above the heavens.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is high above the nations; his glory is higher than the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is high above all nations; His glory is above the heavens.
verses.textEn: The Lord is exalted over all the nations, his glory above the heavens.

verses.textZh: 谁像耶和华我们的神呢？ 他坐在至高之处，
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁像耶和华我们的神呢？ 他坐在至高之处，
verses.textZhCuv: 谁像耶和华－我们的神呢？ 他坐在至高之处，
verses.textEnNiv: Who is like the Lord our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,
verses.textEnEsv: Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on high,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is like the Lord our God, Who dwells on high,
verses.textEnNlt: Who can be compared with the Lord our God, who is enthroned on high?
verses.textEnNasb: Who is like the Lord our God, Who is enthroned on high,
verses.textEn: Who is like the Lord our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,

verses.textZh: 他俯首垂顾天上和地下的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他俯首垂顾天上和地下的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 自己谦卑， 观看天上地下的事。
verses.textEnNiv: who stoops down to look on the heavens and the earth?
verses.textEnEsv: who looks far down on the heavens and the earth?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who humbles Himself to behold Thethingsthatare in the heavens and in the earth?
verses.textEnNlt: He stoops to look down on heaven and on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Who looks far down to The heavens and the earth?
verses.textEn: who stoops down to look on the heavens and the earth?

verses.textZh: 他从灰尘中抬举贫寒人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从灰尘中抬举贫寒人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏人，
verses.textZhCuv: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人， 从粪堆中提拔穷乏人，
verses.textEnNiv: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap;
verses.textEnEsv: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap,
verses.textEnNkjv: He raises the poor out of the dust, And lifts the needy out of the ash heap,
verses.textEnNlt: He lifts the poor from the dust and the needy from the garbage dump.
verses.textEnNasb: He raises the poor from the dust, He lifts the needy from the garbage heap,
verses.textEn: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap;

verses.textZh: 使他们和权贵同坐， 就是和他子民中的权贵同坐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他们和权贵同坐， 就是和他子民中的权贵同坐，
verses.textZhCuv: 使他们与王子同坐， 就是与本国的王子同坐。
verses.textEnNiv: he seats them with princes, with the princes of his people.
verses.textEnEsv: to make them sit with princes, with the princes of his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: That He may seat him with princes— With the princes of His people.
verses.textEnNlt: He sets them among princes, even the princes of his own people!
verses.textEnNasb: To seat them with noblemen, With the noblemen of His people.
verses.textEn: he seats them with princes, with the princes of his people.

verses.textZh: 他使不能生育的妇人安居家中， 成了有许多儿女的快乐母亲。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使不能生育的妇人安居家中， 成了有许多儿女的快乐母亲。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使不能生育的妇人安居家中， 为多子的乐母。 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: He settles the childless woman in her home as a happy mother of children. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He gives the barren woman a home, making her the joyous mother of children. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: He grants the barren woman a home, Like a joyful mother of children. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: He gives the childless woman a family, making her a happy mother. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: He has the infertile woman live in the house As a joyful mother of children. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: He settles the childless woman in her home as a happy mother of children. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以色列出了埃及， 雅各家离开了说外国语言的人民的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列出了埃及， 雅各家离开了说外国语言的人民的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列出了埃及， 雅各家离开说异言之民；
verses.textEnNiv: When Israel came out of Egypt, Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
verses.textEnEsv: When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,
verses.textEnNkjv: When Israel went out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language,
verses.textEnNlt: When the Israelites escaped from Egypt— when the family of Jacob left that foreign land—
verses.textEnNasb: When Israel went forth from Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of a foreign language,
verses.textEn: When Israel came out of Egypt, Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

verses.textZh: 犹大就成了主的圣所， 以色列成了他的王国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大就成了主的圣所， 以色列成了他的王国。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，犹大为主的圣所， 以色列为他所治理的国度。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.textEnEsv: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Judah became His sanctuary, And Israel His dominion.
verses.textEnNlt: the land of Judah became God’s sanctuary, and Israel became his kingdom.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah became His sanctuary; Israel, His dominion.
verses.textEn: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

verses.textZh: 大海看见就奔逃， 约旦河也倒流。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大海看见就奔逃， 约旦河也倒流。
verses.textZhCuv: 沧海看见就奔逃； 约旦河也倒流。
verses.textEnNiv: The sea looked and fled, the Jordan turned back;
verses.textEnEsv: The sea looked and fled; Jordan turned back.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sea saw it and fled; Jordan turned back.
verses.textEnNlt: The Red Sea saw them coming and hurried out of their way! The water of the Jordan River turned away.
verses.textEnNasb: The sea looked and fled; The Jordan turned back.
verses.textEn: The sea looked and fled, the Jordan turned back;

verses.textZh: 大山跳跃像公羊， 小山蹦跳像小羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大山跳跃像公羊， 小山蹦跳像小羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 大山踊跃，如公羊； 小山跳舞，如羊羔。
verses.textEnNiv: the mountains leaped like rams, the hills like lambs.
verses.textEnEsv: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.
verses.textEnNlt: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs!
verses.textEnNasb: The mountains skipped like rams, The hills, like lambs.
verses.textEn: the mountains leaped like rams, the hills like lambs.

verses.textZh: 大海啊！你为甚么奔逃？ 约旦河啊！你为甚么倒流？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大海啊！你为甚么奔逃？ 约旦河啊！你为甚么倒流？
verses.textZhCuv: 沧海啊，你为何奔逃？ 约旦哪，你为何倒流？
verses.textEnNiv: Why was it, sea, that you fled? Why, Jordan, did you turn back?
verses.textEnEsv: What ails you, O sea, that you flee? O Jordan, that you turn back?
verses.textEnNkjv: What ails you, O sea, that you fled? O Jordan, that you turned back?
verses.textEnNlt: What’s wrong, Red Sea, that made you hurry out of their way? What happened, Jordan River, that you turned away?
verses.textEnNasb: What ails you, sea, that you flee? Jordan, that you turn back?
verses.textEn: Why was it, sea, that you fled? Why, Jordan, did you turn back?

verses.textZh: 大山啊！你们为甚么跳跃像公羊？ 小山啊！你们为甚么蹦跳像小羊？
verses.textZhCnvs: 大山啊！你们为甚么跳跃像公羊？ 小山啊！你们为甚么蹦跳像小羊？
verses.textZhCuv: 大山哪，你为何踊跃，如公羊？ 小山哪，你为何跳舞，如羊羔？
verses.textEnNiv: Why, mountains, did you leap like rams, you hills, like lambs?
verses.textEnEsv: O mountains, that you skip like rams? O hills, like lambs?
verses.textEnNkjv: O mountains, that you skipped like rams? O little hills, like lambs?
verses.textEnNlt: Why, mountains, did you skip like rams? Why, hills, like lambs?
verses.textEnNasb: Mountains, that you skip like rams? Hills, like lambs?
verses.textEn: Why, mountains, did you leap like rams, you hills, like lambs?

verses.textZh: 大地啊！你在主的面前， 在雅各的神面前要战抖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地啊！你在主的面前， 在雅各的神面前要战抖。
verses.textZhCuv: 大地啊，你因见主的面， 就是雅各神的面，便要震动。
verses.textEnNiv: Tremble, earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.textEnEsv: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.textEnNkjv: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.textEnNlt: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: Tremble, earth, before the Lord, Before the God of Jacob,
verses.textEn: Tremble, earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

verses.textZh: 他使盘石变为水池， 使坚石变为水泉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使盘石变为水池， 使坚石变为水泉。
verses.textZhCuv: 他叫磐石变为水池， 叫坚石变为泉源。
verses.textEnNiv: who turned the rock into a pool, the hard rock into springs of water.
verses.textEnEsv: who turns the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.textEnNlt: He turned the rock into a pool of water; yes, a spring of water flowed from solid rock.
verses.textEnNasb: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of water.
verses.textEn: who turned the rock into a pool, the hard rock into springs of water.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！不要把荣耀归给我们，不要归给我们； 要因你的慈爱和信实把荣耀归在你的名下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！不要把荣耀归给我们，不要归给我们； 要因你的慈爱和信实把荣耀归在你的名下。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，荣耀不要归与我们， 不要归与我们； 要因你的慈爱和诚实归在你的名下！
verses.textEnNiv: Not to us, Lord , not to us but to your name be the glory, because of your love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: Not to us, O Lord , not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love and your faithfulness!
verses.textEnNkjv: Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, But to Your name give glory, Because of Your mercy, Because of Your truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Not to us, O Lord , not to us, but to your name goes all the glory for your unfailing love and faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: Not to us, Lord, not to us, But to Your name give glory, Because of Your mercy, because of Your truth.
verses.textEn: Not to us, Lord , not to us but to your name be the glory, because of your love and faithfulness.

verses.textZh: 为甚么容列国的人说： "他们的神在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么容列国的人说： "他们的神在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 为何容外邦人说： 他们的神在哪里呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do the nations say, "Where is their God?"
verses.textEnEsv: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Why should the Gentiles say, "So where is their God?"
verses.textEnNlt: Why let the nations say, "Where is their God?"
verses.textEnNasb: Why should the nations say, "Where, then, is their God?"
verses.textEn: Why do the nations say, "Where is their God?"

verses.textZh: 我们的神在天上； 他喜欢甚么，就作甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的神在天上； 他喜欢甚么，就作甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，我们的神在天上， 都随自己的意旨行事。
verses.textEnNiv: Our God is in heaven; he does whatever pleases him.
verses.textEnEsv: Our God is in the heavens; he does all that he pleases.
verses.textEnNkjv: But our God is in heaven; He does whatever He pleases.
verses.textEnNlt: Our God is in the heavens, and he does as he wishes.
verses.textEnNasb: But our God is in the heavens; He does whatever He pleases.
verses.textEn: Our God is in heaven; he does whatever pleases him.

verses.textZh: 列国的偶像是金的、银的， 是人手所做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国的偶像是金的、银的， 是人手所做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的偶像是金的，银的， 是人手所造的，
verses.textEnNiv: But their idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Their idols are merely things of silver and gold, shaped by human hands.
verses.textEnNasb: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of human hands.
verses.textEn: But their idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.

verses.textZh: 它们有口，却不能说话； 有眼，却不能看；
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们有口，却不能说话； 有眼，却不能看；
verses.textZhCuv: 有口却不能言， 有眼却不能看，
verses.textEnNiv: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but cannot see.
verses.textEnEsv: They have mouths, but do not speak; eyes, but do not see.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have mouths, but they do not speak; Eyes they have, but they do not see;
verses.textEnNlt: They have mouths but cannot speak, and eyes but cannot see.
verses.textEnNasb: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; They have eyes, but they cannot see;
verses.textEn: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but cannot see.

verses.textZh: 有耳，却不能听； 有鼻，却不能闻；
verses.textZhCnvs: 有耳，却不能听； 有鼻，却不能闻；
verses.textZhCuv: 有耳却不能听， 有鼻却不能闻，
verses.textEnNiv: They have ears, but cannot hear, noses, but cannot smell.
verses.textEnEsv: They have ears, but do not hear; noses, but do not smell.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have ears, but they do not hear; Noses they have, but they do not smell;
verses.textEnNlt: They have ears but cannot hear, and noses but cannot smell.
verses.textEnNasb: They have ears, but they cannot hear; They have noses, but they cannot smell;
verses.textEn: They have ears, but cannot hear, noses, but cannot smell.

verses.textZh: 有手，却不能摸； 有脚，却不能行； 也不能用喉咙发声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有手，却不能摸； 有脚，却不能行； 也不能用喉咙发声。
verses.textZhCuv: 有手却不能摸， 有脚却不能走， 有喉咙也不能出声。
verses.textEnNiv: They have hands, but cannot feel, feet, but cannot walk, nor can they utter a sound with their throats.
verses.textEnEsv: They have hands, but do not feel; feet, but do not walk; and they do not make a sound in their throat.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have hands, but they do not handle; Feet they have, but they do not walk; Nor do they mutter through their throat.
verses.textEnNlt: They have hands but cannot feel, and feet but cannot walk, and throats but cannot make a sound.
verses.textEnNasb: They have hands, but they cannot feel; They have feet, but they cannot walk; They cannot make a sound with their throat.
verses.textEn: They have hands, but cannot feel, feet, but cannot walk, nor can they utter a sound with their throats.

verses.textZh: 做偶像的必和偶像一样； 凡是倚靠它们的，都必这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 做偶像的必和偶像一样； 凡是倚靠它们的，都必这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 造他的要和他一样； 凡靠他的也要如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who make them become like them; so do all who trust in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who make them are like them; Sois everyone who trusts in them.
verses.textEnNlt: And those who make idols are just like them, as are all who trust in them.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who make them will become like them, Everyone who trusts in them.
verses.textEn: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

verses.textZh: 以色列啊！你们要倚靠耶和华； 他是你们 的帮助、你们 的盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊！你们要倚靠耶和华； 他是你们 的帮助、你们 的盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你要倚靠耶和华！ 他是你的帮助和你的盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: All you Israelites, trust in the Lord — he is their help and shield.
verses.textEnEsv: O Israel, trust in the Lord ! He is their help and their shield.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Israel, trust in the Lord; He is their help and their shield.
verses.textEnNlt: O Israel, trust the Lord ! He is your helper and your shield.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel, trust in the Lord; He is their help and their shield.
verses.textEn: All you Israelites, trust in the Lord — he is their help and shield.

verses.textZh: 亚伦家啊！你们要倚靠耶和华； 他是你们 的帮助、你们 的盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦家啊！你们要倚靠耶和华； 他是你们 的帮助、你们 的盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦家啊，你们要倚靠耶和华！ 他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: House of Aaron, trust in the Lord — he is their help and shield.
verses.textEnEsv: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord ! He is their help and their shield.
verses.textEnNkjv: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord; He is their help and their shield.
verses.textEnNlt: O priests, descendants of Aaron, trust the Lord ! He is your helper and your shield.
verses.textEnNasb: House of Aaron, trust in the Lord; He is their help and their shield.
verses.textEn: House of Aaron, trust in the Lord — he is their help and shield.

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华的啊！你们要倚靠耶和华； 他是你们 的帮助、你们 的盾牌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华的啊！你们要倚靠耶和华； 他是你们 的帮助、你们 的盾牌。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们敬畏耶和华的，要倚靠耶和华！ 他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: You who fear him, trust in the Lord — he is their help and shield.
verses.textEnEsv: You who fear the Lord , trust in the Lord ! He is their help and their shield.
verses.textEnNkjv: You who fear the Lord, trust in the Lord; He is their help and their shield.
verses.textEnNlt: All you who fear the Lord , trust the Lord ! He is your helper and your shield.
verses.textEnNasb: You who fear the Lord, trust in the Lord; He is their help and their shield.
verses.textEn: You who fear him, trust in the Lord — he is their help and shield.

verses.textZh: 耶和华顾念我们， 必赐福给我们； 他必赐福给以色列家， 赐福给亚伦家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华顾念我们， 必赐福给我们； 他必赐福给以色列家， 赐福给亚伦家。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向来眷念我们； 他还要赐福给我们： 要赐福给以色列的家， 赐福给亚伦的家。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord remembers us and will bless us: He will bless his people Israel, he will bless the house of Aaron,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has remembered us; he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron;
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has been mindful of us; He will bless us; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord remembers us and will bless us. He will bless the people of Israel and bless the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has been mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.textEn: The Lord remembers us and will bless us: He will bless his people Israel, he will bless the house of Aaron,

verses.textZh: 敬畏耶和华的，无论大小尊卑， 他都必赐福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏耶和华的，无论大小尊卑， 他都必赐福。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡敬畏耶和华的，无论大小， 主必赐福给他。
verses.textEnNiv: he will bless those who fear the Lord — small and great alike.
verses.textEnEsv: he will bless those who fear the Lord , both the small and the great.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will bless those who fear the Lord, Both small and great.
verses.textEnNlt: He will bless those who fear the Lord , both great and lowly.
verses.textEnNasb: He will bless those who fear the Lord, The small together with the great.
verses.textEn: he will bless those who fear the Lord — small and great alike.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华使你们增多， 使你们和你们的子孙增多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华使你们增多， 使你们和你们的子孙增多。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华叫你们 和你们的子孙日见加增。
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord cause you to flourish, both you and your children.
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord give you increase, you and your children!
verses.textEnNkjv: May the Lord give you increase more and more, You and your children.
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord richly bless both you and your children.
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord increase you, You and your children.
verses.textEn: May the Lord cause you to flourish, both you and your children.

verses.textZh: 愿你们蒙创造天地的耶和华赐福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你们蒙创造天地的耶和华赐福。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们蒙了造天地之耶和华的福！
verses.textEnNiv: May you be blessed by the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.textEnEsv: May you be blessed by the Lord , who made heaven and earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: May you be blessed by the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNlt: May you be blessed by the Lord , who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNasb: May you be blessed of the Lord, Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.textEn: May you be blessed by the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.

verses.textZh: 天属于耶和华， 地，他却赐给了世人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天属于耶和华， 地，他却赐给了世人。
verses.textZhCuv: 天，是耶和华的天； 地，他却给了世人。
verses.textEnNiv: The highest heavens belong to the Lord , but the earth he has given to mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: The heavens are the Lord ’s heavens, but the earth he has given to the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord’s; But the earth He has given to the children of men.
verses.textEnNlt: The heavens belong to the Lord , but he has given the earth to all humanity.
verses.textEnNasb: The heavens are the heavens of the Lord, But the earth He has given to the sons of mankind.
verses.textEn: The highest heavens belong to the Lord , but the earth he has given to mankind.

verses.textZh: 死人不能赞美耶和华， 下到阴间的不能赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 死人不能赞美耶和华， 下到阴间的不能赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 死人不能赞美耶和华； 下到寂静中的也都不能。
verses.textEnNiv: It is not the dead who praise the Lord , those who go down to the place of silence;
verses.textEnEsv: The dead do not praise the Lord , nor do any who go down into silence.
verses.textEnNkjv: The dead do not praise the Lord, Nor any who go down into silence.
verses.textEnNlt: The dead cannot sing praises to the Lord , for they have gone into the silence of the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: The dead do not praise the Lord, Nor do any who go down into silence;
verses.textEn: It is not the dead who praise the Lord , those who go down to the place of silence;

verses.textZh: 至于我们，我们要称颂耶和华， 从现在直到永远。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我们，我们要称颂耶和华， 从现在直到永远。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我们要称颂耶和华， 从今时直到永远。 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: it is we who extol the Lord , both now and forevermore. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and forevermore. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: But we will bless the Lord From this time forth and forevermore. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: But we can praise the Lord both now and forever! Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: But as for us, we will bless the Lord From this time and forever. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: it is we who extol the Lord , both now and forevermore. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我爱耶和华， 因为他听了我的声音、我的恳求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我爱耶和华， 因为他听了我的声音、我的恳求。
verses.textZhCuv: 我爱耶和华， 因为他听了我的声音和我的恳求。
verses.textEnNiv: I love the Lord , for he heard my voice; he heard my cry for mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: I love the Lord , because he has heard my voice and my pleas for mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: I love the Lord, because He has heard My voice and my supplications.
verses.textEnNlt: I love the Lord because he hears my voice and my prayer for mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: I love the Lord, because He hears My voice and my pleas.
verses.textEn: I love the Lord , for he heard my voice; he heard my cry for mercy.

verses.textZh: 因为他留心听我的恳求， 我一生一世要求告他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他留心听我的恳求， 我一生一世要求告他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他既向我侧耳， 我一生要求告他。
verses.textEnNiv: Because he turned his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.
verses.textEnEsv: Because he inclined his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because He has inclined His ear to me, Therefore I will call uponHim as long as I live.
verses.textEnNlt: Because he bends down to listen, I will pray as long as I have breath!
verses.textEnNasb: Because He has inclined His ear to me, Therefore I will call upon Him as long as I live.
verses.textEn: Because he turned his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.

verses.textZh: 死亡的绳索缠绕着我， 阴间的痛苦抓住我； 我遭遇患难和愁苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 死亡的绳索缠绕着我， 阴间的痛苦抓住我； 我遭遇患难和愁苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 死亡的绳索缠绕我； 阴间的痛苦抓住我； 我遭遇患难愁苦。
verses.textEnNiv: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of the grave came over me; I was overcome by distress and sorrow.
verses.textEnEsv: The snares of death encompassed me; the pangs of Sheol laid hold on me; I suffered distress and anguish.
verses.textEnNkjv: The pains of death surrounded me, And the pangs of Sheol laid hold of me; I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.textEnNlt: Death wrapped its ropes around me; the terrors of the grave overtook me. I saw only trouble and sorrow.
verses.textEnNasb: The snares of death encompassed me And the terrors of Sheol came upon me; I found distress and sorrow.
verses.textEn: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of the grave came over me; I was overcome by distress and sorrow.

verses.textZh: 那时，我呼求耶和华的名，说： "耶和华啊！求你拯救我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我呼求耶和华的名，说： "耶和华啊！求你拯救我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我便求告耶和华的名，说： 耶和华啊，求你救我的灵魂！
verses.textEnNiv: Then I called on the name of the Lord : " Lord , save me!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then I called on the name of the Lord : "O Lord , I pray, deliver my soul!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I called upon the name of the Lord: "O Lord, I implore You, deliver my soul!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then I called on the name of the Lord : "Please, Lord , save me!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I called upon the name of the Lord: "Please, Lord, save my life!"
verses.textEn: Then I called on the name of the Lord : " Lord , save me!"

verses.textZh: 耶和华有恩典，有公义， 我们的神满有怜悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华有恩典，有公义， 我们的神满有怜悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华有恩惠，有公义； 我们的神以怜悯为怀。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
verses.textEnEsv: Gracious is the Lord , and righteous; our God is merciful.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; Yes, our God is merciful.
verses.textEnNlt: How kind the Lord is! How good he is! So merciful, this God of ours!
verses.textEnNasb: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; Yes, our God is compassionate.
verses.textEn: The Lord is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

verses.textZh: 耶和华保护愚蒙人， 我落到卑微的地步，他拯救了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华保护愚蒙人， 我落到卑微的地步，他拯救了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华保护愚人； 我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord protects the unwary; when I was brought low, he saved me.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord preserves the simple; when I was brought low, he saved me.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord preserves the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord protects those of childlike faith; I was facing death, and he saved me.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord watches over the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.
verses.textEn: The Lord protects the unwary; when I was brought low, he saved me.

verses.textZh: 我的心哪！你要回复安宁， 因为耶和华用厚恩待你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心哪！你要回复安宁， 因为耶和华用厚恩待你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心哪！你要仍归安乐， 因为耶和华用厚恩待你。
verses.textEnNiv: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Return, O my soul, to your rest; for the Lord has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Return to your rest, O my soul, For the Lord has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Let my soul be at rest again, for the Lord has been good to me.
verses.textEnNasb: Return to your rest, my soul, For the Lord has dealt generously with you.
verses.textEn: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.

verses.textZh: 主啊！你救了我的性命脱离死亡， 你使我的眼睛不致流泪， 使我的双脚不致跌倒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！你救了我的性命脱离死亡， 你使我的眼睛不致流泪， 使我的双脚不致跌倒。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，你救我的命免了死亡， 救我的眼免了流泪， 救我的脚免了跌倒。
verses.textEnNiv: For you, Lord , have delivered me from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling,
verses.textEnEsv: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling;
verses.textEnNkjv: For You have delivered my soul from death, My eyes from tears, And my feet from falling.
verses.textEnNlt: He has saved me from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
verses.textEnNasb: For You have rescued my soul from death, My eyes from tears, And my feet from stumbling.
verses.textEn: For you, Lord , have delivered me from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling,

verses.textZh: 我要在活人之地， 行在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在活人之地， 行在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在耶和华面前行活人之路。
verses.textEnNiv: that I may walk before the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.textEnEsv: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will walk before the Lord In the land of the living.
verses.textEnNlt: And so I walk in the Lord ’s presence as I live here on earth!
verses.textEnNasb: I shall walk before the Lord In the land of the living.
verses.textEn: that I may walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.textZh: 我虽然说："我受了极大的痛苦"， 但我仍然相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然说："我受了极大的痛苦"， 但我仍然相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因信，所以如此说话； 我受了极大的困苦。
verses.textEnNiv: I trusted in the Lord when I said, "I am greatly afflicted";
verses.textEnEsv: I believed, even when I spoke: "I am greatly afflicted";
verses.textEnNkjv: I believed, therefore I spoke, "I am greatly afflicted."
verses.textEnNlt: I believed in you, so I said, "I am deeply troubled, Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: I believed when I said, "I am greatly afflicted."
verses.textEn: I trusted in the Lord when I said, "I am greatly afflicted";

verses.textZh: 我在惊惶之中曾说： "人都是说谎的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在惊惶之中曾说： "人都是说谎的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾急促地说： 人都是说谎的！
verses.textEnNiv: in my alarm I said, "Everyone is a liar."
verses.textEnEsv: I said in my alarm, "All mankind are liars."
verses.textEnNkjv: I said in my haste, "All men are liars."
verses.textEnNlt: In my anxiety I cried out to you, "These people are all liars!"
verses.textEnNasb: I said in my alarm, "All people are liars."
verses.textEn: in my alarm I said, "Everyone is a liar."

verses.textZh: 我拿甚么报答耶和华向我所施的一切厚恩呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我拿甚么报答耶和华向我所施的一切厚恩呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我拿什么报答耶和华向我所赐的一切厚恩？
verses.textEnNiv: What shall I return to the Lord for all his goodness to me?
verses.textEnEsv: What shall I render to the Lord for all his benefits to me?
verses.textEnNkjv: What shall I render to the Lord For all His benefits toward me?
verses.textEnNlt: What can I offer the Lord for all he has done for me?
verses.textEnNasb: What shall I repay to the Lord For all His benefits to me?
verses.textEn: What shall I return to the Lord for all his goodness to me?

verses.textZh: 我要举起救恩的杯， 称扬耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要举起救恩的杯， 称扬耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要举起救恩的杯， 称扬耶和华的名。
verses.textEnNiv: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will take up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will lift up the cup of salvation and praise the Lord ’s name for saving me.
verses.textEnNasb: I will lift up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我要在耶和华的众民面前， 向他还我所许的愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在耶和华的众民面前， 向他还我所许的愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在他众民面前向耶和华还我的愿。
verses.textEnNiv: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people.
verses.textEnEsv: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will pay my vows to the Lord Now in the presence of all His people.
verses.textEnNlt: I will keep my promises to the Lord in the presence of all his people.
verses.textEnNasb: I will pay my vows to the Lord; May it be in the presence of all His people!
verses.textEn: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华的眼中看来， 圣民的死极为宝贵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华的眼中看来， 圣民的死极为宝贵。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华眼中， 看圣民之死极为宝贵。
verses.textEnNiv: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his faithful servants.
verses.textEnEsv: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: Precious in the sight of the Lord Is the death of His saints.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord cares deeply when his loved ones die.
verses.textEnNasb: Precious in the sight of the Lord Is the death of His godly ones.
verses.textEn: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his faithful servants.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我真是你的仆人； 我是你仆人，你婢女的儿子； 我的锁炼你给我解开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我真是你的仆人； 我是你仆人，你婢女的儿子； 我的锁炼你给我解开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我真是你的仆人； 我是你的仆人，是你婢女的儿子。 你已经解开我的绑索。
verses.textEnNiv: Truly I am your servant, Lord ; I serve you just as my mother did; you have freed me from my chains.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of your maidservant. You have loosed my bonds.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, truly I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have loosed my bonds.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , I am your servant; yes, I am your servant, born into your household; you have freed me from my chains.
verses.textEnNasb: O Lord, I surely am Your slave, I am Your slave, the son of Your female slave, You have unfastened my restraints.
verses.textEn: Truly I am your servant, Lord ; I serve you just as my mother did; you have freed me from my chains.

verses.textZh: 我要把感恩祭献给你， 我要称扬耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把感恩祭献给你， 我要称扬耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要以感谢为祭献给你， 又要求告耶和华的名。
verses.textEnNiv: I will sacrifice a thank offering to you and call on the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will offer to You the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will offer you a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: I will offer You a sacrifice of thanksgiving, And call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will sacrifice a thank offering to you and call on the name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我要在耶和华的众民面前， 向他还我所许的愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在耶和华的众民面前， 向他还我所许的愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶和华殿的院内， 在耶路撒冷当中， 向耶和华还我的愿。 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people,
verses.textEnEsv: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will pay my vows to the Lord Now in the presence of all His people,
verses.textEnNlt: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people—
verses.textEnNasb: I will pay my vows to the Lord, May it be in the presence of all His people,
verses.textEn: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people,

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊！就是在你的中间， 在耶和华殿的院子里，我要还我所许的愿。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊！就是在你的中间， 在耶和华殿的院子里，我要还我所许的愿。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊！就是在你的中间， 在耶和华殿的院子里，我要还我所许的愿。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: in the courts of the house of the Lord — in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: in the courts of the house of the Lord , in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: In the courts of the Lord’s house, In the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: in the house of the Lord in the heart of Jerusalem. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: In the courtyards of the Lord’s house, In the midst of you, Jerusalem! Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: in the courts of the house of the Lord — in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 万国啊！你们要赞美耶和华； 万民哪！你们要颂赞他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万国啊！你们要赞美耶和华； 万民哪！你们要颂赞他。
verses.textZhCuv: 万国啊，你们都当赞美耶和华！ 万民哪，你们都当颂赞他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord , all you nations; extol him, all you peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord , all nations! Extol him, all peoples!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Laud Him, all you peoples!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , all you nations. Praise him, all you people of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord, all nations; Sing His praises, all peoples!
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord , all you nations; extol him, all you peoples.

verses.textZh: 他向我们所施的慈爱极大； 耶和华的信实永远长存。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向我们所施的慈爱极大； 耶和华的信实永远长存。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他向我们大施慈爱； 耶和华的诚实存到永远。 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: For great is his love toward us, and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: For great is his steadfast love toward us, and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: For His merciful kindness is great toward us, And the truth of the Lordendures forever. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: For his unfailing love for us is powerful; the Lord ’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: For His mercy toward us is great, And the truth of the Lord is everlasting. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: For great is his love toward us, and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本是良善的； 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本是良善的； 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！
verses.textEnNiv: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good! His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; For His mercy is everlasting.
verses.textEn: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 愿以色列说： "他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿以色列说： "他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿以色列说： 他的慈爱永远长存！
verses.textEnNiv: Let Israel say: "His love endures forever."
verses.textEnEsv: Let Israel say, "His steadfast love endures forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Israel now say, "His mercy endures forever."
verses.textEnNlt: Let all Israel repeat: "His faithful love endures forever."
verses.textEnNasb: Let Israel say, "His mercy is everlasting."
verses.textEn: Let Israel say: "His love endures forever."

verses.textZh: 愿亚伦家说： "他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿亚伦家说： "他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿亚伦的家说： 他的慈爱永远长存！
verses.textEnNiv: Let the house of Aaron say: "His love endures forever."
verses.textEnEsv: Let the house of Aaron say, "His steadfast love endures forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the house of Aaron now say, "His mercy endures forever."
verses.textEnNlt: Let Aaron’s descendants, the priests, repeat: "His faithful love endures forever."
verses.textEnNasb: Oh let the house of Aaron say, "His mercy is everlasting."
verses.textEn: Let the house of Aaron say: "His love endures forever."

verses.textZh: 愿敬畏耶和华的说： "他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿敬畏耶和华的说： "他的慈爱永远长存。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿敬畏耶和华的说： 他的慈爱永远长存！
verses.textEnNiv: Let those who fear the Lord say: "His love endures forever."
verses.textEnEsv: Let those who fear the Lord say, "His steadfast love endures forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let those who fear the Lord now say, "His mercy endures forever."
verses.textEnNlt: Let all who fear the Lord repeat: "His faithful love endures forever."
verses.textEnNasb: Let those who fear the Lord say, "His mercy is everlasting."
verses.textEn: Let those who fear the Lord say: "His love endures forever."

verses.textZh: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 他就应允我，使我站在宽阔之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 他就应允我，使我站在宽阔之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在急难中求告耶和华，他就应允我， 把我安置在宽阔之地。
verses.textEnNiv: When hard pressed, I cried to the Lord ; he brought me into a spacious place.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of my distress I called on the Lord ; the Lord answered me and set me free.
verses.textEnNkjv: I called on the Lord in distress; The Lord answered me and set me in a broad place.
verses.textEnNlt: In my distress I prayed to the Lord , and the Lord answered me and set me free.
verses.textEnNasb: From my distress I called upon the Lord; The Lord answered me and put me in an open space.
verses.textEn: When hard pressed, I cried to the Lord ; he brought me into a spacious place.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是我的帮助，我决不害怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是我的帮助，我决不害怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 有耶和华帮助我，我必不惧怕， 人能把我怎么样呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to me?
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to me?
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is for me, so I will have no fear. What can mere people do to me?
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is for me; I will not fear; What can man do to me?
verses.textEn: The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?

verses.textZh: 耶和华是我的帮助， 我必看见恨我的人遭报。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是我的帮助， 我必看见恨我的人遭报。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那帮助我的人中，有耶和华帮助我， 所以我要看见那恨我的人遭报。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is with me; he is my helper. I look in triumph on my enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is on my side as my helper; I shall look in triumph on those who hate me.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord is for me among those who help me; Therefore I shall see mydesire on those who hate me.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the Lord is for me; he will help me. I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is for me among those who help me; Therefore I will look with satisfaction on those who hate me.
verses.textEn: The Lord is with me; he is my helper. I look in triumph on my enemies.

verses.textZh: 投靠耶和华， 胜过倚靠人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 投靠耶和华， 胜过倚靠人。
verses.textZhCuv: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖人；
verses.textEnNiv: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in humans.
verses.textEnEsv: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis better to trust in the Lord Than to put confidence in man.
verses.textEnNlt: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in people.
verses.textEnNasb: It is better to take refuge in the Lord Than to trust in people.
verses.textEn: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in humans.

verses.textZh: 投靠耶和华， 胜过倚靠王子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 投靠耶和华， 胜过倚靠王子。
verses.textZhCuv: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖王子。
verses.textEnNiv: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.
verses.textEnEsv: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis better to trust in the Lord Than to put confidence in princes.
verses.textEnNlt: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.
verses.textEnNasb: It is better to take refuge in the Lord Than to trust in noblemen.
verses.textEn: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.

verses.textZh: 列国围困着我， 我靠着耶和华的名必除灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国围困着我， 我靠着耶和华的名必除灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 万民围绕我， 我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。
verses.textEnNiv: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.
verses.textEnEsv: All nations surrounded me; in the name of the Lord I cut them off!
verses.textEnNkjv: All nations surrounded me, But in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.textEnNlt: Though hostile nations surrounded me, I destroyed them all with the authority of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: All nations surrounded me; In the name of the Lord I will certainly fend them off.
verses.textEn: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

verses.textZh: 他们围绕着我，把我围困， 我靠着耶和华的名必除灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们围绕着我，把我围困， 我靠着耶和华的名必除灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们环绕我，围困我， 我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.
verses.textEnEsv: They surrounded me, surrounded me on every side; in the name of the Lord I cut them off!
verses.textEnNkjv: They surrounded me, Yes, they surrounded me; But in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, they surrounded and attacked me, but I destroyed them all with the authority of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me; In the name of the Lord I will certainly fend them off.
verses.textEn: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

verses.textZh: 他们如同蜜蜂围绕着我， 但他们要像烧荆棘的火熄灭； 我靠着耶和华的名必除灭他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们如同蜜蜂围绕着我， 但他们要像烧荆棘的火熄灭； 我靠着耶和华的名必除灭他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们如同蜂子围绕我， 好像烧荆棘的火，必被熄灭； 我靠耶和华的名，必剿灭他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were consumed as quickly as burning thorns; in the name of the Lord I cut them down.
verses.textEnEsv: They surrounded me like bees; they went out like a fire among thorns; in the name of the Lord I cut them off!
verses.textEnNkjv: They surrounded me like bees; They were quenched like a fire of thorns; For in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.textEnNlt: They swarmed around me like bees; they blazed against me like a crackling fire. But I destroyed them all with the authority of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: They surrounded me like bees; They were extinguished like a fire of thorn bushes; In the name of the Lord I will certainly fend them off.
verses.textEn: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were consumed as quickly as burning thorns; in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

verses.textZh: 他们 极力推我，要我跌倒， 耶和华却帮助了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们 极力推我，要我跌倒， 耶和华却帮助了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你推我，要叫我跌倒， 但耶和华帮助了我。
verses.textEnNiv: I was pushed back and about to fall, but the Lord helped me.
verses.textEnEsv: I was pushed hard, so that I was falling, but the Lord helped me.
verses.textEnNkjv: You pushed me violently, that I might fall, But the Lord helped me.
verses.textEnNlt: My enemies did their best to kill me, but the Lord rescued me.
verses.textEnNasb: You pushed me violently so that I was falling, But the Lord helped me.
verses.textEn: I was pushed back and about to fall, but the Lord helped me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是我的力量，我的诗歌； 他也成了我的拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是我的力量，我的诗歌； 他也成了我的拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的诗歌； 他也成了我的拯救。
