verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is my strength and my defense ; he has become my salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis my strength and song, And He has become my salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has given me victory.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is my strength and song, And He has become my salvation.
verses.textEn: The Lord is my strength and my defense ; he has become my salvation.

verses.textZh: 在义人的帐棚里， 有欢呼和得胜的声音，说： "耶和华的右手行了大能的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在义人的帐棚里， 有欢呼和得胜的声音，说： "耶和华的右手行了大能的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 在义人的帐棚里，有欢呼拯救的声音； 耶和华的右手施展大能。
verses.textEnNiv: Shouts of joy and victory resound in the tents of the righteous: "The Lord ’s right hand has done mighty things!
verses.textEnEsv: Glad songs of salvation are in the tents of the righteous: "The right hand of the Lord does valiantly,
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation Is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the Lord does valiantly.
verses.textEnNlt: Songs of joy and victory are sung in the camp of the godly. The strong right arm of the Lord has done glorious things!
verses.textEnNasb: The sound of joyful shouting and salvation is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the Lord performs valiantly.
verses.textEn: Shouts of joy and victory resound in the tents of the righteous: "The Lord ’s right hand has done mighty things!

verses.textZh: 耶和华的右手高高举起； 耶和华的右手行了大能的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的右手高高举起； 耶和华的右手行了大能的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的右手高举； 耶和华的右手施展大能。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord ’s right hand is lifted high; the Lord ’s right hand has done mighty things!"
verses.textEnEsv: the right hand of the Lord exalts, the right hand of the Lord does valiantly!"
verses.textEnNkjv: The right hand of the Lord is exalted; The right hand of the Lord does valiantly.
verses.textEnNlt: The strong right arm of the Lord is raised in triumph. The strong right arm of the Lord has done glorious things!
verses.textEnNasb: The right hand of the Lord is exalted; The right hand of the Lord performs valiantly.
verses.textEn: The Lord ’s right hand is lifted high; the Lord ’s right hand has done mighty things!"

verses.textZh: 我必不至于死，我要活下去， 并且要述说耶和华的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必不至于死，我要活下去， 并且要述说耶和华的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必不致死，仍要存活， 并要传扬耶和华的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the Lord has done.
verses.textEnEsv: I shall not die, but I shall live, and recount the deeds of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will not die; instead, I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
verses.textEnNasb: I will not die, but live, And tell of the works of the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the Lord has done.

verses.textZh: 耶和华虽严厉地管教我， 却没有把我置于死地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华虽严厉地管教我， 却没有把我置于死地。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华虽严严地惩治我， 却未曾将我交于死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has chastened me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has disciplined me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has chastened me severely, But He has not given me over to death.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has punished me severely, but he did not let me die.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has disciplined me severely, But He has not turned me over to death.
verses.textEn: The Lord has chastened me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

verses.textZh: 请你们为我打开正义的门， 我要进去，称谢耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你们为我打开正义的门， 我要进去，称谢耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 给我敞开义门； 我要进去称谢耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Open for me the gates of the righteous; I will enter and give thanks to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter through them and give thanks to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will go through them, And I will praise the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Open for me the gates where the righteous enter, and I will go in and thank the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Open the gates of righteousness to me; I will enter through them, I will give thanks to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Open for me the gates of the righteous; I will enter and give thanks to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 这是耶和华的门， 义人才可以进去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是耶和华的门， 义人才可以进去。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶和华的门； 义人要进去！
verses.textEnNiv: This is the gate of the Lord through which the righteous may enter.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the gate of the Lord ; the righteous shall enter through it.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the gate of the Lord, Through which the righteous shall enter.
verses.textEnNlt: These gates lead to the presence of the Lord , and the godly enter there.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the gate of the Lord; The righteous will enter through it.
verses.textEn: This is the gate of the Lord through which the righteous may enter.

verses.textZh: 我要称谢你，因为你应允了我， 又成了我的拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要称谢你，因为你应允了我， 又成了我的拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要称谢你，因为你已经应允我， 又成了我的拯救！
verses.textEnNiv: I will give you thanks, for you answered me; you have become my salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: I thank you that you have answered me and have become my salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will praise You, For You have answered me, And have become my salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: I thank you for answering my prayer and giving me victory!
verses.textEnNasb: I will give thanks to You, for You have answered me, And You have become my salvation.
verses.textEn: I will give you thanks, for you answered me; you have become my salvation.

verses.textZh: 建筑工人所弃的石头， 成了房角的主要石头；
verses.textZhCnvs: 建筑工人所弃的石头， 成了房角的主要石头；
verses.textZhCuv: 匠人所弃的石头 已成了房角的头块石头。
verses.textEnNiv: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;
verses.textEnEsv: The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
verses.textEnNkjv: The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone.
verses.textEnNlt: The stone that the builders rejected has now become the cornerstone.
verses.textEnNasb: A stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone.
verses.textEn: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;

verses.textZh: 这是耶和华作的， 在我们眼中看为希奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是耶和华作的， 在我们眼中看为希奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶和华所做的， 在我们眼中看为希奇。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the Lord ’s doing; it is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: This was the Lord’s doing; It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the Lord ’s doing, and it is wonderful to see.
verses.textEnNasb: This came about from the Lord; It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.textEn: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes.

verses.textZh: 这是耶和华所定的日子， 我们要在这一日欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是耶和华所定的日子， 我们要在这一日欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶和华所定的日子， 我们在其中要高兴欢喜！
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the day that the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the day the Lord has made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the day the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the day which the Lord has made; Let’s rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.textEn: The Lord has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你施行拯救； 耶和华啊！求你使我们亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你施行拯救； 耶和华啊！求你使我们亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你拯救！ 耶和华啊，求你使我们亨通！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , save us! Lord , grant us success!
verses.textEnEsv: Save us, we pray, O Lord ! O Lord , we pray, give us success!
verses.textEnNkjv: Save now, I pray, O Lord; O Lord, I pray, send now prosperity.
verses.textEnNlt: Please, Lord , please save us. Please, Lord , please give us success.
verses.textEnNasb: Please, O Lord, do save us; Please, O Lord, do send prosperity!
verses.textEn: Lord , save us! Lord , grant us success!

verses.textZh: 奉耶和华的名来的是应当称颂的， 我们从耶和华的殿中给你们祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奉耶和华的名来的是应当称颂的， 我们从耶和华的殿中给你们祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 奉耶和华名来的是应当称颂的！ 我们从耶和华的殿中为你们祝福！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord . From the house of the Lord we bless you.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord ! We bless you from the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! We have blessed you from the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord . We bless you from the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord; We have blessed you from the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord . From the house of the Lord we bless you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是神，他光照了我们。 你们要用绳索把祭牲拴住，带到祭坛的角那里 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是神，他光照了我们。 你们要用绳索把祭牲拴住，带到祭坛的角那里 。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是神； 他光照了我们。 理当用绳索把祭牲拴住， 牵到坛角那里。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is God, and he has made his light shine on us. With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession up to the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is God, and he has made his light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords, up to the horns of the altar!
verses.textEnNkjv: God is the Lord, And He has given us light; Bind the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is God, shining upon us. Take the sacrifice and bind it with cords on the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is God, and He has given us light; Bind the festival sacrifice to the horns of the altar with cords.
verses.textEn: The Lord is God, and he has made his light shine on us. With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession up to the horns of the altar.

verses.textZh: 你是我的神，我要称谢你； 你是我的神，我要尊崇你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是我的神，我要称谢你； 你是我的神，我要尊崇你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是我的神，我要称谢你！ 你是我的神，我要尊崇你！
verses.textEnNiv: You are my God, and I will praise you; you are my God, and I will exalt you.
verses.textEnEsv: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you; you are my God; I will extol you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are my God, and I will praise You; Youare my God, I will exalt You.
verses.textEnNlt: You are my God, and I will praise you! You are my God, and I will exalt you!
verses.textEnNasb: You are my God, and I give thanks to You; You are my God, I exalt You.
verses.textEn: You are my God, and I will praise you; you are my God, and I will exalt you.

verses.textZh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本是良善的； 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本是良善的； 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存！
verses.textEnNiv: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good! His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; For His mercy is everlasting.
verses.textEn: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 行为完全， 遵行耶和华律法的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行为完全， 遵行耶和华律法的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 行为完全、遵行耶和华律法的， 这人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, Who walk in the law of the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Joyful are people of integrity, who follow the instructions of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, Who walk in the Law of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 谨守他的法度， 全心寻求他的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谨守他的法度， 全心寻求他的，都是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 遵守他的法度、一心寻求他的， 这人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those who keep his statutes and seek him with all their heart—
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed are those who keep his testimonies, who seek him with their whole heart,
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies, Who seek Him with the whole heart!
verses.textEnNlt: Joyful are those who obey his laws and search for him with all their hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are those who comply with His testimonies, And seek Him with all their heart.
verses.textEn: Blessed are those who keep his statutes and seek him with all their heart—

verses.textZh: 他们不作不义的事； 他们遵行他的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不作不义的事； 他们遵行他的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人不做非义的事， 但遵行他的道。
verses.textEnNiv: they do no wrong but follow his ways.
verses.textEnEsv: who also do no wrong, but walk in his ways!
verses.textEnNkjv: They also do no iniquity; They walk in His ways.
verses.textEnNlt: They do not compromise with evil, and they walk only in his paths.
verses.textEnNasb: They also do no injustice; They walk in His ways.
verses.textEn: they do no wrong but follow his ways.

verses.textZh: 你曾把你的训词吩咐我们， 要我们殷勤遵守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾把你的训词吩咐我们， 要我们殷勤遵守。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你曾将你的训词吩咐我们， 为要我们殷勤遵守。
verses.textEnNiv: You have laid down precepts that are to be fully obeyed.
verses.textEnEsv: You have commanded your precepts to be kept diligently.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have commanded us To keep Your precepts diligently.
verses.textEnNlt: You have charged us to keep your commandments carefully.
verses.textEnNasb: You have ordained Your precepts, That we are to keep them diligently.
verses.textEn: You have laid down precepts that are to be fully obeyed.

verses.textZh: 但愿我的道路坚定， 为要遵守你的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿我的道路坚定， 为要遵守你的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿我行事坚定， 得以遵守你的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, that my ways were steadfast in obeying your decrees!
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that my ways may be steadfast in keeping your statutes!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that my ways were directed To keep Your statutes!
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, that my actions would consistently reflect your decrees!
verses.textEnNasb: Oh that my ways may be established To keep Your statutes!
verses.textEn: Oh, that my ways were steadfast in obeying your decrees!

verses.textZh: 我重视你的一切诫命， 就不至于羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我重视你的一切诫命， 就不至于羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看重你的一切命令， 就不至于羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I shall not be put to shame, having my eyes fixed on all your commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I would not be ashamed, When I look into all Your commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will not be ashamed when I compare my life with your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will not be ashamed When I look at all Your commandments.
verses.textEn: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all your commands.

verses.textZh: 我学会了你公义的法则， 就以正直的心称谢你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我学会了你公义的法则， 就以正直的心称谢你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我学了你公义的判语， 就要以正直的心称谢你。
verses.textEnNiv: I will praise you with an upright heart as I learn your righteous laws.
verses.textEnEsv: I will praise you with an upright heart, when I learn your righteous rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will praise You with uprightness of heart, When I learn Your righteous judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: As I learn your righteous regulations, I will thank you by living as I should!
verses.textEnNasb: I will give thanks to You with uprightness of heart, When I learn Your righteous judgments.
verses.textEn: I will praise you with an upright heart as I learn your righteous laws.

verses.textZh: 我必遵守你的律例， 求你不要把我弃绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必遵守你的律例， 求你不要把我弃绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必守你的律例； 求你总不要丢弃我！
verses.textEnNiv: I will obey your decrees; do not utterly forsake me. ב Beth
verses.textEnEsv: I will keep your statutes; do not utterly forsake me! Beth
verses.textEnNkjv: I will keep Your statutes; Oh, do not forsake me utterly! ב Beth
verses.textEnNlt: I will obey your decrees. Please don’t give up on me! Beth
verses.textEnNasb: I will keep Your statutes; Do not utterly abandon me! Beth
verses.textEn: I will obey your decrees; do not utterly forsake me. ב Beth

verses.textZh: 少年人用甚么洁净自己的行为呢？ 就是要遵守你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 少年人用甚么洁净自己的行为呢？ 就是要遵守你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 少年人用什么洁净他的行为呢？ 是要遵行你的话！
verses.textEnNiv: How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to your word.
verses.textEnEsv: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: How can a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: How can a young person stay pure? By obeying your word.
verses.textEnNasb: How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping it according to Your word.
verses.textEn: How can a young person stay on the path of purity? By living according to your word.

verses.textZh: 我一心寻求你， 求你不要容我偏离你的诫命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我一心寻求你， 求你不要容我偏离你的诫命。
verses.textZhCuv: 我一心寻求了你； 求你不要叫我偏离你的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: I seek you with all my heart; do not let me stray from your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: With my whole heart I seek you; let me not wander from your commandments!
verses.textEnNkjv: With my whole heart I have sought You; Oh, let me not wander from Your commandments!
verses.textEnNlt: I have tried hard to find you— don’t let me wander from your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: With all my heart I have sought You; Do not let me wander from Your commandments.
verses.textEn: I seek you with all my heart; do not let me stray from your commands.

verses.textZh: 我把你的话藏在心里， 免得我得罪你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把你的话藏在心里， 免得我得罪你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将你的话藏在心里， 免得我得罪你。
verses.textEnNiv: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.
verses.textEnEsv: I have stored up your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your word I have hidden in my heart, That I might not sin against You.
verses.textEnNlt: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.textEnNasb: I have treasured Your word in my heart, So that I may not sin against You.
verses.textEn: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你是该受称颂的； 求你把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你是该受称颂的； 求你把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你是应当称颂的！ 求你将你的律例教训我！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to you, Lord ; teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed are you, O Lord ; teach me your statutes!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed are You, O Lord! Teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: I praise you, O Lord ; teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are You, Lord; Teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEn: Praise be to you, Lord ; teach me your decrees.

verses.textZh: 我用嘴唇传扬从你口中所出的一切典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我用嘴唇传扬从你口中所出的一切典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 我用嘴唇传扬你口中的一切典章。
verses.textEnNiv: With my lips I recount all the laws that come from your mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: With my lips I declare all the rules of your mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: With my lips I have declared All the judgments of Your mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: I have recited aloud all the regulations you have given us.
verses.textEnNasb: With my lips I have told of All the ordinances of Your mouth.
verses.textEn: With my lips I recount all the laws that come from your mouth.

verses.textZh: 我喜欢你法度定下的道路， 如同喜欢一切财富。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我喜欢你法度定下的道路， 如同喜欢一切财富。
verses.textZhCuv: 我喜悦你的法度， 如同喜悦一切的财物。
verses.textEnNiv: I rejoice in following your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.
verses.textEnEsv: In the way of your testimonies I delight as much as in all riches.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies, As muchas in all riches.
verses.textEnNlt: I have rejoiced in your laws as much as in riches.
verses.textEnNasb: I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies, As much as in all riches.
verses.textEn: I rejoice in following your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.

verses.textZh: 我要默想你的训词， 重视你的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要默想你的训词， 重视你的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要默想你的训词， 看重你的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: I meditate on your precepts and consider your ways.
verses.textEnEsv: I will meditate on your precepts and fix my eyes on your ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will meditate on Your precepts, And contemplate Your ways.
verses.textEnNlt: I will study your commandments and reflect on your ways.
verses.textEnNasb: I will meditate on Your precepts And regard Your ways.
verses.textEn: I meditate on your precepts and consider your ways.

verses.textZh: 我喜爱你的律例， 我不会忘记你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我喜爱你的律例， 我不会忘记你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在你的律例中自乐； 我不忘记你的话。
verses.textEnNiv: I delight in your decrees; I will not neglect your word. ג Gimel
verses.textEnEsv: I will delight in your statutes; I will not forget your word. Gimel
verses.textEnNkjv: I will delight myself in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word. ג Gimel
verses.textEnNlt: I will delight in your decrees and not forget your word. Gimel
verses.textEnNasb: I shall delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word. Gimel
verses.textEn: I delight in your decrees; I will not neglect your word. ג Gimel

verses.textZh: 求你恩待你的仆人， 使我可以活着， 也可以谨守你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你恩待你的仆人， 使我可以活着， 也可以谨守你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你用厚恩待你的仆人，使我存活， 我就遵守你的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Be good to your servant while I live, that I may obey your word.
verses.textEnEsv: Deal bountifully with your servant, that I may live and keep your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deal bountifully with Your servant, That I may live and keep Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: Be good to your servant, that I may live and obey your word.
verses.textEnNasb: Deal generously with Your servant, That I may live and keep Your word.
verses.textEn: Be good to your servant while I live, that I may obey your word.

verses.textZh: 求你开我的眼睛， 使我能看出你律法的奇妙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你开我的眼睛， 使我能看出你律法的奇妙。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你开我的眼睛， 使我看出你律法中的奇妙。
verses.textEnNiv: Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in your law.
verses.textEnEsv: Open my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Open my eyes, that I may see Wondrous things from Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: Open my eyes to see the wonderful truths in your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Open my eyes, that I may behold Wonderful things from Your Law.
verses.textEn: Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in your law.

verses.textZh: 我是在世上作寄居的， 求你不要向我隐瞒你的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是在世上作寄居的， 求你不要向我隐瞒你的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是在地上作寄居的； 求你不要向我隐瞒你的命令！
verses.textEnNiv: I am a stranger on earth; do not hide your commands from me.
verses.textEnEsv: I am a sojourner on the earth; hide not your commandments from me!
verses.textEnNkjv: I am a stranger in the earth; Do not hide Your commandments from me.
verses.textEnNlt: I am only a foreigner in the land. Don’t hide your commands from me!
verses.textEnNasb: I am a stranger on the earth; Do not hide Your commandments from me.
verses.textEn: I am a stranger on earth; do not hide your commands from me.

verses.textZh: 我常常切慕你的典章， 以致我心力交瘁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我常常切慕你的典章， 以致我心力交瘁。
verses.textZhCuv: 我时常切慕你的典章， 甚至心碎。
verses.textEnNiv: My soul is consumed with longing for your laws at all times.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul is consumed with longing for your rules at all times.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul breaks with longing For Your judgments at all times.
verses.textEnNlt: I am always overwhelmed with a desire for your regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul is crushed with longing For Your ordinances at all times.
verses.textEn: My soul is consumed with longing for your laws at all times.

verses.textZh: 那些受咒诅的傲慢人，和那些偏离了你诫命的人， 你必斥责他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些受咒诅的傲慢人，和那些偏离了你诫命的人， 你必斥责他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 受咒诅、偏离你命令的骄傲人， 你已经责备他们。
verses.textEnNiv: You rebuke the arrogant, who are accursed, those who stray from your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: You rebuke the insolent, accursed ones, who wander from your commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: You rebuke the proud—the cursed, Who stray from Your commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: You rebuke the arrogant; those who wander from your commands are cursed.
verses.textEnNasb: You rebuke the arrogant, the cursed, Who wander from Your commandments.
verses.textEn: You rebuke the arrogant, who are accursed, those who stray from your commands.

verses.textZh: 求你除去我所受的羞辱和藐视， 因为我遵守你的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你除去我所受的羞辱和藐视， 因为我遵守你的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐视， 因我遵守你的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: Remove from me their scorn and contempt, for I keep your statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: Take away from me scorn and contempt, for I have kept your testimonies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remove from me reproach and contempt, For I have kept Your testimonies.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let them scorn and insult me, for I have obeyed your laws.
verses.textEnNasb: Take disgrace and contempt away from me, For I comply with Your testimonies.
verses.textEn: Remove from me their scorn and contempt, for I keep your statutes.

verses.textZh: 虽有作领袖的坐着毁谤我， 你的仆人却默想你的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽有作领袖的坐着毁谤我， 你的仆人却默想你的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有首领坐着妄论我， 你仆人却思想你的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: Though rulers sit together and slander me, your servant will meditate on your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: Even though princes sit plotting against me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Princes also sit and speak against me, But Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: Even princes sit and speak against me, but I will meditate on your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: Even though rulers sit and speak against me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
verses.textEn: Though rulers sit together and slander me, your servant will meditate on your decrees.

verses.textZh: 你的法度是我的喜乐， 是我的谋士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的法度是我的喜乐， 是我的谋士。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的法度是我所喜乐的， 是我的谋士。
verses.textEnNiv: Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors. ד Daleth
verses.textEnEsv: Your testimonies are my delight; they are my counselors. Daleth
verses.textEnNkjv: Your testimonies also are my delight And my counselors. ד Daleth
verses.textEnNlt: Your laws please me; they give me wise advice. Daleth
verses.textEnNasb: Your testimonies also are my delight; They are my advisers. Daleth
verses.textEn: Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors. ד Daleth

verses.textZh: 我快要归回尘土， 求你按着你的话把我救活过来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我快要归回尘土， 求你按着你的话把我救活过来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的性命几乎归于尘土； 求你照你的话将我救活！
verses.textEnNiv: I am laid low in the dust; preserve my life according to your word.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to your word!
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul clings to the dust; Revive me according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: I lie in the dust; revive me by your word.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul clings to the dust; Revive me according to Your word.
verses.textEn: I am laid low in the dust; preserve my life according to your word.

verses.textZh: 我陈明我所行的，你就应允了我； 求你把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我陈明我所行的，你就应允了我； 求你把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我述说我所行的，你应允了我； 求你将你的律例教训我！
verses.textEnNiv: I gave an account of my ways and you answered me; teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: When I told of my ways, you answered me; teach me your statutes!
verses.textEnNkjv: I have declared my ways, and You answered me; Teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: I told you my plans, and you answered. Now teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: I have told of my ways, and You have answered me; Teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEn: I gave an account of my ways and you answered me; teach me your decrees.

verses.textZh: 求你使我明白你的训词， 我就默想你的奇妙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使我明白你的训词， 我就默想你的奇妙。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使我明白你的训词， 我就思想你的奇事。
verses.textEnNiv: Cause me to understand the way of your precepts, that I may meditate on your wonderful deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: Make me understand the way of your precepts, and I will meditate on your wondrous works.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make me understand the way of Your precepts; So shall I meditate on Your wonderful works.
verses.textEnNlt: Help me understand the meaning of your commandments, and I will meditate on your wonderful deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: Make me understand the way of Your precepts, And I will meditate on Your wonders.
verses.textEn: Cause me to understand the way of your precepts, that I may meditate on your wonderful deeds.

verses.textZh: 我因愁苦而流泪， 求你照着你的话使我坚强。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因愁苦而流泪， 求你照着你的话使我坚强。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心因愁苦而消化； 求你照你的话使我坚立！
verses.textEnNiv: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul melts away for sorrow; strengthen me according to your word!
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul melts from heaviness; Strengthen me according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: I weep with sorrow; encourage me by your word.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul weeps because of grief; Strengthen me according to Your word.
verses.textEn: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

verses.textZh: 求你使我离开虚谎的路， 施恩把你的律法赐给我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使我离开虚谎的路， 施恩把你的律法赐给我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使我离开奸诈的道， 开恩将你的律法赐给我！
verses.textEnNiv: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me and teach me your law.
verses.textEnEsv: Put false ways far from me and graciously teach me your law!
verses.textEnNkjv: Remove from me the way of lying, And grant me Your law graciously.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep me from lying to myself; give me the privilege of knowing your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Remove the false way from me, And graciously grant me Your Law.
verses.textEn: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me and teach me your law.

verses.textZh: 我拣选了信实的道路， 我把你的典章摆在我面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我拣选了信实的道路， 我把你的典章摆在我面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 我拣选了忠信的道， 将你的典章摆在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set my heart on your laws.
verses.textEnEsv: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I set your rules before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have chosen the way of truth; Your judgments I have laid beforeme.
verses.textEnNlt: I have chosen to be faithful; I have determined to live by your regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: I have chosen the faithful way; I have placed Your judgments before me.
verses.textEn: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set my heart on your laws.

verses.textZh: 我紧守你的法度， 耶和华啊！求你不要使我蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我紧守你的法度， 耶和华啊！求你不要使我蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 我持守你的法度； 耶和华啊，求你不要叫我羞愧！
verses.textEnNiv: I hold fast to your statutes, Lord ; do not let me be put to shame.
verses.textEnEsv: I cling to your testimonies, O Lord ; let me not be put to shame!
verses.textEnNkjv: I cling to Your testimonies; O Lord, do not put me to shame!
verses.textEnNlt: I cling to your laws. Lord , don’t let me be put to shame!
verses.textEnNasb: I cling to Your testimonies; Lord, do not put me to shame!
verses.textEn: I hold fast to your statutes, Lord ; do not let me be put to shame.

verses.textZh: 因为你使我的心舒畅， 我就跑在你诫命的路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你使我的心舒畅， 我就跑在你诫命的路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你开广我心的时候， 我就往你命令的道上直奔。
verses.textEnNiv: I run in the path of your commands, for you have broadened my understanding. ה He
verses.textEnEsv: I will run in the way of your commandments when you enlarge my heart! He
verses.textEnNkjv: I will run the course of Your commandments, For You shall enlarge my heart. ה He
verses.textEnNlt: I will pursue your commands, for you expand my understanding. He
verses.textEnNasb: I shall run the way of Your commandments, For You will enlarge my heart. He
verses.textEn: I run in the path of your commands, for you have broadened my understanding. ה He

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你把你的律例指教我， 我必遵守到底。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你把你的律例指教我， 我必遵守到底。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你将你的律例指教我， 我必遵守到底！
verses.textEnNiv: Teach me, Lord , the way of your decrees, that I may follow it to the end.
verses.textEnEsv: Teach me, O Lord , the way of your statutes; and I will keep it to the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: Teach me, O Lord, the way of Your statutes, And I shall keep it to the end.
verses.textEnNlt: Teach me your decrees, O Lord ; I will keep them to the end.
verses.textEnNasb: Teach me the way of Your statutes, Lord, And I shall comply with it to the end.
verses.textEn: Teach me, Lord , the way of your decrees, that I may follow it to the end.

verses.textZh: 求你赐我悟性，我好遵守你的律法， 我必一心谨守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你赐我悟性，我好遵守你的律法， 我必一心谨守。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你赐我悟性，我便遵守你的律法， 且要一心遵守。
verses.textEnNiv: Give me understanding, so that I may keep your law and obey it with all my heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Give me understanding, that I may keep your law and observe it with my whole heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep Your law; Indeed, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Give me understanding and I will obey your instructions; I will put them into practice with all my heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Give me understanding, so that I may comply with Your Law And keep it with all my heart.
verses.textEn: Give me understanding, so that I may keep your law and obey it with all my heart.

verses.textZh: 求你领我走在你诫命的路上， 因为这是我喜悦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你领我走在你诫命的路上， 因为这是我喜悦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你叫我遵行你的命令， 因为这是我所喜乐的。
verses.textEnNiv: Direct me in the path of your commands, for there I find delight.
verses.textEnEsv: Lead me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make me walk in the path of Your commandments, For I delight in it.
verses.textEnNlt: Make me walk along the path of your commands, for that is where my happiness is found.
verses.textEnNasb: Make me walk in the path of Your commandments, For I delight in it.
verses.textEn: Direct me in the path of your commands, for there I find delight.

verses.textZh: 求你使我的心倾向你的法度， 不倾向不义之财。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使我的心倾向你的法度， 不倾向不义之财。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使我的心趋向你的法度， 不趋向非义之财。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn my heart toward your statutes and not toward selfish gain.
verses.textEnEsv: Incline my heart to your testimonies, and not to selfish gain!
verses.textEnNkjv: Incline my heart to Your testimonies, And not to covetousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Give me an eagerness for your laws rather than a love for money!
verses.textEnNasb: Incline my heart to Your testimonies, And not to dishonest gain.
verses.textEn: Turn my heart toward your statutes and not toward selfish gain.

verses.textZh: 求你使我转眼不看虚空的事； 又使我在你的道中存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使我转眼不看虚空的事； 又使我在你的道中存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你叫我转眼不看虚假， 又叫我在你的道中生活。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to your word.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn my eyes from looking at worthless things; and give me life in your ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: Turn away my eyes from looking at worthless things, And revive me in Your way.
verses.textEnNlt: Turn my eyes from worthless things, and give me life through your word.
verses.textEnNasb: Turn my eyes away from looking at what is worthless, And revive me in Your ways.
verses.textEn: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to your word.

verses.textZh: 求你向你的仆人实践你的诺言， 就是你向敬畏你的人所应许的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你向你的仆人实践你的诺言， 就是你向敬畏你的人所应许的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你向敬畏你的人所应许的话， 求你向仆人坚定！
verses.textEnNiv: Fulfill your promise to your servant, so that you may be feared.
verses.textEnEsv: Confirm to your servant your promise, that you may be feared.
verses.textEnNkjv: Establish Your word to Your servant, Who isdevoted to fearing You.
verses.textEnNlt: Reassure me of your promise, made to those who fear you.
verses.textEnNasb: Establish Your word to Your servant As that which produces reverence for You.
verses.textEn: Fulfill your promise to your servant, so that you may be feared.

verses.textZh: 求你使我所怕的羞辱离开我， 因为你的典章都是美好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使我所怕的羞辱离开我， 因为你的典章都是美好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你使我所怕的羞辱远离我， 因你的典章本为美。
verses.textEnNiv: Take away the disgrace I dread, for your laws are good.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn away the reproach that I dread, for your rules are good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Turn away my reproach which I dread, For Your judgments are good.
verses.textEnNlt: Help me abandon my shameful ways; for your regulations are good.
verses.textEnNasb: Take away my disgrace which I dread, For Your judgments are good.
verses.textEn: Take away the disgrace I dread, for your laws are good.

verses.textZh: 我切慕你的训词，求你使我活在你的公义中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我切慕你的训词，求你使我活在你的公义中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我羡慕你的训词； 求你使我在你的公义上生活！
verses.textEnNiv: How I long for your precepts! In your righteousness preserve my life. ו Waw
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I long for your precepts; in your righteousness give me life! Waw
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I long for Your precepts; Revive me in Your righteousness. ו Waw
verses.textEnNlt: I long to obey your commandments! Renew my life with your goodness. Waw
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I long for Your precepts; Revive me through Your righteousness. Vav
verses.textEn: How I long for your precepts! In your righteousness preserve my life. ו Waw

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！愿你照着你的应许， 使你的慈爱、你的救恩临到我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！愿你照着你的应许， 使你的慈爱、你的救恩临到我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，愿你照你的话，使你的慈爱， 就是你的救恩，临到我身上，
verses.textEnNiv: May your unfailing love come to me, Lord , your salvation, according to your promise;
verses.textEnEsv: Let your steadfast love come to me, O Lord , your salvation according to your promise;
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Your mercies come also to me, O Lord— Your salvation according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , give me your unfailing love, the salvation that you promised me.
verses.textEnNasb: May Your favor also come to me, Lord, Your salvation according to Your word;
verses.textEn: May your unfailing love come to me, Lord , your salvation, according to your promise;

verses.textZh: 我就有话回答那羞辱我的， 因为我倚靠你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就有话回答那羞辱我的， 因为我倚靠你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就有话回答那羞辱我的， 因我倚靠你的话。
verses.textEnNiv: then I can answer anyone who taunts me, for I trust in your word.
verses.textEnEsv: then shall I have an answer for him who taunts me, for I trust in your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: So shall I have an answer for him who reproaches me, For I trust in Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I can answer those who taunt me, for I trust in your word.
verses.textEnNasb: So that I will have an answer for one who taunts me, For I trust in Your word.
verses.textEn: then I can answer anyone who taunts me, for I trust in your word.

verses.textZh: 求你使真理的话总不离开我的口， 因为我仰望你的典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你使真理的话总不离开我的口， 因为我仰望你的典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你叫真理的话总不离开我口， 因我仰望你的典章。
verses.textEnNiv: Never take your word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in your laws.
verses.textEnEsv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, for my hope is in your rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, For I have hoped in Your ordinances.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not snatch your word of truth from me, for your regulations are my only hope.
verses.textEnNasb: And do not take the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, For I wait for Your judgments.
verses.textEn: Never take your word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in your laws.

verses.textZh: 我要常常谨守你的律法， 直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要常常谨守你的律法， 直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要常守你的律法， 直到永永远远。
verses.textEnNiv: I will always obey your law, for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: I will keep your law continually, forever and ever,
verses.textEnNkjv: So shall I keep Your law continually, Forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: I will keep on obeying your instructions forever and ever.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will keep Your Law continually, Forever and ever.
verses.textEn: I will always obey your law, for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 我必行在宽阔之处， 因为我一向寻求你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必行在宽阔之处， 因为我一向寻求你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要自由而行 ， 因我素来考究你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: and I shall walk in a wide place, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will walk at liberty, For I seek Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: I will walk in freedom, for I have devoted myself to your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will walk at liberty, For I seek Your precepts.
verses.textEn: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.

verses.textZh: 我在君王面前讲论你的法度， 也不以为耻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在君王面前讲论你的法度， 也不以为耻。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要在君王面前论说你的法度， 并不至于羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: I will speak of your statutes before kings and will not be put to shame,
verses.textEnEsv: I will also speak of your testimonies before kings and shall not be put to shame,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will speak of Your testimonies also before kings, And will not be ashamed.
verses.textEnNlt: I will speak to kings about your laws, and I will not be ashamed.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also speak of Your testimonies before kings And shall not be ashamed.
verses.textEn: I will speak of your statutes before kings and will not be put to shame,

verses.textZh: 我要以你的诫命为乐， 这些诫命是我所爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要以你的诫命为乐， 这些诫命是我所爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在你的命令中自乐； 这命令素来是我所爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: for I delight in your commands because I love them.
verses.textEnEsv: for I find my delight in your commandments, which I love.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will delight myself in Your commandments, Which I love.
verses.textEnNlt: How I delight in your commands! How I love them!
verses.textEnNasb: I will delight in Your commandments, Which I love.
verses.textEn: for I delight in your commands because I love them.

verses.textZh: 我又要向你的诫命举手，这些诫命是我所爱的； 我也要默想你的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又要向你的诫命举手，这些诫命是我所爱的； 我也要默想你的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又要遵行 你的命令， 这命令素来是我所爱的； 我也要思想你的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: I reach out for your commands, which I love, that I may meditate on your decrees. ז Zayin
verses.textEnEsv: I will lift up my hands toward your commandments, which I love, and I will meditate on your statutes. Zayin
verses.textEnNkjv: My hands also I will lift up to Your commandments, Which I love, And I will meditate on Your statutes. ז Zayin
verses.textEnNlt: I honor and love your commands. I meditate on your decrees. Zayin
verses.textEnNasb: And I shall lift up my hands to Your commandments, Which I love; And I will meditate on Your statutes. Zayin
verses.textEn: I reach out for your commands, which I love, that I may meditate on your decrees. ז Zayin

verses.textZh: 求你记念你向你仆人应许的话， 因为你使我有盼望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你记念你向你仆人应许的话， 因为你使我有盼望。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你记念向你仆人所应许的话， 叫我有盼望。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember your word to your servant, for you have given me hope.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember your word to your servant, in which you have made me hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember the word to Your servant, Upon which You have caused me to hope.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember your promise to me; it is my only hope.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember the word to Your servant, In which You have made me hope.
verses.textEn: Remember your word to your servant, for you have given me hope.

verses.textZh: 你的应许使我存活； 这就是我在困苦中的安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的应许使我存活； 这就是我在困苦中的安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 这话将我救活了； 我在患难中，因此得安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: My comfort in my suffering is this: Your promise preserves my life.
verses.textEnEsv: This is my comfort in my affliction, that your promise gives me life.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is my comfort in my affliction, For Your word has given me life.
verses.textEnNlt: Your promise revives me; it comforts me in all my troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: This is my comfort in my misery, That Your word has revived me.
verses.textEn: My comfort in my suffering is this: Your promise preserves my life.

verses.textZh: 骄傲的人苛刻地讥诮我， 我却没有偏离你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 骄傲的人苛刻地讥诮我， 我却没有偏离你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 骄傲的人甚侮慢我， 我却未曾偏离你的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: The arrogant mock me unmercifully, but I do not turn from your law.
verses.textEnEsv: The insolent utterly deride me, but I do not turn away from your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: The proud have me in great derision, Yet I do not turn aside from Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: The proud hold me in utter contempt, but I do not turn away from your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: The arrogant utterly deride me, Yet I do not turn aside from Your Law.
verses.textEn: The arrogant mock me unmercifully, but I do not turn from your law.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我思念你在古时赐下的典章， 我就得了安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我思念你在古时赐下的典章， 我就得了安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我记念你从古以来的典章， 就得了安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: I remember, Lord , your ancient laws, and I find comfort in them.
verses.textEnEsv: When I think of your rules from of old, I take comfort, O Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I remembered Your judgments of old, O Lord, And have comforted myself.
verses.textEnNlt: I meditate on your age-old regulations; O Lord , they comfort me.
verses.textEnNasb: I have remembered Your judgments from of old, Lord, And comfort myself.
verses.textEn: I remember, Lord , your ancient laws, and I find comfort in them.

verses.textZh: 因为恶人离弃你的律法， 我就非常忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为恶人离弃你的律法， 我就非常忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见恶人离弃你的律法， 就怒气发作，犹如火烧。
verses.textEnNiv: Indignation grips me because of the wicked, who have forsaken your law.
verses.textEnEsv: Hot indignation seizes me because of the wicked, who forsake your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indignation has taken hold of me Because of the wicked, who forsake Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: I become furious with the wicked, because they reject your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Burning indignation has seized me because of the wicked, Who abandon Your Law.
verses.textEn: Indignation grips me because of the wicked, who have forsaken your law.

verses.textZh: 在我寄居的住所里， 你的律例成了我的诗歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我寄居的住所里， 你的律例成了我的诗歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在世寄居， 素来以你的律例为诗歌。
verses.textEnNiv: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.
verses.textEnEsv: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my sojourning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.textEnNlt: Your decrees have been the theme of my songs wherever I have lived.
verses.textEnNasb: Your statutes are my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.textEn: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我在夜间记念你的名， 我要谨守你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我在夜间记念你的名， 我要谨守你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我夜间记念你的名， 遵守你的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: In the night, Lord , I remember your name, that I may keep your law.
verses.textEnEsv: I remember your name in the night, O Lord , and keep your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: I remember Your name in the night, O Lord, And I keep Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: I reflect at night on who you are, O Lord ; therefore, I obey your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, I remember Your name in the night, And keep Your Law.
verses.textEn: In the night, Lord , I remember your name, that I may keep your law.

verses.textZh: 我这样作， 是因为我遵守你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这样作， 是因为我遵守你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 我所以如此， 是因我守你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: This has been my practice: I obey your precepts. ח Heth
verses.textEnEsv: This blessing has fallen to me, that I have kept your precepts. Heth
verses.textEnNkjv: This has become mine, Because I kept Your precepts. ח Heth
verses.textEnNlt: This is how I spend my life: obeying your commandments. Heth
verses.textEnNasb: This has become mine, That I comply with Your precepts. Heth
verses.textEn: This has been my practice: I obey your precepts. ח Heth

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你是我的业分， 我曾说我要谨守你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你是我的业分， 我曾说我要谨守你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是我的福分； 我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: You are my portion, Lord ; I have promised to obey your words.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is my portion; I promise to keep your words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Youare my portion, O Lord; I have said that I would keep Your words.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , you are mine! I promise to obey your words!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
verses.textEn: You are my portion, Lord ; I have promised to obey your words.

verses.textZh: 我曾一心向你乞恩， 愿你照着你的应许恩待我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾一心向你乞恩， 愿你照着你的应许恩待我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我一心求过你的恩； 愿你照你的话怜悯我！
verses.textEnNiv: I have sought your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.
verses.textEnEsv: I entreat your favor with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: I entreated Your favor with my whole heart; Be merciful to me according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: With all my heart I want your blessings. Be merciful as you promised.
verses.textEnNasb: I sought Your favor with all my heart; Be gracious to me according to Your word.
verses.textEn: I have sought your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.

verses.textZh: 我思想我所行的道路， 就转回脚步归向你的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我思想我所行的道路， 就转回脚步归向你的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 我思想我所行的道， 就转步归向你的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: I have considered my ways and have turned my steps to your statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: When I think on my ways, I turn my feet to your testimonies;
verses.textEnNkjv: I thought about my ways, And turned my feet to Your testimonies.
verses.textEnNlt: I pondered the direction of my life, and I turned to follow your laws.
verses.textEnNasb: I considered my ways And turned my feet to Your testimonies.
verses.textEn: I have considered my ways and have turned my steps to your statutes.

verses.textZh: 我赶快谨守你的命令， 不敢耽延。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我赶快谨守你的命令， 不敢耽延。
verses.textZhCuv: 我急忙遵守你的命令， 并不迟延。
verses.textEnNiv: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: I hasten and do not delay to keep your commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: I made haste, and did not delay To keep Your commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: I will hurry, without delay, to obey your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: I hurried and did not delay To keep Your commandments.
verses.textEn: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.

verses.textZh: 恶人的绳索虽然捆绑我， 我却不忘记你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的绳索虽然捆绑我， 我却不忘记你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的绳索缠绕我， 我却没有忘记你的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Though the wicked bind me with ropes, I will not forget your law.
verses.textEnEsv: Though the cords of the wicked ensnare me, I do not forget your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: The cords of the wicked have bound me, But I have not forgotten Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: Evil people try to drag me into sin, but I am firmly anchored to your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: The snares of the wicked have surrounded me, But I have not forgotten Your Law.
verses.textEn: Though the wicked bind me with ropes, I will not forget your law.

verses.textZh: 因你公义的典章， 我半夜起来称谢你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你公义的典章， 我半夜起来称谢你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因你公义的典章， 半夜必起来称谢你。
verses.textEnNiv: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.
verses.textEnEsv: At midnight I rise to praise you, because of your righteous rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to You, Because of Your righteous judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: I rise at midnight to thank you for your just regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to You Because of Your righteous judgments.
verses.textEn: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.

verses.textZh: 凡是敬畏你，谨守你训词的， 我都与他们为友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是敬畏你，谨守你训词的， 我都与他们为友。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡敬畏你、守你训词的人， 我都与他作伴。
verses.textEnNiv: I am a friend to all who fear you, to all who follow your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: I am a companion of all who fear you, of those who keep your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am a companion of all who fear You, And of those who keep Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: I am a friend to anyone who fears you— anyone who obeys your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: I am a companion to all those who fear You, And to those who keep Your precepts.
verses.textEn: I am a friend to all who fear you, to all who follow your precepts.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的慈爱遍满大地； 求你把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的慈爱遍满大地； 求你把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱遍满大地； 求你将你的律例教训我！
verses.textEnNiv: The earth is filled with your love, Lord ; teach me your decrees. ט Teth
verses.textEnEsv: The earth, O Lord , is full of your steadfast love; teach me your statutes! Teth
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth, O Lord, is full of Your mercy; Teach me Your statutes. ט Teth
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , your unfailing love fills the earth; teach me your decrees. Teth
verses.textEnNasb: The earth is full of Your goodness, Lord; Teach me Your statutes. Teth
verses.textEn: The earth is filled with your love, Lord ; teach me your decrees. ט Teth

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你向来照着你的话， 善待你的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你向来照着你的话， 善待你的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你向来是照你的话善待仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: Do good to your servant according to your word, Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You have dealt well with your servant, O Lord , according to your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have dealt well with Your servant, O Lord, according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: You have done many good things for me, Lord , just as you promised.
verses.textEnNasb: You have treated Your servant well, Lord, according to Your word.
verses.textEn: Do good to your servant according to your word, Lord .

verses.textZh: 求你把聪明和知识指教我， 因为我信靠你的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你把聪明和知识指教我， 因为我信靠你的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你将精明和知识赐给我， 因我信了你的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: Teach me knowledge and good judgment, for I trust your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, For I believe Your commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: I believe in your commands; now teach me good judgment and knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: Teach me good discernment and knowledge, For I believe in Your commandments.
verses.textEn: Teach me knowledge and good judgment, for I trust your commands.

verses.textZh: 我受苦以先，犯了错误； 现在我谨守你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我受苦以先，犯了错误； 现在我谨守你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我未受苦以先走迷了路， 现在却遵守你的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I obey your word.
verses.textEnEsv: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I keep your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: Before I was afflicted I went astray, But now I keep Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: I used to wander off until you disciplined me; but now I closely follow your word.
verses.textEnNasb: Before I was afflicted I went astray, But now I keep Your word.
verses.textEn: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I obey your word.

verses.textZh: 你本是良善的，你所行的也是良善的； 求你把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你本是良善的，你所行的也是良善的； 求你把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你本为善，所行的也善； 求你将你的律例教训我！
verses.textEnNiv: You are good, and what you do is good; teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: You are good and do good; teach me your statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are good, and do good; Teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: You are good and do only good; teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: You are good and You do good; Teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEn: You are good, and what you do is good; teach me your decrees.

verses.textZh: 傲慢人用谎言中伤我， 我却一心遵守你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 傲慢人用谎言中伤我， 我却一心遵守你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 骄傲人编造谎言攻击我， 我却要一心守你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep your precepts with all my heart.
verses.textEnEsv: The insolent smear me with lies, but with my whole heart I keep your precepts;
verses.textEnNkjv: The proud have forged a lie against me, But I will keep Your precepts with my whole heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Arrogant people smear me with lies, but in truth I obey your commandments with all my heart.
verses.textEnNasb: The arrogant have forged a lie against me; With all my heart I will comply with Your precepts.
verses.textEn: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep your precepts with all my heart.

verses.textZh: 他们的心麻木如同脂油， 我却喜欢你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的心麻木如同脂油， 我却喜欢你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们心蒙脂油， 我却喜爱你的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Their hearts are callous and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.
verses.textEnEsv: their heart is unfeeling like fat, but I delight in your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their heart is as fat as grease, But I delight in Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: Their hearts are dull and stupid, but I delight in your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Their heart is insensitive, like fat, But I delight in Your Law.
verses.textEn: Their hearts are callous and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.

verses.textZh: 我受苦是对我有益的， 为要使我学习你的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我受苦是对我有益的， 为要使我学习你的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 我受苦是与我有益， 为要使我学习你的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: It is good for me that I was afflicted, that I might learn your statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis good for me that I have been afflicted, That I may learn Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: My suffering was good for me, for it taught me to pay attention to your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: It is good for me that I was afflicted, So that I may learn Your statutes.
verses.textEn: It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn your decrees.

verses.textZh: 你口中的律法对我有益， 胜过千千万万的金银。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你口中的律法对我有益， 胜过千千万万的金银。
verses.textZhCuv: 你口中的训言 与我有益， 胜于千万的金银。
verses.textEnNiv: The law from your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver and gold. י Yodh
verses.textEnEsv: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces. Yodh
verses.textEnNkjv: The law of Your mouth is better to me Than thousands of coinsof gold and silver. י Yod
verses.textEnNlt: Your instructions are more valuable to me than millions in gold and silver. Yodh
verses.textEnNasb: The Law of Your mouth is better to me Than thousands of gold and silver pieces. Yodh
verses.textEn: The law from your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver and gold. י Yodh

verses.textZh: 你的手造了我，建立了我； 求你使我有悟性，可以学习你的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的手造了我，建立了我； 求你使我有悟性，可以学习你的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的手制造我，建立我； 求你赐我悟性，可以学习你的命令！
verses.textEnNiv: Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding to learn your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: Your hands have made and fashioned me; give me understanding that I may learn your commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, that I may learn Your commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: You made me; you created me. Now give me the sense to follow your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: Your hands made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, so that I may learn Your commandments.
verses.textEn: Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding to learn your commands.

verses.textZh: 愿敬畏你的人看见我就欢喜， 因为我仰望你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿敬畏你的人看见我就欢喜， 因为我仰望你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏你的人见我就要欢喜， 因我仰望你的话。
verses.textEnNiv: May those who fear you rejoice when they see me, for I have put my hope in your word.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who fear you shall see me and rejoice, because I have hoped in your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who fear You will be glad when they see me, Because I have hoped in Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: May all who fear you find in me a cause for joy, for I have put my hope in your word.
verses.textEnNasb: May those who fear You see me and be glad, Because I wait for Your word.
verses.textEn: May those who fear you rejoice when they see me, for I have put my hope in your word.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我知道你的判语是公义的， 为了你的信实，你使我受苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我知道你的判语是公义的， 为了你的信实，你使我受苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我知道你的判语是公义的； 你使我受苦是以诚实待我。
verses.textEnNiv: I know, Lord , that your laws are righteous, and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.textEnEsv: I know, O Lord , that your rules are righteous, and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I know, O Lord, that Your judgments are right, And that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
verses.textEnNlt: I know, O Lord , that your regulations are fair; you disciplined me because I needed it.
verses.textEnNasb: I know, Lord, that Your judgments are righteous, And that You have afflicted me in faithfulness.
verses.textEn: I know, Lord , that your laws are righteous, and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

verses.textZh: 求你按着你给你仆人的应许， 以你的慈爱安慰我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你按着你给你仆人的应许， 以你的慈爱安慰我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你照着应许仆人的话， 以慈爱安慰我。
verses.textEnNiv: May your unfailing love be my comfort, according to your promise to your servant.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your steadfast love comfort me according to your promise to your servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let, I pray, Your merciful kindness be for my comfort, According to Your word to Your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: Now let your unfailing love comfort me, just as you promised me, your servant.
verses.textEnNasb: May Your favor comfort me, According to Your word to Your servant.
verses.textEn: May your unfailing love be my comfort, according to your promise to your servant.

verses.textZh: 愿你的怜悯临到我，使我活着， 因为我喜欢你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你的怜悯临到我，使我活着， 因为我喜欢你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你的慈悲临到我，使我存活， 因你的律法是我所喜爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: Let your compassion come to me that I may live, for your law is my delight.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your mercy come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; For Your law is my delight.
verses.textEnNlt: Surround me with your tender mercies so I may live, for your instructions are my delight.
verses.textEnNasb: May Your compassion come to me so that I may live, For Your Law is my delight.
verses.textEn: Let your compassion come to me that I may live, for your law is my delight.

verses.textZh: 愿傲慢人蒙羞，因为他们以诡诈诬蔑我； 至于我，我却要默想你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿傲慢人蒙羞，因为他们以诡诈诬蔑我； 至于我，我却要默想你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿骄傲人蒙羞，因为他们无理地倾覆我； 但我要思想你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause; but I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the insolent be put to shame, because they have wronged me with falsehood; as for me, I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the proud be ashamed, For they treated me wrongfully with falsehood; But I will meditate on Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: Bring disgrace upon the arrogant people who lied about me; meanwhile, I will concentrate on your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: May the arrogant be put to shame, because they lead me astray with a lie; But I shall meditate on Your precepts.
verses.textEn: May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause; but I will meditate on your precepts.

verses.textZh: 愿敬畏你、知道你法度的人， 都归向我；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿敬畏你、知道你法度的人， 都归向我；
verses.textZhCuv: 愿敬畏你的人归向我， 他们就知道你的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: May those who fear you turn to me, those who understand your statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: Let those who fear you turn to me, that they may know your testimonies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let those who fear You turn to me, Those who know Your testimonies.
verses.textEnNlt: Let me be united with all who fear you, with those who know your laws.
verses.textEnNasb: May those who fear You turn to me, And those who know Your testimonies.
verses.textEn: May those who fear you turn to me, those who understand your statutes.

verses.textZh: 愿我的心在你的律例上无可指摘， 使我不至蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我的心在你的律例上无可指摘， 使我不至蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我的心在你的律例上完全， 使我不致蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: May I wholeheartedly follow your decrees, that I may not be put to shame. כ Kaph
verses.textEnEsv: May my heart be blameless in your statutes, that I may not be put to shame! Kaph
verses.textEnNkjv: Let my heart be blameless regarding Your statutes, That I may not be ashamed. ך Kaph
verses.textEnNlt: May I be blameless in keeping your decrees; then I will never be ashamed. Kaph
verses.textEnNasb: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, So that I will not be ashamed. Kaph
verses.textEn: May I wholeheartedly follow your decrees, that I may not be put to shame. כ Kaph

verses.textZh: 我渴望你的救恩以致心力衰竭， 但我仍仰望你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我渴望你的救恩以致心力衰竭， 但我仍仰望你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心渴想你的救恩， 仰望你的应许。
verses.textEnNiv: My soul faints with longing for your salvation, but I have put my hope in your word.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul longs for your salvation; I hope in your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul faints for Your salvation, But I hope in Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: I am worn out waiting for your rescue, but I have put my hope in your word.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul languishes for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
verses.textEn: My soul faints with longing for your salvation, but I have put my hope in your word.

verses.textZh: 我仰望你的应许以致眼睛昏花， 我说："你甚么时候才安慰我呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我仰望你的应许以致眼睛昏花， 我说："你甚么时候才安慰我呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我因盼望你的应许眼睛失明，说： 你何时安慰我？
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, "When will you comfort me?"
verses.textEnEsv: My eyes long for your promise; I ask, "When will you comfort me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: My eyes fail fromsearching Your word, Saying, "When will You comfort me?"
verses.textEnNlt: My eyes are straining to see your promises come true. When will you comfort me?
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes fail with longing for Your word, While I say, "When will You comfort me?"
verses.textEn: My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, "When will you comfort me?"

verses.textZh: 我虽然好象烟熏的皮袋， 我却没有忘记你的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然好象烟熏的皮袋， 我却没有忘记你的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 我好像烟薰的皮袋， 却不忘记你的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, yet I have not forgotten your statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have become like a wineskin in smoke, Yet I do not forget Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: I am shriveled like a wineskin in the smoke, but I have not forgotten to obey your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: Though I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
verses.textEn: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget your decrees.

verses.textZh: 你仆人的日子还有多少？ 你甚么时候才向那些逼迫我的人施行审判呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你仆人的日子还有多少？ 你甚么时候才向那些逼迫我的人施行审判呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你仆人的年日有多少呢？ 你几时向逼迫我的人施行审判呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How long must your servant wait? When will you punish my persecutors?
verses.textEnEsv: How long must your servant endure? When will you judge those who persecute me?
verses.textEnNkjv: How many are the days of Your servant? When will You execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.textEnNlt: How long must I wait? When will you punish those who persecute me?
verses.textEnNasb: How many are the days of Your servant? When will You execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.textEn: How long must your servant wait? When will you punish my persecutors?

verses.textZh: 傲慢人为我掘了坑， 他们就是那些不按着你律法而行的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 傲慢人为我掘了坑， 他们就是那些不按着你律法而行的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 不从你律法的骄傲人为我掘了坑。
verses.textEnNiv: The arrogant dig pits to trap me, contrary to your law.
verses.textEnEsv: The insolent have dug pitfalls for me; they do not live according to your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: The proud have dug pits for me, Which is not according to Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: These arrogant people who hate your instructions have dug deep pits to trap me.
verses.textEnNasb: The arrogant have dug pits for me, People who are not in accord with Your Law.
verses.textEn: The arrogant dig pits to trap me, contrary to your law.

verses.textZh: 你的一切命令都是可信靠的； 他们以诡诈逼迫我，求你帮助我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的一切命令都是可信靠的； 他们以诡诈逼迫我，求你帮助我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的命令尽都诚实； 他们无理地逼迫我，求你帮助我！
verses.textEnNiv: All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for I am being persecuted without cause.
verses.textEnEsv: All your commandments are sure; they persecute me with falsehood; help me!
verses.textEnNkjv: All Your commandments are faithful; They persecute me wrongfully; Help me!
verses.textEnNlt: All your commands are trustworthy. Protect me from those who hunt me down without cause.
verses.textEnNasb: All Your commandments are faithful; They have persecuted me with a lie; help me!
verses.textEn: All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for I am being persecuted without cause.

verses.textZh: 他们几乎把我从世上除灭了； 至于我，我却没有离弃你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们几乎把我从世上除灭了； 至于我，我却没有离弃你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们几乎把我从世上灭绝， 但我没有离弃你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: They have almost made an end of me on earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: They almost made an end of me on earth, But I did not forsake Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: They almost finished me off, but I refused to abandon your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: They almost destroyed me on earth, But as for me, I did not abandon Your precepts.
verses.textEn: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.

verses.textZh: 求你照着你的慈爱使我存活， 我就必谨守你口中的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你照着你的慈爱使我存活， 我就必谨守你口中的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你照你的慈爱将我救活， 我就遵守你口中的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: In your unfailing love preserve my life, that I may obey the statutes of your mouth. ל Lamedh
verses.textEnEsv: In your steadfast love give me life, that I may keep the testimonies of your mouth. Lamedh
verses.textEnNkjv: Revive me according to Your lovingkindness, So that I may keep the testimony of Your mouth. ל Lamed
verses.textEnNlt: In your unfailing love, spare my life; then I can continue to obey your laws. Lamedh
verses.textEnNasb: Revive me according to Your faithfulness, So that I may keep the testimony of Your mouth. Lamedh
verses.textEn: In your unfailing love preserve my life, that I may obey the statutes of your mouth. ל Lamedh

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的话存到永远， 坚立在天上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的话存到永远， 坚立在天上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的话安定在天， 直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: Your word, Lord , is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: Forever, O Lord , your word is firmly fixed in the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: Forever, O Lord, Your word is settled in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Your eternal word, O Lord , stands firm in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Forever, Lord, Your word stands in heaven.
verses.textEn: Your word, Lord , is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.

verses.textZh: 你的信实存到万代； 你坚立了地，地就长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的信实存到万代； 你坚立了地，地就长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的诚实存到万代； 你坚定了地，地就长存。
verses.textEnNiv: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures.
verses.textEnEsv: Your faithfulness endures to all generations; you have established the earth, and it stands fast.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your faithfulness endures to all generations; You established the earth, and it abides.
verses.textEnNlt: Your faithfulness extends to every generation, as enduring as the earth you created.
verses.textEnNasb: Your faithfulness continues throughout generations; You established the earth, and it stands.
verses.textEn: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures.

verses.textZh: 天地照着你的安排存到今日， 因为万有都是你的仆役。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天地照着你的安排存到今日， 因为万有都是你的仆役。
verses.textZhCuv: 天地照你的安排存到今日； 万物都是你的仆役。
verses.textEnNiv: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.
verses.textEnEsv: By your appointment they stand this day, for all things are your servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: They continue this day according to Your ordinances, For all are Your servants.
verses.textEnNlt: Your regulations remain true to this day, for everything serves your plans.
verses.textEnNasb: They stand this day by Your ordinances, For all things are Your servants.
verses.textEn: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.

verses.textZh: 如果我不是喜欢你的律法， 就早已在苦难中灭亡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我不是喜欢你的律法， 就早已在苦难中灭亡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若不是喜爱你的律法， 早就在苦难中灭绝了！
verses.textEnNiv: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.textEnEsv: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.textEnNkjv: Unless Your law hadbeen my delight, I would then have perished in my affliction.
verses.textEnNlt: If your instructions hadn’t sustained me with joy, I would have died in my misery.
verses.textEnNasb: If Your Law had not been my delight, Then I would have perished in my misery.
verses.textEn: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

verses.textZh: 我永远不会忘记你的训词， 因为你用这些训词使我存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我永远不会忘记你的训词， 因为你用这些训词使我存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 我永不忘记你的训词， 因你用这训词将我救活了。
verses.textEnNiv: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.
verses.textEnEsv: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will never forget Your precepts, For by them You have given me life.
verses.textEnNlt: I will never forget your commandments, for by them you give me life.
verses.textEnNasb: I will never forget Your precepts, For by them You have revived me.
verses.textEn: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.

verses.textZh: 我是属于你的，求你拯救我， 因为我寻求你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是属于你的，求你拯救我， 因为我寻求你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是属你的，求你救我， 因我寻求了你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: Save me, for I am yours; I have sought out your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: I am yours; save me, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am Yours, save me; For I have sought Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: I am yours; rescue me! For I have worked hard at obeying your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: I am Yours, save me; For I have sought Your precepts.
verses.textEn: Save me, for I am yours; I have sought out your precepts.

verses.textZh: 恶人等待着要把我毁灭， 我却思考你的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人等待着要把我毁灭， 我却思考你的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人等待我，要灭绝我， 我却要揣摩你的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will ponder your statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I consider your testimonies.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked wait for me to destroy me, But I will consider Your testimonies.
verses.textEnNlt: Though the wicked hide along the way to kill me, I will quietly keep my mind on your laws.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked wait for me to destroy me; I will diligently consider Your testimonies.
verses.textEn: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will ponder your statutes.

verses.textZh: 我看一切圆满的事都有尽头， 只有你的命令是广阔无边的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看一切圆满的事都有尽头， 只有你的命令是广阔无边的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看万事尽都有限， 惟有你的命令极其宽广。
verses.textEnNiv: To all perfection I see a limit, but your commands are boundless. מ Mem
verses.textEnEsv: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commandment is exceedingly broad. Mem
verses.textEnNkjv: I have seen the consummation of all perfection, But Your commandment is exceedingly broad. ם Mem
verses.textEnNlt: Even perfection has its limits, but your commands have no limit. Mem
verses.textEnNasb: I have seen a limit to all perfection; Your commandment is exceedingly broad. Mem
verses.textEn: To all perfection I see a limit, but your commands are boundless. מ Mem

verses.textZh: 我多么爱慕你的律法， 终日不住地默想。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我多么爱慕你的律法， 终日不住地默想。
verses.textZhCuv: 我何等爱慕你的律法， 终日不住地思想。
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh how I love your law! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, how I love Your law! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, how I love your instructions! I think about them all day long.
verses.textEnNasb: How I love Your Law! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.textEn: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.

verses.textZh: 你的命令使我比我的仇敌更有智慧， 因为你的命令常存在我里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的命令使我比我的仇敌更有智慧， 因为你的命令常存在我里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的命令常存在我心里， 使我比仇敌有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Your commands are always with me and make me wiser than my enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies, for it is ever with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: You, through Your commandments, make me wiser than my enemies; For they are ever with me.
verses.textEnNlt: Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, for they are my constant guide.
verses.textEnNasb: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, For they are ever mine.
verses.textEn: Your commands are always with me and make me wiser than my enemies.

verses.textZh: 我比我所有的老师明智， 因为我默想你的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我比我所有的老师明智， 因为我默想你的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 我比我的师傅更通达， 因我思想你的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have more understanding than all my teachers, For Your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I have more insight than my teachers, for I am always thinking of your laws.
verses.textEnNasb: I have more insight than all my teachers, For Your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.textEn: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your statutes.

verses.textZh: 我比老年人更明理， 因为我遵守你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我比老年人更明理， 因为我遵守你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 我比年老的更明白， 因我守了你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: I have more understanding than the elders, for I obey your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: I understand more than the aged, for I keep your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: I understand more than the ancients, Because I keep Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: I am even wiser than my elders, for I have kept your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: I understand more than those who are old, Because I have complied with Your precepts.
verses.textEn: I have more understanding than the elders, for I obey your precepts.

verses.textZh: 我制止我的脚不走任何邪恶的路， 为要谨守你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我制止我的脚不走任何邪恶的路， 为要谨守你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我禁止我脚走一切的邪路， 为要遵守你的话。
verses.textEnNiv: I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I might obey your word.
verses.textEnEsv: I hold back my feet from every evil way, in order to keep your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have restrained my feet from every evil way, That I may keep Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: I have refused to walk on any evil path, so that I may remain obedient to your word.
verses.textEnNasb: I have restrained my feet from every evil way, So that I may keep Your word.
verses.textEn: I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I might obey your word.

verses.textZh: 我没有偏离你的典章， 因为你亲自教导了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我没有偏离你的典章， 因为你亲自教导了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我没有偏离你的典章， 因为你教训了我。
verses.textEnNiv: I have not departed from your laws, for you yourself have taught me.
verses.textEnEsv: I do not turn aside from your rules, for you have taught me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have not departed from Your judgments, For You Yourself have taught me.
verses.textEnNlt: I haven’t turned away from your regulations, for you have taught me well.
verses.textEnNasb: I have not turned aside from Your judgments, For You Yourself have taught me.
verses.textEn: I have not departed from your laws, for you yourself have taught me.

verses.textZh: 你的话语在我的上膛多么甜美， 在我的口中比蜂蜜更甜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的话语在我的上膛多么甜美， 在我的口中比蜂蜜更甜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的言语在我上膛何等甘美， 在我口中比蜜更甜！
verses.textEnNiv: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.textEnEsv: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.textEnNkjv: How sweet are Your words to my taste, Sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.textEnNlt: How sweet your words taste to me; they are sweeter than honey.
verses.textEnNasb: How sweet are Your words to my taste! Yes, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.textEn: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.textZh: 我借着你的训词，得以明白事理； 因此，我恨恶一切虚谎的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我借着你的训词，得以明白事理； 因此，我恨恶一切虚谎的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 我藉着你的训词得以明白， 所以我恨一切的假道。
verses.textEnNiv: I gain understanding from your precepts; therefore I hate every wrong path. נ Nun
verses.textEnEsv: Through your precepts I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. Nun
verses.textEnNkjv: Through Your precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way. ן Nun
verses.textEnNlt: Your commandments give me understanding; no wonder I hate every false way of life. Nun
verses.textEnNasb: From Your precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way. Nun
