verses.textEn: I gain understanding from your precepts; therefore I hate every wrong path. נ Nun

verses.textZh: 你的话是我脚前的灯， 是我路上的光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的话是我脚前的灯， 是我路上的光。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的话是我脚前的灯， 是我路上的光。
verses.textEnNiv: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.
verses.textEnEsv: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your word is a lamp to my feet And a light to my path.
verses.textEnNlt: Your word is a lamp to guide my feet and a light for my path.
verses.textEnNasb: Your word is a lamp to my feet And a light to my path.
verses.textEn: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

verses.textZh: 我曾起誓，并且坚守誓言， 我必遵守你公义的典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾起誓，并且坚守誓言， 我必遵守你公义的典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 你公义的典章，我曾起誓遵守， 我必按誓而行。
verses.textEnNiv: I have taken an oath and confirmed it, that I will follow your righteous laws.
verses.textEnEsv: I have sworn an oath and confirmed it, to keep your righteous rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have sworn and confirmed That I will keep Your righteous judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: I’ve promised it once, and I’ll promise it again: I will obey your righteous regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: I have sworn and I will confirm it, That I will keep Your righteous judgments.
verses.textEn: I have taken an oath and confirmed it, that I will follow your righteous laws.

verses.textZh: 我受苦极重； 耶和华啊！求你照着你的应许使我存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我受苦极重； 耶和华啊！求你照着你的应许使我存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 我甚是受苦； 耶和华啊，求你照你的话将我救活！
verses.textEnNiv: I have suffered much; preserve my life, Lord , according to your word.
verses.textEnEsv: I am severely afflicted; give me life, O Lord , according to your word!
verses.textEnNkjv: I am afflicted very much; Revive me, O Lord, according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: I have suffered much, O Lord ; restore my life again as you promised.
verses.textEnNasb: I am exceedingly afflicted; Revive me, Lord, according to Your word.
verses.textEn: I have suffered much; preserve my life, Lord , according to your word.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你悦纳我口中的甘心祭， 又把你的典章教导我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你悦纳我口中的甘心祭， 又把你的典章教导我。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你悦纳我口中的赞美为供物， 又将你的典章教训我！
verses.textEnNiv: Accept, Lord , the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me your laws.
verses.textEnEsv: Accept my freewill offerings of praise, O Lord , and teach me your rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: Accept, I pray, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, And teach me Your judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , accept my offering of praise, and teach me your regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: Be pleased to accept the voluntary offerings of my mouth, Lord, And teach me Your judgments.
verses.textEn: Accept, Lord , the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me your laws.

verses.textZh: 我的性命常在危险中， 我却没有忘记你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的性命常在危险中， 我却没有忘记你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的性命常在危险之中， 我却不忘记你的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget your law.
verses.textEnEsv: I hold my life in my hand continually, but I do not forget your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: My life is continually in my hand, Yet I do not forget Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: My life constantly hangs in the balance, but I will not stop obeying your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: My life is continually in my hand, Yet I do not forget Your Law.
verses.textEn: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget your law.

verses.textZh: 恶人虽然设下陷阱要害我， 我却没有偏离你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人虽然设下陷阱要害我， 我却没有偏离你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人为我设下网罗， 我却没有偏离你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: The wicked have laid a snare for me, but I do not stray from your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: The wicked have laid a snare for me, Yet I have not strayed from Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked have set their traps for me, but I will not turn from your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: The wicked have set a trap for me, Yet I have not wandered from Your precepts.
verses.textEn: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.

verses.textZh: 我以你的法度为我永远的产业； 因为它们是我心中的喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我以你的法度为我永远的产业； 因为它们是我心中的喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我以你的法度为永远的产业， 因这是我心中所喜爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your testimonies I have taken as a heritage forever, For they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Your laws are my treasure; they are my heart’s delight.
verses.textEnNasb: I have inherited Your testimonies forever, For they are the joy of my heart.
verses.textEn: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.

verses.textZh: 我专心遵行你的律例， 永不改变，遵行到底。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我专心遵行你的律例， 永不改变，遵行到底。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心专向你的律例， 永远遵行，一直到底。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end. ס Samekh
verses.textEnEsv: I incline my heart to perform your statutes forever, to the end. Samekh
verses.textEnNkjv: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes Forever, to the very end. ס Samek
verses.textEnNlt: I am determined to keep your decrees to the very end. Samekh
verses.textEnNasb: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes Forever, even to the end. Samekh
verses.textEn: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end. ס Samekh

verses.textZh: 我恨恶心怀二意的人， 我却喜爱你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我恨恶心怀二意的人， 我却喜爱你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 心怀二意的人为我所恨； 但你的律法为我所爱。
verses.textEnNiv: I hate double-minded people, but I love your law.
verses.textEnEsv: I hate the double-minded, but I love your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: I hate the double-minded, But I love Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: I hate those with divided loyalties, but I love your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: I hate those who are double-minded, But I love Your Law.
verses.textEn: I hate double-minded people, but I love your law.

verses.textZh: 你是我的避难所，我的盾牌； 我仰望你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是我的避难所，我的盾牌； 我仰望你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是我藏身之处，又是我的盾牌； 我甚仰望你的话语。
verses.textEnNiv: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.
verses.textEnEsv: You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: You are my refuge and my shield; your word is my source of hope.
verses.textEnNasb: You are my hiding place and my shield; I wait for Your word.
verses.textEn: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.

verses.textZh: 作恶的人哪！你们离开我吧， 好让我遵守我神的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作恶的人哪！你们离开我吧， 好让我遵守我神的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 作恶的人哪，你们离开我吧！ 我好遵守我神的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!
verses.textEnEsv: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Depart from me, you evildoers, For I will keep the commandments of my God!
verses.textEnNlt: Get out of my life, you evil-minded people, for I intend to obey the commands of my God.
verses.textEnNasb: Leave me, you evildoers, So that I may comply with the commandments of my God.
verses.textEn: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!

verses.textZh: 求你照着你的应许扶持我，使我存活； 不要使我因仰望你而蒙羞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你照着你的应许扶持我，使我存活； 不要使我因仰望你而蒙羞。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你照你的话扶持我，使我存活， 也不叫我因失望而害羞。
verses.textEnNiv: Sustain me, my God, according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.
verses.textEnEsv: Uphold me according to your promise, that I may live, and let me not be put to shame in my hope!
verses.textEnNkjv: Uphold me according to Your word, that I may live; And do not let me be ashamed of my hope.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , sustain me as you promised, that I may live! Do not let my hope be crushed.
verses.textEnNasb: Sustain me according to Your word, that I may live; And do not let me be ashamed of my hope.
verses.textEn: Sustain me, my God, according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.

verses.textZh: 求你扶持我，我就必得救； 我必常常重视你的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你扶持我，我就必得救； 我必常常重视你的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你扶持我，我便得救， 时常看重你的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: Hold me up, that I may be safe and have regard for your statutes continually!
verses.textEnNkjv: Hold me up, and I shall be safe, And I shall observe Your statutes continually.
verses.textEnNlt: Sustain me, and I will be rescued; then I will meditate continually on your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: Sustain me so that I may be safe, That I may have regard for Your statutes continually.
verses.textEn: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.

verses.textZh: 偏离你的律例的，你都把他们弃绝； 他们的诡诈是徒然的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 偏离你的律例的，你都把他们弃绝； 他们的诡诈是徒然的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡偏离你律例的人，你都轻弃他们， 因为他们的诡诈必归虚空。
verses.textEnNiv: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their delusions come to nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: You spurn all who go astray from your statutes, for their cunning is in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: You reject all those who stray from Your statutes, For their deceit is falsehood.
verses.textEnNlt: But you have rejected all who stray from your decrees. They are only fooling themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: You have rejected all those who stray from Your statutes, For their deceitfulness is useless.
verses.textEn: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their delusions come to nothing.

verses.textZh: 世上所有的恶人，你都把他们除灭，如同除去渣滓， 因此我喜爱你的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上所有的恶人，你都把他们除灭，如同除去渣滓， 因此我喜爱你的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡地上的恶人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓； 因此我爱你的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross, therefore I love your testimonies.
verses.textEnNkjv: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross; Therefore I love Your testimonies.
verses.textEnNlt: You skim off the wicked of the earth like scum; no wonder I love to obey your laws!
verses.textEnNasb: You have removed all the wicked of the earth like impurities; Therefore I love Your testimonies.
verses.textEn: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.

verses.textZh: 我因惧怕你而战栗； 我畏惧你的审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因惧怕你而战栗； 我畏惧你的审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因惧怕你，肉就发抖； 我也怕你的判语。
verses.textEnNiv: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws. ע Ayin
verses.textEnEsv: My flesh trembles for fear of you, and I am afraid of your judgments. Ayin
verses.textEnNkjv: My flesh trembles for fear of You, And I am afraid of Your judgments. ע Ayin
verses.textEnNlt: I tremble in fear of you; I stand in awe of your regulations. Ayin
verses.textEnNasb: My flesh trembles from the fear of You, And I am afraid of Your judgments. Ayin
verses.textEn: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws. ע Ayin

verses.textZh: 我曾秉公行义； 求你不要把我撇下，交给欺压我的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾秉公行义； 求你不要把我撇下，交给欺压我的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我行过公平和公义， 求你不要撇下我给欺压我的人！
verses.textEnNiv: I have done what is righteous and just; do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.textEnEsv: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have done justice and righteousness; Do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t leave me to the mercy of my enemies, for I have done what is just and right.
verses.textEnNasb: I have done justice and righteousness; Do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.textEn: I have done what is righteous and just; do not leave me to my oppressors.

verses.textZh: 求你作你仆人的保证人，确保我的好处； 不要容傲慢人欺压我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你作你仆人的保证人，确保我的好处； 不要容傲慢人欺压我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你为仆人作保，使我得好处， 不容骄傲人欺压我！
verses.textEnNiv: Ensure your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
verses.textEnEsv: Give your servant a pledge of good; let not the insolent oppress me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be surety for Your servant for good; Do not let the proud oppress me.
verses.textEnNlt: Please guarantee a blessing for me. Don’t let the arrogant oppress me!
verses.textEnNasb: Be a guarantor for Your servant for good; Do not let the arrogant oppress me.
verses.textEn: Ensure your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.

verses.textZh: 因盼望你的救恩和你公义的应许， 我的眼睛都昏花了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因盼望你的救恩和你公义的应许， 我的眼睛都昏花了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因盼望你的救恩 和你公义的话眼睛失明。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.
verses.textEnEsv: My eyes long for your salvation and for the fulfillment of your righteous promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eyes fail fromseeking Your salvation And Your righteous word.
verses.textEnNlt: My eyes strain to see your rescue, to see the truth of your promise fulfilled.
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes fail with longing for Your salvation, And for Your righteous word.
verses.textEn: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.

verses.textZh: 求你按着你的慈爱待你的仆人， 把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你按着你的慈爱待你的仆人， 把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你照你的慈爱待仆人， 将你的律例教训我。
verses.textEnNiv: Deal with your servant according to your love and teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: Deal with your servant according to your steadfast love, and teach me your statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deal with Your servant according to Your mercy, And teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: I am your servant; deal with me in unfailing love, and teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: Deal with Your servant according to Your graciousness, And teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEn: Deal with your servant according to your love and teach me your decrees.

verses.textZh: 我是你的仆人，求你赐我悟性， 使我可以明白你的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是你的仆人，求你赐我悟性， 使我可以明白你的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是你的仆人，求你赐我悟性， 使我得知你的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: I am your servant; give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies!
verses.textEnNkjv: I am Your servant; Give me understanding, That I may know Your testimonies.
verses.textEnNlt: Give discernment to me, your servant; then I will understand your laws.
verses.textEnNasb: I am Your servant; give me understanding, So that I may know Your testimonies.
verses.textEn: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.

verses.textZh: 现在是耶和华行动的时候； 因为人都违犯了你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在是耶和华行动的时候； 因为人都违犯了你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是耶和华降罚的时候， 因人废了你的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: It is time for you to act, Lord ; your law is being broken.
verses.textEnEsv: It is time for the Lord to act, for your law has been broken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis time for You to act, O Lord, For they have regarded Your law as void.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , it is time for you to act, for these evil people have violated your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: It is time for the Lord to act, For they have broken Your Law.
verses.textEn: It is time for you to act, Lord ; your law is being broken.

verses.textZh: 因此我爱你的命令， 胜过金子，甚至胜过精金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我爱你的命令， 胜过金子，甚至胜过精金。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我爱你的命令胜于金子， 更胜于精金。
verses.textEnNiv: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I love your commandments above gold, above fine gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I love Your commandments More than gold, yes, than fine gold!
verses.textEnNlt: Truly, I love your commands more than gold, even the finest gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I love Your commandments Above gold, yes, above pure gold.
verses.textEn: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,

verses.textZh: 在一切事上，你所有的训词我都视为正直； 我恨恶一切虚谎的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在一切事上，你所有的训词我都视为正直； 我恨恶一切虚谎的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 你一切的训词，在万事上我都以为正直； 我却恨恶一切假道。
verses.textEnNiv: and because I consider all your precepts right, I hate every wrong path. פ Pe
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I consider all your precepts to be right; I hate every false way. Pe
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore all Your precepts concerning all things I consider tobe right; I hate every false way. פ Pe
verses.textEnNlt: Each of your commandments is right. That is why I hate every false way. Pe
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I carefully follow all Your precepts concerning everything, I hate every false way. Pe
verses.textEn: and because I consider all your precepts right, I hate every wrong path. פ Pe

verses.textZh: 你的法度奇妙， 所以我必遵守你的法度，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的法度奇妙， 所以我必遵守你的法度，
verses.textZhCuv: 你的法度奇妙， 所以我一心谨守。
verses.textEnNiv: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.
verses.textEnEsv: Your testimonies are wonderful; therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your testimonies are wonderful; Therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.textEnNlt: Your laws are wonderful. No wonder I obey them!
verses.textEnNasb: Your testimonies are wonderful; Therefore my soul complies with them.
verses.textEn: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.

verses.textZh: 你的话一解开，就发出亮光， 使愚人有悟性。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的话一解开，就发出亮光， 使愚人有悟性。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的言语一解开就发出亮光， 使愚人通达。
verses.textEnNiv: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.
verses.textEnEsv: The unfolding of your words gives light; it imparts understanding to the simple.
verses.textEnNkjv: The entrance of Your words gives light; It gives understanding to the simple.
verses.textEnNlt: The teaching of your word gives light, so even the simple can understand.
verses.textEnNasb: The unfolding of Your words gives light; It gives understanding to the simple.
verses.textEn: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

verses.textZh: 我张口喘气， 因为我切慕你的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我张口喘气， 因为我切慕你的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 我张口而气喘， 因我切慕你的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: I open my mouth and pant, longing for your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: I open my mouth and pant, because I long for your commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: I opened my mouth and panted, For I longed for Your commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: I pant with expectation, longing for your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: I opened my mouth wide and panted, For I longed for Your commandments.
verses.textEn: I open my mouth and pant, longing for your commands.

verses.textZh: 求你转向我，恩待我； 像你素常对待那些爱你名的人那样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你转向我，恩待我； 像你素常对待那些爱你名的人那样。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你转向我，怜悯我， 好像你素常待那些爱你名的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn to me and be gracious to me, as is your way with those who love your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look upon me and be merciful to me, As Your custom is toward those who love Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: Come and show me your mercy, as you do for all who love your name.
verses.textEnNasb: Turn to me and be gracious to me, As is right for those who love Your name.
verses.textEn: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

verses.textZh: 求你用你的话引导我的脚步， 不容甚么罪孽辖制我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你用你的话引导我的脚步， 不容甚么罪孽辖制我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你用你的话使我脚步稳当， 不许什么罪孽辖制我。
verses.textEnNiv: Direct my footsteps according to your word; let no sin rule over me.
verses.textEnEsv: Keep steady my steps according to your promise, and let no iniquity get dominion over me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Direct my steps by Your word, And let no iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.textEnNlt: Guide my steps by your word, so I will not be overcome by evil.
verses.textEnNasb: Establish my footsteps in Your word, And do not let any wrongdoing have power over me.
verses.textEn: Direct my footsteps according to your word; let no sin rule over me.

verses.textZh: 求你救赎我脱离人的欺压， 好让我谨守你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你救赎我脱离人的欺压， 好让我谨守你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你救我脱离人的欺压， 我要遵守你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: Redeem me from human oppression, that I may obey your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: Redeem me from man’s oppression, that I may keep your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Redeem me from the oppression of man, That I may keep Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: Ransom me from the oppression of evil people; then I can obey your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: Redeem me from oppression by man, So that I may keep Your precepts.
verses.textEn: Redeem me from human oppression, that I may obey your precepts.

verses.textZh: 求你用你的脸光照你的仆人， 把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你用你的脸光照你的仆人， 把你的律例教导我。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你用脸光照仆人， 又将你的律例教训我。
verses.textEnNiv: Make your face shine on your servant and teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: Make your face shine upon your servant, and teach me your statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, And teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: Look upon me with love; teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, And teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEn: Make your face shine on your servant and teach me your decrees.

verses.textZh: 我的眼泪像河水涌流， 因为人都不谨守你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼泪像河水涌流， 因为人都不谨守你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的眼泪下流成河， 因为他们不守你的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for your law is not obeyed. צ Tsadhe
verses.textEnEsv: My eyes shed streams of tears, because people do not keep your law. Tsadhe
verses.textEnNkjv: Rivers of water run down from my eyes, Because men do not keep Your law. ץ Tsadde
verses.textEnNlt: Rivers of tears gush from my eyes because people disobey your instructions. Tsadhe
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes shed streams of water, Because they do not keep Your Law. Tsadhe
verses.textEn: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for your law is not obeyed. צ Tsadhe

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你是公义的， 你的判词也是正直的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你是公义的， 你的判词也是正直的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你是公义的； 你的判语也是正直的！
verses.textEnNiv: You are righteous, Lord , and your laws are right.
verses.textEnEsv: Righteous are you, O Lord , and right are your rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: Righteous are You, O Lord, And upright are Your judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , you are righteous, and your regulations are fair.
verses.textEnNasb: You are righteous, Lord, And Your judgments are right.
verses.textEn: You are righteous, Lord , and your laws are right.

verses.textZh: 你以公义和至诚， 命定了你的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你以公义和至诚， 命定了你的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所命定的法度是凭公义和至诚。
verses.textEnNiv: The statutes you have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.
verses.textEnEsv: You have appointed your testimonies in righteousness and in all faithfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your testimonies, which You have commanded, Are righteous and very faithful.
verses.textEnNlt: Your laws are perfect and completely trustworthy.
verses.textEnNasb: You have commanded Your testimonies in righteousness And great faithfulness.
verses.textEn: The statutes you have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.

verses.textZh: 我心中迫切如同火烧， 因为我的敌人忘记了你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心中迫切如同火烧， 因为我的敌人忘记了你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心焦急，如同火烧， 因我敌人忘记你的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.
verses.textEnEsv: My zeal consumes me, because my foes forget your words.
verses.textEnNkjv: My zeal has consumed me, Because my enemies have forgotten Your words.
verses.textEnNlt: I am overwhelmed with indignation, for my enemies have disregarded your words.
verses.textEnNasb: My zeal has consumed me, Because my enemies have forgotten Your words.
verses.textEn: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.

verses.textZh: 你的话语十分精炼， 因此你的仆人喜爱你的话语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的话语十分精炼， 因此你的仆人喜爱你的话语。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的话极其精炼， 所以你的仆人喜爱。
verses.textEnNiv: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
verses.textEnEsv: Your promise is well tried, and your servant loves it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your word is very pure; Therefore Your servant loves it.
verses.textEnNlt: Your promises have been thoroughly tested; that is why I love them so much.
verses.textEnNasb: Your word is very pure, Therefore Your servant loves it.
verses.textEn: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

verses.textZh: 我虽然微小，被人藐视， 我却没有忘记你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然微小，被人藐视， 我却没有忘记你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 我微小，被人藐视， 却不忘记你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: I am small and despised, yet I do not forget your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am small and despised, Yet I do not forget Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: I am insignificant and despised, but I don’t forget your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: I am small and despised, Yet I do not forget Your precepts.
verses.textEn: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget your precepts.

verses.textZh: 你的公义是永远的公义， 你的律法是可信可靠的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的公义是永远的公义， 你的律法是可信可靠的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的公义永远长存； 你的律法尽都真实。
verses.textEnNiv: Your righteousness is everlasting and your law is true.
verses.textEnEsv: Your righteousness is righteous forever, and your law is true.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And Your law is truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Your justice is eternal, and your instructions are perfectly true.
verses.textEnNasb: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And Your Law is truth.
verses.textEn: Your righteousness is everlasting and your law is true.

verses.textZh: 我遭遇患难和困苦， 但你的命令仍是我欢喜的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我遭遇患难和困苦， 但你的命令仍是我欢喜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我遭遇患难愁苦， 你的命令却是我所喜爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands give me delight.
verses.textEnEsv: Trouble and anguish have found me out, but your commandments are my delight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Trouble and anguish have overtaken me, Yet Your commandments are my delights.
verses.textEnNlt: As pressure and stress bear down on me, I find joy in your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: Trouble and anguish have come upon me, Yet Your commandments are my delight.
verses.textEn: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands give me delight.

verses.textZh: 你的法度永远是公义的， 求你赐我悟性， 好让我存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的法度永远是公义的， 求你赐我悟性， 好让我存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的法度永远是公义的； 求你赐我悟性，我就活了。
verses.textEnNiv: Your statutes are always righteous; give me understanding that I may live. ק Qoph
verses.textEnEsv: Your testimonies are righteous forever; give me understanding that I may live. Qoph
verses.textEnNkjv: The righteousness of Your testimonies is everlasting; Give me understanding, and I shall live. ק Qoph
verses.textEnNlt: Your laws are always right; help me to understand them so I may live. Qoph
verses.textEnNasb: Your testimonies are righteous forever; Give me understanding that I may live. Qoph
verses.textEn: Your statutes are always righteous; give me understanding that I may live. ק Qoph

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我一心呼求你，求你应允我； 我必遵守你的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我一心呼求你，求你应允我； 我必遵守你的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我一心呼吁你； 求你应允我，我必谨守你的律例！
verses.textEnNiv: I call with all my heart; answer me, Lord , and I will obey your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: With my whole heart I cry; answer me, O Lord ! I will keep your statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: I cry out with my whole heart; Hear me, O Lord! I will keep Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: I pray with all my heart; answer me, Lord ! I will obey your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: I cried out with all my heart; answer me, Lord! I will comply with Your statutes.
verses.textEn: I call with all my heart; answer me, Lord , and I will obey your decrees.

verses.textZh: 我向你呼求，求你救我； 我必谨守你的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向你呼求，求你救我； 我必谨守你的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 我向你呼吁，求你救我！ 我要遵守你的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: I call out to you; save me and I will keep your statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: I call to you; save me, that I may observe your testimonies.
verses.textEnNkjv: I cry out to You; Save me, and I will keep Your testimonies.
verses.textEnNlt: I cry out to you; rescue me, that I may obey your laws.
verses.textEnNasb: I cried to You; save me And I shall keep Your testimonies.
verses.textEn: I call out to you; save me and I will keep your statutes.

verses.textZh: 天还未亮我就呼求救助， 我所仰望的就是你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天还未亮我就呼求救助， 我所仰望的就是你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我趁天未亮呼求； 我仰望了你的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word.
verses.textEnEsv: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I hope in your words.
verses.textEnNkjv: I rise before the dawning of the morning, And cry for help; I hope in Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: I rise early, before the sun is up; I cry out for help and put my hope in your words.
verses.textEnNasb: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I wait for Your words.
verses.textEn: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word.

verses.textZh: 我整夜睁开眼睛， 为要默想你的话语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我整夜睁开眼睛， 为要默想你的话语。
verses.textZhCuv: 我趁夜更未换将眼睁开， 为要思想你的话语。
verses.textEnNiv: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promises.
verses.textEnEsv: My eyes are awake before the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promise.
verses.textEnNkjv: My eyes are awake through the night watches, That I may meditate on Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: I stay awake through the night, thinking about your promise.
verses.textEnNasb: My eyes anticipate the night watches, So that I may meditate on Your word.
verses.textEn: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promises.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你照着你的慈爱垂听我的声音， 求你按着你的公正使我存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你照着你的慈爱垂听我的声音， 求你按着你的公正使我存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你照你的慈爱听我的声音； 耶和华啊，求你照你的典章将我救活！
verses.textEnNiv: Hear my voice in accordance with your love; preserve my life, Lord , according to your laws.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear my voice according to your steadfast love; O Lord , according to your justice give me life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear my voice according to Your lovingkindness; O Lord, revive me according to Your justice.
verses.textEnNlt: In your faithful love, O Lord , hear my cry; let me be revived by following your regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: Hear my voice according to Your faithfulness; Revive me, Lord, according to Your judgments.
verses.textEn: Hear my voice in accordance with your love; preserve my life, Lord , according to your laws.

verses.textZh: 追求奸恶的人临近了， 他们远离你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 追求奸恶的人临近了， 他们远离你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 追求奸恶的人临近了； 他们远离你的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from your law.
verses.textEnEsv: They draw near who persecute me with evil purpose; they are far from your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: They draw near who follow after wickedness; They are far from Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: Lawless people are coming to attack me; they live far from your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who follow after wickedness approach; They are far from Your Law.
verses.textEn: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from your law.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你和我十分接近， 你的一切命令都是可信可靠的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你和我十分接近， 你的一切命令都是可信可靠的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你与我相近； 你一切的命令尽都真实！
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you are near, Lord , and all your commands are true.
verses.textEnEsv: But you are near, O Lord , and all your commandments are true.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are near, O Lord, And all Your commandments are truth.
verses.textEnNlt: But you are near, O Lord , and all your commands are true.
verses.textEnNasb: You are near, Lord, And all Your commandments are truth.
verses.textEn: Yet you are near, Lord , and all your commands are true.

verses.textZh: 我从你的法度早已知道， 这些法度是你立定，存到永远的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从你的法度早已知道， 这些法度是你立定，存到永远的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因学你的法度， 久已知道是你永远立定的。
verses.textEnNiv: Long ago I learned from your statutes that you established them to last forever. ר Resh
verses.textEnEsv: Long have I known from your testimonies that you have founded them forever. Resh
verses.textEnNkjv: Concerning Your testimonies, I have known of old that You have founded them forever. ר Resh
verses.textEnNlt: I have known from my earliest days that your laws will last forever. Resh
verses.textEnNasb: From long ago I have known from Your testimonies That You have founded them forever. Resh
verses.textEn: Long ago I learned from your statutes that you established them to last forever. ר Resh

verses.textZh: 求你察看我的苦难，搭救我； 因为我没有忘记你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你察看我的苦难，搭救我； 因为我没有忘记你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你看顾我的苦难，搭救我， 因我不忘记你的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Look on my suffering and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.
verses.textEnEsv: Look on my affliction and deliver me, for I do not forget your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Consider my affliction and deliver me, For I do not forget Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: Look upon my suffering and rescue me, for I have not forgotten your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Look at my affliction and rescue me, For I have not forgotten Your Law.
verses.textEn: Look on my suffering and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.

verses.textZh: 求你为我的案件申辩，救赎我； 按着你的应许使我存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你为我的案件申辩，救赎我； 按着你的应许使我存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你为我辨屈，救赎我， 照你的话将我救活。
verses.textEnNiv: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to your promise.
verses.textEnEsv: Plead my cause and redeem me; give me life according to your promise!
verses.textEnNkjv: Plead my cause and redeem me; Revive me according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: Argue my case; take my side! Protect my life as you promised.
verses.textEnNasb: Plead my cause and redeem me; Revive me according to Your word.
verses.textEn: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to your promise.

verses.textZh: 救恩远离恶人， 因为他们不寻求你的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 救恩远离恶人， 因为他们不寻求你的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 救恩远离恶人， 因为他们不寻求你的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek your statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Salvation is far from the wicked, For they do not seek Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked are far from rescue, for they do not bother with your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: Salvation is far from the wicked, For they do not seek Your statutes.
verses.textEn: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的怜悯浩大； 求你照着你的公正使我存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的怜悯浩大； 求你照着你的公正使我存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的慈悲本为大； 求你照你的典章将我救活。
verses.textEnNiv: Your compassion, Lord , is great; preserve my life according to your laws.
verses.textEnEsv: Great is your mercy, O Lord ; give me life according to your rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: Great are Your tender mercies, O Lord; Revive me according to Your judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , how great is your mercy; let me be revived by following your regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: Great are Your mercies, Lord; Revive me according to Your judgments.
verses.textEn: Your compassion, Lord , is great; preserve my life according to your laws.

verses.textZh: 逼迫我的和敌挡我的很多， 但我没有偏离你的法度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 逼迫我的和敌挡我的很多， 但我没有偏离你的法度。
verses.textZhCuv: 逼迫我的，抵挡我的，很多， 我却没有偏离你的法度。
verses.textEnNiv: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from your statutes.
verses.textEnEsv: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries, but I do not swerve from your testimonies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Many are my persecutors and my enemies, Yet I do not turn from Your testimonies.
verses.textEnNlt: Many persecute and trouble me, yet I have not swerved from your laws.
verses.textEnNasb: Many are my persecutors and my enemies, Yet I do not turn aside from Your testimonies.
verses.textEn: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from your statutes.

verses.textZh: 我看见诡诈的人就讨厌， 因为他们不遵守你的话语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见诡诈的人就讨厌， 因为他们不遵守你的话语。
verses.textZhCuv: 我看见奸恶的人就甚憎恶， 因为他们不遵守你的话。
verses.textEnNiv: I look on the faithless with loathing, for they do not obey your word.
verses.textEnEsv: I look at the faithless with disgust, because they do not keep your commands.
verses.textEnNkjv: I see the treacherous, and am disgusted, Because they do not keep Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: Seeing these traitors makes me sick at heart, because they care nothing for your word.
verses.textEnNasb: I see the treacherous and loathe them, Because they do not keep Your word.
verses.textEn: I look on the faithless with loathing, for they do not obey your word.

verses.textZh: 你看我多么爱你的训词； 耶和华啊！求你按着你的慈爱使我存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看我多么爱你的训词； 耶和华啊！求你按着你的慈爱使我存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 你看我怎样爱你的训词！ 耶和华啊，求你照你的慈爱将我救活！
verses.textEnNiv: See how I love your precepts; preserve my life, Lord , in accordance with your love.
verses.textEnEsv: Consider how I love your precepts! Give me life, O Lord , according to your steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Consider how I love Your precepts; Revive me, O Lord, according to Your lovingkindness.
verses.textEnNlt: See how I love your commandments, Lord . Give back my life because of your unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: Consider how I love Your precepts; Revive me, Lord, according to Your faithfulness.
verses.textEn: See how I love your precepts; preserve my life, Lord , in accordance with your love.

verses.textZh: 你的话的总纲就是真理， 你一切公义的典章要存到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的话的总纲就是真理， 你一切公义的典章要存到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 你话的总纲是真实； 你一切公义的典章是永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: All your words are true; all your righteous laws are eternal. ש Sin and Shin
verses.textEnEsv: The sum of your word is truth, and every one of your righteous rules endures forever. Sin and Shin
verses.textEnNkjv: The entirety of Your word is truth, And every one of Your righteous judgments endures forever. שׁ Shin
verses.textEnNlt: The very essence of your words is truth; all your just regulations will stand forever. Shin
verses.textEnNasb: The sum of Your word is truth, And every one of Your righteous judgments is everlasting. Shin
verses.textEn: All your words are true; all your righteous laws are eternal. ש Sin and Shin

verses.textZh: 领袖们无缘无故迫害我， 我的心却畏惧你的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 领袖们无缘无故迫害我， 我的心却畏惧你的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 首领无故地逼迫我， 但我的心畏惧你的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at your word.
verses.textEnEsv: Princes persecute me without cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Princes persecute me without a cause, But my heart stands in awe of Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: Powerful people harass me without cause, but my heart trembles only at your word.
verses.textEnNasb: Rulers persecute me without cause, But my heart stands in awe of Your words.
verses.textEn: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at your word.

verses.textZh: 我因你的话语欢喜， 像得了许多战利品的人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因你的话语欢喜， 像得了许多战利品的人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我喜爱你的话， 好像人得了许多掳物。
verses.textEnNiv: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds great spoil.
verses.textEnEsv: I rejoice at your word like one who finds great spoil.
verses.textEnNkjv: I rejoice at Your word As one who finds great treasure.
verses.textEnNlt: I rejoice in your word like one who discovers a great treasure.
verses.textEnNasb: I rejoice at Your word, Like one who finds great plunder.
verses.textEn: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds great spoil.

verses.textZh: 虚伪是我憎恨厌恶的， 你的律法却是我所爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虚伪是我憎恨厌恶的， 你的律法却是我所爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 谎话是我所恨恶所憎嫌的； 惟你的律法是我所爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: I hate and detest falsehood but I love your law.
verses.textEnEsv: I hate and abhor falsehood, but I love your law.
verses.textEnNkjv: I hate and abhor lying, But I love Your law.
verses.textEnNlt: I hate and abhor all falsehood, but I love your instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: I hate and loathe falsehood, But I love Your Law.
verses.textEn: I hate and detest falsehood but I love your law.

verses.textZh: 我因你公义的典章， 一天七次赞美你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我因你公义的典章， 一天七次赞美你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因你公义的典章一天七次赞美你。
verses.textEnNiv: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seven times a day I praise You, Because of Your righteous judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: I will praise you seven times a day because all your regulations are just.
verses.textEnNasb: Seven times a day I praise You Because of Your righteous judgments.
verses.textEn: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.

verses.textZh: 喜爱你律法的必有丰盛的平安， 甚么都不能绊倒他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 喜爱你律法的必有丰盛的平安， 甚么都不能绊倒他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱你律法的人有大平安， 什么都不能使他们绊脚。
verses.textEnNiv: Great peace have those who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.
verses.textEnEsv: Great peace have those who love your law; nothing can make them stumble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Great peace have those who love Your law, And nothing causes them to stumble.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who love your instructions have great peace and do not stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who love Your Law have great peace, And nothing causes them to stumble.
verses.textEn: Great peace have those who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我要等候你的救恩， 我要遵行你的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我要等候你的救恩， 我要遵行你的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我仰望了你的救恩， 遵行了你的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: I wait for your salvation, Lord , and I follow your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: I hope for your salvation, O Lord , and I do your commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, I hope for Your salvation, And I do Your commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: I long for your rescue, Lord , so I have obeyed your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: I hope for Your salvation, Lord, And do Your commandments.
verses.textEn: I wait for your salvation, Lord , and I follow your commands.

verses.textZh: 我的心谨守你的法度， 这些法度是我热爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心谨守你的法度， 这些法度是我热爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心里守了你的法度； 这法度我甚喜爱。
verses.textEnNiv: I obey your statutes, for I love them greatly.
verses.textEnEsv: My soul keeps your testimonies; I love them exceedingly.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul keeps Your testimonies, And I love them exceedingly.
verses.textEnNlt: I have obeyed your laws, for I love them very much.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul keeps Your testimonies, And I love them exceedingly.
verses.textEn: I obey your statutes, for I love them greatly.

verses.textZh: 我谨守你的训词和法度， 因我所行的一切都在你面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我谨守你的训词和法度， 因我所行的一切都在你面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 我遵守了你的训词和法度， 因我一切所行的都在你面前。
verses.textEnNiv: I obey your precepts and your statutes, for all my ways are known to you. ת Taw
verses.textEnEsv: I keep your precepts and testimonies, for all my ways are before you. Taw
verses.textEnNkjv: I keep Your precepts and Your testimonies, For all my ways are before You. ת Tau
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I obey your commandments and laws because you know everything I do. Taw
verses.textEnNasb: I keep Your precepts and Your testimonies, For all my ways are before You. Tav
verses.textEn: I obey your precepts and your statutes, for all my ways are known to you. ת Taw

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！愿我的呼求达到你面前； 求你照着你的话赐我悟性。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！愿我的呼求达到你面前； 求你照着你的话赐我悟性。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，愿我的呼吁达到你面前， 照你的话赐我悟性。
verses.textEnNiv: May my cry come before you, Lord ; give me understanding according to your word.
verses.textEnEsv: Let my cry come before you, O Lord ; give me understanding according to your word!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let my cry come before You, O Lord; Give me understanding according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , listen to my cry; give me the discerning mind you promised.
verses.textEnNasb: Let my cry come before You, Lord; Give me understanding according to Your word.
verses.textEn: May my cry come before you, Lord ; give me understanding according to your word.

verses.textZh: 愿我的恳求达到你面前； 求你照着你的应许拯救我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我的恳求达到你面前； 求你照着你的应许拯救我。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我的恳求达到你面前， 照你的话搭救我。
verses.textEnNiv: May my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.
verses.textEnEsv: Let my plea come before you; deliver me according to your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let my supplication come before You; Deliver me according to Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to my prayer; rescue me as you promised.
verses.textEnNasb: Let my pleading come before You; Save me according to Your word.
verses.textEn: May my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.

verses.textZh: 愿我的嘴唇涌出赞美的话， 因为你把你的律例教导了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我的嘴唇涌出赞美的话， 因为你把你的律例教导了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我的嘴发出赞美的话， 因为你将律例教训我。
verses.textEnNiv: May my lips overflow with praise, for you teach me your decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: My lips will pour forth praise, for you teach me your statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: My lips shall utter praise, For You teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: Let praise flow from my lips, for you have taught me your decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: Let my lips pour out praise, For You teach me Your statutes.
verses.textEn: May my lips overflow with praise, for you teach me your decrees.

verses.textZh: 愿我的舌头歌唱你的话语， 因为你的一切命令都是公义的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我的舌头歌唱你的话语， 因为你的一切命令都是公义的。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我的舌头歌唱你的话， 因你一切的命令尽都公义。
verses.textEnNiv: May my tongue sing of your word, for all your commands are righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: My tongue will sing of your word, for all your commandments are right.
verses.textEnNkjv: My tongue shall speak of Your word, For all Your commandments are righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Let my tongue sing about your word, for all your commands are right.
verses.textEnNasb: Let my tongue sing about Your word, For all Your commandments are righteousness.
verses.textEn: May my tongue sing of your word, for all your commands are righteous.

verses.textZh: 愿你的手帮助我， 因为我选择了你的训词。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你的手帮助我， 因为我选择了你的训词。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你用手帮助我， 因我拣选了你的训词。
verses.textEnNiv: May your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Your hand become my help, For I have chosen Your precepts.
verses.textEnNlt: Give me a helping hand, for I have chosen to follow your commandments.
verses.textEnNasb: Let Your hand be ready to help me, For I have chosen Your precepts.
verses.textEn: May your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我渴慕你的救恩， 我喜欢你的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我渴慕你的救恩， 我喜欢你的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我切慕你的救恩！ 你的律法也是我所喜爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: I long for your salvation, Lord , and your law gives me delight.
verses.textEnEsv: I long for your salvation, O Lord , and your law is my delight.
verses.textEnNkjv: I long for Your salvation, O Lord, And Your law is my delight.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , I have longed for your rescue, and your instructions are my delight.
verses.textEnNasb: I long for Your salvation, Lord, And Your Law is my delight.
verses.textEn: I long for your salvation, Lord , and your law gives me delight.

verses.textZh: 求你容我活着，可以赞美你； 愿你的典章帮助我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你容我活着，可以赞美你； 愿你的典章帮助我。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿我的性命存活，得以赞美你！ 愿你的典章帮助我！
verses.textEnNiv: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.
verses.textEnEsv: Let my soul live and praise you, and let your rules help me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let my soul live, and it shall praise You; And let Your judgments help me.
verses.textEnNlt: Let me live so I can praise you, and may your regulations help me.
verses.textEnNasb: Let my soul live that it may praise You, And let Your ordinances help me.
verses.textEn: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.

verses.textZh: 我像亡羊走迷了路； 求你寻找你的仆人， 因为我没有忘记你的命令。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我像亡羊走迷了路； 求你寻找你的仆人， 因为我没有忘记你的命令。
verses.textZhCuv: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你寻找仆人， 因我不忘记你的命令。
verses.textEnNiv: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commands.
verses.textEnEsv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek your servant, for I do not forget your commandments.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; Seek Your servant, For I do not forget Your commandments.
verses.textEnNlt: I have wandered away like a lost sheep; come and find me, for I have not forgotten your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: I have wandered about like a lost sheep; search for Your servant, For I do not forget Your commandments.
verses.textEn: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commands.

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 我在急难中呼求耶和华， 他就应允我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 我在急难中呼求耶和华， 他就应允我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在急难中求告耶和华， 他就应允我。
verses.textEnNiv: I call on the Lord in my distress, and he answers me.
verses.textEnEsv: In my distress I called to the Lord , and he answered me.
verses.textEnNkjv: In my distress I cried to the Lord, And He heard me.
verses.textEnNlt: I took my troubles to the Lord ; I cried out to him, and he answered my prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: I cried to the Lord in my trouble, And He answered me.
verses.textEn: I call on the Lord in my distress, and he answers me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你救我脱离说谎的嘴唇， 救我脱离诡诈的舌头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你救我脱离说谎的嘴唇， 救我脱离诡诈的舌头。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离说谎的嘴唇和诡诈的舌头！
verses.textEnNiv: Save me, Lord , from lying lips and from deceitful tongues.
verses.textEnEsv: Deliver me, O Lord , from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips And from a deceitful tongue.
verses.textEnNlt: Rescue me, O Lord , from liars and from all deceitful people.
verses.textEnNasb: Rescue my soul, Lord, from lying lips, From a deceitful tongue.
verses.textEn: Save me, Lord , from lying lips and from deceitful tongues.

verses.textZh: 诡诈的舌头啊！他要给你甚么呢？ 他要加给你甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 诡诈的舌头啊！他要给你甚么呢？ 他要加给你甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 诡诈的舌头啊，要给你什么呢？ 要拿什么加给你呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What will he do to you, and what more besides, you deceitful tongue?
verses.textEnEsv: What shall be given to you, and what more shall be done to you, you deceitful tongue?
verses.textEnNkjv: What shall be given to you, Or what shall be done to you, You false tongue?
verses.textEnNlt: O deceptive tongue, what will God do to you? How will he increase your punishment?
verses.textEnNasb: What will He give to you, and what more will He do to you, You deceitful tongue?
verses.textEn: What will he do to you, and what more besides, you deceitful tongue?

verses.textZh: 就是勇士的利箭， 和罗腾木烧的炭火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是勇士的利箭， 和罗腾木烧的炭火。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是勇士的利箭和罗腾木 的炭火。
verses.textEnNiv: He will punish you with a warrior’s sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom bush.
verses.textEnEsv: A warrior’s sharp arrows, with glowing coals of the broom tree!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sharp arrows of the warrior, With coals of the broom tree!
verses.textEnNlt: You will be pierced with sharp arrows and burned with glowing coals.
verses.textEnNasb: Sharp arrows of the warrior, With the burning coals of the broom tree!
verses.textEn: He will punish you with a warrior’s sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom bush.

verses.textZh: 我寄居在米设， 住在基达的帐棚中，有祸了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我寄居在米设， 住在基达的帐棚中，有祸了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我寄居在米设， 住在基达帐棚之中，有祸了！
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshek, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to me, that I sojourn in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe is me, that I dwell in Meshech, That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
verses.textEnNlt: How I suffer in far-off Meshech. It pains me to live in distant Kedar.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to me, for I reside in Meshech, For I have settled among the tents of Kedar!
verses.textEn: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshek, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

verses.textZh: 我和恨恶和平的人， 同住得太久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我和恨恶和平的人， 同住得太久。
verses.textZhCuv: 我与那恨恶和睦的人许久同住。
verses.textEnNiv: Too long have I lived among those who hate peace.
verses.textEnEsv: Too long have I had my dwelling among those who hate peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul has dwelt too long With one who hates peace.
verses.textEnNlt: I am tired of living among people who hate peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Too long has my soul had its dwelling With those who hate peace.
verses.textEn: Too long have I lived among those who hate peace.

verses.textZh: 我希望有和平， 但我一说话，他们就要争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我希望有和平， 但我一说话，他们就要争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 我愿和睦， 但我发言，他们就要争战。
verses.textEnNiv: I am for peace; but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.textEnEsv: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war!
verses.textEnNkjv: I amfor peace; But when I speak, they are for war.
verses.textEnNlt: I search for peace; but when I speak of peace, they want war!
verses.textEnNasb: I am for peace, but when I speak, They are for war.
verses.textEn: I am for peace; but when I speak, they are for war.

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 我要向群山举目， 我的帮助从哪里来呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 我要向群山举目， 我的帮助从哪里来呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我要向山举目； 我的帮助从何而来？
verses.textEnNiv: I lift up my eyes to the mountains— where does my help come from?
verses.textEnEsv: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
verses.textEnNkjv: I will lift up my eyes to the hills— From whence comes my help?
verses.textEnNlt: I look up to the mountains— does my help come from there?
verses.textEnNasb: I will raise my eyes to the mountains; From where will my help come?
verses.textEn: I lift up my eyes to the mountains— where does my help come from?

verses.textZh: 我的帮助是从 造天地的耶和华而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的帮助是从 造天地的耶和华而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的帮助 从造天地的耶和华而来。
verses.textEnNiv: My help comes from the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.textEnEsv: My help comes from the Lord , who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: My help comes from the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNlt: My help comes from the Lord , who made heaven and earth!
verses.textEnNasb: My help comes from the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEn: My help comes from the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.

verses.textZh: 他必不使你的脚滑倒； 保护你的必不打盹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必不使你的脚滑倒； 保护你的必不打盹。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必不叫你的脚摇动； 保护你的必不打盹！
verses.textEnNiv: He will not let your foot slip— he who watches over you will not slumber;
verses.textEnEsv: He will not let your foot be moved; he who keeps you will not slumber.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will not allow your foot to be moved; He who keeps you will not slumber.
verses.textEnNlt: He will not let you stumble; the one who watches over you will not slumber.
verses.textEnNasb: He will not allow your foot to slip; He who watches over you will not slumber.
verses.textEn: He will not let your foot slip— he who watches over you will not slumber;

verses.textZh: 看哪！保护以色列的， 必不打盹，也不睡觉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！保护以色列的， 必不打盹，也不睡觉。
verses.textZhCuv: 保护以色列的， 也不打盹也不睡觉。
verses.textEnNiv: indeed, he who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, He who keeps Israel Shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.textEnNlt: Indeed, he who watches over Israel never slumbers or sleeps.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, He who watches over Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.textEn: indeed, he who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.textZh: 保护你的是耶和华， 耶和华在你的右边荫庇你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保护你的是耶和华， 耶和华在你的右边荫庇你。
verses.textZhCuv: 保护你的是耶和华； 耶和华在你右边荫庇你。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord watches over you— the Lord is your shade at your right hand;
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is your keeper; the Lord is your shade on your right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis your keeper; The Lordis your shade at your right hand.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord himself watches over you! The Lord stands beside you as your protective shade.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is your protector; The Lord is your shade on your right hand.
verses.textEn: The Lord watches over you— the Lord is your shade at your right hand;

verses.textZh: 白天太阳必不伤你， 夜里月亮必不害你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 白天太阳必不伤你， 夜里月亮必不害你。
verses.textZhCuv: 白日，太阳必不伤你； 夜间，月亮必不害你。
verses.textEnNiv: the sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.textEnEsv: The sun shall not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sun shall not strike you by day, Nor the moon by night.
verses.textEnNlt: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon at night.
verses.textEnNasb: The sun will not beat down on you by day, Nor the moon by night.
verses.textEn: the sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.textZh: 耶和华要保护你脱离一切灾祸， 他要保护你的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华要保护你脱离一切灾祸， 他要保护你的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华要保护你，免受一切的灾害； 他要保护你的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will keep you from all harm— he will watch over your life;
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will keep you from all evil; he will keep your life.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord shall preserve you from all evil; He shall preserve your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord keeps you from all harm and watches over your life.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will protect you from all evil; He will keep your soul.
verses.textEn: The Lord will keep you from all harm— he will watch over your life;

verses.textZh: 你出你入，耶和华要保护你， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你出你入，耶和华要保护你， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 你出你入，耶和华要保护你， 从今时直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will keep your going out and your coming in from this time forth and forevermore.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord shall preserve your going out and your coming in From this time forth, and even forevermore.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord keeps watch over you as you come and go, both now and forever.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will guard your going out and your coming in From this time and forever.
verses.textEn: the Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

verses.textZh: 大卫朝圣之歌 。 人对我说："我们到耶和华的殿那里去"， 我就欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫朝圣之歌 。 人对我说："我们到耶和华的殿那里去"， 我就欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 人对我说：我们往耶和华的殿去， 我就欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: I rejoiced with those who said to me, "Let us go to the house of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go to the house of the Lord !"
verses.textEnNkjv: I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go into the house of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: I was glad when they said to me, "Let us go to the house of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: I was glad when they said to me, "Let’s go to the house of the Lord."
verses.textEn: I rejoiced with those who said to me, "Let us go to the house of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊！ 我们的脚正站在你的门内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊！ 我们的脚正站在你的门内。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊， 我们的脚站在你的门内。
verses.textEnNiv: Our feet are standing in your gates, Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Our feet have been standing within your gates, O Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNkjv: Our feet have been standing Within your gates, O Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNlt: And now here we are, standing inside your gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Our feet are standing Within your gates, Jerusalem,
verses.textEn: Our feet are standing in your gates, Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷被建造， 好象一座结构完整的城巿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷被建造， 好象一座结构完整的城巿。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷被建造， 如同连络整齐的一座城。
verses.textEnNiv: Jerusalem is built like a city that is closely compacted together.
verses.textEnEsv: Jerusalem— built as a city that is bound firmly together,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jerusalem is built As a city that is compact together,
verses.textEnNlt: Jerusalem is a well-built city; its seamless walls cannot be breached.
verses.textEnNasb: Jerusalem, that has been built As a city that is firmly joined together;
verses.textEn: Jerusalem is built like a city that is closely compacted together.

verses.textZh: 众支派，就是耶和华的支派， 都上那里去； 照着以色列的定例， 称颂耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众支派，就是耶和华的支派， 都上那里去； 照着以色列的定例， 称颂耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 众支派，就是耶和华的支派，上那里去， 按以色列的常例 称赞耶和华的名。
verses.textEnNiv: That is where the tribes go up— the tribes of the Lord — to praise the name of the Lord according to the statute given to Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: to which the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord , as was decreed for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Where the tribes go up, The tribes of the Lord, To the Testimony of Israel, To give thanks to the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: All the tribes of Israel—the Lord ’s people— make their pilgrimage here. They come to give thanks to the name of the Lord , as the law requires of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: To which the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord— An ordinance for Israel— To give thanks to the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: That is where the tribes go up— the tribes of the Lord — to praise the name of the Lord according to the statute given to Israel.

verses.textZh: 因为在那里设有审判的宝座， 就是大卫家的宝座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在那里设有审判的宝座， 就是大卫家的宝座。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为在那里设立审判的宝座， 就是大卫家的宝座。
verses.textEnNiv: There stand the thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.textEnEsv: There thrones for judgment were set, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thrones are set there for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.
verses.textEnNlt: Here stand the thrones where judgment is given, the thrones of the dynasty of David.
verses.textEnNasb: For thrones were set there for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.
verses.textEn: There stand the thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.textZh: 你们要为耶路撒冷求平安，说： "耶路撒冷啊！愿爱你的人都亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要为耶路撒冷求平安，说： "耶路撒冷啊！愿爱你的人都亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要为耶路撒冷求平安！ 耶路撒冷啊，爱你的人必然兴旺！
verses.textEnNiv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May those who love you be secure.
verses.textEnEsv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem! "May they be secure who love you!
verses.textEnNkjv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May they prosper who love you.
verses.textEnNlt: Pray for peace in Jerusalem. May all who love this city prosper.
verses.textEnNasb: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May they prosper who love you.
verses.textEn: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May those who love you be secure.

verses.textZh: 愿你的城墙内有平安， 愿你的宫殿中有安稳。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你的城墙内有平安， 愿你的宫殿中有安稳。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你城中平安！ 愿你宫内兴旺！
verses.textEnNiv: May there be peace within your walls and security within your citadels."
verses.textEnEsv: Peace be within your walls and security within your towers!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Peace be within your walls, Prosperity within your palaces."
verses.textEnNlt: O Jerusalem, may there be peace within your walls and prosperity in your palaces.
verses.textEnNasb: "May peace be within your walls, And prosperity within your palaces."
verses.textEn: May there be peace within your walls and security within your citadels."

verses.textZh: 为了我的兄弟和朋友的缘故， 我要说："愿你中间有平安。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了我的兄弟和朋友的缘故， 我要说："愿你中间有平安。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因我弟兄和同伴的缘故，我要说： 愿平安在你中间！
verses.textEnNiv: For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, "Peace be within you."
verses.textEnEsv: For my brothers and companions’ sake I will say, "Peace be within you!"
verses.textEnNkjv: For the sake of my brethren and companions, I will now say, "Peace be within you."
verses.textEnNlt: For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, "May you have peace."
verses.textEnNasb: For the sake of my brothers and my friends, I will now say, "May peace be within you."
verses.textEn: For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, "Peace be within you."

verses.textZh: 为了耶和华我们神的殿的缘故， 我要为你求福乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了耶和华我们神的殿的缘故， 我要为你求福乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华－我们神殿的缘故， 我要为你求福！
verses.textEnNiv: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek your prosperity.
verses.textEnEsv: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek your good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek your good.
verses.textEnNlt: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek what is best for you, O Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek your good.
verses.textEn: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek your prosperity.

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 坐在天上的主啊！ 我向你举目。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 坐在天上的主啊！ 我向你举目。
verses.textZhCuv: 坐在天上的主啊， 我向你举目。
verses.textEnNiv: I lift up my eyes to you, to you who sit enthroned in heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: To you I lift up my eyes, O you who are enthroned in the heavens!
verses.textEnNkjv: Unto You I lift up my eyes, O You who dwell in the heavens.
verses.textEnNlt: I lift my eyes to you, O God, enthroned in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: To You I have raised my eyes, You who are enthroned in the heavens!
verses.textEn: I lift up my eyes to you, to you who sit enthroned in heaven.

verses.textZh: 仆人的眼睛怎样望着主人的手， 婢女的眼睛怎样望着主母的手， 我们的眼睛也照样望着耶和华我们的神， 直到他向我们施恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 仆人的眼睛怎样望着主人的手， 婢女的眼睛怎样望着主母的手， 我们的眼睛也照样望着耶和华我们的神， 直到他向我们施恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，仆人的眼睛怎样望主人的手， 使女的眼睛怎样望主母的手， 我们的眼睛也照样望耶和华－我们的神， 直到他怜悯我们。
verses.textEnNiv: As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female slave look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the Lord our God, till he shows us his mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the Lord our God, till he has mercy upon us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, As the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, So our eyes look to the Lord our God, Until He has mercy on us.
verses.textEnNlt: We keep looking to the Lord our God for his mercy, just as servants keep their eyes on their master, as a slave girl watches her mistress for the slightest signal.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, As the eyes of a female servant to the hand of her mistress, So our eyes look to the Lord our God, Until He is gracious to us.
verses.textEn: As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female slave look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the Lord our God, till he shows us his mercy.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你向我们施恩，求你向我们施恩； 因为我们饱受藐视，到了极点。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你向我们施恩，求你向我们施恩； 因为我们饱受藐视，到了极点。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你怜悯我们，怜悯我们！ 因为我们被藐视，已到极处。
verses.textEnNiv: Have mercy on us, Lord , have mercy on us, for we have endured no end of contempt.
verses.textEnEsv: Have mercy upon us, O Lord , have mercy upon us, for we have had more than enough of contempt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us! For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.textEnNlt: Have mercy on us, Lord , have mercy, for we have had our fill of contempt.
verses.textEnNasb: Be gracious to us, Lord, be gracious to us, For we have had much more than enough of contempt.
verses.textEn: Have mercy on us, Lord , have mercy on us, for we have endured no end of contempt.

verses.textZh: 我们饱受那些安逸的人的嘲笑， 和骄傲的人的藐视，到了极点。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们饱受那些安逸的人的嘲笑， 和骄傲的人的藐视，到了极点。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们被那些安逸人的讥诮 和骄傲人的藐视，已到极处。
verses.textEnNiv: We have endured no end of ridicule from the arrogant, of contempt from the proud.
verses.textEnEsv: Our soul has had more than enough of the scorn of those who are at ease, of the contempt of the proud.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scorn of those who are at ease, With the contempt of the proud.
verses.textEnNlt: We have had more than our fill of the scoffing of the proud and the contempt of the arrogant.
verses.textEnNasb: Our soul has had much more than enough Of the scoffing of those who are at ease, And of the contempt of the proud.
verses.textEn: We have endured no end of ridicule from the arrogant, of contempt from the proud.

verses.textZh: 大卫朝圣之歌 。 愿以色列人说： 如果不是耶和华帮助我们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫朝圣之歌 。 愿以色列人说： 如果不是耶和华帮助我们，
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人要说： 若不是耶和华帮助我们，
verses.textEnNiv: If the Lord had not been on our side— let Israel say—
verses.textEnEsv: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side— let Israel now say—
verses.textEnNkjv: "If it had not been the Lord who was on our side," Let Israel now say—
verses.textEnNlt: What if the Lord had not been on our side? Let all Israel repeat:
verses.textEnNasb: "Had it not been the Lord who was on our side," Let Israel say,
verses.textEn: If the Lord had not been on our side— let Israel say—

verses.textZh: 如果不是耶和华帮助我们； 那么，人起来攻击我们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果不是耶和华帮助我们； 那么，人起来攻击我们，
verses.textZhCuv: 若不是耶和华帮助我们， 当人起来攻击我们、
verses.textEnNiv: if the Lord had not been on our side when people attacked us,
verses.textEnEsv: if it had not been the Lord who was on our side when people rose up against us,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, When men rose up against us,
verses.textEnNlt: What if the Lord had not been on our side when people attacked us?
verses.textEnNasb: "Had it not been the Lord who was on our side When people rose up against us,
verses.textEn: if the Lord had not been on our side when people attacked us,

verses.textZh: 向我们发怒的时候， 就把我们活活吞下去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 向我们发怒的时候， 就把我们活活吞下去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 向我们发怒的时候， 就把我们活活地吞了。
verses.textEnNiv: they would have swallowed us alive when their anger flared against us;
verses.textEnEsv: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their anger was kindled against us;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they would have swallowed us alive, When their wrath was kindled against us;
verses.textEnNlt: They would have swallowed us alive in their burning anger.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they would have swallowed us alive, When their anger was kindled against us;
verses.textEn: they would have swallowed us alive when their anger flared against us;

verses.textZh: 那时，洪水漫过我们， 急流淹没我们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，洪水漫过我们， 急流淹没我们；
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，波涛必漫过我们， 河水必淹没我们，
verses.textEnNiv: the flood would have engulfed us, the torrent would have swept over us,
verses.textEnEsv: then the flood would have swept us away, the torrent would have gone over us;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the waters would have overwhelmed us, The stream would have gone over our soul;
verses.textEnNlt: The waters would have engulfed us; a torrent would have overwhelmed us.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the waters would have flooded over us, The stream would have swept over our souls;
verses.textEn: the flood would have engulfed us, the torrent would have swept over us,

verses.textZh: 汹涌的洪水把我们淹没。
verses.textZhCnvs: 汹涌的洪水把我们淹没。
verses.textZhCuv: 狂傲的水必淹没我们。
verses.textEnNiv: the raging waters would have swept us away.
verses.textEnEsv: then over us would have gone the raging waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the swollen waters Would have gone over our soul."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the raging waters of their fury would have overwhelmed our very lives.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the raging waters would have swept over our souls."
verses.textEn: the raging waters would have swept us away.

verses.textZh: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 他没有容让敌人把我们当作猎物撕裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华是应当称颂的， 他没有容让敌人把我们当作猎物撕裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是应当称颂的！ 他没有把我们当野食交给他们吞吃 。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord , who has not let us be torn by their teeth.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord , who has not given us as prey to their teeth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord, Who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , who did not let their teeth tear us apart!
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord, Who has not given us to be torn by their teeth.
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord , who has not let us be torn by their teeth.

verses.textZh: 我们像雀鸟从捕鸟的人的网罗里逃脱； 网罗破裂，我们就逃脱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们像雀鸟从捕鸟的人的网罗里逃脱； 网罗破裂，我们就逃脱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们好像雀鸟，从捕鸟人的网罗里逃脱； 网罗破裂，我们逃脱了。
verses.textEnNiv: We have escaped like a bird from the fowler’s snare; the snare has been broken, and we have escaped.
verses.textEnEsv: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowlers; the snare is broken, and we have escaped!
verses.textEnNkjv: Our soul has escaped as a bird from the snare of the fowlers; The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
verses.textEnNlt: We escaped like a bird from a hunter’s trap. The trap is broken, and we are free!
verses.textEnNasb: Our souls have escaped like a bird from the trapper’s snare; The snare is broken and we have escaped.
verses.textEn: We have escaped like a bird from the fowler’s snare; the snare has been broken, and we have escaped.

verses.textZh: 我们的帮助在于耶和华的名， 他是造天地的主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的帮助在于耶和华的名， 他是造天地的主。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们得帮助， 是在乎倚靠造天地之耶和华的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Our help is in the name of the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Our help is in the name of the Lord , who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Our help is in the name of the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Our help is from the Lord , who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Our help is in the name of the Lord, Who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEn: Our help is in the name of the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 倚靠耶和华的人好象锡安山， 总不动摇，永远屹立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 倚靠耶和华的人好象锡安山， 总不动摇，永远屹立。
verses.textZhCuv: 倚靠耶和华的人 好像锡安山，永不动摇。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abides forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who trust in the Lord Are like Mount Zion, Which cannot be moved, but abides forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who trust in the Lord are as secure as Mount Zion; they will not be defeated but will endure forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who trust in the Lord Are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved but remains forever.
verses.textEn: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

verses.textZh: 群山怎样围绕着耶路撒冷， 耶和华也照样围绕着他的子民， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群山怎样围绕着耶路撒冷， 耶和华也照样围绕着他的子民， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 众山怎样围绕耶路撒冷， 耶和华也照样围绕他的百姓， 从今时直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people both now and forevermore.
verses.textEnEsv: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people, from this time forth and forevermore.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, So the Lord surrounds His people From this time forth and forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people, both now and forever.
verses.textEnNasb: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, So the Lord surrounds His people From this time and forever.
verses.textEn: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people both now and forevermore.

verses.textZh: 恶人的杖不会常留在义人的地业上， 免得义人伸手作恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人的杖不会常留在义人的地业上， 免得义人伸手作恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人的杖不常落在义人的分上， 免得义人伸手作恶。
verses.textEnNiv: The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land allotted to the righteous, for then the righteous might use their hands to do evil.
verses.textEnEsv: For the scepter of wickedness shall not rest on the land allotted to the righteous, lest the righteous stretch out their hands to do wrong.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the scepter of wickedness shall not rest On the land allotted to the righteous, Lest the righteous reach out their hands to iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: The wicked will not rule the land of the godly, for then the godly might be tempted to do wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: For the scepter of wickedness will not rest upon the land of the righteous, So that the righteous will not extend their hands to do wrong.
verses.textEn: The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land allotted to the righteous, for then the righteous might use their hands to do evil.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你善待那些良善， 和心里正直的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你善待那些良善， 和心里正直的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你善待那些为善 和心里正直的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , do good to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Do good, O Lord , to those who are good, and to those who are upright in their hearts!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do good, O Lord, to thosewhoare good, And to thosewhoare upright in their hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , do good to those who are good, whose hearts are in tune with you.
verses.textEnNasb: Do good, Lord, to those who are good And to those who are upright in their hearts.
verses.textEn: Lord , do good to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.

verses.textZh: 至于那些偏行弯曲道路的人， 耶和华必把他们和作恶的人一同除去。 愿平安归于以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那些偏行弯曲道路的人， 耶和华必把他们和作恶的人一同除去。 愿平安归于以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于那偏行弯曲道路的人， 耶和华必使他和作恶的人一同出去受刑。 愿平安归于以色列！
verses.textEnNiv: But those who turn to crooked ways the Lord will banish with the evildoers. Peace be on Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But those who turn aside to their crooked ways the Lord will lead away with evildoers! Peace be upon Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: As for such as turn aside to their crooked ways, The Lord shall lead them away With the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel!
verses.textEnNlt: But banish those who turn to crooked ways, O Lord . Take them away with those who do evil. May Israel have peace!
verses.textEnNasb: But as for those who turn aside to their crooked ways, The Lord will lead them away with those who practice injustice. Peace be upon Israel.
verses.textEn: But those who turn to crooked ways the Lord will banish with the evildoers. Peace be on Israel.

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 耶和华使被掳的人归回锡安的时候， 我们好象在作梦的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 耶和华使被掳的人归回锡安的时候， 我们好象在作梦的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华将那些被掳的带回锡安的时候， 我们好像做梦的人。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dreamed.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dream.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Lord brought back the captivity of Zion, We were like those who dream.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord brought back his exiles to Jerusalem, it was like a dream!
verses.textEnNasb: When the Lord brought back the captives of Zion, We were like those who dream.
verses.textEn: When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dreamed.

verses.textZh: 那时，我们满口喜笑， 满舌欢呼； 那时列国中有人说： "耶和华为他们行了大事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我们满口喜笑， 满舌欢呼； 那时列国中有人说： "耶和华为他们行了大事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们满口喜笑、 满舌欢呼的时候， 外邦中就有人说： 耶和华为他们行了大事！
verses.textEnNiv: Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, "The Lord has done great things for them."
verses.textEnEsv: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with shouts of joy; then they said among the nations, "The Lord has done great things for them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, "The Lord has done great things for them."
verses.textEnNlt: We were filled with laughter, and we sang for joy. And the other nations said, "What amazing things the Lord has done for them."
verses.textEnNasb: Then our mouth was filled with laughter And our tongue with joyful shouting; Then they said among the nations, "The Lord has done great things for them."
verses.textEn: Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, "The Lord has done great things for them."

verses.textZh: 耶和华为我们行了大事， 我们就欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华为我们行了大事， 我们就欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华果然为我们行了大事， 我们就欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has done great things for us; we are glad.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has done great things for us, And we are glad.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the Lord has done amazing things for us! What joy!
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has done great things for us; We are joyful.
verses.textEn: The Lord has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，求你使我们被掳的人归回， 像南地的河水复流一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，求你使我们被掳的人归回， 像南地的河水复流一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你使我们被掳的人归回， 好像南地的河水复流。
verses.textEnNiv: Restore our fortunes, Lord , like streams in the Negev.
verses.textEnEsv: Restore our fortunes, O Lord , like streams in the Negeb!
verses.textEnNkjv: Bring back our captivity, O Lord, As the streams in the South.
verses.textEnNlt: Restore our fortunes, Lord , as streams renew the desert.
