verses.textEnNasb: Restore our fortunes, Lord, As the streams in the South.
verses.textEn: Restore our fortunes, Lord , like streams in the Negev.

verses.textZh: 那些流泪撒种的， 必欢呼收割。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些流泪撒种的， 必欢呼收割。
verses.textZhCuv: 流泪撒种的， 必欢呼收割！
verses.textEnNiv: Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who sow in tears shall reap with shouts of joy!
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who sow in tears Shall reap in joy.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who plant in tears will harvest with shouts of joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who sow in tears shall harvest with joyful shouting.
verses.textEn: Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.

verses.textZh: 那带着种子流着泪出去撒种的， 必带着禾捆欢呼快乐地回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那带着种子流着泪出去撒种的， 必带着禾捆欢呼快乐地回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那带种流泪出去的， 必要欢欢乐乐地带禾捆回来！
verses.textEnNiv: Those who go out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with them.
verses.textEnEsv: He who goes out weeping, bearing the seed for sowing, shall come home with shouts of joy, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who continually goes forth weeping, Bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, Bringing his sheaves withhim.
verses.textEnNlt: They weep as they go to plant their seed, but they sing as they return with the harvest.
verses.textEnNasb: One who goes here and there weeping, carrying his bag of seed, Shall indeed come again with a shout of joy, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.textEn: Those who go out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with them.

verses.textZh: 所罗门朝圣之歌 。 如果不是耶和华建造房屋， 建造的人就徒然劳苦； 如果不是耶和华看守城池， 看守的人就徒然警醒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门朝圣之歌 。 如果不是耶和华建造房屋， 建造的人就徒然劳苦； 如果不是耶和华看守城池， 看守的人就徒然警醒。
verses.textZhCuv: 若不是耶和华建造房屋， 建造的人就枉然劳力； 若不是耶和华看守城池， 看守的人就枉然警醒。
verses.textEnNiv: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain. Unless the Lord watches over the city, the guards stand watch in vain.
verses.textEnEsv: Unless the Lord builds the house, those who build it labor in vain. Unless the Lord watches over the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Unless the Lord builds the house, They labor in vain who build it; Unless the Lord guards the city, The watchman stays awake in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: Unless the Lord builds a house, the work of the builders is wasted. Unless the Lord protects a city, guarding it with sentries will do no good.
verses.textEnNasb: Unless the Lord builds a house, They who build it labor in vain; Unless the Lord guards a city, The watchman stays awake in vain.
verses.textEn: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain. Unless the Lord watches over the city, the guards stand watch in vain.

verses.textZh: 你们清早起来，很晚才歇息， 吃劳碌得来的饭，都是徒然； 因为主必使他所爱的安睡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们清早起来，很晚才歇息， 吃劳碌得来的饭，都是徒然； 因为主必使他所爱的安睡。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们清晨早起，夜晚安歇， 吃劳碌得来的饭，本是枉然； 惟有耶和华所亲爱的，必叫他安然睡觉。
verses.textEnNiv: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat— for he grants sleep to those he loves.
verses.textEnEsv: It is in vain that you rise up early and go late to rest, eating the bread of anxious toil; for he gives to his beloved sleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis vain for you to rise up early, To sit up late, To eat the bread of sorrows; For so He gives His beloved sleep.
verses.textEnNlt: It is useless for you to work so hard from early morning until late at night, anxiously working for food to eat; for God gives rest to his loved ones.
verses.textEnNasb: It is futile for you to rise up early, To stay up late, To eat the bread of painful labor; This is how He gives to His beloved sleep.
verses.textEn: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat— for he grants sleep to those he loves.

verses.textZh: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业， 腹中的胎儿是他的赏赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业， 腹中的胎儿是他的赏赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业； 所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: Children are a heritage from the Lord , offspring a reward from him.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, children are a heritage from the Lord , the fruit of the womb a reward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, children are a heritage from the Lord, The fruit of the womb is a reward.
verses.textEnNlt: Children are a gift from the Lord ; they are a reward from him.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, children are a gift of the Lord, The fruit of the womb is a reward.
verses.textEn: Children are a heritage from the Lord , offspring a reward from him.

verses.textZh: 年轻时所生的儿女， 好象勇士手中的箭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 年轻时所生的儿女， 好象勇士手中的箭。
verses.textZhCuv: 少年时所生的儿女 好像勇士手中的箭。
verses.textEnNiv: Like arrows in the hands of a warrior are children born in one’s youth.
verses.textEnEsv: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the children of one’s youth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, So are the children of one’s youth.
verses.textEnNlt: Children born to a young man are like arrows in a warrior’s hands.
verses.textEnNasb: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, So are the children of one’s youth.
verses.textEn: Like arrows in the hands of a warrior are children born in one’s youth.

verses.textZh: 箭袋装满了箭的人是有福的， 他们在城门口和仇敌说话的时候， 必不至于羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 箭袋装满了箭的人是有福的， 他们在城门口和仇敌说话的时候， 必不至于羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 箭袋充满的人便为有福； 他们在城门口和仇敌说话的时候， 必不至于羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their opponents in court.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is the man who fills his quiver with them! He shall not be put to shame when he speaks with his enemies in the gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them; They shall not be ashamed, But shall speak with their enemies in the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: How joyful is the man whose quiver is full of them! He will not be put to shame when he confronts his accusers at the city gates.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them; They will not be ashamed When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
verses.textEn: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their opponents in court.

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 敬畏耶和华，遵行他的道的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 敬畏耶和华，遵行他的道的人，是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡敬畏耶和华、 遵行他道的人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are all who fear the Lord , who walk in obedience to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord , who walks in his ways!
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is every one who fears the Lord, Who walks in His ways.
verses.textEnNlt: How joyful are those who fear the Lord — all who follow his ways!
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord, Who walks in His ways.
verses.textEn: Blessed are all who fear the Lord , who walk in obedience to him.

verses.textZh: 你必吃你亲手劳碌得来的， 你必享福，事事顺利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必吃你亲手劳碌得来的， 你必享福，事事顺利。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要吃劳碌得来的； 你要享福，事情顺利。
verses.textEnNiv: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat the fruit of the labor of your hands; you shall be blessed, and it shall be well with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you eat the labor of your hands, You shallbe happy, and itshallbe well with you.
verses.textEnNlt: You will enjoy the fruit of your labor. How joyful and prosperous you will be!
verses.textEnNasb: When you eat the fruit of the labor of your hands, You will be happy and it will go well for you.
verses.textEn: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.

verses.textZh: 你的妻子在你的内室， 好象多结果子的葡萄树； 你的儿女环绕着你的桌子， 好象橄榄树的枝条。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的妻子在你的内室， 好象多结果子的葡萄树； 你的儿女环绕着你的桌子， 好象橄榄树的枝条。
verses.textZhCuv: 你妻子在你的内室，好像多结果子的葡萄树； 你儿女围绕你的桌子，好像橄榄栽子。
verses.textEnNiv: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
verses.textEnEsv: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your wife shallbe like a fruitful vine In the very heart of your house, Your children like olive plants All around your table.
verses.textEnNlt: Your wife will be like a fruitful grapevine, flourishing within your home. Your children will be like vigorous young olive trees as they sit around your table.
verses.textEnNasb: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine Within your house, Your children like olive plants Around your table.
verses.textEn: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.

verses.textZh: 看哪！敬畏耶和华的人 必这样蒙福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！敬畏耶和华的人 必这样蒙福。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，敬畏耶和华的人必要这样蒙福！
verses.textEnNiv: Yes, this will be the blessing for the man who fears the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed who fears the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed Who fears the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: That is the Lord ’s blessing for those who fear him.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, for so shall a man Who fears the Lord be blessed.
verses.textEn: Yes, this will be the blessing for the man who fears the Lord .

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华从锡安赐福给你； 愿你一生一世得见耶路撒冷的繁荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华从锡安赐福给你； 愿你一生一世得见耶路撒冷的繁荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华从锡安赐福给你！ 愿你一生一世看见耶路撒冷的好处！
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord bless you from Zion; may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord bless you from Zion! May you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life!
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord bless you out of Zion, And may you see the good of Jerusalem All the days of your life.
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord continually bless you from Zion. May you see Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord bless you from Zion, And may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.textEn: May the Lord bless you from Zion; may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

verses.textZh: 愿你得见你儿女的儿女。 愿平安归于以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你得见你儿女的儿女。 愿平安归于以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你看见你儿女的儿女！ 愿平安归于以色列！
verses.textEnNiv: May you live to see your children’s children— peace be on Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: May you see your children’s children! Peace be upon Israel!
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
verses.textEnNlt: May you live to enjoy your grandchildren. May Israel have peace!
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
verses.textEn: May you live to see your children’s children— peace be on Israel.

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 愿以色列说： "从我幼年以来，敌人就多次苦害我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 愿以色列说： "从我幼年以来，敌人就多次苦害我。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列当说：从我幼年以来， 敌人屡次苦害我，
verses.textEnNiv: "They have greatly oppressed me from my youth," let Israel say;
verses.textEnEsv: "Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth"— let Israel now say—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Many a time they have afflicted me from my youth," Let Israel now say—
verses.textEnNlt: From my earliest youth my enemies have persecuted me. Let all Israel repeat this:
verses.textEnNasb: " Many times they have attacked me from my youth up," Let Israel say,
verses.textEn: "They have greatly oppressed me from my youth," let Israel say;

verses.textZh: 从我幼年以来，敌人虽然多次苦害我， 却没有胜过我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从我幼年以来，敌人虽然多次苦害我， 却没有胜过我。
verses.textZhCuv: 从我幼年以来，敌人屡次苦害我， 却没有胜了我。
verses.textEnNiv: "they have greatly oppressed me from my youth, but they have not gained the victory over me.
verses.textEnEsv: "Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Many a time they have afflicted me from my youth; Yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.textEnNlt: From my earliest youth my enemies have persecuted me, but they have never defeated me.
verses.textEnNasb: " Many times they have attacked me from my youth up; Yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.textEn: "they have greatly oppressed me from my youth, but they have not gained the victory over me.

verses.textZh: 他们好象犁田的人犁在我的背上， 所犁的沟甚长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们好象犁田的人犁在我的背上， 所犁的沟甚长。
verses.textZhCuv: 如同扶犁的在我背上扶犁而耕， 耕的犁沟甚长。
verses.textEnNiv: Plowmen have plowed my back and made their furrows long.
verses.textEnEsv: The plowers plowed upon my back; they made long their furrows."
verses.textEnNkjv: The plowers plowed on my back; They made their furrows long."
verses.textEnNlt: My back is covered with cuts, as if a farmer had plowed long furrows.
verses.textEnNasb: "The plowers plowed upon my back; They lengthened their furrows."
verses.textEn: Plowmen have plowed my back and made their furrows long.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华是公义的， 他砍断了恶人的绳索。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华是公义的， 他砍断了恶人的绳索。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华是公义的； 他砍断了恶人的绳索。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord is righteous; he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is righteous; he has cut the cords of the wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis righteous; He has cut in pieces the cords of the wicked.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord is good; he has cut me free from the ropes of the ungodly.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is righteous; He has cut up the ropes of the wicked.
verses.textEn: But the Lord is righteous; he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked."

verses.textZh: 愿所有恨恶锡安的， 都蒙羞退后。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿所有恨恶锡安的， 都蒙羞退后。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恨恶锡安的都蒙羞退后！
verses.textEnNiv: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
verses.textEnEsv: May all who hate Zion be put to shame and turned backward!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all those who hate Zion Be put to shame and turned back.
verses.textEnNlt: May all who hate Jerusalem be turned back in shameful defeat.
verses.textEnNasb: May all who hate Zion Be put to shame and turned backward;
verses.textEn: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.

verses.textZh: 愿他们像屋顶上的草， 尚未长大，就枯干了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们像屋顶上的草， 尚未长大，就枯干了；
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们像房顶上的草， 未长成而枯干，
verses.textEnNiv: May they be like grass on the roof, which withers before it can grow;
verses.textEnEsv: Let them be like the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, Which withers before it grows up,
verses.textEnNlt: May they be as useless as grass on a rooftop, turning yellow when only half grown,
verses.textEnNasb: May they be like grass upon the housetops, Which withers before it grows up;
verses.textEn: May they be like grass on the roof, which withers before it can grow;

verses.textZh: 收割的不够一把， 捆禾的不够满怀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 收割的不够一把， 捆禾的不够满怀。
verses.textZhCuv: 收割的不够一把， 捆禾的也不满怀。
verses.textEnNiv: a reaper cannot fill his hands with it, nor one who gathers fill his arms.
verses.textEnEsv: with which the reaper does not fill his hand nor the binder of sheaves his arms,
verses.textEnNkjv: With which the reaper does not fill his hand, Nor he who binds sheaves, his arms.
verses.textEnNlt: ignored by the harvester, despised by the binder.
verses.textEnNasb: With which the harvester does not fill his hand, Or the binder of sheaves his arms;
verses.textEn: a reaper cannot fill his hands with it, nor one who gathers fill his arms.

verses.textZh: 过路的人也不说： "愿耶和华所赐的福临到你们； 我们奉耶和华的名祝福你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 过路的人也不说： "愿耶和华所赐的福临到你们； 我们奉耶和华的名祝福你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 过路的也不说： 愿耶和华所赐的福归与你们！ 我们奉耶和华的名给你们祝福！
verses.textEnNiv: May those who pass by not say to them, "The blessing of the Lord be on you; we bless you in the name of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: nor do those who pass by say, "The blessing of the Lord be upon you! We bless you in the name of the Lord !"
verses.textEnNkjv: Neither let those who pass by them say, "The blessing of the Lordbe upon you; We bless you in the name of the Lord!"
verses.textEnNlt: And may those who pass by refuse to give them this blessing: "The Lord bless you; we bless you in the Lord ’s name."
verses.textEnNasb: Nor do those who pass by say, "The blessing of the Lord be upon you; We bless you in the name of the Lord."
verses.textEn: May those who pass by not say to them, "The blessing of the Lord be on you; we bless you in the name of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 耶和华啊！我从深处向你呼求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 耶和华啊！我从深处向你呼求。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我从深处向你求告！
verses.textEnNiv: Out of the depths I cry to you, Lord ;
verses.textEnEsv: Out of the depths I cry to you, O Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Out of the depths I have cried to You, O Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: From the depths of despair, O Lord , I call for your help.
verses.textEnNasb: Out of the depths I have cried to You, Lord.
verses.textEn: Out of the depths I cry to you, Lord ;

verses.textZh: 主啊！求你听我的声音， 求你留心听我恳求的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！求你听我的声音， 求你留心听我恳求的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，求你听我的声音！ 愿你侧耳听我恳求的声音！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord, hear my voice! Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my pleas for mercy!
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, hear my voice! Let Your ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.
verses.textEnNlt: Hear my cry, O Lord. Pay attention to my prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, hear my voice! Let Your ears be attentive To the sound of my pleadings.
verses.textEn: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！如果你究察罪孽， 主啊！谁能站立得住呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！如果你究察罪孽， 主啊！谁能站立得住呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 主－耶和华啊，你若究察罪孽， 谁能站得住呢？
verses.textEnNiv: If you, Lord , kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
verses.textEnEsv: If you, O Lord , should mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
verses.textEnNkjv: If You, Lord, should mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , if you kept a record of our sins, who, O Lord, could ever survive?
verses.textEnNasb: If You, Lord, were to keep account of guilty deeds, Lord, who could stand?
verses.textEn: If you, Lord , kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

verses.textZh: 但你有赦免之恩， 为要使人敬畏你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但你有赦免之恩， 为要使人敬畏你。
verses.textZhCuv: 但在你有赦免之恩， 要叫人敬畏你。
verses.textEnNiv: But with you there is forgiveness, so that we can, with reverence, serve you.
verses.textEnEsv: But with you there is forgiveness, that you may be feared.
verses.textEnNkjv: But thereis forgiveness with You, That You may be feared.
verses.textEnNlt: But you offer forgiveness, that we might learn to fear you.
verses.textEnNasb: But there is forgiveness with You, So that You may be revered.
verses.textEn: But with you there is forgiveness, so that we can, with reverence, serve you.

verses.textZh: 我等候耶和华，我的心等候他， 我仰望他的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我等候耶和华，我的心等候他， 我仰望他的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我等候耶和华，我的心等候； 我也仰望他的话。
verses.textEnNiv: I wait for the Lord , my whole being waits, and in his word I put my hope.
verses.textEnEsv: I wait for the Lord , my soul waits, and in his word I hope;
verses.textEnNkjv: I wait for the Lord, my soul waits, And in His word I do hope.
verses.textEnNlt: I am counting on the Lord ; yes, I am counting on him. I have put my hope in his word.
verses.textEnNasb: I wait for the Lord, my soul waits, And I wait for His word.
verses.textEn: I wait for the Lord , my whole being waits, and in his word I put my hope.

verses.textZh: 我的心等候主， 比守夜的等候天亮还迫切， 比守夜的等候天亮还迫切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心等候主， 比守夜的等候天亮还迫切， 比守夜的等候天亮还迫切。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心等候主， 胜于守夜的，等候天亮， 胜于守夜的，等候天亮。
verses.textEnNiv: I wait for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen wait for the morning.
verses.textEnEsv: my soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: My soul waits for the Lord More than those who watch for the morning— Yes, more than those who watch for the morning.
verses.textEnNlt: I long for the Lord more than sentries long for the dawn, yes, more than sentries long for the dawn.
verses.textEnNasb: My soul waits in hope for the Lord More than the watchmen for the morning; Yes, more than the watchmen for the morning.
verses.textEn: I wait for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen wait for the morning.

verses.textZh: 以色列啊！你要仰望耶和华， 因为耶和华有慈爱， 也有丰盛的救恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊！你要仰望耶和华， 因为耶和华有慈爱， 也有丰盛的救恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华！ 因他有慈爱，有丰盛的救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel, put your hope in the Lord , for with the Lord is unfailing love and with him is full redemption.
verses.textEnEsv: O Israel, hope in the Lord ! For with the Lord there is steadfast love, and with him is plentiful redemption.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Israel, hope in the Lord; For with the Lordthereis mercy, And with Him is abundant redemption.
verses.textEnNlt: O Israel, hope in the Lord ; for with the Lord there is unfailing love. His redemption overflows.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel, wait for the Lord; For with the Lord there is mercy, And with Him is abundant redemption.
verses.textEn: Israel, put your hope in the Lord , for with the Lord is unfailing love and with him is full redemption.

verses.textZh: 他必救赎以色列， 脱离一切罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必救赎以色列， 脱离一切罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必救赎以色列脱离一切的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: He himself will redeem Israel from all their sins.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He shall redeem Israel From all his iniquities.
verses.textEnNlt: He himself will redeem Israel from every kind of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will redeem Israel From all his guilty deeds.
verses.textEn: He himself will redeem Israel from all their sins.

verses.textZh: 大卫朝圣之歌 。 耶和华啊！我的心不骄傲， 我的眼不自高； 重大和超过我能力的事，我都不敢作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫朝圣之歌 。 耶和华啊！我的心不骄傲， 我的眼不自高； 重大和超过我能力的事，我都不敢作。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我的心不狂傲， 我的眼不高大； 重大和测不透的事， 我也不敢行。
verses.textEnNiv: My heart is not proud, Lord , my eyes are not haughty; I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , my heart is not lifted up; my eyes are not raised too high; I do not occupy myself with things too great and too marvelous for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, my heart is not haughty, Nor my eyes lofty. Neither do I concern myself with great matters, Nor with things too profound for me.
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , my heart is not proud; my eyes are not haughty. I don’t concern myself with matters too great or too awesome for me to grasp.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, my heart is not proud, nor my eyes arrogant; Nor do I involve myself in great matters, Or in things too difficult for me.
verses.textEn: My heart is not proud, Lord , my eyes are not haughty; I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.

verses.textZh: 我的心平静安稳， 像断过奶的孩子躺在他母亲的怀中， 我的心在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的心平静安稳， 像断过奶的孩子躺在他母亲的怀中， 我的心在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的心平稳安静， 好像断过奶的孩子在他母亲的怀中； 我的心在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。
verses.textEnNiv: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child I am content.
verses.textEnEsv: But I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely I have calmed and quieted my soul, Like a weaned child with his mother; Like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, I have calmed and quieted myself, like a weaned child who no longer cries for its mother’s milk. Yes, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verses.textEnNasb: I have certainly soothed and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child resting against his mother, My soul within me is like a weaned child.
verses.textEn: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child I am content.

verses.textZh: 以色列啊！你要仰望耶和华， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊！你要仰望耶和华， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华， 从今时直到永远！
verses.textEnNiv: Israel, put your hope in the Lord both now and forevermore.
verses.textEnEsv: O Israel, hope in the Lord from this time forth and forevermore.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Israel, hope in the Lord From this time forth and forever.
verses.textEnNlt: O Israel, put your hope in the Lord — now and always.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel, wait for the Lord From this time on and forever.
verses.textEn: Israel, put your hope in the Lord both now and forevermore.

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 耶和华啊！求你记念大卫， 记念他的一切苦难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 耶和华啊！求你记念大卫， 记念他的一切苦难。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你记念大卫所受的一切苦难！
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , remember David and all his self-denial.
verses.textEnEsv: Remember, O Lord , in David’s favor, all the hardships he endured,
verses.textEnNkjv: Lord, remember David And all his afflictions;
verses.textEnNlt: Lord , remember David and all that he suffered.
verses.textEnNasb: Remember, Lord, in David’s behalf, All his affliction;
verses.textEn: Lord , remember David and all his self-denial.

verses.textZh: 他怎样向耶和华起誓， 向雅各的大能者许愿，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他怎样向耶和华起誓， 向雅各的大能者许愿，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 他怎样向耶和华起誓， 向雅各的大能者许愿，
verses.textEnNiv: He swore an oath to the Lord , he made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.textEnEsv: how he swore to the Lord and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob,
verses.textEnNkjv: How he swore to the Lord, And vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
verses.textEnNlt: He made a solemn promise to the Lord . He vowed to the Mighty One of Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: How he swore to the Lord And vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob,
verses.textEn: He swore an oath to the Lord , he made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

verses.textZh: "我必不进我的家 ， 也必不上我的床榻。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必不进我的家 ， 也必不上我的床榻。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：我必不进我的帐幕， 也不上我的床榻；
verses.textEnNiv: "I will not enter my house or go to my bed,
verses.textEnEsv: "I will not enter my house or get into my bed,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Surely I will not go into the chamber of my house, Or go up to the comfort of my bed;
verses.textEnNlt: "I will not go home; I will not let myself rest.
verses.textEnNasb: "I certainly will not enter my house, Nor lie on my bed;
verses.textEn: "I will not enter my house or go to my bed,

verses.textZh: 我必不容我的眼睛睡觉， 也不容我的眼睑打盹；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必不容我的眼睛睡觉， 也不容我的眼睑打盹；
verses.textZhCuv: 我不容我的眼睛睡觉， 也不容我的眼目打盹；
verses.textEnNiv: I will allow no sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.textEnEsv: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will not give sleep to my eyes Or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.textEnNlt: I will not let my eyes sleep nor close my eyelids in slumber
verses.textEnNasb: I will not give sleep to my eyes Or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.textEn: I will allow no sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,

verses.textZh: 直到我为耶和华找着一个地方， 为雅各的大能者找到居所。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到我为耶和华找着一个地方， 为雅各的大能者找到居所。"
verses.textZhCuv: 直等我为耶和华寻得所在， 为雅各的大能者寻得居所。
verses.textEnNiv: till I find a place for the Lord , a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.textEnEsv: until I find a place for the Lord , a dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.textEnNkjv: Until I find a place for the Lord, A dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.textEnNlt: until I find a place to build a house for the Lord , a sanctuary for the Mighty One of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: Until I find a place for the Lord, A dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob."
verses.textEn: till I find a place for the Lord , a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

verses.textZh: 我们听说约柜在以法他； 我们在雅珥的田间找到它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们听说约柜在以法他； 我们在雅珥的田间找到它。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们听说约柜在以法他， 我们在基列‧耶琳就寻见了。
verses.textEnNiv: We heard it in Ephrathah, we came upon it in the fields of Jaar:
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah; We found it in the fields of the woods.
verses.textEnNlt: We heard that the Ark was in Ephrathah; then we found it in the distant countryside of Jaar.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, we heard about it in Ephrathah, We found it in the field of Jaar.
verses.textEn: We heard it in Ephrathah, we came upon it in the fields of Jaar:

verses.textZh: "我们要进入他的居所， 在他的脚凳前下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们要进入他的居所， 在他的脚凳前下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要进他的居所， 在他脚凳前下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: "Let us go to his dwelling place, let us worship at his footstool, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: "Let us go to his dwelling place; let us worship at his footstool!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us go into His tabernacle; Let us worship at His footstool.
verses.textEnNlt: Let us go to the sanctuary of the Lord ; let us worship at the footstool of his throne.
verses.textEnNasb: Let’s go into His dwelling place; Let’s worship at His footstool.
verses.textEn: "Let us go to his dwelling place, let us worship at his footstool, saying,

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，求你起来， 求你和你有能力的约柜同入安息的居所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，求你起来， 求你和你有能力的约柜同入安息的居所。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你兴起， 和你有能力的约柜同入安息之所！
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Arise, Lord , and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, O Lord , and go to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, O Lord, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Arise, O Lord , and enter your resting place, along with the Ark, the symbol of your power.
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, Lord, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
verses.textEn: ‘Arise, Lord , and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.

verses.textZh: 愿你的祭司都披上公义， 愿你的圣民都欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你的祭司都披上公义， 愿你的圣民都欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你的祭司披上公义！ 愿你的圣民欢呼！
verses.textEnNiv: May your priests be clothed with your righteousness; may your faithful people sing for joy.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness, and let your saints shout for joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Your priests be clothed with righteousness, And let Your saints shout for joy.
verses.textEnNlt: May your priests be clothed in godliness; may your loyal servants sing for joy.
verses.textEnNasb: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, And may Your godly ones sing for joy.
verses.textEn: May your priests be clothed with your righteousness; may your faithful people sing for joy.’ "

verses.textZh: 求你因你仆人大卫的缘故， 不要转脸不理你的受膏者。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你因你仆人大卫的缘故， 不要转脸不理你的受膏者。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你因你仆人大卫的缘故， 不要厌弃你的受膏者！
verses.textEnNiv: For the sake of your servant David, do not reject your anointed one.
verses.textEnEsv: For the sake of your servant David, do not turn away the face of your anointed one.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Your servant David’s sake, Do not turn away the face of Your Anointed.
verses.textEnNlt: For the sake of your servant David, do not reject the king you have anointed.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sake of Your servant David, Do not turn away the face of Your anointed.
verses.textEn: For the sake of your servant David, do not reject your anointed one.

verses.textZh: 耶和华实实在在向大卫起了誓， 他必不会收回，他说： "我要从你的后裔中， 立一位坐在你的王位上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华实实在在向大卫起了誓， 他必不会收回，他说： "我要从你的后裔中， 立一位坐在你的王位上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向大卫、凭诚实起了誓， 必不反复，说： 我要使你所生的 坐在你的宝座上。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord swore an oath to David, a sure oath he will not revoke: "One of your own descendants I will place on your throne.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord swore to David a sure oath from which he will not turn back: "One of the sons of your body I will set on your throne.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has sworn in truth to David; He will not turn from it: "I will set upon your throne the fruit of your body.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord swore an oath to David with a promise he will never take back: "I will place one of your descendants on your throne.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has sworn to David A truth from which He will not turn back: "I will set upon your throne one from the fruit of your body.
verses.textEn: The Lord swore an oath to David, a sure oath he will not revoke: "One of your own descendants I will place on your throne.

verses.textZh: 如果你的子孙谨守我的约， 和我教训他们的法度， 他们的子孙也必永远坐在你的王位上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你的子孙谨守我的约， 和我教训他们的法度， 他们的子孙也必永远坐在你的王位上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的众子若守我的约 和我所教训他们的法度， 他们的子孙必永远坐在你的宝座上。
verses.textEnNiv: If your sons keep my covenant and the statutes I teach them, then their sons will sit on your throne for ever and ever."
verses.textEnEsv: If your sons keep my covenant and my testimonies that I shall teach them, their sons also forever shall sit on your throne."
verses.textEnNkjv: If your sons will keep My covenant And My testimony which I shall teach them, Their sons also shall sit upon your throne forevermore."
verses.textEnNlt: If your descendants obey the terms of my covenant and the laws that I teach them, then your royal line will continue forever and ever."
verses.textEnNasb: "If your sons will keep My covenant And My testimony which I will teach them, Their sons also will sit upon your throne forever."
verses.textEn: If your sons keep my covenant and the statutes I teach them, then their sons will sit on your throne for ever and ever."

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华拣选了锡安， 定意把它当作自己的居所。他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华拣选了锡安， 定意把它当作自己的居所。他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华拣选了锡安， 愿意当作自己的居所，
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord has chosen Zion, he has desired it for his dwelling, saying,
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord has chosen Zion; he has desired it for his dwelling place:
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His dwelling place:
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord has chosen Jerusalem ; he has desired it for his home.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord has chosen Zion; He has desired it as His dwelling place.
verses.textEn: For the Lord has chosen Zion, he has desired it for his dwelling, saying,

verses.textZh: "这是我永远安息的居所； 我要住在这里，因为我定意这样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这是我永远安息的居所； 我要住在这里，因为我定意这样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：这是我永远安息之所； 我要住在这里， 因为是我所愿意的。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is my resting place for ever and ever; here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it.
verses.textEnEsv: "This is my resting place forever; here I will dwell, for I have desired it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is My resting place forever; Here I will dwell, for I have desired it.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is my resting place forever," he said. "I will live here, for this is the home I desired.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is My resting place forever; Here I will dwell, for I have desired it.
verses.textEn: "This is my resting place for ever and ever; here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it.

verses.textZh: 我要赐给锡安丰盛的粮食， 我要使城中的穷人饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要赐给锡安丰盛的粮食， 我要使城中的穷人饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使其中的粮食丰满， 使其中的穷人饱足。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor I will satisfy with food.
verses.textEnEsv: I will abundantly bless her provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bless this city and make it prosperous; I will satisfy its poor with food.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will abundantly bless her food; I will satisfy her needy with bread.
verses.textEn: I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor I will satisfy with food.

verses.textZh: 我要使祭司都披上救恩， 使圣民都大大欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使祭司都披上救恩， 使圣民都大大欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使祭司披上救恩， 圣民大声欢呼！
verses.textEnNiv: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her faithful people will ever sing for joy.
verses.textEnEsv: Her priests I will clothe with salvation, and her saints will shout for joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also clothe her priests with salvation, And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.textEnNlt: I will clothe its priests with godliness; its faithful servants will sing for joy.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also clothe her priests with salvation, And her godly ones will sing aloud for joy.
verses.textEn: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her faithful people will ever sing for joy.

verses.textZh: 我要在那里使大卫的角长起来， 我要为我的受膏者安排明灯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在那里使大卫的角长起来， 我要为我的受膏者安排明灯。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要叫大卫的角在那里发生； 我为我的受膏者预备明灯。
verses.textEnNiv: "Here I will make a horn grow for David and set up a lamp for my anointed one.
verses.textEnEsv: There I will make a horn to sprout for David; I have prepared a lamp for my anointed.
verses.textEnNkjv: There I will make the horn of David grow; I will prepare a lamp for My Anointed.
verses.textEnNlt: Here I will increase the power of David; my anointed one will be a light for my people.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will make the horn of David spring forth there; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.
verses.textEn: "Here I will make a horn grow for David and set up a lamp for my anointed one.

verses.textZh: 我要使他的仇敌都披上羞辱， 但他的冠冕必在他头上发光。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使他的仇敌都披上羞辱， 但他的冠冕必在他头上发光。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使他的仇敌披上羞耻； 但他的冠冕要在头上发光。
verses.textEnNiv: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but his head will be adorned with a radiant crown."
verses.textEnEsv: His enemies I will clothe with shame, but on him his crown will shine."
verses.textEnNkjv: His enemies I will clothe with shame, But upon Himself His crown shall flourish."
verses.textEnNlt: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but he will be a glorious king."
verses.textEnNasb: "I will clothe his enemies with shame, But upon himself his crown will gleam."
verses.textEn: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but his head will be adorned with a radiant crown."

verses.textZh: 大卫朝圣之歌 。 看哪！弟兄和睦共处， 是多么的善，多么的美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫朝圣之歌 。 看哪！弟兄和睦共处， 是多么的善，多么的美。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，弟兄和睦同居 是何等地善，何等地美！
verses.textEnNiv: How good and pleasant it is when God’s people live together in unity!
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell in unity!
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant itis For brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.textEnNlt: How wonderful and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brothers to live together in unity!
verses.textEn: How good and pleasant it is when God’s people live together in unity!

verses.textZh: 这好比那珍贵的油浇在亚伦的头上， 流到胡须， 又从亚伦的胡须， 流到他的衣领上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这好比那珍贵的油浇在亚伦的头上， 流到胡须， 又从亚伦的胡须， 流到他的衣领上。
verses.textZhCuv: 这好比那贵重的油浇在亚伦的头上， 流到胡须，又流到他的衣襟；
verses.textEnNiv: It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard, running down on Aaron’s beard, down on the collar of his robe.
verses.textEnEsv: It is like the precious oil on the head, running down on the beard, on the beard of Aaron, running down on the collar of his robes!
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis like the precious oil upon the head, Running down on the beard, The beard of Aaron, Running down on the edge of his garments.
verses.textEnNlt: For harmony is as precious as the anointing oil that was poured over Aaron’s head, that ran down his beard and onto the border of his robe.
verses.textEnNasb: It is like the precious oil on the head, Running down upon the beard, As on Aaron’s beard, The oil which ran down upon the edge of his robes.
verses.textEn: It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard, running down on Aaron’s beard, down on the collar of his robe.

verses.textZh: 又好比黑门的甘露 落在锡安的众山上， 在那里有耶和华命定的福， 就是永远的生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又好比黑门的甘露 落在锡安的众山上， 在那里有耶和华命定的福， 就是永远的生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 又好比黑门的甘露降在锡安山； 因为在那里有耶和华所命定的福， 就是永远的生命。
verses.textEnNiv: It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the Lord bestows his blessing, even life forevermore.
verses.textEnEsv: It is like the dew of Hermon, which falls on the mountains of Zion! For there the Lord has commanded the blessing, life forevermore.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis like the dew of Hermon, Descending upon the mountains of Zion; For there the Lord commanded the blessing— Life forevermore.
verses.textEnNlt: Harmony is as refreshing as the dew from Mount Hermon that falls on the mountains of Zion. And there the Lord has pronounced his blessing, even life everlasting.
verses.textEnNasb: It is like the dew of Hermon Coming down upon the mountains of Zion; For the Lord commanded the blessing there—life forever.
verses.textEn: It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the Lord bestows his blessing, even life forevermore.

verses.textZh: 朝圣之歌 。 耶和华的众仆人哪！ 你们要称颂耶和华； 夜间在耶和华殿中侍候的， 你们要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝圣之歌 。 耶和华的众仆人哪！ 你们要称颂耶和华； 夜间在耶和华殿中侍候的， 你们要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的仆人夜间站在耶和华殿中的， 你们当称颂耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord , all you servants of the Lord who minister by night in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Come, bless the Lord , all you servants of the Lord , who stand by night in the house of the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, bless the Lord, All you servants of the Lord, Who by night stand in the house of the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, praise the Lord , all you servants of the Lord , you who serve at night in the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, Who serve by night in the house of the Lord!
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord , all you servants of the Lord who minister by night in the house of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要向圣所举手祷告， 称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要向圣所举手祷告， 称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当向圣所举手， 称颂耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary and praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Lift up your hands to the holy place and bless the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, And bless the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Lift your hands toward the sanctuary, and praise the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary And bless the Lord.
verses.textEn: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary and praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 愿造天地的耶和华， 从锡安赐福给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿造天地的耶和华， 从锡安赐福给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿造天地的耶和华， 从锡安赐福给你们！
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord bless you from Zion, he who is the Maker of heaven and earth.
verses.textEnEsv: May the Lord bless you from Zion, he who made heaven and earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord who made heaven and earth Bless you from Zion!
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord , who made heaven and earth, bless you from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord bless you from Zion, He who made heaven and earth.
verses.textEn: May the Lord bless you from Zion, he who is the Maker of heaven and earth.

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华， 你们要赞美耶和华的名； 耶和华的众仆人哪！你们都要赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华， 你们要赞美耶和华的名； 耶和华的众仆人哪！你们都要赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华的名！ 耶和华的仆人站在耶和华殿中； 站在我们神殿院中的，你们要赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . Praise the name of the Lord ; praise him, you servants of the Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! Praise the name of the Lord , give praise, O servants of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! Praise the name of the Lord; Praise Him, O you servants of the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! Praise the name of the Lord ! Praise him, you who serve the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! Praise the name of the Lord; Praise Him, you servants of the Lord,
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . Praise the name of the Lord ; praise him, you servants of the Lord ,

verses.textZh: 在耶和华殿中侍候的， 在我们神殿的院里侍候的， 你们要赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华殿中侍候的， 在我们神殿的院里侍候的， 你们要赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 耶和华本为善； 要歌颂他的名， 因为这是美好的。
verses.textEnNiv: you who minister in the house of the Lord , in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: who stand in the house of the Lord , in the courts of the house of our God!
verses.textEnNkjv: You who stand in the house of the Lord, In the courts of the house of our God,
verses.textEnNlt: you who serve in the house of the Lord , in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.textEnNasb: You who stand in the house of the Lord, In the courtyards of the house of our God!
verses.textEn: you who minister in the house of the Lord , in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华， 因耶和华本是良善的； 你们要歌颂他的名， 因为他的名是美好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华， 因耶和华本是良善的； 你们要歌颂他的名， 因为他的名是美好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华拣选雅各归自己， 拣选以色列特作自己的子民。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord , for the Lord is good; sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord , for the Lord is good; sing to his name, for it is pleasant!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord, for the Lordis good; Sing praises to His name, for itis pleasant.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , for the Lord is good; celebrate his lovely name with music.
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good; Sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord , for the Lord is good; sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华拣选了雅各归他自己， 拣选了以色列作他自己的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华拣选了雅各归他自己， 拣选了以色列作他自己的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来我知道耶和华为大， 也知道我们的主超乎万神之上。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his treasured possession.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel as his own possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel for His special treasure.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own special treasure.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel as His own possession.
verses.textEn: For the Lord has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his treasured possession.

verses.textZh: 我确实知道耶和华是伟大的， 我们的主超越万神之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我确实知道耶和华是伟大的， 我们的主超越万神之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在天上，在地下， 在海中，在一切的深处， 都随自己的意旨而行。
verses.textEnNiv: I know that the Lord is great, that our Lord is greater than all gods.
verses.textEnEsv: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I know that the Lordis great, And our Lord is above all gods.
verses.textEnNlt: I know the greatness of the Lord — that our Lord is greater than any other god.
verses.textEnNasb: For I know that the Lord is great And that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.textEn: I know that the Lord is great, that our Lord is greater than all gods.

verses.textZh: 在天上，在地上，在海中，在一切深处， 耶和华喜欢甚么，就作甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在天上，在地上，在海中，在一切深处， 耶和华喜欢甚么，就作甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使云雾从地极上腾， 造电随雨而闪， 从府库中带出风来。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord does whatever pleases him, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.
verses.textEnEsv: Whatever the Lord pleases, he does, in heaven and on earth, in the seas and all deeps.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever the Lord pleases He does, In heaven and in earth, In the seas and in all deep places.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord does whatever pleases him throughout all heaven and earth, and on the seas and in their depths.
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever the Lord pleases, He does, In heaven and on earth, in the seas and in all the ocean depths.
verses.textEn: The Lord does whatever pleases him, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.

verses.textZh: 他使云雾从地极上升， 发出闪电随雨而来， 又从他的府库吹出风来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使云雾从地极上升， 发出闪电随雨而来， 又从他的府库吹出风来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将埃及头生的， 连人带牲畜都击杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth; he sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
verses.textEnEsv: He it is who makes the clouds rise at the end of the earth, who makes lightnings for the rain and brings forth the wind from his storehouses.
verses.textEnNkjv: He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; He makes lightning for the rain; He brings the wind out of His treasuries.
verses.textEnNlt: He causes the clouds to rise over the whole earth. He sends the lightning with the rain and releases the wind from his storehouses.
verses.textEnNasb: He causes the mist to ascend from the ends of the earth, He makes lightning for the rain; He brings forth the wind from His treasuries.
verses.textEn: He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth; he sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

verses.textZh: 他把埃及头生的， 无论人或牲畜都击杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把埃及头生的， 无论人或牲畜都击杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及啊，他施行神迹奇事， 在你当中，在法老和他一切臣仆身上。
verses.textEnNiv: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of people and animals.
verses.textEnEsv: He it was who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and of beast;
verses.textEnNkjv: He destroyed the firstborn of Egypt, Both of man and beast.
verses.textEnNlt: He destroyed the firstborn in each Egyptian home, both people and animals.
verses.textEnNasb: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, Both human firstborn and animal.
verses.textEn: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of people and animals.

verses.textZh: 埃及啊！他在你当中施行神迹和奇事， 惩罚法老和他所有的臣仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及啊！他在你当中施行神迹和奇事， 惩罚法老和他所有的臣仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 他击杀许多的民， 又杀戮大能的王，
verses.textEnNiv: He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.textEnEsv: who in your midst, O Egypt, sent signs and wonders against Pharaoh and all his servants;
verses.textEnNkjv: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.textEnNlt: He performed miraculous signs and wonders in Egypt against Pharaoh and all his people.
verses.textEnNasb: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, Upon Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.textEn: He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

verses.textZh: 他击杀了多国的民， 杀戮了强悍的王，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他击杀了多国的民， 杀戮了强悍的王，
verses.textZhCuv: 就是亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩， 并迦南一切的国王，
verses.textEnNiv: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings—
verses.textEnEsv: who struck down many nations and killed mighty kings,
verses.textEnNkjv: He defeated many nations And slew mighty kings—
verses.textEnNlt: He struck down great nations and slaughtered mighty kings—
verses.textEnNasb: He struck many nations And brought death to mighty kings,
verses.textEn: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings—

verses.textZh: 就是亚摩利王西宏、 巴珊王噩， 和迦南列国的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是亚摩利王西宏、 巴珊王噩， 和迦南列国的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 将他们的地赏赐他的百姓以色列为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan—
verses.textEnEsv: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
verses.textEnNkjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan—
verses.textEnNlt: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: Sihon, king of the Amorites, Og, king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan;
verses.textEn: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan—

verses.textZh: 他把他们的地 赐给了自己的子民以色列作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把他们的地 赐给了自己的子民以色列作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你的名存到永远！ 耶和华啊，你可记念的名存到万代！
verses.textEnNiv: and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: and gave their land as a heritage, a heritage to his people Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And gave their land as a heritage, A heritage to Israel His people.
verses.textEnNlt: He gave their land as an inheritance, a special possession to his people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And He gave their land as an inheritance, An inheritance to His people Israel.
verses.textEn: and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你的名存到永远； 耶和华啊！你可记念的名留存万代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你的名存到永远； 耶和华啊！你可记念的名留存万代。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华要为他的百姓伸冤， 为他的仆人后悔。
verses.textEnNiv: Your name, Lord , endures forever, your renown, Lord , through all generations.
verses.textEnEsv: Your name, O Lord , endures forever, your renown, O Lord , throughout all ages.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your name, O Lord, endures forever, Your fame, O Lord, throughout all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: Your name, O Lord , endures forever; your fame, O Lord , is known to every generation.
verses.textEnNasb: Your name, Lord, is everlasting, The mention of You, Lord, is throughout all generations.
verses.textEn: Your name, Lord , endures forever, your renown, Lord , through all generations.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华要为自己的子民伸冤， 他要怜悯自己的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华要为自己的子民伸冤， 他要怜悯自己的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦的偶像是金的，银的， 是人手所造的；
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will judge His people, And He will have compassion on His servants.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord will give justice to his people and have compassion on his servants.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord will judge His people And will have compassion on His servants.
verses.textEn: For the Lord will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.

verses.textZh: 列国的偶像是金的银的， 是人手所做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国的偶像是金的银的， 是人手所做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有口却不能言， 有眼却不能看，
verses.textEnNiv: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by human hands.
verses.textEnEsv: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
verses.textEnNlt: The idols of the nations are merely things of silver and gold, shaped by human hands.
verses.textEnNasb: The idols of the nations are nothing but silver and gold, The work of human hands.
verses.textEn: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by human hands.

verses.textZh: 有口却不能说话， 有眼却不能看，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有口却不能说话， 有眼却不能看，
verses.textZhCuv: 有耳却不能听， 口中也没有气息。
verses.textEnNiv: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but cannot see.
verses.textEnEsv: They have mouths, but do not speak; they have eyes, but do not see;
verses.textEnNkjv: They have mouths, but they do not speak; Eyes they have, but they do not see;
verses.textEnNlt: They have mouths but cannot speak, and eyes but cannot see.
verses.textEnNasb: They have mouths, but they do not speak; They have eyes, but they do not see;
verses.textEn: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but cannot see.

verses.textZh: 有耳却不能听， 口中也没有气息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有耳却不能听， 口中也没有气息。
verses.textZhCuv: 造他的要和他一样， 凡靠他的也要如此。
verses.textEnNiv: They have ears, but cannot hear, nor is there breath in their mouths.
verses.textEnEsv: they have ears, but do not hear, nor is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have ears, but they do not hear; Nor is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.textEnNlt: They have ears but cannot hear, and mouths but cannot breathe.
verses.textEnNasb: They have ears, but they do not hear, Nor is there any breath at all in their mouths.
verses.textEn: They have ears, but cannot hear, nor is there breath in their mouths.

verses.textZh: 做偶像的必和它们一样， 所有倚靠它们的也必这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 做偶像的必和它们一样， 所有倚靠它们的也必这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！ 亚伦家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who make them become like them; so do all who trust in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who make them are like them; Sois everyone who trusts in them.
verses.textEnNlt: And those who make idols are just like them, as are all who trust in them.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who make them will become like them, Yes, everyone who trusts in them.
verses.textEn: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

verses.textZh: 以色列家啊！你们要称颂耶和华； 亚伦家啊！你们要称颂耶和华；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家啊！你们要称颂耶和华； 亚伦家啊！你们要称颂耶和华；
verses.textZhCuv: 利未家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！ 你们敬畏耶和华的，要称颂耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: All you Israelites, praise the Lord ; house of Aaron, praise the Lord ;
verses.textEnEsv: O house of Israel, bless the Lord ! O house of Aaron, bless the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel! Bless the Lord, O house of Aaron!
verses.textEnNlt: O Israel, praise the Lord ! O priests—descendants of Aaron—praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: House of Israel, bless the Lord; House of Aaron, bless the Lord;
verses.textEn: All you Israelites, praise the Lord ; house of Aaron, praise the Lord ;

verses.textZh: 利未家啊！你们要称颂耶和华； 敬畏耶和华的，你们要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未家啊！你们要称颂耶和华； 敬畏耶和华的，你们要称颂耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在耶路撒冷的耶和华 该从锡安受称颂。 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: house of Levi, praise the Lord ; you who fear him, praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: O house of Levi, bless the Lord ! You who fear the Lord , bless the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi! You who fear the Lord, bless the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: O Levites, praise the Lord ! All you who fear the Lord , praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: House of Levi, bless the Lord; You who revere the Lord, bless the Lord.
verses.textEn: house of Levi, praise the Lord ; you who fear him, praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 从锡安来的耶和华， 就是住在耶路撒冷的，是应当称颂的。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从锡安来的耶和华， 就是住在耶路撒冷的，是应当称颂的。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 从锡安来的耶和华， 就是住在耶路撒冷的，是应当称颂的。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord from Zion, to him who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord from Zion, he who dwells in Jerusalem! Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, Who dwells in Jerusalem! Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord be praised from Zion, for he lives here in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord from Zion, Who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord from Zion, to him who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本是良善的， 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本是良善的， 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善； 他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good. His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for Heis good! For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good! His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good. His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 你们要称谢万神之神， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要称谢万神之神， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称谢万神之神， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: Give thanks to the God of gods. His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the God of gods! For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the God of gods. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the God of gods, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: Give thanks to the God of gods. His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 你们要称谢万主之主， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要称谢万主之主， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称谢万主之主， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: Give thanks to the Lord of lords: His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the Lord of lords! For His mercy endures forever:
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: Give thanks to the Lord of lords: His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 要称谢那独行大奇事的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要称谢那独行大奇事的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 称谢那独行大奇事的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: to him who alone does great wonders, His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: to him who alone does great wonders, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him who alone does great wonders, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to him who alone does mighty miracles. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him who alone does great wonders, For His faithfulness is everlasting;
verses.textEn: to him who alone does great wonders, His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 要称谢那用智慧造成诸天的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要称谢那用智慧造成诸天的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 称谢那用智慧造天的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: who by his understanding made the heavens, His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him who by wisdom made the heavens, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to him who made the heavens so skillfully. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him who made the heavens with skill, For His faithfulness is everlasting;
verses.textEn: who by his understanding made the heavens, His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 要称谢那铺张大地在水上的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要称谢那铺张大地在水上的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 称谢那铺地在水以上的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: who spread out the earth upon the waters, His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him who laid out the earth above the waters, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to him who placed the earth among the waters. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him who spread out the earth above the waters, For His faithfulness is everlasting;
verses.textEn: who spread out the earth upon the waters, His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 要称谢那造成大光的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要称谢那造成大光的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 称谢那造成大光的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: who made the great lights— His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: to him who made the great lights, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him who made great lights, For His mercy endures forever—
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to him who made the heavenly lights— His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him who made the great lights, For His faithfulness is everlasting:
verses.textEn: who made the great lights— His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他造太阳管白昼， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他造太阳管白昼， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他造日头管白昼， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: the sun to govern the day, His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: the sun to rule over the day, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: The sun to rule by day, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: the sun to rule the day, His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: The sun to rule by day, For His faithfulness is everlasting,
verses.textEn: the sun to govern the day, His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他造月亮和星星管黑夜， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他造月亮和星星管黑夜， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他造月亮星宿管黑夜， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: the moon and stars to govern the night; His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: the moon and stars to rule over the night, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: The moon and stars to rule by night, For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: and the moon and stars to rule the night. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: The moon and stars to rule by night, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: the moon and stars to govern the night; His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 要称谢那击杀埃及所有头生的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要称谢那击杀埃及所有头生的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 称谢那击杀埃及人之长子的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him who struck Egypt in their firstborn, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to him who killed the firstborn of Egypt. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him who struck the Egyptians, that is, their firstborn, For His faithfulness is everlasting,
verses.textEn: to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他领以色列人从他们中间出来， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领以色列人从他们中间出来， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他领以色列人从他们中间出来， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: and brought Israel out from among them His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: and brought Israel out from among them, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: And brought out Israel from among them, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: He brought Israel out of Egypt. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And brought Israel out from their midst, For His faithfulness is everlasting,
verses.textEn: and brought Israel out from among them His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂领他们出来， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂领他们出来， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他施展大能的手和伸出来的膀臂， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: with a mighty hand and outstretched arm; His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: He acted with a strong hand and powerful arm. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: With a strong hand and an outstretched arm, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: with a mighty hand and outstretched arm; His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 要称谢那分开红海的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要称谢那分开红海的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 称谢那分裂红海的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: to him who divided the Red Sea asunder His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: to him who divided the Red Sea in two, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him who divided the Red Sea in two, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to him who parted the Red Sea. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him who divided the Red Sea in parts, For His faithfulness is everlasting,
verses.textEn: to him who divided the Red Sea asunder His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他领以色列人从海中经过， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领以色列人从海中经过， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他领以色列从其中经过， 因他的慈爱永远长存；
verses.textEnNiv: and brought Israel through the midst of it, His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: and made Israel pass through the midst of it, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: And made Israel pass through the midst of it, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: He led Israel safely through, His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And allowed Israel to pass through the midst of it, For His faithfulness is everlasting;
verses.textEn: and brought Israel through the midst of it, His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他把法老和他的军兵都抖落在红海里， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把法老和他的军兵都抖落在红海里， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 却把法老和他的军兵推翻在红海里， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea; His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: but overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: but he hurled Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: But He overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea; His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 要称谢那引导自己的子民走过旷野的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要称谢那引导自己的子民走过旷野的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 称谢那引导自己的民行走旷野的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: to him who led his people through the wilderness; His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him who led His people through the wilderness, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to him who led his people through the wilderness. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him who led His people through the wilderness, For His faithfulness is everlasting;
verses.textEn: to him who led his people through the wilderness; His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 要称谢那击杀大君王的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要称谢那击杀大君王的， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 称谢那击杀大君王的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: to him who struck down great kings, His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: to him who struck down great kings, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him who struck down great kings, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to him who struck down mighty kings. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: To Him who struck great kings, For His faithfulness is everlasting,
verses.textEn: to him who struck down great kings, His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他杀戮了强盛的君王， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他杀戮了强盛的君王， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他杀戮有名的君王， 因他的慈爱永远长存；
verses.textEnNiv: and killed mighty kings— His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: and killed mighty kings, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: And slew famous kings, For His mercy endures forever—
verses.textEnNlt: He killed powerful kings— His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And brought death to mighty kings, For His faithfulness is everlasting:
verses.textEn: and killed mighty kings— His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他杀了亚摩利王西宏， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他杀了亚摩利王西宏， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是杀戮亚摩利王西宏， 因他的慈爱永远长存；
verses.textEnNiv: Sihon king of the Amorites His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Sihon, king of the Amorites, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: Sihon king of the Amorites, His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Sihon, king of the Amorites, For His faithfulness is everlasting,
verses.textEn: Sihon king of the Amorites His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他杀了巴珊王噩， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他杀了巴珊王噩， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 又杀巴珊王噩， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: and Og king of Bashan— His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: and Og, king of Bashan, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: And Og king of Bashan, For His mercy endures forever—
verses.textEnNlt: and Og king of Bashan. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And Og, king of Bashan, For His faithfulness is everlasting,
verses.textEn: and Og king of Bashan— His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他把他们的地赐给了自己的子民作产业， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把他们的地赐给了自己的子民作产业， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将他们的地赐他的百姓为业， 因他的慈爱永远长存；
verses.textEnNiv: and gave their land as an inheritance, His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: and gave their land as a heritage, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: And gave their land as a heritage, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: God gave the land of these kings as an inheritance— His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And gave their land as an inheritance, For His faithfulness is everlasting,
verses.textEn: and gave their land as an inheritance, His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他把他们的地赐给他的仆人以色列作产业， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把他们的地赐给他的仆人以色列作产业， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是赐他的仆人以色列为业， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: an inheritance to his servant Israel. His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: a heritage to Israel his servant, for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: A heritage to Israel His servant, For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: a special possession to his servant Israel. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: An inheritance to His servant Israel, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: an inheritance to his servant Israel. His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他在我们卑微的时候顾念我们， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在我们卑微的时候顾念我们， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他顾念我们在卑微的地步， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: He remembered us in our low estate His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: It is he who remembered us in our low estate, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: Who remembered us in our lowly state, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: He remembered us in our weakness. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Who remembered us in our lowliness, For His faithfulness is everlasting,
verses.textEn: He remembered us in our low estate His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他救我们脱离了敌人， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救我们脱离了敌人， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他救拔我们脱离敌人， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: and freed us from our enemies. His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: and rescued us from our foes, for his steadfast love endures forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: And rescued us from our enemies, For His mercy endures forever;
verses.textEnNlt: He saved us from our enemies. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And has rescued us from our enemies, For His faithfulness is everlasting;
verses.textEn: and freed us from our enemies. His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 他把粮食赐给全人类， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把粮食赐给全人类， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 他赐粮食给凡有血气的， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: He gives food to every creature. His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: he who gives food to all flesh, for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who gives food to all flesh, For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: He gives food to every living thing. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Who gives food to all flesh, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: He gives food to every creature. His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 你们要称谢天上的神， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要称谢天上的神， 因为他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要称谢天上的神， 因他的慈爱永远长存。
verses.textEnNiv: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Give thanks to the God of heaven, for his steadfast love endures forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, give thanks to the God of heaven! For His mercy endures forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His faithful love endures forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Give thanks to the God of heaven, For His faithfulness is everlasting.
verses.textEn: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever.

verses.textZh: 我们曾坐在巴比伦的河畔， 在那里我们一想起锡安就哭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们曾坐在巴比伦的河畔， 在那里我们一想起锡安就哭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们曾在巴比伦的河边坐下， 一追想锡安就哭了。
verses.textEnNiv: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: By the waters of Babylon, there we sat down and wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept When we remembered Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: Beside the rivers of Babylon, we sat and wept as we thought of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down and wept, When we remembered Zion.
verses.textEn: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

verses.textZh: 我们把我们的琴 挂在那里的柳树上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们把我们的琴 挂在那里的柳树上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们把琴挂在那里的柳树上；
verses.textEnNiv: There on the poplars we hung our harps,
verses.textEnEsv: On the willows there we hung up our lyres.
verses.textEnNkjv: We hung our harps Upon the willows in the midst of it.
verses.textEnNlt: We put away our harps, hanging them on the branches of poplar trees.
verses.textEnNasb: Upon the willows in the midst of it We hung our harps.
verses.textEn: There on the poplars we hung our harps,

verses.textZh: 因为在那里，掳掠我们的人要我们唱歌， 苦待我们的人要我们娱乐他们； 他们说："为我们唱一首锡安歌吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在那里，掳掠我们的人要我们唱歌， 苦待我们的人要我们娱乐他们； 他们说："为我们唱一首锡安歌吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为在那里，掳掠我们的要我们唱歌， 抢夺我们的要我们作乐，说： 给我们唱一首锡安歌吧！
verses.textEnNiv: for there our captors asked us for songs, our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"
verses.textEnEsv: For there our captors required of us songs, and our tormentors, mirth, saying, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"
verses.textEnNkjv: For there those who carried us away captive asked of us a song, And those who plundered us requested mirth, Saying, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"
verses.textEnNlt: For our captors demanded a song from us. Our tormentors insisted on a joyful hymn: "Sing us one of those songs of Jerusalem!"
verses.textEnNasb: For there our captors demanded of us songs, And our tormentors, jubilation, saying, "Sing for us one of the songs of Zion!"
verses.textEn: for there our captors asked us for songs, our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"

verses.textZh: 我们怎能在异族之地 唱耶和华的歌呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们怎能在异族之地 唱耶和华的歌呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们怎能在外邦唱耶和华的歌呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How can we sing the songs of the Lord while in a foreign land?
verses.textEnEsv: How shall we sing the Lord ’s song in a foreign land?
verses.textEnNkjv: How shall we sing the Lord’s song In a foreign land?
verses.textEnNlt: But how can we sing the songs of the Lord while in a pagan land?
verses.textEnNasb: How can we sing the Lord’s song In a foreign land?
verses.textEn: How can we sing the songs of the Lord while in a foreign land?

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊！如果我忘记你， 情愿我的右手忘记技巧 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊！如果我忘记你， 情愿我的右手忘记技巧 。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊，我若忘记你， 情愿我的右手忘记技巧！
verses.textEnNiv: If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill.
verses.textEnEsv: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill!
verses.textEnNkjv: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget itsskill!
verses.textEnNlt: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget how to play the harp.
verses.textEnNasb: If I forget you, Jerusalem, May my right hand forget its skill.
verses.textEn: If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill.

verses.textZh: 如果我不记念你， 如果我不高举耶路撒冷 超过我最大的喜乐， 情愿我的舌头紧贴上膛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我不记念你， 如果我不高举耶路撒冷 超过我最大的喜乐， 情愿我的舌头紧贴上膛。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若不记念你， 若不看耶路撒冷过于我所最喜乐的， 情愿我的舌头贴于上膛！
verses.textEnNiv: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not consider Jerusalem my highest joy.
verses.textEnEsv: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I do not remember you, if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy!
verses.textEnNkjv: If I do not remember you, Let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth— If I do not exalt Jerusalem Above my chief joy.
verses.textEnNlt: May my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I fail to remember you, if I don’t make Jerusalem my greatest joy.
verses.textEnNasb: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth If I do not remember you, If I do not exalt Jerusalem Above my chief joy.
verses.textEn: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not consider Jerusalem my highest joy.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！求你记念以东人在耶路撒冷遭难的日子所行的， 他们说："拆毁它，拆毁它， 直拆到根基。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！求你记念以东人在耶路撒冷遭难的日子所行的， 他们说："拆毁它，拆毁它， 直拆到根基。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷遭难的日子， 以东人说：拆毁！拆毁！ 直拆到根基！ 耶和华啊，求你记念这仇！
verses.textEnNiv: Remember, Lord , what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. "Tear it down," they cried, "tear it down to its foundations!"
verses.textEnEsv: Remember, O Lord , against the Edomites the day of Jerusalem, how they said, "Lay it bare, lay it bare, down to its foundations!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Remember, O Lord, against the sons of Edom The day of Jerusalem, Who said, "Raze it, raze it, To its very foundation!"
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , remember what the Edomites did on the day the armies of Babylon captured Jerusalem. "Destroy it!" they yelled. "Level it to the ground!"
verses.textEnNasb: Remember, Lord, against the sons of Edom The day of Jerusalem, Those who said, "Lay it bare, lay it bare To its foundation!"
verses.textEn: Remember, Lord , what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. "Tear it down," they cried, "tear it down to its foundations!"

verses.textZh: 将要被毁灭的 巴比伦城 啊！ 照着你待我们的行为报复你的， 那人有福了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 将要被毁灭的 巴比伦城 啊！ 照着你待我们的行为报复你的， 那人有福了。
