verses.textEnNlt: Everyone will share the story of your wonderful goodness; they will sing with joy about your righteousness.
verses.textEnNasb: They will burst forth in speaking of Your abundant goodness, And will shout joyfully of Your righteousness.
verses.textEn: They celebrate your abundant goodness and joyfully sing of your righteousness.

verses.textZh: 耶和华有恩典有怜悯， 不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华有恩典有怜悯， 不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯， 不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis gracious and full of compassion, Slow to anger and great in mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is merciful and compassionate, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is gracious and compassionate; Slow to anger and great in mercy.
verses.textEn: The Lord is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love.

verses.textZh: 耶和华善待万有， 他的怜悯临到他一切所造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华善待万有， 他的怜悯临到他一切所造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华善待万民； 他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is good to all; he has compassion on all he has made.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is good to all, and his mercy is over all that he has made.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis good to all, And His tender mercies are over all His works.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is good to everyone. He showers compassion on all his creation.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is good to all, And His mercies are over all His works.
verses.textEn: The Lord is good to all; he has compassion on all he has made.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！你一切所造的都要称谢你， 你的圣民也要称颂你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！你一切所造的都要称谢你， 你的圣民也要称颂你。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，你一切所造的都要称谢你； 你的圣民也要称颂你，
verses.textEnNiv: All your works praise you, Lord ; your faithful people extol you.
verses.textEnEsv: All your works shall give thanks to you, O Lord , and all your saints shall bless you!
verses.textEnNkjv: All Your works shall praise You, O Lord, And Your saints shall bless You.
verses.textEnNlt: All of your works will thank you, Lord , and your faithful followers will praise you.
verses.textEnNasb: All Your works will give thanks to You, Lord, And Your godly ones will bless You.
verses.textEn: All your works praise you, Lord ; your faithful people extol you.

verses.textZh: 他们要讲论你国的荣耀， 也要述说你大能的作为。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要讲论你国的荣耀， 也要述说你大能的作为。
verses.textZhCuv: 传说你国的荣耀， 谈论你的大能，
verses.textEnNiv: They tell of the glory of your kingdom and speak of your might,
verses.textEnEsv: They shall speak of the glory of your kingdom and tell of your power,
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom, And talk of Your power,
verses.textEnNlt: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom; they will give examples of your power.
verses.textEnNasb: They will speak of the glory of Your kingdom, And talk of Your might,
verses.textEn: They tell of the glory of your kingdom and speak of your might,

verses.textZh: 好使世人知道你大能的作为， 和你国威严的尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使世人知道你大能的作为， 和你国威严的尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫世人知道你大能的作为， 并你国度威严的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: so that all people may know of your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: to make known to the children of man your mighty deeds, and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: To make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, And the glorious majesty of His kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: They will tell about your mighty deeds and about the majesty and glory of your reign.
verses.textEnNasb: To make known to the sons of mankind Your mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of Your kingdom.
verses.textEn: so that all people may know of your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

verses.textZh: 你的国是永远的国， 你的王权存到万代 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的国是永远的国， 你的王权存到万代 。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的国是永远的国！ 你执掌的权柄存到万代！
verses.textEnNiv: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations. The Lord is trustworthy in all he promises and faithful in all he does.
verses.textEnEsv: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures throughout all generations. [The Lord is faithful in all his words and kind in all his works. ]
verses.textEnNkjv: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And Your dominion endures throughout all generations.
verses.textEnNlt: For your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. You rule throughout all generations. The Lord always keeps his promises; he is gracious in all he does.
verses.textEnNasb: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The Lord is faithful in His words, And holy in all His works.
verses.textEn: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations. The Lord is trustworthy in all he promises and faithful in all he does.

verses.textZh: 跌倒的，耶和华都扶持他们； 被压迫的，他都扶他们起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 跌倒的，耶和华都扶持他们； 被压迫的，他都扶他们起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡跌倒的，耶和华将他们扶持； 凡被压下的，将他们扶起。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord upholds all who are falling and raises up all who are bowed down.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord upholds all who fall, And raises up all whoare bowed down.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord helps the fallen and lifts those bent beneath their loads.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord supports all who fall, And raises up all who are bowed down.
verses.textEn: The Lord upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

verses.textZh: 万人的眼睛都仰望你， 你按时把粮食赐给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万人的眼睛都仰望你， 你按时把粮食赐给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 万民都举目仰望你； 你随时给他们食物。
verses.textEnNiv: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food at the proper time.
verses.textEnEsv: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food in due season.
verses.textEnNkjv: The eyes of all look expectantly to You, And You give them their food in due season.
verses.textEnNlt: The eyes of all look to you in hope; you give them their food as they need it.
verses.textEnNasb: The eyes of all look to You, And You give them their food in due time.
verses.textEn: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food at the proper time.

verses.textZh: 你把手张开， 使所有生物都随愿得到饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把手张开， 使所有生物都随愿得到饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 你张手， 使有生气的都随愿饱足。
verses.textEnNiv: You open your hand and satisfy the desires of every living thing.
verses.textEnEsv: You open your hand; you satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: You open Your hand And satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.textEnNlt: When you open your hand, you satisfy the hunger and thirst of every living thing.
verses.textEnNasb: You open Your hand And satisfy the desire of every living thing.
verses.textEn: You open your hand and satisfy the desires of every living thing.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在他一切所行的事上，都是公义的， 他对他一切所造的，都存着慈爱的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在他一切所行的事上，都是公义的， 他对他一切所造的，都存着慈爱的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在他一切所行的，无不公义； 在他一切所做的都有慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is righteous in all his ways and faithful in all he does.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is righteous in all his ways and kind in all his works.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis righteous in all His ways, Gracious in all His works.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is righteous in everything he does; he is filled with kindness.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is righteous in all His ways, And kind in all His works.
verses.textEn: The Lord is righteous in all his ways and faithful in all he does.

verses.textZh: 凡是求告耶和华的，耶和华都和他们接近， 就是和所有真诚求告他的人接近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是求告耶和华的，耶和华都和他们接近， 就是和所有真诚求告他的人接近。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡求告耶和华的，就是诚心求告他的， 耶和华便与他们相近。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis near to all who call upon Him, To all who call upon Him in truth.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is close to all who call on him, yes, to all who call on him in truth.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is near to all who call on Him, To all who call on Him in truth.
verses.textEn: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

verses.textZh: 敬畏他的，他必成就他们的心愿， 也必听他们的呼求，拯救他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬畏他的，他必成就他们的心愿， 也必听他们的呼求，拯救他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 敬畏他的，他必成就他们的心愿， 也必听他们的呼求，拯救他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He fulfills the desires of those who fear him; he hears their cry and saves them.
verses.textEnEsv: He fulfills the desire of those who fear him; he also hears their cry and saves them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He also will hear their cry and save them.
verses.textEnNlt: He grants the desires of those who fear him; he hears their cries for help and rescues them.
verses.textEnNasb: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He will also hear their cry for help and save them.
verses.textEn: He fulfills the desires of those who fear him; he hears their cry and saves them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华保护所有爱他的人， 却要消灭所有恶人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华保护所有爱他的人， 却要消灭所有恶人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华保护一切爱他的人， 却要灭绝一切的恶人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord watches over all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord preserves all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord preserves all who love Him, But all the wicked He will destroy.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord protects all those who love him, but he destroys the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord watches over all who love Him, But He will destroy all the wicked.
verses.textEn: The Lord watches over all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.

verses.textZh: 我的口要说赞美耶和华的话； 愿所有的人都永永远远称颂他的圣名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的口要说赞美耶和华的话； 愿所有的人都永永远远称颂他的圣名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的口要说出赞美耶和华的话； 惟愿凡有血气的都永永远远称颂他的圣名。
verses.textEnNiv: My mouth will speak in praise of the Lord . Let every creature praise his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: My mouth will speak the praise of the Lord , and let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord, And all flesh shall bless His holy name Forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: I will praise the Lord , and may everyone on earth bless his holy name forever and ever.
verses.textEnNasb: My mouth will speak the praise of the Lord, And all flesh will bless His holy name forever and ever.
verses.textEn: My mouth will speak in praise of the Lord . Let every creature praise his holy name for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华。 我的心哪！要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华。 我的心哪！要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 我的心哪，你要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord , my soul.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord , O my soul!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord, O my soul!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! Let all that I am praise the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord, my soul!
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord , my soul.

verses.textZh: 我还活着的时候，我要赞美耶和华； 我还在世上的时候，我要歌颂我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我还活着的时候，我要赞美耶和华； 我还在世上的时候，我要歌颂我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我一生要赞美耶和华！ 我还活的时候要歌颂我的神！
verses.textEnNiv: I will praise the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.
verses.textEnEsv: I will praise the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
verses.textEnNkjv: While I live I will praise the Lord; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
verses.textEnNlt: I will praise the Lord as long as I live. I will sing praises to my God with my dying breath.
verses.textEnNasb: I will praise the Lord while I live; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
verses.textEn: I will praise the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

verses.textZh: 你们不要倚靠权贵， 不要倚靠世人，他们一点都不能救助你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要倚靠权贵， 不要倚靠世人，他们一点都不能救助你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人； 他一点不能帮助。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not put your trust in princes, in human beings, who cannot save.
verses.textEnEsv: Put not your trust in princes, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not put your trust in princes, Nor in a son of man, in whom thereis no help.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t put your confidence in powerful people; there is no help for you there.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not trust in noblemen, In mortal man, in whom there is no salvation.
verses.textEn: Do not put your trust in princes, in human beings, who cannot save.

verses.textZh: 他们的气一断，就归回尘土； 他们所计划的，当天就幻灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的气一断，就归回尘土； 他们所计划的，当天就幻灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的气一断，就归回尘土； 他所打算的，当日就消灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: When their spirit departs, they return to the ground; on that very day their plans come to nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: When his breath departs, he returns to the earth; on that very day his plans perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: His spirit departs, he returns to his earth; In that very day his plans perish.
verses.textEnNlt: When they breathe their last, they return to the earth, and all their plans die with them.
verses.textEnNasb: His spirit departs, he returns to the earth; On that very day his plans perish.
verses.textEn: When their spirit departs, they return to the ground; on that very day their plans come to nothing.

verses.textZh: 以雅各的神为自己的帮助， 仰望耶和华他的神的， 这人就是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以雅各的神为自己的帮助， 仰望耶和华他的神的， 这人就是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以雅各的神为帮助、 仰望耶和华－他神的，这人便为有福！
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed are those whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Happy ishe who has the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in the Lord his God,
verses.textEnNlt: But joyful are those who have the God of Israel as their helper, whose hope is in the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, Whose hope is in the Lord his God,
verses.textEn: Blessed are those whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: 耶和华造天、地、海， 和其中的万物； 他持守信实，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华造天、地、海， 和其中的万物； 他持守信实，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华造天、地、海，和其中的万物； 他守诚实，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: He is the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them— he remains faithful forever.
verses.textEnEsv: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, who keeps faith forever;
verses.textEnNkjv: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that is in them; Who keeps truth forever,
verses.textEnNlt: He made heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He keeps every promise forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Who made heaven and earth, The sea and everything that is in them; Who keeps faith forever;
verses.textEn: He is the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them— he remains faithful forever.

verses.textZh: 他为受欺压的人伸冤， 赐食物给饥饿的人， 耶和华使被囚的得自由。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为受欺压的人伸冤， 赐食物给饥饿的人， 耶和华使被囚的得自由。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为受屈的伸冤， 赐食物与饥饿的。 耶和华释放被囚的；
verses.textEnNiv: He upholds the cause of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free,
verses.textEnEsv: who executes justice for the oppressed, who gives food to the hungry. The Lord sets the prisoners free;
verses.textEnNkjv: Who executes justice for the oppressed, Who gives food to the hungry. The Lord gives freedom to the prisoners.
verses.textEnNlt: He gives justice to the oppressed and food to the hungry. The Lord frees the prisoners.
verses.textEnNasb: Who executes justice for the oppressed; Who gives food to the hungry. The Lord frees the prisoners.
verses.textEn: He upholds the cause of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free,

verses.textZh: 耶和华开了瞎子的眼睛， 耶和华扶起被压迫的人， 耶和华喜爱义人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华开了瞎子的眼睛， 耶和华扶起被压迫的人， 耶和华喜爱义人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华开了瞎子的眼睛； 耶和华扶起被压下的人。 耶和华喜爱义人。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord gives sight to the blind, the Lord lifts up those who are bowed down, the Lord loves the righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord opens the eyes of the blind. The Lord lifts up those who are bowed down; the Lord loves the righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord opens theeyesof the blind; The Lord raises those who are bowed down; The Lord loves the righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord opens the eyes of the blind. The Lord lifts up those who are weighed down. The Lord loves the godly.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord opens the eyes of those who are blind; The Lord raises up those who are bowed down; The Lord loves the righteous.
verses.textEn: the Lord gives sight to the blind, the Lord lifts up those who are bowed down, the Lord loves the righteous.

verses.textZh: 耶和华保护寄居的， 扶持孤儿寡妇， 却使恶人的行动挫败。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华保护寄居的， 扶持孤儿寡妇， 却使恶人的行动挫败。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华保护寄居的， 扶持孤儿和寡妇， 却使恶人的道路弯曲。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord watches over the foreigner and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord watches over the sojourners; he upholds the widow and the fatherless, but the way of the wicked he brings to ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord watches over the strangers; He relieves the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked He turns upside down.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord protects the foreigners among us. He cares for the orphans and widows, but he frustrates the plans of the wicked.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord watches over strangers; He supports the fatherless and the widow, But He thwarts the way of the wicked.
verses.textEn: The Lord watches over the foreigner and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华作王，直到永远！ 锡安哪！愿你的神作王，直到万代。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华作王，直到永远！ 锡安哪！愿你的神作王，直到万代。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华要作王，直到永远！ 锡安哪，你的神要作王，直到万代！ 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will reign forever, your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord shall reign forever— Your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will reign forever. He will be your God, O Jerusalem, throughout the generations. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will reign forever, Your God, Zion, to all generations. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: The Lord reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华。 歌颂我们的神，这是多么美善， 赞美他，这是美好的，是合宜的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华。 歌颂我们的神，这是多么美善， 赞美他，这是美好的，是合宜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 因歌颂我们的神为善为美； 赞美的话是合宜的。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise him!
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! For it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant, and a song of praise is fitting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! For itis good to sing praises to our God; For itis pleasant, and praise is beautiful.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! How good to sing praises to our God! How delightful and how fitting!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! For it is good to sing praises to our God; For it is pleasant and praise is beautiful.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise him!

verses.textZh: 耶和华重建耶路撒冷， 召聚被赶散的以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华重建耶路撒冷， 召聚被赶散的以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华建造耶路撒冷， 聚集以色列中被赶散的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the exiles of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the outcasts of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord is rebuilding Jerusalem and bringing the exiles back to Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the outcasts of Israel.
verses.textEn: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the exiles of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他医好伤心的人， 裹好他们的伤处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他医好伤心的人， 裹好他们的伤处。
verses.textZhCuv: 他医好伤心的人， 裹好他们的伤处。
verses.textEnNiv: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verses.textEnEsv: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verses.textEnNkjv: He heals the brokenhearted And binds up their wounds.
verses.textEnNlt: He heals the brokenhearted and bandages their wounds.
verses.textEnNasb: He heals the brokenhearted And binds up their wounds.
verses.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

verses.textZh: 他数点星辰的数目， 一一给它们起名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他数点星辰的数目， 一一给它们起名。
verses.textZhCuv: 他数点星宿的数目， 一一称它的名。
verses.textEnNiv: He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.
verses.textEnEsv: He determines the number of the stars; he gives to all of them their names.
verses.textEnNkjv: He counts the number of the stars; He calls them all by name.
verses.textEnNlt: He counts the stars and calls them all by name.
verses.textEnNasb: He counts the number of the stars; He gives names to all of them.
verses.textEn: He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.

verses.textZh: 我们的主伟大，大有能力； 他的智慧无法测度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的主伟大，大有能力； 他的智慧无法测度。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的主为大，最有能力； 他的智慧无法测度。
verses.textEnNiv: Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit.
verses.textEnEsv: Great is our Lord, and abundant in power; his understanding is beyond measure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.
verses.textEnNlt: How great is our Lord! His power is absolute! His understanding is beyond comprehension!
verses.textEnNasb: Great is our Lord and abundant in strength; His understanding is infinite.
verses.textEn: Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit.

verses.textZh: 耶和华扶持谦卑的人， 却把恶人丢弃在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华扶持谦卑的人， 却把恶人丢弃在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华扶持谦卑人， 将恶人倾覆于地。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord lifts up the humble; he casts the wicked to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord lifts up the humble; He casts the wicked down to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord supports the humble, but he brings the wicked down into the dust.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord supports the afflicted; He brings the wicked down to the ground.
verses.textEn: The Lord sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.

verses.textZh: 你们要以感谢的心向耶和华歌唱， 用琴向我们的神歌颂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要以感谢的心向耶和华歌唱， 用琴向我们的神歌颂。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要以感谢向耶和华歌唱， 用琴向我们的神歌颂。
verses.textEnNiv: Sing to the Lord with grateful praise; make music to our God on the harp.
verses.textEnEsv: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving; make melody to our God on the lyre!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving; Sing praises on the harp to our God,
verses.textEnNlt: Sing out your thanks to the Lord ; sing praises to our God with a harp.
verses.textEnNasb: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving; Sing praises to our God on the lyre;
verses.textEn: Sing to the Lord with grateful praise; make music to our God on the harp.

verses.textZh: 他以密云遮盖天空， 为大地预备雨水， 使群山长满青草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以密云遮盖天空， 为大地预备雨水， 使群山长满青草。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用云遮天，为地降雨， 使草生长在山上。
verses.textEnNiv: He covers the sky with clouds; he supplies the earth with rain and makes grass grow on the hills.
verses.textEnEsv: He covers the heavens with clouds; he prepares rain for the earth; he makes grass grow on the hills.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who covers the heavens with clouds, Who prepares rain for the earth, Who makes grass to grow on the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: He covers the heavens with clouds, provides rain for the earth, and makes the grass grow in mountain pastures.
verses.textEnNasb: It is He who covers the heavens with clouds, Who provides rain for the earth, Who makes grass sprout on the mountains.
verses.textEn: He covers the sky with clouds; he supplies the earth with rain and makes grass grow on the hills.

verses.textZh: 他把食物赐给走兽， 也赐给啼叫的小乌鸦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把食物赐给走兽， 也赐给啼叫的小乌鸦。
verses.textZhCuv: 他赐食给走兽 和啼叫的小乌鸦。
verses.textEnNiv: He provides food for the cattle and for the young ravens when they call.
verses.textEnEsv: He gives to the beasts their food, and to the young ravens that cry.
verses.textEnNkjv: He gives to the beast its food, And to the young ravens that cry.
verses.textEnNlt: He gives food to the wild animals and feeds the young ravens when they cry.
verses.textEnNasb: It is He who gives an animal its food, And feeds young ravens that cry.
verses.textEn: He provides food for the cattle and for the young ravens when they call.

verses.textZh: 他喜欢的不是马的力大， 他喜悦的不是人的腿快。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他喜欢的不是马的力大， 他喜悦的不是人的腿快。
verses.textZhCuv: 他不喜悦马的力大， 不喜爱人的腿快。
verses.textEnNiv: His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse, nor his delight in the legs of the warrior;
verses.textEnEsv: His delight is not in the strength of the horse, nor his pleasure in the legs of a man,
verses.textEnNkjv: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.textEnNlt: He takes no pleasure in the strength of a horse or in human might.
verses.textEnNasb: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He does not take pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.textEn: His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse, nor his delight in the legs of the warrior;

verses.textZh: 耶和华喜悦敬畏他的人， 喜悦仰望他慈爱的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华喜悦敬畏他的人， 喜悦仰望他慈爱的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华喜爱敬畏他 和盼望他慈爱的人。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord delights in those who fear him, who put their hope in his unfailing love.
verses.textEnEsv: but the Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear Him, In those who hope in His mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: No, the Lord ’s delight is in those who fear him, those who put their hope in his unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord favors those who fear Him, Those who wait for His faithfulness.
verses.textEn: the Lord delights in those who fear him, who put their hope in his unfailing love.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷啊！你要颂赞耶和华； 锡安哪！你要赞美你的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷啊！你要颂赞耶和华； 锡安哪！你要赞美你的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷啊，你要颂赞耶和华！ 锡安哪，你要赞美你的神！
verses.textEnNiv: Extol the Lord , Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord , O Jerusalem! Praise your God, O Zion!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem! Praise your God, O Zion!
verses.textEnNlt: Glorify the Lord , O Jerusalem! Praise your God, O Zion!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
verses.textEn: Extol the Lord , Jerusalem; praise your God, Zion.

verses.textZh: 因为他坚固了你城门的门闩， 赐福在你中间的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他坚固了你城门的门闩， 赐福在你中间的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他坚固了你的门闩， 赐福给你中间的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your people within you.
verses.textEnEsv: For he strengthens the bars of your gates; he blesses your children within you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He has strengthened the bars of your gates; He has blessed your children within you.
verses.textEnNlt: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates and blessed your children within your walls.
verses.textEnNasb: For He has strengthened the bars of your gates; He has blessed your sons among you.
verses.textEn: He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your people within you.

verses.textZh: 他使你的边界平靖； 用上好的麦子使你饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使你的边界平靖； 用上好的麦子使你饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使你境内平安， 用上好的麦子使你满足。
verses.textEnNiv: He grants peace to your borders and satisfies you with the finest of wheat.
verses.textEnEsv: He makes peace in your borders; he fills you with the finest of the wheat.
verses.textEnNkjv: He makes peace in your borders, And fills you with the finest wheat.
verses.textEnNlt: He sends peace across your nation and satisfies your hunger with the finest wheat.
verses.textEnNasb: He makes peace in your borders; He satisfies you with the finest of the wheat.
verses.textEn: He grants peace to your borders and satisfies you with the finest of wheat.

verses.textZh: 他向地发出命令， 他的话迅速颁行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向地发出命令， 他的话迅速颁行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他发命在地； 他的话颁行最快。
verses.textEnNiv: He sends his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.
verses.textEnEsv: He sends out his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sends out His command tothe earth; His word runs very swiftly.
verses.textEnNlt: He sends his orders to the world— how swiftly his word flies!
verses.textEnNasb: He sends His command to the earth; His word runs very swiftly.
verses.textEn: He sends his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.

verses.textZh: 他降下像羊毛一样的雪， 撒下像炉灰一样的霜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他降下像羊毛一样的雪， 撒下像炉灰一样的霜。
verses.textZhCuv: 他降雪如羊毛， 撒霜如炉灰。
verses.textEnNiv: He spreads the snow like wool and scatters the frost like ashes.
verses.textEnEsv: He gives snow like wool; he scatters frost like ashes.
verses.textEnNkjv: He gives snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
verses.textEnNlt: He sends the snow like white wool; he scatters frost upon the ground like ashes.
verses.textEnNasb: He showers snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes.
verses.textEn: He spreads the snow like wool and scatters the frost like ashes.

verses.textZh: 他拋下像碎屑一样的冰雹； 面对他发出的寒冷，谁能承受得起呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拋下像碎屑一样的冰雹； 面对他发出的寒冷，谁能承受得起呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他掷下冰雹如碎渣； 他发出寒冷，谁能当得起呢？
verses.textEnNiv: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can withstand his icy blast?
verses.textEnEsv: He hurls down his crystals of ice like crumbs; who can stand before his cold?
verses.textEnNkjv: He casts out His hail like morsels; Who can stand before His cold?
verses.textEnNlt: He hurls the hail like stones. Who can stand against his freezing cold?
verses.textEnNasb: He hurls His ice as fragments; Who can stand before His cold?
verses.textEn: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can withstand his icy blast?

verses.textZh: 他发出命令，这一切就都融化； 他使风刮起，水就流动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他发出命令，这一切就都融化； 他使风刮起，水就流动。
verses.textZhCuv: 他一出令，这些就都消化； 他使风刮起，水便流动。
verses.textEnNiv: He sends his word and melts them; he stirs up his breezes, and the waters flow.
verses.textEnEsv: He sends out his word, and melts them; he makes his wind blow and the waters flow.
verses.textEnNkjv: He sends out His word and melts them; He causes His wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, at his command, it all melts. He sends his winds, and the ice thaws.
verses.textEnNasb: He sends His word and makes them melt; He makes His wind blow, and the waters flow.
verses.textEn: He sends his word and melts them; he stirs up his breezes, and the waters flow.

verses.textZh: 他把自己的话向雅各颁布， 把自己的律例和典章向以色列颁布。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把自己的话向雅各颁布， 把自己的律例和典章向以色列颁布。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将他的道指示雅各， 将他的律例典章指示以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: He has revealed his word to Jacob, his laws and decrees to Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: He declares his word to Jacob, his statutes and rules to Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: He has revealed his words to Jacob, his decrees and regulations to Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: He declares His words to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.
verses.textEn: He has revealed his word to Jacob, his laws and decrees to Israel.

verses.textZh: 他从没有这样对待其他各国； 他们都不知道他的典章。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从没有这样对待其他各国； 他们都不知道他的典章。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 别国他都没有这样待过； 至于他的典章，他们向来没有知道。 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know his laws. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He has not dealt thus with any other nation; they do not know his rules. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: He has not dealt thus with any nation; And asforHis judgments, they have not known them. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: He has not done this for any other nation; they do not know his regulations. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: He has not dealt this way with any other nation; And as for His judgments, they have not known them. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know his laws. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华。 你们要从天上赞美耶和华， 在高天赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华。 你们要从天上赞美耶和华， 在高天赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 从天上赞美耶和华， 在高处赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise him in the heights above.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise him in the heights!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord from the heavens; Praise Him in the heights!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord from the heavens! Praise him from the skies!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord from the heavens; Praise Him in the heights!
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise him in the heights above.

verses.textZh: 他的众使者啊！你们要赞美他； 他的众军啊！你们也要赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的众使者啊！你们要赞美他； 他的众军啊！你们也要赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的众使者都要赞美他！ 他的诸军都要赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his heavenly hosts.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his hosts!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise Him, all His angels; Praise Him, all His hosts!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all the armies of heaven!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise Him, all His angels; Praise Him, all His heavenly armies!
verses.textEn: Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his heavenly hosts.

verses.textZh: 太阳和月亮啊！你们要赞美他； 光亮的星星啊！你们都要赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 太阳和月亮啊！你们要赞美他； 光亮的星星啊！你们都要赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 日头月亮，你们要赞美他！ 放光的星宿，你们都要赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all you shining stars.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise him, sun and moon, praise him, all you shining stars!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all you stars of light!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you twinkling stars!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all stars of light!
verses.textEn: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all you shining stars.

verses.textZh: 天上的天啊！你们要赞美他。 天上的水啊！你们要赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天上的天啊！你们要赞美他。 天上的水啊！你们要赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 天上的天和天上的水， 你们都要赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise him, you highest heavens and you waters above the skies.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise him, you highest heavens, and you waters above the heavens!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise Him, you heavens of heavens, And you waters above the heavens!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise him, skies above! Praise him, vapors high above the clouds!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise Him, highest heavens, And the waters that are above the heavens!
verses.textEn: Praise him, you highest heavens and you waters above the skies.

verses.textZh: 愿这一切都赞美耶和华的名， 因为他一发令，它们就都造成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿这一切都赞美耶和华的名， 因为他一发令，它们就都造成。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！ 因他一吩咐便都造成。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for at his command they were created,
verses.textEnEsv: Let them praise the name of the Lord ! For he commanded and they were created.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them praise the name of the Lord, For He commanded and they were created.
verses.textEnNlt: Let every created thing give praise to the Lord , for he issued his command, and they came into being.
verses.textEnNasb: They are to praise the name of the Lord, For He commanded and they were created.
verses.textEn: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for at his command they were created,

verses.textZh: 他把它们立定，直到永永远远； 他立了定律，永不废去 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把它们立定，直到永永远远； 他立了定律，永不废去 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将这些立定，直到永永远远； 他定了命，不能废去 。
verses.textEnNiv: and he established them for ever and ever— he issued a decree that will never pass away.
verses.textEnEsv: And he established them forever and ever; he gave a decree, and it shall not pass away.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also established them forever and ever; He made a decree which shall not pass away.
verses.textEnNlt: He set them in place forever and ever. His decree will never be revoked.
verses.textEnNasb: He has also established them forever and ever; He has made a decree, and it will not pass away.
verses.textEn: and he established them for ever and ever— he issued a decree that will never pass away.

verses.textZh: 你们要从地上赞美耶和华。 海怪和一切深海，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要从地上赞美耶和华。 海怪和一切深海，
verses.textZhCuv: 所有在地上的， 大鱼和一切深洋，
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord from the earth, you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord from the earth, you great sea creatures and all deeps,
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord from the earth, You great sea creatures and all the depths;
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord from the earth, you creatures of the ocean depths,
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord from the earth, Sea monsters, and all the ocean depths;
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord from the earth, you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,

verses.textZh: 火和冰雹，雪和云雾， 执行他命令的狂风，
verses.textZhCnvs: 火和冰雹，雪和云雾， 执行他命令的狂风，
verses.textZhCuv: 火与冰雹，雪和雾气， 成就他命的狂风，
verses.textEnNiv: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy winds that do his bidding,
verses.textEnEsv: fire and hail, snow and mist, stormy wind fulfilling his word!
verses.textEnNkjv: Fire and hail, snow and clouds; Stormy wind, fulfilling His word;
verses.textEnNlt: fire and hail, snow and clouds, wind and weather that obey him,
verses.textEnNasb: Fire and hail, snow and clouds; Stormy wind, fulfilling His word;
verses.textEn: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy winds that do his bidding,

verses.textZh: 大山和一切小山， 果树和一切香柏树，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大山和一切小山， 果树和一切香柏树，
verses.textZhCuv: 大山和小山， 结果的树木和一切香柏树，
verses.textEnNiv: you mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
verses.textEnEsv: Mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars!
verses.textEnNkjv: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;
verses.textEnNlt: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
verses.textEnNasb: Mountains and all hills; Fruit trees and all cedars;
verses.textEn: you mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

verses.textZh: 野兽和一切牲畜， 爬行的动物和飞鸟，
verses.textZhCnvs: 野兽和一切牲畜， 爬行的动物和飞鸟，
verses.textZhCuv: 野兽和一切牲畜， 昆虫和飞鸟，
verses.textEnNiv: wild animals and all cattle, small creatures and flying birds,
verses.textEnEsv: Beasts and all livestock, creeping things and flying birds!
verses.textEnNkjv: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying fowl;
verses.textEnNlt: wild animals and all livestock, small scurrying animals and birds,
verses.textEnNasb: Animals and all cattle; Crawling things and winged fowl;
verses.textEn: wild animals and all cattle, small creatures and flying birds,

verses.textZh: 地上的君王和万族的人民， 领袖和地上所有的审判官，
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上的君王和万族的人民， 领袖和地上所有的审判官，
verses.textZhCuv: 世上的君王和万民， 首领和世上一切审判官，
verses.textEnNiv: kings of the earth and all nations, you princes and all rulers on earth,
verses.textEnEsv: Kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth!
verses.textEnNkjv: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;
verses.textEnNlt: kings of the earth and all people, rulers and judges of the earth,
verses.textEnNasb: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Rulers and all judges of the earth;
verses.textEn: kings of the earth and all nations, you princes and all rulers on earth,

verses.textZh: 少男和少女， 老年人和孩童，
verses.textZhCnvs: 少男和少女， 老年人和孩童，
verses.textZhCuv: 少年人和处女， 老年人和孩童， 都当赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: young men and women, old men and children.
verses.textEnEsv: Young men and maidens together, old men and children!
verses.textEnNkjv: Both young men and maidens; Old men and children.
verses.textEnNlt: young men and young women, old men and children.
verses.textEnNasb: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children.
verses.textEn: young men and women, old men and children.

verses.textZh: 愿这一切都赞美耶和华的名， 因为独有他的名被尊崇， 他的荣耀超越天地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿这一切都赞美耶和华的名， 因为独有他的名被尊崇， 他的荣耀超越天地。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！ 因为独有他的名被尊崇； 他的荣耀在天地之上。
verses.textEnNiv: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for his name alone is exalted; his majesty is above earth and heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them praise the name of the Lord, For His name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them all praise the name of the Lord . For his name is very great; his glory towers over the earth and heaven!
verses.textEnNasb: They are to praise the name of the Lord, For His name alone is exalted; His majesty is above earth and heaven.
verses.textEn: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.

verses.textZh: 他使自己子民的角得以高举 ， 他所有的圣民，就是和他接近的以色列人，都赞美他。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使自己子民的角得以高举 ， 他所有的圣民，就是和他接近的以色列人，都赞美他。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将他百姓的角高举， 因此他 一切圣民以色列人， 就是与他相近的百姓，都赞美他！ 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: And he has raised up for his people a horn, the praise of all his faithful servants, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He has raised up a horn for his people, praise for all his saints, for the people of Israel who are near to him. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: And He has exalted the horn of His people, The praise of all His saints— Of the children of Israel, A people near to Him. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: He has made his people strong, honoring his faithful ones— the people of Israel who are close to him. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: And He has lifted up a horn for His people, Praise for all His godly ones, For the sons of Israel, a people near to Him. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: And he has raised up for his people a horn, the praise of all his faithful servants, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华， 要向耶和华唱新歌， 在圣民的会中赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华， 要向耶和华唱新歌， 在圣民的会中赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 向耶和华唱新歌， 在圣民的会中赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise in the assembly of his faithful people.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise in the assembly of the godly!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! Sing to the Lord a new song, And His praise in the assembly of saints.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! Sing to the Lord a new song. Sing his praises in the assembly of the faithful.
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! Sing a new song to the Lord, And His praise in the congregation of the godly ones.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise in the assembly of his faithful people.

verses.textZh: 愿以色列因造他的主欢喜， 愿锡安的居民因他们的王快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿以色列因造他的主欢喜， 愿锡安的居民因他们的王快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿以色列因造他的主欢喜！ 愿锡安的民因他们的王快乐！
verses.textEnNiv: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.
verses.textEnEsv: Let Israel be glad in his Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.textEnNlt: O Israel, rejoice in your Maker. O people of Jerusalem, exult in your King.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel shall be joyful in his Maker; The sons of Zion shall rejoice in their King.
verses.textEn: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.

verses.textZh: 愿他们一边跳舞，一边赞美他的名， 击鼓弹琴歌颂他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们一边跳舞，一边赞美他的名， 击鼓弹琴歌颂他。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们跳舞赞美他的名， 击鼓弹琴歌颂他！
verses.textEnNiv: Let them praise his name with dancing and make music to him with timbrel and harp.
verses.textEnEsv: Let them praise his name with dancing, making melody to him with tambourine and lyre!
verses.textEnNkjv: Let them praise His name with the dance; Let them sing praises to Him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.textEnNlt: Praise his name with dancing, accompanied by tambourine and harp.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall praise His name with dancing; They shall sing praises to Him with tambourine and lyre.
verses.textEn: Let them praise his name with dancing and make music to him with timbrel and harp.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华喜悦自己的子民， 以救恩给谦卑的人作装饰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华喜悦自己的子民， 以救恩给谦卑的人作装饰。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华喜爱他的百姓； 他要用救恩当作谦卑人的妆饰。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with victory.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people; he adorns the humble with salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord takes pleasure in His people; He will beautify the humble with salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord delights in his people; he crowns the humble with victory.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord takes pleasure in His people; He will glorify the lowly with salvation.
verses.textEn: For the Lord takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with victory.

verses.textZh: 愿圣民因所得的荣耀高兴， 愿他们在床上欢呼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿圣民因所得的荣耀高兴， 愿他们在床上欢呼。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿圣民因所得的荣耀高兴！ 愿他们在床上欢呼！
verses.textEnNiv: Let his faithful people rejoice in this honor and sing for joy on their beds.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the godly exult in glory; let them sing for joy on their beds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the saints be joyful in glory; Let them sing aloud on their beds.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the faithful rejoice that he honors them. Let them sing for joy as they lie on their beds.
verses.textEnNasb: The godly ones shall be jubilant in glory; They shall sing for joy on their beds.
verses.textEn: Let his faithful people rejoice in this honor and sing for joy on their beds.

verses.textZh: 愿称赞神的话常在他们口中； 愿他们手里拿着两刃的剑，
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿称赞神的话常在他们口中； 愿他们手里拿着两刃的剑，
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们口中称赞神为高， 手里有两刃的刀，
verses.textEnNiv: May the praise of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands,
verses.textEnEsv: Let the high praises of God be in their throats and two-edged swords in their hands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand,
verses.textEnNlt: Let the praises of God be in their mouths, and a sharp sword in their hands—
verses.textEnNasb: The high praises of God shall be in their mouths, And a two-edged sword in their hands,
verses.textEn: May the praise of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands,

verses.textZh: 为要报复列国， 惩罚万民；
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要报复列国， 惩罚万民；
verses.textZhCuv: 为要报复列邦， 刑罚万民。
verses.textEnNiv: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
verses.textEnEsv: to execute vengeance on the nations and punishments on the peoples,
verses.textEnNkjv: To execute vengeance on the nations, And punishments on the peoples;
verses.textEnNlt: to execute vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
verses.textEnNasb: To execute vengeance on the nations, And punishment on the peoples,
verses.textEn: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,

verses.textZh: 用锁炼捆住他们的君王， 用铁镣锁住他们的权贵，
verses.textZhCnvs: 用锁炼捆住他们的君王， 用铁镣锁住他们的权贵，
verses.textZhCuv: 要用链子捆他们的君王， 用铁镣锁他们的大臣；
verses.textEnNiv: to bind their kings with fetters, their nobles with shackles of iron,
verses.textEnEsv: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with fetters of iron,
verses.textEnNkjv: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.textEnNlt: to bind their kings with shackles and their leaders with iron chains,
verses.textEnNasb: To bind their kings with chains, And their dignitaries with shackles of iron,
verses.textEn: to bind their kings with fetters, their nobles with shackles of iron,

verses.textZh: 要在他们身上施行记录在册上的审判。 这就是他所有圣民的尊荣。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要在他们身上施行记录在册上的审判。 这就是他所有圣民的尊荣。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 要在他们身上施行所记录的审判。 他的圣民都有这荣耀。 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: to carry out the sentence written against them— this is the glory of all his faithful people. Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: to execute on them the judgment written! This is honor for all his godly ones. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: To execute on them the written judgment— This honor have all His saints. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: to execute the judgment written against them. This is the glorious privilege of his faithful ones. Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: To execute against them the judgment written. This is an honor for all His godly ones. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: to carry out the sentence written against them— this is the glory of all his faithful people. Praise the Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要赞美耶和华。 要在神的圣所赞美他， 要在他显能力的穹苍下赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赞美耶和华。 要在神的圣所赞美他， 要在他显能力的穹苍下赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 在神的圣所赞美他！ 在他显能力的穹苍赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise the Lord . Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise the Lord ! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise the Lord! Praise God in His sanctuary; Praise Him in His mighty firmament!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord ! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heaven!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise the Lord! Praise God in His sanctuary; Praise Him in His mighty expanse.
verses.textEn: Praise the Lord . Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens.

verses.textZh: 要因他大能的作为赞美他， 要因他无限的伟大赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要因他大能的作为赞美他， 要因他无限的伟大赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 要因他大能的作为赞美他， 按着他极美的大德赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise him for his mighty deeds; praise him according to his excellent greatness!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise Him for His mighty acts; Praise Him according to His excellent greatness!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise him for his mighty works; praise his unequaled greatness!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise Him for His mighty deeds; Praise Him according to His excellent greatness.
verses.textEn: Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.

verses.textZh: 要吹角赞美他， 要鼓瑟弹琴赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要吹角赞美他， 要鼓瑟弹琴赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用角声赞美他， 鼓瑟弹琴赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet, praise him with the harp and lyre,
verses.textEnEsv: Praise him with trumpet sound; praise him with lute and harp!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; Praise Him with the lute and harp!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise him with a blast of the ram’s horn; praise him with the lyre and harp!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise Him with trumpet sound; Praise Him with harp and lyre.
verses.textEn: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet, praise him with the harp and lyre,

verses.textZh: 要击鼓跳舞赞美他， 要弹奏丝弦的乐器和吹箫赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要击鼓跳舞赞美他， 要弹奏丝弦的乐器和吹箫赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 击鼓跳舞赞美他！ 用丝弦的乐器和箫的声音赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: praise him with timbrel and dancing, praise him with the strings and pipe,
verses.textEnEsv: Praise him with tambourine and dance; praise him with strings and pipe!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; Praise Him with stringed instruments and flutes!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise him with the tambourine and dancing; praise him with strings and flutes!
verses.textEnNasb: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; Praise Him with stringed instruments and flute.
verses.textEn: praise him with timbrel and dancing, praise him with the strings and pipe,

verses.textZh: 要用声音洪亮的钹赞美他， 要用声音铿锵的钹赞美他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要用声音洪亮的钹赞美他， 要用声音铿锵的钹赞美他。
verses.textZhCuv: 用大响的钹赞美他！ 用高声的钹赞美他！
verses.textEnNiv: praise him with the clash of cymbals, praise him with resounding cymbals.
verses.textEnEsv: Praise him with sounding cymbals; praise him with loud clashing cymbals!
verses.textEnNkjv: Praise Him with loud cymbals; Praise Him with clashing cymbals!
verses.textEnNlt: Praise him with a clash of cymbals; praise him with loud clanging cymbals.
verses.textEnNasb: Praise Him with loud cymbals; Praise Him with resounding cymbals.
verses.textEn: praise him with the clash of cymbals, praise him with resounding cymbals.

verses.textZh: 凡有气息的，都要赞美耶和华。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡有气息的，都要赞美耶和华。 你们要赞美耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！ 你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.textEnNiv: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord . Praise the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNkjv: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Let everything that breathes sing praises to the Lord ! Praise the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Everything that has breath shall praise the Lord. Praise the Lord!
verses.textEn: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord . Praise the Lord .
